chapter: Chapter on the Deeds to Be Attained on Night of Friday and Its Day
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ya‘qub, from a number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Hammad ibn Isa, from al-Husayn ibn al-Mukhtar, from Abu Basir, who said:
Abu Basir heard Abu Ja’far (a.s) say: “The sun has not risen on a day better than the day of Friday.”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عِدَّةٍ مِنْ أَصْحَابِنَا عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ اَلْمُخْتَارِ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ يَقُولُ مَا طَلَعَتِ اَلشَّمْسُ بِيَوْمٍ أَفْضَلَ مِنْ يَوْمِ اَلْجُمُعَةِ
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ya‘qub, from a number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Hammad ibn Isa, from al-Husayn ibn al-Mukhtar, from Abu Basir, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Basir heard Abu Ja’far (a.s) say: “The sun has not risen on a day better than the day of Friday.”

chapter: Chapter on the Deeds to Be Attained on Night of Friday and Its Day
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Ali ibn Muhammad, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ibn Abi Nasr, from Abu al-Hasan al-Ridha (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Ridha (a.s) said: “The Messenger of Allah (swt), peace and blessings be upon him and his family, said: ‘Indeed, the day of Friday is the master of days. Good deeds are multiplied in it, and evil deeds are erased in it, and ranks are elevated in it, and supplications are answered in it, and afflictions are removed in it, and great needs are fulfilled in it. It is the Day of Increase. In it, Allah (swt) has freed ones and released ones from the Fire. No one among the people supplicates to Allah (swt) on that day, while recognizing its right and sanctity, except that it is an obligation upon Allah (swt), the Mighty and Majestic, to make him among those He (azj) has freed and released from the Fire. And if he dies on its day or its night, he dies as a martyr and is raised secure. And no one treats its sanctity lightly or neglects its right except that it becomes an obligation upon Allah (swt), the Mighty and Majestic, to make him enter the Fire of Hell, unless he repents.’”
arabicText: وَعَنْهُ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي نَصْرٍ عَنْ أَبِي اَلْحَسَنِ اَلرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ إِنَّ يَوْمَ اَلْجُمُعَةِ سَيِّدُ اَلْأَيَّامِ يُضَاعِفُ فِيهِ اَلْحَسَنَاتِ وَيَمْحُو فِيهِ اَلسَّيِّئَاتِ وَيَرْفَعُ فِيهِ اَلدَّرَجَاتِ وَيَسْتَجِيبُ فِيهِ اَلدَّعَوَاتِ وَيَكْشِفُ فِيهِ اَلْكُرُبَاتِ وَيَقْضِي فِيهِ اَلْحَاجَاتِ اَلْعِظَامَ وَهُوَ يَوْمُ اَلْمَزِيدِ لِلَّهِ فِيهِ عُتَقَاءُ وَطُلَقَاءُ مِنَ اَلنَّارِ مَا دَعَا اَللَّهَ فِيهِ أَحَدٌ مِنَ اَلنَّاسِ وَعَرَفَ حَقَّهُ وَحُرْمَتَهُ إِلاَّ كَانَ حَقّاً عَلَى اَللَّهِ عَزَّوَ جَلَّ أَنْ يَجْعَلَهُ مِنْ عُتَقَائِهِ وَطُلَقَائِهِ مِنَ اَلنَّارِ وَإِنْ مَاتَ فِي يَوْمِهِ أَوْ لَيْلَتِهِ مَاتَ شَهِيداً وَبُعِثَ آمِناً وَمَا اِسْتَخَفَّ أَحَدٌ بِحُرْمَتِهِ وَضَيَّعَ حَقَّهُ إِلاَّ كَانَ حَقّاً عَلَى اَللَّهِ عَزَّوَ جَلَّ أَنْ يُصْلِيَهُ نَارَ جَهَنَّمَ إِلاَّ أَنْ يَتُوبَ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Ali ibn Muhammad, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ibn Abi Nasr, from Abu al-Hasan al-Ridha (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Ridha (a.s) said: “The Messenger of Allah (swt), peace and blessings be upon him and his family, said: ‘Indeed, the day of Friday is the master of days. Good deeds are multiplied in it, and evil deeds are erased in it, and ranks are elevated in it, and supplications are answered in it, and afflictions are removed in it, and great needs are fulfilled in it. It is the Day of Increase. In it, Allah (swt) has freed ones and released ones from the Fire. No one among the people supplicates to Allah (swt) on that day, while recognizing its right and sanctity, except that it is an obligation upon Allah (swt), the Mighty and Majestic, to make him among those He (azj) has freed and released from the Fire. And if he dies on its day or its night, he dies as a martyr and is raised secure. And no one treats its sanctity lightly or neglects its right except that it becomes an obligation upon Allah (swt), the Mighty and Majestic, to make him enter the Fire of Hell, unless he repents.’”

chapter: Chapter on the Deeds to Be Attained on Night of Friday and Its Day
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Abdillah ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Aban, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “Indeed, Friday has a right and a sanctity, so beware that you waste it or fall short in anything from the worship of Allah (swt), the Exalted, and in drawing near to Him (azj) through righteous deeds and complete abandonment of all forbidden things. For indeed, Allah (swt) multiplies good deeds in it, and erases evil deeds in it, and elevates ranks in it.” He (Aban) said that Imam (a.s) mentioned: “Indeed, its day is like its night.” Imam (a.s) said: “So if you are able to enliven it with prayer and supplication, then do so. For indeed, your Lord (azj) descends from the beginning of the night of Friday to the heaven of the world, and He (azj) multiplies good deeds in it and erases evil deeds in it. Verily, Allah (swt) is All-Encompassing, Generous.”
arabicText: وَعَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ اَلْحَكَمِ عَنْ أَبَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ إِنَّ لِلْجُمُعَةِ حَقّاً وَحُرْمَةً فَإِيَّاكَ أَنْ تُضَيِّعَ أَوْ تُقَصِّرَ فِي شَيْءٍ مِنْ عِبَادَةِ اَللَّهِ تَعَالَى وَاَلتَّقَرُّبِ إِلَيْهِ بِالْعَمَلِ اَلصَّالِحِ وَتَرْكِ اَلْمَحَارِمِ كُلِّهَا فَإِنَّ اَللَّهَ يُضَاعِفُ فِيهِ اَلْحَسَنَاتِ وَيَمْحُو فِيهِ اَلسَّيِّئَاتِ وَيَرْفَعُ فِيهِ اَلدَّرَجَاتِ» قَالَ وَ ذَكَرَ أَنَّ يَوْمَهُ مِثْلُ لَيْلَتِهِ» قَالَ فَإِنِ اِسْتَطَعْتَ أَنْ تُحْيِيَهُ بِالصَّلاَةِ وَاَلدُّعَاءِ فَافْعَلْ فَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَنْزِلُ مِنْ أَوَّلِ لَيْلَةِ اَلْجُمُعَةِ إِلَى سَمَاءِ اَلدُّنْيَا فَيُضَاعِفُ فِيهِ اَلْحَسَنَاتِ وَيَمْحُو فِيهِ اَلسَّيِّئَاتِ فَإِنَّ اَللَّهَ وَاسِعٌ كَرِيمٌ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Abdillah ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Aban, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “Indeed, Friday has a right and a sanctity, so beware that you waste it or fall short in anything from the worship of Allah (swt), the Exalted, and in drawing near to Him (azj) through righteous deeds and complete abandonment of all forbidden things. For indeed, Allah (swt) multiplies good deeds in it, and erases evil deeds in it, and elevates ranks in it.” He (Aban) said that Imam (a.s) mentioned: “Indeed, its day is like its night.” Imam (a.s) said: “So if you are able to enliven it with prayer and supplication, then do so. For indeed, your Lord (azj) descends from the beginning of the night of Friday to the heaven of the world, and He (azj) multiplies good deeds in it and erases evil deeds in it. Verily, Allah (swt) is All-Encompassing, Generous.”

chapter: Chapter on the Deeds to Be Attained on Night of Friday and Its Day
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn Musa, from al-Abbas ibn Maruf, from Ibn Abi Najran, from Abdillah ibn Sinan, from Ibn Abi Yafur, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
A man asked Imam al-Baqir (a.s): “Why was Friday named ‘al-Jumu’ah’ (the gathering)?” Imam (a.s) said: “Indeed, Allah (swt), the Mighty and Majestic, gathered His (azj) creation on that day for the allegiance (wilayah) of Muhammad (saws), peace be upon him and his family, and his successor (Imam Ali (a.s)), during the covenant (al-mithaq). So He (azj) named it the ‘Day of Gathering’ (Yawm al-Jumu’ah) because He (azj) gathered His (azj) creation on it.”
arabicText: وَعَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُوسَى عَنِ اَلْعَبَّاسِ بْنِ مَعْرُوفٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي نَجْرَانَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي يَعْفُورٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ قَالَ لَهُ رَجُلٌ كَيْفَ سُمِّيَتِ اَلْجُمُعَةُ بِالْجُمُعَةِ قَالَ إِنَّ اَللَّهَ عَزَّوَجَلَّ جَمَعَ فِيهَا خَلْقَهُ لِوَلاَيَةِ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ وَوَصِيِّهِ فِي اَلْمِيثَاقِ فَسَمَّاهُ يَوْمَ اَلْجُمُعَةِ لِجَمْعِهِ فِيهِ خَلْقَهُ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn Musa, from al-Abbas ibn Maruf, from Ibn Abi Najran, from Abdillah ibn Sinan, from Ibn Abi Yafur, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: A man asked Imam al-Baqir (a.s): “Why was Friday named ‘al-Jumu’ah’ (the gathering)?” Imam (a.s) said: “Indeed, Allah (swt), the Mighty and Majestic, gathered His (azj) creation on that day for the allegiance (wilayah) of Muhammad (saws), peace be upon him and his family, and his successor (Imam Ali (a.s)), during the covenant (al-mithaq). So He (azj) named it the ‘Day of Gathering’ (Yawm al-Jumu’ah) because He (azj) gathered His (azj) creation on it.”

chapter: Chapter on the Deeds to Be Attained on Night of Friday and Its Day
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Ali ibn al-Numan, from Umar ibn Yazid, from Jabir, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Baqir (a.s) was asked about the day of Friday and its night. Imam (a.s) said: “Its night is a radiant night, and its day is a luminous day. There is no day on the face of the earth in which the sun sets with more people being spared from the Fire than on the day of Friday. Whoever dies on the day of Friday, while recognizing the right of the people of this House (Ahlulbayt (a.s)), Allah (swt) will write for him a release from the Fire and a release from the punishment of the grave. And whoever dies on the night of Friday will be freed from the Fire.”
arabicText: وَعَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ اَلنُّعْمَانِ عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ عَنْ جَابِرٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ سُئِلَ عَنْ يَوْمِ اَلْجُمُعَةِ وَلَيْلَتِهَا فَقَالَ لَيْلَتُهَا لَيْلَةٌ غَرَّاءُ وَيَوْمُهَا يَوْمٌ أَزْهَرُ وَلَيْسَ عَلَى وَجْهِ اَلْأَرْضِ يَوْمٌ تَغْرُبُ فِيهِ اَلشَّمْسُ أَكْثَرَ مُعَافًى مِنَ اَلنَّارِ مَنْ مَاتَ يَوْمَ اَلْجُمُعَةِ عَارِفاً بِحَقِّ أَهْلِ هَذَا اَلْبَيْتِ كَتَبَ اَللَّهُ لَهُ بَرَاءَةً مِنَ اَلنَّارِ وَبَرَاءَةً مِنْ عَذَابِ اَلْقَبْرِ وَمَنْ مَاتَ لَيْلَةَ اَلْجُمُعَةِ عَتَقَ مِنَ اَلنَّارِ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Ali ibn al-Numan, from Umar ibn Yazid, from Jabir, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Baqir (a.s) was asked about the day of Friday and its night. Imam (a.s) said: “Its night is a radiant night, and its day is a luminous day. There is no day on the face of the earth in which the sun sets with more people being spared from the Fire than on the day of Friday. Whoever dies on the day of Friday, while recognizing the right of the people of this House (Ahlulbayt (a.s)), Allah (swt) will write for him a release from the Fire and a release from the punishment of the grave. And whoever dies on the night of Friday will be freed from the Fire.”

chapter: Chapter on the Deeds to Be Attained on Night of Friday and Its Day
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Khalid, from al-Nadr ibn Suwayd, from Abdillah ibn Sinan, who said:
Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: “Allah (swt) has given superiority to Friday over other days, and indeed the Gardens (of Paradise) are adorned and beautified on the day of Friday for those who come to it. For you will race toward Paradise in accordance with how early you race to Friday, and indeed the gates of the heaven are opened for the ascent of the deeds of the servants.”
arabicText: وَعَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ عَنِ اَلنَّضْرِ بْنِ سُوَيْدٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ فَضَّلَ اَللَّهُ اَلْجُمُعَةَ عَلَى غَيْرِهَا مِنَ اَلْأَيَّامِ وَإِنَّ اَلْجِنَانَ لَتُزَخْرَفُ وَتُزَيَّنُ يَوْمَ اَلْجُمُعَةِ لِمَنْ أَتَاهَا فَإِنَّكُمْ تَتَسَابَقُونَ إِلَى اَلْجَنَّةِ عَلَى قَدْرِ سَبْقِكُمْ إِلَى اَلْجُمُعَةِ وَإِنَّ أَبْوَابَ اَلسَّمَاءِ لَتُفَتَّحُ لِصُعُودِ أَعْمَالِ اَلْعِبَادِ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Khalid, from al-Nadr ibn Suwayd, from Abdillah ibn Sinan, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: “Allah (swt) has given superiority to Friday over other days, and indeed the Gardens (of Paradise) are adorned and beautified on the day of Friday for those who come to it. For you will race toward Paradise in accordance with how early you race to Friday, and indeed the gates of the heaven are opened for the ascent of the deeds of the servants.”

chapter: Chapter on the Deeds to Be Attained on Night of Friday and Its Day
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Husayn ibn Said, from Ibrahim ibn Abi al-Bilad, from one of his companions, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, or Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “The sun has not risen on a day better than the day of Friday. Indeed, the speech of the birds on it, when they meet one another, is: ‘Peace, peace, and a righteous day’.”
arabicText: وَعَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ أَبِي اَلْبِلاَدِ عَنْ بَعْضِ أَصْحَابِهِ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ أَوْ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ مَا طَلَعَتِ اَلشَّمْسُ بِيَوْمٍ أَفْضَلَ مِنْ يَوْمِ اَلْجُمُعَةِ وَإِنَّ كَلاَمَ اَلطَّيْرِ فِيهِ إِذَا لَقِيَ بَعْضُهَا بَعْضاً سَلاَمٌ سَلاَمٌ وَيَوْمٌ صَالِحٌ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Husayn ibn Said, from Ibrahim ibn Abi al-Bilad, from one of his companions, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, or Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “The sun has not risen on a day better than the day of Friday. Indeed, the speech of the birds on it, when they meet one another, is: ‘Peace, peace, and a righteous day’.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 5

chapter: Chapter on the Deeds to Be Attained on Night of Friday and Its Day
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Abi Nasr, from Muawiyah ibn Ammar, who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “The hour on the day of Friday during which no believing person supplicates except that it is answered, (when) is it?” Imam (a.s) said: “Yes, (it is) when the Imam comes out.” I asked: “But the Imam may come out early or late.” Imam (a.s) said: “When the sun passes the meridian (when it declines from its zenith).”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي نَصْرٍ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ قَالَ قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ اَلسَّاعَةُ اَلَّتِي فِي يَوْمِ اَلْجُمُعَةِ اَلَّتِي لاَ يَدْعُو فِيهَا مُؤْمِنٌ إِلاَّ اُسْتُجِيبَ لَهُ قَالَ نَعَمْ إِذَا خَرَجَ اَلْإِمَامُ» قُلْتُ إِنَّ اَلْإِمَامَ يُعَجِّلُ وَيُؤَخِّرُ قَالَ إِذَا زَاغَتِ اَلشَّمْسُ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Abi Nasr, from Muawiyah ibn Ammar, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “The hour on the day of Friday during which no believing person supplicates except that it is answered, (when) is it?” Imam (a.s) said: “Yes, (it is) when the Imam comes out.” I asked: “But the Imam may come out early or late.” Imam (a.s) said: “When the sun passes the meridian (when it declines from its zenith).”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 5

chapter: Chapter on the Deeds to Be Attained on Night of Friday and Its Day
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Ali ibn Muhammad, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Amru ibn Uthman, from Muhammad ibn Udhafir, from Umar ibn Yazid, who said:
Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said to me: “O Umar (ibn Yazid), when it is the night of Friday, angels descend from the sky in numbers equal to the particles of dust. In their hands are pens of gold and scrolls of silver. They do not write, until the night of Saturday, anything except blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws). So increase (your salawat) in it.” And Imam (a.s) said: “O Umar (Ibn Yazid), indeed it is from the Sunnah that you send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws) and the people of his household (a.s) one thousand times on every Friday, and one hundred times on the other days.”
arabicText: وَعَنْهُ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عُذَافِرٍ عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ قَالَ قَالَ لِي أَبُو عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ يَا عُمَرُ إِنَّهُ إِذَا كَانَ لَيْلَةُ اَلْجُمُعَةِ نَزَلَ مِنَ اَلسَّمَاءِ مَلاَئِكَةٌ بِعَدَدِ اَلذَّرِّ فِي أَيْدِيهِمْ أَقْلاَمُ اَلذَّهَبِ وَقَرَاطِيسُ اَلْفِضَّةِ لاَ يَكْتُبُونَ إِلَى لَيْلَةِ اَلسَّبْتِ إِلاَّ اَلصَّلاَةَ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ فَأَكْثِرُوا مِنْهَا» وَقَالَ يَا عُمَرُ إِنَّ مِنَ اَلسُّنَّةِ أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَأَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ فِي كُلِّ يَوْمِ جُمُعَةٍ أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ وَفِي سَائِرِ اَلْأَيَّامِ مِائَةَ مَرَّةٍ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Ali ibn Muhammad, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Amru ibn Uthman, from Muhammad ibn Udhafir, from Umar ibn Yazid, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said to me: “O Umar (ibn Yazid), when it is the night of Friday, angels descend from the sky in numbers equal to the particles of dust. In their hands are pens of gold and scrolls of silver. They do not write, until the night of Saturday, anything except blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws). So increase (your salawat) in it.” And Imam (a.s) said: “O Umar (Ibn Yazid), indeed it is from the Sunnah that you send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws) and the people of his household (a.s) one thousand times on every Friday, and one hundred times on the other days.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 5

chapter: Chapter on the Deeds to Be Attained on Night of Friday and Its Day
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Ahmad, from al-Husayn ibn Said, from al-Nadr ibn Suwayd, from Abdillah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “The Messenger of Allah (swt), peace be upon him and his family, used to prefer that his entering and exiting (travel or movement) during the winter be on the night of Friday.” And Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: “Indeed, Allah (swt) has chosen from everything a special part, and He (azj) has chosen from among the days; the day of Friday.”
arabicText: وَعَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ اَلنَّضْرِ بْنِ سُوَيْدٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ يَسْتَحِبُّ إِذَا دَخَلَ وَإِذَا خَرَجَ فِي اَلشِّتَاءِ أَنْ يَكُونَ فِي لَيْلَةِ اَلْجُمُعَةِ وَقَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ إِنَّ اَللَّهَ اِخْتَارَ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ شَيْئاً وَاِخْتَارَ مِنَ اَ لْأَيَّامِ يَوْمَ اَلْجُمُعَةِ
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Ahmad, from al-Husayn ibn Said, from al-Nadr ibn Suwayd, from Abdillah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “The Messenger of Allah (swt), peace be upon him and his family, used to prefer that his entering and exiting (travel or movement) during the winter be on the night of Friday.” And Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: “Indeed, Allah (swt) has chosen from everything a special part, and He (azj) has chosen from among the days; the day of Friday.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 6

chapter: Chapter on the Deeds to Be Attained on Night of Friday and Its Day
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Abu Basir narrated from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him:
Imam al-Baqir (a.s) said: “Indeed, Allah (swt), the Exalted, calls out every night of Friday from above His (azj) Throne, from the beginning of the night until its end: ‘Is there not a believing servant who will call upon Me (azj) for his Hereafter and his worldly life before the rising of dawn, so that I (azj) may answer him? Is there not a believing servant who will repent to Me (azj) from his sins before the rising of dawn, so that I (azj) may turn to him in forgiveness? Is there not a believing servant whose provision I (azj) have restricted, who will ask Me (azj) for an increase in his provision before the rising of dawn, so that I (azj) may increase it and expand it for him? Is there not a believing servant who is sick, who will ask Me (azj) to cure him before the rising of dawn, so that I (azj) may grant him well-being? Is there not a believing servant who is imprisoned, distressed, who will ask Me (azj) to release him from his imprisonment and relieve his condition? Is there not a believing servant who is oppressed, who will ask Me (azj) to take up his case and grant him victory over his oppressor before the rising of dawn, so that I (azj) may avenge him and restore his right?’” Imam (a.s) said: “And He (azj) continues to call with this until the dawn rises.”
arabicText: وَ رَوَى أَبُو بَصِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ:« إِنَّ اَللَّهَ تَعَالَى لَيُنَادِي كُلَّ لَيْلَةِ جُمُعَةٍ مِنْ فَوْقِ عَرْشِهِ مِنْ أَوَّلِ اَللَّيْلِ إِلَى آخِرِهِ« أَ لاَ عَبْدٌ مُؤْمِنٌ يَدْعُونِي لآِخِرَتِهِ وَ دُنْيَاهُ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ اَلْفَجْرِ لِأُجِيبَهُ أَ لاَ عَبْدٌ مُؤْمِنٌ يَتُوبُ إِلَيَّ مِنْ ذُنُوبِهِ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ اَلْفَجْرِ فَأَتُوبَ عَلَيْهِ أَ لاَ عَبْدٌ مُؤْمِنٌ قَدْ قَتَّرْتُ عَلَيْهِ رِزْقَهُ فَيَسْأَلَنِي اَلزِّيَادَةَ فِي رِزْقِهِ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ اَلْفَجْرِ فَأَزِيدَهُ وَ أُوَسِّعَ عَلَيْهِ أَ لاَ عَبْدٌ مُؤْمِنٌ سَقِيمٌ يَسْأَلُنِي أَنْ أَشْفِيَهُ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ اَلْفَجْرِ فَأُعَافِيَهُ أَ لاَ عَبْدٌ مُؤْمِنٌ مَحْبُوسٌ مَغْمُومٌ يَسْأَلُنِي أَنْ أُطْلِقَهُ مِنْ حَبْسِهِ وَ أُخَلِّيَ سَرْبَهُ أَ لاَ عَبْدٌ مُؤْمِنٌ مَظْلُومٌ يَسْأَلُنِي أَنْ آخُذَ لَهُ بِظُلاَمَتِهِ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ اَلْفَجْرِ فَأَنْتَصِرَ لَهُ وَ آخُذَ لَهُ بِظُلاَمَتِهِ» قَالَ فَلاَ يَزَالُ يُنَادِي بِهَذَا حَتَّى يَطْلُعَ اَلْفَجْرُ»
thaqalaynSanad: Abu Basir narrated from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Baqir (a.s) said: “Indeed, Allah (swt), the Exalted, calls out every night of Friday from above His (azj) Throne, from the beginning of the night until its end: ‘Is there not a believing servant who will call upon Me (azj) for his Hereafter and his worldly life before the rising of dawn, so that I (azj) may answer him? Is there not a believing servant who will repent to Me (azj) from his sins before the rising of dawn, so that I (azj) may turn to him in forgiveness? Is there not a believing servant whose provision I (azj) have restricted, who will ask Me (azj) for an increase in his provision before the rising of dawn, so that I (azj) may increase it and expand it for him? Is there not a believing servant who is sick, who will ask Me (azj) to cure him before the rising of dawn, so that I (azj) may grant him well-being? Is there not a believing servant who is imprisoned, distressed, who will ask Me (azj) to release him from his imprisonment and relieve his condition? Is there not a believing servant who is oppressed, who will ask Me (azj) to take up his case and grant him victory over his oppressor before the rising of dawn, so that I (azj) may avenge him and restore his right?’” Imam (a.s) said: “And He (azj) continues to call with this until the dawn rises.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 6

chapter: Chapter on the Deeds to Be Attained on Night of Friday and Its Day
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And Abu Basir also narrated from one of the two (Imams (a.s)), peace be upon them, who said:
Imam (a.s) said: “Indeed, the believing servant asks Allah (swt) for a need, and Allah (swt), the Mighty and Majestic, delays the fulfillment of his need that he asked for, until the day of Friday.”
arabicText: وَ قَدْ رَوَى أَبُو بَصِيرٍ أَيْضاً عَنْ أَحَدِهِمَا عَلَيْهِمَا اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« إِنَّ اَلْعَبْدَ اَلْمُؤْمِنَ يَسْأَلُ اَللَّهَ اَلْحَاجَةَ فَيُؤَخِّرُ اَللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ قَضَاءَ حَاجَتِهِ اَلَّتِي سَأَلَ إِلَى يَوْمِ اَلْجُمُعَةِ»
thaqalaynSanad: And Abu Basir also narrated from one of the two (Imams (a.s)), peace be upon them, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: “Indeed, the believing servant asks Allah (swt) for a need, and Allah (swt), the Mighty and Majestic, delays the fulfillment of his need that he asked for, until the day of Friday.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 6

chapter: Chapter on the Deeds to Be Attained on Night of Friday and Its Day
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Said, from al-Qasim ibn Muhammad al-Jawhari, from Salamah ibn Hayyan, from Abu al-Sabbah al-Kinani, who said:
Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: “When it is the night of Friday, then recite in the Maghrib prayer Surah al-Jumu’ah and ‘Qul Huwa Allahu Ahad’ (Surah al-Ikhlas). And when it is in the Isha al-Akhirah (the last evening prayer), then recite Surah al-Jumu’ah and ‘Sabbihi Isma Rabbika al-Ala’ (Surah al-Ala). Then when it is the Fajr (dawn) prayer on the day of Friday, then recite Surah al-Jumu’ah and ‘Qul Huwa Allahu Ahad’ (Surah al-Ikhlas). Then when it is the Jumu’ah prayer (Friday congregational prayer), then recite Surah al-Jumu’ah and Surah al-Munafiqun. And when it is the Asr (afternoon) prayer on the day of Friday, then recite Surah al-Jumu’ah and ‘Qul Huwa Allahu Ahad’ (Surah al-Ikhlas).”
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ اَلْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ اَلْجَوْهَرِيِّ عَنْ سَلَمَةَ بْنِ حَيَّانَ عَنْ أَبِي اَلصَّبَّاحِ اَلْكِنَانِيِّ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ:« إِذَا كَانَ لَيْلَةُ اَلْجُمُعَةِ فَاقْرَأْ فِي اَلْمَغْرِبِ سُورَةَ اَلْجُمُعَةِ وَ« قُلْ هُوَ اَللّٰهُ أَحَدٌ» وَ إِذَا كَانَ فِي اَلْعِشَاءِ اَلْآخِرَةِ فَاقْرَأْ سُورَةَ اَلْجُمُعَةِ وَ« سَبِّحِ اِسْمَ رَبِّكَ اَلْأَعْلَى» فَإِذَا كَانَ صَلاَةُ اَلْغَدَاةِ يَوْمَ اَلْجُمُعَةِ فَاقْرَأْ سُورَةَ اَلْجُمُعَةِ وَ« قُلْ هُوَ اَللّٰهُ أَحَدٌ» فَإِذَا كَانَ صَلاَةُ اَلْجُمُعَةِ فَاقْرَأْ سُورَةَ اَلْجُمُعَةِ وَ اَلْمُنَافِقِينَ وَ إِذَا كَانَ صَلاَةُ اَلْعَصْرِ يَوْمَ اَلْجُمُعَةِ فَاقْرَأْ سُورَةَ اَلْجُمُعَةِ وَ« قُلْ هُوَ اَللّٰهُ أَحَدٌ»
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Said, from al-Qasim ibn Muhammad al-Jawhari, from Salamah ibn Hayyan, from Abu al-Sabbah al-Kinani, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: “When it is the night of Friday, then recite in the Maghrib prayer Surah al-Jumu’ah and ‘Qul Huwa Allahu Ahad’ (Surah al-Ikhlas). And when it is in the Isha al-Akhirah (the last evening prayer), then recite Surah al-Jumu’ah and ‘Sabbihi Isma Rabbika al-Ala’ (Surah al-Ala). Then when it is the Fajr (dawn) prayer on the day of Friday, then recite Surah al-Jumu’ah and ‘Qul Huwa Allahu Ahad’ (Surah al-Ikhlas). Then when it is the Jumu’ah prayer (Friday congregational prayer), then recite Surah al-Jumu’ah and Surah al-Munafiqun. And when it is the Asr (afternoon) prayer on the day of Friday, then recite Surah al-Jumu’ah and ‘Qul Huwa Allahu Ahad’ (Surah al-Ikhlas).”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 7

chapter: Chapter on the Deeds to Be Attained on Night of Friday and Its Day
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Uthman ibn Isa, from Sama’ah, from Abu Basir, who said:
Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: “Recite on the night of Friday, Surah al-Jumu’ah and ‘Sabbihi Isma Rabbika al-Ala’ (Surah al-Ala). Recite in the Fajr prayer, Surah al-Jumu’ah and ‘Qul Huwa Allahu Ahad’ (Surah al-Ikhlas), and in the Jumu’ah (Friday congregational) prayer; Surah al-Jumu’ah and al-Munafiqun.”
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ:« اِقْرَأْ فِي لَيْلَةِ اَلْجُمُعَةِ اَلْجُمُعَةَ وَ« سَبِّحِ اِسْمَ رَبِّكَ اَلْأَعْلَى» وَ فِي اَلْفَجْرِ سُورَةَ اَلْجُمُعَةِ وَ« قُلْ هُوَ اَللّٰهُ أَحَدٌ» وَ فِي اَلْجُمُعَةِ سُورَةَ اَلْجُمُعَةِ وَ اَلْمُنَافِقِينَ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Uthman ibn Isa, from Sama’ah, from Abu Basir, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: “Recite on the night of Friday, Surah al-Jumu’ah and ‘Sabbihi Isma Rabbika al-Ala’ (Surah al-Ala). Recite in the Fajr prayer, Surah al-Jumu’ah and ‘Qul Huwa Allahu Ahad’ (Surah al-Ikhlas), and in the Jumu’ah (Friday congregational) prayer; Surah al-Jumu’ah and al-Munafiqun.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 7

chapter: Chapter on the Deeds to Be Attained on Night of Friday and Its Day
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Safwan, from Abu Ayyub, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “Is there anything fixed regarding the recitation in prayer?” Imam (a.s) said: “No, except in the Friday prayer (Salat Al Jumu'ah); Surah al-Jumu’ah and al-Munafiqun are to be recited in it.”
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنْ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ اَلْقِرَاءَةُ فِي اَلصَّلاَةِ فِيهَا شَيْءٌ مُوَقَّتٌ قَالَ« لاَ إِلاَّ فِي اَلْجُمُعَةِ يُقْرَأُ فِيهَا بِالْجُمُعَةِ وَ اَلْمُنَافِقِينَ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Safwan, from Abu Ayyub, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “Is there anything fixed regarding the recitation in prayer?” Imam (a.s) said: “No, except in the Friday prayer (Salat Al Jumu'ah); Surah al-Jumu’ah and al-Munafiqun are to be recited in it.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 7

chapter: Chapter on the Deeds to Be Attained on Night of Friday and Its Day
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Abdillah ibn al-Mughirah, from Jamil, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Baqir (a.s) said: “Indeed, Allah (swt) has honored the believers with Friday, so the Messenger of Allah (swt), peace be upon him and his family, instituted it as a glad tiding for them, and (He (saws) instituted the recitation of) Surah al-Munafiqun as a rebuke to the hypocrites. So they (both) should not be abandoned. Whoever deliberately abandons them, then there is no prayer for him.”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ اَلْمُغِيرَةِ عَنْ جَمِيلٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« إِنَّ اَللَّهَ أَكْرَمَ بِالْجُمُعَةِ اَلْمُؤْمِنِينَ فَسَنَّهَا رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ بِشَارَةً لَهُمْ وَ اَلْمُنَافِقِينَ تَوْبِيخاً لِلْمُنَافِقِينَ فَلاَ يَنْبَغِي تَرْكُهُمَا فَمَنْ تَرَكَهُمَا مُتَعَمِّداً فَلاَ صَلاَةَ لَهُ»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Abdillah ibn al-Mughirah, from Jamil, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Baqir (a.s) said: “Indeed, Allah (swt) has honored the believers with Friday, so the Messenger of Allah (swt), peace be upon him and his family, instituted it as a glad tiding for them, and (He (saws) instituted the recitation of) Surah al-Munafiqun as a rebuke to the hypocrites. So they (both) should not be abandoned. Whoever deliberately abandons them, then there is no prayer for him.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 7

chapter: Chapter on the Deeds to Be Attained on Night of Friday and Its Day
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Said, from al-Husayn ibn Abd al-Malik al-Ahwal, from his father, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “Whoever does not recite in the Friday prayer (Salat Al Jumu'ah); Surah al-Jumu’ah and al-Munafiqun, then there is no Friday (prayer) for him.”
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَلْمَلِكِ اَلْأَحْوَلِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« مَنْ لَمْ يَقْرَأْ فِي اَلْجُمُعَةِ بِالْجُمُعَةِ وَ اَلْمُنَافِقِينَ فَلاَ جُمُعَةَ لَهُ»
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Said, from al-Husayn ibn Abd al-Malik al-Ahwal, from his father, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “Whoever does not recite in the Friday prayer (Salat Al Jumu'ah); Surah al-Jumu’ah and al-Munafiqun, then there is no Friday (prayer) for him.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 8

chapter: Chapter on the Deeds to Be Attained on Night of Friday and Its Day
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Said, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Hariz and Ribi, who both raised it to Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Baqir (a.s) said: “When it is the night of Friday, it is recommended to recite in the Atamah (Isha prayer) Surah al-Jumu’ah and ‘Idha Jaaka al-Munafiqun’ (Surah al-Munafiqun), and in the Fajr prayer the same, and in the Jumu’ah prayer the same, and in the Asr prayer the same.”
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ حَرِيزٍ وَ رِبْعِيٍّ رَفَعَاهُ إِلَى أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« إِذَا كَانَ لَيْلَةُ اَلْجُمُعَةِ يُسْتَحَبُّ أَنْ يُقْرَأَ فِي اَلْعَتَمَةِ سُورَةُ اَلْجُمُعَةِ وَ« إِذٰا جٰاءَكَ اَلْمُنٰافِقُونَ» وَ فِي صَلاَةِ اَلصُّبْحِ مِثْلُ ذَلِكَ وَ فِي صَلاَةِ اَلْجُمُعَةِ مِثْلُ ذَلِكَ وَ فِي صَلاَةِ اَلْعَصْرِ مِثْلُ ذَلِكَ»
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Said, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Hariz and Ribi, who both raised it to Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Baqir (a.s) said: “When it is the night of Friday, it is recommended to recite in the Atamah (Isha prayer) Surah al-Jumu’ah and ‘Idha Jaaka al-Munafiqun’ (Surah al-Munafiqun), and in the Fajr prayer the same, and in the Jumu’ah prayer the same, and in the Asr prayer the same.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 8

chapter: Chapter on the Deeds to Be Attained on Night of Friday and Its Day
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Hasan, from his brother al-Husayn ibn Ali ibn Ya'qtin, from his father, who said:
I asked Abu al-Hasan al-Awwal, peace be upon him, about a man who deliberately recites in the Friday prayer (Salat Al Jumu'ah), other than Surah al-Jumu’ah. Imam (a.s) said: “There is no harm in that.”
arabicText: وَ رَوَى مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ عَنْ أَخِيهِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ يَقْطِينٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا اَلْحَسَنِ اَلْأَوَّلَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يَقْرَأُ فِي صَلاَةِ اَلْجُمُعَةِ بِغَيْرِ سُورَةِ اَلْجُمُعَةِ مُتَعَمِّداً قَالَ« لاَ بَأْسَ بِذَلِكَ»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Hasan, from his brother al-Husayn ibn Ali ibn Ya'qtin, from his father, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu al-Hasan al-Awwal, peace be upon him, about a man who deliberately recites in the Friday prayer (Salat Al Jumu'ah), other than Surah al-Jumu’ah. Imam (a.s) said: “There is no harm in that.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 8

chapter: Chapter on the Deeds to Be Attained on Night of Friday and Its Day
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Muhammad ibn Sahl al-Ashari, from his father, who said:
I asked Abu al-Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him, about a man who deliberately recites in the Friday prayer (Salat Al Jumu'ah), something other than Surah al-Jumu’ah. Imam (a.s) said: “There is no harm.”
arabicText: أحمد بن محمد بن عيسى عن محمد بن سهل الاشعري عن أبيه قال سألت أبا الحسن عليه السلام عن الرجل يقرأ في صلاة الجمعة بغير سورة الجمعة متعمدا قال لا بأس
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Muhammad ibn Sahl al-Ashari, from his father, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu al-Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him, about a man who deliberately recites in the Friday prayer (Salat Al Jumu'ah), something other than Surah al-Jumu’ah. Imam (a.s) said: “There is no harm.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 8

chapter: Chapter on the Deeds to Be Attained on Night of Friday and Its Day
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
As for what was narrated by Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Muawiyah ibn Ammar, from Umar ibn Yazid, who said:
Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: “Whoever prays the Friday prayer (Salat Al Jumu'ah), without (reciting) Surah al-Jumu’ah and Surah al-Munafiqun must repeat the prayer, whether he is travelling or resident.”
arabicText: فَأَمَّا مَا رَوَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ:« مَنْ صَلَّى اَلْجُمُعَةَ بِغَيْرِ اَلْجُمُعَةِ وَ اَلْمُنَافِقِينَ أَعَادَ اَلصَّلاَةَ فِي سَفَرٍ أَوْ حَضَرٍ»
thaqalaynSanad: As for what was narrated by Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Muawiyah ibn Ammar, from Umar ibn Yazid, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: “Whoever prays the Friday prayer (Salat Al Jumu'ah), without (reciting) Surah al-Jumu’ah and Surah al-Munafiqun must repeat the prayer, whether he is travelling or resident.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 8

chapter: Chapter on the Deeds to Be Attained on Night of Friday and Its Day
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
What was narrated by Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Yunus, from Sabbah ibn Sabih, who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “A man intended to pray the Friday prayer (Salat Al Jumu'ah), and recited ‘Qul Huwa Allahu Ahad’ (Surah al-Ikhlas).” Imam (a.s) said: “He completes it as two rak’ahs, then begins again.”
arabicText: مَا رَوَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ يُونُسَ عَنْ صَبَّاحِ بْنِ صَبِيحٍ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ رَجُلٌ أَرَادَ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ اَلْجُمُعَةَ فَقَرَأَ بِ«قُلْ هُوَ اَللّٰهُ أَحَدٌ» قَالَ «يُتِمُّهَا رَكْعَتَيْنِ ثُمَّ يَسْتَأْنِفُ»
thaqalaynSanad: What was narrated by Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Yunus, from Sabbah ibn Sabih, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “A man intended to pray the Friday prayer (Salat Al Jumu'ah), and recited ‘Qul Huwa Allahu Ahad’ (Surah al-Ikhlas).” Imam (a.s) said: “He completes it as two rak’ahs, then begins again.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 9

chapter: Chapter on the Deeds to Be Attained on Night of Friday and Its Day
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Abu al-Fadl, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from Jamil, from Ali ibn Yaqtin, who said:
I asked Abu al-Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him, about the Friday prayer (Salat Al Jumu'ah), during travel what should I recite in them? He said: “Recite in them ‘Qul Huwa Allahu Ahad’ (Surah al-Ikhlas).”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَبِي اَلْفَضْلِ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ جَمِيلٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ يَقْطِينٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا اَلْحَسَنِ عَ عَنِ اَلْجُمُعَةِ فِي اَلسَّفَرِ مَا أَقْرَأُ فِيهِمَا قَالَ« اِقْرَأْهُمَا« قُلْ هُوَ اَللّٰهُ أَحَدٌ»»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Abu al-Fadl, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from Jamil, from Ali ibn Yaqtin, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu al-Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him, about the Friday prayer (Salat Al Jumu'ah), during travel what should I recite in them? He said: “Recite in them ‘Qul Huwa Allahu Ahad’ (Surah al-Ikhlas).”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 9

chapter: Chapter on the Deeds to Be Attained on Night of Friday and Its Day
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from al-Husayn ibn Muhammad, from Abdillah ibn Amir, from Ali ibn Mahziyar, from al-Nadr ibn Suwayd, from Abdillah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “In the last prostration of the supererogatory prayers after Maghrib on the night of Friday, you say: ‘O’ Allah (swt), I ask You (azj) by Your Noble Face, and I ask You (azj) by Your Great Name, to send blessings upon (prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), and to forgive me my great sin’ seven times.”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ عَامِرٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَهْزِيَارَ عَنِ اَلنَّضْرِ بْنِ سُوَيْدٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« تَقُولُ فِي آخِرِ سَجْدَةٍ مِنَ اَلنَّوَافِلِ بَعْدَ اَلْمَغْرِبِ لَيْلَةَ اَلْجُمُعَةِ اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِوَجْهِكَ اَلْكَرِيمِ وَ أَسْأَلُكَ بِاسْمِكَ اَلْعَظِيمِ أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ أَنْ تَغْفِرَ لِي ذَنْبِيَ اَلْعَظِيمَ سَبْعاً»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from al-Husayn ibn Muhammad, from Abdillah ibn Amir, from Ali ibn Mahziyar, from al-Nadr ibn Suwayd, from Abdillah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “In the last prostration of the supererogatory prayers after Maghrib on the night of Friday, you say: ‘O’ Allah (swt), I ask You (azj) by Your Noble Face, and I ask You (azj) by Your Great Name, to send blessings upon (prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), and to forgive me my great sin’ seven times.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 9

chapter: Chapter on the Deeds to Be Attained on Night of Friday and Its Day
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ali ibn Mahziyar, from Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Khazzaz, from Hammad ibn Uthman, who said:
I heard Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, say: “It is recommended to recite after the Fajr (dawn) prayer on the day of Friday; Surah al-Rahman. Then, every time you say; ‘Fa-bi-ayyi alai rabbikuma tukaḏḏiban’ (So which of the favors of your Lord (azj) will you both deny?) in Surah al-Rahman, you say; ‘I do not deny any of Your favors, O’ Lord (azj)’.”
arabicText: عَلِيُّ بْنُ مَهْزِيَارَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى اَلْخَزَّازِ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ يَقُولُ: «يُسْتَحَبُّ أَنْ تَقْرَأَ فِي دُبُرِ اَلْغَدَاةِ يَوْمَ اَلْجُمُعَةِ اَلرَّحْمَنَ ثُمَّ تَقُولَ كُلَّمَا قُلْتَ« فَبِأَيِّ آلاٰءِ رَبِّكُمٰا تُكَذِّبٰانِ» قُلْتَ لاَ بِشَيْءٍ مِنْ آلاَئِكَ رَبِّ أُكَذِّبُ»
thaqalaynSanad: Ali ibn Mahziyar, from Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Khazzaz, from Hammad ibn Uthman, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I heard Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, say: “It is recommended to recite after the Fajr (dawn) prayer on the day of Friday; Surah al-Rahman. Then, every time you say; ‘Fa-bi-ayyi alai rabbikuma tukaḏḏiban’ (So which of the favors of your Lord (azj) will you both deny?) in Surah al-Rahman, you say; ‘I do not deny any of Your favors, O’ Lord (azj)’.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 9

chapter: Chapter on the Deeds to Be Attained on Night of Friday and Its Day
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Ayyub ibn Nuh, from Muhammad ibn Abi Hamzah, who said:
Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: “Whoever recites Surah al-Kahf on every night of Friday, it will be an expiation for him for what is between that Friday and the next Friday.”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ أَيُّوبَ بْنِ نُوحٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ:« مَنْ قَرَأَ سُورَةَ اَلْكَهْفِ فِي كُلِّ لَيْلَةِ جُمُعَةٍ كَانَتْ كَفَّارَةً لَهُ لِمَا بَيْنَ اَلْجُمُعَةِ إِلَى اَلْجُمُعَةِ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Ayyub ibn Nuh, from Muhammad ibn Abi Hamzah, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: “Whoever recites Surah al-Kahf on every night of Friday, it will be an expiation for him for what is between that Friday and the next Friday.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 10

chapter: Chapter on the Deeds to Be Attained on Night of Friday and Its Day
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Sa’ad ibn Abdillah, from Abu Ja’far, from Yaqub ibn Yazid, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Umar ibn Udhaynah, from Zurarah, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Imam (a.s) about the ghusl of the day of Friday Imam (a.s) said: “It is a Sunnah in both travel and residence, except if the traveller fears cold for himself.”
arabicText: سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ أُذَيْنَةَ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ غُسْلِ يَوْمِ اَلْجُمُعَةِ فَقَالَ« سُنَّةٌ فِي اَلسَّفَرِ وَاَلْحَضَرِ إِلاَّ أَنْ يَخَافَ اَلْمُسَافِرُ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ اَلْقُرَّ»
thaqalaynSanad: Sa’ad ibn Abdillah, from Abu Ja’far, from Yaqub ibn Yazid, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Umar ibn Udhaynah, from Zurarah, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Imam (a.s) about the ghusl of the day of Friday Imam (a.s) said: “It is a Sunnah in both travel and residence, except if the traveller fears cold for himself.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 10

chapter: Chapter on the Deeds to Be Attained on Night of Friday and Its Day
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Muhammad ibn Abdillah and Abdillah ibn al-Mughirah, from Abu al-Hasan al-Ridha (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Imam (a.s) about the ghusl on the day of Friday. Imam (a.s) said: “It is obligatory upon every male and female, whether slave or free.”
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ عَبْدِ خ ل اَللَّهِ وَ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ اَلْمُغِيرَةِ عَنْ أَبِي اَلْحَسَنِ اَلرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلْغُسْلِ يَوْمَ اَلْجُمُعَةِ فَقَالَ« وَاجِبٌ عَلَى كُلِّ ذَكَرٍ وَ أُنْثَى مِنْ عَبْدٍ أَوْ حُرٍّ»
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Muhammad ibn Abdillah and Abdillah ibn al-Mughirah, from Abu al-Hasan al-Ridha (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Imam (a.s) about the ghusl on the day of Friday. Imam (a.s) said: “It is obligatory upon every male and female, whether slave or free.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 10

chapter: Chapter on the Deeds to Be Attained on Night of Friday and Its Day
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Ali ibn Sayf, from his father Sayf ibn Umayrah, from al-Husayn ibn Khalid al-Sayrafi, who said:
I asked Abu al-Hasan al-Awwal (a.s), peace be upon him: “How was the ghusl of Friday made obligatory?” Imam (a.s) said: “Indeed, Allah (swt), the Exalted, completed the obligatory prayer with the supererogatory prayer, And He (azj) completed the obligatory fast with the supererogatory fast, and He (azj) completed the obligatory wudu with the ghusl of the day of Friday, For what may occur therein of forgetfulness, shortcoming, or deficiency.”
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ سَيْفٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ سَيْفِ بْنِ عَمِيرَةَ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ اَلصَّيْرَفِيِّ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا اَلْحَسَنِ اَلْأَوَّلَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ كَيْفَ كَانَ غُسْلُ يَوْمِ اَلْجُمُعَةِ وَاجِباً فَقَالَ« إِنَّ اَللَّهَ تَعَالَى أَتَمَّ صَلاَةَ اَلْفَرِيضَةِ بِصَلاَةِ اَلنَّافِلَةِ وَ أَتَمَّ صِيَامَ اَلْفَرِيضَةِ بِصِيَامِ اَلنَّافِلَةِ وَ أَتَمَّ وُضُوءَ اَلْفَرِيضَةِ بِغُسْلِ يَوْمِ اَلْجُمُعَةِ مَا كَانَ مِنْ ذَلِكَ مِنْ سَهْوٍ أَوْ تَقْصِيرٍ أَوْ نُقْصَانٍ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Ali ibn Sayf, from his father Sayf ibn Umayrah, from al-Husayn ibn Khalid al-Sayrafi, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu al-Hasan al-Awwal (a.s), peace be upon him: “How was the ghusl of Friday made obligatory?” Imam (a.s) said: “Indeed, Allah (swt), the Exalted, completed the obligatory prayer with the supererogatory prayer, And He (azj) completed the obligatory fast with the supererogatory fast, and He (azj) completed the obligatory wudu with the ghusl of the day of Friday, For what may occur therein of forgetfulness, shortcoming, or deficiency.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 10

chapter: Chapter on the Deeds to Be Attained on Night of Friday and Its Day
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Ibrahim ibn Ishaq, from Abdillah ibn Hammad al-Ansari, from Sabbah al-Muzani, from al-Harith, from al-Asbagh, who said:
Whenever Imam Ali (a.s), peace be upon him, wanted to rebuke a man, Imam (a.s) would say to him: “By Allah (swt), you are more incapable than the one who abandons the ghusl on the day of Friday, for indeed, one remains in a state of purity until the following Friday.”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ حَمَّادٍ اَلْأَنْصَارِيِّ عَنْ صَبَّاحٍ اَلْمُزَنِيِّ عَنِ اَلْحَارِثِ عَنِ اَلْأَصْبَغِ قَالَ: كَانَ عَلِيٌّ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ إِذَا أَرَادَ أَنْ يُوَبِّخَ اَلرَّجُلَ يَقُولُ لَهُ« وَ اَللَّهِ لَأَنْتَ أَعْجَزُ مِنْ تَارِكِ اَلْغُسْلِ يَوْمَ اَلْجُمُعَةِ فَإِنَّهُ لاَ يَزَالُ فِي طُهْرٍ إِلَى يَوْمِ اَلْجُمُعَةِ اَلْأُخْرَى»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Ibrahim ibn Ishaq, from Abdillah ibn Hammad al-Ansari, from Sabbah al-Muzani, from al-Harith, from al-Asbagh, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Whenever Imam Ali (a.s), peace be upon him, wanted to rebuke a man, Imam (a.s) would say to him: “By Allah (swt), you are more incapable than the one who abandons the ghusl on the day of Friday, for indeed, one remains in a state of purity until the following Friday.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 11

chapter: Chapter on the Deeds to Be Attained on Night of Friday and Its Day
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ahmad ibn Duwail ibn Harun, from Abu Walad al-Hannat, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “Whoever performs ghusl on the day of Friday and says: ‘I bear witness that there is no God but Allah (swt), alone, without partner, and that Muhammad (saws) is His (azj) servant and His (azj) messenger. O’ Allah (swt), send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), and make me among those who repent, and make me among those who purify themselves’ then it will be for him a purification from that Friday to the next Friday.”
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ دُوَيْلِ بْنِ هَارُونَ عَنْ أَبِي وَلاَّدٍ اَلْحَنَّاطِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «مَنِ اِغْتَسَلَ يَوْمَ اَلْجُمُعَةِ فَقَالَ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اَللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ وَ أَنَّ مُحَمَّداً عَبْدُهُ وَ رَسُولُهُ اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اِجْعَلْنِي مِنَ اَلتَّوَّابِينَ وَ اِجْعَلْنِي مِنَ اَلْمُتَطَهِّرِينَ كَانَ لَهُ طُهْراً مِنَ اَلْجُمُعَةِ إِلَى يَوْمِ اَلْجُمُعَةِ»
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ahmad ibn Duwail ibn Harun, from Abu Walad al-Hannat, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “Whoever performs ghusl on the day of Friday and says: ‘I bear witness that there is no God but Allah (swt), alone, without partner, and that Muhammad (saws) is His (azj) servant and His (azj) messenger. O’ Allah (swt), send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), and make me among those who repent, and make me among those who purify themselves’ then it will be for him a purification from that Friday to the next Friday.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 11

chapter: Chapter on the Deeds to Be Attained on Night of Friday and Its Day
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Yunus ibn Abd al-Rahman, from Hisham ibn al-Hakam, who said:
Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: “Let each of you adorn himself on the day of Friday perform ghusl, apply perfume, comb his beard, wear his cleanest clothes, prepare himself for Friday, and let there be upon him on that day calmness and dignity. Let him perfect his worship of his Lord (azj) and do as much good as he is able. For indeed, Allah (swt), the Exalted, looks upon the earth to multiply good deeds.”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَلرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ اَلْحَكَمِ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ:« لِيَتَزَيَّنْ أَحَدُكُمْ يَوْمَ اَلْجُمُعَةِ يَغْتَسِلُ وَ يَتَطَيَّبُ وَ يُسَرِّحُ لِحْيَتَهُ وَ يَلْبَسُ أَنْظَفَ ثِيَابِهِ وَ لْيَتَهَيَّأْ لِلْجُمُعَةِ وَ لْيَكُنْ عَلَيْهِ فِي ذَلِكَ اَلْيَوْمِ اَلسَّكِينَةُ وَ اَلْوَقَارُ وَ لْيُحْسِنْ عِبَادَةَ رَبِّهِ وَ لْيَفْعَلِ اَلْخَيْرَ مَا اِسْتَطَاعَ فَإِنَّ اَللَّهَ تَعَالَى يَطَّلِعُ إِلَى اَلْأَرْضِ لِيُضَاعِفَ اَلْحَسَنَاتِ»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Yunus ibn Abd al-Rahman, from Hisham ibn al-Hakam, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: “Let each of you adorn himself on the day of Friday perform ghusl, apply perfume, comb his beard, wear his cleanest clothes, prepare himself for Friday, and let there be upon him on that day calmness and dignity. Let him perfect his worship of his Lord (azj) and do as much good as he is able. For indeed, Allah (swt), the Exalted, looks upon the earth to multiply good deeds.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 11

chapter: Chapter on the Deeds to Be Attained on Night of Friday and Its Day
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Husayn ibn Said, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Umar al-Jurjani, from Muhammad ibn al-Ala, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
I heard Imam (al-Sadiq (a.s)) say: “Whoever trims his moustache and clips his nails on the day of Friday, then says: ‘In the name of Allah (swt), upon the Sunnah of Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws)’, Allah (swt) will write for him, for every hair and every nail clipping, the reward of freeing a slave. And he will not suffer any illness except the illness of death.”
arabicText: وَعَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُصَيْنِ عَنْ عُمَرَ اَلْجُرْجَانِيِّ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْعَلاَءِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ سَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ:« مَنْ أَخَذَ مِنْ شَارِبِهِ وَ قَلَّمَ أَظْفَارَهُ يَوْمَ اَلْجُمُعَةِ ثُمَّ قَالَ بِسْمِ اَللَّهِ عَلَى سُنَّةِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ كَتَبَ اَللَّهُ لَهُ بِكُلِّ شَعْرَةٍ وَ كُلِّ قُلاَمَةٍ عِتْقَ رَقَبَةٍ وَلَمْ يَمْرَضْ مَرَضاً يُصِيبُهُ إِلاَّ مَرَضَ اَلْمَوْتِ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Husayn ibn Said, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Umar al-Jurjani, from Muhammad ibn al-Ala, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I heard Imam (al-Sadiq (a.s)) say: “Whoever trims his moustache and clips his nails on the day of Friday, then says: ‘In the name of Allah (swt), upon the Sunnah of Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws)’, Allah (swt) will write for him, for every hair and every nail clipping, the reward of freeing a slave. And he will not suffer any illness except the illness of death.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 11

chapter: Chapter on the Deeds to Be Attained on Night of Friday and Its Day
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from Muhammad ibn Yahya and others, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, who said:
Abu al-Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him, said: “The recommended prayer (nafilah) on the day of Friday is six rak’ahs at the beginning of the day, and two rak’ahs when the sun passes its zenith. Then perform the obligatory prayer, then perform after it six rak’ahs.”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى وَ غَيْرِهِ عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي نَصْرٍ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو اَلْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ:« اَلصَّلاَةُ اَلنَّافِلَةُ يَوْمَ اَلْجُمُعَةِ سِتُّ رَكَعَاتٍ صَدْرَ اَلنَّهَارِ وَ رَكْعَتَانِ إِذَا زَالَتِ اَلشَّمْسُ ثُمَّ صَلِّ اَلْفَرِيضَةَ ثُمَّ صَلِّ بَعْدَهَا سِتَّ رَكَعَاتٍ»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from Muhammad ibn Yahya and others, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu al-Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him, said: “The recommended prayer (nafilah) on the day of Friday is six rak’ahs at the beginning of the day, and two rak’ahs when the sun passes its zenith. Then perform the obligatory prayer, then perform after it six rak’ahs.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 12

chapter: Chapter on the Deeds to Be Attained on Night of Friday and Its Day
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from a group (of narrators), from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Husayn ibn Said, from Hammad ibn Isa, from al-Husayn ibn al-Mukhtar, from Ali ibn Abd al-Aziz, from Murad ibn Kharijah, who said:
Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: “As for me when it is the day of Friday, and the sun in the east is at the same position as it is in the west during the time of the Asr prayer, I perform six rak’ahs. Then, when the day has risen high, I perform six (more rak’ahs). Then, when the sun inclines or passes its zenith, I perform two rak’ahs. Then, I perform Dhuhr, and then I perform six (rak’ahs) after it.”
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ جَمَاعَةٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ اَلْمُخْتَارِ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَلْعَزِيزِ عَنْ مُرَادِ بْنِ خَارِجَةَ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ:« أَمَّا أَنَا فَإِذَا كَانَ يَوْمُ اَلْجُمُعَةِ وَ كَانَتِ اَلشَّمْسُ مِنَ اَلْمَشْرِقِ مِقْدَارَهَا مِنَ اَلْمَغْرِبِ فِي وَقْتِ صَلاَةِ اَلْعَصْرِ صَلَّيْتُ سِتَّ رَكَعَاتٍ فَإِذَا اِرْتَفَعَ اَلنَّهَارُ صَلَّيْتُ سِتّاً فَإِذَا زَاغَتِ اَلشَّمْسُ أَوْ زَالَتْ صَلَّيْتُ رَكْعَتَيْنِ ثُمَّ صَلَّيْتُ اَلظُّهْرَ ثُمَّ صَلَّيْتُ بَعْدَهَا سِتّاً»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from a group (of narrators), from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Husayn ibn Said, from Hammad ibn Isa, from al-Husayn ibn al-Mukhtar, from Ali ibn Abd al-Aziz, from Murad ibn Kharijah, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: “As for me when it is the day of Friday, and the sun in the east is at the same position as it is in the west during the time of the Asr prayer, I perform six rak’ahs. Then, when the day has risen high, I perform six (more rak’ahs). Then, when the sun inclines or passes its zenith, I perform two rak’ahs. Then, I perform Dhuhr, and then I perform six (rak’ahs) after it.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 12

chapter: Chapter on the Deeds to Be Attained on Night of Friday and Its Day
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Said, from Yaqub ibn Yaqtin, from the Righteous Servant (of Allah (swt)), peace be upon him, who said:
I asked (Imam al-Kadhim (a.s)) about voluntary (nafl) prayers on the day of Friday. Imam (a.s) said: “If you want to perform voluntary prayers on the day of Friday while not travelling, then pray six rak’ahs when the day rises, and six rak’ahs before midday, and two rak’ahs when the sun passes its zenith before the Friday (congregational prayer), and six rak’ahs after the Friday prayer (Salat Al Jumu'ah).”
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ يَقْطِينٍ عَنِ اَلْعَبْدِ اَلصَّالِحِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلتَّطَوُّعِ فِي يَوْمِ اَلْجُمُعَةِ قَالَ« إِذَا أَرَدْتَ أَنْ تَتَطَوَّعَ فِي يَوْمِ اَلْجُمُعَةِ فِي غَيْرِ سَفَرٍ صَلَّيْتَ سِتَّ رَكَعَاتٍ اِرْتِفَاعَ اَلنَّهَارِ وَ سِتَّ رَكَعَاتٍ قَبْلَ نِصْفِ اَلنَّهَارِ وَ رَكْعَتَيْنِ إِذَا زَالَتِ اَلشَّمْسُ قَبْلَ اَلْجُمُعَةِ وَ سِتَّ رَكَعَاتٍ بَعْدَ اَلْجُمُعَةِ»
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Said, from Yaqub ibn Yaqtin, from the Righteous Servant (of Allah (swt)), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked (Imam al-Kadhim (a.s)) about voluntary (nafl) prayers on the day of Friday. Imam (a.s) said: “If you want to perform voluntary prayers on the day of Friday while not travelling, then pray six rak’ahs when the day rises, and six rak’ahs before midday, and two rak’ahs when the sun passes its zenith before the Friday (congregational prayer), and six rak’ahs after the Friday prayer (Salat Al Jumu'ah).”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 12

chapter: Chapter on the Deeds to Be Attained on Night of Friday and Its Day
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Said, from al-Nadr, from Hisham ibn Salim, from Sulayman ibn Khalid, who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “What is the (ruling on) the nafilah (supererogatory prayer) on the day of Friday?” Imam (a.s) said: “Six rak’ahs before the sun’s zenith, and two rak’ahs at its zenith, and in the first (of those two) recite Surah al-Jumu’ah, and in the second Surah al-Munafiqun, and after the obligatory prayer, (perform) eight rak’ahs.”
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ اَلنَّضْرِ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ سَالِمٍ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ خَالِدٍ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ اَلنَّافِلَةُ يَوْمَ اَلْجُمُعَةِ قَالَ« سِتُّ رَكَعَاتٍ قَبْلَ زَوَالِ اَلشَّمْسِ وَ رَكْعَتَانِ عِنْدَ زَوَالِهَا وَ اَلْقِرَاءَةُ فِي اَلْأُولَى بِالْجُمُعَةِ وَ فِي اَلثَّانِيَةِ بِالْمُنَافِقِينَ وَ بَعْدَ اَلْفَرِيضَةِ ثَمَانِي رَكَعَاتٍ»
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Said, from al-Nadr, from Hisham ibn Salim, from Sulayman ibn Khalid, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “What is the (ruling on) the nafilah (supererogatory prayer) on the day of Friday?” Imam (a.s) said: “Six rak’ahs before the sun’s zenith, and two rak’ahs at its zenith, and in the first (of those two) recite Surah al-Jumu’ah, and in the second Surah al-Munafiqun, and after the obligatory prayer, (perform) eight rak’ahs.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 13

chapter: Chapter on the Deeds to Be Attained on Night of Friday and Its Day
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Hasan, from his brother al-Husayn ibn Ali ibn Yaqtin, from his father, who said:
I asked Abu al-Hasan (a.s) about the supererogatory prayer that is performed on the day of Friday, whether it is better before the Friday prayer (Salat Al Jumu'ah) or after it. Imam (a.s) said: “Before the prayer.”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ عَنْ أَخِيهِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ يَقْطِينٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا اَلْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلنَّافِلَةِ اَلَّتِي تُصَلَّى يَوْمَ اَلْجُمُعَةِ قَبْلَ اَلْجُمُعَةِ أَفْضَلُ أَوْ بَعْدَهَا قَالَ« قَبْلَ اَلصَّلاَةِ».
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Hasan, from his brother al-Husayn ibn Ali ibn Yaqtin, from his father, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu al-Hasan (a.s) about the supererogatory prayer that is performed on the day of Friday, whether it is better before the Friday prayer (Salat Al Jumu'ah) or after it. Imam (a.s) said: “Before the prayer.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 13

chapter: Chapter on the Deeds to Be Attained on Night of Friday and Its Day
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Said, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Ibn Muskan, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Ajlan, who said:
Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, said: “If you are uncertain about the sun's zenith, then perform the two rak’ahs. But when you are certain that the sun has passed the zenith, then perform the obligatory prayer.”
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَلرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَجْلاَنَ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ:« إِذَا كُنْتَ شَاكّاً فِي اَلزَّوَالِ فَصَلِّ اَلرَّكْعَتَيْنِ وَ إِذَا اِسْتَيْقَنْتَ اَلزَّوَالَ فَصَلِّ اَلْفَرِيضَةَ»
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Said, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Ibn Muskan, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Ajlan, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, said: “If you are uncertain about the sun's zenith, then perform the two rak’ahs. But when you are certain that the sun has passed the zenith, then perform the obligatory prayer.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 13

chapter: Chapter on the Deeds to Be Attained on Night of Friday and Its Day
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Ibn Muskan, from Ibn Abi Umayr and Fadalah, from Husayn, from Ibn Abi Umayr, who said:
He (Husayn) narrated to me (Ibn Abi Umayr) that he asked Imam (a.s) about the two rak’ahs at the time of the sun's zenith on the day of Friday. Imam (a.s) said: “As for me when the sun passes its zenith, I begin with the obligatory prayer.”
arabicText: وَعَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ وَفَضَالَةَ عَنْ حُسَيْنٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي أَنَّهُ سَأَلَهُ عَنِ اَلرَّكْعَتَيْنِ اَللَّتَيْنِ عِنْدَ اَلزَّوَالِ يَوْمَ اَلْجُمُعَةِ قَالَ فَقَالَ« أَمَّا أَنَا فَإِذَا زَالَتِ اَلشَّمْسُ بَدَأْتُ بِالْفَرِيضَةِ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Ibn Muskan, from Ibn Abi Umayr and Fadalah, from Husayn, from Ibn Abi Umayr, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: He (Husayn) narrated to me (Ibn Abi Umayr) that he asked Imam (a.s) about the two rak’ahs at the time of the sun's zenith on the day of Friday. Imam (a.s) said: “As for me when the sun passes its zenith, I begin with the obligatory prayer.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 14

chapter: Chapter on the Deeds to Be Attained on Night of Friday and Its Day
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Said from Hammad from Ribi from Sama’ah and al-Hasan from Zurah from Sama’ah, he said:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “The time of Dhuhr on the day of Friday is when the sun passes the meridian (zawal al-shams).”
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ رِبْعِيٍّ عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ وَ اَلْحَسَنِ عَنْ زُرْعَةَ عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ قَالَ قَالَ:« وَقْتُ اَلظُّهْرِ يَوْمَ اَلْجُمُعَةِ حِينَ تَزُولُ اَلشَّمْسُ»
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Said from Hammad from Ribi from Sama’ah and al-Hasan from Zurah from Sama’ah, he said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “The time of Dhuhr on the day of Friday is when the sun passes the meridian (zawal al-shams).”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 14

chapter: Chapter on the Deeds to Be Attained on Night of Friday and Its Day
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from al-Nadr, from Abdillah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “The Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, used to perform the Friday prayer (Salat Al Jumu'ah) when the sun had passed the meridian by the measure of a sandal strap. And He (saws) would deliver the sermon in the first shadow. Then Jibra’il (a.s), peace be upon him, would say: “O Muhammad (saws), the sun has passed the meridian, so descend and pray.” And indeed, Friday was made two rak’ahs on account of the two sermons, for the sermon is part of the prayer until the Imam descends.”
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنِ اَلنَّضْرِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« كَانَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ يُصَلِّي اَلْجُمُعَةَ حِينَ تَزُولُ اَلشَّمْسُ قَدْرَ شِرَاكٍ وَ يَخْطُبُ فِي اَلظِّلِّ اَلْأَوَّلِ فَيَقُولُ جَبْرَئِيلُ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ يَا مُحَمَّدُ قَدْ زَالَتِ اَلشَّمْسُ فَانْزِلْ فَصَلِّ وَ إِنَّمَا جُعِلَتِ اَلْجُمُعَةُ رَكْعَتَيْنِ مِنْ أَجْلِ اَلْخُطْبَتَيْنِ فَهِيَ صَلاَةٌ حَتَّى يَنْزِلَ اَلْإِمَامُ»
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from al-Nadr, from Abdillah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “The Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, used to perform the Friday prayer (Salat Al Jumu'ah) when the sun had passed the meridian by the measure of a sandal strap. And He (saws) would deliver the sermon in the first shadow. Then Jibra’il (a.s), peace be upon him, would say: “O Muhammad (saws), the sun has passed the meridian, so descend and pray.” And indeed, Friday was made two rak’ahs on account of the two sermons, for the sermon is part of the prayer until the Imam descends.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 14

chapter: Chapter on the Deeds to Be Attained on Night of Friday and Its Day
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from al-Nadr, from Ibn Muskan, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, he said:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “The time of the Friday prayer (Salat Al Jumu'ah) is at the meridian (zawal), and the time of Asr on the day of Friday is the same as the time of Dhuhr on other than the day of Friday, and it is recommended to hasten to it (the Friday prayer).”
arabicText: وَعَنْهُ عَنِ اَلنَّضْرِ عَنِ اِبْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ قَالَ:« وَقْتُ صَلاَةِ اَلْجُمُعَةِ عِنْدَ اَلزَّوَالِ وَوَقْتُ اَلْعَصْرِ يَوْمَ اَلْجُمُعَةِ وَقْتُ صَلاَةِ اَلظُّهْرِ فِي غَيْرِ يَوْمِ اَلْجُمُعَةِ وَ يُسْتَحَبُّ اَلتَّبْكِيرُ بِهَا»
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from al-Nadr, from Ibn Muskan, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, he said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “The time of the Friday prayer (Salat Al Jumu'ah) is at the meridian (zawal), and the time of Asr on the day of Friday is the same as the time of Dhuhr on other than the day of Friday, and it is recommended to hasten to it (the Friday prayer).”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 14

chapter: Chapter on the Deeds to Be Attained on Night of Friday and Its Day
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Fadalah, from Abdillah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “There is no prayer at midday except on the day of Friday.”
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَ قَالَ:« لاَ صَلاَةَ نِصْفَ اَلنَّهَارِ إِلاَّ يَوْمَ اَلْجُمُعَةِ»
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Fadalah, from Abdillah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “There is no prayer at midday except on the day of Friday.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 15

chapter: Chapter on the Deeds to Be Attained on Night of Friday and Its Day
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Safwan, from Ibn Muskan, from Ismail ibn Abd al-Khaliq, he said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about the time of Dhuhr. Imam (a.s) said: “After the meridian (zawal) by a footstep or something like that, except on the day of Friday or while traveling, for its time is when the sun passes the meridian.”
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنِ اِبْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَلْخَالِقِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ وَقْتِ اَلظُّهْرِ فَقَالَ« بَعْدَ اَلزَّوَالِ بِقَدَمٍ أَوْ نَحْوِ ذَلِكَ إِلاَّ فِي يَوْمِ اَلْجُمُعَةِ أَوْ فِي اَلسَّفَرِ فَإِنَّ وَقْتَهَا حِينَ تَزُولُ»
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Safwan, from Ibn Muskan, from Ismail ibn Abd al-Khaliq, he said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about the time of Dhuhr. Imam (a.s) said: “After the meridian (zawal) by a footstep or something like that, except on the day of Friday or while traveling, for its time is when the sun passes the meridian.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 15

chapter: Chapter on the Deeds to Be Attained on Night of Friday and Its Day
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Umar ibn Udhaynah, from Zurarah, he said:
I heard Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, say: “Indeed, among matters are those that are restricted and those that are expansive, and indeed, time is of two types. Prayer is among those matters in which there is flexibility. So sometimes the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, would pray early, and sometimes He (saws) would delay except for the Friday prayer (Salat Al Jumu'ah), for the Friday prayer (Salat Al Jumu'ah) is among the restricted matters. It has only one time, which is when the sun passes the meridian (zawal), and the time of Asr on the day of Friday is the same as the time of Dhuhr on the rest of the days.”
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ أُذَيْنَةَ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ يَقُولُ:« إِنَّ مِنَ اَلْأُمُورِ أُمُوراً مُضَيَّقَةً وَ أُمُوراً مُوَسَّعَةً وَ إِنَّ اَلْوَقْتَ وَقْتَانِ اَلصَّلاَةُ مِمَّا فِيهِ اَلسَّعَةُ فَرُبَّمَا عَجَّلَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ وَ رُبَّمَا أَخَّرَ إِلاَّ صَلاَةَ اَلْجُمُعَةِ فَإِنَّ صَلاَةَ اَلْجُمُعَةِ مِنَ اَلْأَمْرِ اَلْمُضَيَّقِ إِنَّمَا لَهَا وَقْتٌ وَاحِدٌ حِينَ تَزُولُ وَ وَقْتُ اَلْعَصْرِ يَوْمَ اَلْجُمُعَةِ وَقْتُ اَلظُّهْرِ فِي سَائِرِ اَلْأَيَّامِ»
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Umar ibn Udhaynah, from Zurarah, he said:
thaqalaynMatn: I heard Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, say: “Indeed, among matters are those that are restricted and those that are expansive, and indeed, time is of two types. Prayer is among those matters in which there is flexibility. So sometimes the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, would pray early, and sometimes He (saws) would delay except for the Friday prayer (Salat Al Jumu'ah), for the Friday prayer (Salat Al Jumu'ah) is among the restricted matters. It has only one time, which is when the sun passes the meridian (zawal), and the time of Asr on the day of Friday is the same as the time of Dhuhr on the rest of the days.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 15

chapter: Chapter on the Deeds to Be Attained on Night of Friday and Its Day
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Said from Safwan from Abdillah ibn Bukayr from Abu Basir, he said:
I entered upon Abu Abdillah (a.s) on a Friday, and I had already performed the Friday prayer (Salat Al Jumu'ah) and the Asr prayer. I found that Imam (a.s) had had intercourse. Imam (a.s) came out to me in a sheet, then called his slave girl and ordered her to bring him water to pour over himself. I asked Imam (a.s): “May Allah (swt) keep you well, have you not performed ghusl?” Imam (a.s) said: “I have not performed ghusl yet, nor have I prayed.” I asked Imam (a.s): “I have already prayed Dhuhr and Asr together.” Imam (a.s) said: “There is no problem in that.”
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ بُكَيْرٍ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ قَالَ: دَخَلْتُ عَلَى أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ فِي يَوْمِ جُمُعَةٍ وَ قَدْ صَلَّيْتُ اَلْجُمُعَةَ وَ اَلْعَصْرَ فَوَجَدْتُهُ قَدْ بَاهَى يَعْنِي مِنَ اَلْبَاهِ أَيْ جَامَعَ فَخَرَجَ إِلَيَّ فِي مِلْحَفَةٍ ثُمَّ دَعَا جَارِيَتَهُ فَأَمَرَهَا أَنْ تَضَعَ لَهُ مَاءً تَصُبُّهُ عَلَيْهِ فَقُلْتُ لَهُ أَصْلَحَكَ اَللَّهُ اِغْتَسَلْتَ فَقَالَ« مَا اِغْتَسَلْتُ بَعْدُ وَ لاَ صَلَّيْتُ» فَقُلْتُ لَهُ قَدْ صَلَّيْنَا اَلظُّهْرَ وَ اَلْعَصْرَ جَمِيعاً قَالَ« لاَ بَأْسَ»
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Said from Safwan from Abdillah ibn Bukayr from Abu Basir, he said:
thaqalaynMatn: I entered upon Abu Abdillah (a.s) on a Friday, and I had already performed the Friday prayer (Salat Al Jumu'ah) and the Asr prayer. I found that Imam (a.s) had had intercourse. Imam (a.s) came out to me in a sheet, then called his slave girl and ordered her to bring him water to pour over himself. I asked Imam (a.s): “May Allah (swt) keep you well, have you not performed ghusl?” Imam (a.s) said: “I have not performed ghusl yet, nor have I prayed.” I asked Imam (a.s): “I have already prayed Dhuhr and Asr together.” Imam (a.s) said: “There is no problem in that.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 15

chapter: Chapter on the Deeds to Be Attained on Night of Friday and Its Day
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
As for what was narrated by al-Husayn ibn Said from Muhammad ibn Sinan from Ibn Muskan from Sulayman ibn Khalid, he said:
I said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “May I perform some rak’ahs on the day of Friday beforehand?” Imam (a.s) said: “Yes, six rak’ahs.” I asked: “Which of the two is better, that I perform the rak’ahs on the day of Friday beforehand, or that I pray them after the obligatory prayer?” Imam (a.s) said: “Praying them after the obligatory prayer is better.”
