As for what was narrated by Sa’ad ibn Abdillah from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Isma’il ibn Buzay from Zarif ibn Nasih from Tha‘labah ibn Maymun from Abdullah ibn Yazid, he said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about the leper and the one with vitiligo, if they can lead the Muslims in prayer? Imam (a.s) said: “Yes.” I asked: “Does Allah (swt) test the believer with them?” Imam (a.s) said: “Yes and upon whom else does Allah (swt) decree affliction other than the believer?”
arabicText: فَأَمَّا مَا رَوَاهُ سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ بَزِيعٍ عَنْ ظَرِيفِ بْنِ نَاصِحٍ عَنْ ثَعْلَبَةَ بْنِ مَيْمُونٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلْمَجْذُومِ وَ اَلْأَبْرَصِ يَؤُمَّانِ اَلْمُسْلِمِينَ فَقَالَ« نَعَمْ» قُلْتُ هَلْ يَبْتَلِي اَللَّهُ بِهِمَا اَلْمُؤْمِنَ قَالَ« نَعَمْ وَ هَلْ كَتَبَ اَللَّهُ اَلْبَلاَءَ إِلاَّ عَلَى اَلْمُؤْمِنِ»
thaqalaynSanad: As for what was narrated by Sa’ad ibn Abdillah from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Isma’il ibn Buzay from Zarif ibn Nasih from Tha‘labah ibn Maymun from Abdullah ibn Yazid, he said:

chapter: Chapter on the Rulings of Congregational Prayer (the Minimum Number for Congregational Prayer, the Description of the Imam, Who Is to Be Followed and Who Is Not to Be Followed, Recitation Behind Both of Them, the Rulings of Those Led in Prayer, and Other Such Rulings Related to It)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ya‘qub from Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from al-Nawfali from al-Sakuni from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, from his father (a.s), he said:
The Commander of the Faithful (a.s), peace be upon him, said: “The one who is restrained (in chains) does not lead those who are free, nor does one afflicted with paralysis lead those who are healthy, nor does the one performing tayammum lead those who have performed wudu’, and the blind man does not lead (prayer) in the open desert unless he is directed toward the qiblah.”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اَلنَّوْفَلِيِّ عَنِ اَلسَّكُونِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ قَالَ أَمِيرُ اَلْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ:« لاَ يَؤُمُّ اَلْمُقَيَّدُ اَلْمُطْلَقِينَ وَ لاَ صَاحِبُ اَلْفَالِجِ اَلْأَصِحَّاءَ وَ لاَ صَاحِبُ اَلتَّيَمُّمِ اَلْمُتَوَضِّئِينَ وَ لاَ يَؤُمُّ اَلْأَعْمَى فِي اَلصَّحْرَاءِ إِلاَّ أَنْ يُوَجَّهَ إِلَى اَلْقِبْلَةِ»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ya‘qub from Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from al-Nawfali from al-Sakuni from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, from his father (a.s), he said:
thaqalaynMatn: The Commander of the Faithful (a.s), peace be upon him, said: “The one who is restrained (in chains) does not lead those who are free, nor does one afflicted with paralysis lead those who are healthy, nor does the one performing tayammum lead those who have performed wudu’, and the blind man does not lead (prayer) in the open desert unless he is directed toward the qiblah.”

chapter: Chapter on the Rulings of Congregational Prayer (the Minimum Number for Congregational Prayer, the Description of the Imam, Who Is to Be Followed and Who Is Not to Be Followed, Recitation Behind Both of Them, the Rulings of Those Led in Prayer, and Other Such Rulings Related to It)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Said from Ibn Abi Umayr from Umar ibn Udhaynah from Ali ibn Said al-Basri, he said:
I said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “I am residing among Bani Adi, and their muadhdhin and imam (of prayer) and all the people of the mosque are Uthmanis, they disassociate themselves from you (Imam al-Sadiq (a.s)) and your Shiah, and I am living among them. What do you say regarding prayer behind their imam (of prayer)?” Imam (a.s) said: “Pray behind him.” He (al-Basri) said: “Imam (a.s) then said to me: ‘And seek reward for what you hear. And if you were to go to Basrah, al-Fudayl ibn Yasar would surely ask you, and you would inform him of what I have issued to you as a verdict and then you would follow al-Fudayl’s word and leave mine.’” Ali (al-Basri) said: “So I went to Basrah and informed al-Fudayl of what Imam (a.s) had said. He (al-Fudayl) replied: “Imam (a.s) knows better what he said, but I have heard Him (a.s) and I have heard his father (Imam al-Baqir (a.s)) both saying: ‘Do not count the prayer behind a nasib (known enemy of the Ahlulbayt (a.s)), and recite to yourself as if you were alone.’” He (al-Basri) said: “So I followed the statement of al-Fudayl and left the statement of Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him.”
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ أُذَيْنَةَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ اَلْبَصْرِيِّ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ إِنِّي نَازِلٌ فِي بَنِي عَدِيٍّ وَ مُؤَذِّنُهُمْ وَ إِمَامُهُمْ وَ جَمِيعُ أَهْلِ اَلْمَسْجِدِ عُثْمَانِيَّةٌ يَتَبَرَّءُونَ مِنْكُمْ وَ مِنْ شِيعَتِكُمْ وَ أَنَا نَازِلٌ فِيهِمْ فَمَا تَرَى فِي اَلصَّلاَةِ خَلْفَ اَلْإِمَامِ قَالَ« صَلِّ خَلْفَهُ» قَالَ قَالَ« وَ اِحْتَسِبْ بِمَا تَسْمَعُ وَ لَوْ قَدِمْتَ اَلْبَصْرَةَ لَقَدْ سَأَلَكَ اَلْفُضَيْلُ بْنُ يَسَارٍ وَ أَخْبَرْتَهُ بِمَا أَفْتَيْتُكَ فَتَأْخُذُ بِقَوْلِ اَلْفُضَيْلِ وَ تَدَعُ قَوْلِي» قَالَ عَلِيٌّ فَقَدِمْتُ اَلْبَصْرَةَ فَأَخْبَرْتُ فُضَيْلاً بِمَا قَالَ فَقَالَ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا قَالَ وَ لَكِنِّي قَدْ سَمِعْتُهُ وَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَاهُ يَقُولاَنِ« لاَ تَعْتَدَّ بِالصَّلاَةِ خَلْفَ اَلنَّاصِبِ وَ اِقْرَأْ لِنَفْسِكَ كَأَنَّكَ وَحْدَكَ» قَالَ فَأَخَذْتُ بِقَوْلِ اَلْفُضَيْلِ وَ تَرَكْتُ قَوْلَ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Said from Ibn Abi Umayr from Umar ibn Udhaynah from Ali ibn Said al-Basri, he said:
thaqalaynMatn: I said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “I am residing among Bani Adi, and their muadhdhin and imam (of prayer) and all the people of the mosque are Uthmanis, they disassociate themselves from you (Imam al-Sadiq (a.s)) and your Shiah, and I am living among them. What do you say regarding prayer behind their imam (of prayer)?” Imam (a.s) said: “Pray behind him.” He (al-Basri) said: “Imam (a.s) then said to me: ‘And seek reward for what you hear. And if you were to go to Basrah, al-Fudayl ibn Yasar would surely ask you, and you would inform him of what I have issued to you as a verdict and then you would follow al-Fudayl’s word and leave mine.’” Ali (al-Basri) said: “So I went to Basrah and informed al-Fudayl of what Imam (a.s) had said. He (al-Fudayl) replied: “Imam (a.s) knows better what he said, but I have heard Him (a.s) and I have heard his father (Imam al-Baqir (a.s)) both saying: ‘Do not count the prayer behind a nasib (known enemy of the Ahlulbayt (a.s)), and recite to yourself as if you were alone.’” He (al-Basri) said: “So I followed the statement of al-Fudayl and left the statement of Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him.”

englishText:
And from him, from Safwan, from Ibn Bukayr, from Zurarah, from Humran, he said:
Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said to me (Humran): “Indeed, in the Book of Ali (a.s), peace be upon him, it is written: ‘If they perform the Jumu‘ah prayer within its (proper) time, then pray with them.’” Zurarah said: “I said to him (Humran) ‘This is something that should not be, was it out of taqiyyah toward the enemy of Allah (swt) that I should follow him (in prayer)?’” Humran said: “How could it be taqiyyah on my part when I did not even ask Imam (a.s)? Imam (a.s) is the one who initiated with me and said; ‘In the Book of Ali (a.s), peace be upon him, it said ‘If they perform the Jumu‘ah prayer within its (proper) time, then pray with them.’ How could there be any taqiyyah in this from Imam (a.s)?” I (Zurarah) said: “He exercised taqiyyah with you, and this is something that is not permissible.” Until it happened that we gathered in the presence of Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, and Humran said to Imam (a.s): “May Allah set you right, I narrated the hadith which you narrated to me, that in the ‘Book of Ali (a.s)’, peace be upon him, it says: ‘If they perform the Jumu‘ah prayer within its (proper) time, then pray with them.’” So He (Zurarah) said: “That cannot be. arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنِ اِبْنِ بُكَيْرٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ حُمْرَانَ قَالَ: قَالَ لِي أَبُو عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ« إِنَّ فِي كِتَابِ عَلِيٍّ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ« إِذَا صَلَّوُا اَلْجُمُعَةَ فِي وَقْتٍ فَصَلُّوا مَعَهُمْ»» قَالَ زُرَارَةُ قُلْتُ لَهُ هَذَا مَالاَ يَكُونُ اِتَّقَاكَ عَدُوُّ اَللَّهِ أَقْتَدِي بِهِ قَالَ حُمْرَانُ كَيْفَ اِتَّقَانِي وَأَنَا لَمْ أَسْأَلْهُ هُوَ اَلَّذِي اِبْتَدَأَنِي وَقَالَ« فِي كِتَابِ عَلِيٍّ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ« إِذَا صَلَّوُا اَلْجُمُعَةَ فِي وَقْتٍ فَصَلُّوا مَعَهُمْ»» كَيْفَ يَكُونُ فِي هَذَا مِنْهُ تَقِيَّةٌ قَالَ قُلْتُ قَدِ اِتَّقَاكَ وَهَذَا مَالاَ يَجُوزُ حَتَّى قُضِيَ أَنَّا اِجْتَمَعْنَا عِنْدَ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ فَقَالَ لَهُ حُمْرَانُ أَصْلَحَكَ اَللَّهُ حَدَّثْتُ هَذَا اَلْحَدِيثَ اَلَّذِي حَدَّثْتَنِي بِهِ «أَنَّ فِي كِتَابِ عَلِيٍّ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ« إِذَا صَلَّوُا اَلْجُمُعَةَ فِي وَقْتٍ فَصَلُّوا مَعَهُمْ»» فَقَالَ هَذَا لاَ يَكُونُ عَدُوُّ اَللَّهِ فَاسِقٌ لاَ يَنْبَغِي لَنَا أَنْ نَقْتَدِيَ بِهِ وَ لاَ نُصَلِّيَ مَعَهُ فَقَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ« فِي كِتَابِ عَلِيٍّ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ« إِذَا صَلَّوُا اَلْجُمُعَةَ فِي وَقْتٍ فَصَلُّوا مَعَهُمْ» وَ لاَ تَقُومَنَّ مِنْ مَقْعَدِكَ حَتَّى تُصَلِّيَ رَكْعَتَيْنِ أُخْرَيَيْنِ» قُلْتُ فَأَكُونُ قَدْ صَلَّيْتُ أَرْبَعاً لِنَفْسِي لَمْ أَقْتَدِ بِهِ فَقَالَ« نَعَمْ» قَالَ فَسَكَتَ وَ سَكَتَ صَاحِبِي وَ رَضِينَا
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Safwan, from Ibn Bukayr, from Zurarah, from Humran, he said:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said to me (Humran): “Indeed, in the Book of Ali (a.s), peace be upon him, it is written: ‘If they perform the Jumu‘ah prayer within its (proper) time, then pray with them.’” Zurarah said: “I said to him (Humran) ‘This is something that should not be, was it out of taqiyyah toward the enemy of Allah (swt) that I should follow him (in prayer)?’” Humran said: “How could it be taqiyyah on my part when I did not even ask Imam (a.s)? chapter: Chapter on the Rulings of Congregational Prayer (the Minimum Number for Congregational Prayer, the Description of the Imam, Who Is to Be Followed and Who Is Not to Be Followed, Recitation Behind Both of Them, the Rulings of Those Led in Prayer, and Other Such Rulings Related to It)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from al-Nadr, from Yahya al-Halabi, from Ibn Muskan, from Ismail al-Jufi, he said:
I said to Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him: “A man loves the Commander of the Faithful (a.s), peace be upon him, but does not disassociate from his enemy, and he says, ‘He (Imam Ali (a.s)) is more beloved to me than the one who opposed him.’” Imam al-Baqir (a.s) said: “This is someone confused and mixed up, and he is an enemy. Do not pray behind him, and no honor is due to him unless you are practicing taqiyyah toward him.”
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنِ اَلنَّضْرِ عَنْ يَحْيَى اَلْحَلَبِيِّ عَنِ اِبْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ اَلْجُعْفِيِّ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ رَجُلٌ يُحِبُّ أَمِيرَ اَلْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ وَ لاَ يَبْرَأُ مِنْ عَدُوِّهِ وَ يَقُولُ هُوَ أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ مِمَّنْ خَالَفَهُ فَقَالَ« هَذَا مِخْلَطٌ وَ هُوَ عَدُوٌّ لاَ تُصَلِّ خَلْفَهُ وَ لاَ كَرَامَةَ إِلاَّ أَنْ تَتَّقِيَهُ»
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from al-Nadr, from Yahya al-Halabi, from Ibn Muskan, from Ismail al-Jufi, he said:
thaqalaynMatn: I said to Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him: “A man loves the Commander of the Faithful (a.s), peace be upon him, but does not disassociate from his enemy, and he says, ‘He (Imam Ali (a.s)) is more beloved to me than the one who opposed him.’” Imam al-Baqir (a.s) said: “This is someone confused and mixed up, and he is an enemy. Do not pray behind him, and no honor is due to him unless you are practicing taqiyyah toward him.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 32

chapter: Chapter on the Rulings of Congregational Prayer (the Minimum Number for Congregational Prayer, the Description of the Imam, Who Is to Be Followed and Who Is Not to Be Followed, Recitation Behind Both of Them, the Rulings of Those Led in Prayer, and Other Such Rulings Related to It)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa from Abu Abdillah al-Barqi, he said:
I wrote to Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him: “May I be your ransom, is it permissible to pray behind someone who has stopped (withheld) regarding your father (Imam al-Ridha (a.s)) and grandfather (Imams (a.s)), peace be upon them all?” He (a.s) replied: “Do not pray behind him.”
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ اَلْبَرْقِيِّ قَالَ: كَتَبْتُ إِلَى أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ أَ يَجُوزُ جُعِلْتُ فِدَاكَ اَلصَّلاَةُ خَلْفَ مَنْ وَقَفَ عَلَى أَبِيكَ وَ جَدِّكَ صَلَوَاتُُ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِمَا فَأَجَابَ« لاَ تُصَلِّ وَرَاءَهُ»
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa from Abu Abdillah al-Barqi, he said:
thaqalaynMatn: I wrote to Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him: “May I be your ransom, is it permissible to pray behind someone who has stopped (withheld) regarding your father (Imam al-Ridha (a.s)) and grandfather (Imams (a.s)), peace be upon them all?” He (a.s) replied: “Do not pray behind him.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 32

chapter: Chapter on the Rulings of Congregational Prayer (the Minimum Number for Congregational Prayer, the Description of the Imam, Who Is to Be Followed and Who Is Not to Be Followed, Recitation Behind Both of Them, the Rulings of Those Led in Prayer, and Other Such Rulings Related to It)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Said from Safwan and Fadalah from al-‘Ala’ from Muhammad from one of the two (Imams (a.s)), peace be upon them:
Imam (a.s) was asked about a slave leading the people in prayer if they are pleased with him and he is the most knowledgeable among them in the Qur’an. Imam (a.s) said: “There is no harm in it.”
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ وَفَضَالَةَ عَنِ اَلْعَلاَءِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَحَدِهِمَا عَلَيْهِمَا اَلسَّلاَمُ: أَنَّهُ سُئِلَ عَنِ اَلْعَبْدِ يَؤُمُّ اَلْقَوْمَ إِذَا رَضُوا بِهِ وَ كَانَ أَكْثَرَهُمْ قُرْآناً قَالَ« لاَ بَأْسَ بِهِ»
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Said from Safwan and Fadalah from al-‘Ala’ from Muhammad from one of the two (Imams (a.s)), peace be upon them:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) was asked about a slave leading the people in prayer if they are pleased with him and he is the most knowledgeable among them in the Qur’an. Imam (a.s) said: “There is no harm in it.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 32

chapter: Chapter on the Rulings of Congregational Prayer (the Minimum Number for Congregational Prayer, the Description of the Imam, Who Is to Be Followed and Who Is Not to Be Followed, Recitation Behind Both of Them, the Rulings of Those Led in Prayer, and Other Such Rulings Related to It)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Hammad, from Hariz, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:
I asked Aba Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about a servant (abd) leading the people in prayer if they are content with him and he is the most versed among them in the Qur’an. Imam (a.s) said: “There is no problem with it.”
arabicText: وَعَنْهُ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلْعَبْدِ يَؤُمُّ اَلْقَوْمَ إِذَا رَضُوا بِهِ وَ كَانَ أَكْثَرَهُمْ قُرْآناً قَالَ« لاَ بَأْسَ بِهِ»
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Hammad, from Hariz, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Aba Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about a servant (abd) leading the people in prayer if they are content with him and he is the most versed among them in the Qur’an. Imam (a.s) said: “There is no problem with it.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 32

chapter: Chapter on the Rulings of Congregational Prayer (the Minimum Number for Congregational Prayer, the Description of the Imam, Who Is to Be Followed and Who Is Not to Be Followed, Recitation Behind Both of Them, the Rulings of Those Led in Prayer, and Other Such Rulings Related to It)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from al-Hasan, from Zurah, from Sama’ah, who said:
I asked Imam (a.s) about the owned slave (mamluk) leading the people in prayer. Imam (a.s) said: “No, except if he is the most understanding of them and the most knowledgeable among them.”
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ عَنْ زُرْعَةَ عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلْمَمْلُوكِ يَؤُمُّ اَلنَّاسَ فَقَالَ« لاَ إِلاَّ أَنْ يَكُونَ هُوَ أَفْقَهَهُمْ وَ أَعْلَمَهُمْ»
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from al-Hasan, from Zurah, from Sama’ah, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Imam (a.s) about the owned slave (mamluk) leading the people in prayer. Imam (a.s) said: “No, except if he is the most understanding of them and the most knowledgeable among them.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 32

chapter: Chapter on the Rulings of Congregational Prayer (the Minimum Number for Congregational Prayer, the Description of the Imam, Who Is to Be Followed and Who Is Not to Be Followed, Recitation Behind Both of Them, the Rulings of Those Led in Prayer, and Other Such Rulings Related to It)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya from Ibn Abi Ishaq from al-Nawfali from al-Sakuni from Imam Ja’far (a.s) from his father, Imam al-Baqir (a.s), peace be upon them both, from Imam Ali (a.s), peace be upon him:
Imam Ali (a.s) said: “The slave (abd) should not lead (in prayer) except his own household.”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ عَنِ اَلنَّوْفَلِيِّ عَنِ اَلسَّكُونِيِّ عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَلِيٍّ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ:« لاَ يَؤُمُّ اَلْعَبْدُ إِلاَّ أَهْلَهُ»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya from Ibn Abi Ishaq from al-Nawfali from al-Sakuni from Imam Ja’far (a.s) from his father, Imam al-Baqir (a.s), peace be upon them both, from Imam Ali (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam Ali (a.s) said: “The slave (abd) should not lead (in prayer) except his own household.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 32

chapter: Chapter on the Rulings of Congregational Prayer (the Minimum Number for Congregational Prayer, the Description of the Imam, Who Is to Be Followed and Who Is Not to Be Followed, Recitation Behind Both of Them, the Rulings of Those Led in Prayer, and Other Such Rulings Related to It)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya narrated from al-Hasan ibn Musa al-Khashshab from Ghiyath ibn Kallub from Ishaq ibn Ammar from Imam Ja’far (a.s) from his father, Imam al-Baqir (a.s), peace be upon them both:
Imam Ali (a.s), peace be upon him, used to say: “There is no problem if a boy (al-ghulam) gives the call to prayer (adhan) before reaching puberty, but he should not lead (in prayer) until he reaches puberty. So if he leads (in prayer), his prayer is valid, but the prayer of those behind him is invalid.”
arabicText: رَوَى مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ مُوسَى اَلْخَشَّابِ عَنْ غِيَاثِ بْنِ كَلُّوبٍ عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَلَيْهِمَا اَلسَّلاَمُ أَنَّ عَلِيّاً عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ كَانَ يَقُولُ:« لاَ بَأْسَ أَنْ يُؤَذِّنَ اَلْغُلاَمُ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَحْتَلِمَ وَ لاَ يَؤُمُّ حَتَّى يَحْتَلِمَ فَإِنْ أَمَّ جَازَتْ صَلاَتُهُ وَ فَسَدَتْ صَلاَةُ مَنْ خَلْفَهُ»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya narrated from al-Hasan ibn Musa al-Khashshab from Ghiyath ibn Kallub from Ishaq ibn Ammar from Imam Ja’far (a.s) from his father, Imam al-Baqir (a.s), peace be upon them both:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam Ali (a.s), peace be upon him, used to say: “There is no problem if a boy (al-ghulam) gives the call to prayer (adhan) before reaching puberty, but he should not lead (in prayer) until he reaches puberty. So if he leads (in prayer), his prayer is valid, but the prayer of those behind him is invalid.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 33

chapter: Chapter on the Rulings of Congregational Prayer (the Minimum Number for Congregational Prayer, the Description of the Imam, Who Is to Be Followed and Who Is Not to Be Followed, Recitation Behind Both of Them, the Rulings of Those Led in Prayer, and Other Such Rulings Related to It)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
As for what was narrated by Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Talhah ibn Zayd from Imam Ja’far (a.s) from his father, Imam al-Baqir (a.s), peace be upon them both, from Imam Ali (a.s), peace be upon him:
Imam Ali (a.s) said: “There is no problem if the boy who has not reached puberty gives the call to prayer (adhan) and leads (the prayer).”
arabicText: وَ أَمَّا مَا رَوَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ طَلْحَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَلِيٍّ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« لاَ بَأْسَ أَنْ يُؤَذِّنَ اَلْغُلاَمُ اَلَّذِي لَمْ يَحْتَلِمْ وَ أَنْ يَؤُمَّ»
thaqalaynSanad: As for what was narrated by Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Talhah ibn Zayd from Imam Ja’far (a.s) from his father, Imam al-Baqir (a.s), peace be upon them both, from Imam Ali (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam Ali (a.s) said: “There is no problem if the boy who has not reached puberty gives the call to prayer (adhan) and leads (the prayer).”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 33

chapter: Chapter on the Rulings of Congregational Prayer (the Minimum Number for Congregational Prayer, the Description of the Imam, Who Is to Be Followed and Who Is Not to Be Followed, Recitation Behind Both of Them, the Rulings of Those Led in Prayer, and Other Such Rulings Related to It)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Sa’ad from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ibn Abi Umayr from Hammad ibn Uthman from Ubaydullah ibn Ali al-Halabi from Abi Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “There is no problem if the blind man leads the people in prayer, even if they are the ones who direct him.”
arabicText: سَعْدٌ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ اَلْحَلَبِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« لاَ بَأْسَ بِأَنْ يُصَلِّيَ اَلْأَعْمَى بِالْقَوْمِ وَ إِنْ كَانُوا هُمُ اَلَّذِينَ يُوَجِّهُونَهُ»
thaqalaynSanad: Sa’ad from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ibn Abi Umayr from Hammad ibn Uthman from Ubaydullah ibn Ali al-Halabi from Abi Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “There is no problem if the blind man leads the people in prayer, even if they are the ones who direct him.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 33

chapter: Chapter on the Rulings of Congregational Prayer (the Minimum Number for Congregational Prayer, the Description of the Imam, Who Is to Be Followed and Who Is Not to Be Followed, Recitation Behind Both of Them, the Rulings of Those Led in Prayer, and Other Such Rulings Related to It)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Sa’ad ibn Abdillah from Yaqub ibn Yazid from Amru ibn Uthman and Muhammad ibn Yazid from Muhammad ibn Udhafir from Umar ibn Yazid, who said:
I asked Aba Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about an imam (of prayer) who is acceptable in all his matters, knowledgeable, except that he speaks to his parents with harsh words that provoke their anger, may I recite (prayer) behind him? Imam (a.s) said: “No, do not read behind him, as he is undutiful and severing (ties).”
arabicText: سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ عُثْمَانَ وَ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عُذَافِرٍ عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ إِمَامٍ لاَ بَأْسَ بِهِ فِي جَمِيعِ أَمْرِهِ عَارِفٍ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ يُسْمِعُ أَبَوَيْهِ اَلْكَلاَمَ اَلْغَلِيظَ اَلَّذِي يَغِيظُهُمَا أَقْرَأُ خَلْفَهُ قَالَ« لاَ، تَقْرَأُ خَلْفَهُ مَا لَمْ يَكُنْ عَاقّاً قَاطِعاً»
thaqalaynSanad: Sa’ad ibn Abdillah from Yaqub ibn Yazid from Amru ibn Uthman and Muhammad ibn Yazid from Muhammad ibn Udhafir from Umar ibn Yazid, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Aba Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about an imam (of prayer) who is acceptable in all his matters, knowledgeable, except that he speaks to his parents with harsh words that provoke their anger, may I recite (prayer) behind him? Imam (a.s) said: “No, do not read behind him, as he is undutiful and severing (ties).”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 33

chapter: Chapter on the Rulings of Congregational Prayer (the Minimum Number for Congregational Prayer, the Description of the Imam, Who Is to Be Followed and Who Is Not to Be Followed, Recitation Behind Both of Them, the Rulings of Those Led in Prayer, and Other Such Rulings Related to It)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya from al-Abbas ibn Maruf from Muhammad ibn Sinan from Talhah ibn Zayd, who said: Thawr ibn Ghaylan narrated to us from Abu Dharr, who said:
(Abu Dharr said) “Indeed, your ‘imam’ (of prayer) is your intercessor before Allah (swt), so do not make your intercessor someone foolish or immoral (fasiq).”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنِ اَلْعَبَّاسِ بْنِ مَعْرُوفٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ طَلْحَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا ثَوْرُ بْنُ غَيْلاَنَ عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ قَالَ: إِنَّ إِمَامَكَ شَفِيعُكَ إِلَى اَللَّهِ فَلاَ تَجْعَلْ شَفِيعَكَ سَفِيهاً وَ لاَ فَاسِقاً.
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya from al-Abbas ibn Maruf from Muhammad ibn Sinan from Talhah ibn Zayd, who said: Thawr ibn Ghaylan narrated to us from Abu Dharr, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: (Abu Dharr said) “Indeed, your ‘imam’ (of prayer) is your intercessor before Allah (swt), so do not make your intercessor someone foolish or immoral (fasiq).”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 34

chapter: Chapter on the Rulings of Congregational Prayer (the Minimum Number for Congregational Prayer, the Description of the Imam, Who Is to Be Followed and Who Is Not to Be Followed, Recitation Behind Both of Them, the Rulings of Those Led in Prayer, and Other Such Rulings Related to It)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya from Abi Ja’far from Abi al-Jawza from al-Husayn ibn Alwan from Amru ibn Khalid from Zayd ibn Ali from his forefathers from Imam Ali (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam Ali (a.s) said: “The uncircumcised person (al-aghlaf) does not lead the people in prayer, even if he is the most proficient among them in recitation, because he has neglected the greatest of the Sunnah. His testimony is not accepted, nor is the funeral prayer performed over him except if he abandoned it (circumcision) out of fear for his life.”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَبِي اَلْجَوْزَاءِ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ عُلْوَانَ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ خَالِدٍ عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ عَنْ آبَائِهِ عَنْ عَلِيٍّ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« اَلْأَ غْلَفُ لاَ يَؤُمُّ اَلْقَوْمَ وَ إِنْ كَانَ أَقْرَأَهُمْ لِأَنَّهُ ضَيَّعَ مِنَ اَلسُّنَّةِ أَعْظَمَهَا وَ لاَ تُقْبَلُ لَهُ شَهَادَةٌ وَ لاَ يُصَلَّى عَلَيْهِ إِلاَّ أَنْ يَكُونَ تَرَكَ ذَلِكَ خَوْفاً عَلَى نَفْسِهِ»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya from Abi Ja’far from Abi al-Jawza from al-Husayn ibn Alwan from Amru ibn Khalid from Zayd ibn Ali from his forefathers from Imam Ali (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam Ali (a.s) said: “The uncircumcised person (al-aghlaf) does not lead the people in prayer, even if he is the most proficient among them in recitation, because he has neglected the greatest of the Sunnah. His testimony is not accepted, nor is the funeral prayer performed over him except if he abandoned it (circumcision) out of fear for his life.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 34

chapter: Chapter on the Rulings of Congregational Prayer (the Minimum Number for Congregational Prayer, the Description of the Imam, Who Is to Be Followed and Who Is Not to Be Followed, Recitation Behind Both of Them, the Rulings of Those Led in Prayer, and Other Such Rulings Related to It)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Muhammad ibn Isa from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Yaqtin from Amru ibn Ibrahim from Khalaf ibn Hammad from a man from Abi Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “Do not pray behind the extremist (al-ghali), even if he claims your belief; nor behind the unknown (al-majhul); nor behind one who openly commits immorality (al-mujahir bil-fisq), even if he is moderate.”
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ يَقْطِينٍ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ خَلَفِ بْنِ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ رَجُلٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« لاَ تُصَلِّ خَلْفَ اَلْغَالِي وَ إِنْ كَانَ يَقُولُ بِقَوْلِكَ وَ اَلْمَجْهُولِ وَ اَلْمُجَاهِرِ بِالْفِسْقِ وَ إِنْ كَانَ مُقْتَصِداً»
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Muhammad ibn Isa from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Yaqtin from Amru ibn Ibrahim from Khalaf ibn Hammad from a man from Abi Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “Do not pray behind the extremist (al-ghali), even if he claims your belief; nor behind the unknown (al-majhul); nor behind one who openly commits immorality (al-mujahir bil-fisq), even if he is moderate.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 34

chapter: Chapter on the Rulings of Congregational Prayer (the Minimum Number for Congregational Prayer, the Description of the Imam, Who Is to Be Followed and Who Is Not to Be Followed, Recitation Behind Both of Them, the Rulings of Those Led in Prayer, and Other Such Rulings Related to It)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Sa’ad ibn Ismail from his father, said:
I said to Imam al-Ridha (a.s), peace be upon him: “A man commits sins while being knowledgeable of this matter may I pray behind him?” Imam (a.s) said: “No.”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِلرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ رَجُلٌ يُقَارِفُ اَلذُّنُوبَ وَ هُوَ عَارِفٌ بِهَذَا اَلْأَمْرِ أُصَلِّي خَلْفَهُ قَالَ« لاَ»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Sa’ad ibn Ismail from his father, said:
thaqalaynMatn: I said to Imam al-Ridha (a.s), peace be upon him: “A man commits sins while being knowledgeable of this matter may I pray behind him?” Imam (a.s) said: “No.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 34

chapter: Chapter on the Rulings of Congregational Prayer (the Minimum Number for Congregational Prayer, the Description of the Imam, Who Is to Be Followed and Who Is Not to Be Followed, Recitation Behind Both of Them, the Rulings of Those Led in Prayer, and Other Such Rulings Related to It)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Said narrated from Uthman ibn Isa from Sama’ah ibn Mihran, who said:
I asked Aba Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about a woman leading women in prayer. Imam (a.s) said: “There is no problem with it.”
arabicText: رَوَى اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ بْنِ مِهْرَانَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلْمَرْأَةِ تَؤُمُّ اَلنِّسَاءَ فَقَالَ« لاَ بَأْسَ بِهِ»
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Said narrated from Uthman ibn Isa from Sama’ah ibn Mihran, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Aba Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about a woman leading women in prayer. Imam (a.s) said: “There is no problem with it.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 35

chapter: Chapter on the Rulings of Congregational Prayer (the Minimum Number for Congregational Prayer, the Description of the Imam, Who Is to Be Followed and Who Is Not to Be Followed, Recitation Behind Both of Them, the Rulings of Those Led in Prayer, and Other Such Rulings Related to It)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Sa’ad ibn Abdillah from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal from Abdillah ibn Bukayr from some of our companions from Abi Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) was asked regarding a man leading a woman in prayer. Imam (a.s) said: “Yes, she stands behind him.” And (Imam (a.s) was asked) regarding a woman leading women in prayer. Imam (a.s) said: “Yes, and she stands in the middle of them and does not stand in front of them.”
arabicText: سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ بُكَيْرٍ عَنْ بَعْضِ أَصْحَابِنَا عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: فِي اَلرَّجُلِ يَؤُمُّ اَلْمَرْأَةَ قَالَ« نَعَمْ تَكُونُ خَلْفَهُ» وَ عَنِ اَلْمَرْأَةِ تَؤُمُّ اَلنِّسَاءَ قَالَ« نَعَمْ وَ تَقُومُ وَسَطاً بَيْنَهُنَّ وَ لاَ تَتَقَدَّمُهُنَّ»
thaqalaynSanad: Sa’ad ibn Abdillah from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal from Abdillah ibn Bukayr from some of our companions from Abi Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) was asked regarding a man leading a woman in prayer. Imam (a.s) said: “Yes, she stands behind him.” And (Imam (a.s) was asked) regarding a woman leading women in prayer. Imam (a.s) said: “Yes, and she stands in the middle of them and does not stand in front of them.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 35

chapter: Chapter on the Rulings of Congregational Prayer (the Minimum Number for Congregational Prayer, the Description of the Imam, Who Is to Be Followed and Who Is Not to Be Followed, Recitation Behind Both of Them, the Rulings of Those Led in Prayer, and Other Such Rulings Related to It)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Yaqub narrated from Ali ibn Muhammad and others from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Ibn Mahbub from Ibn Riab from Abi Ubaydah, who said:
I asked Aba Abdillah (a.s) about a group of our companions who gather and the time of prayer arrives, so some of them say to others, “Step forward, O’ so-and-so.” Imam (a.s) said: “Indeed, the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, said: ‘The one who should lead the people is the one most proficient in the recitation of the Qur’an. If they are equal in recitation, then the one who migrated earlier. If they are equal in migration, then the eldest in age. If they are equal in age, then the one who is more knowledgeable of the Sunnah and more understanding in religion. And none of you should step ahead of a man in his own home, nor of a person of authority in his domain.’”
arabicText: رَوَى مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ غَيْرِهِ عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَهْلِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ رِئَابٍ عَنْ أَبِي عُبَيْدَةَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلْقَوْمِ مِنْ أَصْحَابِنَا يَجْتَمِعُونَ فَتَحْضُرُ اَلصَّلاَةُ فَيَقُولُ بَعْضُهُمْ لِبَعْضٍ تَقَدَّمْ يَا فُلاَنُ فَقَالَ« إِنَّ رَسُولَ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ قَالَ« يَتَقَدَّمُ اَلْقَوْمَ أَقْرَؤُهُمْ لِلْقُرْآنِ فَإِنْ كَانُوا فِي اَلْقِرَاءَةِ سَوَاءً فَأَقْدَمُهُمْ هِجْرَةً فَإِنْ كَانُوا فِي اَلْهِجْرَةِ سَوَاءً فَأَكْبَرُهُمْ سِنّاً فَإِنْ كَانُوا فِي اَلسِّنِّ سَوَاءً فَلْيَؤُمَّهُمْ أَعْلَمُهُمْ بِالسُّنَّةِ وَ أَفْقَهُهُمْ فِي اَلدِّينِ وَ لاَ يَتَقَدَّمَنَّ أَحَدُكُمُ اَلرَّجُلَ فِي مَنْزِلِهِ وَ لاَ صَاحِبَ سُلْطَانٍ فِي سُلْطَانِهِ»»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Yaqub narrated from Ali ibn Muhammad and others from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Ibn Mahbub from Ibn Riab from Abi Ubaydah, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Aba Abdillah (a.s) about a group of our companions who gather and the time of prayer arrives, so some of them say to others, “Step forward, O’ so-and-so.” Imam (a.s) said: “Indeed, the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, said: ‘The one who should lead the people is the one most proficient in the recitation of the Qur’an. If they are equal in recitation, then the one who migrated earlier. If they are equal in migration, then the eldest in age. If they are equal in age, then the one who is more knowledgeable of the Sunnah and more understanding in religion. And none of you should step ahead of a man in his own home, nor of a person of authority in his domain.’”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 35

chapter: Chapter on the Rulings of Congregational Prayer (the Minimum Number for Congregational Prayer, the Description of the Imam, Who Is to Be Followed and Who Is Not to Be Followed, Recitation Behind Both of Them, the Rulings of Those Led in Prayer, and Other Such Rulings Related to It)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Yaqub narrated from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn and Muhammad ibn Ismail from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan, all from Safwan ibn Yahya from Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Hajjaj, who said:
I asked Aba Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about prayer behind the imam (of prayer), should I recite behind him? Imam (a.s) said: “As for the prayer in which the recitation is not done aloud, then that has been assigned to him (the imam of prayer), so do not recite behind him. But as for the prayer in which the recitation is done aloud, then we were only commanded to recite aloud so that those behind him may listen attentively. So if you hear, then remain silent; and if you do not hear, then recite.”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ وَمُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ عَنِ اَلْفَضْلِ بْنِ شَاذَانَ جَمِيعاً عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ عَبْدِ اَلرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ اَلْحَجَّاجِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلصَّلاَةِ خَلْفَ اَلْإِمَامِ أَقْرَأُ خَلْفَهُ فَقَالَ« أَمَّا اَلصَّلاَةُ اَلَّتِي لاَ يُجْهَرُ فِيهَا بِالْقِرَاءَةِ فَإِنَّ ذَلِكَ جُعِلَ إِلَيْهِ فَلاَ تَقْرَأْ خَلْفَهُ وَ أَمَّا اَلَّتِي يُجْهَرُ فِيهَا فَإِنَّمَا أَمَرْنَا بِالْجَهْرِ لِيُنْصِتَ مَنْ خَلْفَهُ فَإِنْ سَمِعْتَ فَأَنْصِتْ وَ إِنْ لَمْ تَسْمَعْ فَاقْرَأْ»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Yaqub narrated from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn and Muhammad ibn Ismail from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan, all from Safwan ibn Yahya from Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Hajjaj, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Aba Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about prayer behind the imam (of prayer), should I recite behind him? Imam (a.s) said: “As for the prayer in which the recitation is not done aloud, then that has been assigned to him (the imam of prayer), so do not recite behind him. But as for the prayer in which the recitation is done aloud, then we were only commanded to recite aloud so that those behind him may listen attentively. So if you hear, then remain silent; and if you do not hear, then recite.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 35

chapter: Chapter on the Rulings of Congregational Prayer (the Minimum Number for Congregational Prayer, the Description of the Imam, Who Is to Be Followed and Who Is Not to Be Followed, Recitation Behind Both of Them, the Rulings of Those Led in Prayer, and Other Such Rulings Related to It)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Ibn Abi Umayr from Hammad from al-Halabi from Abi Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “If you pray behind an imam (of prayer) whom you are following, then do not recite behind him whether you hear his recitation or not except if it is a prayer in which the recitation is done aloud and you do not hear it, then recite.”
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنِ اَلْحَلَبِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «إِذَا صَلَّيْتَ خَلْفَ إِمَامٍ تَأْتَمُّ بِهِ فَلاَ تَقْرَأْ خَلْفَهُ سَمِعْتَ قِرَاءَتَهُ أَوْ لَمْ تَسْمَعْ إِلاَّ أَنْ تَكُونَ صَلاَةً يُجْهَرُ فِيهَا وَلَمْ تَسْمَعْ فَاقْرَأْ»
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Ibn Abi Umayr from Hammad from al-Halabi from Abi Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “If you pray behind an imam (of prayer) whom you are following, then do not recite behind him whether you hear his recitation or not except if it is a prayer in which the recitation is done aloud and you do not hear it, then recite.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 36

chapter: Chapter on the Rulings of Congregational Prayer (the Minimum Number for Congregational Prayer, the Description of the Imam, Who Is to Be Followed and Who Is Not to Be Followed, Recitation Behind Both of Them, the Rulings of Those Led in Prayer, and Other Such Rulings Related to It)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Ali from his father from Hammad ibn Isa from Hariz from Zurarah from one of the two (Imams (a.s)), peace be upon them, who said:
Imam (a.s) said: “If you are behind an imam (of prayer) whom you are following, then remain silent and glorify (Allah (swt)) in yourself.”
arabicText: وَعَنْهُ عَنْ عَلِيٍّ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَحَدِهِمَا عَلَيْهِمَا اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« إِذَا كُنْتَ خَلْفَ إِمَامٍ تَأْتَمُّ بِهِ فَأَنْصِتْ وَ سَبِّحْ فِي نَفْسِكَ»
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Ali from his father from Hammad ibn Isa from Hariz from Zurarah from one of the two (Imams (a.s)), peace be upon them, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: “If you are behind an imam (of prayer) whom you are following, then remain silent and glorify (Allah (swt)) in yourself.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 36

chapter: Chapter on the Rulings of Congregational Prayer (the Minimum Number for Congregational Prayer, the Description of the Imam, Who Is to Be Followed and Who Is Not to Be Followed, Recitation Behind Both of Them, the Rulings of Those Led in Prayer, and Other Such Rulings Related to It)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Ali from his father from Abdillah ibn al-Mughirah from Qutaybah from Abi Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “If you are behind an imam (of prayer) whom you are pleased with, in a prayer in which the recitation is done aloud, and you do not hear his recitation, then recite for yourself. But if you hear the murmuring sound (hammhamah), then do not recite.”
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ عَلِيٍّ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ اَلْمُغِيرَةِ عَنْ قُتَيْبَةَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« إِذَا كُنْتَ خَلْفَ إِمَامٍ تَرْتَضِي بِهِ فِي صَلاَةٍ يُجْهَرُ فِيهَا بِالْقِرَاءَةِ فَلَمْ تَسْمَعْ قِرَاءَتَهُ فَاقْرَأْ أَنْتَ لِنَفْسِكَ وَ إِنْ كُنْتَ تَسْمَعُ اَلْهَمْهَمَةَ فَلاَ تَقْرَأْ»
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Ali from his father from Abdillah ibn al-Mughirah from Qutaybah from Abi Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “If you are behind an imam (of prayer) whom you are pleased with, in a prayer in which the recitation is done aloud, and you do not hear his recitation, then recite for yourself. But if you hear the murmuring sound (hammhamah), then do not recite.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 36

chapter: Chapter on the Rulings of Congregational Prayer (the Minimum Number for Congregational Prayer, the Description of the Imam, Who Is to Be Followed and Who Is Not to Be Followed, Recitation Behind Both of Them, the Rulings of Those Led in Prayer, and Other Such Rulings Related to It)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal from Yunus ibn Yaqub, who said:
I asked Aba Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about praying behind someone whom I am pleased with, should I recite (separately) behind him? Imam (a.s) said: “The one you are pleased with, do not recite (separately) behind him.” (meaning his recitation suffices you)
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ يَعْقُوبَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلصَّلاَةِ خَلْفَ مَنْ أَرْتَضِي بِهِ أَقْرَأُ خَلْفَهُ فَقَالَ« مَنْ رَضِيتَ بِهِ فَلاَ تَقْرَأْ خَلْفَهُ»
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal from Yunus ibn Yaqub, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Aba Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about praying behind someone whom I am pleased with, should I recite (separately) behind him? Imam (a.s) said: “The one you are pleased with, do not recite (separately) behind him.” (meaning his recitation suffices you)

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 37

chapter: Chapter on the Rulings of Congregational Prayer (the Minimum Number for Congregational Prayer, the Description of the Imam, Who Is to Be Followed and Who Is Not to Be Followed, Recitation Behind Both of Them, the Rulings of Those Led in Prayer, and Other Such Rulings Related to It)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Said from al-Nadr ibn Suwayd from Hisham from Sulayman ibn Khalid and Ali ibn al-Numan from Abdillah ibn Muskan from Sulayman ibn Khalid, who said:
I said to Aba Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “Should a man recite in Dhuhr and Asr prayers, behind the imam (of prayer), while he does not know whether the imam (of prayer) is reciting?” Imam (a.s) said: “He should not recite; he should entrust it to the imam (of prayer).”
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ اَلنَّضْرِ بْنِ سُوَيْدٍ عَنْ هِشَامٍ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ خَالِدٍ وَعَلِيِّ بْنِ اَلنُّعْمَانِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ خَالِدٍ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ أَ يَقْرَأُ اَلرَّجُلُ فِي اَلْأُولَى وَ اَلْعَصْرِ خَلْفَ اَلْإِمَامِ وَ هُوَ لاَ يَعْلَمُ أَنَّهُ يَقْرَأُ فَقَالَ« لاَ يَنْبَغِي لَهُ أَنْ يَقْرَأَ يَكِلُهُ إِلَى اَلْإِمَامِ»
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Said from al-Nadr ibn Suwayd from Hisham from Sulayman ibn Khalid and Ali ibn al-Numan from Abdillah ibn Muskan from Sulayman ibn Khalid, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I said to Aba Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “Should a man recite in Dhuhr and Asr prayers, behind the imam (of prayer), while he does not know whether the imam (of prayer) is reciting?” Imam (a.s) said: “He should not recite; he should entrust it to the imam (of prayer).”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 37

chapter: Chapter on the Rulings of Congregational Prayer (the Minimum Number for Congregational Prayer, the Description of the Imam, Who Is to Be Followed and Who Is Not to Be Followed, Recitation Behind Both of Them, the Rulings of Those Led in Prayer, and Other Such Rulings Related to It)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Said Ibn Uqdah narrated, saying: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Khazimi narrated to us, who said: al-Hasan ibn al-Husayn narrated to us, who said: Ibrahim ibn Ali al-Murafiqi and Abu Ahmad Amru ibn al-Rabi al-Nasri narrated to us from Ja’far ibn Muhammad (a.s), peace be upon him:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) was asked about reciting behind the imam (of prayer). Imam (a.s) said: “If you are behind an imam (of prayer) whom you follow and trust, then his recitation suffices you. But if you wish to recite, then recite in the parts where he recites quietly. When he recites aloud, then listen attentively. Allah (swt), the Exalted, said: ‘And listen attentively so that you may receive mercy.’” (Surah Al-Aʿraf 7:204) Imam (a.s) was then asked: “And if I do not trust him (imam of prayer), should I pray behind him and recite?” Imam (a.s) said: “No. Pray before him or after him.” Imam (a.s) was asked: “Shall I pray behind him and make it a supererogatory prayer?” Imam (a.s) said: “If the supererogatory prayer were accepted, then the obligatory would have been accepted. But rather, make it a tasbih prayer (a non-obligatory act of glorification).”
arabicText: رَوَى أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍاِ بْنُ عُقْدَةَ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى اَلْخَازِمِيُّ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا اَلْحَسَنُ بْنُ اَلْحُسَيْنِ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ اَلْمُرَافِقِيُّ وَ أَبُو أَحْمَدَ عَمْرُو بْنُ اَلرَّبِيعِ اَلنَّصْرِيُّ عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: أَنَّهُ سُئِلَ عَنِ اَلْقِرَاءَةِ خَلْفَ اَلْإِمَامِ فَقَالَ« إِذَا كُنْتَ خَلْفَ إِمَامٍ تَتَوَلاَّهُ وَ تَثِقُ بِهِ فَإِنَّهُ يُجْزِيكَ قِرَاءَتُهُ وَ إِنْ أَحْبَبْتَ أَنْ تَقْرَأَ فَاقْرَأْ فِيمَا يُخَافِتُ فِيهِ فَإِذَا جَهَرَ فَأَنْصِتْ قَالَ اَللَّهُ تَعَالَى« وَأَنْصِتُوا لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ»» قَالَ فَقِيلَ لَهُ فَإِنْ لَمْ أَكُنْ أَثِقُ بِهِ أَ فَأُصَلِّي خَلْفَهُ وَ أَقْرَأُ قَالَ« لاَ صَلِّ قَبْلَهُ أَوْ بَعْدَهُ» فَقِيلَ لَهُ أَ فَأُصَلِّي خَلْفَهُ وَ أَجْعَلُهَا تَطَوُّعاً قَالَ فَقَالَ« لَوْ قُبِلَ اَلتَّطَوُّعُ لَقُبِلَتِ اَلْفَرِيضَةُ وَ لَكِنِ اِجْعَلْهَا سُبْحَةً»
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Said Ibn Uqdah narrated, saying: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Khazimi narrated to us, who said: al-Hasan ibn al-Husayn narrated to us, who said: Ibrahim ibn Ali al-Murafiqi and Abu Ahmad Amru ibn al-Rabi al-Nasri narrated to us from Ja’far ibn Muhammad (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) was asked about reciting behind the imam (of prayer). Imam (a.s) said: “If you are behind an imam (of prayer) whom you follow and trust, then his recitation suffices you. But if you wish to recite, then recite in the parts where he recites quietly. When he recites aloud, then listen attentively. Allah (swt), the Exalted, said: ‘And listen attentively so that you may receive mercy.’” (Surah Al-Aʿraf 7:204) Imam (a.s) was then asked: “And if I do not trust him (imam of prayer), should I pray behind him and recite?” Imam (a.s) said: “No. Pray before him or after him.” Imam (a.s) was asked: “Shall I pray behind him and make it a supererogatory prayer?” Imam (a.s) said: “If the supererogatory prayer were accepted, then the obligatory would have been accepted. But rather, make it a tasbih prayer (a non-obligatory act of glorification).”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 37

chapter: Chapter on the Rulings of Congregational Prayer (the Minimum Number for Congregational Prayer, the Description of the Imam, Who Is to Be Followed and Who Is Not to Be Followed, Recitation Behind Both of Them, the Rulings of Those Led in Prayer, and Other Such Rulings Related to It)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
As for what was narrated by Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr from Hammad ibn Uthman from al-Halabi from Abi Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “If you pray behind an imam (of prayer) whom you are following, then do not recite behind him whether you hear his recitation or do not hear it.”
arabicText: فَأَمَّا مَا رَوَاهُ أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنِ اَلْحَلَبِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« إِذَا صَلَّيْتَ خَلْفَ إِمَامٍ تَأْتَمُّ بِهِ فَلاَ تَقْرَأْ خَلْفَهُ سَمِعْتَ قِرَاءَتَهُ أَوْ لَمْ تَسْمَعْ»
thaqalaynSanad: As for what was narrated by Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr from Hammad ibn Uthman from al-Halabi from Abi Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “If you pray behind an imam (of prayer) whom you are following, then do not recite behind him whether you hear his recitation or do not hear it.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 37

chapter: Chapter on the Rulings of Congregational Prayer (the Minimum Number for Congregational Prayer, the Description of the Imam, Who Is to Be Followed and Who Is Not to Be Followed, Recitation Behind Both of Them, the Rulings of Those Led in Prayer, and Other Such Rulings Related to It)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Sa’ad ibn Abdillah from Abi Ja’far from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Yaqtin, who said:
I asked Aba al-Hasan al-Awwal (a.s), peace be upon him, about a man who prays behind an imam (of prayer) whom he follows in a prayer in which the recitation is done aloud, but he does not hear the recitation. Imam (a.s) said: “There is no problem whether he remains silent or recites.”
arabicText: سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ يَقْطِينٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا اَلْحَسَنِ اَلْأَوَّلَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يُصَلِّي خَلْفَ إِمَامٍ يَقْتَدِي بِهِ فِي صَلاَةٍ يُجْهَرُ فِيهَا بِالْقِرَاءَةِ فَلاَ يَسْمَعُ اَلْقِرَاءَةَ قَالَ« لاَ بَأْسَ إِنْ صَمَتَ وَ إِنْ قَرَأَ»
thaqalaynSanad: Sa’ad ibn Abdillah from Abi Ja’far from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Yaqtin, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Aba al-Hasan al-Awwal (a.s), peace be upon him, about a man who prays behind an imam (of prayer) whom he follows in a prayer in which the recitation is done aloud, but he does not hear the recitation. Imam (a.s) said: “There is no problem whether he remains silent or recites.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 38

chapter: Chapter on the Rulings of Congregational Prayer (the Minimum Number for Congregational Prayer, the Description of the Imam, Who Is to Be Followed and Who Is Not to Be Followed, Recitation Behind Both of Them, the Rulings of Those Led in Prayer, and Other Such Rulings Related to It)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Said from al-Hasan from Zurah from Sama’ah, who said:
I asked Imam (a.s) about an imam (of prayer) who makes a mistake in the Qur’an and does not know what to say. Imam (a.s) said: “Someone from behind him should prompt him.” He (Sama’ah) said: “And I asked Imam (a.s) about a man leading the people in prayer, and they hear his voice but do not understand what he is saying.” Imam (a.s) said: “If he hears his voice, then it suffices him; and if he does not hear his voice, then he should recite for himself.”
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ عَنْ زُرْعَةَ عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلْإِمَامِ إِذَا أَخْطَأَ فِي اَلْقُرْآنِ فَلاَ يَدْرِي مَا يَقُولُ قَالَ« يَفْتَحُ عَلَيْهِ بَعْضُ مَنْ خَلْفَهُ» قَالَ وَ سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يَؤُمُّ اَلنَّاسَ فَيَسْمَعُونَ صَوْتَهُ وَ لاَ يَفْقَهُونَ مَا يَقُولُ فَقَالَ« إِذَا سَمِعَ صَوْتَهُ فَهُوَ يُجْزِيهِ وَ إِذَا لَمْ يَسْمَعْ صَوْتَهُ قَرَأَ لِنَفْسِهِ»
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Said from al-Hasan from Zurah from Sama’ah, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Imam (a.s) about an imam (of prayer) who makes a mistake in the Qur’an and does not know what to say. Imam (a.s) said: “Someone from behind him should prompt him.” He (Sama’ah) said: “And I asked Imam (a.s) about a man leading the people in prayer, and they hear his voice but do not understand what he is saying.” Imam (a.s) said: “If he hears his voice, then it suffices him; and if he does not hear his voice, then he should recite for himself.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 38

chapter: Chapter on the Rulings of Congregational Prayer (the Minimum Number for Congregational Prayer, the Description of the Imam, Who Is to Be Followed and Who Is Not to Be Followed, Recitation Behind Both of Them, the Rulings of Those Led in Prayer, and Other Such Rulings Related to It)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Said from Safwan from Ibn Sinan from Abi Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “If you are behind the imam (of prayer) in a prayer in which the recitation is not done aloud, then remain silent until he finishes, and if the man (the imam of prayer) is trusted with the Qur’an, then do not recite behind him in the first two units.” And Imam (a.s) said: “The glorification (tasbih) suffices you in the last two units.” I asked: “What do you yourself say?” Imam (a.s) said: “I recite Surah al-Fatihah.”
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنِ اِبْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« إِنْ كُنْتَ خَلْفَ اَلْإِمَامِ فِي صَلاَةٍ لاَ تَجْهَرُ فِيهَا بِالْقِرَاءَةِ حَتَّى تَفْرُغَ وَ كَانَ اَلرَّجُلُ مَأْمُوناً عَلَى اَلْقُرْآنِ فَلاَ تَقْرَأْ خَلْفَهُ فِي اَلْأَوَّلَتَيْنِ» وَ قَالَ« يُجْزِيكَ اَلتَّسْبِيحُ فِي اَلْأَخِيرَتَيْنِ» قُلْتُ أَيَّ شَيْءٍ تَقُولُ أَنْتَ قَالَ« أَقْرَأُ فَاتِحَةَ اَلْكِتَابِ»
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Said from Safwan from Ibn Sinan from Abi Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “If you are behind the imam (of prayer) in a prayer in which the recitation is not done aloud, then remain silent until he finishes, and if the man (the imam of prayer) is trusted with the Qur’an, then do not recite behind him in the first two units.” And Imam (a.s) said: “The glorification (tasbih) suffices you in the last two units.” I asked: “What do you yourself say?” Imam (a.s) said: “I recite Surah al-Fatihah.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 38

chapter: Chapter on the Rulings of Congregational Prayer (the Minimum Number for Congregational Prayer, the Description of the Imam, Who Is to Be Followed and Who Is Not to Be Followed, Recitation Behind Both of Them, the Rulings of Those Led in Prayer, and Other Such Rulings Related to It)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Yaqub from Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Ibn Abi Umayr from Hammad ibn Uthman from al-Halabi from Abi Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadqi (a.s) said: “If you pray behind an imam (of prayer) who is not to be followed, then recite behind him whether you hear his recitation or do not hear it.”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنِ اَلْحَلَبِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« إِذَا صَلَّيْتَ خَلْفَ إِمَامٍ لاَ يُقْتَدَى بِهِ فَاقْرَأْ خَلْفَهُ سَمِعْتَ قِرَاءَتَهُ أَوْ لَمْ تَسْمَعْ»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Yaqub from Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Ibn Abi Umayr from Hammad ibn Uthman from al-Halabi from Abi Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadqi (a.s) said: “If you pray behind an imam (of prayer) who is not to be followed, then recite behind him whether you hear his recitation or do not hear it.”

author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Said from Safwan from Abdillah ibn Bukayr from his father, Bukayr ibn Ayan, who said:
I asked Aba Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about a nasib (person with known enmity of the Ahlulbayt (a.s)) leading us in prayer what do you say about praying with him? Imam (a.s) said: “As for when he recites aloud, then listen to the Qur’an and hear it, then perform the bowing and prostration yourself, for your own self.”
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ بُكَيْرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ بُكَيْرِ بْنِ أَعْيَنَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلنَّاصِبِ يَؤُمُّنَا مَا تَقُولُ فِي اَلصَّلاَةِ مَعَهُ فَقَالَ« أَمَّا إِذَا هُوَ جَهَرَ فَأَنْصِتْ لِلْقُرْآنِ وَ اِسْمَعْ ثُمَّ اِرْكَعْ وَ اُسْجُدْ أَنْتَ لِنَفْسِكَ»
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Said from Safwan from Abdillah ibn Bukayr from his father, Bukayr ibn Ayan, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Aba Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about a nasib (person with known enmity of the Ahlulbayt (a.s)) leading us in prayer what do you say about praying with him? Imam (a.s) said: “As for when he recites aloud, then listen to the Qur’an and hear it, then perform the bowing and prostration yourself, for your own self.”

chapter: Chapter on the Rulings of Congregational Prayer (the Minimum Number for Congregational Prayer, the Description of the Imam, Who Is to Be Followed and Who Is Not to Be Followed, Recitation Behind Both of Them, the Rulings of Those Led in Prayer, and Other Such Rulings Related to It)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Said from Hammad ibn Isa from Muawiyah ibn Wahb from Abi Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) about a man who leads the people in prayer, and you are not pleased with him, in a prayer in which the recitation is done aloud. Imam (a.s) said: “If you hear the Book of Allah (swt) being recited, then listen to it.” I asked: “But he testifies against me with shirk.” Imam (a.s) said: “If he disobeys Allah (swt), then you obey Allah (swt).” I repeated the question to Imam (a.s), but Imam (a.s) refused to permit me (to recite). Then I asked the Imam (a.s): “Shall I then pray in my house and afterward go out to him?” Imam (a.s) said: “That is up to you.” And Imam (a.s) said: “Indeed, Imam Ali (a.s), peace be upon him, was in the morning prayer, and Ibn al-Kawwa, who was standing behind him, recited: 'And indeed it has been revealed to you and to those before you: if you associate (others with Allah), your deeds will surely be nullified, and you will certainly be among the losers' (Surah Az-Zumar 39:65) So Imam Ali (a.s), peace be upon him, remained silent out of reverence for the Qur’an until he completed the verse. Then Imam Ali (a.s) resumed his recitation. Ibn al-Kawwa repeated the verse, and Imam Ali (a.s), peace be upon him, again remained silent. Then Imam (a.s) recited, and Ibn al-Kawwa repeated it again, so Imam Ali (a.s), peace be upon him, remained silent once more. Then Imam Ali (a.s) recited: 'So be patient, indeed the promise of Allah (swt) is true, and let not those who are uncertain (in faith) cause you to lose resolve.' (Surah Ar-Rum 30:60). Then Imam Ali (a.s) completed the surah and bowed (into ruku).”
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ وَهْبٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يَؤُمُّ اَلْقَوْمَ وَ أَنْتَ لاَ تَرْضَى بِهِ فِي صَلاَةٍ يُجْهَرُ فِيهَا بِالْقِرَاءَةِ فَقَالَ« إِذَا سَمِعْتَ كِتَابَ اَللَّهِ يُتْلَى فَأَنْصِتْ لَهُ» قُلْتُ فَإِنَّهُ يَشْهَدُ عَلَيَّ بِالشِّرْكِ قَالَ« إِنْ عَصَى اَللَّهَ فَأَطِعِ اَللَّهَ» فَرَدَدْتُ عَلَيْهِ فَأَبَى أَنْ يُرَخِّصَ لِي قَالَ فَقُلْتُ لَهُ أُصَلِّي إِذاً فِي بَيْتِي ثُمَّ أَخْرُجُ إِلَيْهِ فَقَالَ« أَنْتَ وَذَاكَ» وَقَالَ« إِنَّ عَلِيّاً عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ كَانَ فِي صَلاَةِ اَلصُّبْحِ فَقَرَأَ اِبْنُ اَلْكَوَّاءِ وَ هُوَ خَلْفَهُ« وَ لَقَدْ أُوحِيَ إِلَيْكَ وَ إِلَى اَلَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِكَ لَئِنْ أَشْرَكْتَ لَيَحْبَطَنَّ عَمَلُكَ وَ لَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ اَلْخٰاسِرِينَ» فَأَنْصَتَ عَلِيٌّ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ تَعْظِيماً لِلْقُرْآنِ حَتَّى فَرَغَ مِنَ اَلْآيَةِ ثُمَّ عَادَ فِي قِرَاءَتِهِ ثُمَّ أَعَادَ اِبْنُ اَلْكَوَّاءِ اَلْآيَةَ فَأَنْصَتَ عَلِيٌّ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ أَيْضاً ثُمَّ قَرَأَ فَأَعَادَ اِبْنُ اَلْكَوَّاءِ فَأَنْصَتَ عَلِيٌّ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ ثُمَّ قَالَ«« فَاصْبِرْ إِنَّ وَعْدَ اَللّٰهِ حَقٌّ وَ لاٰ يَسْتَخِفَّنَّكَ اَلَّذِينَ لاٰ يُوقِنُونَ»» ثُمَّ أَتَمَّ اَلسُّورَةَ ثُمَّ رَكَعَ»
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Said from Hammad ibn Isa from Muawiyah ibn Wahb from Abi Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) about a man who leads the people in prayer, and you are not pleased with him, in a prayer in which the recitation is done aloud. Imam (a.s) said: “If you hear the Book of Allah (swt) being recited, then listen to it.” I asked: “But he testifies against me with shirk.” Imam (a.s) said: “If he disobeys Allah (swt), then you obey Allah (swt).” I repeated the question to Imam (a.s), but Imam (a.s) refused to permit me (to recite). Then I asked the Imam (a.s): “Shall I then pray in my house and afterward go out to him?” Imam (a.s) said: “That is up to you.” And Imam (a.s) said: “Indeed, Imam Ali (a.s), peace be upon him, was in the morning prayer, and Ibn al-Kawwa, who was standing behind him, recited: 'And indeed it has been revealed to you and to those before you: if you associate (others with Allah), your deeds will surely be nullified, and you will certainly be among the losers' (Surah Az-Zumar 39:65) So Imam Ali (a.s), peace be upon him, remained silent out of reverence for the Qur’an until he completed the verse. Then Imam Ali (a.s) resumed his recitation. Ibn al-Kawwa repeated the verse, and Imam Ali (a.s), peace be upon him, again remained silent. Then Imam (a.s) recited, and Ibn al-Kawwa repeated it again, so Imam Ali (a.s), peace be upon him, remained silent once more. Then Imam Ali (a.s) recited: 'So be patient, indeed the promise of Allah (swt) is true, and let not those who are uncertain (in faith) cause you to lose resolve.' (Surah Ar-Rum 30:60). Then Imam Ali (a.s) completed the surah and bowed (into ruku).”

author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Sa’ad from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr from Muhammad ibn Ishaq and Muhammad ibn Abi Hamzah from someone who mentioned it from Abi Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “It suffices you, when you are with them, to recite like the whispering of the soul (hadith al-nafs).” (meaning to recite quietly to yourself)
arabicText: سَعْدٌ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ وَ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ عَمَّنْ ذَكَرَهُ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« يُجْزِيكَ إِذَا كُنْتَ مَعَهُمْ مِنَ اَلْقِرَاءَةِ مِثْلُ حَدِيثِ اَلنَّفْسِ»
thaqalaynSanad: Sa’ad from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr from Muhammad ibn Ishaq and Muhammad ibn Abi Hamzah from someone who mentioned it from Abi Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “It suffices you, when you are with them, to recite like the whispering of the soul (hadith al-nafs).” (meaning to recite quietly to yourself)

chapter: Chapter on the Rulings of Congregational Prayer (the Minimum Number for Congregational Prayer, the Description of the Imam, Who Is to Be Followed and Who Is Not to Be Followed, Recitation Behind Both of Them, the Rulings of Those Led in Prayer, and Other Such Rulings Related to It)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Yaqtin from his brother al-Husayn ibn Ali ibn Yaqtin from their father Ali ibn Yaqtin, who said:
I asked Aba al-Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him, about a man who prays behind someone whose prayer he does not follow, and the imam (of prayer) recites aloud. Imam (a.s) said: “Recite for yourself, and if you do not make yourself hear it, then there is no problem.”
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ يَقْطِينٍ عَنْ أَخِيهِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ يَقْطِينٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ يَقْطِينٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا اَلْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يُصَلِّي خَلْفَ مَنْ لاَ يَقْتَدِي بِصَلاَتِهِ وَ اَلْإِمَامُ يَجْهَرُ بِالْقِرَاءَةِ قَالَ« اِقْرَأْ لِنَفْسِكَ وَ إِنْ لَمْ تُسْمِعْ نَفْسَكَ فَلاَ بَأْسَ»
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Yaqtin from his brother al-Husayn ibn Ali ibn Yaqtin from their father Ali ibn Yaqtin, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Aba al-Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him, about a man who prays behind someone whose prayer he does not follow, and the imam (of prayer) recites aloud. Imam (a.s) said: “Recite for yourself, and if you do not make yourself hear it, then there is no problem.”

chapter: Chapter on the Rulings of Congregational Prayer (the Minimum Number for Congregational Prayer, the Description of the Imam, Who Is to Be Followed and Who Is Not to Be Followed, Recitation Behind Both of Them, the Rulings of Those Led in Prayer, and Other Such Rulings Related to It)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Sa’ad ibn Abdillah from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn ibn Abi al-Khattab from al-Hasan ibn Musa al-Khashshab from Ali ibn Asbat from some of his companions from Abi Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, and Abi Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him:
Imam (a.s) was asked concerning a man who is behind an imam (of prayer) but does not follow him in prayer, and the imam (of prayer) precedes him in the recitation. Imam (a.s) said: “If he has already recited the ‘Umm Ul Kitab’ (Surah al-Fatihah), it suffices him. He interrupts (his own recitation) and bows.”
arabicText: سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ أَبِي اَلْخَطَّابِ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ مُوسَى اَلْخَشَّابِ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَسْبَاطٍ عَنْ بَعْضِ أَصْحَابِهِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ وَ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: فِي اَلرَّجُلِ يَكُونُ خَلْفَ اَلْإِمَامِ لاَ يَقْتَدِي بِهِ فَيَسْبِقُهُ اَلْإِمَامُ بِالْقِرَاءَةِ قَالَ« إِنْ كَانَ قَدْ قَرَأَ أُمَّ اَلْكِتَابِ أَجْزَأَهُ يَقْطَعُ وَ يَرْكَعُ»
thaqalaynSanad: Sa’ad ibn Abdillah from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn ibn Abi al-Khattab from al-Hasan ibn Musa al-Khashshab from Ali ibn Asbat from some of his companions from Abi Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, and Abi Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) was asked concerning a man who is behind an imam (of prayer) but does not follow him in prayer, and the imam (of prayer) precedes him in the recitation. Imam (a.s) said: “If he has already recited the ‘Umm Ul Kitab’ (Surah al-Fatihah), it suffices him. He interrupts (his own recitation) and bows.”

chapter: Chapter on the Rulings of Congregational Prayer (the Minimum Number for Congregational Prayer, the Description of the Imam, Who Is to Be Followed and Who Is Not to Be Followed, Recitation Behind Both of Them, the Rulings of Those Led in Prayer, and Other Such Rulings Related to It)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Sa’ad ibn Abdillah from Musa ibn al-Hasan and al-Hasan ibn Ali from Ahmad ibn Hilal from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr from Ahmad ibn Aidh, who said:
I said to Aba al-Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him: “I enter with these people in the Maghrib prayer, and they hasten me such that I do not give the adhan or the iqamah, and I do not recite anything until they bow, and I bow with them does that suffice me?” Imam (a.s) said: “Yes.”
arabicText: سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ اَلْحَسَنِ وَ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ هِلاَلٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي نَصْرٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ عَائِذٍ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي اَلْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ إِنِّي أَدْخُلُ مَعَ هَؤُلاَءِ فِي صَلاَةِ اَلْمَغْرِبِ فَيُعَجِّلُونِّي إِلَى مَا أَنْ أُؤَذِّنَ وَ أُقِيمَ فَلاَ أَقْرَأَ شَيْئاً حَتَّى إِذَا رَكَعُوا وَ أَرْكَعَ مَعَهُمْ أَفَيُجْزِينِي ذَلِكَ قَالَ« نَعَمْ»
thaqalaynSanad: Sa’ad ibn Abdillah from Musa ibn al-Hasan and al-Hasan ibn Ali from Ahmad ibn Hilal from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr from Ahmad ibn Aidh, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I said to Aba al-Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him: “I enter with these people in the Maghrib prayer, and they hasten me such that I do not give the adhan or the iqamah, and I do not recite anything until they bow, and I bow with them does that suffice me?” Imam (a.s) said: “Yes.”

chapter: Chapter on the Rulings of Congregational Prayer (the Minimum Number for Congregational Prayer, the Description of the Imam, Who Is to Be Followed and Who Is Not to Be Followed, Recitation Behind Both of Them, the Rulings of Those Led in Prayer, and Other Such Rulings Related to It)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Sa’ad ibn Abdillah narrated from Musa ibn al-Hasan and al-Hasan ibn Ali from Ahmad ibn Hilal from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr from Abu al-Hasan al-Ridha (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
I said to Imam al-Ridha (a.s): “I enter with these people in the Maghrib prayer, and they hasten me such that I do not give the adhan and the iqamah, and I do not recite except ‘al-Hamd’ (Surah al-Fatihah) until they bow does that suffice me?” Imam (a.s) said: “Yes, ‘al-Hamd’ (Surah al-Fatihah) alone suffices you.”
arabicText: رَوَى سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ اَلْحَسَنِ وَ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ هِلاَلٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي نَصْرٍ عَنْ أَبِي اَلْحَسَنِ اَلرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لَهُ إِنِّي أَدْخُلُ مَعَ هَؤُلاَءِ فِي صَلاَةِ اَلْمَغْرِبِ فَيُعَجِّلُونِّي إِلَى مَا أَنْ أُؤَذِّنَ وَ أُقِيمَ وَ لاَ أَقْرَأَ إِلاَّ اَلْحَمْدَ حَتَّى يَرْكَعَ أَيُجْزِينِي ذَلِكَ فَقَالَ« نَعَمْ يُجْزِيكَ اَلْحَمْدُ وَحْدَهَا»
thaqalaynSanad: Sa’ad ibn Abdillah narrated from Musa ibn al-Hasan and al-Hasan ibn Ali from Ahmad ibn Hilal from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr from Abu al-Hasan al-Ridha (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I said to Imam al-Ridha (a.s): “I enter with these people in the Maghrib prayer, and they hasten me such that I do not give the adhan and the iqamah, and I do not recite except ‘al-Hamd’ (Surah al-Fatihah) until they bow does that suffice me?” Imam (a.s) said: “Yes, ‘al-Hamd’ (Surah al-Fatihah) alone suffices you.”
