chapter: Chapter on the Virtue of the Month of Ramadan and the Prayers Within It in Addition to the Recommended Prayers Mentioned in the Other Months
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Ali ibn Sulayman, who said: Ali ibn Abi Khulays narrated to us, who said: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Mutahhar narrated to me:
I wrote to Abu Muhammad (Imam al-Askari (a.s)), peace be upon him: “A man has narrated from your forefathers, peace be upon them, that the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, did not increase in prayer during the Month of Ramadan beyond what He (saws) used to pray on other days.” Imam (a.s), peace be upon him, responded in his own handwriting: “He has lied, may Allah (swt) tear his mouth! Pray every night in the Month of Ramadan twenty rak’ahs until the twentieth of the month. And pray on the night of the twenty-first; one hundred rak’ahs, and pray on the night of the twenty-third; one hundred rak’ahs, and pray every night of the last ten nights; thirty rak’ahs.”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ سُلَيْمَانَ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ أَبِي خُلَيْسٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُطَهَّرٍ قَالَ: كَتَبْتُ إِلَى أَبِي مُحَمَّدٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ إِنَّ رَجُلاً رَوَى عَنْ آبَائِكَ عَلَيْهِمُ اَلسَّلاَمُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ مَا كَانَ يَزِيدُ مِنَ اَلصَّلاَةِ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ عَلَى مَا كَانَ يُصَلِّيهِ فِي سَائِرِ اَلْأَيَّامِ فَوَقَّعَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ« كَذَبَ فَضَّ اَللَّهُ فَاهُ صَلِّ فِي كُلِّ لَيْلَةٍ مِنْ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ عِشْرِينَ رَكْعَةً إِلَى عِشْرِينَ مِنَ اَلشَّهْرِ وَ صَلِّ لَيْلَةَ إِحْدَى وَعِشْرِينَ مِائَةَ رَكْعَةٍ وَ صَلِّ لَيْلَةَ ثَلاَثٍ وَ عِشْرِينَ مِائَةَ رَكْعَةٍ وَ صَلِّ فِي كُلِّ لَيْلَةٍ مِنَ اَلْعَشْرِ اَلْأَوَاخِرِ ثَلاَثِينَ رَكْعَةً»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Ali ibn Sulayman, who said: Ali ibn Abi Khulays narrated to us, who said: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Mutahhar narrated to me:
thaqalaynMatn: I wrote to Abu Muhammad (Imam al-Askari (a.s)), peace be upon him: “A man has narrated from your forefathers, peace be upon them, that the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, did not increase in prayer during the Month of Ramadan beyond what He (saws) used to pray on other days.” Imam (a.s), peace be upon him, responded in his own handwriting: “He has lied, may Allah (swt) tear his mouth! Pray every night in the Month of Ramadan twenty rak’ahs until the twentieth of the month. And pray on the night of the twenty-first; one hundred rak’ahs, and pray on the night of the twenty-third; one hundred rak’ahs, and pray every night of the last ten nights; thirty rak’ahs.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 75

chapter: Chapter on the Virtue of the Month of Ramadan and the Prayers Within It in Addition to the Recommended Prayers Mentioned in the Other Months
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from Ali ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Mutahhar:
(Ibn Mutahhar) wrote to Abu Muhammad (Imam al-Askari (a.s)), peace be upon him, informing Imam (a.s) of what a narration had conveyed that the Prophet (saws), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, did not used to pray during the nights of the Month of Ramadan or otherwise except thirteen rak’ahs, including the Witr and the two rak’ahs of Fajr. So Imam (a.s), peace be upon him, wrote in response: “May Allah (swt) tear his mouth! Pray in the Month of Ramadan for twenty nights; each night twenty rak’ahs, with eight after Maghrib and twelve after the final Isha. And perform ghusl on the night of the nineteenth, the night of the twenty-first, and the night of the twenty-third. And on those nights, pray thirty rak’ahs; twelve rak’ahs after Maghrib and eighteen rak’ahs after the final Isha. And on those nights, pray one hundred rak’ahs, reciting in every rak’ah the ‘Fatihat al-Kitab’ (Surah al-Fatihah) and ‘Qul huwa Allahu Ahad’ (Surah Ikhlas) ten times. And continue until the end of the month, praying every night; thirty rak’ahs, in the manner I have explained.”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُطَهَّرٍ: أَنَّهُ كَتَبَ إِلَى أَبِي مُحَمَّدٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ يُخْبِرُهُ بِمَا جَاءَتْ بِهِ اَلرِّوَايَةُ أَنَّ اَلنَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ مَا كَانَ يُصَلِّي فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ وَ غَيْرِهِ مِنَ اَللَّيْلِ سِوَى ثَلاَثَ عَشْرَةَ رَكْعَةً مِنْهَا اَلْوَتْرُ وَ رَكْعَتَا اَلْفَجْرِ فَكَتَبَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ« فَضَّ اَللَّهُ فَاهُ صَلِّ مِنْ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ فِي عِشْرِينَ لَيْلَةً كُلَّ لَيْلَةٍ عِشْرِينَ رَكْعَةً ثَمَانٍ بَعْدَ اَلْمَغْرِبِ وَاِثْنَتَيْ عَشْرَةَ بَعْدَ عِشَاءِ اَلْآخِرَةِ وَاِغْتَسِلْ لَيْلَةَ تِسْعَ عَشْرَةَ وَلَيْلَةَ إِحْدَى وَ عِشْرِينَ وَ لَيْلَةَ ثَلاَثٍ وَ عِشْرِينَ وَ صَلِّ فِيهِمَا ثَلاَثِينَ رَكْعَةً اِثْنَتَيْ عَشْرَةَ رَكْعَةً بَعْدَ اَلْمَغْرِبِ وَ ثَمَانَ عَشْرَةَ رَكْعَةً بَعْدَ اَلْعِشَاءِ اَلْآخِرَةِ وَ صَلِّ فِيهِمَا مِائَةَ رَكْعَةٍ تَقْرَأُ فِي كُلِّ رَكْعَةٍ فَاتِحَةَ اَلْكِتَابِ وَ« قُلْ هُوَ اَللّٰهُ أَحَدٌ» عَشْرَ مَرَّاتٍ وَ صَلِّ إِلَى آخِرِ اَلشَّهْرِ كُلَّ لَيْلَةٍ ثَلاَثِينَ رَكْعَةً عَلَى مَا فَسَّرْتُ»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from Ali ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Mutahhar:
thaqalaynMatn: (Ibn Mutahhar) wrote to Abu Muhammad (Imam al-Askari (a.s)), peace be upon him, informing Imam (a.s) of what a narration had conveyed that the Prophet (saws), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, did not used to pray during the nights of the Month of Ramadan or otherwise except thirteen rak’ahs, including the Witr and the two rak’ahs of Fajr. So Imam (a.s), peace be upon him, wrote in response: “May Allah (swt) tear his mouth! Pray in the Month of Ramadan for twenty nights; each night twenty rak’ahs, with eight after Maghrib and twelve after the final Isha. And perform ghusl on the night of the nineteenth, the night of the twenty-first, and the night of the twenty-third. And on those nights, pray thirty rak’ahs; twelve rak’ahs after Maghrib and eighteen rak’ahs after the final Isha. And on those nights, pray one hundred rak’ahs, reciting in every rak’ah the ‘Fatihat al-Kitab’ (Surah al-Fatihah) and ‘Qul huwa Allahu Ahad’ (Surah Ikhlas) ten times. And continue until the end of the month, praying every night; thirty rak’ahs, in the manner I have explained.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 75

chapter: Chapter on the Virtue of the Month of Ramadan and the Prayers Within It in Addition to the Recommended Prayers Mentioned in the Other Months
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
As for what was narrated by al-Husayn ibn Said from Safwan, from Ibn Muskan, from al-Halabi, who said:
I asked Imam (a.s) about the prayer in the Month of Ramadan. Imam (a.s) said: “Thirteen rak’ahs among them, the Witr and the two rak’ahs of dawn after Fajr. That is how the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, used to pray, and I also pray in the same way. And if there had been any good in anything more than that, the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, would not have left it.”
arabicText: فَأَمَّا مَا رَوَاهُ اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنِ اِبْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنِ اَلْحَلَبِيِّ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلصَّلاَةِ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ فَقَالَ« ثَلاَثَ عَشْرَةَ رَكْعَةً مِنْهَا اَلْوَتْرُ وَ رَكْعَتَا اَلصُّبْحِ بَعْدَ اَلْفَجْرِ كَذَلِكَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ يُصَلِّي وَ أَنَا كَذَلِكَ أُصَلِّي وَ لَوْ كَانَ خَيْراً لَمْ يَتْرُكْهُ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ»
thaqalaynSanad: As for what was narrated by al-Husayn ibn Said from Safwan, from Ibn Muskan, from al-Halabi, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Imam (a.s) about the prayer in the Month of Ramadan. Imam (a.s) said: “Thirteen rak’ahs among them, the Witr and the two rak’ahs of dawn after Fajr. That is how the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, used to pray, and I also pray in the same way. And if there had been any good in anything more than that, the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, would not have left it.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 75

chapter: Chapter on the Virtue of the Month of Ramadan and the Prayers Within It in Addition to the Recommended Prayers Mentioned in the Other Months
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Hammad, from Abdillah ibn al-Mughirah, from Ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), said:
I asked Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) about the prayer in the Month of Ramadan. Imam (a.s) said: “Thirteen rak’ahs among them the Witr and two rak’ahs before the Fajr prayer. That is how the Messenger of Allah (swt), used to pray. And if there had been any virtue in more than that, the Messenger of Allah (swt), would have practiced it and been more entitled to it.”
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ اَلْمُغِيرَةِ عَنِ اِبْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلصَّلاَةِ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ قَالَ« ثَلاَثَ عَشْرَةَ رَكْعَةً مِنْهَا اَلْوَتْرُ وَرَكْعَتَانِ قَبْلَ صَلاَةِ اَلْفَجْرِ كَذَلِكَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ يُصَلِّي وَ لَوْ كَانَ فَضْلاً لَكَانَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ أَعْمَلَ بِهِ وَ أَحَقَّ»
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Hammad, from Abdillah ibn al-Mughirah, from Ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) about the prayer in the Month of Ramadan. Imam (a.s) said: “Thirteen rak’ahs among them the Witr and two rak’ahs before the Fajr prayer. That is how the Messenger of Allah (swt), used to pray. And if there had been any virtue in more than that, the Messenger of Allah (swt), would have practiced it and been more entitled to it.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 76

chapter: Chapter on the Virtue of the Month of Ramadan and the Prayers Within It in Addition to the Recommended Prayers Mentioned in the Other Months
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Faddal, from Muhammad ibn Abdillah al-Halabi and al-Abbas ibn Amir al-Thaqafi, both from Abdillah ibn Bukayr, from Abd al-Hamid al-Tai, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:
I heard Abu Abdillah (a.s) say: “When the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, had prayed the final Isha, He (saws) would go to his bed and not pray anything until after midnight, neither in the Month of Ramadan nor in any other time.”
arabicText: عَلِيُّ بْنُ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ اَلْحَلَبِيِّ وَ اَلْعَبَّاسِ بْنِ عَامِرٍ اَلثَّقَفِيِّ جَمِيعاً عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ بُكَيْرٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَلْحَمِيدِ اَلطَّائِيِّ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ يَقُولُ:« كَانَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ إِذَا صَلَّى اَلْعِشَاءَ اَلْآخِرَةَ أَوَى إِلَى فِرَاشِهِ لاَ يُصَلِّي شَيْئاً إِلاَّ بَعْدَ اِنْتِصَافِ اَللَّيْلِ لاَ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ وَ لاَ فِي غَيْرِهِ»
thaqalaynSanad: Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Faddal, from Muhammad ibn Abdillah al-Halabi and al-Abbas ibn Amir al-Thaqafi, both from Abdillah ibn Bukayr, from Abd al-Hamid al-Tai, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I heard Abu Abdillah (a.s) say: “When the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, had prayed the final Isha, He (saws) would go to his bed and not pray anything until after midnight, neither in the Month of Ramadan nor in any other time.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 76

chapter: Chapter on the Virtue of the Month of Ramadan and the Prayers Within It in Addition to the Recommended Prayers Mentioned in the Other Months
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Said, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Hariz, from Zurarah, and Ibn Muslim, and al-Fudayl, said:
We asked the two of them (Imam al-Baqir (a.s) and Imam al-Sadiq (a.s)) about the supererogatory prayer (nafilah) at night during (month of) Ramadan in congregation. The Imams (a.s) said: “Indeed, the Prophet (saws), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, when He (saws) had prayed the final Isha; He would return to his home, then come out in the last part of the night to the mosque and stand and pray. So Prophet (saws) came out on the first night of the Month of Ramadan, to pray as he used to pray, and the people lined up behind Him (saws), and he fled from them into his house and left them. They did this for three nights. Then on the fourth day, Prophet (saws) ascended his pulpit, praised Allah (swt) and glorified Him (azj), and then said: ‘O people, the night prayer in the Month of Ramadan, the nafilah in congregation is an innovation (bidah), and the forenoon prayer (salat al-duha) is an innovation. Beware! Do not gather at night during the Month of Ramadan for the night prayer, and do not pray the forenoon prayer, for indeed that is disobedience. Beware! Every innovation is misguidance, and every misguidance leads to the Fire.’ Then Prophet (saws) descended while saying: ‘A little in accordance with the Sunnah is better than much in innovation.’”
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ وَ اِبْنِ مُسْلِمٍ وَ اَلْفُضَيْلِ قَالُوا: سَأَلْنَاهُمَا عَنِ اَلصَّلاَةِ فِي رَمَضَانَ نَافِلَةً بِاللَّيْلِ جَمَاعَةً فَقَالاَ« إِنَّ اَلنَّبِيَّ صَ كَانَ إِذَا صَلَّى اَلْعِشَاءَ اَلْآخِرَةَ اِنْصَرَفَ إِلَى مَنْزِلِهِ ثُمَّ يَخْرُجُ مِنْ آخِرِ اَللَّيْلِ إِلَى اَلْمَسْجِدِ فَيَقُومُ فَيُصَلِّي فَخَرَجَ فِي أَوَّلِ لَيْلَةٍ مِنْ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ لِيُصَلِّيَ كَمَا كَانَ يُصَلِّي فَاصْطَفَّ اَلنَّاسُ خَلْفَهُ فَهَرَبَ مِنْهُمْ إِلَى بَيْتِهِ وَ تَرَكَهُمْ فَفَعَلُوا ذَلِكَ ثَلاَثَ لَيَالٍ فَقَامَ فِي اَلْيَوْمِ اَلرَّابِعِ عَلَى مِنْبَرِهِ فَحَمِدَ اَللَّهَ وَ أَثْنَى عَلَيْهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ« أَيُّهَا اَلنَّاسُ إِنَّ اَلصَّلاَةَ بِاللَّيْلِ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ اَلنَّافِلَةَ فِي جَمَاعَةٍ بِدْعَةٌ وَ صَلاَةَ اَلضُّحَى بِدْعَةٌ أَلاَ فَلاَ تَجْتَمِعُوا لَيْلاً فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ لِصَلاَةِ اَللَّيْلِ وَ لاَ تُصَلُّوا صَلاَةَ اَلضُّحَى فَإِنَّ ذَلِكَ مَعْصِيَةٌ أَلاَ وَ إِنَّ كُلَّ بِدْعَةٍ ضَلاَلَةٌ وَ كُلَّ ضَلاَلَةٍ سَبِيلُهَا إِلَى اَلنَّارِ ثُمَّ نَزَلَ وَ هُوَ يَقُولُ قَلِيلٌ فِي سُنَّةٍ خَيْرٌ مِنْ كَثِيرٍ فِي بِدْعَةٍ»»
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Said, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Hariz, from Zurarah, and Ibn Muslim, and al-Fudayl, said:
thaqalaynMatn: We asked the two of them (Imam al-Baqir (a.s) and Imam al-Sadiq (a.s)) about the supererogatory prayer (nafilah) at night during (month of) Ramadan in congregation. The Imams (a.s) said: “Indeed, the Prophet (saws), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, when He (saws) had prayed the final Isha; He would return to his home, then come out in the last part of the night to the mosque and stand and pray. So Prophet (saws) came out on the first night of the Month of Ramadan, to pray as he used to pray, and the people lined up behind Him (saws), and he fled from them into his house and left them. They did this for three nights. Then on the fourth day, Prophet (saws) ascended his pulpit, praised Allah (swt) and glorified Him (azj), and then said: ‘O people, the night prayer in the Month of Ramadan, the nafilah in congregation is an innovation (bidah), and the forenoon prayer (salat al-duha) is an innovation. Beware! Do not gather at night during the Month of Ramadan for the night prayer, and do not pray the forenoon prayer, for indeed that is disobedience. Beware! Every innovation is misguidance, and every misguidance leads to the Fire.’ Then Prophet (saws) descended while saying: ‘A little in accordance with the Sunnah is better than much in innovation.’”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 77

chapter: Chapter on the Virtue of the Month of Ramadan and the Prayers Within It in Addition to the Recommended Prayers Mentioned in the Other Months
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Faddal, from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan, from Amr ibn Said al-Mada'ini, from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah, from Ammar, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) about prayer in the Month of Ramadan in the mosques. Imam (a.s) said: “When the Commander of the Faithful (a.s), peace be upon him, arrived in Kufa, He (a.s) ordered al-Hasan ibn Ali (a.s), peace be upon him, to announce to the people: ‘There is no congregational prayer in the Month of Ramadan in the mosques.’” So Imam al-Hasan ibn Ali (a.s), peace be upon him, announced to the people what the Commander of the Faithful had ordered him. So when the people heard the statement of Imam al-Hasan ibn Ali (a.s), they cried out: “O Umar! O’ Umar!” And when Imam al-Hasan (a.s) returned to the Commander of the Faithful (a.s), peace be upon him, He (a.s) asked Imam al-Hasan (a.s): “What are these cries (sounds)?” Imam al-Hasan (a.s) replied: “O Commander of the Faithful, the people are crying out, ‘O Umar! O’ Umar!’” So the Commander of the Faithful (a.s), peace be upon him, said: “Say to them; ‘Pray.’”
arabicText: عَلِيُّ بْنُ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ اَلْحَسَنِ عَنْ عَمْرِ و بْنِ سَعِيدٍ اَلْمَدَائِنِيِّ عَنْ مُصَدِّقِ بْنِ صَدَقَةَ عَنْ عَمَّارٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلصَّلاَةِ فِي رَمَضَانَ فِي اَلْمَسَاجِدِ قَالَ« لَمَّا قَدِمَ أَمِيرُ اَلْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ اَلْكُوفَةَ أَمَرَ اَلْحَسَنَ بْنَ عَلِيٍّ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ أَنْ يُنَادِيَ فِي اَلنَّاسِ« لاَ صَلاَةَ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ فِي اَلْمَسَاجِدِ جَمَاعَةً» فَنَادَى فِي اَلنَّاسِ اَلْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ بِمَا أَمَرَهُ بِهِ أَمِيرُ اَلْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ فَلَمَّا سَمِعَ اَلنَّاسُ مَقَالَةَ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ صَاحُوا وَاعُمَرَاهْ وَاعُمَرَاهْ فَلَمَّا رَجَعَ اَلْحَسَنُ إِلَى أَمِيرِ اَلْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ لَهُ« مَا هَذَا اَلصَّوْتُ» فَقَالَ« يَا أَمِيرَ اَلْمُؤْمِنِينَ اَلنَّاسُ يَصِيحُونَ وَاعُمَرَاهْ وَاعُمَرَاهْ» فَقَالَ أَمِيرُ اَلْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ «قُلْ لَهُمْ صَلُّوا»»
thaqalaynSanad: Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Faddal, from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan, from Amr ibn Said al-Mada'ini, from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah, from Ammar, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) about prayer in the Month of Ramadan in the mosques. Imam (a.s) said: “When the Commander of the Faithful (a.s), peace be upon him, arrived in Kufa, He (a.s) ordered al-Hasan ibn Ali (a.s), peace be upon him, to announce to the people: ‘There is no congregational prayer in the Month of Ramadan in the mosques.’” So Imam al-Hasan ibn Ali (a.s), peace be upon him, announced to the people what the Commander of the Faithful had ordered him. So when the people heard the statement of Imam al-Hasan ibn Ali (a.s), they cried out: “O Umar! O’ Umar!” And when Imam al-Hasan (a.s) returned to the Commander of the Faithful (a.s), peace be upon him, He (a.s) asked Imam al-Hasan (a.s): “What are these cries (sounds)?” Imam al-Hasan (a.s) replied: “O Commander of the Faithful, the people are crying out, ‘O Umar! O’ Umar!’” So the Commander of the Faithful (a.s), peace be upon him, said: “Say to them; ‘Pray.’”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 77

chapter: Chapter on the Virtue of the Month of Ramadan and the Prayers Within It in Addition to the Recommended Prayers Mentioned in the Other Months
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ali ibn Hatim, from Muhammad ibn Ja’far, who said: Muhammad ibn Ahmad narrated to us from Ahmad ibn Muhammad al-Sayyari, who raised it (in isnad) to the Commander of the Faithful (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam Ali (a.s) said: “The Messenger of Allah (swt), blessings on him and his family, said: ‘Whoever performs two units of prayer on the night of Eid al-Fitr; reciting in the first unit ‘al-Hamd’ (Surah al-Fatihah) and ‘Qul huwa Allahu Ahad’ (Surah Ikhlas) one thousand times, And reciting in the second unit ‘al-Hamd’ (Surah al-Fatihah) and ‘Qul huwa Allahu Ahad’ (Surah Ikhlas) once, Then there is nothing he asks Allah (swt) the Exalted for, except that Allah (swt) grants it to him.”
arabicText: عَلِيُّ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ اَلسَّيَّارِيِّ رَفَعَهُ إِلَى أَمِيرِ اَلْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ:« مَنْ صَلَّى لَيْلَةَ اَلْفِطْرِ رَكْعَتَيْنِ يَقْرَأُ فِي أَوَّلِ رَكْعَةٍ مِنْهُمَا اَلْحَمْدَ وَ« قُلْ هُوَ اَللّٰهُ أَحَدٌ» أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ وَ فِي اَلرَّكْعَةِ اَلثَّانِيَةِ اَلْحَمْدَ وَ« قُلْ هُوَ اَللّٰهُ أَحَدٌ» مَرَّةً وَاحِدَةً لَمْ يَسْأَلِ اَللَّهَ تَعَالَى شَيْئاً إِلاَّ أَعْطَاهُ اَللَّهُ إِيَّاهُ»
thaqalaynSanad: Ali ibn Hatim, from Muhammad ibn Ja’far, who said: Muhammad ibn Ahmad narrated to us from Ahmad ibn Muhammad al-Sayyari, who raised it (in isnad) to the Commander of the Faithful (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam Ali (a.s) said: “The Messenger of Allah (swt), blessings on him and his family, said: ‘Whoever performs two units of prayer on the night of Eid al-Fitr; reciting in the first unit ‘al-Hamd’ (Surah al-Fatihah) and ‘Qul huwa Allahu Ahad’ (Surah Ikhlas) one thousand times, And reciting in the second unit ‘al-Hamd’ (Surah al-Fatihah) and ‘Qul huwa Allahu Ahad’ (Surah Ikhlas) once, Then there is nothing he asks Allah (swt) the Exalted for, except that Allah (swt) grants it to him.”

chapter: Chapter on Supplication Between the Units of Prayer (Rak‘at)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ali ibn Hatim, from Muhammad ibn Ja’far, from Abdullah ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn Hassan, from some of his companions, from a man, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “O’ Allah (swt), You (azj) are the First there is nothing before You (azj). And You (azj) are the Last there is nothing after You (azj). And You (azj) are the Manifest there is nothing above You (azj). And You (azj) are the Hidden there is nothing beyond You (azj). And You (azj) are the Mighty, the Wise. O’ Allah (swt), send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), and include me in every good into which You (azj) included Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), and remove me from every evil from which You (azj) removed Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws). And peace be upon them, and the mercy of Allah (swt) and His (azj) blessings.’ Then you perform two rak‘ahs.”
arabicText: عَلِيُّ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ حَسَّانَ عَنْ بَعْضِ أَصْحَابِهِ عَنْ رَجُلٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ:« اَللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ اَلْأَوَّلُ فَلَيْسَ قَبْلَكَ شَيْءٌ وَ أَنْتَ اَلْآخِرُ فَلَيْسَ بَعْدَكَ شَيْءٌ وَ أَنْتَ اَلظَّاهِرُ فَلَيْسَ فَوْقَكَ شَيْءٌ وَ أَنْتَ اَلْبَاطِنُ فَلَيْسَ دُونَكَ شَيْءٌ وَ أَنْتَ اَلْعَزِيزُ اَلْحَكِيمُ اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ أَدْخِلْنِي فِي كُلِّ خَيْرٍ أَدْخَلْتَ فِيهِ مُحَمَّداً وَ آلَ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ أَخْرِجْنِي مِنْ كُلِّ سُوءٍ أَخْرَجْتَ مِنْهُ مُحَمَّداً وَ آلَ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْهِمْ وَ رَحْمَةُ اَللَّهِ وَ بَرَكَاتُهُ ثُمَّ تُصَلِّي رَكْعَتَيْنِ»
thaqalaynSanad: Ali ibn Hatim, from Muhammad ibn Ja’far, from Abdullah ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn Hassan, from some of his companions, from a man, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “O’ Allah (swt), You (azj) are the First there is nothing before You (azj). And You (azj) are the Last there is nothing after You (azj). And You (azj) are the Manifest there is nothing above You (azj). And You (azj) are the Hidden there is nothing beyond You (azj). And You (azj) are the Mighty, the Wise. O’ Allah (swt), send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), and include me in every good into which You (azj) included Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), and remove me from every evil from which You (azj) removed Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws). And peace be upon them, and the mercy of Allah (swt) and His (azj) blessings.’ Then you perform two rak‘ahs.”

chapter: Chapter on Supplication Between the Units of Prayer (Rak‘at)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ali ibn Hatim, from Muhammad ibn Ja’far, from Abdullah ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid, from Ali ibn Hassan, from some of his companions, from a man, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “All praise is due to Allah (swt), the One who is exalted and thus subdued (everything), and all praise is due to Allah (swt), the One who possesses dominion and thus measured (everything), and all praise is due to Allah (swt), the One who is hidden and thus knows (all things), and all praise is due to Allah (swt), the One who ‘gives life to the dead’ and causes the living to die, and ‘He (azj) is over all things Powerful’. And all praise is due to Allah (swt), before whose greatness everything has humbled, and all praise is due to Allah (swt), before whose might everything has been humbled, and all praise is due to Allah (swt), to whose power everything has submitted. All praise is due to Allah (swt), the One before whose dominion everything has submitted. And all praise is due to Allah (swt), the One who does whatever He (azj) wills, and no one else does what He (azj) wills. O’ Allah (swt), send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), and include me in every good into which You (azj) included Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), and remove me from every evil from which You (azj) removed Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), may Allah’s blessings be upon him and upon them, and peace be upon him and upon them, and the mercy of Allah (swt) and His (azj) blessings.’ And send abundant salutations. Then you perform two rak‘ahs.”
arabicText: عَلِيُّ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ حَسَّانَ عَنْ بَعْضِ أَصْحَابِهِ عَنْ رَجُلٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ:« اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ اَلَّذِي عَلاَ فَقَهَرَ وَ اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ اَلَّذِي مَلَكَ فَقَدَرَ وَ اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ اَلَّذِي بَطَنَ فَخَبَرَ وَ اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ اَلَّذِي« يُحْيِ اَلْمَوْتىٰ» وَ يُمِيتُ اَلْأَحْيَاءَ« وَ هُوَ عَلىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ» وَ اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ اَلَّذِي تَوَاضَعَ كُلُّ شَيْءٍ لِعَظَمَتِهِ وَ اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ اَلَّذِي ذَلَّ كُلُّ شَيْءٍ لِعِزَّتِهِ وَ اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ اَلَّذِي اِسْتَسْلَمَ كُلُّ شَيْءٍ لِقُدْرَتِهِ وَ اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ اَلَّذِي خَضَعَ كُلُّ شَيْءٍ لِمَلَكَتِهِ وَ اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ اَلَّذِي يَفْعَلُ مَا يَشَاءُ وَ لاَ يَفْعَلُ مَا يَشَاءُ غَيْرُهُ اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَأَدْخِلْنِي فِي كُلِّ خَيْرٍ أَدْخَلْتَ فِيهِ' مُحَمَّداً وَآلَ مُحَمَّدٍ وَأَخْرِجْنِي مِنْ كُلِّ سُوءٍ أَخْرَجْتَ مِنْهُ مُحَمَّداً وَآلَ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ عَلَيْهِمْ وَاَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَيْهِمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اَللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ وَ سَلَّمَ كَثِيراً ثُمَّ تُصَلِّي رَكْعَتَيْنِ»

And all praise is due to Allah (swt), before whose greatness everything has humbled, and all praise is due to Allah (swt), before whose might everything has been humbled, and all praise is due to Allah (swt), to whose power everything has submitted. All praise is due to Allah (swt), the One before whose dominion everything has submitted. And all praise is due to Allah (swt), the One who does whatever He (azj) wills, and no one else does what He (azj) wills. O’ Allah (swt), send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), and include me in every good into which You (azj) included Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), and remove me from every evil from which You (azj) removed Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), may Allah’s blessings be upon him and upon them, and peace be upon him and upon them, and the mercy of Allah (swt) and His (azj) blessings.’ And send abundant salutations. Then you perform two rak‘ahs.”

chapter: Chapter on Supplication Between the Units of Prayer (Rak‘at)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ali ibn Hatim, from Muhammad ibn Ja’far, from Abdullah ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn Hassan, from Isa ibn Bashir, from a man, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “O’ Allah (swt), I ask You (azj) by the meanings of all that Your servants, whom You (azj) have chosen for Yourself, have called upon You (azj) with; those entrusted with Your secret, those protected under Your Eye, those who conceal themselves with Your religion, those who proclaim it, those who describe Your greatness, those who keep away from disobeying You (azj), those who call toward Your path, those who are foremost in Your knowledge, And those who have attained Your honor. I call upon You (azj), at the places of Your boundaries and the perfection of Your obedience, and by that with which the guardians of Your command call upon You (azj), that You (azj) send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), And that You (azj) deal with me in accordance with what You (azj) are worthy of, and not in accordance with what I am worthy of.’ Then you perform two rak‘ahs.”
arabicText: عَلِيُّ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ حَسَّانَ عَنْ عِيسَى بْنِ بَشِيرٍ عَنْ رَجُلٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ:« اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِمَعَانِي جَمِيعِ مَا دَعَاكَ بِهِ عِبَادُكَ اَلَّذِينَ اِصْطَفَيْتَهُمْ لِنَفْسِكَ اَلْمَأْمُونُونَ عَلَى سِرِّكَ اَلْمُحْتَجِبُونَ بِعَيْنِكَ اَلْمُسْتَسِرُّونَ بِدِينِكَ اَلْمُعْلِنُونَ بِهِ اَلْوَاصِفُونَ لِعَظَمَتِكَ اَلْمُتَنَزِّهُونَ عَنْ مَعَاصِيكَ اَلدَّاعُونَ إِلَى سَبِيلِكَ اَلسَّابِقُونَ فِي عِلْمِكَ اَلْفَائِزُونَ بِكَرَامَتِكَ أَدْعُوكَ عَلَى مَوَاضِعِ حُدُودِكَ وَ كَمَالِ طَاعَتِكَ وَ بِمَا يَدْعُوكَ بِهِ وُلاَةُ أَمْرِكَ أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ أَنْ تَفْعَلَ بِي مَا أَنْتَ أَهْلُهُ وَ لاَ تَفْعَلَ بِي مَا أَنَا أَهْلُهُ ثُمَّ تُصَلِّي رَكْعَتَيْنِ»
thaqalaynSanad: Ali ibn Hatim, from Muhammad ibn Ja’far, from Abdullah ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn Hassan, from Isa ibn Bashir, from a man, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “O’ Allah (swt), I ask You (azj) by the meanings of all that Your servants, whom You (azj) have chosen for Yourself, have called upon You (azj) with; those entrusted with Your secret, those protected under Your Eye, those who conceal themselves with Your religion, those who proclaim it, those who describe Your greatness, those who keep away from disobeying You (azj), those who call toward Your path, those who are foremost in Your knowledge, And those who have attained Your honor. I call upon You (azj), at the places of Your boundaries and the perfection of Your obedience, and by that with which the guardians of Your command call upon You (azj), that You (azj) send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), And that You (azj) deal with me in accordance with what You (azj) are worthy of, and not in accordance with what I am worthy of.’ Then you perform two rak‘ahs.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 79

chapter: Chapter on Supplication Between the Units of Prayer (Rak‘at)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ali ibn Hatim from Ali ibn al-Husayn from Ahmad ibn Abi Abdillah from al-Hasan ibn Mahbub from Jamil ibn Salih from Dhurayh ibn Muhammad ibn Yazid al-Muharibi from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “O Possessor of grace, upon whom none has any grace; O’ Possessor of bounty, there is no God but You (azj), the support of those who seek refuge, the security of those who are afraid, the protector of those who seek protection. If, in the Mother of the ‘Book’ (Surah Al-Fatiha) with You (azj), I am recorded as wretched or deprived or constrained in my sustenance, then erase from the Mother of the ‘Book’ (Surah Al-Fatiha) my wretchedness, my deprivation, and the constraint of my sustenance, and write me with You (azj) as happy, successful in goodness, and granted abundance in sustenance from You (azj). For surely, You (azj) have said in Your Book that You (azj) revealed upon Your sent Prophet (saws), may Your blessings be upon him and his family, ‘Allah (swt) erases what He (azj) wills and confirms, and with Him (azj) is the Mother of the Book,” (Surah Ar-Raʿd 13:39). And You (azj) have said, ‘My mercy encompasses all things,’ (Surah Al-Aʿraf 7:156) and I am a ‘thing’, so let Your mercy encompass me, O’ Most Merciful of the merciful. And may Allah (swt) send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws).’” (Imam (a.s) then continued) “And supplicate with whatever appears to you, and when you finish the supplication, then prostrate and say in your prostration: ‘O’ Allah (swt), enrich me with knowledge, adorn me with forbearance, honor me with piety, and beautify me with well-being. O’ Guardian of well-being, Your pardon, Your pardon from the Fire.’ Then, when you raise your head, say: ‘O’ Allah (swt), O’ Allah (swt), O’ Allah (swt), I ask You (azj); There is no God but You (azj) by Your name, In the name of Allah (swt), the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. O’ All-Merciful, O’ Allah (swt), O’ Lord, O’ Near One, O’ Responsive One, O’ Originator of the heavens and the earth, O’ Possessor of Majesty and Honor, O’ Most Compassionate, O’ Most Generous Bestower, O’ Ever-Living, O’ Self-Subsisting. I ask You (azj) by every name that is Yours, which You (azj) love to be called by, and by every supplication with which anyone among the first and the last has called upon You (azj) and You (azj) answered him; O’Allah (swt), send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), and to turn my heart towards fear of You (azj) and awe of You (azj), and to make me among the sincere ones, and to strengthen all of my limbs for Your worship, and to open my breast to goodness and piety, and to loosen my tongue for the recitation of Your Book. O’ Guardian of the believers, send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws).” (Imam (a.s) then continued) “And supplicate with whatever you desire. Then perform the final Isha prayer. When you have completed Isha prayer, stand and pray two rak’ahs. When you have completed them, say: ‘O’ Allah (swt), I ask You (azj) by Your splendor, and Your majesty, and Your beauty, and Your greatness, and Your light, and the vastness of Your mercy, and Your names, and Your might, and Your power, and Your will, and the execution of Your command, and the utmost of Your pleasure, and Your nobility, and Your generosity, and the permanence of Your glory and sovereignty, and Your pride, and the elevation of Your station, and the ancientness of Your bounty, and the wonder of Your signs, and Your grace, and Your generosity, and the universality of Your provision, and Your gifts, and Your goodness, and Your benevolence, and Your bestowal, and Your favour, and Your status, and Your omnipotence. And I ask You (azj) by all of Your entitlements, that You (azj) send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), and that You (azj) save me from the Fire. And that You (azj) bestow upon me Paradise, and that You (azj) expand for me the provision of lawful and pure sustenance, And that You (azj) repel from me the evil of the wicked among the Arabs and the non-Arabs, And that You (azj) restrain my tongue from lying, and my heart from envy, and my eye from betrayal for indeed You (azj) know ‘the treachery of the eyes and what the hearts conceal’ (Surah Ghafir 40:19). And that You (azj) grant me, in this year and every year, the ability to perform Hajj and Umrah, And that You (azj) lower my gaze, protect my private parts, expand my sustenance, And protect me from every evil, O’ Most Merciful of the merciful.’ Then you are to pray two rak’ahs.”
arabicText: عَلِيُّ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ جَمِيلِ بْنِ صَالِحٍ عَنْ ذَرِيحِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ اَلْمُحَارِبِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ:« يَا ذَا اَلْمَنِّ لاَ مَنَّ عَلَيْكَ يَا ذَا اَلطَّوْلِ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ ظَهْرَ اَللاَّجِينَ وَ مَأْمَنَ اَلْخَائِفِينَ وَ جَارَ اَلْمُسْتَجِيرِينَ إِنْ كَانَ عِنْدَكَ فِي أُمِّ اَلْكِتَابِ أَنِّي شَقِيٌّ أَوْ مَحْرُومٌ أَوْ مُقْتَرٌ عَلَيَّ رِزْقِي فَامْحُ مِنْ أُمِّ اَلْكِتَابِ شَقَائِي وَحِرْمَانِي وَإِقْتَارَ رِزْقِي وَاُكْتُبْنِي عِنْدَكَ سَعِيداً مُوَفَّقاً لِلْخَيْرِ مُوَسَّعاً عَلَيَّ رِزْقُكَ فَإِنَّكَ قُلْتَ فِي كِتَابِكَ اَلْمُنْزَلِ عَلَى نَبِيِّكَ اَلْمُرْسَلِ صَلَوَاتُكَ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ« يَمْحُو ااَللّٰهُ مٰا يَشٰاءُ وَ يُثْبِتُ وَ عِنْدَهُ أُمُّ اَلْكِتٰابِ» وَ قُلْتَ« وَ رَحْمَتِي وَسِعَتْ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ» وَ أَنَا شَيْءٌ فَلْتَسَعْنِي رَحْمَتُكَ يَا أَرْحَمَ اَلرَّاحِمِينَ وَ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اُدْعُ بِمَا بَدَا لَكَ فَإِذَا فَرَغْتَ مِنَ اَلدُّعَاءِ فَاسْجُدْ وَ قُلْ فِي سُجُودِكَ اَللَّهُمَّ أَغْنِنِي بِالْعِلْمِ وَزَيِّنِّي بِالْحِلْمِ وَكَرِّمْنِي بِالتَّقْوَى وَجَمِّلْنِي بِالْعَافِيَةِ يَا وَلِيَّ اَلْعَافِيَةِ عَفْوَكَ عَفْوَكَ مِنَ اَلنَّارِ فَإِذَا رَفَعْتَ رَأْسَكَ فَقُلْ يَا اَللَّهُ يَا اَللَّهُ يَا اَللَّهُ أَسْأَلُكَ يَالاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ بِاسْمِكَ« بِسْمِ اَللّٰهِ اَلرَّحْمٰنِ اَلرَّحِيمِ» يَا رَحْمَانُ يَا اَللَّهُ يَا رَبُّ يَا قَرِيبُ يَا مُجِيبُ يَا بَدِيعَ اَلسَّمَاوَاتِ وَ اَلْأَرْضِ يَا ذَا اَلْجَلاَلِ وَ اَلْإِكْرَامِ يَا حَنَّانُ يَا مَنَّانُ يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ أَسْأَلُكَ بِكُلِّ اِسْمٍ هُوَ لَكَ تُحِبُّ أَنْ تُدْعَى بِهِ وَ بِكُلِّ دَعْوَةٍ دَعَاكَ بِهَا أَحَدٌ مِنَ اَلْأَوَّلِينَ وَ اَلْآخِرِينَ فَاسْتَجَبْتَ لَهُ أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ أَنْ تَصْرِفَ قَلْبِي إِلَى خَشْيَتِكَ وَ رَهْبَتِكَ وَ أَنْ تَجْعَلَنِي مِنَ اَلْمُخْلَصِينَ وَ تُقَوِّيَ أَرْكَانِي كُلَّهَا لِعِبَادَتِكَ وَ تَشْرَحَ صَدْرِي لِلْخَيْرِ وَ اَلتُّقَى وَ تُطْلِقَ لِسَانِي لِتِلاَوَةِ كِتَابِكَ يَا وَلِيَّ اَلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اُدْعُ بِمَا أَحْبَبْتَ ثُمَّ تُصَلِّي اَلْعِشَاءَ اَلْآخِرَةَ فَإِذَا فَرَغْتَ مِنْهَا قُمْتَ فَصَلَّيْتَ رَكْعَتَيْنِ فَإِذَا فَرَغْتَ مِنْهَا فَقُلِ اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِبَهَائِكَ وَ جَلاَلِكَ وَ جَمَالِكَ وَ عَظَمَتِكَ وَ نُورِكَ وَ سَعَةِ رَحْمَتِكَ وَ أَسْمَائِكَ وَ عِزَّتِكَ وَ قُدْرَتِكَ وَ مَشِيَّتِكَ وَ نَفَاذِ أَمْرِكَ وَ مُنْتَهَى رِضَاكَ وَ شَرَفِكَ وَ كَرَمِكَ وَ دَوَامِ عِزِّكَ وَ سُلْطَانِكَ وَ فَخْرِكَ وَ عُلُوِّ شَأْنِكَ وَ قَدِيمِ مَنِّكَ وَ عَجِيبِ آيَاتِكَ وَ فَضْلِكَ وَ جُودِكَ وَ عُمُومِ رِزْقِكَ وَ عَطَائِكَ وَ خَيْرِكَ وَ إِحْسَانِكَ وَ تَفَضُّلِكَ وَ اِمْتِنَانِكَ وَ شَأْنِكَ وَ جَبَرُوتِكَ وَ أَسْأَلُكَ بِجَمِيعِ مَسَائِلِكَ أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ أَنْ تُنْجِيَنِي مِنَ اَلنَّارِ وَ تَمُنَّ عَلَيَّ بِالْجَنَّةِ وَ تُوَسِّعَ عَلَيَّ مِنَ اَلرِّزْقِ اَلْحَلاَلِ اَلطَّيِّبِ وَ تَدْرَأَ عَنِّي شَرَّ فَسَقَةِ اَلْعَرَبِ وَ اَلْعَجَمِ وَ تَمْنَعَ لِسَانِي مِنَ اَلْكَذِبِ وَ قَلْبِي مِنَ اَلْحَسَدِ وَ عَيْنِي مِنَ اَلْخِيَانَةِ فَإِنَّكَ تَعْلَمُ« خٰائِنَةَ اَلْأَعْيُنِ وَ مٰا تُخْفِي اَلصُّدُورُ وَ تَرْزُقَنِي فِي عَامِي هَذَا وَ فِي كُلِّ عَامٍ اَلْحَجَّ وَ اَلْعُمْرَةَ وَ تَغُضَّ بَصَرِي وَ تُحْصِنَ فَرْجِي وَ تُوَسِّعَ رِزْقِي وَ تَعْصِمَنِي مِنْ كُلِّ سُوءٍ يَا أَرْحَمَ اَلرَّاحِمِينَ ثُمَّ تُصَلِّي رَكْعَتَيْنِ»

chapter: Chapter on Supplication Between the Units of Prayer (Rak‘at)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ali ibn Hatim from Ali ibn Sulayman from Ahmad ibn Ishaq from Sadan ibn Muslim from Abdullah ibn al-Sarraj from a man from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “O’ Allah (swt), I ask You (azj) for good opinion of You (azj), and for sincerity in reliance upon You (azj). And I seek refuge in You (azj) from being tested with a trial whose pressure compels me to become accustomed to something from among Your disobedience. And I seek refuge in You (azj) from being placed in a condition in hardship or ease wherein I imagine that disobeying You (azj) would be more beneficial to me than obeying You (azj). And I seek refuge in You (azj) from uttering a true statement, from among the acts of obedience to You (azj), by which I intend other than You (azj). arabicText: عَلِيُّ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ سُلَيْمَانَ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ سَعْدَانَ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ اَلسَّرَّاجِ عَنْ رَجُلٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ:« اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ حُسْنَ اَلظَّنِّ بِكَ وَ اَلصِّدْقَ فِي اَلتَّوَكُّلِ عَلَيْكَ وَ أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ تَبْتَلِيَنِي بِبَلِيَّةٍ تَحْمِلُنِي ضَرُورَتُهَا عَلَى اَلتَّعَوُّدِ بِشَيْءٍ مِنْ مَعَاصِيكَ وَ أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ تُدْخِلَنِي فِي حَالٍ كُنْتُ أَوْ أَكُونُ فِيهَا فِي عُسْرٍ أَوْ يُسْرٍ أَظُنُّ أَنَّ مَعَاصِيَكَ أَنْجَحُ لِي مِنْ طَاعَتِكَ وَ أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أَقُولَ قَوْلاً حَقّاً مِنْ طَاعَتِكَ أَلْتَمِسُ بِهِ سِوَاكَ وَ أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ تَجْعَلَنِي عِظَةً لِغَيْرِي وَ أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ يَكُونَ أَحَدٌ أَسْعَدَ بِمَا آتَيْتَنِي بِهِ مِنِّي وَ أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أَتَكَلَّفَ طَلَبَ مَا لَمْ تَقْسِمْ لِي وَ مَا قَسَمْتَ لِي مِنْ قِسْمٍ أَوْ رَزَقْتَنِي مِنْ رِزْقٍ فَأْتِنِي بِهِ فِي يُسْرٍ مِنْكَ وَ عَافِيَةٍ حَلاَلاً طَيِّباً وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ زَحْزَحَ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَكَ وَبَاعَدَ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَكَ أَوْ نَقَصَ بِهِ حَظِّي عِنْدَكَ أَوْ صَرَفَ بِوَجْهِكَ اَلْكَرِيمِ عَنِّي وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ تَحُولَ خَطِيئَتِي أَوْ ظُلْمِي أَوْ جُرْمِي وَإِسْرَافِي عَلَى نَفْسِي وَاِتِّبَاعُ هَوَايَ وَاِسْتِعْجَالُ شَهْوَتِي دُونَ مَغْفِرَتِكَ وَ رِضْوَانِكَ وَ ثَوَابِكَ وَ نَائِلِكَ وَ بَرَكَاتِكَ وَ مَوْعُودِكَ اَلْحَسَنِ اَلْجَمِيلِ عَلَى نَفْسِكَ ثُمَّ تُصَلِّي رَكْعَتَيْنِ فَإِذَا فَرَغْتَ فَقُلِ اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِعَزَائِمِ مَغْفِرَتِكَ وَ بِوَاجِبِ رَحْمَتِكَ اَلسَّلاَمَةَ مِنْ كُلِّ إِثْمٍ وَ اَلْغَنِيمَةَ مِنْ كُلِّ بِرٍّ وَ اَلْفَوْزَ بِالْجَنَّةِ وَ اَلنَّجَاةَ مِنَ اَلنَّارِ اَللَّهُمَّ دَعَاكَ اَلدَّاعُونَ وَ دَعَوْتُكَ وَ سَأَلَكَ اَلسَّائِلُونَ وَ سَأَلْتُكَ وَ طَلَبَكَ اَلطَّالِبُونَ وَ طَلَبْتُ إِلَيْكَ وَ رَغِبَ اَلرَّاغِبُونَ وَ رَغِبْتُ إِلَيْكَ اَللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ اَلثِّقَةُ وَ اَلرَّجَاءُ وَ إِلَيْكَ مُنْتَهَى اَلرَّغْبَةِ وَ اَلدُّعَاءِ فِي اَلشِّدَّةِ وَ اَلرَّخَاءِ اَللَّهُمَّ فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اِجْعَلِ اَلْيَقِينَ فِي قَلْبِي وَ اَلنُّورَ فِي بَصَرِي وَ اَلنَّصِيحَةَ فِي صَدْرِي وَ ذِكْرَكَ بِاللَّيْلِ وَ اَلنَّهَارِ عَلَى لِسَانِي وَ رِزْقاً وَاسِعاً غَيْرَ مَمْنُونٍ وَ لاَ مَحْظُورٍ فَارْزُقْنِي وَ بَارِكْ لِي فِيمَا رَزَقْتَنِي وَاِجْعَلْ غِنَايَ فِي نَفْسِي وَرَغْبَتِي فِيمَا عِنْدَكَ بِرَحْمَتِكَ يَا أَرْحَمَ اَلرَّاحِمِينَ ثُمَّ تُصَلِّي رَكْعَتَيْنِ فَإِذَا فَرَغْتَ فَقُلِ اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ فَرِّغْنِي لِمَا خَلَقْتَنِي لَهُ وَ لاَ تَشْغَلْنِي بِمَا قَدْ تَكَفَّلْتَ لِي بِهِ اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ إِيمَاناً لاَ يَرْتَدُّ وَ نَعِيماً لاَ يَنْفَدُ وَ مُرَافَقَةَ نَبِيِّكَ صَلَوَاتُكَ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ فِي أَعْلَى جَنَّةِ اَلْخُلْدِ اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ رِزْقَ يَوْمٍ بِيَوْمٍ لاَ قَلِيلاً فَأَشْقَى وَ لاَ كَثِيراً فَأَطْغَى اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اُرْزُقْنِي مِنْ فَضْلِكَ مَا تَرْزُقُنِي بِهِ اَلْحَجَّ وَ اَلْعُمْرَةَ فِي عَامِي هَذَا وَ تُقَوِّينِي بِهِ عَلَى اَلصَّوْمِ وَ اَلصَّلاَةِ فَإِنَّكَ أَنْتَ رَبِّي وَ رَجَائِي وَ عِصْمَتِي لَيْسَ لِي مُعْتَصَمٌ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ وَ لاَ رَجَاءٌ غَيْرَكَ وَ لاَ مَنْجَى مِنْكَ إِلاَّ إِلَيْكَ فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آتِنِي« فِي اَلدُّنْيٰا حَسَنَةً وَ فِي اَلْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً» وَ قِنِي بِرَحْمَتِكَ« عَذٰابَ اَلنّٰارِ» ثُمَّ تُصَلِّي رَكْعَتَيْنِ فَإِذَا فَرَغْتَ فَقُلِ اَللَّهُمَّ لَكَ اَلْحَمْدُ كُلُّهُ وَ لَكَ اَلْمُلْكُ كُلُّهُ وَ بِيَدِكَ اَلْخَيْرُ كُلُّهُ وَ إِلَيْكَ يَرْجِعُ اَلْأَمْرُ كُلُّهُ عَلاَنِيَتُهُ وَ سِرُّهُ وَ أَنْتَ مُنْتَهَى اَلشَّأْنِ كُلِّهِ اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنَ اَلْخَيْرِ كُلِّهِ وَ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ اَلشَّرِّ كُلِّهِ اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ رَضِّنِي بِقَضَائِكَ وَ بَارِكْ لِي فِي قَدَرِكَ حَتَّى لاَ أُحِبَّ تَعْجِيلَ مَا أَخَّرْتَ وَ لاَ تَأْخِيرَ مَا عَجَّلْتَ اَللَّهُمَّ وَ أَوْسِعْ عَلَيَّ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ وَ اُرْزُقْنِي مِنْ بَرَكَاتِكَ وَ اِسْتَعْمِلْنِي فِي طَاعَتِكَ وَ تَوَفَّنِي عِنْدَ اِنْقِضَاءِ أَجَلِي عَلَى سَبِيلِكَ وَ لاَ تُوَلِّ أَمْرِي غَيْرَكَ وَ لاَ تُزِغْ قَلْبِي بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنِي وَ هَبْ لِي« مِنْ لَدُنْكَ رَحْمَةً إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ اَلْوَهّٰابُ» ثُمَّ تُصَلِّي رَكْعَتَيْنِ»

thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “O’ Allah (swt), I ask You (azj) for good opinion of You (azj), and for sincerity in reliance upon You (azj). And I seek refuge in You (azj) from being tested with a trial whose pressure compels me to become accustomed to something from among Your disobedience. And I seek refuge in You (azj) from being placed in a condition in hardship or ease wherein I imagine that disobeying You (azj) would be more beneficial to me than obeying You (azj). And I seek refuge in You (azj) from uttering a true statement, from among the acts of obedience to You (azj), by which I intend other than You (azj). And I seek refuge in You (azj) from being made a lesson for others. And I seek refuge in You (azj) that anyone should be more fortunate than I am with what You (azj) have given me. And I seek refuge in You (azj) from striving after that which You (azj) have not allotted to me. And that which You (azj) have allotted for me as my portion, or provided me as sustenance, then bring it to me with ease from You (azj), and well-being, and in a lawful and pure form. And I seek refuge in You (azj) from anything that would separate me from You (azj), or distance me from You (azj), or diminish my share with You (azj), or turn away Your noble face from me. And I seek refuge in You (azj) lest my sin, or my wrongdoing, or my offense, or my excess against myself, or my following of my desires, or the hastening of my lust should come between me and Your forgiveness. And (I seek refuge in You (azj)) from being deprived of Your pleasure, and Your reward, and Your giving, and Your blessings, and Your beautiful and excellent promise which You (azj) have pledged upon Yourself.” (Imam (a.s) then continued) “Then pray two rak’ahs. When you complete them, say: ‘O’ Allah (swt), I ask You (azj) by the determinations of Your forgiveness, and by the obligation of Your mercy, for safety from every sin, and gain from every righteousness, and triumph with Paradise, and salvation from the Fire. O’ Allah (swt), the callers have called upon You (azj) and I have called upon You (azj), And the supplicants have asked You (azj) and I have asked You (azj), And the seekers have sought You (azj) and I have sought You (azj), And those who yearn have yearned toward You (azj) and I have yearned toward You (azj). O’ Allah (swt), You (azj) are the trust, and the hope, and to You (azj) is the utmost of longing and supplication in hardship and ease. O’ Allah (swt), so send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and upon the family of Muhammad (saws). And place certainty in my heart, and light in my vision, and sincerity in my chest, and Your remembrance on my tongue by night and day. And provide for me an abundant sustenance, not withheld and not forbidden. So grant me sustenance and bless me in what You (azj) provide for me. And make my contentment within myself, and my longing for that which is with You (azj), by Your mercy, O’ Most Merciful of the merciful.” (Imam (a.s) then continued) “Then pray two rak’ahs. When you complete them, say: ‘O’ Allah (swt), send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), And devote me fully to that for which You (azj) created me, and do not preoccupy me with what You (azj) have already guaranteed for me. O’ Allah (swt), I ask You (azj) for faith that never reverts, and bliss that never ends, and the companionship of Your Prophet (saws), Your blessings be upon him and his family, in the highest eternal Garden of Paradise. O’ Allah (swt), I ask You (azj) for daily sustenance day by day neither so little that I become miserable, nor so much that I become arrogant. O’ Allah (swt), send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), And grant me from Your bounty that by which You (azj) enable me to perform Hajj and Umrah in this year of mine, and strengthen me through it for fasting and prayer for indeed You (azj) are my Lord (azj), my hope, and my protection. I have no refuge but You (azj), no hope besides You (azj), and there is no escape from You (azj) except to You (azj). So send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), and grant me ‘goodness in this world and goodness in the Hereafter’, and by Your mercy, ‘protect me from the punishment of the Fire’.” (Imam (a.s) then continued) “Then pray two rak’ahs. When you complete them, say: “O’ Allah (swt), to You (azj) belongs all praise, all sovereignty belongs to You (azj), all good is in Your hand, A nd to You (azj) returns all affairs both its public and its hidden aspects. And You (azj) are the ultimate end of all matters. O’ Allah (swt), I ask You (azj) for all good, and I seek refuge in You (azj) from all evil. O’ Allah (swt), send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), and make me content with Your decree, and bless for me what You (azj) have destined, such that I do not wish for the hastening of what You (azj) have delayed, nor the delaying of what You (azj) have hastened. O’ Allah (swt), expand upon me from Your bounty, and provide for me from Your blessings, and employ me in Your obedience, and take me at the end of my term upon Your path. And do not assign authority over my affairs to anyone other than You (azj), and do not cause my heart to deviate after You (azj) have guided me, and grant me ‘from Yourself mercy; indeed, You (azj) are the Bestower’. chapter: Chapter on Supplication Between the Units of Prayer (Rak‘at)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ali ibn Hatim from Ali ibn Sulayman from Ahmad ibn Ishaq from Sadan ibn Muslim from Abdullah ibn al-Sarraj from a man from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “O’ Allah (swt), I ask You (azj) by Your Might, Your Honor, Your Beauty, Your Power, Your Greatness, Your Light, and by every name that is Yours that You (azj) place love for Yourself in my heart, and fear of You (azj) in my soul, and belief in You (azj) in my mind, and remembrance of You (azj) on my tongue, and conviction in You (azj) in my inner self. O’ Allah (swt), make my acts purely for Your face, sincere to You (azj), not seeking with them the praise of others, nor aiming by them for anything other than Your pleasure. O’ Allah (swt), make me among those who humble themselves before You (azj), hope from You (azj), are intimate with Your remembrance, and rely upon You (azj). O’ Allah (swt), cause me to die on the path of Your Prophet (saws), and raise me in His (saws) company, and make me enter His (saws) pool (hawdh), and give me to drink from his cup a drink after which I shall never thirst. And send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), and make me among the righteous and obedient ones in this world and the Hereafter, by Your mercy, O’ Most Merciful of the merciful. And glory be to Allah (swt), as often as anything glorifies Allah (swt), and in the manner that Allah (swt) loves to be glorified. arabicText: عَلِيُّ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ سَعْدٍ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ هِلاَلٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ سَالِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ اَلثُّمَالِيِّ قَالَ: أَخَذْتُ هَذَا اَلدُّعَاءَ مِنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ وَ كَانَ يُسَمِّيهِ اَلدُّعَاءَ اَلْجَامِعَ«« بِسْمِ اَللّٰهِ اَلرَّحْمٰنِ اَلرَّحِيمِ» أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اَللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ وَ أَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّداً عَبْدُهُ وَ رَسُولُهُ آمَنْتُ بِاللَّهِ وَ بِجَمِيعِ رُسُلِ اَللَّهِ وَ بِجَمِيعِ مَا أُنْزِلَتْ بِهِ جَمِيعُ رُسُلِ اَللَّهِ وَ أَنَّ وَعْدَ اَللَّهِ حَقٌّ وَ لِقَاءَهُ حَقٌّ وَ صَدَقَ اَللَّهُ وَ بَلَّغَ اَلْمُرْسَلُونَ« وَ اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ رَبِّ اَلْعٰالَمِينَ» وَ سُبْحَانَ اَللَّهِ كُلَّمَا سَبَّحَ اَللَّهَ شَيْءٌ وَ كَمَا يُحِبُّ اَللَّهُ أَنْ يُسَبَّحَ وَ اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ كُلَّمَا حَمِدَ اَللَّهَ شَيْءٌ وَ كَمَا يُحِبُّ اَللَّهُ أَنْ يُحْمَدَ وَ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اَللَّهُ كُلَّمَا هَلَّلَ اَللَّهَ شَيْءٌ وَ كَمَا يُحِبُّ اَللَّهُ أَنْ يُهَلَّلَ وَاَللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ كُلَّمَا كَبَّرَ اَللَّهَ شَيْءٌ وَكَمَا يُحِبُّ اَللَّهُ أَنْ يُكَبَّرَ اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مَفَاتِيحَ اَلْخَيْرِ وَخَوَاتِيمَهُ وَسَوَابِغَهُ وَفَوَائِدَهُ وَ شَرَائِعَهُ وَبَرَكَاتِهِ مَا بَلَغَ عِلْمُهُ عِلْمِي وَمَا قَصَرَ عَنْ إِحْصَائِهِ حِفْظِي اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اِنْهَجْ لِي أَسْبَابَ مَعْرِفَتِهِ وَ اِفْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَهُ وَ غَشِّنِي بَرَكَاتِ رَحْمَتِكَ وَ مُنَّ عَلَيَّ بِعِصْمَةٍ عَنِ اَلْإِزَالَةِ عَنْ دِينِكَ وَ طَهِّرْ قَلْبِي مِنَ اَلشَّكِّ وَ لاَ تَشْغَلْ قَلْبِي بِدُنْيَايَ وَ عَاجِلِ مَعَاشِي عَنْ آجِلِ ثَوَابِ آخِرَتِي وَ اِشْغَلْ قَلْبِي بِحِفْظِ مَالاَ تَقْبَلُ مِنِّي جَهْلَهُ وَ ذَلِّلْ لِكُلِّ خَيْرٍ لِسَانِي وَ طَهِّرْ قَلْبِي مِنَ اَلرِّيَاءِ وَ لاَ تُجْرِهِ فِي مَفَاصِلِي وَ اِجْعَلْ عَمَلِي خَالِصاً لَكَ اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ اَلشَّرِّ وَ أَنْوَاعِ اَلْفَوَاحِشِ كُلِّهَا ظَاهِرِهَا وَ بَاطِنِهَا وَ غَفَلاَتِهَا وَ جَمِيعِ مَا يُرِيدُنِي بِهِ اَلشَّيْطَانُ اَلرَّجِيمُ وَ مَا يُرِيدُنِي بِهِ اَلسُّلْطَانُ اَلْعَنِيدُ مِمَّا أَحَطْتَ بِعِلْمِهِ وَ أَنْتَ اَلْقَادِرُ عَلَى صَرْفِهِ عَنِّي اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ طَوَارِقِ اَلْجِنِّ وَ اَلْإِنْسِ وَ زَوَابِعِهِمْ وَ بَوَائِقِهِمْ وَ مَكَايِدِهِمْ وَ مَشَاهِدِ اَلْفَسَقَةِ مِنَ اَلْجِنِّ وَ اَلْإِنْسِ وَ أَنْ أُسْتَزَلَّ عَنْ دِينِي فَتَفْسُدَ عَلَيَّ آخِرَتِي وَ أَنْ يَكُونَ ذَلِكَ ضَرَراً مِنْهُمْ عَلَيَّ فِي مَعَاشِي أَوْ تَعْرِضَ بَلاَءٌ يُصِيبُنِي مِنْهُمْ وَ لاَ قُوَّةَ لِي بِهِ وَ لاَ صَبْرَ لِي عَلَى اِحْتِمَالِهِ فَلاَ تَبْتَلِيَنِّي يَا إِلَهِي بِمُقَاسَاتِهِ فَيَمْنَعَنِي ذَلِكَ مِنْ ذِكْرِكَ وَ يَشْغَلَنِي عَنْ عِبَادَتِكَ أَنْتَ اَلْعَاصِمُ اَلْمَانِعُ وَاَلدَّافِعُ اَلْوَاقِي مِنْ ذَلِكَ كُلِّهِ أَسْأَلُكَ اَللَّهُمَّ اَلرَّفَاهِيَةَ فِي مَعِيشَتِي مَا أَبْقَيْتَنِي مَعِيشَةً أَقْوَى بِهَا عَلَى طَاعَتِكَ وَ أَبْلُغُ بِهَا رِضْوَانَكَ وَ أَصِيرُ بِهَا مِنْكَ إِلَى دَارِ اَلْحَيَوَانِ غَداً اَللَّهُمَّ اُرْزُقْنِي رِزْقاً حَلاَلاً يَكْفِينِي وَ لاَ تَرْزُقْنِي رِزْقاً يُطْغِينِي وَ لاَ تَبْتَلِيَنِّي بِفَقْرٍ أَشْقَى بِهِ مُضَيِّقاً عَلَيَّ أَعْطِنِي حَظّاً وَافِراً فِي آخِرَتِي وَ مَعَاشاً وَاسِعاً هَنِيئاً مَرِيئاً فِي دُنْيَايَ وَلاَ تَجْعَلِ اَلدُّنْيَا عَلَيَّ سِجْناً وَلاَ تَجْعَلْ فِرَاقَهَا عَلَيَّ حُزْناً أَجِرْنِي مِنْ فِتْنَتِهَا وَاِجْعَلْ عَمَلِي فِيهَا مَقْبُولاً وَ سَعْيِي فِيهَا مَشْكُوراً اَللَّهُمَّ وَ مَنْ أَرَادَنِي فِيهَا بِسُوءٍ فَأَرِدْهُ وَ مَنْ كَادَنِي فِيهَا فَكِدْهُ وَ اِصْرِفْ عَنِّي هَمَّ مَنْ أَدْخَلَ عَلَيَّ هَمَّهُ وَاُمْكُرْ بِمَنْ يَمْكُرُنِي فَإِنَّكَ خَيْرُ اَلْمَاكِرِينَ وَاِفْقَأْ عَنِّي عُيُونَ اَلْكَفَرَةِ اَلظَّلَمَةِ اَلطُّغَاةِ اَلْحَسَدَةِ اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ أَنْزِلْ عَلَيَّ مِنْكَ سَكِينَةً وَ أَلْبِسْنِي دِرْعَكَ اَلْحَصِينَةَ وَ اِحْفَظْنِي بِسِتْرِكَ اَلْوَاقِي وَ جَلِّلْنِي عَافِيَتَكَ اَلنَّافِعَةَ وَ صَدِّقْ قَوْلِي وَ فَعَالِي وَ بَارِكْ لِي فِي أَهْلِي وَ وُلْدِي وَ مَالِي وَ مَا قَدَّمْتُ وَ مَا أَخَّرْتُ وَ مَا أَغْفَلْتُ وَ مَا تَعَمَّدْتُ وَ مَا تَوَانَيْتُ وَ مَا أَعْلَنْتُ وَ مَا أَسْرَرْتُ فَاغْفِرْهُ لِي وَ اِرْحَمْنِي يَا أَرْحَمَ اَلرَّاحِمِينَ وَ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ اَلطَّيِّبِينَ اَلطَّاهِرِينَ كَمَا أَنْتَ أَهْلُهُ يَا وَلِيَّ اَلْمُؤْمِنِينَ»

chapter: Chapter on Supplication Between the Units of Prayer (Rak‘at)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText: You perform two units of prayer and say: “O’ You (azj) who is excellent in trials, be with me. O’ You (azj) who is ancient in forgiveness, pardon me. O’ You (azj) whom nothing can do without, O’ You (azj) whom everything is in need of, O’ You (azj) to whom everything returns, O’ You (azj) to whom all matters end take charge of me, my Master (azj), And do not hand over my affairs to the worst of Your creation. You (azj) are my Creator and my Sustainer, O’ my Master (azj), so do not forsake me.” Then you perform two units of prayer and say: “O’ Allah (swt), send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), And make me among the most fortunate of Your servants in every good that You (azj) have sent down on this night or that You (azj) will send down of light by which You (azj) guide, or of mercy which You (azj) spread, or of sustenance which You (azj) expand, or of harm which You (azj) remove, or of affliction which You (azj) lift, or of evil which You (azj) repel, or of trial which You (azj) avert and write for me what You (azj) have written for Your righteous friends who have earned from You (azj) the reward and have been secured by Your pleasure from the punishment. O’ Generous! O’ Generous! O’ Generous! Send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), hasten their relief, forgive me my sin, bless for me my earnings, make me content with what You (azj) have provided me, and do not test me with what You (azj) have withheld from me.” Then you perform two units of prayer and say: “O’ Allah (swt), to You (azj) I have raised my hands, and in what is with You (azj) my desire has greatly increased, so accept, O’ my Master (azj), my repentance, have mercy on my weakness, forgive me and have mercy on me, and grant me a share in every good and a path to every good. O’ Allah (swt), I seek refuge in You (azj) from arrogance and from positions of disgrace in this world and the Hereafter. O’ Allah (swt), send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws). And forgive me for the sins that have passed, and protect me in what remains of my life. Bring upon me the means of Your obedience and employ me in them. Turn away from me the causes of Your disobedience and place a barrier between me and them. Place me, my family, and my children in Your trusts that are never lost. Protect me from the Fire, and turn away from me the evil of the wicked among the jinn and humans, and the evil of every possessor of evil, and the evil of every weak or strong being among Your creation, and the evil of every creature whose forelock You (azj) hold. Truly, You (azj) have power over all things.” Then you perform two units of prayer and say: “O’ Allah (swt), You (azj) are exalted in status, mighty in dominion, severe in strength, magnificent in majesty, powerful, overwhelming, near in mercy, true in promise, faithful in covenant, near, responsive, hearer of supplication, acceptor of repentance, enumerator of what You (azj) have created, capable of what You (azj) will, perceiver of whomever You (azj) pursue, provider for whomever You (azj) create, grateful when thanked, mindful when remembered. So I ask You (azj), O’ my God (azj), as one in need; and I turn to You (azj) as a poor one; and I humble myself to You (azj) as one in fear; and I weep to You (azj) as one distressed; and I hope in You (azj) as a helper; and I seek forgiveness from You (azj) as one weak; and I rely upon You (azj) seeking reward; and I seek provision from You (azj) with open hope. And I ask You (azj), O’ my God (azj), to send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), and that You (azj) forgive me my sins, accept my deeds, ease my return, and bring relief to my heart. My God (azj), I ask You (azj) to confirm my hope, pardon my sin, and protect me from disobedience. My God (azj), I have grown weak, and I have no strength; I have become incapable, and I have no power. My God (azj), I have come to You (azj) as one who has wronged his own soul, acknowledging the evil of my deeds. I have remembered my heedlessness and become fearful of what I have done. So send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), be pleased with me, and fulfill all of my needs of this world and the Hereafter, O’ Most Merciful of the merciful.” Then you perform two units of prayer and say: “O’ Allah (swt), I ask You (azj) for well-being from the hardship of affliction, the gloating of enemies, the evil of judgment, the attainment of misery, And from harm in livelihood; And that You (azj) do not test me with a trial beyond my endurance, nor place over me a tyrant, nor tear away from me a covering, nor expose my faults, nor call me to account on the Day of Resurrection with precise measure at the time when I am most in need of Your pardon and Your overlooking of me. So I ask You (azj) by Your noble Face and Your perfect words to send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), And that You (azj) make me among those whom You (azj) have freed and released from the Fire. O’ Allah (swt), send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), And admit me into Paradise, and make me among its inhabitants and dwellers. O’ Allah (swt), I seek refuge in You (azj) from the seizing flames of the Fire. O’ Allah (swt), send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), And grant me the opportunity to perform Hajj and Umrah, and fasting and charity for Your sake. Then you prostrate and say in your prostration: “O’ Hearer of every voice, O’ Creator of souls after death, O’ He (azj) whom darknesses do not veil, O’ He (azj) for whom voices do not become confused, O’ He (azj) whom nothing distracts from anything else, Grant (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) the best of what He (saws) has asked You (azj) for, and the best of what has been asked for Him (saws), and the best of what You (azj) are asked for until the Day of Resurrection. And I ask You (azj) to make me among those whom You (azj) have freed and released from the Fire. O’ Allah (swt), send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), and make well-being my outer and inner garment, and a means of salvation for me from every evil on the Day of Resurrection.”
arabicText: تصلي ركعتين وتقول يَا حَسَنَ اَلْبَلاَيَا عِنْدِي يَا قَدِيمَ اَلْعَفْوِ عَنِّي يَا مَنْ لاَ غِنَى لِشَيْءٍ عَنْهُ يَا مَنْ لاَ بُدَّ لِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ مِنْهُ يَا مَنْ مَرَدُّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ إِلَيْهِ يَا مَنْ مَصِيرُ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ إِلَيْهِ تَوَلَّنِي سَيِّدِي وَ لاَ تُوَلِّ أَمْرِي شِرَارَ خَلْقِكَ أَنْتَ خَالِقِي وَ رَازِقِي يَا مَوْلاَيَ فَلاَ تُضَيِّعْنِي» ثم تصلي ركعتين وتقول اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اِجْعَلْنِي مِنْ أَوْفَرِ عِبَادِكَ نَصِيباً مِنْ كُلِّ خَيْرٍ أَنْزَلْتَهُ فِي هَذِهِ اَللَّيْلَةِ أَوْ أَنْتَ مُنْزِلُهُ مِنْ نُورٍ تَهْدِي بِهِ أَوْ رَحْمَةٍ تَنْشُرُهَا وَمِنْ رِزْقٍ تَبْسُطُهُ وَمِنْ ضُرٍّ تَكْشِفُهُ وَمِنْ بَلاَءٍ تَرْفَعُهُ وَمِنْ سُوءٍ تَدْفَعُهُ وَ مِنْ فِتْنَةٍ تَصْرِفُهَا وَ اُكْتُبْ لِي مَا كَتَبْتَ لِأَ وْلِيَائِكَ اَلصَّالِحِينَ اَلَّذِينَ اِسْتَوْجَبُوا مِنْكَ اَلثَّوَابَ وَ أَمِنُوا بِرِضَاكَ عَنْهُمْ مِنْكَ اَلْعَذَابَ يَا كَرِيمُ يَا كَرِيمُ يَا كَرِيمُ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ عَجِّلْ فَرَجَهُمْ وَ اِغْفِرْ لِي ذَنْبِي وَ بَارِكْ لِي فِي كَسْبِي وَ قَنِّعْنِي بِمَا رَزَقْتَنِي وَ لاَ تَفْتِنِّي بِمَا زَوَيْتَ عَنِّي» ثم تصلي ركعتين وتقول اَللَّهُمَّ إِلَيْكَ نَصَبْتُ يَدِي وَ فِيمَا عِنْدَكَ عَظُمَتْ رَغْبَتِي فَاقْبَلْ سَيِّدِي تَوْبَتِي وَ اِرْحَمْ ضَعْفِي وَ اِغْفِرْ لِي وَ اِرْحَمْنِي وَ اِجْعَلْ لِي فِي كُلِّ خَيْرٍ نَصِيباً وَ إِلَى كُلِّ خَيْرٍ سَبِيلاً اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ اَلْكِبْرِ وَ مَوَاقِفِ اَلْخِزْيِ فِي اَلدُّنْيَا وَ اَلْآخِرَةِ اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اِغْفِرْ لِي مَا سَلَفَ مِنْ ذُنُوبِي وَ اِعْصِمْنِي فِيمَا بَقِيَ مِنْ عُمُرِي وَ أَوْرِدْ عَلَيَّ أَسْبَابَ طَاعَتِكَ وَ اِسْتَعْمِلْنِي بِهَا وَ اِصْرِفْ عَنِّي أَسْبَابَ مَعْصِيَتِكَ وَ حُلْ بَيْنِي وَ بَيْنَهَا وَ اِجْعَلْنِي وَ أَهْلِي وَ وُلْدِي فِي وَدَائِعِكَ اَلَّتِي لاَ تَضِيعُ وَ اِعْصِمْنِي مِنَ اَلنَّارِ وَ اِصْرِفْ عَنِّي شَرَّ فَسَقَةِ اَلْجِنِّ وَ اَلْإِنْسِ وَ شَرَّ كُلِّ ذِي شَرٍّ وَ شَرَّ كُلِّ ضَعِيفٍ أَوْ شَدِيدٍ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ وَ شَرَّ كُلِّ دَابَّةٍ أَنْتَ« آخِذٌ بِنٰاصِيَتِهٰا»« إِنَّكَ عَلىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ» ثم تصلي ركعتين وتقول اَللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ مُتَعَالِي اَلشَّأْنِ عَظِيمُ اَلْجَبَرُوتِ شَدِيدُ اَلْمِحَالِ عَظِيمُ اَلْكِبْرِيَاءِ قَادِرٌ قَاهِرٌ قَرِيبُ اَلرَّحْمَةِ صَادِقُ اَلْوَعْدِ وَفِيُّ اَلْعَهْدِ قَرِيبٌ مُجِيبٌ سَامِعُ اَلدُّعَاءِ قَابِلُ اَلتَّوْبَةِ مُحْصٍ لِمَا خَلَقْتَ قَادِرٌ عَلَى مَا أَرَدْتَ مُدْرِكٌ مَنْ طَلَبْتَ رَازِقٌ مَنْ خَلَقْتَ شَكُورٌ إِنْ شُكِرْتَ ذَاكِرٌ إِنْ ذُكِرْتَ فَأَسْأَلُكَ يَا إِلَهِي مُحْتَاجاً وَ أَرْغَبُ إِلَيْكَ فَقِيراً وَ أَتَضَرَّعُ إِلَيْكَ خَائِفاً وَ أَبْكِي إِلَيْكَ مَكْرُوباً وَ أَرْجُوكَ نَاصِراً وَ أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ ضَعِيفاً وَ أَتَوَكَّلُ عَلَيْكَ مُحْتَسِباً وَ أَسْتَرْزِقُكَ مُتَوَسِّعاً وَ أَسْأَلُكَ يَا إِلَهِي أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ أَنْ تَغْفِرَ لِي ذُنُوبِي وَ تَتَقَبَّلَ لِي عَمَلِي وَ تُيَسِّرَ مُنْقَلَبِي وَ تُفَرِّجَ قَلْبِي إِلَهِي أَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تُصَدِّقَ ظَنِّي وَ تَعْفُوَ عَنْ خَطِيئَتِي وَ تَعْصِمَنِي مِنَ اَلْمَعَاصِي إِلَهِي ضَعُفْتُ فَلاَ قُوَّةَ لِي وَ عَجَزْتُ فَلاَ حَوْلَ لِي إِلَهِي جِئْتُكَ مُسْرِفاً عَلَى نَفْسِي مُقِرّاً بِسُوءِ عَمَلِي قَدْ ذَكَرْتُ غَفْلَتِي وَ أَشْفَقْتُ مِمَّا كَانَ مِنِّي فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اِرْضَ عَنِّي وَ اِقْضِ لِي جَمِيعَ حَوَائِجِي مِنْ حَوَائِجِ اَلدُّنْيَا وَ اَلْآخِرَةِ يَا أَرْحَمَ اَلرَّاحِمِينَ». ثم تصلي ركعتين وتقول اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ اَلْعَافِيَةَ مِنْ جَهْدِ اَلْبَلاَءِ وَ شَمَاتَةِ اَلْأَعْدَاءِ وَ سُوءِ اَلْقَضَاءِ وَ دَرَكِ اَلشَّقَاءِ وَ مِنَ اَلضَّرَرِ فِي اَلْمَعِيشَةِ وَ أَنْ تَبْتَلِيَنِي بِبَلاَءٍ لاَ طَاقَةَ لِي بِهِ أَوْ تُسَلِّطَ عَلَيَّ طَاغِياً أَوْ تَهْتِكَ لِي سِتْراً أَوْ تُبْدِيَ لِي عَوْرَةً أَوْ تُحَاسِبَنِي يَوْمَ اَلْقِيَامَةِ مُقَاصّاً أَحْوَجَ مَا أَكُونُ إِلَى عَفْوِكَ وَ تَجَاوُزِكَ عَنِّي فَأَسْأَلُكَ بِوَجْهِكَ اَلْكَرِيمِ وَ كَلِمَاتِكَ اَلتَّامَّةِ أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ أَنْ تَجْعَلَنِي مِنْ عُتَقَائِكَ وَ طُلَقَائِكَ مِنَ اَلنَّارِ اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ أَدْخِلْنِي اَلْجَنَّةَ وَ اِجْعَلْنِي مِنْ سُكَّانِهَا وَ عُمَّارِهَا اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ سَفَعَاتِ اَلنَّارِ اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اُرْزُقْنِي اَلْحَجَّ وَ اَلْعُمْرَةَ وَ اَلصِّيَامَ وَ اَلصَّدَقَةَ لِوَجْهِكَ» ثم تسجد وتقول في سجودك يا سامع كل صوت ويا بارئ النفوس بعد الموت ويا من لا تغشاه الظلمات ويا من لا تتشابه عليه الاصوات ويا من لا يشغله شئ عن شئ اعط محمدا أفضل ما سألك وأفضل ما سئلت له وافضل ما أنت مسؤول له إلى يوم القيامة وأسألك أن تجعلني من عتقائك وطلقائك من النار اللهم صل على محمد وآل محمد واجعل العافية شعاري ودثاري ونجاة لي من كل سوء يوم القيامة
thaqalaynMatn: You perform two units of prayer and say: “O’ You (azj) who is excellent in trials, be with me. O’ You (azj) who is ancient in forgiveness, pardon me. O’ You (azj) whom nothing can do without, O’ You (azj) whom everything is in need of, O’ You (azj) to whom everything returns, O’ You (azj) to whom all matters end take charge of me, my Master (azj), And do not hand over my affairs to the worst of Your creation. You (azj) are my Creator and my Sustainer, O’ my Master (azj), so do not forsake me.” Then you perform two units of prayer and say: “O’ Allah (swt), send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), And make me among the most fortunate of Your servants in every good that You (azj) have sent down on this night or that You (azj) will send down of light by which You (azj) guide, or of mercy which You (azj) spread, or of sustenance which You (azj) expand, or of harm which You (azj) remove, or of affliction which You (azj) lift, or of evil which You (azj) repel, or of trial which You (azj) avert and write for me what You (azj) have written for Your righteous friends who have earned from You (azj) the reward and have been secured by Your pleasure from the punishment. O’ Generous! O’ Generous! O’ Generous! Send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), hasten their relief, forgive me my sin, bless for me my earnings, make me content with what You (azj) have provided me, and do not test me with what You (azj) have withheld from me.” Then you perform two units of prayer and say: “O’ Allah (swt), to You (azj) I have raised my hands, and in what is with You (azj) my desire has greatly increased, so accept, O’ my Master (azj), my repentance, have mercy on my weakness, forgive me and have mercy on me, and grant me a share in every good and a path to every good. O’ Allah (swt), I seek refuge in You (azj) from arrogance and from positions of disgrace in this world and the Hereafter. O’ Allah (swt), send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws). And forgive me for the sins that have passed, and protect me in what remains of my life. Bring upon me the means of Your obedience and employ me in them. Turn away from me the causes of Your disobedience and place a barrier between me and them. Place me, my family, and my children in Your trusts that are never lost. Protect me from the Fire, and turn away from me the evil of the wicked among the jinn and humans, and the evil of every possessor of evil, and the evil of every weak or strong being among Your creation, and the evil of every creature whose forelock You (azj) hold. Truly, You (azj) have power over all things.” Then you perform two units of prayer and say: “O’ Allah (swt), You (azj) are exalted in status, mighty in dominion, severe in strength, magnificent in majesty, powerful, overwhelming, near in mercy, true in promise, faithful in covenant, near, responsive, hearer of supplication, acceptor of repentance, enumerator of what You (azj) have created, capable of what You (azj) will, perceiver of whomever You (azj) pursue, provider for whomever You (azj) create, grateful when thanked, mindful when remembered. So I ask You (azj), O’ my God (azj), as one in need; and I turn to You (azj) as a poor one; and I humble myself to You (azj) as one in fear; and I weep to You (azj) as one distressed; and I hope in You (azj) as a helper; and I seek forgiveness from You (azj) as one weak; and I rely upon You (azj) seeking reward; and I seek provision from You (azj) with open hope. And I ask You (azj), O’ my God (azj), to send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), and that You (azj) forgive me my sins, accept my deeds, ease my return, and bring relief to my heart. My God (azj), I ask You (azj) to confirm my hope, pardon my sin, and protect me from disobedience. My God (azj), I have grown weak, and I have no strength; I have become incapable, and I have no power. My God (azj), I have come to You (azj) as one who has wronged his own soul, acknowledging the evil of my deeds. I have remembered my heedlessness and become fearful of what I have done. So send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), be pleased with me, and fulfill all of my needs of this world and the Hereafter, O’ Most Merciful of the merciful.” Then you perform two units of prayer and say: “O’ Allah (swt), I ask You (azj) for well-being from the hardship of affliction, the gloating of enemies, the evil of judgment, the attainment of misery, And from harm in livelihood; And that You (azj) do not test me with a trial beyond my endurance, nor place over me a tyrant, nor tear away from me a covering, nor expose my faults, nor call me to account on the Day of Resurrection with precise measure at the time when I am most in need of Your pardon and Your overlooking of me. So I ask You (azj) by Your noble Face and Your perfect words to send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), And that You (azj) make me among those whom You (azj) have freed and released from the Fire. O’ Allah (swt), send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), And admit me into Paradise, and make me among its inhabitants and dwellers. O’ Allah (swt), I seek refuge in You (azj) from the seizing flames of the Fire. O’ Allah (swt), send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), And grant me the opportunity to perform Hajj and Umrah, and fasting and charity for Your sake. Then you prostrate and say in your prostration: “O’ Hearer of every voice, O’ Creator of souls after death, O’ He (azj) whom darknesses do not veil, O’ He (azj) for whom voices do not become confused, O’ He (azj) whom nothing distracts from anything else, Grant (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) the best of what He (saws) has asked You (azj) for, and the best of what has been asked for Him (saws), and the best of what You (azj) are asked for until the Day of Resurrection. And I ask You (azj) to make me among those whom You (azj) have freed and released from the Fire. O’ Allah (swt), send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), and make well-being my outer and inner garment, and a means of salvation for me from every evil on the Day of Resurrection.”

chapter: Chapter on Supplication Between the Units of Prayer (Rak‘at)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ali ibn Hatim from Muhammad ibn Ja’far, who said: Muhammad ibn al-Husayn ibn Abi al-Khattab narrated to me, who said: Muhammad ibn Hammad narrated to me from his father, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:

chapter: Chapter on Supplication Between the Units of Prayer (Rak‘at)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ali ibn Hatim from Muhammad ibn Amr from Ali ibn Muhammad ibn Ziyad from Ja’far ibn Muhammad ibn Ubaydullah from Abdillah ibn Maymun from his father from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Baqir (a.s) said: “There is no God but Allah (swt), the Forbearing, the Generous. There is no God but Allah (swt), the Most High, the Most Great. Glory be to Allah (swt), the Lord (azj) of the seven heavens and the Lord (azj) of the seven earths and the Lord (azj) of the Great Throne. ‘And all praise is due to Allah (swt), Lord of the worlds’. O’ Allah (swt), I ask You (azj) by my love for You (azj), and by my love for Your Messenger may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, And by my love for the family of Your Messenger (saws), may Your blessings be upon him and upon all of them. O’ One who is better for me than my father and my mother and all people, Ordain for me better than what I would ordain for myself, and better than what my father and my mother would ordain for me. You (azj) are Generous and do not withhold, Forbearing and not ignorant, Mighty and never humiliated. O’ Allah (swt), for the one whose trust and hope is in the people, You (azj) are my trust and my hope. Ordain for me the best of outcomes, with well-being, and make me content with what You (azj) have decreed for me. O’ Allah (swt), send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), and clothe me in Your protective well-being. And if You (azj) try me with affliction, then grant me patience, though well-being is more beloved to me.”
arabicText: عَلِيُّ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ مَيْمُونٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ:« لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اَللَّهُ اَلْحَلِيمُ اَلْكَرِيمُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اَللَّهُ اَلْعَلِيُّ اَلْعَظِيمُ سُبْحَانَ اَللَّهِ رَبِّ اَلسَّمَاوَاتِ اَلسَّبْعِ وَرَبِّ اَلْأَرَضِينَ اَلسَّبْعِ وَرَبِّ اَلْعَرْشِ اَلْعَظِيمِ« وَاَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ رَبِّ اَلْعٰالَمِينَ» اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِدِرْعِكَ اَلْحَصِينَةِ وَبِقُوَّتِكَ وَعَظَمَتِكَ وَ سُلْطَانِكَ أَنْ تُجِيرَنِي مِنَ اَلشَّيْطَانِ اَلرَّجِيمِ وَمِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ جَبَّارٍ عَنِيدٍ اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِحُبِّي إِيَّاكَ وَ بِحُبِّي رَسُولَكَ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ وَ بِحُبِّي أَهْلَ بَيْتِ رَسُولِكَ صَلَوَاتُكَ عَلَيْهِ وَ عَلَيْهِمْ أَجْمَعِينَ يَا خَيْراً لِي مِنْ أَبِي وَ أُمِّي وَ مِنَ اَلنَّاسِ جَمِيعاً اِقْدِرْ لِي خَيْراً مِنْ قَدْرِي لِنَفْسِي وَ خَيْراً لِي مِمَّا يَقْدِرُ لِي أَبِي وَأُمِّي أَنْتَ جَوَادٌ لاَ تَبْخَلُ وَحَلِيمٌ لاَ تَجْهَلُ وَعَزِيزٌ لاَ تُسْتَذَلُّ اَللَّهُمَّ مَنْ كَانَ اَلنَّاسُ ثِقَتَهُ وَ رَجَاءَهُ فَأَنْتَ ثِقَتِي وَ رَجَائِي اِقْدِرْ لِي خَيْرَهَا عَافِيَةً وَ رَضِّنِي بِمَا قَضَيْتَ لِي اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ أَلْبِسْنِي عَافِيَتَكَ اَلْحَصِينَةَ فَإِنِ اِبْتَلَيْتَنِي فَصَبِّرْنِي وَ اَلْعَافِيَةُ أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ»
