chapter: Chapter on Supplication Between the Units of Prayer (Rak‘at)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ali ibn Hatim, from Muhammad ibn Abi Abdillah and Ali ibn Sulayman both said: Muhammad ibn Khalid narrated to us, from al-Ala ibn Razin, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from one of the two (Imams (a.s)) peace be upon them, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “O’ Allah (swt), to You (azj) belongs all praise with all of Your praises for all of Your blessings, until the praise reaches that which You (azj) love and are pleased with. O’ Allah (swt), I ask You (azj) for Your goodness and the goodness of what I hope for, And I seek refuge in You (azj) from the evil of what I fear and from the evil of what I do not fear. O’ Allah (swt), send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), And expand my sustenance, and extend my life, and forgive my sin, and make me among those through whom You (azj) support Your religion, and do not replace me with someone else.” Then perform two units of prayer, and when you have finished, say: “O’ Allah (swt), send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), And apportion for us, of Your fear, that which acts as a barrier between us and Your disobedience; And of Your obedience, that which will deliver us to Your Paradise; And of certainty, that which makes the afflictions of this world easy upon us. And allow us to enjoy our hearing and our sight, and grant us victory over those who show enmity to us. And do not make our affliction in our religion, and do not make this world the greatest of our concerns, and do not give power over us to those who will not show us mercy.” Then perform two units of prayer, and when you have finished, say: “O’ Allah (swt), indeed my sins cause me to fear You (azj), and Your generosity gives me hope from You (azj). So, by fear, remove me from sins, and by Your bounty, bring me to gifts, until I may be tomorrow on the Day of Resurrection a freed one by Your generosity, just as I was in the world a nurtured one of Your blessings. For what You (azj) will bestow tomorrow of salvation is not greater than what You (azj) have granted today of hope. And when has one who hoped at Your door ever been disappointed? Or when has one who asked of You (azj) ever been turned away rejected? My God (azj), never has one called upon You (azj), whom You (azj) did not answer for You (azj) have said: ‘Call upon Me, I will respond to you’ (Surah al-Mu’min 40:60), And You (azj) do not break the promise. So send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), O’ my God (azj), and answer my supplication.”
arabicText: عَلِيُّ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ وَ عَلِيِّ بْنِ سُلَيْمَانَ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ عَنِ اَلْعَلاَءِ بْنِ رَزِينٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ أَحَدِهِمَا عَلَيْهِمَا اَلسَّلاَمُ:« اَللَّهُمَّ لَكَ اَلْحَمْدُ بِمَحَامِدِكَ كُلِّهَا عَلَى نَعْمَائِكَ كُلِّهَا حَتَّى يَنْتَهِيَ اَلْحَمْدُ إِلَى مَا تُحِبُّ وَ تَرْضَى اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَكَ وَ خَيْرَ مَا أَرْجُو وَ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا أَحْذَرُ وَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا لاَ أَحْذَرُ اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ أَوْسِعْ لِي فِي رِزْقِي وَ اُمْدُدْ لِي فِي عُمُرِي وَ اِغْفِرْ لِي ذَنْبِي وَاِجْعَلْنِي مِمَّنْ تَنْتَصِرُ بِهِ لِدِينِكَ وَ لاَ تَسْتَبْدِلْ بِي غَيْرِي ثُمَّ تُصَلِّي رَكْعَتَيْنِ فَإِذَا فَرَغْتَ فَقُلِ اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اِقْسِمْ لَنَا مِنْ خَشْيَتِكَ مَا يَحُولُ بَيْنَنَا وَ بَيْنَ مَعَاصِيكَ وَ مِنْ طَاعَتِكَ مَا تُبَلِّغُنَا بِهِ جَنَّتَكَ وَ مِنَ اَلْيَقِينِ مَا تُهَوِّنُ بِهِ عَلَيْنَا مُصِيبَاتِ اَلدُّنْيَا وَمَتِّعْنَا بِأَسْمَاعِنَا وَأَبْصَارِنَا وَاُنْصُرْنَا عَلَى مَنْ عَادَانَا وَ لاَ تَجْعَلْ مُصِيبَتَنَا فِي دِينِنَا وَ لاَ تَجْعَلِ اَلدُّنْيَا أَكْبَرَ هَمِّنَا وَ لاَ تُسَلِّطْ عَلَيْنَا مَنْ لاَ يَرْحَمُنَا ثُمَّ تُصَلِّي رَكْعَتَيْنِ فَإِذَا فَرَغْتَ فَقُلِ اَللَّهُمَّ إِنَّ ذُنُوبِي تُخَوِّفُنِي مِنْكَ وَ جُودَكَ يُبَشِّرُنِي عَنْكَ فَأَخْرِجْنِي بِالْخَوْفِ مِنَ اَلْخَطَايَا وَ أَوْصِلْنِي بِجُودِكَ إِلَى اَلْعَطَايَا حَتَّى أَكُونَ غَداً فِي اَلْقِيَامَةِ عَتِيقَ كَرَمِكَ كَمَا كُنْتُ فِي اَلدُّنْيَا رَبِيبَ نِعَمِكَ فَلَيْسَ مَا تَبْذُلُهُ غَداً مِنَ اَلنَّجَاةِ بِأَعْظَمَ مِمَّا قَدْ مَنَحْتَهُ اَلْيَوْمَ مِنَ اَلرَّجَاءِ وَمَتَى خَابَ فِي فِنَائِكَ آمِلٌ أَمْ مَتَى اِنْصَرَفَ عَنْكَ بِالرَّدِّ سَائِلٌ إِلَهِي مَا دَعَاكَ مَنْ لَمْ تُجِبْهُ لِأَنَّكَ قُلْتَ« اُدْعُونِي أَسْتَجِبْ لَكُمْ» وَ أَنْتَ« لاٰ تُخْلِفُ اَلْمِيعٰادَ» فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ يَا إِلَهِي وَ اِسْتَجِبْ دُعَائِي»
thaqalaynSanad: Ali ibn Hatim, from Muhammad ibn Abi Abdillah and Ali ibn Sulayman both said: Muhammad ibn Khalid narrated to us, from al-Ala ibn Razin, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from one of the two (Imams (a.s)) peace be upon them, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “O’ Allah (swt), to You (azj) belongs all praise with all of Your praises for all of Your blessings, until the praise reaches that which You (azj) love and are pleased with. O’ Allah (swt), I ask You (azj) for Your goodness and the goodness of what I hope for, And I seek refuge in You (azj) from the evil of what I fear and from the evil of what I do not fear. O’ Allah (swt), send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), And expand my sustenance, and extend my life, and forgive my sin, and make me among those through whom You (azj) support Your religion, and do not replace me with someone else.” Then perform two units of prayer, and when you have finished, say: “O’ Allah (swt), send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), And apportion for us, of Your fear, that which acts as a barrier between us and Your disobedience; And of Your obedience, that which will deliver us to Your Paradise; And of certainty, that which makes the afflictions of this world easy upon us. And allow us to enjoy our hearing and our sight, and grant us victory over those who show enmity to us. And do not make our affliction in our religion, and do not make this world the greatest of our concerns, and do not give power over us to those who will not show us mercy.” Then perform two units of prayer, and when you have finished, say: “O’ Allah (swt), indeed my sins cause me to fear You (azj), and Your generosity gives me hope from You (azj). So, by fear, remove me from sins, and by Your bounty, bring me to gifts, until I may be tomorrow on the Day of Resurrection a freed one by Your generosity, just as I was in the world a nurtured one of Your blessings. For what You (azj) will bestow tomorrow of salvation is not greater than what You (azj) have granted today of hope. And when has one who hoped at Your door ever been disappointed? Or when has one who asked of You (azj) ever been turned away rejected? My God (azj), never has one called upon You (azj), whom You (azj) did not answer for You (azj) have said: ‘Call upon Me, I will respond to you’ (Surah al-Mu’min 40:60), And You (azj) do not break the promise. So send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), O’ my God (azj), and answer my supplication.”

chapter: Chapter on Supplication Between the Units of Prayer (Rak‘at)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ali ibn Hatim, from Muhammad ibn Ja’far, from Abdullah ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn al-Walid, from Yunus ibn Yaqub, from Muattib, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “O’ Allah (swt), bless for me the moment of death. O’ Allah (swt), help me in facing death. O’ Allah (swt), help me during the agonies of death. O’ Allah (swt), help me in the grief of the grave. O’ Allah (swt), help me in the constriction of the grave. O’ Allah (swt), help me in the darkness of the grave. O’ Allah (swt), help me in the loneliness of the grave. O’ Allah (swt), help me against the terrors of the Day of Resurrection. O’ Allah (swt), bless for me the length of the Day of Resurrection. O’ Allah (swt), marry me to the maidens of Paradise (al-Hur al-In).” Then perform two units of prayer, and when you have finished, say: “O’ Allah (swt), there is no escape from Your command, nor from Your decree, nor from Your judgment, and there is no power and no strength except through You (azj). O’ Allah (swt), whatever decree You (azj) have passed upon us and whatever destiny You (azj) have ordained for us, Then grant us with it a patience that overcomes and subdues it. And make it for us ascending toward Your good pleasure, increasing our good deeds, our merit, our excellence, our dignity, our glory, our blessings, and our honor in this world and the Hereafter. And do not let it diminish from our good deeds. O’ Allah (swt), and whatever You (azj) have given us of a gift, or whatever excellence You have distinguished us with, or whatever honor You (azj) have ennobled us with then grant us with it gratitude that overcomes and subdues it. And make it for us ascending toward Your good pleasure, and among our good deeds, our distinction, our honor, Your blessings and Your generosity in this world and the Hereafter. O’ Allah (swt), do not make it for us a cause of arrogance, or boastfulness, or trial, or wrath, or punishment, or disgrace in this world and the Hereafter. O’ Allah (swt), we seek refuge in You (azj) from the slip of the tongue, from an evil end, and from a light scale (on the Day of Judgment). O’ Allah (swt), send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), And inspire us to remember our good deeds at the time of death. Do not show us our deeds as causes of regret, and do not disgrace us at the moment of Your judgment, And do not expose us due to our sins on the Day we meet You (azj). Make our hearts remember You (azj) and never forget You (azj), And fear You (azj) as though they see You (azj), until we meet You (azj). Send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), And replace our evil deeds with good deeds, And make our good deeds into degrees, And make our degrees into chambers, And make our chambers lofty. O’ Allah (swt), expand the provision of our poor from the vastness of what You (azj) have decreed upon Yourself. O’ Allah (swt), send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), And bestow upon us guidance as long as You (azj) keep us alive, And honor as long as You (azj) give us life, And forgiveness when You (azj) cause us to die and protection in what remains of our lives, And blessing in what You (azj) have provided us, And help in what You (azj) have burdened us with, And firmness in what You (azj) have obligated upon us. Do not hold us accountable for our injustice, And do not measure us by our ignorance, and do not draw us gradually to ruin through our sins. Make the best of what we say firmly rooted in our hearts, And make us great in Your sight while humble within ourselves. Benefit us through what You (azj) have taught us, and increase us in beneficial knowledge. I seek refuge in You (azj) from a heart that does not humble, and from an eye that does not shed tears, And from a prayer that is not accepted. Protect us from the evil of trials, O’ Guardian of this world and the Hereafter.”
arabicText: عَلِيُّ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْوَلِيدِ عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ مُعَتِّبٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ:« اَللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لِي فِي اَلْمَوْتِ اَللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَى اَلْمَوْتِ اَللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَى سَكَرَاتِ اَلْمَوْتِ اَللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَى غَمِّ اَلْقَبْرِ اَللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَى ضِيقِ اَلْقَبْرِ اَللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَى ظُلْمَةِ اَلْقَبْرِ اَللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَى وَحْشَةِ اَلْقَبْرِ اَللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَى أَهْوَالِ يَوْمِ اَلْقِيَامَةِ اَللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لِي فِي طُولِ يَوْمِ اَلْقِيَامَةِ اَللَّهُمَّ زَوِّجْنِي مِنَ اَلْحُورِ اَلْعِينِ ثُمَّ تُصَلِّي رَكْعَتَيْنِ فَإِذَا فَرَغْتَ فَقُلِ اَللَّهُمَّ لاَ بُدَّ مِنْ أَمْرِكَ وَ لاَ بُدَّ مِنْ قَدَرِكَ وَ لاَ بُدَّ مِنْ قَضَائِكَ وَ لاَ حَوْلَ وَ لاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِكَ اَللَّهُمَّ فَمَا قَضَيْتَ عَلَيْنَا مِنْ قَضَاءٍ وَ قَدَّرْتَ عَلَيْنَا مِنْ قَدَرٍ فَأَعْطِنَا مَعَهُ صَبْراً يَقْهَرُهُ وَيَدْمَغُهُ وَ اِجْعَلْهُ لَنَا صَاعِداً فِي رِضْوَانِكَ يُنْمِي فِي حَسَنَاتِنَا وَ تَفْضِيلِنَا وَ سُؤْدُدِنَا وَ شَرَفِنَا وَ مَجْدِنَا وَ نَعْمَائِنَا وَ كَرَامَتِنَا فِي اَلدُّنْيَا وَ اَلْآخِرَةِ وَ لاَ تَنْقُصْهُ مِنْ حَسَنَاتِنَا اَللَّهُمَّ وَ مَا أَعْطَيْتَنَا مِنْ عَطَاءٍ أَوْ فَضَّلْتَنَا بِهِ مِنْ فَضِيلَةٍ أَوْ أَكْرَمْتَنَا بِهِ مِنْ كَرَامَةٍ فَأَعْطِنَا مَعَهُ شُكْراً يَقْهَرُهُ وَيَدْمَغُهُ وَاِجْعَلْهُ لَنَا صَاعِداً فِي رِضْوَانِكَ وَفِي حَسَنَاتِنَا وَسُؤْدُدِنَا وَشَرَفِنَا وَنَعْمَائِكَ وَكَرَامَتِكَ فِي اَلدُّنْيَا وَاَلْآخِرَةِ اَللَّهُمَّ وَلاَ تَجْعَلْهُ لَنَا أَشَراً وَلاَ بَطَراً وَلاَ فِتْنَةً وَلاَ مَقْتاً وَلاَ عَذَاباً وَلاَ خِزْياً فِي اَلدُّنْيَا وَاَلْآخِرَةِ اَللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَثْرَةِ اَللِّسَانِ وَ سُوءِ اَلْمَقَامِ وَخِفَّةِ اَلْمِيزَانِ اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَلَقِّنَا حَسَنَاتِنَا فِي اَلْمَمَاتِ وَ لاَ تُرِنَا أَعْمَالَنَا عَلَيْنَا حَسَرَاتٍ وَ لاَ تُخْزِنَا عِنْدَ قَضَائِكَ وَ لاَ تَفْضَحْنَا بِسَيِّئَاتِنَا يَوْمَ نَلْقَاكَ وَ اِجْعَلْ قُلُوبَنَا تَذْكُرُكَ وَ لاَ تَنْسَاكَ وَ تَخْشَاكَ كَأَنَّهَا تَرَاكَ حَتَّى نَلْقَاكَ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ أَبْدِلْ سَيِّئَاتِنَا حَسَنَاتٍ وَ اِجْعَلْ حَسَنَاتِنَا دَرَجَاتٍ وَ اِجْعَلْ دَرَجَاتِنَا غُرُفَاتٍ وَ اِجْعَلْ غُرُفَاتِنَا عَالِيَاتٍ اَللَّهُمَّ وَ أَوْسِعْ لِفَقِيرِنَا مِنْ سَعَةِ مَا قَضَيْتَ عَلَى نَفْسِكَ اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ مُنَّ عَلَيْنَا بِالْهُدَى مَا أَبْقَيْتَنَا وَ اَلْكَرَامَةِ مَا أَحْيَيْتَنَا وَ اَلْمَغْفِرَةِ إِذَا تَوَفَّيْتَنَا وَ اَلْحِفْظِ فِيمَا يَبْقَى مِنْ عُمُرِنَا وَ اَلْبَرَكَةِ فِيمَا رَزَقْتَنَا وَ اَلْعَوْنِ عَلَى مَا حَمَّلْتَنَا وَ اَلثَّبَاتِ عَلَى مَا طَوَّقْتَنَا وَلاَ تُؤَاخِذْنَا بِظُلْمِنَا وَلاَ تُقَايِسْنَا بِجَهْلِنَا وَلاَ تَسْتَدْرِجْنَا بِخَطَايَانَا وَاِجْعَلْ أَحْسَنَ مَا نَقُولُ ثَابِتاً فِي قُلُوبِنَا وَ اِجْعَلْنَا عُظَمَاءَ عِنْدَكَ وَ فِي أَنْفُسِنَا أَذِلَّةً وَ اِنْفَعْنَا بِمَا عَلَّمْتَنَا وَ زِدْنَا عِلْماً نَافِعاً أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ قَلْبٍ لاَ يَخْشَعُ وَ مِنْ عَيْنٍ لاَ تَدْمَعُ وَ صَلاَةٍ لاَ تُقْبَلُ أَجِرْنَا مِنْ سُوءِ اَلْفِتَنِ يَا وَلِيَّ اَلدُّنْيَا وَ اَلْآخِرَةِ»

O’ Allah (swt), and whatever You (azj) have given us of a gift, or whatever excellence You have distinguished us with, or whatever honor You (azj) have ennobled us with then grant us with it gratitude that overcomes and subdues it. And make it for us ascending toward Your good pleasure, and among our good deeds, our distinction, our honor, Your blessings and Your generosity in this world and the Hereafter. O’ Allah (swt), do not make it for us a cause of arrogance, or boastfulness, or trial, or wrath, or punishment, or disgrace in this world and the Hereafter. O’ Allah (swt), we seek refuge in You (azj) from the slip of the tongue, from an evil end, and from a light scale (on the Day of Judgment). O’ Allah (swt), send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), And inspire us to remember our good deeds at the time of death. Do not show us our deeds as causes of regret, and do not disgrace us at the moment of Your judgment, And do not expose us due to our sins on the Day we meet You (azj). Make our hearts remember You (azj) and never forget You (azj), And fear You (azj) as though they see You (azj), until we meet You (azj). Send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), And replace our evil deeds with good deeds, And make our good deeds into degrees, And make our degrees into chambers, And make our chambers lofty. O’ Allah (swt), expand the provision of our poor from the vastness of what You (azj) have decreed upon Yourself. O’ Allah (swt), send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), And bestow upon us guidance as long as You (azj) keep us alive, And honor as long as You (azj) give us life, And forgiveness when You (azj) cause us to die and protection in what remains of our lives, And blessing in what You (azj) have provided us, And help in what You (azj) have burdened us with, And firmness in what You (azj) have obligated upon us. Do not hold us accountable for our injustice, And do not measure us by our ignorance, and do not draw us gradually to ruin through our sins. Make the best of what we say firmly rooted in our hearts, And make us great in Your sight while humble within ourselves. Benefit us through what You (azj) have taught us, and increase us in beneficial knowledge. I seek refuge in You (azj) from a heart that does not humble, and from an eye that does not shed tears, And from a prayer that is not accepted. Protect us from the evil of trials, O’ Guardian of this world and the Hereafter.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 100

Ali ibn Hatim, from Ahmad ibn Ali, from Ahmad ibn Ishaq, from Bakr ibn Muhammad, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:

chapter: Chapter on Supplication Between the Units of Prayer (Rak‘at)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ali ibn Hatim, from Ahmad ibn Ali, from Ahmad ibn Ishaq, from Bakr ibn Muhammad, from Abu Abdillah (a.s):
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “O’ Allah (swt), You (azj) are my trust in every distress, and You (azj) are my hope in every hardship, and You (azj) are my reliance and provision in every matter that befalls me. How many a distress has caused the heart to weaken, in which the means fail, the close one deserts, the enemy rejoices, and I am bewildered by the matters, Yet I directed it to You (azj), and I complained of it to You (azj), seeking refuge in You (azj) over all others. Then You (azj) relieved it, and removed it, and sufficed me in it. So You (azj) are the Master of every blessing, the Companion in every need, and the Ultimate Goal of every hope. To You (azj) belongs much praise, and to You (azj) belongs the favor in excellence.”

How many a distress has caused the heart to weaken, in which the means fail, the close one deserts, the enemy rejoices, and I am bewildered by the matters, Yet I directed it to You (azj), and I complained of it to You (azj), seeking refuge in You (azj) over all others. Then You (azj) relieved it, and removed it, and sufficed me in it. So You (azj) are the Master of every blessing, the Companion in every need, and the Ultimate Goal of every hope. To You (azj) belongs much praise, and to You (azj) belongs the favor in excellence.”

chapter: Chapter on Supplication Between the Units of Prayer (Rak‘at)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ali ibn Hatim from Muhammad ibn Amr, from Ja’far ibn al-Hasan, from his father, from al-Husayn ibn Rashid:
It was reported that Abu Abdillah (a.s) used to instruct with this supplication: “O’ Allah (swt), indeed You (azj) send down during the night and the day whatever You (azj) will so send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and family of Muhammad (saws), And send down upon me, and upon my brothers, my family, and my neighbors, Your blessings and forgiveness and expansive provision, and suffice us in our needs. O’ Allah (swt), send blessings upon Muhammad (saws) and family of Muhammad (saws), and provide for us from where we expect and from where we do not expect, and protect us from where we take precautions and from where we do not take precautions. O’ Allah (swt), send blessings upon Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), and place us in Your protection and Your safeguard mighty is Your protection, exalted is Your praise, and there is no God other than You (azj).”
arabicText: عَلِيُّ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ اَلْحَسَنِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ رَاشِدٍ قَالَ: ذُكِرَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَ أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَأْمُرُ بِهَذَا اَلدُّعَاءِ« اَللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ تُنْزِلُ فِي اَللَّيْلِ وَ اَلنَّهَارِ مَا شِئْتَ فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ أَنْزِلْ عَلَيَّ وَ عَلَى إِخْوَانِي وَ أَهْلِي وَ جِيرَانِي بَرَكَاتِكَ وَ مَغْفِرَتَكَ وَ اَلرِّزْقَ اَلْوَاسِعَ وَ اِكْفِنَا اَلْمُؤَنَ اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اُرْزُقْنَا مِنْ حَيْثُ نَحْتَسِبُ وَ مِنْ حَيْثُ لاَ نَحْتَسِبُ وَ اِحْفَظْنَا مِنْ حَيْثُ نَحْتَفِظُ وَ مِنْ حَيْثُ لاَ نَحْتَفِظُ اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اِجْعَلْنَا فِي جِوَارِكَ وَ حِرْزِكَ عَزَّ جَارُكَ وَ جَلَّ ثَنَاؤُكَ وَ لاَ إِلَهَ غَيْرُكَ»
thaqalaynSanad: Ali ibn Hatim from Muhammad ibn Amr, from Ja’far ibn al-Hasan, from his father, from al-Husayn ibn Rashid:
thaqalaynMatn: It was reported that Abu Abdillah (a.s) used to instruct with this supplication: “O’ Allah (swt), indeed You (azj) send down during the night and the day whatever You (azj) will so send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and family of Muhammad (saws), And send down upon me, and upon my brothers, my family, and my neighbors, Your blessings and forgiveness and expansive provision, and suffice us in our needs. O’ Allah (swt), send blessings upon Muhammad (saws) and family of Muhammad (saws), and provide for us from where we expect and from where we do not expect, and protect us from where we take precautions and from where we do not take precautions. O’ Allah (swt), send blessings upon Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), and place us in Your protection and Your safeguard mighty is Your protection, exalted is Your praise, and there is no God other than You (azj).”

chapter: Chapter on Supplication Between the Units of Prayer (Rak‘at)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ali ibn Hatim, from Muhammad ibn Abi Abdillah, from Sa’ad ibn Abdillah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Barqi, from Sa’ad ibn Sad, from Imam al-Ridha (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Ridha (a.s) said: “This is the supplication for well-being: O’ Allah (swt), O’ Guardian of well-being, O’ Bestower of well-being, O’ Provider of well-being, O’ Granter of well-being, O’ Benefactor of well-being upon me and upon all of His creation, O’ Most Merciful of this world and the Hereafter and their Compassionate One, send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), And hasten for us relief and a way out and grant me well-being and the continuity of well-being in this world and the Hereafter, O’ Most Merciful of the merciful.” Then perform two units of prayer, and when you have finished, say: “O’ Allah (swt), I ask You (azj) by Your mercy which has encompassed all things, And by Your power through which You (azj) have subdued all things, And by Your might through which You (azj) have overcome all things, And by Your honor before which nothing can stand, And by Your greatness which has filled all things, And by Your knowledge which has encompassed all things, And by Your Face which remains after the annihilation of all things, And by the light of Your Face by which everything is illuminated. O’ Bestower, O’ Light, O’ First of the first, and O’ Last of the last, O’ Allah (swt), O’ Most Merciful, O’ Allah (swt), O’ Most Compassionate, O’ Allah (swt) I seek refuge in You (azj) from the sins that bring about retribution, And I seek refuge in You (azj) from the sins that result in regret, And I seek refuge in You (azj) from the sins that withhold allotted portions, And I seek refuge in You (azj) from the sins that tear apart protections, And I seek refuge in You (azj) from the sins that prevent decrees, And I seek refuge in You (azj) from the sins that bring down afflictions, And I seek refuge in You (azj) from the sins that give victory to the enemies, And I seek refuge in You (azj) from the sins that block supplication. And I seek refuge in You (azj) from the sins that hasten destruction, And I seek refuge in You (azj) from the sins that cut off hope, And I seek refuge in You (azj) from the sins that lead to misery, And I seek refuge in You (azj) from the sins that darken the atmosphere, And I seek refuge in You (azj) from the sins that remove the covering, And I seek refuge in You (azj) from the sins that withhold the rain of the sky.
arabicText: عَلِيُّ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اَلْبَرْقِيِّ عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ عَنِ اَلرِّضَا عَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ:« هَذَا دُعَاءُ اَلْعَافِيَةِ يَا اَللَّهُ يَا وَلِيَّ اَلْعَافِيَةِ وَاَلْمَنَّانَ بِالْعَافِيَةِ وَرَازِقَ اَلْعَافِيَةِ وَاَلْمُنْعِمَ بِالْعَافِيَةِ وَ اَلْمُتَفَضِّلَ بِالْعَافِيَةِ عَلَيَّ وَ عَلَى جَمِيعِ خَلْقِهِ وَ رَحْمَانَ اَلدُّنْيَا وَ اَلْآخِرَةِ وَ رَحِيمَهُمَا صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ عَجِّلْ لَنَا فَرَجاً وَ مَخْرَجاً وَ اُرْزُقْنِي اَلْعَافِيَةَ وَ دَوَامَ اَلْعَافِيَةِ فِي اَلدُّنْيَا وَ اَلْآخِرَةِ يَا أَرْحَمَ اَلرَّاحِمِينَ ثُمَّ تُصَلِّي رَكْعَتَيْنِ فَإِذَا فَرَغْتَ فَقُلْ اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِرَحْمَتِكَ اَلَّتِي وَسِعَتْ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ وَ بِقُوَّتِكَ اَلَّتِي قَهَرَتْ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ وَ بِجَبَرُوتِكَ اَلَّتِي غَلَبَتْ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ وَ بِعِزَّتِكَ اَلَّتِي لاَ يَقُومُ لَهَا شَيْءٌ وَ بِعَظَمَتِكَ اَلَّتِي مَلَأَتْ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ وَ بِعِلْمِكَ اَلَّذِي أَحَاطَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَ بِوَجْهِكَ اَلْبَاقِي بَعْدَ فَنَاءِ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَ بِنُورِ وَجْهِكَ اَلَّذِي أَضَاءَ لَهُ كُلُّ شَيْءٍ يَا مَنَّانُ يَا نُورُ يَا أَوَّلَ اَلْأَوَّلِينَ وَ يَا آخِرَ اَلْآخِرِينَ يَا اَللَّهُ يَا رَحْمَانُ يَا اَللَّهُ يَا رَحِيمُ يَا اَللَّهُ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ اَلذُّنُوبِ اَلَّتِي تُحْدِثُ اَلنِّقَمَ وَ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ اَلذُّنُوبِ اَلَّتِي تُورِثُ اَلنَّدَمَ وَ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ اَلذُّنُوبِ اَلَّتِي تَحْبِسُ اَلْقِسَمَ وَ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ اَلذُّنُوبِ اَلَّتِي تَهْتِكُ اَلْعِصَمَ وَ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ اَلذُّنُوبِ اَلَّتِي تَمْنَعُ اَلْقَضَاءَ وَ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ اَلذُّنُوبِ اَلَّتِي تُنْزِلُ اَلْبَلاَءَ وَ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ اَلذُّنُوبِ اَلَّتِي تُدِيلُ اَلْأَعْدَاءَ وَ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ اَلذُّنُوبِ اَلَّتِي تَحْبِسُ اَلدُّعَاءَ وَ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ اَلذُّنُوبِ اَلَّتِي تُعَجِّلُ اَلْفَنَاءَ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ اَلذُّنُوبِ اَلَّتِي تَقْطَعُ اَلرَّجَاءَ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ اَلذُّنُوبِ اَلَّتِي تُورِثُ اَلشَّقَاءَ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ اَلذُّنُوبِ اَلَّتِي تُظْلِمُ اَلْهَوَاءَ وَ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ اَلذُّنُوبِ اَلَّتِي تَكْشِفُ اَلْغِطَاءَ وَ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ اَلذُّنُوبِ اَلَّتِي تَحْبِسُ غَيْثَ اَلسَّمَاءِ»
thaqalaynSanad: Ali ibn Hatim, from Muhammad ibn Abi Abdillah, from Sa’ad ibn Abdillah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Barqi, from Sa’ad ibn Sad, from Imam al-Ridha (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Ridha (a.s) said: “This is the supplication for well-being: O’ Allah (swt), O’ Guardian of well-being, O’ Bestower of well-being, O’ Provider of well-being, O’ Granter of well-being, O’ Benefactor of well-being upon me and upon all of His creation, O’ Most Merciful of this world and the Hereafter and their Compassionate One, send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), And hasten for us relief and a way out and grant me well-being and the continuity of well-being in this world and the Hereafter, O’ Most Merciful of the merciful.” Then perform two units of prayer, and when you have finished, say: “O’ Allah (swt), I ask You (azj) by Your mercy which has encompassed all things, And by Your power through which You (azj) have subdued all things, And by Your might through which You (azj) have overcome all things, And by Your honor before which nothing can stand, And by Your greatness which has filled all things, And by Your knowledge which has encompassed all things, And by Your Face which remains after the annihilation of all things, And by the light of Your Face by which everything is illuminated. O’ Bestower, O’ Light, O’ First of the first, and O’ Last of the last, O’ Allah (swt), O’ Most Merciful, O’ Allah (swt), O’ Most Compassionate, O’ Allah (swt) I seek refuge in You (azj) from the sins that bring about retribution, And I seek refuge in You (azj) from the sins that result in regret, And I seek refuge in You (azj) from the sins that withhold allotted portions, And I seek refuge in You (azj) from the sins that tear apart protections, And I seek refuge in You (azj) from the sins that prevent decrees, And I seek refuge in You (azj) from the sins that bring down afflictions, And I seek refuge in You (azj) from the sins that give victory to the enemies, And I seek refuge in You (azj) from the sins that block supplication. And I seek refuge in You (azj) from the sins that hasten destruction, And I seek refuge in You (azj) from the sins that cut off hope, And I seek refuge in You (azj) from the sins that lead to misery, And I seek refuge in You (azj) from the sins that darken the atmosphere, And I seek refuge in You (azj) from the sins that remove the covering, And I seek refuge in You (azj) from the sins that withhold the rain of the sky.

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 103

chapter: Chapter on Supplication Between the Units of Prayer (Rak‘at)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ali ibn Hatim, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad, said: He narrated to me, Ali ibn Ishaq ibn Umarah, from Abd al-Rahman, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Ibrahim ibn Umar, from the (Imams (a.s)), peace be upon them. And the earlier supplication was narrated with this chain of transmission:
Imam (a.s) said: “O’ Allah (swt), indeed You (azj) preserved the two young boys due to the righteousness of their parents (meaning the story in Surah Al-Kahf). And the believers supplicated to You (azj) and said: ‘Our Lord, do not make us a trial for the wrongdoing people.’ (Surah Yunus 10:85–86) O’ Allah (swt), I implore You (azj) by Your mercy, And I implore You (azj) by Your Prophet (saws), the Prophet of mercy, And I implore You (azj) by Ali (a.s) and Fatimah (s.a), And I implore You (azj) by Hasan (a.s) and Husayn (a.s), Your blessings be upon them all. And I implore You (azj) by Your names and all of Your pillars, And I implore You (azj) by Your Greatest Name, the Greatest, the Greatest, the Most Great, by which if You (azj) are called upon, You (azj) do not reject that which is closest to Your obedience and farthest from Your disobedience, and most fulfilling of Your covenant, and most decisive in executing Your right. And I ask You (azj) to send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), and to make my heart firm for Him (saws), and to make me a grateful servant to You (azj). You (azj) will find among Your creation one whom You (azj) punish other than me, but I do not find anyone to forgive me except You (azj). You (azj) are free of need of my punishment, and I am in need of Your mercy. You (azj) are the destination of every complaint, the witness of every secret conversation, the end of every need, the deliverer from every slip, and the helper of every seeker of help. So I ask You (azj) to send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), And that You (azj) protect me by Your obedience from Your disobedience, And by what You (azj) love from what You (azj) dislike, And by faith from disbelief, And by guidance from misguidance, And by certainty from doubt, And by trustworthiness from betrayal, And by truthfulness from lying, And by right from falsehood, And by piety from sin, And by good from evil, And by remembrance from forgetfulness. O’ Allah (swt), send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), And grant me well-being as long as You (azj) keep me alive, And inspire me to be thankful for what You (azj) have given me, and be merciful to me.” Then, when you have completed the supplication, prostrate and say in prostration: “O’ Allah (swt), send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), and pardon my wrongdoing and my crime through Your forbearance and Your generosity. O’ Lord (azj), O’ Generous One, O’ He (azj) whose supplicant is never disappointed, and whose gifts never run out. O’ He (azj) who is exalted so there is nothing above Him (azj) and O’ He (azj) who is near so there is nothing beneath Him (azj). Send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), and supplicate with whatever you wish.” Then pray two units of prayer, and when you have finished, say: “O’ Support of the one who has no support, O’ Treasure of the one who has no treasure, O’ Reliance of the one who has no reliance, O’ Helper of the one who has no helper, O’ Refuge of the one who has no refuge, O’ Generous in pardon, O’ Excellent in trial, O’ Great in hope, O’ Aid of the weak, O’ Rescuer of the drowning, O’ Deliverer of the doomed, O’ Doer of good, O’ Beautifier, O’ Bestower of blessings, O’ Bountiful Giver. You (azj) are the One before whom the darkness of the night and the light of day and the glow of the moon prostrate. And the rays of the sun, and the sound of the flowing water, and the rustling of the trees. O’ Allah (swt), O’ Allah (swt), O’ Allah (swt), to You (azj) belong the Most Beautiful Names. You (azj) have no partner. O’ Lord (azj), send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), And save us from the Fire by Your pardon, And admit us into Paradise by Your mercy, And marry us to the wide-eyed houris by Your generosity. And send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and family of Muhammad (saws), And act towards me as You (azj) are worthy of, O’ Most Merciful of the merciful. “Indeed, You have power over all things.” (Surah Al-Baqarah 2:109)” Then supplicate with whatever you wish, and then pray two units of prayer. When you have finished, say: “O’ Allah (swt), I ask You (azj) by Your praiseworthy, noble names those which, when they are placed upon things, they become humbled before them, And when good deeds are sought through them, they are attained, And when evil is sought to be averted by them, it is repelled. And I ask You (azj) by Your complete words those of which, ‘If all the trees on earth were pens and the sea, with seven more seas to replenish it, were ink, the words of Allah (swt) would not be exhausted. Indeed, Allah (swt) is Mighty and Wise.’ (Surah Luqman 31:27) O’ Ever-Living, O’ Sustainer, O’ Generous, O’ Most High, O’ Most Great, O’ All-Seeing, O’ Most Seeing of those who see, O’ Most Hearing of those who hear, O’ Swiftest of Reckoners, O’ Wisest of Judges, O’ Most Merciful of the merciful, I ask You (azj) by Your might, And I ask You (azj) by Your power over whatever You (azj) will, And I ask You (azj) by everything Your knowledge encompasses, And I ask You (azj) by every letter You (azj) revealed in a book from among Your books, And by every name through which any of Your angels, messengers, or prophets called upon You (azj), that You (azj) send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws).” Then supplicate with whatever occurs to you, then pray two units of prayer. When you have completed them, say: “Glory be to Him (azj) who honored Muhammad (saws), Allah (swt) bless him and his family. Glory be to Him (azj) who chose Muhammad (saws), Allah (swt) bless him and his family. Glory be to Him (azj) who chose Imam Ali (a.s), peace be upon him. Glory be to Him (azj) who favored Hasan (a.s) and Husayn (a.s), peace be upon them. Glory be to Him (azj) who, through (Sayyida) Fatimah (s.a), peace be upon her, protected from the Fire those who love her. Glory be to Him (azj) who created the heavens and the earth by His (azj) permission. Glory be to Him (azj) who subjected the inhabitants of the heavens and the earth to the authority of Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), peace be upon them. Glory be to Him (azj) who created Paradise for (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family. Glory be to Him (azj) who shall grant it (paradise) to (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) as inheritance, and the family of Muhammad (saws), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, and their followers (Shi‘ah). Glory be to Him (azj) who created the Fire for the enemies of (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family. Glory be to Him (azj) who shall grant Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, and their followers, authority over it. Glory be to Him (azj) who created this world and the Hereafter, and all that dwells in the night and the day, for (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family. And all praise belongs to Allah (swt) as befits Allah (azj). Allah (swt) is the Greatest as befits Allah (azj). There is no God but Allah (swt) as befits Allah (azj). Glory be to Allah (swt) as befits Allah (azj). There is no power and no strength except with Allah (swt), As befits Allah (azj). And may Allah (swt) send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), and upon all the messengers, until Allah (swt) is pleased. O’ Allah (swt), among Your favors upon me which are more than can be counted and among Your blessings upon me which are too immense to be neglected is that my enemy is Your enemy. And I have no patience with Your forbearance (toward them), so hasten their destruction, their ruin, and their annihilation.” Then pray two units of prayer. When you have finished, say: “In the Name of Allah (swt), the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. O’ Allah (swt), Originator of the heavens and the earth, Knower of the unseen and the seen, The Most Gracious, the Most Merciful, Indeed I entrust to You (azj) in this worldly abode that I bear witness; That there is no God but You (azj), alone, with no partner for You (azj), And that (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) is Your servant and Your messenger, And that the religion is as You (azj) have legislated, And Islam is as You (azj) have described, And the Book is as You (azj) have revealed, And the (its) speech is as You (azj) have declared, And that You (azj), You (azj) are You (azj). You are Allah (swt), the True, the Clear. May Allah (swt) reward (Prophet) Muhammad (saws), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, with the best reward, And may Allah (swt) greet Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws) from us with peace.”
arabicText: عَلِيُّ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَحْمَدَ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عَلِيُّ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عُمَارَةَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَلرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ عُمَرَ عَنْهُمْ عَلَيْهِمُ اَلسَّلاَمُ وَاَلدُّعَاءُ اَلْمُتَقَدِّمُ رَوَاهُ بِهَذَا اَلْإِسْنَادِ:« اَللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ حَفِظْتَ اَلْغُلاَمَيْنِ لِصَلاَحِ أَبَوَيْهِمَا وَ دَعَاكَ اَلْمُؤْمِنُونَ فَقَالُوا« رَبَّنٰا لاٰ تَجْعَلْنٰا فِتْنَةً لِلْقَوْمِ اَلظّٰالِمِينَ» اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَنْشُدُكَ بِرَحْمَتِكَ وَأَنْشُدُكَ بِنَبِيِّكَ نَبِيِّ اَلرَّحْمَةِ وَ أَنْشُدُكَ بِعَلِيٍّ وَ فَاطِمَةَ وَ أَنْشُدُكَ بِحَسَنٍ وَ حُسَيْنٍ صَلَوَاتُكَ عَلَيْهِمْ أَجْمَعِينَ وَأَنْشُدُكَ بِأَسْمَائِكَ وَ أَرْكَانِكَ كُلِّهَا وَأَنْشُدُكَ بِاسْمِكَ اَلْأَعْظَمِ اَلْأَعْظَمِ اَلْأَعْظَمِ اَلْعَظِيمِ اَلَّذِي إِذَا دُعِيتَ بِهِ لَمْ تَرُدَّ مَا كَانَ أَقْرَبَ مِنْ طَاعَتِكَ وَ أَبْعَدَ مِنْ مَعْصِيَتِكَ وَ أَوْفَى بِعَهْدِكَ وَ أَقْضَى لِحَقِّكَ وَ أَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ أَنْ تُثَبِّتَ قَلْبِي لَهُ وَ أَنْ تَجْعَلَنِي لَكَ عَبْداً شَاكِراً تَجِدُ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ مَنْ تُعَذِّبُهُ غَيْرِي وَ لاَ أَجِدُ مَنْ يَغْفِرُ لِي إِلاَّ أَنْتَ أَنْتَ غَنِيٌّ عَنْ عَذَابِي وَ أَنَا إِلَى رَحْمَتِكَ فَقِيرٌ أَنْتَ مَوْضِعُ كُلِّ شَكْوَى وَ شَاهِدُ كُلِّ نَجْوَى وَ مُنْتَهَى كُلِّ حَاجَةٍ وَ مُنْجِي مِنْ كُلِّ عَثْرَةٍ وَ غَوْثُ كُلِّ مُسْتَغِيثٍ فَأَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ أَنْ تَعْصِمَنِي بِطَاعَتِكَ عَنْ مَعْصِيَتِكَ وَ بِمَا أَحْبَبْتَ عَمَّا كَرِهْتَ وَ بِالْإِيمَانِ عَنِ اَلْكُفْرِ وَ بِالْهُدَى عَنِ اَلضَّلاَلَةِ وَ بِالْيَقِينِ عَنِ اَلرِّيبَةِ وبالأمانة عن الخيانة وَ بِالصِّدْقِ عَنِ اَلْكَذِبِ وَ بِالْحَقِّ عَنِ اَلْبَاطِلِ وَ بِالتَّقْوَى عَنِ اَلْإِثْمِ وَ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ عَنِ اَلْمُنْكَرِ وَ بِالذُّكْرِ عَنِ اَلنِّسْيَانِ اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَافِنِي مَا أَحْيَيْتَنِي وَأَلْهِمْنِي اَلشُّكْرَ عَلَى مَا أَعْطَيْتَنِي وَكُنْ بِي رَحِيماً فَإِذَا فَرَغْتَ مِنَ اَلدُّعَاءِ فَاسْجُدْ وَ قُلْ فِي سُجُودِكَ اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اُعْفُ عَنْ ظُلْمِي وَ جُرْمِي بِحِلْمِكَ وَ جُودِكَ يَا رَبِّ يَا كَرِيمُ يَا مَنْ لاَ يَخِيبُ سَائِلُهُ وَ لاَ يَنْفَدُ نَائِلُهُ يَا مَنْ عَلاَ فَلاَ شَيْءَ فَوْقَهُ وَ يَا مَنْ دَنَا فَلاَ شَيْءَ دُونَهُ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اُدْعُ بِمَا أَحْبَبْتَ ثُمَّ تُصَلِّي رَكْعَتَيْنِ فَإِذَا فَرَغْتَ فَقُلْ يَا عِمَادَ مَنْ لاَ عِمَادَ لَهُ وَ يَا ذُخْرَ مَنْ لاَ ذُخْرَ لَهُ وَ يَا سَنَدَ مَنْ لاَ سَنَدَ لَهُ وَ يَا غِيَاثَ مَنْ لاَ غِيَاثَ لَهُ وَ يَا حِرْزَ مَنْ لاَ حِرْزَلَهُ يَا كَرِيمَ اَلْعَفْوِ يَا حَسَنَ اَلْبَلاَءِ يَا عَظِيمَ اَلرَّجَاءِ يَا عَوْنَ اَلضُّعَفَاءِ يَا مُنْقِذَ اَلْغَرْقَى يَا مُنْجِيَ اَلْهَلْكَى يَا مُحْسِنُ يَا مُجْمِلُ يَا مُنْعِمُ يَا مُفْضِلُ أَنْتَ اَلَّذِي سَجَدَ لَكَ سَوَادُ اَللَّيْلِ وَ نُورُ اَلنَّهَارِ وَ ضَوْءُ اَلْقَمَرِ وَ شُعَاعُ اَلشَّمْسِ وَ خَرِيرُ اَلْمَاءِ وَ حَفِيفُ اَلشَّجَرِ يَا اَللَّهُ يَا اَللَّهُ يَا اَللَّهُ لَكَ اَلْأَسْمَاءُ اَلْحُسْنَى لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ يَا رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ نَجِّنَا مِنَ اَلنَّارِ بِعَفْوِكَ وَأَدْخِلْنَا اَلْجَنَّةَ بِرَحْمَتِكَ وَزَوِّجْنَا مِنَ اَلْحُورِ اَلْعِينِ بِجُودِكَ وَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَاِفْعَلْ بِي مَا أَنْتَ أَهْلُهُ يَا أَرْحَمَ اَلرَّاحِمِينَ« إِنَّكَ عَلىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ» وَ اُدْعُ بِمَا أَحْبَبْتَ ثُمَّ تُصَلِّي رَكْعَتَيْنِ فَإِذَا فَرَغْتَ فَقُلِ اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِأَسْمَائِكَ اَلْحَمِيدَةِ اَلْكَرِيمَةِ اَلَّتِي إِذَا وُضِعَتْ عَلَى اَلْأَشْيَاءِ ذَلَّتْ لَهَا وَ إِذَا طُلِبَتْ بِهَا اَلْحَسَنَاتُ أُدْرِكَتْ وَ إِذَا أُرِيدَ بِهَا صَرْفُ اَلسَّيِّئَاتِ صُرِفَتْ وَ أَسْأَلُكَ بِكَلِمَاتِكَ اَلتَّامَّاتِ اَلَّتِي« لَوْ أَنَّ مٰا فِي اَلْأَرْضِ مِنْ شَجَرَةٍ أَقْلاٰمٌ وَ اَلْبَحْرُ يَمُدُّهُ مِنْ بَعْدِهِ سَبْعَةُ أَبْحُرٍ مٰا نَفِدَتْ كَلِمٰاتُ اَللّٰهِ إِنَّ اَللّٰهَ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌ» يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ يَا كَرِيمُ يَا عَلِيُّ يَا عَظِيمُ يَا بَصِيرُ يَا أَبْصَرَ اَلنَّاظِرِينَ وَ يَا أَسْمَعَ اَلسَّامِعِينَ وَ يَا أَسْرَعَ اَلْحَاسِبِينَ وَ يَا أَحْكَمَ اَلْحَاكِمِينَ وَ يَا أَرْحَمَ اَلرَّاحِمِينَ أَسْأَلُكَ بِعِزَّتِكَ وَ أَسْأَلُكَ بِقُدْرَتِكَ عَلَى مَا تَشَاءُ وَ أَسْأَلُكَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ أَحَاطَ بِهِ عِلْمُكَ وَ أَسْأَلُكَ بِكُلِّ حَرْفٍ أَنْزَلْتَهُ فِي كِتَابٍ مِنْ كُتُبِكَ وَ بِكُلِّ اِسْمٍ دَعَاكَ بِهِ أَحَدٌ مِنْ مَلاَئِكَتِكَ وَ رُسُلِكَ وَ أَنْبِيَائِكَ أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اُدْعُ بِمَا بَدَا لَكَ ثُمَّ تُصَلِّي رَكْعَتَيْنِ فَإِذَا فَرَغْتَ فَقُلْ سُبْحَانَ مَنْ أَكْرَمَ مُحَمَّداً صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ سُبْحَانَ مَنِ اِنْتَجَبَ مُحَمَّداً صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ سُبْحَانَ مَنِ اِنْتَجَبَ عَلِيّاً عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ سُبْحَانَ مَنْ خَصَّ اَلْحَسَنَ وَ اَلْحُسَيْنَ عَلَيْهِمَا اَلسَّلاَمُ سُبْحَانَ مَنْ فَطَمَ بِفَاطِمَةَ عَلَيْهَا اَلسَّلاَمُ مَنْ أَحَبَّهَا مِنَ اَلنَّارِ سُبْحَانَ مَنْ خَلَقَ اَلسَّمَاوَاتِ وَ اَلْأَرْضَ بِإِذْنِهِ سُبْحَانَ مَنِ اِسْتَعْبَدَ أَهْلَ اَلسَّمَاوَاتِ وَ اَلْأَرَضِينَ بِوَلاَيَةِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ سُبْحَانَ مَنْ خَلَقَ اَلْجَنَّةَ لِمُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ سُبْحَانَ مَنْ يُورِثُهَا مُحَمَّداً وَ آلَ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ وَ شِيعَتَهُمْ سُبْحَانَ مَنْ خَلَقَ اَلنَّارَ مِنْ أَجْلِ أَعْدَاءِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ سُبْحَانَ مَنْ يُمَلِّكُهَا مُحَمَّداً وَآلَ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ وَ شِيعَتَهُمْ سُبْحَانَ مَنْ خَلَقَ اَلدُّنْيَا وَاَلْآخِرَةَ وَمَا سَكَنَ فِي اَللَّيْلِ وَاَلنَّهَارِ لِمُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ وَ اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ كَمَا يَنْبَغِي لِلَّهِ اَللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ كَمَا يَنْبَغِي لِلَّهِ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اَللَّهُ كَمَا يَنْبَغِي لِلَّهِ سُبْحَانَ اَللَّهِ كَمَا يَنْبَغِي لِلَّهِ لاَ حَوْلَ وَ لاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ كَمَا يَنْبَغِي لِلَّهِ وَ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ عَلَى جَمِيعِ اَلْمُرْسَلِينَ حَتَّى يَرْضَى اَللَّهُ اَللَّهُمَّ مِنْ أَيَادِيكَ عَلَيَّ وَ هِيَ أَكْثَرُ مِنْ أَنْ تُحْصَى وَ مِنْ نِعَمِكَ عَلَيَّ وَ هِيَ أَجَلُّ مِنْ أَنْ تُغَادَرَ أَنْ يَكُونَ عَدُوِّي عَدُوَّكَ وَ لاَ صَبْرَ لِي عَلَى أَنَاتِكَ فَعَجِّلْ هَلاَكَهُمْ وَ بَوَارَهُمْ وَ دَمَارَهُمْ ثُمَّ تُصَلِّي رَكْعَتَيْنِ فَإِذَا فَرَغْتَ فَقُلْ« بِسْمِ اَللّٰهِ اَلرَّحْمٰنِ اَلرَّحِيمِ»« اَللّٰهُمَّ فٰاطِرَ اَلسَّمٰاوٰاتِ وَ اَلْأَرْضِ عٰالِمَ اَلْغَيْبِ وَ اَلشَّهٰادَةِ» اَلرَّحْمَنَ اَلرَّحِيمَ إِنِّي أَعْهَدُ إِلَيْكَ فِي دَارِ اَلدُّنْيَا' أَنِّي أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ وَحْدَكَ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ وَ أَنَّ مُحَمَّداً عَبْدُكَ وَ رَسُولُكَ وَ أَنَّ اَلدِّينَ كَمَا شَرَعْتَ وَ اَلْإِسْلاَمَ كَمَا وَصَفْتَ وَاَلْكِتَابَ كَمَا أَنْزَلْتَ وَ اَلْقَوْلَ كَمَا حَدَّثْتَ وَ أَنَّكَ أَنْتَ أَنْتَ أَنْتَ اَللَّهُ اَلْحَقُّ اَلْمُبِينُ جَزَى اَللَّهُ مُحَمَّداً صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ خَيْرَ اَلْجَزَاءِ وَ حَيَّا اَللَّهُ مُحَمَّداً وَ آلَ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنَّا بِالسَّلاَمِ»
thaqalaynSanad: Ali ibn Hatim, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad, said: He narrated to me, Ali ibn Ishaq ibn Umarah, from Abd al-Rahman, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Ibrahim ibn Umar, from the (Imams (a.s)), peace be upon them. And the earlier supplication was narrated with this chain of transmission:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: “O’ Allah (swt), indeed You (azj) preserved the two young boys due to the righteousness of their parents (meaning the story in Surah Al-Kahf). And the believers supplicated to You (azj) and said: ‘Our Lord, do not make us a trial for the wrongdoing people.’ (Surah Yunus 10:85–86) O’ Allah (swt), I implore You (azj) by Your mercy, And I implore You (azj) by Your Prophet (saws), the Prophet of mercy, And I implore You (azj) by Ali (a.s) and Fatimah (s.a), And I implore You (azj) by Hasan (a.s) and Husayn (a.s), Your blessings be upon them all. And I implore You (azj) by Your names and all of Your pillars, And I implore You (azj) by Your Greatest Name, the Greatest, the Greatest, the Most Great, by which if You (azj) are called upon, You (azj) do not reject that which is closest to Your obedience and farthest from Your disobedience, and most fulfilling of Your covenant, and most decisive in executing Your right. And I ask You (azj) to send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), and to make my heart firm for Him (saws), and to make me a grateful servant to You (azj). You (azj) will find among Your creation one whom You (azj) punish other than me, but I do not find anyone to forgive me except You (azj). You (azj) are free of need of my punishment, and I am in need of Your mercy. You (azj) are the destination of every complaint, the witness of every secret conversation, the end of every need, the deliverer from every slip, and the helper of every seeker of help. So I ask You (azj) to send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), And that You (azj) protect me by Your obedience from Your disobedience, And by what You (azj) love from what You (azj) dislike, And by faith from disbelief, And by guidance from misguidance, And by certainty from doubt, And by trustworthiness from betrayal, And by truthfulness from lying, And by right from falsehood, And by piety from sin, And by good from evil, And by remembrance from forgetfulness. O’ Allah (swt), send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), And grant me well-being as long as You (azj) keep me alive, And inspire me to be thankful for what You (azj) have given me, and be merciful to me.” Then, when you have completed the supplication, prostrate and say in prostration: “O’ Allah (swt), send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), and pardon my wrongdoing and my crime through Your forbearance and Your generosity. O’ Lord (azj), O’ Generous One, O’ He (azj) whose supplicant is never disappointed, and whose gifts never run out. O’ He (azj) who is exalted so there is nothing above Him (azj) and O’ He (azj) who is near so there is nothing beneath Him (azj). Send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), and supplicate with whatever you wish.” Then pray two units of prayer, and when you have finished, say: “O’ Support of the one who has no support, O’ Treasure of the one who has no treasure, O’ Reliance of the one who has no reliance, O’ Helper of the one who has no helper, O’ Refuge of the one who has no refuge, O’ Generous in pardon, O’ Excellent in trial, O’ Great in hope, O’ Aid of the weak, O’ Rescuer of the drowning, O’ Deliverer of the doomed, O’ Doer of good, O’ Beautifier, O’ Bestower of blessings, O’ Bountiful Giver. You (azj) are the One before whom the darkness of the night and the light of day and the glow of the moon prostrate. And the rays of the sun, and the sound of the flowing water, and the rustling of the trees. O’ Allah (swt), O’ Allah (swt), O’ Allah (swt), to You (azj) belong the Most Beautiful Names. You (azj) have no partner. O’ Lord (azj), send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), And save us from the Fire by Your pardon, And admit us into Paradise by Your mercy, And marry us to the wide-eyed houris by Your generosity. And send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and family of Muhammad (saws), And act towards me as You (azj) are worthy of, O’ Most Merciful of the merciful. “Indeed, You have power over all things.” (Surah Al-Baqarah 2:109)” Then supplicate with whatever you wish, and then pray two units of prayer. When you have finished, say: “O’ Allah (swt), I ask You (azj) by Your praiseworthy, noble names those which, when they are placed upon things, they become humbled before them, And when good deeds are sought through them, they are attained, And when evil is sought to be averted by them, it is repelled. And I ask You (azj) by Your complete words those of which, ‘If all the trees on earth were pens and the sea, with seven more seas to replenish it, were ink, the words of Allah (swt) would not be exhausted. Indeed, Allah (swt) is Mighty and Wise.’ (Surah Luqman 31:27) O’ Ever-Living, O’ Sustainer, O’ Generous, O’ Most High, O’ Most Great, O’ All-Seeing, O’ Most Seeing of those who see, O’ Most Hearing of those who hear, O’ Swiftest of Reckoners, O’ Wisest of Judges, O’ Most Merciful of the merciful, I ask You (azj) by Your might, And I ask You (azj) by Your power over whatever You (azj) will, And I ask You (azj) by everything Your knowledge encompasses, And I ask You (azj) by every letter You (azj) revealed in a book from among Your books, And by every name through which any of Your angels, messengers, or prophets called upon You (azj), that You (azj) send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws).” Then supplicate with whatever occurs to you, then pray two units of prayer. When you have completed them, say: “Glory be to Him (azj) who honored Muhammad (saws), Allah (swt) bless him and his family. Glory be to Him (azj) who chose Muhammad (saws), Allah (swt) bless him and his family. Glory be to Him (azj) who chose Imam Ali (a.s), peace be upon him. Glory be to Him (azj) who favored Hasan (a.s) and Husayn (a.s), peace be upon them. Glory be to Him (azj) who, through (Sayyida) Fatimah (s.a), peace be upon her, protected from the Fire those who love her. Glory be to Him (azj) who created the heavens and the earth by His (azj) permission. Glory be to Him (azj) who subjected the inhabitants of the heavens and the earth to the authority of Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), peace be upon them. Glory be to Him (azj) who created Paradise for (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family. Glory be to Him (azj) who shall grant it (paradise) to (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) as inheritance, and the family of Muhammad (saws), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, and their followers (Shi‘ah). Glory be to Him (azj) who created the Fire for the enemies of (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family. Glory be to Him (azj) who shall grant Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, and their followers, authority over it. Glory be to Him (azj) who created this world and the Hereafter, and all that dwells in the night and the day, for (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family. And all praise belongs to Allah (swt) as befits Allah (azj). Allah (swt) is the Greatest as befits Allah (azj). There is no God but Allah (swt) as befits Allah (azj). Glory be to Allah (swt) as befits Allah (azj). There is no power and no strength except with Allah (swt), As befits Allah (azj). And may Allah (swt) send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), and upon all the messengers, until Allah (swt) is pleased. O’ Allah (swt), among Your favors upon me which are more than can be counted and among Your blessings upon me which are too immense to be neglected is that my enemy is Your enemy. And I have no patience with Your forbearance (toward them), so hasten their destruction, their ruin, and their annihilation.” Then pray two units of prayer. When you have finished, say: “In the Name of Allah (swt), the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. O’ Allah (swt), Originator of the heavens and the earth, Knower of the unseen and the seen, The Most Gracious, the Most Merciful, Indeed I entrust to You (azj) in this worldly abode that I bear witness; That there is no God but You (azj), alone, with no partner for You (azj), And that (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) is Your servant and Your messenger, And that the religion is as You (azj) have legislated, And Islam is as You (azj) have described, And the Book is as You (azj) have revealed, And the (its) speech is as You (azj) have declared, And that You (azj), You (azj) are You (azj). You are Allah (swt), the True, the Clear. May Allah (swt) reward (Prophet) Muhammad (saws), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, with the best reward, And may Allah (swt) greet Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws) from us with peace.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 104

chapter: Chapter on Supplication Between the Units of Prayer (Rak‘at)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ali ibn Hatim, from Muhammad ibn Abi Abdillah, from Sa’ad ibn Abdillah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Abd al-Malik al-Qummi, from his brother Idris ibn Abdillah, who said:
I heard Aba Abdillah (a.s), say: “When you finish the prayer, then say this supplication: ‘O’ Allah (swt), I submit to You (azj) through obedience to You (azj), And through allegiance to You (azj), And through allegiance to Your Messenger, And the allegiance to the Imams (a.s), peace be upon them, from the first of them to the last of them.’” (And name the Imams (a.s), peace be upon them) (Imam (a.s) then continued) “Then say: ‘Ameen’. I submit to You through obedience to them. And (I submit to You (azj) through) their allegiance, And acceptance of what You (azj) have favored them with, without denial and without arrogance toward the meaning of what You (azj) revealed in Your Book, according to the boundaries of what has come to us concerning it and what has not come to us. I am a believer, acknowledging that before You (azj), submitting, And content with what You (azj) have been pleased with, O’ Lord (azj). I seek through it Your countenance and the Abode of the Hereafter, in fear and in hope toward You (azj). So keep me alive upon it as long as You (azj) give me life, And cause me to die upon it when You (azj) cause me to die, And resurrect me upon it when You (azj) resurrect me. And if there has been from me any shortcoming in what has passed, then I repent to You (azj) from it, and I turn eagerly to what is with You (azj). And I ask You (azj) to protect me from disobeying You (azj), And not to leave me to myself for the blink of an eye ever as long as You (azj) keep me alive, not for less than that and not for more. “Indeed, the soul is ever-inclined to evil,” (Surah Yusuf 12:53) except for whom You (azj) have mercy, O’ Most Merciful of the merciful. And I ask You (azj) to protect me through Your obedience until You (azj) cause me to die upon it while You (azj) are pleased with me, And that You (azj) seal (my life) for me with happiness, And never turn me away from it ever. And there is no power except through You (azj).” Then supplicate with whatever you wish. When you finish the supplication, go into prostration and say in your prostration: “My worn-out, bleak face has prostrated before Your everlasting, magnificent Face. My humbled face has prostrated before Your Mighty Face. My needy face has prostrated before Your Rich, Generous Face. My Lord (azj), Indeed, I seek Your forgiveness for what has passed, And I seek Your forgiveness for what is to come. My Lord (azj), do not make my trials overwhelming. My Lord (azj), do not make Your decree concerning me evil. My Lord (azj), do not make my enemies rejoice over me. My Lord (azj), there is no repeller and no preventer except You (azj). My Lord (azj), send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws) with the best of Your blessings, and bless (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws) with the finest of Your blessings. O’ Allah (swt), I seek refuge in You (azj) from Your overwhelming might, And I seek refuge in You (azj) from Your punishments, And I seek refuge in You (azj) from all of Your wrath and displeasure. Glory be to You (azj). You (azj) are Allah (swt), the Lord of the worlds.”
arabicText: عَلِيُّ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَلْمَلِكِ اَلْقُمِّيِّ عَنْ أَخِيهِ إِدْرِيسَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ يَقُولُ:« إِذَا فَرَغْتَ مِنْ صَلاَةٍ فَقُلْ هَذَا اَلدُّعَاءَ اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَدِينُكَ بِطَاعَتِكَ وَ وَلاَيَتِكَ وَ وَلاَيَةِ رَسُولِكَ وَ وَلاَيَةِ اَلْأَئِمَّةِ عَلَيْهِمُ اَلسَّلاَمُ مِنْ أَوَّلِهِمْ إِلَى آخِرِهِمْ وَ سَمِّهِمْ عَلَيْهِمُ اَلسَّلاَمُ ثُمَّ قُلْ آمِينَ أَدِينُكَ بِطَاعَتِهِمْ وَ وِلاَيَتِهِمْ وَ اَلرِّضَا بِمَا فَضَّلْتَهُمْ بِهِ غَيْرَ مُنْكِرٍ وَ لاَ مُسْتَكْبِرٍ عَلَى مَعْنَى مَا أَنْزَلْتَ فِي كِتَابِكَ عَلَى حُدُودِ مَا أَتَانَا فِيهِ وَ مَا لَمْ يَأْتِنَا مُؤْمِنٌ مُقِرٌّ لَكَ بِذَلِكَ مُسَلِّمٌ رَاضٍ بِمَا رَضِيتَ بِهِ يَا رَبِّ أُرِيدُ بِهِ وَجْهَكَ وَ اَلدَّارَ اَلْآخِرَةَ مَرْهُوباً مَرْغُوباً إِلَيْكَ فَأَحْيِنِي مَا أَحْيَيْتَنِي عَلَيْهِ وَ أَمِتْنِي إِذَا أَمَتَّنِي عَلَيْهِ وَ اِبْعَثْنِي إِذَا بَعَثْتَنِي عَلَى ذَلِكَ وَ إِنْ كَانَ مِنِّي تَقْصِيرٌ فِيمَا مَضَى فَإِنِّي أَتُوبُ إِلَيْكَ مِنْهُ وَ أَرْغَبُ إِلَيْكَ فِيمَا عِنْدَكَ وَأَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تَعْصِمَنِي مِنْ مَعَاصِيكَ وَلاَ تَكِلَنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ أَبَداً مَا أَحْيَيْتَنِي لاَ أَقَلَّ مِنْ ذَلِكَ وَلاَ أَكْثَرَ« إِنَّ اَلنَّفْسَ لَأَمّٰارَةٌ بِالسُّوءِ» إِلاَّ مَا رَحِمْتَ يَا أَرْحَمَ اَلرَّاحِمِينَ وَأَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تَعْصِمَنِي بِطَاعَتِكَ حَتَّى تَوَفَّانِي عَلَيْهَا وَ أَنْتَ عَنِّي رَاضٍ وَ أَنْ تَخْتِمَ لِي بِالسَّعَادَةِ وَ لاَ تُحَوِّلَنِي عَنْهَا أَبَداً وَ لاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِكَ ثُمَّ تَدْعُو بِمَا أَحْبَبْتَ فَإِذَا فَرَغْتَ مِنَ اَلدُّعَاءِ فَاسْجُدْ وَ قُلْ فِي سُجُودِكَ سَجَدَ وَجْهِيَ اَلْبَالِي اَلْفَانِي لِوَجْهِكَ اَلدَّائِمِ اَلْعَظِيمِ سَجَدَ وَجْهِيَ اَلذَّلِيلُ لِوَجْهِكَ اَلْعَزِيزِ سَجَدَ وَجْهِيَ اَلْفَقِيرُ لِوَجْهِكَ اَلْغَنِيِّ اَلْكَرِيمِ رَبِّ إِنِّي أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ مِمَّا كَانَ وَأَسْتَغْفِرُكَ مِمَّا يَكُونُ رَبِّ لاَ تُجْهِدْ بَلاَئِي رَبِّ لاَ تُسِئْ قَضَائِي رَبِّ لاَ تُشْمِتْ بِي أَعْدَائِي رَبِّ إِنَّهُ لاَ دَافِعَ وَ لاَ مَانِعَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ بِأَفْضَلِ صَلَوَاتِكَ وَ بَارِكْ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ بِأَفْضَلِ بَرَكَاتِكَ اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ سَطَوَاتِكَ وَ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ نَقِمَاتِكَ وَ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ جَمِيعِ غَضَبِكَ وَ سَخَطِكَ سُبْحَانَكَ أَنْتَ اَللَّهُ رَبُّ اَلْعَالَمِينَ»
thaqalaynSanad: Ali ibn Hatim, from Muhammad ibn Abi Abdillah, from Sa’ad ibn Abdillah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Abd al-Malik al-Qummi, from his brother Idris ibn Abdillah, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I heard Aba Abdillah (a.s), say: “When you finish the prayer, then say this supplication: ‘O’ Allah (swt), I submit to You (azj) through obedience to You (azj), And through allegiance to You (azj), And through allegiance to Your Messenger, And the allegiance to the Imams (a.s), peace be upon them, from the first of them to the last of them.’” (And name the Imams (a.s), peace be upon them) (Imam (a.s) then continued) “Then say: ‘Ameen’. I submit to You through obedience to them. And (I submit to You (azj) through) their allegiance, And acceptance of what You (azj) have favored them with, without denial and without arrogance toward the meaning of what You (azj) revealed in Your Book, according to the boundaries of what has come to us concerning it and what has not come to us. I am a believer, acknowledging that before You (azj), submitting, And content with what You (azj) have been pleased with, O’ Lord (azj). I seek through it Your countenance and the Abode of the Hereafter, in fear and in hope toward You (azj). So keep me alive upon it as long as You (azj) give me life, And cause me to die upon it when You (azj) cause me to die, And resurrect me upon it when You (azj) resurrect me. And if there has been from me any shortcoming in what has passed, then I repent to You (azj) from it, and I turn eagerly to what is with You (azj). And I ask You (azj) to protect me from disobeying You (azj), And not to leave me to myself for the blink of an eye ever as long as You (azj) keep me alive, not for less than that and not for more. “Indeed, the soul is ever-inclined to evil,” (Surah Yusuf 12:53) except for whom You (azj) have mercy, O’ Most Merciful of the merciful. And I ask You (azj) to protect me through Your obedience until You (azj) cause me to die upon it while You (azj) are pleased with me, And that You (azj) seal (my life) for me with happiness, And never turn me away from it ever. And there is no power except through You (azj).” Then supplicate with whatever you wish. When you finish the supplication, go into prostration and say in your prostration: “My worn-out, bleak face has prostrated before Your everlasting, magnificent Face. My humbled face has prostrated before Your Mighty Face. My needy face has prostrated before Your Rich, Generous Face. My Lord (azj), Indeed, I seek Your forgiveness for what has passed, And I seek Your forgiveness for what is to come. My Lord (azj), do not make my trials overwhelming. My Lord (azj), do not make Your decree concerning me evil. My Lord (azj), do not make my enemies rejoice over me. My Lord (azj), there is no repeller and no preventer except You (azj). My Lord (azj), send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws) with the best of Your blessings, and bless (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws) with the finest of Your blessings. O’ Allah (swt), I seek refuge in You (azj) from Your overwhelming might, And I seek refuge in You (azj) from Your punishments, And I seek refuge in You (azj) from all of Your wrath and displeasure. Glory be to You (azj). You (azj) are Allah (swt), the Lord of the worlds.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 107

chapter: Chapter on Supplication Between the Units of Prayer (Rak‘at)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ali ibn Hatim, from Ali ibn Sulayman, from Ahmad ibn Ishaq, from Sa’adan, from Murazim, from a man, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “When you raise your head from prostration, begin with supplication and the recitation of ‘Indeed, We sent it down on the Night of Qadr’ (Surah Al-Qadr) and other recitations that are recommended to be read. If it is not possible for you to supplicate between every two units of prayer, then supplicate during the sets of ten (rak‘at). And when it is the night of the twenty-third, then recite ‘Indeed, We sent it down on the Night of Qadr’ (Surah Al-Qadr) a thousand times, and recite Surah al-Ankabut and Surah al-Rum once each.”
arabicText: عَلِيُّ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ سُلَيْمَانَ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ سَعْدَانَ عَنْ مُرَازِمٍ عَنْ رَجُلٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ:« فَإِذَا رَفَعْتَ رَأْسَكَ مِنَ اَلسُّجُودِ فَخُذْ فِي اَلدُّعَاءِ وَقِرَاءَةِ« إِنّٰا أَنْزَلْنٰاهُ فِي لَيْلَةِ اَلْقَدْرِ» وَغَيْرِهِ مِمَّا يُسْتَحَبُّ أَنْ يُقْرَأَ فَإِنْ لَمْ يَتَهَيَّأْ لَكَ أَنْ تَدْعُوَ بَيْنَ كُلِّ رَكْعَتَيْنِ فَادْعُ فِي اَلْعَشَرَاتِ فَإِذَا كَانَتْ لَيْلَةُ ثَلاَثٍ وَ عِشْرِينَ فَاقْرَأْ« إِنّٰا أَنْزَلْنٰاهُ فِي لَيْلَةِ اَلْقَدْرِ» أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ وَ اِقْرَأْ سُورَةَ اَلْعَنْكَبُوتِ وَ اَلرُّومِ مَرَّةً وَاحِدَةً»
thaqalaynSanad: Ali ibn Hatim, from Ali ibn Sulayman, from Ahmad ibn Ishaq, from Sa’adan, from Murazim, from a man, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “When you raise your head from prostration, begin with supplication and the recitation of ‘Indeed, We sent it down on the Night of Qadr’ (Surah Al-Qadr) and other recitations that are recommended to be read. If it is not possible for you to supplicate between every two units of prayer, then supplicate during the sets of ten (rak‘at). And when it is the night of the twenty-third, then recite ‘Indeed, We sent it down on the Night of Qadr’ (Surah Al-Qadr) a thousand times, and recite Surah al-Ankabut and Surah al-Rum once each.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 108

chapter: Chapter on Supplication Between the Units of Prayer (Rak‘at)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ali ibn Hatim, from Muhammad ibn Ja’far, who said: Muhammad ibn Ahmad narrated to me, from Muhammad ibn Hassan, from Isma’il ibn Mihran, from al-Hasan ibn ‘Ali, from his father, from Abu Basir, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “Whoever recites the two Surahs; ‘al-Ankabut’ and ‘al-Rum’ during the Month of Ramadan on the night of the twenty-third. By Allah (swt), O’ Aba Muhammad, (such person) he is among the people of Paradise. I do not make any exception in this at all, nor do I fear Allah (swt) will record a sin upon me for this statement. Indeed, these Surahs have a special status with Allah (swt).”
arabicText: عَلِيُّ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ حَسَّانَ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ مِهْرَانَ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« مَنْ قَرَأَ سُورَتَيِ اَلْعَنْكَبُوتِ وَ اَلرُّومِ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ فِي لَيْلَةِ ثَلاَثٍ وَ عِشْرِينَ فَهُوَ وَ اَللَّهِ يَا أَبَا مُحَمَّدٍ مِنْ أَهْلِ اَلْجَنَّةِ لاَ أَسْتَثْنِي فِيهِ أَبَداً وَ لاَ أَخَافُ أَنْ يَكْتُبَ اَللَّهُ عَلَيَّ فِي يَمِينِي إِثْماً وَ إِنَّ لِهَاتَيْنِ اَلسُّورَتَيْنِ مِنَ اَللَّهِ مَكَاناً»
thaqalaynSanad: Ali ibn Hatim, from Muhammad ibn Ja’far, who said: Muhammad ibn Ahmad narrated to me, from Muhammad ibn Hassan, from Isma’il ibn Mihran, from al-Hasan ibn ‘Ali, from his father, from Abu Basir, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “Whoever recites the two Surahs; ‘al-Ankabut’ and ‘al-Rum’ during the Month of Ramadan on the night of the twenty-third. By Allah (swt), O’ Aba Muhammad, (such person) he is among the people of Paradise. I do not make any exception in this at all, nor do I fear Allah (swt) will record a sin upon me for this statement. Indeed, these Surahs have a special status with Allah (swt).”

chapter: Chapter on Supplication Between the Units of Prayer (Rak‘at)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And it has been narrated from Abu Yahya al-San‘ani, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, that he said:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “If a man were to recite on the night of the twenty-third of the Month of Ramadan ‘Indeed, We sent it down on the Night of Qadr’ (Surah Al Qadr) a thousand times, by morning he would be firm in certainty regarding the acknowledgment of that which pertains specifically to us (Ahlulbayt (a.s)). And that would be only due to something he witnessed in his sleep.”
arabicText: وَ رُوِيَ عَنْ أَبِي يَحْيَى اَلصَّنْعَانِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ:« لَوْ قَرَأَ رَجُلٌ لَيْلَةَ ثَلاَثٍ وَ عِشْرِينَ مِنْ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ« إِنّٰا أَنْزَلْنٰاهُ فِي لَيْلَةِ اَلْقَدْرِ» أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ لَأَ صْبَحَ وَ هُوَ شَدِيدُ اَلْيَقِينِ بِالاِعْتِرَافِ بِمَا يَخُصُّ بِهِ فِينَا وَ مَا ذَاكَ إِلاَّ لِشَيْءٍ عَايَنَهُ فِي نَوْمِهِ»
thaqalaynSanad: And it has been narrated from Abu Yahya al-San‘ani, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, that he said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “If a man were to recite on the night of the twenty-third of the Month of Ramadan ‘Indeed, We sent it down on the Night of Qadr’ (Surah Al Qadr) a thousand times, by morning he would be firm in certainty regarding the acknowledgment of that which pertains specifically to us (Ahlulbayt (a.s)). And that would be only due to something he witnessed in his sleep.”
