chapter: Chapter on Supplication Between the Units of Prayer (Rak‘at)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ya‘qub narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn al-Hasan, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ayyub ibn Yaqtin or someone else from them (Imams (a.s)), peace be upon them:
The supplication of the last ten nights (Month of Ramadan). The supplication of the First night of the Month of Ramadan: “O’ One (azj) who causes the night to enter into the day, and causes the day to enter into the night, and brings forth the living from the dead, and brings forth the dead from the living, O’ Provider of ‘whom He wills without reckoning’, (Surah Az-Zumar 39:52) O’ Allah (swt), O’ Merciful, O’ Allah (swt), O’ Compassionate, O’ Allah (swt), O’ Allah (swt), O’ Allah (swt), to You (azj) belong the Most Beautiful Names, and the Highest Examples, and Majesty, and Blessings. I ask You (azj) to send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and upon his household, and that You (azj) place my name on this night among the fortunate ones, and my soul among the martyrs, and my good deeds in the highest of the high (Illiyyin), and my misdeeds forgiven. And that You (azj) bestow upon me certainty which directly reaches my heart, and faith that removes doubt from me, and that You (azj) make me content with what You (azj) have allotted for me. And (that You (azj) grant me what You (azj) promised in Your words): “Give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the punishment of the burning Fire.” (Surah Al-Baqarah 2:201) And grant me in it remembrance of You (azj), gratitude to You (azj), longing toward You (azj), turning back to You (azj), and success in that which You (azj) granted success to (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), peace be upon them. The supplication of the Second night of the Month of Ramadan: “O’ You (azj) who draws out the day from the night, then suddenly we are in darkness, and who causes the sun to flow ‘in its fixed course,’ (Surah Ya Sin 36:38) by Your decree, O’ Mighty, O’ Knowing; and (You (azj) are) the One who determined for the moon “phases until it returns like the old, dried palm stalk,” (Surah Ya Sin 36:39) O’ Light of every light, and the ultimate object of every desire, and the Possessor of every blessing, O’ Allah (swt), O’ Merciful, O’ Allah (swt), O’ Holy, O’ Allah (swt), O’ One, O’ Unique, O’ Solitary, O’ Allah (swt), O’ Allah (swt), O’ Allah (swt), to You (azj) belong the Most Beautiful Names, the Highest Examples, and Majesty.” Then return to the first supplication at the words: ‘And I ask You to send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws),’ to the end of the supplication. The supplication of the Third night of the Month of Ramadan: O’ Lord (azj) of the Night of Qadr, and the One who made it better “than a thousand months,” (Surah Al-Qadr 97:3) and Lord (azj) of the night and the day, the mountains and the seas, the darknesses and the lights, the earth and the sky, O’ Creator, O’ Fashioner, O’ Most Compassionate, O’ Most Generous Bestower, O’ Allah (swt), O’ Merciful, O’ Allah (swt), O’ Self-Subsisting, O’ Allah (swt), O Originator of the heavens and the earth, O’ Allah (swt), O’ Allah (swt), O’ Allah (swt), to You (azj) belong the Most Beautiful Names, the Highest Examples, the Blessings, and the Majesty. I ask You (azj) to send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), and to place my name on this night among the fortunate, and my soul among the martyrs and my good deeds in the highest ranks (Illiyyin), and my misdeeds forgiven, and that You (azj) bestow upon me certainty that directly reaches my heart, and faith that removes doubt from me, and that You (azj) make me content with what You (azj) have allotted for me, and (grant me) “good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the punishment of the burning Fire,” (Surah Al-Baqarah 2:201) and grant me in it remembrance of You (azj), gratitude to You (azj), longing toward You (azj), returning to You (azj), repentance, and success in what You (azj) granted success to (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), peace be upon them.
arabicText: رَوَى مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ اَلْحَسَنِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ أَيُّوبَ بْنِ يَقْطِينٍ أَوْ غَيْرِهِ عَنْهُمْ عَلَيْهِمُ اَلسَّلاَمُ: دُعَاءَ اَلْعَشْرِ اَلْأَوَاخِرِ تَقُولُ فِي اَللَّيْلَةِ اَلْأُولَى يَا مُولِجَ اَللَّيْلِ فِي اَلنَّهَارِ وَ مُولِجَ اَلنَّهَارِ فِي اَللَّيْلِ وَ مُخْرِجَ اَلْحَيِّ مِنَ اَلْمَيِّتِ وَ مُخْرِجَ اَلْمَيِّتِ مِنَ اَلْحَيِّ يَا رَازِقَ «مَنْ يَشٰاءُ بِغَيْرِ حِسٰابٍ» يَا اَللَّهُ يَا رَحْمَانُ يَا اَللَّهُ يَا رَحِيمُ يَا اَللَّهُ يَا اَللَّهُ يَا اَللَّهُ لَكَ اَلْأَسْمَاءُ اَلْحُسْنَى وَ اَلْأَمْثَالُ اَلْعُلْيَا وَ اَلْكِبْرِيَاءُ وَ اَلْآلاَءُ أَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ عَلَى أَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ وَ أَنْ تَجْعَلَ اِسْمِي فِي هَذِهِ اَللَّيْلَةِ فِي اَلسُّعَدَاءِ وَ رُوحِي مَعَ اَلشُّهَدَاءِ وَ إِحْسَانِي فِي عِلِّيِّينَ وَ إِسَاءَتِي مَغْفُورَةً وَ أَنْ تَهَبَ لِي يَقِيناً تُبَاشِرُ بِهِ قَلْبِي وَ إِيمَاناً يُذْهِبُ اَلشَّكَّ عَنِّي وَ تُرْضِيَنِي بِمَا قَسَمْتَ لِي وَ« آتِنٰا فِي اَلدُّنْيٰا حَسَنَةً وَ فِي اَلْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَ قِنٰا عَذٰابَ اَلنّٰارِ» اَلْحَرِيقِ وَ اُرْزُقْنِي فِيهَا ذِكْرَكَ وَ شُكْرَكَ وَ اَلرَّغْبَةَ إِلَيْكَ وَ اَلْإِنَابَةَ وَ اَلتَّوْفِيقَ لِمَا وَفَّقْتَ لَهُ مُحَمَّداً وَ آلَ مُحَمَّدٍ عَلَيْهِمُ اَلسَّلاَمُ يَا سَالِخَ اَلنَّهَارِ مِنَ اَللَّيْلِ فَإِذَا نَحْنُ مُظْلِمُونَ وَ مُجْرِيَ اَلشَّمْسِ« لِمُسْتَقَرٍّ لَهٰا» بِتَقْدِيرِكَ يَا عَزِيزُ يَا عَلِيمُ وَ مُقَدِّرَ اَلْقَمَرِ« مَنٰازِلَ حَتّٰى عٰادَ كَالْعُرْجُونِ اَلْقَدِيمِ» يَا نُورَ كُلِّ نُورٍ وَ مُنْتَهَى كُلِّ رَغْبَةٍ وَ وَلِيَّ كُلِّ نِعْمَةٍ يَا اَللَّهُ يَا رَحْمَانُ يَا اَللَّهُ يَا قُدُّوسُ يَا اَللَّهُ يَا أَحَدُ يَا وَاحِدُ يَا فَرْدُ يَا اَللَّهُ يَا اَللَّهُ يَا اَللَّهُ لَكَ اَلْأَسْمَاءُ اَلْحُسْنَى وَ اَلْأَ مْثَالُ اَلْعُلْيَا وَ اَلْكِبْرِيَاءُ ثُمَّ تَعُودُ إِلَى اَلدُّعَاءِ اَلْأَوَّلِ إِلَى قَوْلِهِ وَ أَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ إِلَى آخِرِ اَلدُّعَاءِ يَا رَبَّ لَيْلَةِ اَلْقَدْرِ وَ جَاعِلَهَا خَيْراً« مِنْ أَلْفِ شَهْرٍ» وَ رَبَّ اَللَّيْلِ وَ اَلنَّهَارِ وَ اَلْجِبَالِ وَ اَلْبِحَارِ وَ اَلظُّلَمِ وَ اَلْأَنْوَارِ وَ اَلْأَرْضِ وَ اَلسَّمَاءِ يَا بَارِئُ يَا مُصَوِّرُ يَا حَنَّانُ يَا مَنَّانُ يَا اَللَّهُ يَا رَحْمَانُ يَا اَللَّهُ يَا قَيُّومُ يَا اَللَّهُ يَا بَدِيعَ اَلسَّمَاوَاتِ وَ اَلْأَرْضِ يَا اَللَّهُ يَا اَللَّهُ يَا اَللَّهُ لَكَ اَلْأَسْمَاءُ اَلْحُسْنَى وَ اَلْأَمْثَالُ اَلْعُلْيَا وَ اَلْآلاَءُ وَ اَلْكِبْرِيَاءُ أَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَأَنْ تَجْعَلَ اِسْمِي فِي هَذِهِ اَللَّيْلَةِ فِي اَلسُّعَدَاءِ وَرُوحِي مَعَ اَلشُّهَدَاءِ وَإِحْسَانِي فِي عِلِّيِّينَ وَإِسَاءَتِي مَغْفُورَةً وَ أَنْ تَهَبَ لِي يَقِيناً تُبَاشِرُ بِهِ قَلْبِي وَ إِيمَاناً يُذْهِبُ اَلشَّكَّ عَنِّي وَ تُرْضِيَنِي بِمَا قَسَمْتَ لِي وَ« آتِنٰا فِي اَلدُّنْيٰا حَسَنَةً وَ فِي اَلْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَ قِنٰا عَذٰابَ اَلنّٰارِ» اَلْحَرِيقِ وَ اُرْزُقْنِي فِيهَا ذِكْرَكَ وَ شُكْرَكَ وَ اَلرَّغْبَةَ إِلَيْكَ وَ اَلْإِنَابَةَ وَ اَلتَّوْبَةَ وَ اَلتَّوْفِيقَ لِمَا وَفَّقْتَ لَهُ مُحَمَّداً وَ آلَ مُحَمَّدٍ عَلَيْهِمُ اَلسَّلاَمُ
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ya‘qub narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn al-Hasan, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ayyub ibn Yaqtin or someone else from them (Imams (a.s)), peace be upon them:
thaqalaynMatn: The supplication of the last ten nights (Month of Ramadan). The supplication of the First night of the Month of Ramadan: “O’ One (azj) who causes the night to enter into the day, and causes the day to enter into the night, and brings forth the living from the dead, and brings forth the dead from the living, O’ Provider of ‘whom He wills without reckoning’, (Surah Az-Zumar 39:52) O’ Allah (swt), O’ Merciful, O’ Allah (swt), O’ Compassionate, O’ Allah (swt), O’ Allah (swt), O’ Allah (swt), to You (azj) belong the Most Beautiful Names, and the Highest Examples, and Majesty, and Blessings. I ask You (azj) to send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and upon his household, and that You (azj) place my name on this night among the fortunate ones, and my soul among the martyrs, and my good deeds in the highest of the high (Illiyyin), and my misdeeds forgiven. And that You (azj) bestow upon me certainty which directly reaches my heart, and faith that removes doubt from me, and that You (azj) make me content with what You (azj) have allotted for me. And (that You (azj) grant me what You (azj) promised in Your words): “Give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the punishment of the burning Fire.” (Surah Al-Baqarah 2:201) And grant me in it remembrance of You (azj), gratitude to You (azj), longing toward You (azj), turning back to You (azj), and success in that which You (azj) granted success to (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), peace be upon them. The supplication of the Second night of the Month of Ramadan: “O’ You (azj) who draws out the day from the night, then suddenly we are in darkness, and who causes the sun to flow ‘in its fixed course,’ (Surah Ya Sin 36:38) by Your decree, O’ Mighty, O’ Knowing; and (You (azj) are) the One who determined for the moon “phases until it returns like the old, dried palm stalk,” (Surah Ya Sin 36:39) O’ Light of every light, and the ultimate object of every desire, and the Possessor of every blessing, O’ Allah (swt), O’ Merciful, O’ Allah (swt), O’ Holy, O’ Allah (swt), O’ One, O’ Unique, O’ Solitary, O’ Allah (swt), O’ Allah (swt), O’ Allah (swt), to You (azj) belong the Most Beautiful Names, the Highest Examples, and Majesty.” Then return to the first supplication at the words: ‘And I ask You to send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws),’ to the end of the supplication. The supplication of the Third night of the Month of Ramadan: O’ Lord (azj) of the Night of Qadr, and the One who made it better “than a thousand months,” (Surah Al-Qadr 97:3) and Lord (azj) of the night and the day, the mountains and the seas, the darknesses and the lights, the earth and the sky, O’ Creator, O’ Fashioner, O’ Most Compassionate, O’ Most Generous Bestower, O’ Allah (swt), O’ Merciful, O’ Allah (swt), O’ Self-Subsisting, O’ Allah (swt), O Originator of the heavens and the earth, O’ Allah (swt), O’ Allah (swt), O’ Allah (swt), to You (azj) belong the Most Beautiful Names, the Highest Examples, the Blessings, and the Majesty. I ask You (azj) to send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), and to place my name on this night among the fortunate, and my soul among the martyrs and my good deeds in the highest ranks (Illiyyin), and my misdeeds forgiven, and that You (azj) bestow upon me certainty that directly reaches my heart, and faith that removes doubt from me, and that You (azj) make me content with what You (azj) have allotted for me, and (grant me) “good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the punishment of the burning Fire,” (Surah Al-Baqarah 2:201) and grant me in it remembrance of You (azj), gratitude to You (azj), longing toward You (azj), returning to You (azj), repentance, and success in what You (azj) granted success to (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), peace be upon them.

chapter: Chapter on Supplication Between the Units of Prayer (Rak‘at)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ibn Abi ‘Umayr, from Muhammad ibn ‘Atiyyah, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said regarding the supplication in the Month of Ramadan, on every night, to say: “O’ Allah (swt), I ask You (azj) by that which You (azj) decree and determine from the decisive matter, in the wise decree, on the Night of Qadr, in the decree that is neither repelled nor altered, that You (azj) prolong my life, and expand my sustenance, and make me among those through whom You (azj) grant victory, and do not replace me with someone else.”
arabicText: اِبْنُ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَطِيَّةَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَ:« فِي اَلدُّعَاءِ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ فِي كُلِّ لَيْلَةٍ تَقُولُ اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ فِيمَا تَقْضِي وَ تُقَدِّرُ مِنَ اَلْأَمْرِ اَلْمَحْتُومِ فِي اَلْأَمْرِ اَلْحَكِيمِ فِي لَيْلَةِ اَلْقَدْرِ فِي اَلْقَضَاءِ اَلَّذِي لاَ يُرَدُّ وَ لاَ يُبَدَّلُ أَنْ تُطِيلَ عُمُرِي وَ أَنْ تُوَسِّعَ عَلَيَّ فِي رِزْقِي وَ أَنْ تَجْعَلَنِي مِمَّنْ تَنْتَصِرُ بِهِ وَ لاَ تَسْتَبْدِلَ بِي غَيْرِي»
thaqalaynSanad: Ibn Abi ‘Umayr, from Muhammad ibn ‘Atiyyah, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said regarding the supplication in the Month of Ramadan, on every night, to say: “O’ Allah (swt), I ask You (azj) by that which You (azj) decree and determine from the decisive matter, in the wise decree, on the Night of Qadr, in the decree that is neither repelled nor altered, that You (azj) prolong my life, and expand my sustenance, and make me among those through whom You (azj) grant victory, and do not replace me with someone else.”

chapter: Chapter on Supplication Between the Units of Prayer (Rak‘at)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Isa, with his chain of narration from the Truthful Ones (Imams (a.s)), peace be upon them, said:
Imam (a.s) said: “And repeat on the night of the twenty-third of the Month of Ramadan this supplication in prostration, standing, sitting, and in every state and throughout the entire month, and whenever and however it is possible for you, and whenever it comes to you during your lifetime, say after glorifying Allah (swt), the Exalted, and sending blessings upon the Prophet (saws), peace be upon him and his family: ‘O’ Allah (swt), be for Your representative (so-and-so), son of (so-and-so), in this hour and in every hour, a guardian, a protector, a leader, a helper, a guide, and an eye, until You (azj) settle him in Your land in obedience and cause him to dwell in it for a long time. The supplication of the Fourth night of the Month of Ramadan: “O’ Splitter of the dawn, and Maker of the night for rest, and (Maker) of the sun and the moon as a reckoning. O’ Mighty, O’ All-Knowing. O’ Possessor of grace and bounty and power and might and excellence and generosity, O’ Possessor of majesty and honour. O’ Allah (swt), O’ All-Beneficent, O’ Allah (swt), O’ Unique, O’ Single, O’ Allah (swt), O’ Manifest, O’ Hidden, O’ Ever-Living there is no God but You (azj). To You (azj) belong the Most Beautiful Names, the Highest Attributes, the Grandeur, and the Blessings. I ask You (azj) to send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), And to place my name on this night among the fortunate ones, And my soul with the martyrs, And my good deeds in the highest of the high, And my bad deeds forgiven; And that You (azj) grant me certainty that directly touches my heart, and faith that removes doubt from me, and contentment with what You (azj) have apportioned for me, And “Give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.” (Surah Al-Baqarah 2:201), And grant me in it Your remembrance, and gratitude to You (azj), and yearning toward You (azj), and turning back in repentance, and repentance itself, And success in that which You (azj) granted success to (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), Your blessings be upon him and upon all of them. The supplication of the Fifth night of the Month of Ramadan: “O’ Maker of the night as a covering, and the day for livelihood, and the earth as a resting place, and the mountains as pegs. O’ Allah (swt), O’ Subduer, O’ Allah (swt), O’ Most Compassionate, O’ Allah (swt), O’ All-Hearing, O’ Allah (swt), O’ Near, O’ Allah (swt), O’ Responder, O’ Allah (swt), O’ Allah (swt), O’ Allah (swt) to You (azj) belong the Most Beautiful Names, and the Highest Attributes, and the Blessings, and the Majesty. I ask You (azj) to send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the people of his household, and to place my name on this night among the fortunate ones, and my soul among the martyrs, and my good deeds in the highest ranks, and my bad deeds forgiven, and that You (azj) grant me certainty that directly touches my heart, and faith that removes doubt from me, and contentment with what You (azj) have apportioned for me, And “Give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.” (Surah Al-Baqarah 2:201), And grant me therein Your remembrance, and gratitude to You (azj), and yearning toward You (azj), and turning to You (azj), and repentance, and success in what You (azj) granted success to (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), peace be upon them. The supplication of the Sixth night of the Month of Ramadan: “O’ Maker of the night and the day as two signs, O’ He (azj) who effaced the sign of the night and made the sign of the day visible so that they may seek bounty from Him (azj) and (attain) His (azj) pleasure. O’ You (azj) who explains all things in detail, explanation upon explanation! O’ Glorious! O’ Bestower! O’ Allah (azj)! O’ Generous! O’ Allah (azj)! O’ Allah (azj)! O’ Allah (azj)! To You (azj) belong the Most Beautiful Names, and the Highest Attributes, and the Majesty, and the Blessings. I ask You (azj) to send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), and to place my name on this night among the fortunate ones, and my soul among the martyrs, and my good deeds in the highest ranks, and my bad deeds forgiven, and to grant me certainty that directly touches my heart, and faith that removes doubt from me, and make me content with what You (azj) have apportioned for me. And “Give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.” (Surah Al-Baqarah 2:201), And grant me in it Your remembrance, and gratitude to You (azj), and yearning toward You (azj), and turning to You (azj), and repentance, and success in what You (azj) granted success to (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), may Allah (swt) send blessings upon him and his family. The supplication of the Seventh night of the Month of Ramadan: “O’ One who stretches the shadow and had You (azj) willed, You (azj) would have made it still and made “the sun its guide” (Surah Al-Furqan 25:45), then You (azj) drew it in to Yourself “with a gradual drawing in.” (Surah Al-Furqan 25:46) O’ Possessor of generosity, bounty, majesty, and blessings there is no God but You (azj) “Knower of the unseen and the witnessed,” … “the All-Beneficent, the Most Merciful.” (Surah Al-Hashr 59:22). There is no God but You (azj). O’ Holy One, O’ Source of Peace, O’ Faithful, O’ Guardian, O’ Mighty, O’ Compeller, O’ Supreme, O’ Allah (swt), O’ Creator, O’ Maker, O’ Fashioner, O’ Allah (swt), O’ Allah (swt). O’ Allah (swt), to You (azj) belong the Most Beautiful Names, and the Highest Attributes, and the Majesty, and the Blessings. I ask You (azj) to send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and upon the people of his household, and to place my name on this night among the fortunate ones, and my soul among the martyrs, and my good deeds in the highest ranks, and my bad deeds forgiven, and that You (azj) grant me certainty that directly touches my heart, and faith that removes doubt from me, And make me content with what You (azj) have apportioned for me, And “Give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.” (Surah Al-Baqarah 2:201), And grant me in it Your remembrance, and gratitude to You (azj), and yearning toward You (azj), and turning to You (azj), and repentance, and success in what You (azj) granted success to (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), may Allah (swt) send blessings upon him and upon all of them. The supplication of the Eighth night of the Month of Ramadan: “O’ Keeper of the night in the air, and Keeper of light in the sky, and Preventer of the heaven “from falling upon the earth except by His permission,” (Surah Al-An’am 6:59), And the One (azj) who restrains both “from vanishing,” (Surah Ibrahim 14:19), O’ All-Knowing, O’ All-Forgiving, O’ Everlasting, O’ Allah (swt), O’ Inheritor, O’ Resurrector “of those in the graves,” (Surah Fatir 35:22) O’ Allah (swt), O’ Allah (swt), O’ Allah (swt) to You (azj) belong the Most Beautiful Names, and the Highest Attributes, and the Majesty, and the Blessings. I ask You (azj) to send blessings upon Muhammad (saws) and family of Muhammad (saws), and to place my name on this night among the fortunate ones, and my soul among the martyrs, and my good deeds in the highest ranks, and my bad deeds forgiven, and that You (azj) grant me certainty that directly touches my heart, and faith that removes doubt from me, and make me content with what You (azj) have apportioned for me, And “Give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.” (Surah Al-Baqarah 2:201), And grant me in it Your remembrance, and gratitude to You (azj), and yearning toward You (azj), and turning to You (azj), and repentance, and success in that which You (azj) granted success to (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), may Allah (swt) send blessings upon him and his family. The supplication of the Ninth night of the Month of Ramadan: “O’ One who wraps the night over the day, and wraps the day over the night, O’ All-Knowing, O’ All-Wise, O’ Lord (azj) of the lords and Master of the masters there is no God but You (azj). O’ You (azj) who are “closer to me than my jugular vein,” (Surah Qaf 50:16) O’ Allah (swt), O’ Allah (swt), O’ Allah (swt) to You (azj) belong the Most Beautiful Names, and the Highest Attributes, and the Majesty, and the Blessings. I ask You (azj) to send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), and to place my name on this night among the fortunate ones, and my soul among the martyrs, and my good deeds in the highest ranks, and my bad deeds forgiven, and that You (azj) grant me certainty that directly touches my heart, and faith that removes doubt from me, and make me content with what You (azj) have apportioned for me, And “Give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.” (Surah Al-Baqarah 2:201), And grant me in it Your remembrance, and gratitude to You (azj), and yearning toward You (azj), and turning to You (azj), and repentance, and success in what You (azj) granted success to (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), may Allah (swt) send blessings upon him and his family. The supplication of the Tenth night of the Month of Ramadan: All praise is due to Allah (swt), there is no partner with Him (azj). And all praise is due to Allah (swt), in the manner that befits the generosity of His (azj) Face and the might of His (azj) Majesty, and as He (azj) is worthy of. O’ Holy One, O’ Light, O’ Light of Sanctity, O’ Most Glorified, O’ Ultimate Point of Glorification, O’ All-Beneficent, O’ Doer of mercy, O’ Allah (swt), O’ All-Knowing, O’ Most Great, O’ Allah (swt), O’ Subtle, O’ Majestic, O’ Allah (swt), O’ All-Hearing, O’ Allah (swt), O’ All-Seeing, O’ Allah (swt), O’ Allah (swt), O’ Allah (swt) to You (azj) belong the Most Beautiful Names, and the Highest Attributes, and the Majesty, and the Blessings. I ask You (azj) to send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and upon his household (a.s), and that You (azj) place my name on this night among the fortunate ones, and my soul among the martyrs, and my good deeds in the highest ranks, and my bad deeds forgiven, And that You (azj) grant me certainty that directly touches my heart, and faith that removes doubt from me, and make me content with what You (azj) have apportioned for me, And “Give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.” (Surah Al-Baqarah 2:201), And grant me in it Your remembrance, and gratitude to You (azj), and yearning toward You (azj), and turning to You (azj), and repentance, and success in what You (azj) granted success to Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), may Allah (swt) send blessings upon him and his family and upon his household, and grant them peace.
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى بِإِسْنَادِهِ عَنِ اَلصَّادِقِينَ عَ قَالَ: قَالَ« وَكَرِّرْ فِي لَيْلَةِ ثَلاَثٍ وَعِشْرِينَ مِنْ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ هَذَا اَلدُّعَاءَ سَاجِداً وَ قَائِماً وَ قَاعِداً وَ عَلَى كُلِّ حَالٍ وَ فِي اَلشَّهْرِ كُلِّهِ وَ كَيْفَ أَمْكَنَكَ وَ مَتَى حَضَرَكَ مِنْ دَهْرِكَ تَقُولُ بَعْدَ تَمْجِيدِ اَللَّهِ تَعَالَى وَ اَلصَّلاَةِ عَلَى اَلنَّبِيِّ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ اَللَّهُمَّ كُنْ لِوَلِيِّكَ فُلاَنِ بْنِ فُلاَنٍ فِي هَذِهِ اَلسَّاعَةِ وَ فِي كُلِّ سَاعَةٍ وَلِيّاً وَ حَافِظاً وَ قَائِداً وَ نَاصِراً وَ دَلِيلاً وَ عَيْناً حَتَّى تُسْكِنَهُ أَرْضَكَ طَوْعاً وَ تُمَكِّنَهُ فِيهَا طَوِيلاً يَا فَالِقَ اَلْإِصْبَاحِ وَ جَاعِلَ اَللَّيْلِ سَكَناً وَ اَلشَّمْسِ وَ اَلْقَمَرِ حُسْبَاناً يَا عَزِيزُ يَا عَلِيمُ يَا ذَا اَلْمَنِّ وَ اَلطَّوْلِ وَ اَلْقُدْرَةِ وَ اَلْحَوْلِ وَ اَلْفَضْلِ وَ اَلْإِنْعَامِ يَا ذَا اَلْجَلاَلِ وَ اَلْإِكْرَامِ يَا اَللَّهُ يَا رَحْمَانُ يَا اَللَّهُ يَا فَرْدُ يَا وَتْرُ يَا اَللَّهُ يَا ظَاهِرُ يَا بَاطِنُ يَا حَيُّ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ لَكَ اَلْأَسْمَاءُ اَلْحُسْنَى وَ اَلْأَمْثَالُ اَلْعُلْيَا وَ اَلْكِبْرِيَاءُ وَ اَلْآلاَءُ أَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ أَنْ تَجْعَلَ اِسْمِي فِي هَذِهِ اَللَّيْلَةِ فِي اَلسُّعَدَاءِ وَ رُوحِي مَعَ اَلشُّهَدَاءِ وَ إِحْسَانِي فِي عِلِّيِّينَ وَ إِسَاءَتِي مَغْفُورَةً وَ أَنْ تَهَبَ لِي يَقِيناً تُبَاشِرُ بِهِ قَلْبِي وَ إِيمَاناً يُذْهِبُ اَلشَّكَّ عَنِّي وَ رِضًا بِمَا قَسَمْتَ لِي وَ« آتِنٰا فِي اَلدُّنْيٰا حَسَنَةً وَ فِي اَلْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَ قِنٰا عَذٰابَ اَلنّٰارِ» اَلْحَرِيقِ وَ اُرْزُقْنِي فِيهَا ذِكْرَكَ وَ شُكْرَكَ وَ اَلرَّغْبَةَ إِلَيْكَ وَ اَلْإِنَابَةَ وَ اَلتَّوْبَةَ وَ اَلتَّوْفِيقَ لِمَا وَفَّقْتَ لَهُ مُحَمَّداً وَ آلَ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَوَاتُكَ عَلَيْهِ وَ عَلَيْهِمْ أَجْمَعِينَ يَا جَاعِلَ اَللَّيْلِ لِبَاساً وَ اَلنَّهَارِ مَعَاشاً وَ اَلْأَرْضِ مِهَاداً وَ اَلْجِبَالِ أَوْتَاداً يَا اَللَّهُ يَا قَاهِرُ يَا اَللَّهُ يَا حَنَّانُ يَا اَللَّهُ يَا سَمِيعُ يَا اَللَّهُ يَا قَرِيبُ يَا اَللَّهُ يَا مُجِيبُ يَا اَللَّهُ يَا اَللَّهُ يَا اَللَّهُ لَكَ اَلْأَسْمَاءُ اَلْحُسْنَى وَ اَلْأَمْثَالُ اَلْعُلْيَا وَ اَلْآلاَءُ وَ اَلْكِبْرِيَاءُ أَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ أَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ وَ أَنْ تَجْعَلَ اِسْمِي فِي هَذِهِ اَللَّيْلَةِ فِي اَلسُّعَدَاءِ وَ رُوحِي مَعَ اَلشُّهَدَاءِ وَ إِحْسَانِي فِي عِلِّيِّينَ وَ إِسَاءَتِي مَغْفُورَةً وَ أَنْ تَهَبَ لِي يَقِيناً تُبَاشِرُ بِهِ قَلْبِي وَ إِيمَاناً يُذْهِبُ اَلشَّكَّ عَنِّي وَ رِضًا بِمَا قَسَمْتَ لِي وَ« آتِنٰا فِي اَلدُّنْيٰا حَسَنَةً وَ فِي اَلْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنٰا عَذٰابَ اَلنّٰارِ» اَلْحَرِيقِ وَاُرْزُقْنِي فِيهَا ذِكْرَكَ وَشُكْرَكَ وَ اَلرَّغْبَةَ إِلَيْكَ وَ اَلْإِنَابَةَ وَ اَلتَّوْبَةَ وَ اَلتَّوْفِيقَ لِمَا وَفَّقْتَ لَهُ مُحَمَّداً وَ آلَ مُحَمَّدٍ عَلَيْهِمُ اَلسَّلاَمُ يَا جَاعِلَ اَللَّيْلِ وَ اَلنَّهَارِ آيَتَيْنِ يَا مَنْ مَحَا آيَةَ اَللَّيْلِ وَ جَعَلَ« آيَةَ اَلنَّهٰارِ مُبْصِرَةً» لِيَبْتَغُوا فَضْلاً مِنْهُ وَ رِضْوَاناً يَا مُفَصِّلَ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ تَفْصِيلاً يَا مَاجِدُ يَا وَهَّابُ يَا اَللَّهُ يَا جَوَادُ يَا اَللَّهُ يَا اَللَّهُ يَا اَللَّهُ لَكَ اَلْأَسْمَاءُ اَلْحُسْنَى وَ اَلْأَمْثَالُ اَلْعُلْيَا وَ اَلْكِبْرِيَاءُ وَ اَلْآلاَءُ أَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ أَنْ تَجْعَلَ اِسْمِي فِي هَذِهِ اَللَّيْلَةِ فِي اَلسُّعَدَاءِ وَ رُوحِي مَعَ اَلشُّهَدَاءِ وَإِحْسَانِي فِي عِلِّيِّينَ وَإِسَاءَتِي مَغْفُورَةً وَأَنْ تَهَبَ لِي يَقِيناً تُبَاشِرُ بِهِ قَلْبِي وَإِيمَاناً يُذْهِبُ اَلشَّكَّ عَنِّي وَ تُرْضِيَنِي بِمَا قَسَمْتَ لِي وَ« آتِنٰا فِي اَلدُّنْيٰا حَسَنَةً وَ فِي اَلْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَ قِنٰا عَذٰابَ اَلنّٰارِ» اَلْحَرِيقِ وَ اُرْزُقْنِي فِيهَا ذِكْرَكَ وَ شُكْرَكَ وَ اَلرَّغْبَةَ إِلَيْكَ وَ اَلْإِنَابَةَ وَ اَلتَّوْبَةَ وَ اَلتَّوْفِيقَ لِمَا وَفَّقْتَ لَهُ مُحَمَّداً وَ آلَ مُحَمَّدٍ صَ يَا مَادَّ اَلظِّلِّ وَ لَوْ شِئْتَ لَجَعَلْتَهُ سَاكِناً وَ جَعَلْتَ« اَلشَّمْسَ عَلَيْهِ دَلِيلاً» ثُمَّ قَبَضْتَهُ إِلَيْكَ« قَبْضاً يَسِيراً» يَا ذَا اَلْجُودِ وَ اَلطَّوْلِ وَ اَلْكِبْرِيَاءِ وَ اَلْآلاَءِ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ« عٰالِمُ اَلْغَيْبِ وَ اَلشَّهٰادَةِ»..« اَلرَّحْمٰنُ اَلرَّحِيمُ» لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ يَا قُدُّوسُ يَا سَلاَمُ يَا مُؤْمِنُ يَا مُهَيْمِنُ يَا عَزِيزُ يَا جَبَّارُ يَا مُتَكَبِّرُ يَا اَللَّهُ يَا خَالِقُ يَا بَارِئُ يَا مُصَوِّرُ يَا اَللَّهُ يَا اَللَّهُ يَا اَللَّهُ لَكَ اَلْأَسْمَاءُ اَلْحُسْنَى وَ اَلْأَمْثَالُ اَلْعُلْيَا وَ اَلْكِبْرِيَاءُ وَ اَلْآلاَءُ أَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ عَلَى أَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ وَ أَنْ تَجْعَلَ اِسْمِي فِي هَذِهِ اَللَّيْلَةِ فِي اَلسُّعَدَاءِ وَ رُوحِي مَعَ اَلشُّهَدَاءِ وَ إِحْسَانِي فِي عِلِّيِّينَ وَ إِسَاءَتِي مَغْفُورَةً وَ أَنْ تَهَبَ لِي يَقِيناً تُبَاشِرُ بِهِ قَلْبِي وَ إِيمَاناً يُذْهِبُ اَلشَّكَّ عَنِّي وَ تُرْضِيَنِي بِمَا قَسَمْتَ لِي وَ« آتِنٰا فِي اَلدُّنْيٰا حَسَنَةً وَ فِي اَلْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَ قِنٰا عَذٰابَ اَلنّٰارِ» اَلْحَرِيقِ وَ اُرْزُقْنِي فِيهَا ذِكْرَكَ وَ شُكْرَكَ وَ اَلرَّغْبَةَ إِلَيْكَ وَ اَلْإِنَابَةَ وَ اَلتَّوْبَةَ وَ اَلتَّوْفِيقَ لِمَا وَفَّقْتَ لَهُ مُحَمَّداً وَ آلَ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ عَلَيْهِمْ أَجْمَعِينَ يَا خَازِنَ اَللَّيْلِ فِي اَلْهَوَاءِ وَ خَازِنَ اَلنُّورِ فِي اَلسَّمَاءِ وَ مَانِعَ اَلسَّمَاءِ« أَنْ تَقَعَ عَلَى اَلْأَرْضِ إِلاّٰ بِإِذْنِهِ» وَ حَابِسَهُمَا« أَنْ تَزُولاٰ» يَا عَلِيمُ يَا غَفُورُ يَا دَائِمُ يَا اَللَّهُ يَا وَارِثُ يَا بَاعِثَ« مَنْ فِي اَلْقُبُورِ» يَا اَللَّهُ يَا اَللَّهُ يَا اَللَّهُ لَكَ اَلْأَسْمَاءُ اَلْحُسْنَى وَ اَلْأَمْثَالُ اَلْعُلْيَا وَ اَلْكِبْرِيَاءُ وَ اَلْآلاَءُ أَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ أَنْ تَجْعَلَ اِسْمِي فِي هَذِهِ اَللَّيْلَةِ فِي اَلسُّعَدَاءِ وَ رُوحِي مَعَ اَلشُّهَدَاءِ وَ إِحْسَانِي فِي عِلِّيِّينَ وَ إِسَاءَتِي مَغْفُورَةً وَ أَنْ تَهَبَ لِي يَقِيناً تُبَاشِرُ بِهِ قَلْبِي وَ إِيمَاناً يَذْهَبُ بِالشَّكِّ عَنِّي وَ تُرْضِيَنِي بِمَا قَسَمْتَ لِي وَ« آتِنٰا فِي اَلدُّنْيٰا حَسَنَةً وَ فِي اَلْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَ قِنٰا عَذٰابَ اَلنّٰارِ» اَلْحَرِيقِ وَ اُرْزُقْنِي فِيهَا ذِكْرَكَ وَ شُكْرَكَ وَ اَلرَّغْبَةَ إِلَيْكَ وَ اَلْإِنَابَةَ وَ اَلتَّوْبَةَ وَ اَلتَّوْفِيقَ لِمَا وَفَّقْتَ لَهُ مُحَمَّداً وَ آلَ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ يَا مُكَوِّرَ اَللَّيْلِ عَلَى اَلنَّهَارِ وَ مُكَوِّرَ اَلنَّهَارِ عَلَى اَللَّيْلِ يَا عَلِيمُ يَا حَكِيمُ يَا رَبَّ اَلْأَرْبَابِ وَ سَيِّدَ اَلسَّادَةِ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ يَا أَقْرَبَ إِلَيَّ« مِنْ حَبْلِ اَلْوَرِيدِ» يَا اَللَّهُ يَا اَللَّهُ يَا اَللَّهُ لَكَ اَلْأَسْمَاءُ اَلْحُسْنَى وَ اَلْأَمْثَالُ اَلْعُلْيَا وَ اَلْكِبْرِيَاءُ وَ اَلْآلاَءُ أَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ أَنْ تَجْعَلَ اِسْمِي فِي هَذِهِ اَللَّيْلَةِ فِي اَلسُّعَدَاءِ وَ رُوحِي مَعَ اَلشُّهَدَاءِ وَ إِحْسَانِي فِي عِلِّيِّينَ وَإِسَاءَتِي مَغْفُورَةً وَأَنْ تَهَبَ لِي يَقِيناً تُبَاشِرُ بِهِ قَلْبِي وَإِيمَاناً يَذْهَبُ بِالشَّكِّ عَنِّي وَ تُرْضِيَنِي بِمَا قَسَمْتَ لِي وَ« آتِنٰا فِي اَلدُّنْيٰا حَسَنَةً وَفِي اَلْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنٰا» بِرَحْمَتِكَ« عَذٰابَ اَلنّٰارِ» اَلْحَرِيقِ وَاُرْزُقْنِي فِيهَا ذِكْرَكَ وَ شُكْرَكَ وَ اَلرَّغْبَةَ إِلَيْكَ وَ اَلْإِنَابَةَ وَ اَلتَّوْبَةَ وَ اَلتَّوْفِيقَ لِمَا وَفَّقْتَ لَهُ مُحَمَّداً وَ آلَ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ اَ لْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ وَ اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ كَمَا يَنْبَغِي لِكَرَمِ وَجْهِهِ وَ عِزِّ جَلاَلِهِ وَ كَمَا هُوَ أَهْلُهُ يَا قُدُّوسُ يَا نُورُ يَا نُورَ اَلْقُدْسِ يَا سُبُّوحُ يَا مُنْتَهَى اَلتَّسْبِيحِ يَا رَحْمَانُ يَا فَاعِلَ اَلرَّحْمَةِ يَا اَللَّهُ يَا عَلِيمُ يَا كَبِيرُ يَا اَللَّهُ يَالَطِيفُ يَا جَلِيلُ يَا اَللَّهُ يَا سَمِيعُ يَا اَللَّهُ يَا بَصِيرُ يَا اَللَّهُ يَا اَللَّهُ يَا اَللَّهُ لَكَ اَلْأَسْمَاءُ اَلْحُسْنَى وَ اَلْأَمْثَالُ اَلْعُلْيَا وَ اَلْكِبْرِيَاءُ وَ اَلْآلاَءُ أَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ عَلَى أَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ وَ أَنْ تَجْعَلَ اِسْمِي فِي هَذِهِ اَللَّيْلَةِ فِي اَلسُّعَدَاءِ وَرُوحِي مَعَ اَلشُّهَدَاءِ وَ إِحْسَانِي فِي عِلِّيِّينَ وَإِسَاءَتِي مَغْفُورَةً وَأَنْ تَهَبَ لِي يَقِيناً تُبَاشِرُ بِهِ قَلْبِي وَإِيمَاناً يَذْهَبُ بِالشَّكِّ عَنِّي وَ تُرْضِيَنِي بِمَا قَسَمْتَ لِي وَ« آتِنٰا فِي اَلدُّنْيٰا حَسَنَةً وَ فِي اَلْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَ قِنٰا عَذٰابَ اَلنّٰارِ» اَلْحَرِيقِ وَ اُرْزُقْنِي فِيهَا ذِكْرَكَ وَ شُكْرَكَ وَ اَلرَّغْبَةَ إِلَيْكَ وَ اَلْإِنَابَةَ وَ اَلتَّوْبَةَ وَ اَلتَّوْفِيقَ لِمَا وَفَّقْتَ لَهُ مُحَمَّداً وَ آلَ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ وَ عَلَى أَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ وَ سَلَّمَ»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Isa, with his chain of narration from the Truthful Ones (Imams (a.s)), peace be upon them, said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: “And repeat on the night of the twenty-third of the Month of Ramadan this supplication in prostration, standing, sitting, and in every state and throughout the entire month, and whenever and however it is possible for you, and whenever it comes to you during your lifetime, say after glorifying Allah (swt), the Exalted, and sending blessings upon the Prophet (saws), peace be upon him and his family: ‘O’ Allah (swt), be for Your representative (so-and-so), son of (so-and-so), in this hour and in every hour, a guardian, a protector, a leader, a helper, a guide, and an eye, until You (azj) settle him in Your land in obedience and cause him to dwell in it for a long time. The supplication of the Fourth night of the Month of Ramadan: “O’ Splitter of the dawn, and Maker of the night for rest, and (Maker) of the sun and the moon as a reckoning. O’ Mighty, O’ All-Knowing. O’ Possessor of grace and bounty and power and might and excellence and generosity, O’ Possessor of majesty and honour. O’ Allah (swt), O’ All-Beneficent, O’ Allah (swt), O’ Unique, O’ Single, O’ Allah (swt), O’ Manifest, O’ Hidden, O’ Ever-Living there is no God but You (azj). To You (azj) belong the Most Beautiful Names, the Highest Attributes, the Grandeur, and the Blessings. I ask You (azj) to send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), And to place my name on this night among the fortunate ones, And my soul with the martyrs, And my good deeds in the highest of the high, And my bad deeds forgiven; And that You (azj) grant me certainty that directly touches my heart, and faith that removes doubt from me, and contentment with what You (azj) have apportioned for me, And “Give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.” (Surah Al-Baqarah 2:201), And grant me in it Your remembrance, and gratitude to You (azj), and yearning toward You (azj), and turning back in repentance, and repentance itself, And success in that which You (azj) granted success to (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), Your blessings be upon him and upon all of them. The supplication of the Fifth night of the Month of Ramadan: “O’ Maker of the night as a covering, and the day for livelihood, and the earth as a resting place, and the mountains as pegs. O’ Allah (swt), O’ Subduer, O’ Allah (swt), O’ Most Compassionate, O’ Allah (swt), O’ All-Hearing, O’ Allah (swt), O’ Near, O’ Allah (swt), O’ Responder, O’ Allah (swt), O’ Allah (swt), O’ Allah (swt) to You (azj) belong the Most Beautiful Names, and the Highest Attributes, and the Blessings, and the Majesty. I ask You (azj) to send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the people of his household, and to place my name on this night among the fortunate ones, and my soul among the martyrs, and my good deeds in the highest ranks, and my bad deeds forgiven, and that You (azj) grant me certainty that directly touches my heart, and faith that removes doubt from me, and contentment with what You (azj) have apportioned for me, And “Give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.” (Surah Al-Baqarah 2:201), And grant me therein Your remembrance, and gratitude to You (azj), and yearning toward You (azj), and turning to You (azj), and repentance, and success in what You (azj) granted success to (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), peace be upon them. The supplication of the Sixth night of the Month of Ramadan: “O’ Maker of the night and the day as two signs, O’ He (azj) who effaced the sign of the night and made the sign of the day visible so that they may seek bounty from Him (azj) and (attain) His (azj) pleasure. O’ You (azj) who explains all things in detail, explanation upon explanation! O’ Glorious! O’ Bestower! O’ Allah (azj)! O’ Generous! O’ Allah (azj)! O’ Allah (azj)! O’ Allah (azj)! To You (azj) belong the Most Beautiful Names, and the Highest Attributes, and the Majesty, and the Blessings. I ask You (azj) to send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), and to place my name on this night among the fortunate ones, and my soul among the martyrs, and my good deeds in the highest ranks, and my bad deeds forgiven, and to grant me certainty that directly touches my heart, and faith that removes doubt from me, and make me content with what You (azj) have apportioned for me. And “Give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.” (Surah Al-Baqarah 2:201), And grant me in it Your remembrance, and gratitude to You (azj), and yearning toward You (azj), and turning to You (azj), and repentance, and success in what You (azj) granted success to (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), may Allah (swt) send blessings upon him and his family. The supplication of the Seventh night of the Month of Ramadan: “O’ One who stretches the shadow and had You (azj) willed, You (azj) would have made it still and made “the sun its guide” (Surah Al-Furqan 25:45), then You (azj) drew it in to Yourself “with a gradual drawing in.” (Surah Al-Furqan 25:46) O’ Possessor of generosity, bounty, majesty, and blessings there is no God but You (azj) “Knower of the unseen and the witnessed,” … “the All-Beneficent, the Most Merciful.” (Surah Al-Hashr 59:22). There is no God but You (azj). O’ Holy One, O’ Source of Peace, O’ Faithful, O’ Guardian, O’ Mighty, O’ Compeller, O’ Supreme, O’ Allah (swt), O’ Creator, O’ Maker, O’ Fashioner, O’ Allah (swt), O’ Allah (swt). O’ Allah (swt), to You (azj) belong the Most Beautiful Names, and the Highest Attributes, and the Majesty, and the Blessings. I ask You (azj) to send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and upon the people of his household, and to place my name on this night among the fortunate ones, and my soul among the martyrs, and my good deeds in the highest ranks, and my bad deeds forgiven, and that You (azj) grant me certainty that directly touches my heart, and faith that removes doubt from me, And make me content with what You (azj) have apportioned for me, And “Give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.” (Surah Al-Baqarah 2:201), And grant me in it Your remembrance, and gratitude to You (azj), and yearning toward You (azj), and turning to You (azj), and repentance, and success in what You (azj) granted success to (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), may Allah (swt) send blessings upon him and upon all of them. The supplication of the Eighth night of the Month of Ramadan: “O’ Keeper of the night in the air, and Keeper of light in the sky, and Preventer of the heaven “from falling upon the earth except by His permission,” (Surah Al-An’am 6:59), And the One (azj) who restrains both “from vanishing,” (Surah Ibrahim 14:19), O’ All-Knowing, O’ All-Forgiving, O’ Everlasting, O’ Allah (swt), O’ Inheritor, O’ Resurrector “of those in the graves,” (Surah Fatir 35:22) O’ Allah (swt), O’ Allah (swt), O’ Allah (swt) to You (azj) belong the Most Beautiful Names, and the Highest Attributes, and the Majesty, and the Blessings. I ask You (azj) to send blessings upon Muhammad (saws) and family of Muhammad (saws), and to place my name on this night among the fortunate ones, and my soul among the martyrs, and my good deeds in the highest ranks, and my bad deeds forgiven, and that You (azj) grant me certainty that directly touches my heart, and faith that removes doubt from me, and make me content with what You (azj) have apportioned for me, And “Give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.” (Surah Al-Baqarah 2:201), And grant me in it Your remembrance, and gratitude to You (azj), and yearning toward You (azj), and turning to You (azj), and repentance, and success in that which You (azj) granted success to (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), may Allah (swt) send blessings upon him and his family. The supplication of the Ninth night of the Month of Ramadan: “O’ One who wraps the night over the day, and wraps the day over the night, O’ All-Knowing, O’ All-Wise, O’ Lord (azj) of the lords and Master of the masters there is no God but You (azj). O’ You (azj) who are “closer to me than my jugular vein,” (Surah Qaf 50:16) O’ Allah (swt), O’ Allah (swt), O’ Allah (swt) to You (azj) belong the Most Beautiful Names, and the Highest Attributes, and the Majesty, and the Blessings. I ask You (azj) to send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), and to place my name on this night among the fortunate ones, and my soul among the martyrs, and my good deeds in the highest ranks, and my bad deeds forgiven, and that You (azj) grant me certainty that directly touches my heart, and faith that removes doubt from me, and make me content with what You (azj) have apportioned for me, And “Give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.” (Surah Al-Baqarah 2:201), And grant me in it Your remembrance, and gratitude to You (azj), and yearning toward You (azj), and turning to You (azj), and repentance, and success in what You (azj) granted success to (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), may Allah (swt) send blessings upon him and his family. The supplication of the Tenth night of the Month of Ramadan: All praise is due to Allah (swt), there is no partner with Him (azj). And all praise is due to Allah (swt), in the manner that befits the generosity of His (azj) Face and the might of His (azj) Majesty, and as He (azj) is worthy of. O’ Holy One, O’ Light, O’ Light of Sanctity, O’ Most Glorified, O’ Ultimate Point of Glorification, O’ All-Beneficent, O’ Doer of mercy, O’ Allah (swt), O’ All-Knowing, O’ Most Great, O’ Allah (swt), O’ Subtle, O’ Majestic, O’ Allah (swt), O’ All-Hearing, O’ Allah (swt), O’ All-Seeing, O’ Allah (swt), O’ Allah (swt), O’ Allah (swt) to You (azj) belong the Most Beautiful Names, and the Highest Attributes, and the Majesty, and the Blessings. I ask You (azj) to send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and upon his household (a.s), and that You (azj) place my name on this night among the fortunate ones, and my soul among the martyrs, and my good deeds in the highest ranks, and my bad deeds forgiven, And that You (azj) grant me certainty that directly touches my heart, and faith that removes doubt from me, and make me content with what You (azj) have apportioned for me, And “Give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.” (Surah Al-Baqarah 2:201), And grant me in it Your remembrance, and gratitude to You (azj), and yearning toward You (azj), and turning to You (azj), and repentance, and success in what You (azj) granted success to Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), may Allah (swt) send blessings upon him and his family and upon his household, and grant them peace.

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 111

chapter: Chapter on Supplication Between the Units of Prayer (Rak‘at)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ya‘qub from Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Ibn Mahbub from Ali ibn Riab from Abd al Saleh (a.s) (Righteous Servant, Imam al-Kadhim (a.s)), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Kadhim (a.s) said: “Supplicate with this supplication in the Month of Ramadan at the beginning of the year,” And Imam (a.s) mentioned: “Indeed, whoever supplicates with it, anticipating reward and with sincerity, no tribulation shall afflict him in that year, nor any calamity that harms his religion or his body, and Allah (swt) will protect him from the evil of whatever comes in that year; ‘O’ Allah (swt), I ask You (azj) by Your Name the one before which everything submits, And by Your mercy which ‘encompasses all things’ (Surah Al-A’raf 7:156), And by Your greatness before which all things humble themselves, And by Your power before which all things yield, And by Your might through which all things are subdued, And by Your knowledge which encompasses all things. O’ Light, O’ Holy, O’ First before all things, and O’ Last after all things, O’ Allah (swt), O’ All-Beneficent, send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), And forgive me the sins which alter blessings, And forgive me the sins which bring down afflictions, And forgive me the sins which cut off hope, And forgive me the sins which empower the enemies, And forgive me the sins which repel supplication, And forgive me the sins for which calamities descend. And forgive me the sins that withhold the rain of the sky, And forgive me the sins that remove the covering, And forgive me the sins that hasten destruction, And forgive me the sins that lead to regret, And forgive me the sins that tear apart protections. And clothe me in Your impenetrable armor which none can reach, and grant me well-being from the evil of what I fear, by night and by day, in the coming year of mine. O’ Allah (swt), Lord (azj) of the seven heavens, And Lord (azj) of the seven earths, and all that is within them and between them, And Lord (azj) of the Mighty Throne, And Lord (azj) of the Seven Oft-Repeated Verses and the Great Qur’an, And Lord (azj) of Israfil, and Mika’il, and Jabra’il, And Lord (azj) of (Prophet) Muhammad (saws), may Allah (swt) send blessings upon him and his family, the Master of the Messengers and the Seal of the Prophets. I ask You (azj) by Your Own Self, and by what You (azj) have named Yourself with, O’ Magnificent One, You (azj) are the One who bestows greatness, Who repels every feared thing, Who grants every immense bounty, Who multiplies good deeds both small and great, and You (azj) do whatever You (azj) will. O’ All-Powerful, O’ Allah (swt), O’ All-Beneficent, send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the people of his household. And clothe me in this coming year of mine with Your protection, And brighten my face with Your light, And give me life with Your love, And let me attain Your satisfaction and noble generosity and immense gift of the best of what You (azj) possess and of the best You (azj) bestow upon any of Your creation and clothe me along with that in Your well-being. O’ You to whom every complaint is raised, O’ Witness of every whispered conversation, O’ Knower of every hidden matter, O’ Repeller of whatever affliction He (azj) wills, O’ Most Generous in pardon! O’ You (azj) who are excellent in overlooking faults, cause me to die upon the creed of Ibrahim (a.s) and his pure nature, So cause me to die upon the religion of (Prophet) Muhammad (saws), may Allah (swt) send blessings upon him and his family, and His (saws) tradition (sunnah), and upon the best kind of death. So cause me to die as one loyal to Your friends, and disassociated from Your enemies. O’ Allah (swt), keep me away in this year from every deed, word, or action that would distance me from You (azj), And draw me near to every deed, word, or action that would bring me closer to You (azj) in this year, O’ Most Merciful of the merciful! And prevent me from every deed, word, or action that may proceed from me, of which I fear the harm of its outcome and I fear Your displeasure upon it, for fear that You (azj) would turn Your Noble Face away from me, and thereby I would deserve a loss in the portion I have with You (azj). O’ Most Kind, O’ Most Merciful, O’ Allah (swt), place me in this coming year of mine under Your protection and care, In Your shelter and under Your guardianship, And enshroud me with the covering of Your well-being, And grant me Your generosity. Mighty is Your protection, and exalted is Your praise there is no God other than You (azj). O’ Allah (swt), make me a follower of the righteous ones among Your past friends, and join me with them, and make me submissive to the one who spoke truthfully on Your behalf from among them. O’ Allah (swt), I seek refuge in You (azj) lest my sins, my wrongdoing, my excess against myself, my following of my desires, And my preoccupation with my lusts should encompass me and all of this becomes a barrier between me and Your mercy and satisfaction, so I become forgotten in Your sight and exposed to Your wrath and punishment. O’ Allah (swt), grant me success in every righteous deed through which You (azj) are pleased with me, and bring me near to You (azj) in closeness. O’ Allah (swt), just as You (azj) sufficed Your Prophet Muhammad may Allah (swt) send blessings upon him and his family, from the terror of his enemy, And You (azj) relieved His (saws) distress, and removed His (saws) grief, and fulfilled Your promise to him, and completed for him Your covenant. O’ Allah (swt), by that, protect me from the terrors of this year, its calamities, its illnesses, its tribulations, its evils, its sorrows, the constriction of livelihood within it. And grant me, by Your mercy, the perfection of well-being along with the complete continuation of Your blessings upon me until the end of my term. I ask You (azj) with the request of one who has done wrong, and committed injustice, and confesses (his guilt). And I ask You (azj) to forgive me for the past sins which Your watchers have counted and which Your noble angels have recorded against me. And that You (azj) protect me, O’ my God (azj), from sins in what remains of my life until the end of my term. O’ Allah (swt), O’ All-Beneficent, send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), And grant me everything I have asked You (azj) for and turned to You (azj) in desire for, for indeed You (azj) have commanded me to supplicate and promised to respond, O’ Most Merciful of the merciful.”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ رِئَابٍ عَنْ عَبْدٍ صَالِحٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« اُدْعُ بِهَذَا اَلدُّعَاءِ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ مُسْتَقْبِلَ دُخُولِ اَلسَّنَةِ» وَ ذَكَرَ« أَنَّهُ مَنْ دَعَا بِهِ مُحْتَسِباً مُخْلِصاً لَمْ تُصِبْهُ فِي تِلْكَ اَلسَّنَةِ فِتْنَةٌ وَ لاَ آفَةٌ يُضَرُّ بِهَا دِينُهُ وَ بَدَنُهُ وَ وَقَاهُ اَللَّهُ شَرَّ مَا يَأْتِي بِهِ تِلْكَ اَلسَّنَةَ اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِاسْمِكَ اَلَّذِي دَانَ لَهُ كُلُّ شَيْءٍ وَ بِرَحْمَتِكَ اَلَّتِي« وَسِعَتْ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ» وَ بِعَظَمَتِكَ اَلَّتِي تَوَاضَعَ لَهَا كُلُّ شَيْءٍ وَ بِقُوَّتِكَ اَلَّتِي خَضَعَ لَهَا كُلُّ شَيْءٍ وَ بِجَبَرُوتِكَ اَلَّتِي غَلَبَتْ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ وَ بِعِلْمِكَ اَلَّذِي أَحَاطَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ يَا نُورُ يَا قُدُّوسُ يَا أَوَّلَ قَبْلَ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَ يَا بَاقِيَ بَعْدَ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ يَا اَللَّهُ يَا رَحْمَانُ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اِغْفِرْ لِيَ اَلذُّنُوبَ اَلَّتِي تُغَيِّرُ اَلنِّعَمَ وَ اِغْفِرْ لِيَ اَلذُّنُوبَ اَلَّتِي تُنْزِلُ اَلنِّقَمَ وَ اِغْفِرْ لِيَ اَلذُّنُوبَ اَلَّتِي تَقْطَعُ اَلرَّجَاءَ وَ اِغْفِرْ لِيَ اَلذُّنُوبَ اَلَّتِي تُدِيلُ اَلْأَعْدَاءَ وَ اِغْفِرْ لِيَ اَلذُّنُوبَ اَلَّتِي تَرُدُّ اَلدُّعَاءَ وَ اِغْفِرْ لِيَ اَلذُّنُوبَ اَلَّتِي يُسْتَحَقُّ بِهَا نُزُولُ اَلْبَلاَءِ وَ اِغْفِرْ لِيَ اَلذُّنُوبَ اَلَّتِي تَحْبِسُ غَيْثَ اَلسَّمَاءِ وَ اِغْفِرْ لِيَ اَلذُّنُوبَ اَلَّتِي تَكْشِفُ اَلْغِطَاءَ وَ اِغْفِرْ لِيَ اَلذُّنُوبَ اَلَّتِي تُعَجِّلُ اَلْفَنَاءَ وَ اِغْفِرْ لِيَ اَلذُّنُوبَ اَلَّتِي تُورِثُ اَلنَّدَمَ وَ اِغْفِرْ لِيَ اَلذُّنُوبَ اَلَّتِي تَهْتِكُ اَلْعِصَمَ وَ أَلْبِسْنِي دِرْعَكَ اَلْحَصِينَةَ اَلَّتِي لاَ تُرَامُ وَعَافِنِي مِنْ شَرِّ مَا أُحَاذِرُ بِاللَّيْلِ وَاَلنَّهَارِ فِي مُسْتَقْبَلِ سَنَتِي هَذِهِ اَللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ اَلسَّمَاوَاتِ اَلسَّبْعِ وَرَبَّ اَلْأَرَضِينَ اَلسَّبْعِ وَ مَا فِيهِنَّ وَ مَا بَيْنَهُنَّ وَ رَبَّ اَلْعَرْشِ اَلْعَظِيمِ وَ رَبَّ اَلسَّبْعِ اَلْمَثَانِي وَ اَلْقُرْآنِ اَلْعَظِيمِ وَ رَبَّ إِسْرَافِيلَ وَ مِيكَائِيلَ وَ جَبْرَئِيلَ وَ رَبَّ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ سَيِّدِ اَلْمُرْسَلِينَ وَ خَاتَمِ اَلنَّبِيِّينَ أَسْأَلُكَ بِكَ وَ بِمَا سَمَّيْتَ بِهِ نَفْسَكَ يَا عَظِيمُ أَنْتَ اَلَّذِي تَمُنُّ بِالْعَظِيمِ وَ تَدْفَعُ كُلَّ مَحْذُورٍ وَ تُعْطِي كُلَّ جَزِيلٍ وَ تُضَاعِفُ مِنَ اَلْحَسَنَاتِ بِالْقَلِيلِ وَ بِالْكَثِيرِ وَ تَفْعَلُ مَا تَشَاءُ يَا قَدِيرُ يَا اَللَّهُ يَا رَحْمَانُ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ أَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ وَ أَلْبِسْنِي فِي مُسْتَقْبَلِ سَنَتِي هَذِهِ سِتْرَكَ وَ نَضِّرْ وَجْهِي بِنُورِكَ وَ أَحْيِنِي بِمَحَبَّتِكَ وَ بَلِّغْنِي رِضْوَانَكَ وَ شَرِيفَ كَرَامَتِكَ وَ جَسِيمَ عَطِيَّتِكَ مِنْ خَيْرِ مَا عِنْدَكَ وَ مِنْ خَيْرِ مَا أَنْتَ مُعْطِيهِ أَحَداً مِنْ خَلْقِكَ وَ أَلْبِسْنِي مَعَ ذَلِكَ عَافِيَتَكَ يَا مَوْضِعَ كُلِّ شَكْوَى وَ يَا شَاهِدَ كُلِّ نَجْوَى وَ عَالِمَ كُلِّ خَفِيَّةٍ وَ يَا دَافِعَ مَا يَشَاءُ مِنْ بَلِيَّةٍ يَا كَرِيمَ اَلْعَفْوِ يَا حَسَنَ اَلتَّجَاوُزِ تَوَفَّنِي عَلَى مِلَّةِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَ فِطْرَتِهِ وَ عَلَى دِينِ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ وَ سُنَّتِهِ وَ عَلَى خَيْرِ اَلْوَفَاةِ فَتَوَفَّنِي مُوَالِياً لِأَوْلِيَائِكَ مُعَادِياً لِأَ عْدَائِكَ اَللَّهُمَّ وَ جَنِّبْنِي فِي هَذِهِ اَلسَّنَةِ كُلَّ عَمَلٍ أَوْ قَوْلٍ أَوْ فِعْلٍ يُبَاعِدُنِي مِنْكَ وَ اِجْلِبْنِي إِلَى كُلِّ عَمَلٍ أَوْ قَوْلٍ أَوْ فِعْلٍ يُقَرِّبُنِي مِنْكَ فِي هَذِهِ اَلسَّنَةِ يَا أَرْحَمَ اَلرَّاحِمِينَ وَ اِمْنَعْنِي مِنْ كُلِّ عَمَلٍ أَوْ قَوْلٍ أَوْ فِعْلٍ يَكُونُ مِنِّي أَخَافُ ضَرَرَ عَاقِبَتِهِ وَ أَخَافُ مَقْتَكَ إِيَّايَ عَلَيْهِ حِذَارَ أَنْ تَصْرِفَ وَجْهَكَ اَلْكَرِيمَ عَنِّي فَأَسْتَوْجِبَ بِهِ نَقْصاً مِنْ حَظٍّ لِي عِنْدَكَ يَا رَءُوفُ يَا رَحِيمُ اَللَّهُمَّ وَ اِجْعَلْنِي فِي مُسْتَقْبَلِ سَنَتِي هَذِهِ فِي حِفْظِكَ وَ كِلاَءَتِكَ وَ فِي جِوَارِكَ وَ فِي كَنَفِكَ وَ جَلِّلْنِي سِتْرَ عَافِيَتِكَ وَ هَبْ لِي كَرَامَتَكَ عَزَّ جَارُكَ وَ جَلَّ ثَنَاؤُكَ وَ لاَ إِلَهَ غَيْرُكَ اَللَّهُمَّ اِجْعَلْنِي تَابِعاً لِصَالِحِ مَنْ مَضَى مِنْ أَوْلِيَائِكَ وَ أَلْحِقْنِي بِهِمْ وَ اِجْعَلْنِي مُسَلِّماً لِمَنْ قَالَ بِالصِّدْقِ عَلَيْكَ مِنْهُمْ اَللَّهُمَّ وَ أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ تُحِيطَ بِي خَطِيئَتِي وَ ظُلْمِي وَ إِسْرَافِي عَلَى نَفْسِي وَ اِتِّبَاعِي لِهَوَايَ وَ اِشْتِغَالِي بِشَهَوَاتِي فَيَحُولَ ذَلِكَ بَيْنِي وَ بَيْنَ رَحْمَتِكَ وَرِضْوَانِكَ فَأَكُونَ مَنْسِيّاً عِنْدَكَ مُتَعَرِّضاً لِسَخَطِكَ وَنَقِمَتِكَ اَللَّهُمَّ وَفِّقْنِي لِكُلِّ عَمَلٍ صَالِحٍ تَرْضَى بِهِ عَنِّي وَ قَرِّبْنِي إِلَيْكَ زُلْفَى اَللَّهُمَّ كَمَا كَفَيْتَ نَبِيَّكَ مُحَمَّداً صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ هَوْلَ عَدُوِّهِ وَ فَرَّجْتَ هَمَّهُ وَ كَشَفْتَ غَمَّهُ وَصَدَقْتَهُ وَعْدَكَ وَأَنْجَزْتَ لَهُ عَهْدَكَ اَللَّهُمَّ فَبِذَلِكَ فَاكْفِنِي هَوْلَ هَذِهِ اَلسَّنَةِ وَآفَاتِهَا وَأَسْقَامَهَا وَفِتْنَتَهَا وَشُرُورَهَا وَأَحْزَانَهَا وَ ضِيقَ اَلْمَعَاشِ فِيهَا وَبَلِّغْنِي بِرَحْمَتِكَ كَمَالَ اَلْعَافِيَةِ بِتَمَامِ دَوَامِ اَلنِّعْمَةِ عِنْدِي إِلَى مُنْتَهَى أَجَلِي أَسْأَلُكَ سُؤَالَ مَنْ أَسَاءَ وَ ظَلَمَ وَ اِعْتَرَفَ وَ أَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تَغْفِرَ لِي مَا مَضَى مِنَ اَلذُّنُوبِ اَلَّتِي حَصَرَتْهَا حَفَظَتُكَ وَ أَحْصَتْهَا كِرَامُ مَلاَئِكَتِكَ عَلَيَّ وَ أَنْ تَعْصِمَنِي إِلَهِي مِنَ اَلذُّنُوبِ فِيمَا بَقِيَ مِنْ عُمُرِي إِلَى مُنْتَهَى أَجَلِي يَا اَللَّهُ يَا رَحْمَانُ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ أَهْلِ بَيْتِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آتِنِي كُلَّمَا سَأَلْتُكَ وَ رَغِبْتُ إِلَيْكَ فِيهِ فَإِنَّكَ أَمَرْتَنِي بِالدُّعَاءِ وَ تَكَفَّلْتَ بِالْإِجَابَةِ يَا أَرْحَمَ اَلرَّاحِمِينَ»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ya‘qub from Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Ibn Mahbub from Ali ibn Riab from Abd al Saleh (a.s) (Righteous Servant, Imam al-Kadhim (a.s)), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Kadhim (a.s) said: “Supplicate with this supplication in the Month of Ramadan at the beginning of the year,” And Imam (a.s) mentioned: “Indeed, whoever supplicates with it, anticipating reward and with sincerity, no tribulation shall afflict him in that year, nor any calamity that harms his religion or his body, and Allah (swt) will protect him from the evil of whatever comes in that year; ‘O’ Allah (swt), I ask You (azj) by Your Name the one before which everything submits, And by Your mercy which ‘encompasses all things’ (Surah Al-A’raf 7:156), And by Your greatness before which all things humble themselves, And by Your power before which all things yield, And by Your might through which all things are subdued, And by Your knowledge which encompasses all things. O’ Light, O’ Holy, O’ First before all things, and O’ Last after all things, O’ Allah (swt), O’ All-Beneficent, send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), And forgive me the sins which alter blessings, And forgive me the sins which bring down afflictions, And forgive me the sins which cut off hope, And forgive me the sins which empower the enemies, And forgive me the sins which repel supplication, And forgive me the sins for which calamities descend. And forgive me the sins that withhold the rain of the sky, And forgive me the sins that remove the covering, And forgive me the sins that hasten destruction, And forgive me the sins that lead to regret, And forgive me the sins that tear apart protections. And clothe me in Your impenetrable armor which none can reach, and grant me well-being from the evil of what I fear, by night and by day, in the coming year of mine. O’ Allah (swt), Lord (azj) of the seven heavens, And Lord (azj) of the seven earths, and all that is within them and between them, And Lord (azj) of the Mighty Throne, And Lord (azj) of the Seven Oft-Repeated Verses and the Great Qur’an, And Lord (azj) of Israfil, and Mika’il, and Jabra’il, And Lord (azj) of (Prophet) Muhammad (saws), may Allah (swt) send blessings upon him and his family, the Master of the Messengers and the Seal of the Prophets. I ask You (azj) by Your Own Self, and by what You (azj) have named Yourself with, O’ Magnificent One, You (azj) are the One who bestows greatness, Who repels every feared thing, Who grants every immense bounty, Who multiplies good deeds both small and great, and You (azj) do whatever You (azj) will. O’ All-Powerful, O’ Allah (swt), O’ All-Beneficent, send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the people of his household. And clothe me in this coming year of mine with Your protection, And brighten my face with Your light, And give me life with Your love, And let me attain Your satisfaction and noble generosity and immense gift of the best of what You (azj) possess and of the best You (azj) bestow upon any of Your creation and clothe me along with that in Your well-being. O’ You to whom every complaint is raised, O’ Witness of every whispered conversation, O’ Knower of every hidden matter, O’ Repeller of whatever affliction He (azj) wills, O’ Most Generous in pardon! O’ You (azj) who are excellent in overlooking faults, cause me to die upon the creed of Ibrahim (a.s) and his pure nature, So cause me to die upon the religion of (Prophet) Muhammad (saws), may Allah (swt) send blessings upon him and his family, and His (saws) tradition (sunnah), and upon the best kind of death. So cause me to die as one loyal to Your friends, and disassociated from Your enemies. O’ Allah (swt), keep me away in this year from every deed, word, or action that would distance me from You (azj), And draw me near to every deed, word, or action that would bring me closer to You (azj) in this year, O’ Most Merciful of the merciful! And prevent me from every deed, word, or action that may proceed from me, of which I fear the harm of its outcome and I fear Your displeasure upon it, for fear that You (azj) would turn Your Noble Face away from me, and thereby I would deserve a loss in the portion I have with You (azj). O’ Most Kind, O’ Most Merciful, O’ Allah (swt), place me in this coming year of mine under Your protection and care, In Your shelter and under Your guardianship, And enshroud me with the covering of Your well-being, And grant me Your generosity. Mighty is Your protection, and exalted is Your praise there is no God other than You (azj). O’ Allah (swt), make me a follower of the righteous ones among Your past friends, and join me with them, and make me submissive to the one who spoke truthfully on Your behalf from among them. O’ Allah (swt), I seek refuge in You (azj) lest my sins, my wrongdoing, my excess against myself, my following of my desires, And my preoccupation with my lusts should encompass me and all of this becomes a barrier between me and Your mercy and satisfaction, so I become forgotten in Your sight and exposed to Your wrath and punishment. O’ Allah (swt), grant me success in every righteous deed through which You (azj) are pleased with me, and bring me near to You (azj) in closeness. O’ Allah (swt), just as You (azj) sufficed Your Prophet Muhammad may Allah (swt) send blessings upon him and his family, from the terror of his enemy, And You (azj) relieved His (saws) distress, and removed His (saws) grief, and fulfilled Your promise to him, and completed for him Your covenant. O’ Allah (swt), by that, protect me from the terrors of this year, its calamities, its illnesses, its tribulations, its evils, its sorrows, the constriction of livelihood within it. And grant me, by Your mercy, the perfection of well-being along with the complete continuation of Your blessings upon me until the end of my term. I ask You (azj) with the request of one who has done wrong, and committed injustice, and confesses (his guilt). And I ask You (azj) to forgive me for the past sins which Your watchers have counted and which Your noble angels have recorded against me. And that You (azj) protect me, O’ my God (azj), from sins in what remains of my life until the end of my term. O’ Allah (swt), O’ All-Beneficent, send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), And grant me everything I have asked You (azj) for and turned to You (azj) in desire for, for indeed You (azj) have commanded me to supplicate and promised to respond, O’ Most Merciful of the merciful.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 114

chapter: Chapter on Supplication Between the Units of Prayer (Rak‘at)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ya‘qub, from al-Husayn ibn Muhammad, from Ahmad ibn Ishaq al-Qummi, from Sa’adan ibn Muslim, from Abu Basir, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said in the farewell of the Month of Ramadan: “O’ Allah (swt), indeed You (azj) have said in Your revealed Book, upon the tongue of Your sent Prophet (saws), Your blessings be upon him and his family, and Your word is truth: ‘The Month of Ramadan in which was revealed the Qur’an’ (Surah Al-Baqarah 2:185); and now this Month of Ramadan has passed by. So I ask You (azj) by Your Noble Face and by Your complete words; if there remains upon me any sin which You (azj) have not yet forgiven me for, or that You (azj) will punish me for, or take me to account for (I ask You (azj)) that the dawn of this night not rise, nor this month come to a close, except that You (azj) have forgiven it for me, O’ Most Merciful of the merciful. O’ Allah (swt), to You (azj) belongs all praise with all forms of praise, its first and its last, what You (azj) have praised Yourself with, and what the praising creatures have said for You (azj) those who strive, enumerate, and devote themselves in Your remembrance and gratitude; those whom You (azj) have assisted in fulfilling Your due, right from among the various ranks of Your creation of the angels brought near, and the prophets and the messengers, and the various ranks of those who speak and glorify You (azj) from among all the worlds. For the fact that You (azj) caused us to reach the Month of Ramadan, And (that) upon us was from Your blessings, And in our possession from Your allotment, And Your beneficence, And the manifestation of Your generosity for that, to You (azj) belongs the utmost praise; everlasting, enduring, settled, perpetual praise that never comes to an end, throughout all eternity. Exalted is Your praise. You (azj) assisted us in it until You (azj) enabled us, to fulfill its fasting and its nightly standing in prayer and devotion. And whatever acts of righteousness, or gratitude, or remembrance that we performed in it, O’ Allah (swt), accept it from us with the best of Your acceptance, And through Your overlooking, Your pardon, Your forgiveness, Your clemency, and the reality of Your pleasure until You (azj) grant us therein every desired good, and abundant granted gifts, and grant us safety from every feared matter and acquired sin. O’ Allah (swt), I ask You (azj) by the greatest of what any of Your creation has ever asked You (azj), by the nobility of Your Names, the abundance of Your praise, and the specificity of Your invocation, to send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), And to make this month of ours the greatest Month of Ramadan to pass over us since You (azj) placed us in this world, Both in blessings upon the protection of my religion, And the salvation of my soul, And the fulfillment of my needs, And the acceptance of my supplications, And the completion of Your bounty upon me, And the repelling of evil from me, And the clothing of well-being for me. And that You (azj) make me, by Your mercy, among those for whom You (azj) secured the Night of al-Qadr, and made it for him better than ‘a thousand months’ (Surah Al Qadr) in the greatest reward, the most noble reserves, the longest life, the best gratitude, and the continuity of ease. O’ Allah (swt), I also ask You (azj) by Your mercy, and Your bounty, and Your pardon, and Your blessings, and Your majesty, and Your ancient kindness and generosity, that You (azj) do not make this our last encounter with the Month of Ramadan, until You (azj) allow us to reach it again in the coming year in the best of states, and that You (azj) show me its crescent moon together with those who behold it and recognize it, in the fullest of Your well-being, the most gracious of Your blessings, the vastest of Your mercy, and the most abundant of Your allotment. O’ Allah (swt), O’ my Lord (azj), there is no Lord (azj) for me other than You (azj), do not make this farewell of mine a farewell of separation and extinction. And not the last of the covenant of encounter, until You (azj) show it to me again in the fullness of blessings and the best of hopes, while I remain in the finest state of loyalty to You (azj), ‘indeed, You are the Hearer of supplication’ (Surah Al Imran 3:38). O’ Allah (swt), hear my supplication, my humble entreaty, my submissiveness before You (azj), my brokenness, and my reliance upon You (azj). I am in full submission to You (azj), I seek no success, no well-being, no honor, and no attainment except through You (azj), and from You (azj). So bestow it upon me, Exalted is Your praise, and sanctified are Your names by allowing me to reach the Month of Ramadan again while I am safe from every disliked and feared thing, and from all calamities. All praise is due to Allah (swt), who aided us in the fasting of this month and its nightly standing, until He (azj) brought us to its final night.”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ اَلْقُمِّيِّ عَنْ سَعْدَانَ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ:« فِي وَدَاعِ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ اَللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ قُلْتَ فِي كِتَابِكَ اَلْمُنْزَلِ عَلَى لِسَانِ نَبِيِّكَ اَلْمُرْسَلِ صَلَوَاتُكَ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ وَ قَوْلُكَ حَقٌّ« شَهْرُ رَمَضٰانَ اَلَّذِي أُنْزِلَ فِيهِ اَلْقُرْآنُ وَ هَذَا شَهْرُ رَمَضَانَ قَدْ تَصَرَّمَ فَأَسْأَلُكَ بِوَجْهِكَ اَلْكَرِيمِ وَ كَلِمَاتِكَ اَلتَّامَّةِ إِنْ كَانَ بَقِيَ عَلَيَّ ذَنْبٌ لَمْ تَغْفِرْهُ لِي أَوْ تُرِيدُ أَنْ تُعَذِّبَنِي عَلَيْهِ أَوْ تُقَايِسَنِي بِهِ أَنْ يَطْلُعَ فَجْرُ هَذِهِ اَللَّيْلَةِ أَوْ يَتَصَرَّمَ هَذَا اَلشَّهْرُ إِلاَّ وَ قَدْ غَفَرْتَهُ لِي يَا أَرْحَمَ اَلرَّاحِمِينَ اَللَّهُمَّ لَكَ اَلْحَمْدُ بِمَحَامِدِكَ كُلِّهَا أَوَّلِهَا وَ آخِرِهَا مَا قُلْتَ لِنَفْسِكَ مِنْهَا وَ مَا قَالَ لَكَ اَلْخَلاَئِقُ اَلْحَامِدُونَ اَلْمُجْتَهِدُونَ اَلْمُعَدِّدُونَ اَلْمُؤْثِرُونَ فِي ذِكْرِكَ وَ اَلشُّكْرِ لَكَ اَلَّذِينَ أَعَنْتَهُمْ عَلَى أَدَاءِ حَقِّكَ مِنْ أَصْنَافِ خَلْقِكَ مِنَ اَلْمَلاَئِكَةِ اَلْمُقَرَّبِينَ وَ اَلنَّبِيِّينَ وَ اَلْمُرْسَلِينَ وَ أَصْنَافِ اَلنَّاطِقِينَ اَلْمُسَبِّحِينَ لَكَ مِنْ جَمِيعِ اَلْعَالَمِينَ عَلَى أَنَّكَ بَلَّغْتَنَا شَهْرَ رَمَضَانَ وَ عَلَيْنَا مِنْ نِعَمِكَ وَ عِنْدَنَا مِنْ قَسْمِكَ وَ إِحْسَانِكَ وَ تَظَاهُرِ اِمْتِنَانِكَ بِذَلِكَ لَكَ مُنْتَهَى اَلْحَمْدِ اَلْخَالِدِ اَلدَّائِمِ اَلرَّاكِدِ اَلْمُخَلَّدِ اَلسَّرْمَدِ اَلَّذِي لاَ يَنْفَدُ طُولَ اَلْأَبَدِ جَلَّ ثَنَاؤُكَ أَعَنْتَنَا عَلَيْهِ حَتَّى قَضَيْتَ عَنَّا صِيَامَهُ وَ قِيَامَهُ مِنْ صَلاَةٍ وَ مَا كَانَ مِنَّا فِيهِ مِنْ بِرٍّ أَوْ شُكْرٍ أَوْ ذِكْرٍ اَللَّهُمَّ فَتَقَبَّلْهُ مِنَّا بِأَ حْسَنِ قَبُولِكَ وَ تَجَاوُزِكَ وَ عَفْوِكَ وَ صَفْحِكَ وَ غُفْرَانِكَ وَ حَقِيقَةِ رِضْوَانِكَ حَتَّى تُظْفِرَنَا فِيهِ بِكُلِّ خَيْرٍ مَطْلُوبٍ وَجَزِيلِ عَطَاءٍ مَوْهُوبٍ وَ تُؤْمِنَنَا فِيهِ مِنْ كُلِّ أَمْرٍ مَرْهُوبٍ وَذَنْبٍ مَكْسُوبٍ اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِعَظِيمِ مَا سَأَلَكَ أَحَدٌ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ مِنْ كَرِيمِ أَسْمَائِكَ وَ جَزِيلِ ثَنَائِكَ وَ خَاصَّةِ دُعَائِكَ أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ أَنْ تَجْعَلَ شَهْرَنَا هَذَا أَعْظَمَ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ مَرَّ عَلَيْنَا مُنْذُ أَنْزَلْتَنَا إِلَى اَلدُّنْيَا بَرَكَةً فِي عِصْمَةِ دِينِي وَ خَلاَصِ نَفْسِي وَ قَضَاءِ حَاجَتِي وَ تَشْفِيعِي فِي مَسَائِلِي وَ تَمَامِ اَلنِّعْمَةِ عَلَيَّ وَ صَرْفِ اَلسُّوءِ عَنِّي وَ لِبَاسِ اَلْعَافِيَةِ لِي وَ أَنْ تَجْعَلَنِي بِرَحْمَتِكَ مِمَّنْ حُزْتَ لَهُ لَيْلَةَ اَلْقَدْرِ وَ جَعَلْتَهَا لَهُ خَيْراً« مِنْ أَلْفِ شَهْرٍ» فِي أَعْظَمِ اَلْأَجْرِ وَ كَرَائِمِ اَلذُّخْرِ وَ طُولِ اَلْعُمُرِ وَ حُسْنِ اَلشُّكْرِ وَ دَوَامِ اَلْيُسْرِ اَللَّهُمَّ وَ أَسْأَلُكَ بِرَحْمَتِكَ وَ طَوْلِكَ وَ عَفْوِكَ وَ نَعْمَائِكَ وَ جَلاَلِكَ وَ قَدِيمِ إِحْسَانِكَ وَ اِمْتِنَانِكَ أَنْ لاَ تَجْعَلَهُ آخِرَ اَلْعَهْدِ مِنَّا بِشَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ حَتَّى تُبَلِّغَنَاهُ مِنْ قَابِلٍ عَلَى أَحْسَنِ حَالٍ وَ تُعَرِّفَنِي هِلاَلَهُ مَعَ اَلنَّاظِرِينَ إِلَيْهِ وَ اَلْمُتَعَرِّفِينَ لَهُ فِي أَعْفَى عَافِيَتِكَ وَ أَنْعَمِ نِعْمَتِكَ وَ أَوْسَعِ رَحْمَتِكَ وَ أَجْزَلِ قَسْمِكَ اَللَّهُمَّ يَا رَبِّيَ اَلَّذِي لَيْسَ لِي رَبٌّ غَيْرُهُ لاَ يَكُونُ هَذَا اَلْوَدَاعُ مِنِّي وَدَاعَ فَنَاءٍ وَ لاَ آخِرَ اَلْعَهْدِ مِنَ اَللِّقَاءِ حَتَّى تُرِيَنِيهِ مِنْ قَابِلٍ فِي أَسْبَغِ اَلنِّعَمِ وَ أَفْضَلِ اَلرَّجَاءِ وَ أَنَا لَكَ عَلَى أَحْسَنِ اَلْوَفَاءِ« إِنَّكَ سَمِيعُ اَلدُّعٰاءِ اَللَّهُمَّ اِسْمَعْ دُعَائِي وَ تَضَرُّعِي وَ تَذَلُّلِي لَكَ وَاِسْتِكَانَتِي وَ تَوَكُّلِي عَلَيْكَ وَأَنَا لَكَ سِلْمٌ لاَ أَرْجُو نَجَاحاً وَلاَ مُعَافَاةً وَلاَ تَشْرِيفاً وَلاَ تَبْلِيغاً إِلاَّ بِكَ وَ مِنْكَ فَامْنُنْ عَلَيَّ جَلَّ ثَنَاؤُكَ وَ تَقَدَّسَتْ أَسْمَاؤُكَ بِتَبْلِيغِي شَهْرَ رَمَضَانَ وَ أَنَا مُعَافًى مِنْ كُلِّ مَكْرُوهٍ وَ مَحْذُورٍ مِنْ جَمِيعِ اَلْبَوَائِقِ اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ اَلَّذِي أَعَانَنَا عَلَى صِيَامِ هَذَا اَلشَّهْرِ وَ قِيَامِهِ حَتَّى بَلَّغَنَا آخِرَ لَيْلَةٍ مِنْهُ»
