chapter: Chapter on the Prayer over the Dead
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ali ibn al-Hasan from Ahmad ibn Idris from Muhammad ibn Salim from Ahmad ibn al-Nadr from Amr ibn Shimr from Jabir from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, he said:
Imam al-Baqir (a.s) said: “The Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, used to stand (for Salat Al Mayyit) in the case of a man; opposite the navel, and in the case of women; lower than that, before the chest.”
arabicText: عَلِيُّ بْنُ اَلْحَسَنِ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ إِدْرِيسَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سَالِمٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ اَلنَّضْرِ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ شِمْرٍ عَنْ جَابِرٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« كَانَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ يَقُومُ مِنَ اَلرَّجُلِ بِحِيَالِ اَلسُّرَّةِ وَ مِنَ اَلنِّسَاءِ أَدْوَنَ مِنْ ذَلِكَ قَبْلَ اَلصَّدْرِ»
thaqalaynSanad: Ali ibn al-Hasan from Ahmad ibn Idris from Muhammad ibn Salim from Ahmad ibn al-Nadr from Amr ibn Shimr from Jabir from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, he said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Baqir (a.s) said: “The Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, used to stand (for Salat Al Mayyit) in the case of a man; opposite the navel, and in the case of women; lower than that, before the chest.”

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer over the Dead
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Said from al-Hasan from Zurah from Sama’ah he said:
I asked Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) about the funeral processions of men and women, when they are brought together. Imam (a.s) said: “The man is placed slightly ahead of the woman, and the woman is placed slightly lower than that, at the level of his feet. And the imam (of Salat Al Mayyit) stands at the head of the deceased and prays over both of them together.” And I asked Imam (a.s) about the prayer over the deceased. Imam (a.s) said: “Five takbirs. You say when you pronounce the takbirs; ‘I bear witness that there is no God but Allah (swt), alone, without any partner, and I bear witness that (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) is His (swt) servant and messenger. O’ Allah (swt), send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws) and upon the Imams (a.s) of guidance. And forgive us and our brothers who preceded us in faith, and do not place in our hearts any resentment toward those who have believed. Our Lord (azj), indeed You (azj) are Kind and Merciful. O’ Allah (swt), forgive our living and our dead, among the believing men and believing women, and unite our hearts upon the hearts of our best ones, and guide us, by Your permission, to the truth concerning that over which there is disagreement indeed, You (azj) guide whom You (azj) will to a straight path.’ If the second takbir interrupts you, it does not harm you, so say: ‘O’ Allah (swt), this is Your servant, the son of Your servant, and the son of Your bondwoman. You (azj) know him best. He is in need of You (azj), and You (azj) are free of need from him. O’ Allah (swt), overlook his bad deeds, And increase his good deeds, And forgive him, And have mercy on him, And illuminate his grave for him, And prompt him with his proof, And join him with his Prophet (saws). Do not deprive us of his reward, and do not subject us to trial after him.’ Say this when you complete the five takbirs. And when you finish, give salam to your right. (said in taqiyyah, mentioned later)
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ عَنْ زُرْعَةَ عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ جَنَائِزِ اَلرِّجَالِ وَ اَلنِّسَاءِ إِذَا اِجْتَمَعَتْ فَقَالَ «يُقَدَّمُ اَلرَّجُلُ قُدَّامَ اَلْمَرْأَةِ قَلِيلاً وَ تُوضَعُ اَلْمَرْأَةُ أَسْفَلَ مِنْ ذَلِكَ قَلِيلاً عِنْدَ رِجْلَيْهِ وَ يَقُومُ اَلْإِمَامُ عِنْدَ رَأْسِ اَلْمَيِّتِ فَيُصَلِّي عَلَيْهِمَا جَمِيعاً» وَ سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلصَّلاَةِ عَلَى اَلْمَيِّتِ فَقَالَ« خَمْسُ تَكْبِيرَاتٍ تَقُولُ إِذَا كَبَّرَ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اَللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ وَ أَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّداً عَبْدُهُ وَ رَسُولُهُ اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ عَلَى أَئِمَّةِ اَلْهُدَى وَ «اِغْفِرْ لَنٰا وَ لِإِ خْوٰانِنَا اَلَّذِينَ سَبَقُونٰا بِالْإِيمٰانِ وَ لاٰ تَجْعَلْ فِي قُلُوبِنٰا غِلاًّ لِلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا رَبَّنٰا إِنَّكَ رَؤُفٌ رَحِيمٌ» اَللَّهُمَّ اِغْفِرْ لِأَ حْيَائِنَا وَ أَمْوَاتِنَا مِنَ اَلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَ اَلْمُؤْمِنَاتِ وَ أَلِّفْ بَيْنَ قُلُوبِنَا عَلَى قُلُوبِ خِيَارِنَا وَ اِهْدِنَا لِمَا اُخْتُلِفَ فِيهِ مِنَ اَلْحَقِّ بِإِذْنِكَ إِنَّكَ تَهْدِي مَنْ تَشَاءُ إِلَى صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ فَإِنْ قَطَعَ عَلَيْكَ اَلتَّكْبِيرَةَ اَلثَّانِيَةَ فَلاَ يَضُرُّكَ فَقُلِ اَللَّهُمَّ هَذَا عَبْدُكَ وَ اِبْنُ عَبْدِكَ وَ اِبْنُ أَمَتِكَ أَنْتَ أَعْلَمُ بِهِ اِفْتَقَرَ إِلَيْكَ وَ اِسْتَغْنَيْتَ عَنْهُ اَللَّهُمَّ تَجَاوَزْ عَنْ سَيِّئَاتِهِ وَ زِدْ فِي إِحْسَانِهِ وَ اِغْفِرْ لَهُ وَ اِرْحَمْهُ وَ نَوِّرْ لَهُ فِي قَبْرِهِ وَ لَقِّنْهُ حُجَّتَهُ وَ أَلْحِقْهُ بِنَبِيِّهِ وَ لاَ تَحْرِمْنَا أَجْرَهُ وَ لاَ تَفْتِنَّا بَعْدَهُ قُلْ هَذَا حِينَ تَفْرُغُ مِنَ اَلْخَمْسِ تَكْبِيرَاتٍ فَإِذَا فَرَغْتَ سَلَّمْتَ عَنْ يَمِينِكَ»
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Said from al-Hasan from Zurah from Sama’ah he said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) about the funeral processions of men and women, when they are brought together. Imam (a.s) said: “The man is placed slightly ahead of the woman, and the woman is placed slightly lower than that, at the level of his feet. And the imam (of Salat Al Mayyit) stands at the head of the deceased and prays over both of them together.” And I asked Imam (a.s) about the prayer over the deceased. Imam (a.s) said: “Five takbirs. You say when you pronounce the takbirs; ‘I bear witness that there is no God but Allah (swt), alone, without any partner, and I bear witness that (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) is His (swt) servant and messenger. O’ Allah (swt), send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws) and upon the Imams (a.s) of guidance. And forgive us and our brothers who preceded us in faith, and do not place in our hearts any resentment toward those who have believed. Our Lord (azj), indeed You (azj) are Kind and Merciful. O’ Allah (swt), forgive our living and our dead, among the believing men and believing women, and unite our hearts upon the hearts of our best ones, and guide us, by Your permission, to the truth concerning that over which there is disagreement indeed, You (azj) guide whom You (azj) will to a straight path.’ If the second takbir interrupts you, it does not harm you, so say: ‘O’ Allah (swt), this is Your servant, the son of Your servant, and the son of Your bondwoman. You (azj) know him best. He is in need of You (azj), and You (azj) are free of need from him. O’ Allah (swt), overlook his bad deeds, And increase his good deeds, And forgive him, And have mercy on him, And illuminate his grave for him, And prompt him with his proof, And join him with his Prophet (saws). Do not deprive us of his reward, and do not subject us to trial after him.’ Say this when you complete the five takbirs. And when you finish, give salam to your right. (said in taqiyyah, mentioned later)

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 210

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer over the Dead
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub from Abu Walad he said:
I asked Aba Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about the takbirs over the deceased. Imam (a.s) said: “Five takbirs. You say when you pronounce the takbir: ‘I bear witness that there is no God but Allah (swt), alone, with no partner. O’ Allah (swt), send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws).’ Then you say: ‘O’ Allah (swt), this shrouded one lying before us is Your servant and the son of Your servant. You (azj) have seized his soul and he is now in need of Your mercy, and You (azj) are free from needing to punish him. O’ Allah (swt), we know nothing of his outward condition except good, and You (azj) are most knowledgeable of his inward state. O’ Allah (swt), if he was a doer of good, then multiply his good deeds, and if he was a wrongdoer, then overlook his misdeeds.’ Then you pronounce the second takbir, and you do the same after each takbir.”
arabicText: اَلْحَسَنُ بْنُ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ أَبِي وَلاَّدٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلتَّكْبِيرِ عَلَى اَلْمَيِّتِ فَقَالَ« خَمْسُ تَكْبِيرَاتٍ تَقُولُ إِذَا كَبَّرْتَ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اَللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ ثُمَّ تَقُولُ اَللَّهُمَّ إِنَّ هَذَا اَلْمُسَجَّى قُدَّامَنَا عَبْدُكَ وَ اِبْنُ عَبْدِكَ وَ قَدْ قَبَضْتَ رُوحَهُ إِلَيْكَ وَ قَدِ اِحْتَاجَ إِلَى رَحْمَتِكَ وَ أَنْتَ غَنِيٌّ عَنْ عَذَابِهِ اَللَّهُمَّ وَ لاَ نَعْلَمُ مِنْ ظَاهِرِهِ إِلاَّ خَيْراً وَ أَنْتَ أَعْلَمُ بِسَرِيرَتِهِ اَللَّهُمَّ إِنْ كَانَ مُحْسِناً فَضَاعِفْ إِحْسَانَهُ وَ إِنْ كَانَ مُسِيئاً فَتَجَاوَزْ عَنْ إِسَاءَتِهِ ثُمَّ تُكَبِّرُ اَلثَّانِيَةَ ثُمَّ تَفْعَلُ ذَلِكَ فِي كُلِّ تَكْبِيرَةٍ»
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub from Abu Walad he said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Aba Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about the takbirs over the deceased. Imam (a.s) said: “Five takbirs. You say when you pronounce the takbir: ‘I bear witness that there is no God but Allah (swt), alone, with no partner. O’ Allah (swt), send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws).’ Then you say: ‘O’ Allah (swt), this shrouded one lying before us is Your servant and the son of Your servant. You (azj) have seized his soul and he is now in need of Your mercy, and You (azj) are free from needing to punish him. O’ Allah (swt), we know nothing of his outward condition except good, and You (azj) are most knowledgeable of his inward state. O’ Allah (swt), if he was a doer of good, then multiply his good deeds, and if he was a wrongdoer, then overlook his misdeeds.’ Then you pronounce the second takbir, and you do the same after each takbir.”

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer over the Dead
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Yaqub from a number of our companions from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Muhammad ibn Sinan from Abdillah ibn Muskan from al-Halabi, he said:
Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: “There is no taslim (salutation of peace) in the prayer over the deceased (Salat Al Mayyit).”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عِدَّةٍ مِنْ أَصْحَابِنَا عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنِ اَلْحَلَبِيِّ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ:« لَيْسَ فِي اَلصَّلاَةِ عَلَى اَلْمَيِّتِ تَسْلِيمٌ»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Yaqub from a number of our companions from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Muhammad ibn Sinan from Abdillah ibn Muskan from al-Halabi, he said:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: “There is no taslim (salutation of peace) in the prayer over the deceased (Salat Al Mayyit).”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 211

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer over the Dead
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Ibn Abi Umayr from Hammad ibn Uthman from al-Halabi and Zurarah from Abu Ja’far (a.s) and Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon them both, said:
Imam (a.s) said: “There is no taslim (salutation of peace) in the prayer over the deceased (Salat Al Mayyit).”
arabicText: وعنه عن علي بن ابراهيم عن ابيه عن ابن ابى عمير عن حماد بن عثمان عن الحلبي وزرارة عن ابى جعفر وابي عبد الله عليهما السلام قالا ليس في الصلاة على الميت تسليم
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Ibn Abi Umayr from Hammad ibn Uthman from al-Halabi and Zurarah from Abu Ja’far (a.s) and Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon them both, said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: “There is no taslim (salutation of peace) in the prayer over the deceased (Salat Al Mayyit).”

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer over the Dead
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ismail ibn Sa’ad al-Ashari from Abu al-Hasan al-Ridha (a.s), peace be upon him, he said:
I asked Imam al-Ridha (a.s) about the prayer over the deceased (Salat Al Mayyit). Imam (a.s) said: “As for the believer, five takbirs; and as for the hypocrite, four and there is no salam in it.”
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ سَعْدٍ اَلْأَشْعَرِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي اَلْحَسَنِ اَلرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلصَّلاَةِ عَلَى اَلْمَيِّتِ فَقَالَ« أَمَّا اَلْمُؤْمِنُ فَخَمْسُ تَكْبِيرَاتٍ وَ أَمَّا اَلْمُنَافِقُ فَأَرْبَعٌ وَ لاَ سَلاَمَ فِيهَا»
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ismail ibn Sa’ad al-Ashari from Abu al-Hasan al-Ridha (a.s), peace be upon him, he said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Imam al-Ridha (a.s) about the prayer over the deceased (Salat Al Mayyit). Imam (a.s) said: “As for the believer, five takbirs; and as for the hypocrite, four and there is no salam in it.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 212

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer over the Dead
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
As for what was narrated by Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa from Muhammad ibn Ismail ibn Buzay from his uncle Hamzah ibn Buzay from Ali ibn Suwayd from al-Ridha (a.s), peace be upon him, as we understand, he said:
Imam al-Ridha (a.s) said: “In the prayer over the deceased (Salat Al Mayyit), you recite in the first (takbir) Surah al-Fatihah; in the second (takbir), you send blessings upon the Prophet (saws), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family; in the third (takbir), you supplicate for the believing men and believing women; in the fourth (takbir), you supplicate for your deceased; and the fifth (takbir) is the one by which you conclude.”
arabicText: فَأَمَّا مَا رَوَاهُ أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ بَزِيعٍ عَنْ عَمِّهِ حَمْزَةَ بْنِ بَزِيعٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ سُوَيْدٍ عَنِ اَلرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ فِيمَا نَعْلَمُ قَالَ:« فِي اَلصَّلاَةِ عَلَى اَلْجَنَائِزِ تَقْرَأُ فِي اَلْأُولَى بِأُمِّ اَلْكِتَابِ وَ فِي اَلثَّانِيَةِ تُصَلِّي عَلَى اَلنَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ وَ تَدْعُو فِي اَلثَّالِثَةِ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَ اَلْمُؤْمِنَاتِ وَ تَدْعُو فِي اَلرَّابِعَةِ لِمَيِّتِكَ وَ اَلْخَامِسَةُ تَنْصَرِفُ بِهَا»
thaqalaynSanad: As for what was narrated by Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa from Muhammad ibn Ismail ibn Buzay from his uncle Hamzah ibn Buzay from Ali ibn Suwayd from al-Ridha (a.s), peace be upon him, as we understand, he said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Ridha (a.s) said: “In the prayer over the deceased (Salat Al Mayyit), you recite in the first (takbir) Surah al-Fatihah; in the second (takbir), you send blessings upon the Prophet (saws), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family; in the third (takbir), you supplicate for the believing men and believing women; in the fourth (takbir), you supplicate for your deceased; and the fifth (takbir) is the one by which you conclude.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 212

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer over the Dead
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from Muhammad ibn Ismail ibn Buzay from his uncle from Ali ibn Suwayd al-Sai:
Abu al-Hasan al-Awwal (a.s), peace be upon him, (narrated) the like of that.
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ بَزِيعٍ عَنْ عَمِّهِ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ سُوَيْدٍ اَلسَّائِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي اَلْحَسَنِ اَلْأَوَّلِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ.
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from Muhammad ibn Ismail ibn Buzay from his uncle from Ali ibn Suwayd al-Sai:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu al-Hasan al-Awwal (a.s), peace be upon him, (narrated) the like of that.

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 212

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer over the Dead
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Yaqub from Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Ibn Abi Umayr from Ibn Udhaynah from Muhammad ibn Muslim, Zurarah, Mamar ibn Yahya, and Ismail al-Jufi from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, he said:
Imam al-Baqir (a.s) said: “There is no recitation in the prayer over the deceased (Salat Al Mayyit), nor any fixed supplication. You may supplicate with whatever occurs to you. And the one most deserving, among the dead, to be prayed for is the believer, and the prayer should begin with blessings upon the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family.”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أُذَيْنَةَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ وَ زُرَارَةَ وَ مَعْمَرِ بْنِ يَحْيَى وَ إِسْمَاعِيلَ اَلْجُعْفِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« لَيْسَ فِي اَلصَّلاَةِ عَلَى اَلْمَيِّتِ قِرَاءَةٌ وَ لاَ دُعَاءٌ مُوَقَّتٌ تَدْعُو كَمَا بَدَا لَكَ وَ أَحَقُّ اَلْمَوْتَى أَنْ يُدْعَى لَهُ اَلْمُؤْمِنُ وَ أَنْ يُبْدَأَ بِالصَّلاَةِ عَلَى رَسُولِ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Yaqub from Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Ibn Abi Umayr from Ibn Udhaynah from Muhammad ibn Muslim, Zurarah, Mamar ibn Yahya, and Ismail al-Jufi from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, he said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Baqir (a.s) said: “There is no recitation in the prayer over the deceased (Salat Al Mayyit), nor any fixed supplication. You may supplicate with whatever occurs to you. And the one most deserving, among the dead, to be prayed for is the believer, and the prayer should begin with blessings upon the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family.”

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer over the Dead
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya from Ghayath in a mursal form, and it was also narrated by Sa’ad from Abu Ja’far from his father from Abdillah ibn al-Mughirah from Ghayath ibn Ibrahim from Abu Abdillah (a.s) from Imam Ali (a.s), peace be upon him:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “That Imam Ali (a.s) would not raise his hands in the funeral prayer, except once - meaning with the (first) takbir.”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ غِيَاثٍ مُرْسَلاً وَ رَوَاهُ سَعْدٌ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ اَلْمُغِيرَةِ عَنْ غِيَاثِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ عَلِيٍّ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ:« أَنَّهُ كَانَ لاَ يَرْفَعُ يَدَهُ فِي اَلْجِنَازَةِ إِلاَّ مَرَّةً وَاحِدَةً يَعْنِي فِي اَلتَّكْبِيرِ»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya from Ghayath in a mursal form, and it was also narrated by Sa’ad from Abu Ja’far from his father from Abdillah ibn al-Mughirah from Ghayath ibn Ibrahim from Abu Abdillah (a.s) from Imam Ali (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “That Imam Ali (a.s) would not raise his hands in the funeral prayer, except once - meaning with the (first) takbir.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 213

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer over the Dead
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ali ibn al-Husayn ibn Babawayh, may Allah (swt) have mercy on him, narrated from Sa’ad ibn Abdillah and Muhammad ibn Yahya, both from Salamah ibn al-Khattab. He said: Isma’il ibn Ishaq ibn Aban al-Warraq narrated to me from Imam Ja’far (a.s) from his father, Imam al-Baqir (a.s), peace be upon them. He said:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “The Commander of the Faithful, Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (a.s), peace be upon him, used to raise his hand at the first takbir over the deceased (Salat Al Mayyit), then would not do so again until He (a.s) completed (the prayer).”
arabicText: وَ رَوَى عَلِيُّ بْنُ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ بَابَوَيْهِ رَحِمَهُ اَللَّهُ عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ وَ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى جَمِيعاً عَنْ سَلَمَةَ بْنِ اَلْخَطَّابِ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ أَبَانٍ اَلْوَرَّاقُ عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَلَيْهِمَا اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« كَانَ أَمِيرُ اَلْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلِيُّ بْنُ أَبِي طَالِبٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ يَرْفَعُ يَدَهُ فِي أَوَّلِ اَلتَّكْبِيرِ عَلَى اَلْجِنَازَةِ ثُمَّ لاَ يَعُودُ حَتَّى يَنْصَرِفَ»
thaqalaynSanad: Ali ibn al-Husayn ibn Babawayh, may Allah (swt) have mercy on him, narrated from Sa’ad ibn Abdillah and Muhammad ibn Yahya, both from Salamah ibn al-Khattab. He said: Isma’il ibn Ishaq ibn Aban al-Warraq narrated to me from Imam Ja’far (a.s) from his father, Imam al-Baqir (a.s), peace be upon them. He said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “The Commander of the Faithful, Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (a.s), peace be upon him, used to raise his hand at the first takbir over the deceased (Salat Al Mayyit), then would not do so again until He (a.s) completed (the prayer).”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 214

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer over the Dead
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa narrated from Ali ibn al-Hakam from Abdur Rahman ibn al-Arzami from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him. He said:
I prayed behind Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, over a deceased person (Salat Al Mayyit), and Imam (a.s) said five takbirs, raising His (a.s) hand in each takbir.
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ اَلْحَكَمِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَلرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ اَلْعَرْزَمِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: صَلَّيْتُ خَلْفَ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَى جِنَازَةٍ فَكَبَّرَ خَمْساً يَرْفَعُ يَدَهُ فِي كُلِّ تَكْبِيرَةٍ
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa narrated from Ali ibn al-Hakam from Abdur Rahman ibn al-Arzami from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him. He said:
thaqalaynMatn: I prayed behind Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, over a deceased person (Salat Al Mayyit), and Imam (a.s) said five takbirs, raising His (a.s) hand in each takbir.

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer over the Dead
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Yaqub narrated from a number of our companions from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Muhammad ibn Isa from Yunus. He said:
I asked Imam al-Ridha (a.s), peace be upon him: “May I be your ransom, the people raise their hands in the takbir over the deceased (Salat Al Mayyit) in the first takbir and do not raise them after that. So should I limit myself to (raising hands in) the first takbir as they do, or should I raise my hands in every takbir?” Imam (a.s) said: “Raise your hands in every takbir.”
arabicText: وَ رَوَى مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عِدَّةٍ مِنْ أَصْحَابِنَا عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ يُونُسَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ اَلرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قُلْتُ جُعِلْتُ فِدَاكَ إِنَّ اَلنَّاسَ يَرْفَعُونَ أَيْدِيَهُمْ فِي اَلتَّكْبِيرِ عَلَى اَلْمَيِّتِ فِي اَلتَّكْبِيرَةِ اَلْأُولَى وَ لاَ يَرْفَعُونَ فِيمَا بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ فَأَقْتَصِرُ عَلَى اَلتَّكْبِيرَةِ اَلْأُولَى كَمَا يَفْعَلُونَ أَوْ أَرْفَعُ يَدَيَّ فِي كُلِّ تَكْبِيرَةٍ فَقَالَ« اِرْفَعْ يَدَيْكَ فِي كُلِّ تَكْبِيرَةٍ»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Yaqub narrated from a number of our companions from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Muhammad ibn Isa from Yunus. He said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Imam al-Ridha (a.s), peace be upon him: “May I be your ransom, the people raise their hands in the takbir over the deceased (Salat Al Mayyit) in the first takbir and do not raise them after that. So should I limit myself to (raising hands in) the first takbir as they do, or should I raise my hands in every takbir?” Imam (a.s) said: “Raise your hands in every takbir.”

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer over the Dead
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Sa’id ibn Uqda narrated in the book ‘al-Rijal’. He said: Ahmad ibn Umar ibn Muhammad ibn al-Hasan narrated to me. He said: My father narrated to us. He said: Muhammad ibn Abdillah ibn Khalid, the client (mawla) of Banu al-Sayyida, narrated to us that:
(Muhammad ibn Abdillah ibn Khalid) prayed behind Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad (a.s), peace be upon him, over a deceased person (Salat Al Mayyit), and he saw Imam (a.s) raising his hands in every takbir.
arabicText: وَ رَوَى أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍاِ بْنُ عُقْدَةَ فِي كِتَابِ اَلرِّجَالِ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عُمَرَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحَسَنِ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ مَوْلَى بَنِي اَلصَّيْدَاءِ: أَنَّهُ صَلَّى خَلْفَ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَى جِنَازَةٍ فَرَآهُ يَرْفَعُ يَدَيْهِ فِي كُلِّ تَكْبِيرَةٍ
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Sa’id ibn Uqda narrated in the book ‘al-Rijal’. He said: Ahmad ibn Umar ibn Muhammad ibn al-Hasan narrated to me. He said: My father narrated to us. He said: Muhammad ibn Abdillah ibn Khalid, the client (mawla) of Banu al-Sayyida, narrated to us that:
thaqalaynMatn: (Muhammad ibn Abdillah ibn Khalid) prayed behind Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad (a.s), peace be upon him, over a deceased person (Salat Al Mayyit), and he saw Imam (a.s) raising his hands in every takbir.

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer over the Dead
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya narrated from Abu Ja’far from his father from Hafs ibn Ghiyath from Imam Ja’far (a.s) from his father, Imam al-Baqir (a.s), peace be upon them both:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) narrated from Imam al-Baqir (a.s): “Indeed, Imam Ali (a.s), peace be upon him, when He (a.s) prayed over a deceased person (Salat Al Mayyit), would not leave his place of prayer until He (a.s) saw it being carried by the hands of the men.”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ حَفْصِ بْنِ غِيَاثٍ عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَلَيْهِمَا اَلسَّلاَمُ:« أَنَّ عَلِيّاً عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ كَانَ إِذَا صَلَّى عَلَى جِنَازَةٍ لَمْ يَبْرَحْ مِنْ مُصَلاَّهُ حَتَّى يَرَاهَا عَلَى أَيْدِي اَلرِّجَالِ»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya narrated from Abu Ja’far from his father from Hafs ibn Ghiyath from Imam Ja’far (a.s) from his father, Imam al-Baqir (a.s), peace be upon them both:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) narrated from Imam al-Baqir (a.s): “Indeed, Imam Ali (a.s), peace be upon him, when He (a.s) prayed over a deceased person (Salat Al Mayyit), would not leave his place of prayer until He (a.s) saw it being carried by the hands of the men.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 214

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer over the Dead
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ali ibn al-Husayn from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya from Abu al-Jawza, al-Munabbih ibn Abdillah from al-Husayn ibn ‘Alwan from Amr ibn Khalid from Zayd ibn Ali from his forefathers:
Imam Ali (a.s) said regarding the prayer (Salat Al Mayyit) over a child. Imam (a.s) used to say: “O’ Allah (swt), make him a predecessor (salafan) and a forerunner (faratan) and a reward (ajran) for his parents and for us.”
arabicText: وَ رَوَى عَلِيُّ بْنُ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَبِي اَلْجَوْزَاءِ اَلْمُنَبِّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ عُلْوَانَ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ خَالِدٍ عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ عَنْ آبَائِهِ عَنْ عَلِيٍّ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: فِي اَلصَّلاَةِ عَلَى اَلطِّفْلِ أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَقُولُ:« اَللَّهُمَّ اِجْعَلْهُ لِأَبَوَيْهِ وَ لَنَا سَلَفاً وَ فَرَطاً وَ أَجْراً»
thaqalaynSanad: Ali ibn al-Husayn from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya from Abu al-Jawza, al-Munabbih ibn Abdillah from al-Husayn ibn ‘Alwan from Amr ibn Khalid from Zayd ibn Ali from his forefathers:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam Ali (a.s) said regarding the prayer (Salat Al Mayyit) over a child. Imam (a.s) used to say: “O’ Allah (swt), make him a predecessor (salafan) and a forerunner (faratan) and a reward (ajran) for his parents and for us.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 215

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer over the Dead
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Yaqub narrated from Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Ibn Abi Umayr from Umar ibn Udhaynah from al-Fudayl ibn Yasar from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him. He said:
Imam al-Baqir (a.s) said: “When you pray (Salat Al Mayyit) over a believer, supplicate for him and strive in supplication. And if he was a Waqifi, deemed weak (mustad'af), then perform the takbir and say: ‘O’ Allah (swt), forgive those who repented and followed Your path, and protect them from the punishment of the blazing fire.’”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ أُذَيْنَةَ عَنِ اَلْفُضَيْلِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« إِذَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى اَلْمُؤْمِنِ فَادْعُ لَهُ وَ اِجْتَهِدْ فِي اَلدُّعَاءِ وَ إِنْ كَانَ وَاقِفاً مُسْتَضْعَفاً فَكَبِّرْ وَ قُلِ اَللَّهُمَّ اِغْفِرْ« لِلَّذِينَ تٰابُوا وَ اِتَّبَعُوا سَبِيلَكَ وَ قِهِمْ عَذٰابَ اَلْجَحِيمِ»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Yaqub narrated from Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Ibn Abi Umayr from Umar ibn Udhaynah from al-Fudayl ibn Yasar from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him. He said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Baqir (a.s) said: “When you pray (Salat Al Mayyit) over a believer, supplicate for him and strive in supplication. And if he was a Waqifi, deemed weak (mustad'af), then perform the takbir and say: ‘O’ Allah (swt), forgive those who repented and followed Your path, and protect them from the punishment of the blazing fire.’”

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer over the Dead
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Yaqub narrated from a number of our companions from Sahl ibn Ziyad from al-Hasan ibn Mahbub from Abdillah ibn Ghalib from Thabit Abu al-Miqdam. He said:
I was with Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, when there came a funeral for some people from among his neighbors, so Imam (a.s) attended it. I was (standing) close to Imam (a.s), and I overheard Imam (a.s) say: “O’ Allah (swt), surely You (azj) created these souls, and You (azj) cause them to die, and You (azj) bring them to life, and You (azj) are more knowing of their secrets and their open matters than we are, and of their final abode and their place of deposit. O’ Allah (swt), this is Your servant, and I know no evil of him, but You (azj) are more knowing of him. We have come to You (azj) interceding for him after his death, so if he is deserving, then accept our intercession for him and resurrect him with those whom he used to follow.”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عِدَّةٍ مِنْ أَصْحَابِنَا عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ غَالِبٍ عَنْ ثَابِتٍ أَبِي اَلْمِقْدَامِ قَالَ: كُنْتُ مَعَ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ فَإِذَا بِجَنَازَةٍ لِقَوْمٍ مِنْ جِيرَتِهِ فَحَضَرَهَا وَ كُنْتُ قَرِيباً مِنْهُ فَسَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ« اَللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ خَلَقْتَ هَذِهِ اَلنُّفُوسَ وَأَنْتَ تُمِيتُهَا وَأَنْتَ تُحْيِيهَا وَأَنْتَ أَعْلَمُ بِسَرَائِرِهَا وَعَلاَنِيَتِهَا مِنَّا وَ مُسْتَقَرِّهَا وَ مُسْتَوْدَعِهَا اَللَّهُمَّ وَ هَذَا عَبْدُكَ وَ لاَ أَعْلَمُ مِنْهُ سُوءاً وَ أَنْتَ أَعْلَمُ بِهِ وَ قَدْ جِئْنَاكَ شَافِعِينَ لَهُ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهِ فَإِنْ كَانَ مُسْتَوْجِباً فَشَفِّعْنَا فِيهِ وَ اُحْشُرْهُ مَعَ مَنْ كَانَ يَتَوَلاَّهُ»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Yaqub narrated from a number of our companions from Sahl ibn Ziyad from al-Hasan ibn Mahbub from Abdillah ibn Ghalib from Thabit Abu al-Miqdam. He said:
thaqalaynMatn: I was with Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, when there came a funeral for some people from among his neighbors, so Imam (a.s) attended it. I was (standing) close to Imam (a.s), and I overheard Imam (a.s) say: “O’ Allah (swt), surely You (azj) created these souls, and You (azj) cause them to die, and You (azj) bring them to life, and You (azj) are more knowing of their secrets and their open matters than we are, and of their final abode and their place of deposit. O’ Allah (swt), this is Your servant, and I know no evil of him, but You (azj) are more knowing of him. We have come to You (azj) interceding for him after his death, so if he is deserving, then accept our intercession for him and resurrect him with those whom he used to follow.”

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer over the Dead
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Yaqub narrated from Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Ibn Abi Umayr from Hammad ibn Uthman from al-Halabi from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him.
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “When Abdillah ibn Ubayy ibn Salul died, the Prophet (saws), blessings of Allah (swt) be upon him and his family, attended his funeral. So Umar said to the Messenger of Allah (swt): “O’ Messenger of Allah (swt), did Allah (swt) not forbid you from standing by his grave?” The Prophet (saws) remained silent. Then Umar said (repeated): “O Messenger of Allah (swt), did Allah (swt) not forbid you from standing by his grave?” So Prophet (saws) said to Umar: “Woe to you! And what do you know of what I said (over his grave)? Indeed, I said (over his grave); ‘O’ Allah (swt), fill his insides with fire, and fill his grave with fire, and expose him to fire.’” Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: “So there appeared from the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, that which He (saws) used to conceal.”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنِ اَلْحَلَبِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« لَمَّا مَاتَ عَبْدُ اَللَّهِ بْنُ أُبَيِّ بْنِ سَلُولٍ حَضَرَ اَلنَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ جَنَازَتَهُ فَقَالَ عُمَرُ لِرَسُولِ اَللَّهِ يَا رَسُولَ اَللَّهِ أَ لَمْ يَنْهَكَ اَللَّهُ أَنْ تَقُومَ عَلَى قَبْرِهِ فَسَكَتَ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اَللَّهِ أَ لَمْ يَنْهَكَ اَللَّهُ أَنْ تَقُومَ عَلَى قَبْرِهِ فَقَالَ لَهُ« وَيْلَكَ وَ مَا يُدْرِيكَ مَا قُلْتُ إِنِّي قُلْتُ اَللَّهُمَّ اُحْشُ جَوْفَهُ نَاراً وَ اِمْلَأْ قَبْرَهُ نَاراً وَ أَصْلِهِ نَاراً»» قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ« فَأَبْدَى مِنْ رَسُولِ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ مَا كَانَ يَكْرَهُ»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Yaqub narrated from Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Ibn Abi Umayr from Hammad ibn Uthman from al-Halabi from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him.
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “When Abdillah ibn Ubayy ibn Salul died, the Prophet (saws), blessings of Allah (swt) be upon him and his family, attended his funeral. So Umar said to the Messenger of Allah (swt): “O’ Messenger of Allah (swt), did Allah (swt) not forbid you from standing by his grave?” The Prophet (saws) remained silent. Then Umar said (repeated): “O Messenger of Allah (swt), did Allah (swt) not forbid you from standing by his grave?” So Prophet (saws) said to Umar: “Woe to you! And what do you know of what I said (over his grave)? Indeed, I said (over his grave); ‘O’ Allah (swt), fill his insides with fire, and fill his grave with fire, and expose him to fire.’” Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: “So there appeared from the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, that which He (saws) used to conceal.”

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer over the Dead
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī

And from him, from a number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad and Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father, all from Ibn Mahbub from Ziyad ibn Isa from Amir ibn al-Simt from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “A man from among the hypocrites died, so Imam al-Husayn ibn Ali (a.s), peace be upon him, went out walking with him. A servant of Imam (a.s) met him, so al-Husayn (a.s), peace be upon him, said to him: ‘Where are you going, O’ so-and-so?’ He (the servant) replied: “I am fleeing from (attending) the funeral of this hypocrite, so that I do not pray over him.” So Imam al-Husayn (a.s), peace be upon him, said to him (the servant): “Stand to my right side and whatever you hear me say, then say (repeat) the same.” When the guardian (of the dead hypocrite) said the takbir over him, Imam al-Husayn (a.s), peace be upon him, said: ‘O’ Allah (swt), curse so-and-so, Your (this) servant, with a thousand united curses, not divided. chapter: Chapter on the Additions
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Yaqub narrated from Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Ibn Abi Umayr from Hammad ibn Uthman and Hisham ibn Salim from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him.
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “The Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, used to say five takbirs over some people (for Salat Al Mayyit) and four takbirs over others. And when Prophet (saws) said four takbirs over a man (for Salat Al Mayyit), he (the deceased) would be accused (meaning) of hypocrisy.”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ وَ هِشَامِ بْنِ سَالِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« كَانَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ يُكَبِّرُ عَلَى قَوْمٍ خَمْساً وَ عَلَى قَوْمٍ آخَرِينَ أَرْبَعاً وَ إِذَا كَبَّرَ عَلَى رَجُلٍ أَرْبَعاً اُتُّهِمَ يَعْنِي بِالنِّفَاقِ»

chapter: Chapter on the Additions
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Husayn ibn Sa’id from al-Qasim ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn Abi Hamzah from Abu Basir from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him.
Imam al-Baqir (a.s) said: “The Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, said seventy takbirs over Hamzah (a.s), and Imam Ali (a.s), peace be upon him, said twenty-five takbirs over Sahl ibn Hunayf.” Imam (a.s) said: “Imam Ali (a.s) said five takbirs at a time; whenever people caught up with him, they said, ‘O Commander of the Faithful (a.s), we did not catch the prayer over Sahl,’ so Imam Ali (a.s) would place him down (his bier down) and say five takbirs over him, until He (a.s) reached his grave, (Imam (a.s) did this separately) five times.”
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ اَلْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« كَبَّرَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ عَلَى حَمْزَةَ سَبْعِينَ تَكْبِيرَةً وَ كَبَّرَ عَلِيٌّ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَى سَهْلِ بْنِ حُنَيْفٍ خَمْساً وَعِشْرِينَ تَكْبِيرَةً» قَالَ« كَبَّرَ خَمْساً خَمْساً كُلَّمَا أَدْرَكَهُ اَلنَّاسُ قَالُوا يَا أَمِيرَ اَلْمُؤْمِنِينَ لَمْ نُدْرِكِ اَلصَّلاَةَ عَلَى سَهْلٍ فَيَضَعُهُ فَيُكَبِّرُ عَلَيْهِ خَمْساً حَتَّى اِنْتَهَى إِلَى قَبْرِهِ خَمْسَ مَرَّاتٍ»
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Husayn ibn Sa’id from al-Qasim ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn Abi Hamzah from Abu Basir from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him.

chapter: Chapter on the Additions
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Yaqub narrated from Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Ibn Abi Umayr from Hammad ibn Uthman from al-Halabi from Zurarah from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:

chapter: Chapter on the Additions
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Ibn Abi Umayr from Zurarah.
Zurarah said: “I saw a son of Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, during the lifetime of Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, who was called ‘Abdullah’. He was weaned (fatim, or recently weaned), who passed away. I (Zurarah) said to him (Abdullah): “O boy, who is this next to you?” referring to a servant of theirs. Abdullah said: “This is my master.” The servant lightheartedly replied to Abdullah: “I am not your master.” So Abdullah replied: “That is worse for you.” Then he (the servant) jabbed at the boy’s body (in jest), and the boy (Abdullah) died. He (Abdullah) was then carried out in a box (safat) to al-Baqi’ (cemetery). Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, came out wearing a yellow khazz cloak, a yellow khazz turban, and a yellow khazz mantle. Imam (a.s) walked toward al-Baqi‘, leaning on me, while the people were offering him condolences for his grandson (Abdullah). When He (a.s) reached al-Baqi‘, Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, stepped forward and prayed over him (Abdullah), saying four takbirs. Then Imam (a.s) ordered that he (Abdulla) be buried. After that, Imam (a.s) took me (Zurarah) by the hand and moved aside with me, and said: “Indeed, it was not customary to pray (Salat Al Mayyit) over children. Rather, the Commander of the Faithful (a.s), peace be upon him, used to order that they (children) be buried behind (the rows), and Imam Ali (a.s) would not pray over them. But I prayed over him (Abdullah) for the sake of the people of Medina, out of dislike that they might say: ‘They do not pray (Salat Al Mayyit) over their children.’”

author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa narrated from Musa ibn al-Qasim al-Bajali from Ali ibn Ja’far from his brother Musa ibn Ja’far, peace be upon them both. He said:
I asked Imam al-Kadhim (a.s) about a child, Should the prayer (Salat Al Mayyit) be performed over him if he dies and he is five years old? Imam (a.s) said: “If he comprehends the prayer, then the prayer is performed over him.”
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ اَلْقَاسِمِ اَلْبَجَلِيِّ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَخِيهِ مُوسَى بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِمَا اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلصَّبِيِّ أَ يُصَلَّى عَلَيْهِ إِذَا مَاتَ وَ هُوَ اِبْنُ خَمْسِ سِنِينَ قَالَ« إِذَا عَقَلَ اَلصَّلاَةَ صُلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ»
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa narrated from Musa ibn al-Qasim al-Bajali from Ali ibn Ja’far from his brother Musa ibn Ja’far, peace be upon them both. He said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Imam al-Kadhim (a.s) about a child, Should the prayer (Salat Al Mayyit) be performed over him if he dies and he is five years old? Imam (a.s) said: “If he comprehends the prayer, then the prayer is performed over him.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 219

chapter: Chapter on the Additions
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
As for what was narrated by Ibn Abi Umayr from Abdillah ibn Sinan from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “The prayer (Salat Al Mayyit) is not performed over the stillborn (al-manfus) and this is a newborn who did not cry out, and did not show signs of life, and thus will not inherit from blood money (al-diyyah) or anything else. But if it (newborn) cries (shows signs of life), then pray (Salat Al Mayyit) over it (if they die afterwards) and include them in inheritance.”
arabicText: فَأَمَّا مَا رَوَاهُ اِبْنُ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« لاَ يُصَلَّى عَلَى اَلْمَنْفُوسِ وَ هُوَ اَلْمَوْلُودُ اَلَّذِي لَمْ يَسْتَهِلَّ وَ لَمْ يَصِحْ وَ لَمْ يُوَرَّثْ مِنَ اَلدِّيَةِ وَ لاَ مِنْ غَيْرِهَا وَ إِذَا اِسْتَهَلَّ فَصَلِّ عَلَيْهِ وَ وَرِّثْهُ»
thaqalaynSanad: As for what was narrated by Ibn Abi Umayr from Abdillah ibn Sinan from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “The prayer (Salat Al Mayyit) is not performed over the stillborn (al-manfus) and this is a newborn who did not cry out, and did not show signs of life, and thus will not inherit from blood money (al-diyyah) or anything else. But if it (newborn) cries (shows signs of life), then pray (Salat Al Mayyit) over it (if they die afterwards) and include them in inheritance.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 219

chapter: Chapter on the Additions
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya narrated from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan from Amr ibn Sa’id from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah from Ammar from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) was asked about the newborn, over whom the ‘Pen’ (of accountability) has not yet passed, is the funeral prayer performed over him? Imam (a.s) said: “No. The prayer is only for the man and the woman when the ‘Pen’ (of accountability) has passed over them.”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ اَلْحَسَنِ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُصَدِّقِ بْنِ صَدَقَةَ عَنْ عَمَّارٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: أَنَّهُ سُئِلَ عَنِ اَلْمَوْلُودِ مَا لَمْ يَجْرِ عَلَيْهِ اَلْقَلَمُ هَلْ يُصَلَّى عَلَيْهِ قَالَ« لاَ إِنَّمَا اَلصَّلاَةُ عَلَى اَلرَّجُلِ وَ اَلْمَرْأَةِ إِذَا جَرَى عَلَيْهِمَا اَلْقَلَمُ»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya narrated from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan from Amr ibn Sa’id from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah from Ammar from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) was asked about the newborn, over whom the ‘Pen’ (of accountability) has not yet passed, is the funeral prayer performed over him? Imam (a.s) said: “No. The prayer is only for the man and the woman when the ‘Pen’ (of accountability) has passed over them.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 220

chapter: Chapter on the Additions
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa’id narrated from Safwan ibn Yahya from ‘Is ibn al-Qasim. He said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about a man who catches one takbir from the prayer over the deceased (Salat Al Mayyit). Imam (a.s) said: “He completes what remains (of the Salat Al Mayyit).”
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ عِيصِ بْنِ اَلْقَاسِمِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يُدْرِكُ مِنَ اَلصَّلاَةِ عَلَى اَلْمَيِّتِ تَكْبِيرَةً قَالَ« يُتِمُّ مَا بَقِيَ»
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Sa’id narrated from Safwan ibn Yahya from ‘Is ibn al-Qasim. He said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about a man who catches one takbir from the prayer over the deceased (Salat Al Mayyit). Imam (a.s) said: “He completes what remains (of the Salat Al Mayyit).”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 220

chapter: Chapter on the Additions
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Sa’ad narrated from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from al-Nadr ibn Shu’ayb from Khalid ibn Maad al-Qalanisi from a man from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him. He said:
I heard Imam al-Baqir (a.s) say regarding a man, who catches one or two takbirs, with the imam (of prayer) in the funeral prayer. Imam (a.s) said: “He should complete the takbirs while walking with it (the bier). If he does not catch the takbirs, he should say the takbirs at the grave. And if he reaches them (funeral) after it has already been buried, he should say the takbirs over the grave.”
arabicText: سَعْدٌ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنِ اَلنَّضْرِ بْنِ شُعَيْبٍ عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ مَادٍّ اَلْقَلاَنِسِيِّ عَنْ رَجُلٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ سَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ: فِي اَلرَّجُلِ يُدْرِكُ مَعَ اَلْإِمَامِ فِي اَلْجِنَازَةِ تَكْبِيرَةً أَوْ تَكْبِيرَتَيْنِ فَقَالَ« يُتِمُّ اَلتَّكْبِيرَ وَ هُوَ يَمْشِي مَعَهَا فَإِذَا لَمْ يُدْرِكِ اَلتَّكْبِيرَ كَبَّرَ عِنْدَ اَلْقَبْرِ فَإِنْ كَانَ أَدْرَكَهُمْ وَ قَدْ دُفِنَ كَبَّرَ عَلَى اَلْقَبْرِ»
thaqalaynSanad: Sa’ad narrated from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from al-Nadr ibn Shu’ayb from Khalid ibn Maad al-Qalanisi from a man from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him. He said:
thaqalaynMatn: I heard Imam al-Baqir (a.s) say regarding a man, who catches one or two takbirs, with the imam (of prayer) in the funeral prayer. Imam (a.s) said: “He should complete the takbirs while walking with it (the bier). If he does not catch the takbirs, he should say the takbirs at the grave. And if he reaches them (funeral) after it has already been buried, he should say the takbirs over the grave.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 220

chapter: Chapter on the Additions
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa narrated from his father from Abdillah ibn al-Mughira from Abdillah ibn Muskan from al-Halabi from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him.
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “If a man catches one or two takbirs from the prayer over the deceased (Salat Al Mayyit), then let him make up what remains consecutively.”
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ اَلْمُغِيرَةِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنِ اَلْحَلَبِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« إِذَا أَدْرَكَ اَلرَّجُلُ اَلتَّكْبِيرَةَ وَ اَلتَّكْبِيرَتَيْنِ مِنَ اَلصَّلاَةِ عَلَى اَلْمَيِّتِ فَلْيَقْضِ مَا بَقِيَ مُتَتَابِعاً»
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa narrated from his father from Abdillah ibn al-Mughira from Abdillah ibn Muskan from al-Halabi from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him.
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “If a man catches one or two takbirs from the prayer over the deceased (Salat Al Mayyit), then let him make up what remains consecutively.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 220

chapter: Chapter on the Additions
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal from Abu Jamila from Zayd al-Shahham.
He (Zayd) said: “I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about the funeral prayer if a man misses one, two, or three takbirs from it.” Imam (a.s) said: “He should say the takbirs that he missed.”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَمِيلَةَ عَنْ زَيْدٍ اَلشَّحَّامِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلصَّلاَةِ عَلَى اَلْجَنَائِزِ إِذَا فَاتَ اَلرَّجُلَ مِنْهَا اَلتَّكْبِيرَةُ أَوِ اَلثِّنْتَانِ أَوِ اَلثَّلاَثُ قَالَ« يُكَبِّرُ مَا فَاتَهُ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal from Abu Jamila from Zayd al-Shahham.
thaqalaynMatn: He (Zayd) said: “I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about the funeral prayer if a man misses one, two, or three takbirs from it.” Imam (a.s) said: “He should say the takbirs that he missed.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 220

chapter: Chapter on the Additions
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
As for what was narrated by Sa’ad ibn Abdillah from al-Hasan ibn Musa al-Khashshab from Ghiyath ibn Kallub from Ishaq ibn Ammar from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, from his father (a.s), peace be upon him:
Imam al-Baqir (a.s) said: “Imam Ali (a.s), peace be upon him, used to say: ‘What has passed of the takbirs in the funeral prayer is not to be made up.’”
arabicText: فَأَمَّا مَا رَوَاهُ سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ مُوسَى اَلْخَشَّابِ عَنْ غِيَاثِ بْنِ كَلُّوبٍ عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ أَنَّ عَلِيّاً عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ كَانَ يَقُولُ:« لاَ يُقْضَى مَا سَبَقَ مِنْ تَكْبِيرِ اَلْجَنَائِزِ» فالوجه في هذه الرواية انه لا يقضي كما كان يبتدأ به من الفصل بينهما بالدعاء وانما يقضي متتابعا على ما فصله الحلبي في روايته المتقدمة
thaqalaynSanad: As for what was narrated by Sa’ad ibn Abdillah from al-Hasan ibn Musa al-Khashshab from Ghiyath ibn Kallub from Ishaq ibn Ammar from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, from his father (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Baqir (a.s) said: “Imam Ali (a.s), peace be upon him, used to say: ‘What has passed of the takbirs in the funeral prayer is not to be made up.’”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 220

chapter: Chapter on the Additions
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Sa’ad from Ya'qub ibn Yazid from Ibn Abi 'Umayr from Hisham ibn Salim from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “There is no harm if a man performs the prayer over the deceased (Salat Al Mayyit), after he has been buried.”
arabicText: سَعْدٌ عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ سَالِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« لاَ بَأْسَ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ اَلرَّجُلُ عَلَى اَلْمَيِّتِ بَعْدَمَا يُدْفَنُ»
thaqalaynSanad: Sa’ad from Ya'qub ibn Yazid from Ibn Abi 'Umayr from Hisham ibn Salim from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “There is no harm if a man performs the prayer over the deceased (Salat Al Mayyit), after he has been buried.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 221

chapter: Chapter on the Additions
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Abu Ja’far, from his father, from Abdillah ibn al-Mughirah, from Abdillah ibn Muskan, from Malik, the client (mawla) of al-Jahm, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “If the prayer over the deceased (Salat al-Mayyit) passes you by (meaning you miss it) until he is buried, then there is no harm in praying (Salat Al Mayyit) over him after he has been buried.”
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ اَلْمُغِيرَةِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنْ مَالِكٍ مَوْلَى اَلْجَهْمِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« إِذَا فَاتَتْكَ اَلصَّلاَةُ عَلَى اَلْمَيِّتِ حَتَّى يُدْفَنَ فَلاَ بَأْسَ بِالصَّلاَةِ عَلَيْهِ وَ قَدْ دُفِنَ»
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Abu Ja’far, from his father, from Abdillah ibn al-Mughirah, from Abdillah ibn Muskan, from Malik, the client (mawla) of al-Jahm, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “If the prayer over the deceased (Salat al-Mayyit) passes you by (meaning you miss it) until he is buried, then there is no harm in praying (Salat Al Mayyit) over him after he has been buried.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 221

chapter: Chapter on the Additions
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Abu Ja’far, from al-Husayn ibn Ali ibn Yusuf, from Mu'adh ibn Thabit al-Jawhari, from Amr ibn Jumay' from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “Whenever the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, missed the prayer over the deceased (Salat al-Mayyit), He (saws) would perform the prayer over the grave.”
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ يُوسُفَ عَنْ مُعَاذِ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ اَلْجَوْهَرِيِّ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ جُمَيْعٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« كَانَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ إِذَا فَاتَتْهُ اَلصَّلاَةُ عَلَى اَلْمَيِّتِ صَلَّى عَلَى اَلْقَبْرِ»
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Abu Ja’far, from al-Husayn ibn Ali ibn Yusuf, from Mu'adh ibn Thabit al-Jawhari, from Amr ibn Jumay' from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “Whenever the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, missed the prayer over the deceased (Salat al-Mayyit), He (saws) would perform the prayer over the grave.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 221

chapter: Chapter on the Additions
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
As for what was narrated by Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya from Ya'qub ibn Yazid from Ziyad ibn Marwan from Yunus ibn Zabyan from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, from his father (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Baqir (a.s) said: “The Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, forbade that prayer be performed over a grave, or that one sit upon it, or that anything be built upon it.”
arabicText: فَأَمَّا مَا رَوَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ عَنْ زِيَادِ بْنِ مَرْوَانَ عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ ظَبْيَانَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« نَهَى رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ أَنْ يُصَلَّى عَلَى قَبْرٍ أَوْ يُقْعَدَ عَلَيْهِ أَوْ يُبْنَى عَلَيْهِ»
thaqalaynSanad: As for what was narrated by Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya from Ya'qub ibn Yazid from Ziyad ibn Marwan from Yunus ibn Zabyan from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, from his father (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Baqir (a.s) said: “The Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, forbade that prayer be performed over a grave, or that one sit upon it, or that anything be built upon it.”

chapter: Chapter on the Additions
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan, from Amr ibn Sa'id, from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah, from Ammar ibn Musa, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) was asked about someone over whom the prayer (Salat Al Mayyit) was performed, and when the imam (of prayer) finished the prayer (Salat Al Mayyit), it was found that the deceased was turned, with his feet at the place of his head. Imam (a.s) said: “He is to be straightened, and the prayer (Salat Al Mayyit) is to be repeated over him. And if he has already been carried (to the grave), then so long as he has not been buried, it (Salat Al Mayyit) is to be repeated. But if he has already been buried, then the prayer (Salat Al Mayyit) upon him has already been completed, and he is not to be prayed over (again) while he is buried.”
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ اَلْحَسَنِ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُصَدِّقِ بْنِ صَدَقَةَ عَنْ عَمَّارِ بْنِ مُوسَى عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: أَنَّهُ سُئِلَ عَمَّنْ صُلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ فَلَمَّا سَلَّمَ اَلْإِمَامُ فَإِذَا اَلْمَيِّتُ مَقْلُوبٌ رِجْلاَهُ إِلَى مَوْضِعِ رَأْسِهِ قَالَ« يُسَوَّى وَ تُعَادُ اَلصَّلاَةُ عَلَيْهِ وَإِنْ كَانَ قَدْ حُمِلَ مَا لَمْ يُدْفَنْ فَإِنْ دُفِنَ فَقَدْ مَضَتِ اَلصَّلاَةُ عَلَيْهِ وَلاَ يُصَلَّى عَلَيْهِ وَهُوَ مَدْفُونٌ»
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan, from Amr ibn Sa'id, from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah, from Ammar ibn Musa, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) was asked about someone over whom the prayer (Salat Al Mayyit) was performed, and when the imam (of prayer) finished the prayer (Salat Al Mayyit), it was found that the deceased was turned, with his feet at the place of his head. Imam (a.s) said: “He is to be straightened, and the prayer (Salat Al Mayyit) is to be repeated over him. And if he has already been carried (to the grave), then so long as he has not been buried, it (Salat Al Mayyit) is to be repeated. But if he has already been buried, then the prayer (Salat Al Mayyit) upon him has already been completed, and he is not to be prayed over (again) while he is buried.”
