chapter: Chapter on the Additions
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from al-Sayyari, from Muhammad ibn Aslam, from a man from the people of al-Jazirah, who said:
I asked Imam al-Ridha (a.s), peace be upon him: “Is it permissible to pray (Salat Al Mayyit) over the one who has been buried, after he has been buried?” Imam (a.s) said: “No. If it had been permissible for anyone, it would have been permissible for the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family.” Imam (a.s) said: “Rather, one does not pray (Salat Al Mayyit) over the (already) buried, nor over the naked.” (meaning a deceased body that has exposed private parts)
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنِ اَلسَّيَّارِيِّ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ عَنْ رَجُلٍ مِنْ أَهْلِ اَلْجَزِيرَةِ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِلرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ يُصَلَّى عَلَى اَلْمَدْفُونِ بَعْدَ مَا يُدْفَنُ قَالَ« لاَ لَوْ جَازَ لِأَحَدٍ لَجَازَ لِرَسُولِ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ قَالَ« بَلْ لاَ يُصَلَّى عَلَى اَلْمَدْفُونِ وَ لاَ عَلَى اَلْعُرْيَانِ»
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from al-Sayyari, from Muhammad ibn Aslam, from a man from the people of al-Jazirah, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Imam al-Ridha (a.s), peace be upon him: “Is it permissible to pray (Salat Al Mayyit) over the one who has been buried, after he has been buried?” Imam (a.s) said: “No. If it had been permissible for anyone, it would have been permissible for the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family.” Imam (a.s) said: “Rather, one does not pray (Salat Al Mayyit) over the (already) buried, nor over the naked.” (meaning a deceased body that has exposed private parts)

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 222

chapter: Chapter on the Additions
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ali ibn al-Husayn from Sa’ad from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr from al-Husayn ibn Musa from Ja’far ibn Isa who said:
Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, arrived in Mecca and asked me about Abdillah ibn A'yan, so I said: “He has died.” Imam (a.s) said: “He has died?” I replied: “Yes.” Imam (a.s) said: “Then let us go to his grave so that we may pray over him.” I said: “Yes.” Imam (a.s) said: “No, but rather we will pray over him here.” Then Imam (a.s) raised his hands, supplicating, and exerted himself in supplication and asked for mercy upon him (Abdillah ibn A'yan).
arabicText: عَلِيُّ بْنُ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ سَعْدٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي نَصْرٍ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ مُوسَى عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ عِيسَى قَالَ: قَدِمَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ مَكَّةَ فَسَأَلَنِي عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ أَعْيَنَ فَقُلْتُ مَاتَ فَقَالَ «مَاتَ» قُلْتُ نَعَمْ قَالَ« فَانْطَلِقْ بِنَا إِلَى قَبْرِهِ حَتَّى نُصَلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ» قُلْتُ نَعَمْ فَقَالَ« لاَ وَ لَكِنْ نُصَلِّي عَلَيْهِ هَاهُنَا» فَرَفَعَ يَدَيْهِ يَدْعُو وَ اِجْتَهَدَ فِي اَلدُّعَاءِ وَ تَرَحَّمَ عَلَيْهِ
thaqalaynSanad: Ali ibn al-Husayn from Sa’ad from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr from al-Husayn ibn Musa from Ja’far ibn Isa who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, arrived in Mecca and asked me about Abdillah ibn A'yan, so I said: “He has died.” Imam (a.s) said: “He has died?” I replied: “Yes.” Imam (a.s) said: “Then let us go to his grave so that we may pray over him.” I said: “Yes.” Imam (a.s) said: “No, but rather we will pray over him here.” Then Imam (a.s) raised his hands, supplicating, and exerted himself in supplication and asked for mercy upon him (Abdillah ibn A'yan).

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 222

chapter: Chapter on the Additions
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Saffar from Ibrahim ibn Hashim from Nuh ibn Shu'ayb from Hariz from Muhammad ibn Muslim or Zurarah:
It was said: “The prayer over the deceased (Salat al-Mayyit) after he has been buried is merely supplication (du'a).” He (narrator) said: “I asked, ‘Did the Prophet (saws), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, not pray over al-Najashi?” Imam (a.s) said: “No, He (saws) only supplicated for him.”
arabicText: اَلصَّفَّارُ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ هَاشِمٍ عَنْ نُوحِ بْنِ شُعَيْبٍ عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ أَوْ زُرَارَةَ قَالَ:« اَلصَّلاَةُ عَلَى اَلْمَيِّتِ بَعْدَ مَا يُدْفَنُ إِنَّمَا هُوَ اَلدُّعَاءُ» قَالَ قُلْتُ فَالنَّجَاشِيُّ لَمْ يُصَلِّ عَلَيْهِ اَلنَّبِيُّ صَ فَقَالَ« لاَ إِنَّمَا دَعَالَهُ»
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Saffar from Ibrahim ibn Hashim from Nuh ibn Shu'ayb from Hariz from Muhammad ibn Muslim or Zurarah:
thaqalaynMatn: It was said: “The prayer over the deceased (Salat al-Mayyit) after he has been buried is merely supplication (du'a).” He (narrator) said: “I asked, ‘Did the Prophet (saws), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, not pray over al-Najashi?” Imam (a.s) said: “No, He (saws) only supplicated for him.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 223

chapter: Chapter on the Additions
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ya'qub from Abu Ali al-Ash'ari from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Jabbar from Safwan ibn Yahya from al-Ala ibn Razin from Muhammad ibn Muslim from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Baqir (a.s) said: “The funeral prayer (Salat Al Mayyit) may be performed at any hour, for it is not a prayer of bowing (ruku') and prostration (sujud). Rather, what is disliked is prayer at sunrise and at sunset, the prayer which contain humility (khushu), bowing (rukuh), and prostration (sujud) because sun sets between the horns of a devil and it rises between the horns of a devil.” (metaphorical warning not to imitate non-Islamic or pagan rituals as they used to do)
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ أَبِي عَلِيٍّ اَلْأَشْعَرِيِّ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَلْجَبَّارِ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنِ اَلْعَلاَءِ بْنِ رَزِينٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« يُصَلَّى عَلَى اَلْجِنَازَةِ فِي كُلِّ سَاعَةٍ إِنَّهَا لَيْسَتْ بِصَلاَةِ رُكُوعٍ وَ لاَ سُجُودٍ وَ إِنَّمَا تُكْرَهُ اَلصَّلاَةُ عِنْدَ طُلُوعِ اَلشَّمْسِ وَ عِنْدَ غُرُوبِهَا اَلَّتِي فِيهَا اَلْخُشُوعُ وَ اَلرُّكُوعُ وَ اَلسُّجُودُ لِأَنَّهَا تَغْرُبُ بَيْنَ قَرْنَيْ شَيْطَانٍ وَ تَطْلُعُ بَيْنَ قَرْنَيْ شَيْطَانٍ»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub from Abu Ali al-Ash'ari from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Jabbar from Safwan ibn Yahya from al-Ala ibn Razin from Muhammad ibn Muslim from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Baqir (a.s) said: “The funeral prayer (Salat Al Mayyit) may be performed at any hour, for it is not a prayer of bowing (ruku') and prostration (sujud). Rather, what is disliked is prayer at sunrise and at sunset, the prayer which contain humility (khushu), bowing (rukuh), and prostration (sujud) because sun sets between the horns of a devil and it rises between the horns of a devil.” (metaphorical warning not to imitate non-Islamic or pagan rituals as they used to do)

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 223

chapter: Chapter on the Additions
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ya'qub from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa from Ibn Faddal from Yunus ibn Ya'qub, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about the funeral, can I pray over it without ablution (wudu)? Imam (a.s) said: “Yes. It is merely glorification (takbir), praise (tasbih), thanksgiving (tahmid), and declaration of God's oneness (tahlil), just as you glorify and praise in your house without ablution.”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنِ اِبْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ يَعْقُوبَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلْجِنَازَةِ أُصَلِّي عَلَيْهَا عَلَى غَيْرِ وُضُوءٍ فَقَالَ« نَعَمْ إِنَّمَا هُوَ تَكْبِيرٌ وَ تَسْبِيحٌ وَ تَحْمِيدٌ وَ تَهْلِيلٌ كَمَا تُكَبِّرُ وَ تُسَبِّحُ فِي بَيْتِكَ عَلَى غَيْرِ وُضُوءٍ»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa from Ibn Faddal from Yunus ibn Ya'qub, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about the funeral, can I pray over it without ablution (wudu)? Imam (a.s) said: “Yes. It is merely glorification (takbir), praise (tasbih), thanksgiving (tahmid), and declaration of God's oneness (tahlil), just as you glorify and praise in your house without ablution.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 223

chapter: Chapter on the Additions
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Muhammad ibn Isma'il, from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan and Abu Ali al-Ash'ari, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Jabbar all from Safwan ibn Yahya from Abd al-Hamid ibn Sa’ad, who said:
I said to Abu al-Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him: “A funeral is being brought out and I am not in a state of ablution (wudu). If I go to perform ablution, I will miss the prayer (Salat Al Mayyit). Is it sufficient for me to pray over it, while I am not in a state of ablution?” Imam (a.s) said: “That you be in a state of purity is more beloved to me.”
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ عَنِ اَلْفَضْلِ بْنِ شَاذَانَ وَ أَبِي عَلِيٍّ اَلْأَشْعَرِيِّ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَلْجَبَّارِ جَمِيعاً عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ عَبْدِ اَلْحَمِيدِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي اَلْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ اَلْجِنَازَةُ يُخْرَجُ بِهَا وَ لَسْتُ عَلَى وُضُوءٍ فَإِنْ ذَهَبْتُ أَتَوَضَّأُ فَاتَتْنِي اَلصَّلاَةُ أَيُجْزِينِي أَنْ أُصَلِّيَ عَلَيْهَا وَ أَنَا عَلَى غَيْرِ وُضُوءٍ قَالَ« تَكُونُ عَلَى طُهْرٍ أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ»
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Muhammad ibn Isma'il, from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan and Abu Ali al-Ash'ari, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Jabbar all from Safwan ibn Yahya from Abd al-Hamid ibn Sa’ad, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I said to Abu al-Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him: “A funeral is being brought out and I am not in a state of ablution (wudu). If I go to perform ablution, I will miss the prayer (Salat Al Mayyit). Is it sufficient for me to pray over it, while I am not in a state of ablution?” Imam (a.s) said: “That you be in a state of purity is more beloved to me.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 224

chapter: Chapter on the Additions
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ya'qub from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from his brother al-Hasan from Zur'ah from Sama'ah, who said:
I asked Imam (a.s) about a man over whom a funeral (procession) passes while he is not in a state of purity. Imam (a.s) said: “He should strike his hands on a clay wall and perform ‘tayammum’ (dry ablution).”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ أَخِيهِ اَلْحَسَنِ عَنْ زُرْعَةَ عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ مَرَّتْ بِهِ جَنَازَةٌ وَ هُوَ عَلَى غَيْرِ طُهْرٍ قَالَ« يَضْرِبُ بِيَدَيْهِ عَلَى حَائِطِ اَللَّبِنِ فَيَتَيَمَّمُ»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from his brother al-Hasan from Zur'ah from Sama'ah, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Imam (a.s) about a man over whom a funeral (procession) passes while he is not in a state of purity. Imam (a.s) said: “He should strike his hands on a clay wall and perform ‘tayammum’ (dry ablution).”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 224

chapter: Chapter on the Additions
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ya'qub from Humayd ibn Ziyad from al-Hasan ibn Muhammad al-Kindi from al-Mi’thami from Aban ibn Uthman from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Abdillah from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said:
I said to Imam al-Sadiq (a.s): “Does a menstruating woman (al-ha'id) pray over the funeral (Salat Al Mayyit)?” Imam (a.s) said: “Yes, but she does not stand with them (within rows with others); she stands separately.”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ اَلْكِنْدِيِّ عَنِ اَلْمِيثَمِيِّ عَنْ أَبَانِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَلرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لَهُ تُصَلِّي اَلْحَائِضُ عَلَى اَلْجِنَازَةِ قَالَ« نَعَمْ وَ لاَ تَقِفُ مَعَهُمْ تَقُومُ مُفْرَدَةً»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub from Humayd ibn Ziyad from al-Hasan ibn Muhammad al-Kindi from al-Mi’thami from Aban ibn Uthman from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Abdillah from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said:
thaqalaynMatn: I said to Imam al-Sadiq (a.s): “Does a menstruating woman (al-ha'id) pray over the funeral (Salat Al Mayyit)?” Imam (a.s) said: “Yes, but she does not stand with them (within rows with others); she stands separately.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 224

chapter: Chapter on the Additions
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ali from his father from Hammad ibn Isa from Hariz from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about the menstruating woman (al-ha'id), does she pray over the funeral (Salat Al Mayyit)? Imam (a.s) said: “Yes, but she does not stand with them; she stands separately.”
arabicText: عَلِيٌّ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلْحَائِضِ تُصَلِّي عَلَى اَلْجِنَازَةِ قَالَ« نَعَمْ وَ لاَ تَقِفُ مَعَهُمْ تَقِفُ مُفْرَدَةً»
thaqalaynSanad: Ali from his father from Hammad ibn Isa from Hariz from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about the menstruating woman (al-ha'id), does she pray over the funeral (Salat Al Mayyit)? Imam (a.s) said: “Yes, but she does not stand with them; she stands separately.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 224

chapter: Chapter on the Additions
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Sa’ad from Abu Ja’far from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Najran and al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Hammad from Hariz from someone who informed him from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “The menstruating woman (al-tamith) may pray over the funeral (Salat Al Mayyit), because it does not contain bowing (rukuh) or prostration (sujud). And the one in a state of major ritual impurity (al-junub) may perform tayammum and pray over the funeral.”
arabicText: سَعْدٌ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَلرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي نَجْرَانَ وَ اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَمَّنْ أَخْبَرَهُ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« اَلطَّامِثُ تُصَلِّي عَلَى اَلْجِنَازَةِ لِأَنْ لَيْسَ فِيهَا رُكُوعٌ وَ لاَ سُجُودٌ وَ اَلْجُنُبُ يَتَيَمَّمُ وَ يُصَلِّي عَلَى اَلْجِنَازَةِ»
thaqalaynSanad: Sa’ad from Abu Ja’far from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Najran and al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Hammad from Hariz from someone who informed him from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “The menstruating woman (al-tamith) may pray over the funeral (Salat Al Mayyit), because it does not contain bowing (rukuh) or prostration (sujud). And the one in a state of major ritual impurity (al-junub) may perform tayammum and pray over the funeral.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 224

chapter: Chapter on the Additions
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Abu Ja’far, from Uthman, from Sama'ah, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him.
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) was asked regarding the menstruating woman (al-tamith), and when she is present at the funeral. Imam (a.s) said: “She performs tayammum and prays over it (Salat Al Mayyit), and she stands alone, separate from the row.”
arabicText: وَعَنْهُ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: عَنِ اَلْمَرْأَةِ اَلطَّامِثِ إِذَا حَضَرَتِ اَلْجِنَازَةَ فَقَالَ« تَتَيَمَّمُ وَ تُصَلِّي عَلَيْهَا وَ تَقُومُ وَحْدَهَا بَارِزَةً مِنَ اَلصَّفِّ»
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Abu Ja’far, from Uthman, from Sama'ah, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him.
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) was asked regarding the menstruating woman (al-tamith), and when she is present at the funeral. Imam (a.s) said: “She performs tayammum and prays over it (Salat Al Mayyit), and she stands alone, separate from the row.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 225

chapter: Chapter on the Additions
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Abu Ja’far, from his father and al-Abbas ibn Ma'ruf from Abdillah ibn al-Mughirah from a man, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) about the menstruating woman (al-ha'id), does she pray over the funeral (Salat Al Mayyit)? Imam (a.s) said: “Yes, but she does not stand with them. And the one in a state of major ritual impurity (al-junub) may also perform the funeral prayer.”
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ وَ اَلْعَبَّاسِ بْنِ مَعْرُوفٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ اَلْمُغِيرَةِ عَنْ رَجُلٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلْحَائِضِ تُصَلِّي عَلَى اَلْجِنَازَةِ فَقَالَ« نَعَمْ وَ لاَ تَقِفُ مَعَهُمْ وَ اَلْجُنُبُ يُصَلِّي عَلَى اَلْجِنَازَةِ»
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Abu Ja’far, from his father and al-Abbas ibn Ma'ruf from Abdillah ibn al-Mughirah from a man, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) about the menstruating woman (al-ha'id), does she pray over the funeral (Salat Al Mayyit)? Imam (a.s) said: “Yes, but she does not stand with them. And the one in a state of major ritual impurity (al-junub) may also perform the funeral prayer.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 225

chapter: Chapter on the Additions
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ya'qub from Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Ibn Abi 'Umayr from one of his companions from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “The one who has the greatest right over the deceased performs the funeral prayer (Salat Al Mayyit), or he appoints whomever he wishes.”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ بَعْضِ أَصْحَابِهِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« يُصَلِّي عَلَى اَلْجِنَازَةِ أَوْلَى اَلنَّاسِ بِهَا أَوْ يَأْمُرُ مَنْ يُحِبُّ»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub from Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Ibn Abi 'Umayr from one of his companions from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “The one who has the greatest right over the deceased performs the funeral prayer (Salat Al Mayyit), or he appoints whomever he wishes.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 225

chapter: Chapter on the Additions
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from al-Qasim ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn Abi Hamzah from Abu Basir from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
I said to Imam al-Sadiq (a.s): “If a woman dies, who is the most entitled among the people to perform the prayer (Salat Al Mayyit) over her?” Imam (a.s) said: “Her husband.” I asked: “Is the husband more entitled than the father, the child, and the brother?” Imam (a.s) said: “Yes, and he washes her.”
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ اَلْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لَهُ اَلْمَرْأَةُ تَمُوتُ مَنْ أَحَقُّ اَلنَّاسِ بِالصَّلاَةِ عَلَيْهَا قَالَ« زَوْجُهَا» قُلْتُ اَلزَّوْجُ أَحَقُّ مِنَ اَلْأَبِ وَ اَلْوَلَدِ وَ اَلْأَخِ قَالَ« نَعَمْ وَ يُغَسِّلُهَا»
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from al-Qasim ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn Abi Hamzah from Abu Basir from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I said to Imam al-Sadiq (a.s): “If a woman dies, who is the most entitled among the people to perform the prayer (Salat Al Mayyit) over her?” Imam (a.s) said: “Her husband.” I asked: “Is the husband more entitled than the father, the child, and the brother?” Imam (a.s) said: “Yes, and he washes her.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 225

chapter: Chapter on the Additions
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
As for what was narrated by Muhassin ibn Ahmad from Aban ibn Uthman from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Abdillah, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, regarding the funeral prayer (Salat Al Mayyit) over a woman, is the husband more entitled to it or the brother? Imam (a.s) said: “The brother.”
arabicText: فَأَمَّا مَا رَوَاهُ مُحَسِّنُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ عَنْ أَبَانِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَلرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلصَّلاَةِ عَلَى اَلْمَرْأَةِ اَلزَّوْجُ أَحَقُّ بِهَا أَوِ اَلْأَخُ قَالَ« اَلْأَخُ»
thaqalaynSanad: As for what was narrated by Muhassin ibn Ahmad from Aban ibn Uthman from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Abdillah, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, regarding the funeral prayer (Salat Al Mayyit) over a woman, is the husband more entitled to it or the brother? Imam (a.s) said: “The brother.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 226

chapter: Chapter on the Additions
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Abi Abdillah from his father from Ibn Abi ‘Umayr from Hafs ibn al-Bukhtari from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
Imam (a.s) was asked regarding a woman who dies and her brother and husband are present, which of them should pray (Salat Al Mayyit) over her? Imam (a.s) said: “Her brother is more entitled to perform the prayer (Salat Al Mayyit) over her.”
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَفْصِ بْنِ اَلْبَخْتَرِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: فِي اَلْمَرْأَةِ تَمُوتُ وَ مَعَهَا أَخُوهَا وَ زَوْجُهَا أَيُّهُمَا يُصَلِّي عَلَيْهَا قَالَ« أَخُوهَا أَحَقُّ بِالصَّلاَةِ عَلَيْهَا»
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Abi Abdillah from his father from Ibn Abi ‘Umayr from Hafs ibn al-Bukhtari from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) was asked regarding a woman who dies and her brother and husband are present, which of them should pray (Salat Al Mayyit) over her? Imam (a.s) said: “Her brother is more entitled to perform the prayer (Salat Al Mayyit) over her.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 226

chapter: Chapter on the Additions
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Mas'ud al-'Ayyashi from Muhammad ibn Nusayr, who said: Muhammad ibn al-Husayn narrated to us from Ja’far ibn Bashir from Hisham ibn Salim from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said:
I asked Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) about the woman, can she lead other women in prayer? Imam (a.s) said: “She may lead them in the nafilah (supererogatory prayer), but as for the maktoobah (obligatory prayer), then no. And she should not stand in front of them, but rather she stands in the middle of them.” (meaning other women will join her shoulder-to-shoulder either side of her)
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مَسْعُودٍ اَلْعَيَّاشِيُّ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ نُصَيْرٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ بَشِيرٍ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ سَالِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلْمَرْأَةِ هَلْ تَؤُمُّ اَلنِّسَاءَ قَالَ« تَؤُمُّهُنَّ فِي اَلنَّافِلَةِ فَأَمَّا فِي اَلْمَكْتُوبَةِ فَلاَ وَ لاَ تَتَقَدَّمُهُنَّ وَ لَكِنْ تَقُومُ وَسَطَهُنَّ»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Mas'ud al-'Ayyashi from Muhammad ibn Nusayr, who said: Muhammad ibn al-Husayn narrated to us from Ja’far ibn Bashir from Hisham ibn Salim from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) about the woman, can she lead other women in prayer? Imam (a.s) said: “She may lead them in the nafilah (supererogatory prayer), but as for the maktoobah (obligatory prayer), then no. And she should not stand in front of them, but rather she stands in the middle of them.” (meaning other women will join her shoulder-to-shoulder either side of her)

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 226

chapter: Chapter on the Additions
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from al-Abbas ibn al-Mughirah, who said: al-Fadl ibn Shadhan narrated to me from Ibn Abi ‘Umayr from Hammad from Hariz from Zurarah from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Imam al-Baqir (a.s): “Can a woman lead other women in prayer?” Imam (a.s) said: “No, except over the deceased (Salat Al Mayyit), if there is no one more entitled than her. She stands in the middle of them in the row, and she says the takbir, and they say the takbir.”
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنِ اَلْعَبَّاسِ بْنِ اَلْمُغِيرَةِ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي اَلْفَضْلُ بْنُ شَاذَانَ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: قُلْتُ اَلْمَرْأَةُ تَؤُمُّ اَلنِّسَاءَ قَالَ« لاَ إِلاَّ عَلَى اَلْمَيِّتِ إِذَا لَمْ يَكُنْ أَحَدٌ أَوْلَى مِنْهَا تَقُومُ وَسَطَهُنَّ فِي اَلصَّفِّ فَتُكَبِّرُ وَ يُكَبِّرْنَ»
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from al-Abbas ibn al-Mughirah, who said: al-Fadl ibn Shadhan narrated to me from Ibn Abi ‘Umayr from Hammad from Hariz from Zurarah from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Imam al-Baqir (a.s): “Can a woman lead other women in prayer?” Imam (a.s) said: “No, except over the deceased (Salat Al Mayyit), if there is no one more entitled than her. She stands in the middle of them in the row, and she says the takbir, and they say the takbir.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 227

chapter: Chapter on the Additions
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Talhah ibn Zayd from Abu Abdillah (a.s), said:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “If the Imam is present at the funeral, then he is the most entitled of the people to perform the prayer over it.”
arabicText: عَلِيُّ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ طَلْحَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« إِذَا حَضَرَ اَلْإِمَامُ اَلْجِنَازَةَ فَهُوَ أَحَقُّ اَلنَّاسِ بِالصَّلاَةِ عَلَيْهَا»
thaqalaynSanad: Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Talhah ibn Zayd from Abu Abdillah (a.s), said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “If the Imam is present at the funeral, then he is the most entitled of the people to perform the prayer over it.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 227

chapter: Chapter on the Additions
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya from Ibrahim ibn Hashim from al-Nawfali from al-Sakuni from Imam Ja’far (a.s) from his father Imam al-Baqir (a.s), from his forefathers, peace be upon them, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “The Commander of the Faithful (a.s), peace be upon him, said: ‘If a ruler among the rulers of Allah (swt) (meaning Imam (a.s)), is present at a funeral, then he is the most entitled to perform the prayer (Salat Al Mayyit) over it, if the guardian of the deceased permits him. Otherwise, he (one who assumed without permission) is a usurper (Gasib).”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ هَاشِمٍ عَنِ اَلنَّوْفَلِيِّ عَنِ اَلسَّكُونِيِّ عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ آبَائِهِ عَلَيْهِمُ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ قَالَ أَمِيرُ اَلْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ:« إِذَا حَضَرَ سُلْطَانٌ مِنْ سُلْطَانِ اَللَّهِ جِنَازَةً فَهُوَ أَحَقُّ بِالصَّلاَةِ عَلَيْهَا إِنْ قَدَّمَهُ وَلِيُّ اَلْمَيِّتِ وَ إِلاَّ فَهُوَ غَاصِبٌ»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya from Ibrahim ibn Hashim from al-Nawfali from al-Sakuni from Imam Ja’far (a.s) from his father Imam al-Baqir (a.s), from his forefathers, peace be upon them, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “The Commander of the Faithful (a.s), peace be upon him, said: ‘If a ruler among the rulers of Allah (swt) (meaning Imam (a.s)), is present at a funeral, then he is the most entitled to perform the prayer (Salat Al Mayyit) over it, if the guardian of the deceased permits him. Otherwise, he (one who assumed without permission) is a usurper (Gasib).”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 227

chapter: Chapter on the Additions
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ya‘qub from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Isma’il ibn Mehran from Sayf ibn ‘Umayrah from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “One should not perform the funeral prayer in shoes (bi-hidha’), but there is no harm in (performing Salat Al Mayyit) in leather socks (khuff).”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ مِهْرَانَ عَنْ سَيْفِ بْنِ عَمِيرَةَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« لاَ يُصَلَّى عَلَى اَلْجِنَازَةِ بِحِذَاءٍ وَ لاَ بَأْسَ بِالْخُفِّ»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ya‘qub from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Isma’il ibn Mehran from Sayf ibn ‘Umayrah from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “One should not perform the funeral prayer in shoes (bi-hidha’), but there is no harm in (performing Salat Al Mayyit) in leather socks (khuff).”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 227

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Ahmad from al-Husayn from al-Hasan from Zur’ah from Sama’ah, said:
I asked Imam (a.s) about the traveller, at what distance does he shorten the prayer? Imam (a.s) said: “At the distance of a day’s journey, and that is two ‘barid’, which is eight ‘farsakh’. And whoever travels, shortens the prayer and breaks the fast, unless he is a man seeing someone off (mushayyi’), or he goes out for hunting, or to a village of his where the journey is a day’s travel and he spends the night with his family. In that case, he does not shorten (the prayer) and does not break the fast.”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ عَنْ زُرْعَةَ عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلْمُسَافِرِ فِي كَمْ يُقَصِّرُ اَلصَّلاَةَ فَقَالَ« فِي مَسِيرَةِ يَوْمٍ وَ ذَلِكَ بَرِيدَانِ وَ هُمَا ثَمَانِيَةُ فَرَاسِخَ وَ مَنْ سَافَرَ قَصَّرَ اَلصَّلاَةَ وَ أَفْطَرَ إِلاَّ أَنْ يَكُونَ رَجُلاً مُشَيِّعاً أَوْ خَرَجَ إِلَى صَيْدٍ أَوْ إِلَى قَرْيَةٍ لَهُ يَكُونُ مَسِيرَةَ يَوْمٍ يَبِيتُ إِلَى أَهْلِهِ لاَ يُقَصِّرُ وَ لاَ يُفْطِرُ»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Ahmad from al-Husayn from al-Hasan from Zur’ah from Sama’ah, said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Imam (a.s) about the traveller, at what distance does he shorten the prayer? Imam (a.s) said: “At the distance of a day’s journey, and that is two ‘barid’, which is eight ‘farsakh’. And whoever travels, shortens the prayer and breaks the fast, unless he is a man seeing someone off (mushayyi’), or he goes out for hunting, or to a village of his where the journey is a day’s travel and he spends the night with his family. In that case, he does not shorten (the prayer) and does not break the fast.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 228

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn al-Hakam from Abdillah ibn Yahya al-Kahili, who said:
I heard Abu Abdillah (a.s), speaking about shortening the prayer (taqsir). Imam (a.s) said: “A ‘barid’ by a ‘barid’, which is twenty-four miles.”
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ اَلْحَكَمِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ يَحْيَى اَلْكَاهِلِيِّ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ يَقُولُ: فِي اَلتَّقْصِيرِ فِي اَلصَّلاَةِ قَالَ« بَرِيدٌ فِي بَرِيدٍ أَرْبَعَةٌ وَ عِشْرُونَ مِيلاً»
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn al-Hakam from Abdillah ibn Yahya al-Kahili, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I heard Abu Abdillah (a.s), speaking about shortening the prayer (taqsir). Imam (a.s) said: “A ‘barid’ by a ‘barid’, which is twenty-four miles.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 228

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
As for what was narrated by Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Ibn Abi 'Umayr from Jamil from Zurarah from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Baqir (a.s) said: “Shortening (the prayer, ‘al-taqsir’) is at a ‘barid’, and a ‘barid’ is four ‘farsakh’.”
arabicText: فَأَمَّا مَا رَوَاهُ عَلِيُّ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ جَمِيلٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «اَلتَّقْصِيرُ فِي بَرِيدٍ وَ اَلْبَرِيدُ أَرْبَعَةُ فَرَاسِخَ»
thaqalaynSanad: As for what was narrated by Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Ibn Abi 'Umayr from Jamil from Zurarah from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Baqir (a.s) said: “Shortening (the prayer, ‘al-taqsir’) is at a ‘barid’, and a ‘barid’ is four ‘farsakh’.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 228

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from his father, from Ibn Abi ‘Umayr, from Abu Ayyub, who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “What is the minimum distance at which the traveller shortens (the prayer)?” Imam (a.s) said: “A ‘barid’.”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ أَدْنَى مَا يُقَصِّرُ فِيهِ اَلْمُسَافِرُ فَقَالَ« بَرِيدٌ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from his father, from Ibn Abi ‘Umayr, from Abu Ayyub, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “What is the minimum distance at which the traveller shortens (the prayer)?” Imam (a.s) said: “A ‘barid’.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 228

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Sa’ad from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Fadalah ibn Ayyub from Mu'awiyah ibn Wahb, who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “What is the minimum distance at which the traveller shortens the prayer?” Imam (a.s) said: “A ‘barid’ going, and a ‘barid’ returning.”
arabicText: سَعْدٌ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ بْنِ أَيُّوبَ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ وَهْبٍ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ أَدْنَى مَا يُقَصِّرُ فِيهِ اَلْمُسَافِرُ فَقَالَ« بَرِيدٌ ذَاهِباً وَ بَرِيدٌ جَائِياً»
thaqalaynSanad: Sa’ad from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Fadalah ibn Ayyub from Mu'awiyah ibn Wahb, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “What is the minimum distance at which the traveller shortens the prayer?” Imam (a.s) said: “A ‘barid’ going, and a ‘barid’ returning.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 229

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Abi ‘Umayr from Abdillah ibn Bukayr, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about al-Qadisiyyah. When I go out to it, should I pray in full or shorten? Imam (a.s) said: “And how far is it?” I said: “It is the one you saw.” He said: “Shorten (the prayer).”
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ بُكَيْرٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلْقَادِسِيَّةِ أَخْرُجُ إِلَيْهَا أُتِمُّ أَمْ أُقَصِّرُ قَالَ« وَ كَمْ هِيَ» قُلْتُ هِيَ اَلَّتِي رَأَيْتَ قَالَ« قَصِّرْ»
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Abi ‘Umayr from Abdillah ibn Bukayr, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about al-Qadisiyyah. When I go out to it, should I pray in full or shorten? Imam (a.s) said: “And how far is it?” I said: “It is the one you saw.” He said: “Shorten (the prayer).”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 229

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Sa’ad from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Husayn from Fadalah from Hammad ibn Uthman from Abu Usamah Zayd al-Shahham, who said:
I heard Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, say: “A man shortens the prayer on a journey of twelve miles.”
arabicText: سَعْدٌ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ أَبِي أُسَامَةَ زَيْدٍ اَلشَّحَّامِ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ يَقُولُ:« يُقَصِّرُ اَلرَّجُلُ اَلصَّلاَةَ فِي مَسِيرَةِ اِثْنَيْ عَشَرَ مِيلاً»
thaqalaynSanad: Sa’ad from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Husayn from Fadalah from Hammad ibn Uthman from Abu Usamah Zayd al-Shahham, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I heard Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, say: “A man shortens the prayer on a journey of twelve miles.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 229

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Abu Ja’far from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal from Mu‘awiyah ibn ‘Ammar, who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “At what distance do I shorten the prayer?” Imam (a.s) said: “At a ‘barid’. Do you not see that the people of Mecca, when they go out to ‘Arafah, shortening becomes obligatory upon them?”
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ فِي كَمْ أُقَصِّرُ اَلصَّلاَةَ فَقَالَ« فِي بَرِيدٍ أَ لاَ تَرَى أَنَّ أَهْلَ مَكَّةَ إِذَا خَرَجُوا إِلَى عَرَفَةَ كَانَ عَلَيْهِمُ اَلتَّقْصِيرُ»
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Abu Ja’far from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal from Mu‘awiyah ibn ‘Ammar, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “At what distance do I shorten the prayer?” Imam (a.s) said: “At a ‘barid’. Do you not see that the people of Mecca, when they go out to ‘Arafah, shortening becomes obligatory upon them?”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 229

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn ibn Abi al-Khattab from Ja’far ibn Bashir from Hammad ibn Uthman from Muhammad ibn al-Nu‘man from Isma’il ibn al-Fadl, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about shortening the prayer. Imam (a.s) said: “At four ‘farsakh’.”
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ أَبِي اَلْخَطَّابِ عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ بَشِيرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلنُّعْمَانِ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ اَلْفَضْلِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلتَّقْصِيرِ فَقَالَ« فِي أَرْبَعَةِ فَرَاسِخَ»
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn ibn Abi al-Khattab from Ja’far ibn Bashir from Hammad ibn Uthman from Muhammad ibn al-Nu‘man from Isma’il ibn al-Fadl, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about shortening the prayer. Imam (a.s) said: “At four ‘farsakh’.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 229

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from Mu'awiyah ibn Hakim from Abu Malik al-Hadrami from Abu al-Jarud, who said:
I said to Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him: “At what distance is the shortening (of prayer)?” Imam (a.s) said: “At a ‘barid’.”
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ حُكَيْمٍ عَنْ أَبِي مَالِكٍ اَلْحَضْرَمِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي اَلْجَارُودِ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ فِي كَمِ اَلتَّقْصِيرُ فَقَالَ« فِي بَرِيدٍ»
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from Mu'awiyah ibn Hakim from Abu Malik al-Hadrami from Abu al-Jarud, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I said to Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him: “At what distance is the shortening (of prayer)?” Imam (a.s) said: “At a ‘barid’.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 229

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from Mu‘awiyah ibn Hakim from Sulayman ibn Muhammad al-Khath‘ami from Ishaq ibn ‘Ammar, who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “At what distance is the shortening (of prayer)?” Imam (a.s) said: “At one ‘barid’. Woe to them! (meaning the opponents) It is as if they did not perform Hajj with the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, and shorten (their prayers).”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ حُكَيْمٍ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ اَلْخَثْعَمِيِّ عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ فِي كَمِ اَلتَّقْصِيرُ فَقَالَ« فِي بَرِيدٍ وَيْحَهُمْ كَأَنَّهُمْ لَمْ يَحُجُّوا مَعَ رَسُولِ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ فَقَصَّرُوا»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from Mu‘awiyah ibn Hakim from Sulayman ibn Muhammad al-Khath‘ami from Ishaq ibn ‘Ammar, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “At what distance is the shortening (of prayer)?” Imam (a.s) said: “At one ‘barid’. Woe to them! (meaning the opponents) It is as if they did not perform Hajj with the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, and shorten (their prayers).”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 230

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Abu Ja’far, from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Yaqtin, from his brother, from their father Ali ibn Yaqtin, who said:
I asked Abu al-Hasan al-Awwal (a.s) (the First), peace be upon him, about a man who sets out on a journey and it is the distance of a day. Imam al-Kadhim (a.s) said: “He is obligated to shorten (the prayer) if it is the distance of a day, even if he is going around for his work (‘ya-duuru fi amalihi’).”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ يَقْطِينٍ عَنْ أَخِيهِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ يَقْطِينٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا اَلْحَسَنِ اَلْأَوَّلَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يَخْرُجُ فِي سَفَرِهِ وَ هُوَ مَسِيرَةُ يَوْمٍ قَالَ« يَجِبُ عَلَيْهِ اَلتَّقْصِيرُ إِذَا كَانَ مَسِيرَةَ يَوْمٍ وَ إِنْ كَانَ يَدُورُ فِي عَمَلِهِ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Abu Ja’far, from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Yaqtin, from his brother, from their father Ali ibn Yaqtin, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu al-Hasan al-Awwal (a.s) (the First), peace be upon him, about a man who sets out on a journey and it is the distance of a day. Imam al-Kadhim (a.s) said: “He is obligated to shorten (the prayer) if it is the distance of a day, even if he is going around for his work (‘ya-duuru fi amalihi’).”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 230

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
As for what was narrated by Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ibn Abi Nasr from Abu al-Hasan al-Ridha (a.s), peace be upon him, he said:
I asked Imam al-Ridha (a.s) about a man who intends to travel, at what distance does he shorten (the prayer)? Imam (a.s) said: “At three ‘barid’ (‘burud’).”
arabicText: فَأَمَّا مَا رَوَاهُ أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي نَصْرٍ عَنْ أَبِي اَلْحَسَنِ اَلرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يُرِيدُ اَلسَّفَرَ فِي كَمْ يُقَصِّرُ فَقَالَ« فِي ثَلاَثَةِ بُرُدٍ»
thaqalaynSanad: As for what was narrated by Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ibn Abi Nasr from Abu al-Hasan al-Ridha (a.s), peace be upon him, he said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Imam al-Ridha (a.s) about a man who intends to travel, at what distance does he shorten (the prayer)? Imam (a.s) said: “At three ‘barid’ (‘burud’).”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 230

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
As for what was narrated by Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Ahmad from al-Hasan ibn Mahbub from Abu Jamila from Abu Basir from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, he said:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “There is no harm for the traveller to complete (the prayer) if the journey is the distance of two days.”
arabicText: فَأَمَّا مَا رَوَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَمِيلَةَ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« لاَ بَأْسَ لِلْمُسَافِرِ أَنْ يُتِمَّ اَلسَّفَرَ مَسِيرَةَ يَوْمَيْنِ
thaqalaynSanad: As for what was narrated by Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Ahmad from al-Hasan ibn Mahbub from Abu Jamila from Abu Basir from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, he said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “There is no harm for the traveller to complete (the prayer) if the journey is the distance of two days.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 230

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Yaqub ibn Yazid from Ibn Abi Umayr from Abu Ayyub from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) about shortening (the prayer). Imam (a.s) said: “At two ‘barid’ (‘buridayn’) or the brightness of a day (‘bayad yawm’).”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلتَّقْصِيرِ قَالَ فَقَالَ« فِي بَرِيدَيْنِ أَوْ بَيَاضِ يَوْمٍ»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Yaqub ibn Yazid from Ibn Abi Umayr from Abu Ayyub from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) about shortening (the prayer). Imam (a.s) said: “At two ‘barid’ (‘buridayn’) or the brightness of a day (‘bayad yawm’).”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 231

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from al-Abbas, from Abdillah ibn al-Mughira, from Muawiyah ibn Ammar, who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “Indeed, the people of Mecca complete the prayer (in full) at Arafat.” Imam (a.s) said: “Woe to them! (Or ‘May they be ruined!’ (waylahum aw wayhahum)) And what journey is more strenuous than that? Do not complete (the prayer in full).”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنِ اَلْعَبَّاسِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ اَلْمُغِيرَةِ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ إِنَّ أَهْلَ مَكَّةَ يُتِمُّونَ اَلصَّلاَةَ بِعَرَفَاتٍ قَالَ« وَيْلَهُمْ أَوْ وَيْحَهُمْ وَ أَيُّ سَفَرٍ أَشَدُّ مِنْهُ لاَ تُتِمَّ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from al-Abbas, from Abdillah ibn al-Mughira, from Muawiyah ibn Ammar, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “Indeed, the people of Mecca complete the prayer (in full) at Arafat.” Imam (a.s) said: “Woe to them! (Or ‘May they be ruined!’ (waylahum aw wayhahum)) And what journey is more strenuous than that? Do not complete (the prayer in full).”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 231

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Sa’ad ibn Abdillah from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Faddalah from Aban ibn Uthman from Isma'il ibn al-Fadl, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about a man who travelled from one land to another and only stayed in his villages and his estate. Imam (a.s) said: “If you settle in your villages and estate, then complete the prayer, and if you are in other than your own land, then shorten (the prayer).”
arabicText: سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ أَبَانِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ اَلْفَضْلِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ سَافَرَ مِنْ أَرْضٍ إِلَى أَرْضٍ وَ إِنَّمَا يَنْزِلُ قُرَاهُ وَ ضَيْعَتَهُ قَالَ «إِذَا نَزَلْتَ قُرَاكَ وَ ضَيْعَتَكَ فَأَتِمَّ اَلصَّلاَةَ وَ إِذَا كُنْتَ فِي غَيْرِ أَرْضِكَ فَقَصِّرْ»
thaqalaynSanad: Sa’ad ibn Abdillah from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Faddalah from Aban ibn Uthman from Isma'il ibn al-Fadl, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about a man who travelled from one land to another and only stayed in his villages and his estate. Imam (a.s) said: “If you settle in your villages and estate, then complete the prayer, and if you are in other than your own land, then shorten (the prayer).”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 231

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Muhammad ibn Isa from Imran ibn Muhammad, who said:
I said to Abu Ja’far al-Thani (a.s): “May I be your ransom, I have an estate at a distance of fifteen miles, five parasangs (‘faraasikh’), so sometimes I go out to it and stay there for three days, or five days, or seven days. Should I complete the prayer or shorten it?” Imam (a.s) said: “Shorten (the prayer) on the way, and complete in the estate.”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ عِمْرَانَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي جَعْفَرٍ اَلثَّانِي عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ جُعِلْتُ فِدَاكَ إِنَّ لِي ضَيْعَةً عَلَى خَمْسَةَ عَشَرَ مِيلاً خَمْسَةِ فَرَاسِخَ فَرُبَّمَا خَرَجْتُ إِلَيْهَا فَأُقِيمُ فِيهَا ثَلاَثَةَ أَيَّامٍ أَوْ خَمْسَةَ أَيَّامٍ أَوْ سَبْعَةَ أَيَّامٍ فَأُتِمُّ اَلصَّلاَةَ أَمْ أُقَصِّرُ فَقَالَ« قَصِّرْ فِي اَلطَّرِيقِ وَ أَتِمَّ فِي اَلضَّيْعَةِ»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Muhammad ibn Isa from Imran ibn Muhammad, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I said to Abu Ja’far al-Thani (a.s): “May I be your ransom, I have an estate at a distance of fifteen miles, five parasangs (‘faraasikh’), so sometimes I go out to it and stay there for three days, or five days, or seven days. Should I complete the prayer or shorten it?” Imam (a.s) said: “Shorten (the prayer) on the way, and complete in the estate.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 231

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Ali ibn Ishaq ibn Sa’ad from Musa ibn al-Khazraj, who said:
I said to Abu al-Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him: “I go out to my estate, and from my house to it, is twelve parasangs. Should I complete the prayer or shorten it?” Imam (a.s) said: “Complete (the prayers in full).”
arabicText: وَعَنْهُ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ سَعْدٍ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ اَلْخَزْرَجِ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي اَلْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ أَخْرُجُ إِلَى ضَيْعَتِي وَ مِنْ مَنْزِلِي إِلَيْهَا اِثْنَا عَشَرَ فَرْسَخاً أُتِمُّ اَلصَّلاَةَ أَمْ أُقَصِّرُ قَالَ« أَتِمَّ»
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Ali ibn Ishaq ibn Sa’ad from Musa ibn al-Khazraj, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I said to Abu al-Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him: “I go out to my estate, and from my house to it, is twelve parasangs. Should I complete the prayer or shorten it?” Imam (a.s) said: “Complete (the prayers in full).”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 232

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Muhammad ibn Sahl from his father, who said:
I asked Abu al-Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him, about a man who travels to his estate at a distance of two or three ‘barid’, and his route passes through the estates of his cousins. Should he shorten (the prayer) and break his fast, or complete (the prayer) and fast? Imam (a.s) said: “He does not shorten (the prayers), and he does not break his fast.”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سَهْلٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا اَلْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ يَسِيرُ إِلَى ضَيْعَتِهِ عَلَى بَرِيدَيْنِ أَوْ ثَلاَثَةٍ وَ مَمَرُّهُ عَلَى ضِيَاعِ بَنِي عَمِّهِ أَ يُقَصِّرُ وَ يُفْطِرُ أَوْ يُتِمُّ وَ يَصُومُ قَالَ« لاَ يُقَصِّرُ وَ لاَ يُفْطِرُ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Muhammad ibn Sahl from his father, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu al-Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him, about a man who travels to his estate at a distance of two or three ‘barid’, and his route passes through the estates of his cousins. Should he shorten (the prayer) and break his fast, or complete (the prayer) and fast? Imam (a.s) said: “He does not shorten (the prayers), and he does not break his fast.”

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal from Amr ibn Sa'id al-Mada'ini from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah from Ammar ibn Musa from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said regarding a man who sets out on a journey and passes by a village or a house of his and stays in it. Imam (a.s) said: “He should complete the prayer, even if he possesses nothing there, except a single palm tree, and he should not shorten (the prayers). And he should fast, if fasting becomes due, while he is there.”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدٍ اَلْمَدَائِنِيِّ عَنْ مُصَدِّقِ بْنِ صَدَقَةَ عَنْ عَمَّارِ بْنِ مُوسَى عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: فِي اَلرَّجُلِ يَخْرُجُ فِي سَفَرِهِ فَيَمُرُّ بِقَرْيَةٍ لَهُ أَوْ دَارٍ فَيَنْزِلُ فِيهَا قَالَ« يُتِمُّ اَلصَّلاَةَ وَ لَوْ لَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ إِلاَّ نَخْلَةٌ وَاحِدَةٌ وَ لاَ يُقَصِّرُ وَ لْيَصُمْ إِذَا حَضَرَهُ اَلصَّوْمُ وَ هُوَ فِيهَا»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal from Amr ibn Sa'id al-Mada'ini from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah from Ammar ibn Musa from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said regarding a man who sets out on a journey and passes by a village or a house of his and stays in it. Imam (a.s) said: “He should complete the prayer, even if he possesses nothing there, except a single palm tree, and he should not shorten (the prayers). And he should fast, if fasting becomes due, while he is there.”

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Sa’ad ibn Abdillah from Ibrahim ibn Hashim from Isma'il ibn Marrar from Yunus ibn Abd al-Rahman from Abdillah ibn Sinan from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “Whoever comes to his estate and does not intend to stay for ten days, he should shorten (the prayer), but if he intends to stay for ten days, he should complete the prayer.”
arabicText: سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ هَاشِمٍ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ مَرَّارٍ عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَلرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« مَنْ أَتَى ضَيْعَتَهُ ثُمَّ لَمْ يُرِدِ اَلْمُقَامَ عَشَرَةَ أَيَّامٍ قَصَّرَ وَ إِنْ أَرَادَ اَلْمُقَامَ عَشَرَةَ أَيَّامٍ أَتَمَّ اَلصَّلاَةَ»
thaqalaynSanad: Sa’ad ibn Abdillah from Ibrahim ibn Hashim from Isma'il ibn Marrar from Yunus ibn Abd al-Rahman from Abdillah ibn Sinan from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “Whoever comes to his estate and does not intend to stay for ten days, he should shorten (the prayer), but if he intends to stay for ten days, he should complete the prayer.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 232

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Ibrahim from al-Barqi from Sulayman ibn Ja’far al-Ja’fari from Musa ibn Hamzah ibn Baziy', who said:
I said to Abu al-Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him: “May I be your ransom, I have an estate before reaching Baghdad. I set out from Kufah, intending to go onwards to Baghdad, but I stay in that estate. Should I shorten or complete (the prayer)?” Imam (a.s) said: “If you do not intend to stay for ten (days), then shorten (the prayers).”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنِ اَلْبَرْقِيِّ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ اَلْجَعْفَرِيِّ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ حَمْزَةَ بْنِ بَزِيعٍ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي اَلْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ جُعِلْتُ فِدَاكَ إِنَّ لِي ضَيْعَةً دُونَ بَغْدَادَ فَأَخْرُجُ مِنَ اَلْكُوفَةِ أُرِيدُ بَغْدَادَ فَأُقِيمُ فِي تِلْكَ اَلضَّيْعَةِ فَأُقَصِّرُ أَمْ أُتِمُّ فَقَالَ« إِنْ لَمْ تَنْوِ اَلْمُقَامَ عَشْراً فَقَصِّرْ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Ibrahim from al-Barqi from Sulayman ibn Ja’far al-Ja’fari from Musa ibn Hamzah ibn Baziy', who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I said to Abu al-Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him: “May I be your ransom, I have an estate before reaching Baghdad. I set out from Kufah, intending to go onwards to Baghdad, but I stay in that estate. Should I shorten or complete (the prayer)?” Imam (a.s) said: “If you do not intend to stay for ten (days), then shorten (the prayers).”
