chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Sa’ad from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ibn Abi Nasr from Hammad ibn Uthman from Ali ibn Yaqtin, who said:
I said to Abu al-Hasan al-Awwal (a.s) (the First), peace be upon him: “A man establishes a house and passes by it. Should he perform his prayer in full or shorten it?” Imam (a.s) said: “Every house that you do not take as a permanent residence (‘tastawtinu-hu’) is not considered your home, and you are not to perform the prayer in full in it.”
arabicText: سَعْدٌ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي نَصْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ يَقْطِينٍ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي اَلْحَسَنِ اَلْأَوَّلِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ اَلرَّجُلُ يَتَّخِذُ اَلْمَنْزِلَ فَيَمُرُّ بِهِ أَ يُتِمُّ صَلاَتَهُ أَمْ يُقَصِّرُ قَالَ« كُلُّ مَنْزِلِ لاَ تَسْتَوْطِنُهُ فَلَيْسَ لَكَ بِمَنْزِلٍ وَ لَيْسَ لَكَ أَنْ تُتِمَّ فِيهِ»
thaqalaynSanad: Sa’ad from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ibn Abi Nasr from Hammad ibn Uthman from Ali ibn Yaqtin, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I said to Abu al-Hasan al-Awwal (a.s) (the First), peace be upon him: “A man establishes a house and passes by it. Should he perform his prayer in full or shorten it?” Imam (a.s) said: “Every house that you do not take as a permanent residence (‘tastawtinu-hu’) is not considered your home, and you are not to perform the prayer in full in it.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 233

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Ahmad from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Yaqtin from his brother al-Husayn from Ali, who said:
I asked Abu al-Hasan al-Awwal (a.s) (the First), peace be upon him, about a man who passes through some cities, and he has a house in that city, but the city is not his homeland. Should he complete his prayer or shorten it? Imam (a.s) said: “He should shorten the prayer, and estates (al-diya’) are the same in that regard, if he passes through them.”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ يَقْطِينٍ عَنْ أَخِيهِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ عَلِيٍّ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا اَلْحَسَنِ اَلْأَوَّلَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ يَمُرُّ بِبَعْضِ اَلْأَمْصَارِ وَ لَهُ بِالْمِصْرِ دَارٌ وَ لَيْسَ اَلْمِصْرُ وَطَنَهُ أَ يُتِمُّ صَلاَتَهُ أَمْ يُقَصِّرُ قَالَ« يُقَصِّرُ اَلصَّلاَةَ وَ اَلضِّيَاعُ مِثْلُ ذَلِكَ إِذَا مَرَّبِهَا»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Ahmad from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Yaqtin from his brother al-Husayn from Ali, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu al-Hasan al-Awwal (a.s) (the First), peace be upon him, about a man who passes through some cities, and he has a house in that city, but the city is not his homeland. Should he complete his prayer or shorten it? Imam (a.s) said: “He should shorten the prayer, and estates (al-diya’) are the same in that regard, if he passes through them.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 233

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, by Ayyub ibn Nuh by Ibn Abi Umayr by Hammad ibn Uthman by al-Halabi from Abu Abdillah (a.s):
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) was asked regarding a man who travels and passes by a house of his, on the road. Should he complete the prayer or shorten it? Imam (a.s) said: “He should shorten (the prayers). Prayer is only (performed in full) in the house that he has settled in permanently (‘tawattanahu’).”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ أَيُّوبَ بْنِ نُوحٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنِ اَلْحَلَبِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: فِي اَلرَّجُلِ يُسَافِرُ فَيَمُرُّ بِالْمَنْزِلِ لَهُ فِي اَلطَّرِيقِ يُتِمُّ اَلصَّلاَةَ أَمْ يُقَصِّرُ قَالَ« يُقَصِّرُ إِنَّمَا هُوَ اَلْمَنْزِلُ اَلَّذِي تَوَطَّنَهُ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, by Ayyub ibn Nuh by Ibn Abi Umayr by Hammad ibn Uthman by al-Halabi from Abu Abdillah (a.s):
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) was asked regarding a man who travels and passes by a house of his, on the road. Should he complete the prayer or shorten it? Imam (a.s) said: “He should shorten (the prayers). Prayer is only (performed in full) in the house that he has settled in permanently (‘tawattanahu’).”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 233

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Ayyub from Safwan ibn Yahya from Sa’ad ibn Abi Khalaf, who said:
Ali ibn Yaqtin asked Abu al-Hasan al-Awwal (a.s) (the First), peace be upon him, about a house that a man owns in a city or in an estate, and he passes by it. Imam (a.s) said: “If it is among the places he has lived in, then he should complete the prayer in it; but if it is among those he has not lived in, then let him shorten (prayer).”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ أَيُّوبَ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي خَلَفٍ قَالَ سَأَلَ عَلِيُّ بْنُ يَقْطِينٍ أَبَا اَلْحَسَنِ اَلْأَوَّلَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: عَنِ اَلدَّارِ تَكُونُ لِلرَّجُلِ بِمِصْرٍ أَوِ اَلضَّيْعَةِ فَيَمُرُّ بِهَا قَالَ« إِذَا كَانَ مِمَّا قَدْ سَكَنَهُ أَتَمَّ فِيهِ اَلصَّلاَةَ وَ إِنْ كَانَ مِمَّا لَمْ يَسْكُنْهُ فَلْيُقَصِّرْ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Ayyub from Safwan ibn Yahya from Sa’ad ibn Abi Khalaf, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Ali ibn Yaqtin asked Abu al-Hasan al-Awwal (a.s) (the First), peace be upon him, about a house that a man owns in a city or in an estate, and he passes by it. Imam (a.s) said: “If it is among the places he has lived in, then he should complete the prayer in it; but if it is among those he has not lived in, then let him shorten (prayer).”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 233

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Ayyub ibn Nuh from Abu Talib from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr from Hammad ibn Uthman from Ali ibn Yaqtin, who said:
I said to Abu al-Hasan al-Awwal (a.s) (the First), peace be upon him: “I have estates and houses between one village and another, at a distance of two or three parasangs.” Imam (a.s) said: “Every house among your houses that you do not take as a permanent residence (tastawtinu-hu), upon you in it is the shortening of the prayer (taqsir).”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ أَيُّوبَ بْنِ نُوحٍ عَنْ أَبِي طَالِبٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي نَصْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ يَقْطِينٍ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي اَلْحَسَنِ اَلْأَوَّلِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ إِنَّ لِي ضِيَاعاً وَ مَنَازِلَ بَيْنَ اَلْقَرْيَةِ وَ اَلْقَرْيَتَيْنِ اَلْفَرْسَخَانِ وَ اَلثَّلاَثَةُ فَقَالَ« كُلُّ مَنْزِلٍ مِنْ مَنَازِلِكَ لاَ تَسْتَوْطِنُهُ فَعَلَيْكَ فِيهِ اَلتَّقْصِيرُ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Ayyub ibn Nuh from Abu Talib from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr from Hammad ibn Uthman from Ali ibn Yaqtin, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I said to Abu al-Hasan al-Awwal (a.s) (the First), peace be upon him: “I have estates and houses between one village and another, at a distance of two or three parasangs.” Imam (a.s) said: “Every house among your houses that you do not take as a permanent residence (tastawtinu-hu), upon you in it is the shortening of the prayer (taqsir).”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 234

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad from Ahmad ibn al-Husayn from Muhammad ibn Isma'il ibn Bazi‘ from Abu al-Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Imam al-Ridha (a.s) about a man who shortens (the prayer) in his estate. Imam (a.s) said: “There is no harm as long as he does not intend to stay for ten days, unless he has in it a house that he resides in permanently (yastawtinuhu).” So I asked: “What is 'residing permanently' (al-istitan)?” Imam (a.s) said: “That he has in it a house, in which he stays for six months if that is the case, then he completes the prayer in it whenever he enters it.”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَحْمَدَ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ بَزِيعٍ عَنْ أَبِي اَلْحَسَنِ عَُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يُقَصِّرُ فِي ضَيْعَتِهِ فَقَالَ« لاَ بَأْسَ مَا لَمْ يَنْوِ مُقَامَ عَشَرَةِ أَيَّامٍ إِلاَّ أَنْ يَكُونَ لَهُ فِيهَا مَنْزِلٌ يَسْتَوْطِنُهُ» فَقُلْتُ مَا اَلاِسْتِيطَانُ فَقَالَ« أَنْ يَكُونَ لَهُ فِيهَا مَنْزِلٌ يُقِيمُ فِيهِ سِتَّةَ أَشْهُرٍ فَإِذَا كَانَ كَذَلِكَ يُتِمُّ فِيهَا مَتَى يَدْخُلُهَا».
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad from Ahmad ibn al-Husayn from Muhammad ibn Isma'il ibn Bazi‘ from Abu al-Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Imam al-Ridha (a.s) about a man who shortens (the prayer) in his estate. Imam (a.s) said: “There is no harm as long as he does not intend to stay for ten days, unless he has in it a house that he resides in permanently (yastawtinuhu).” So I asked: “What is 'residing permanently' (al-istitan)?” Imam (a.s) said: “That he has in it a house, in which he stays for six months if that is the case, then he completes the prayer in it whenever he enters it.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 234

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Yaqub ibn Yazid from Ibn Abi Umayr from Abdillah ibn al-Mughira from Hudhayfah ibn Mansur from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
I heard Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) say: “I went out to a land of mine, and I shortened (the prayer) for three days and performed it in full for three days.”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ اَلْمُغِيرَةِ عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ بْنِ مَنْصُورٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ سَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ:« خَرَجْتُ إِلَى أَرْضٍ لِي فَقَصَّرْتُ ثَلاَثاً وَ أَتْمَمْتُ ثَلاَثاً»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Yaqub ibn Yazid from Ibn Abi Umayr from Abdillah ibn al-Mughira from Hudhayfah ibn Mansur from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I heard Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) say: “I went out to a land of mine, and I shortened (the prayer) for three days and performed it in full for three days.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 234

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
As for what was narrated by Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ibn Abi Umayr from Abdillah ibn Bukayr from Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Hajjaj, who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “A man has estates, some of them near to others, and he goes out and moves around among them. Should he complete (the prayer) or shorten it?” Imam (a.s) said: “He should complete (the prayer).”
arabicText: فَأَمَّا مَا رَوَاهُ أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ بُكَيْرٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَلرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ اَلْحَجَّاجِ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَُ اَلرَّجُلُ لَهُ اَلضِّيَاعُ بَعْضُهَا قَرِيبٌ مِنْ بَعْضٍ فَيَخْرُجُ فَيَطُوفُ فِيهَا أَ يُتِمُّ أَمْ يُقَصِّرُ قَالَ «يُتِمُّ»
thaqalaynSanad: As for what was narrated by Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ibn Abi Umayr from Abdillah ibn Bukayr from Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Hajjaj, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “A man has estates, some of them near to others, and he goes out and moves around among them. Should he complete (the prayer) or shorten it?” Imam (a.s) said: “He should complete (the prayer).”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 235

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And what was narrated by Muhammad ibn Yaqub from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan and others from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, who said:
I asked Imam al-Ridha (a.s), peace be upon him, about a man who goes out to his estate and stays there for a day, or two days, or three dyas. Should he shorten (the prayer) or complete (the prayer)? Imam (a.s) said: “He should complete the prayer whenever he comes to one of his estates.”
arabicText: وَ مَا رَوَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحَسَنِ وَ غَيْرِهِ عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي نَصْرٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ اَلرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يَخْرُجُ إِلَى ضَيْعَتِهِ فَيُقِيمُ اَلْيَوْمَ وَ اَلْيَوْمَيْنِ وَ اَلثَّلاَثَ أَ يُقَصِّرُ أَمْ يُتِمُّ قَالَ« يُتِمُّ اَلصَّلاَةَ كُلَّمَا أَتَى ضَيْعَةً مِنْ ضِيَاعِهِ»
thaqalaynSanad: And what was narrated by Muhammad ibn Yaqub from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan and others from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Imam al-Ridha (a.s), peace be upon him, about a man who goes out to his estate and stays there for a day, or two days, or three dyas. Should he shorten (the prayer) or complete (the prayer)? Imam (a.s) said: “He should complete the prayer whenever he comes to one of his estates.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 235

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Isa from Abdillah ibn al-Mughira from Isma'il ibn Abi Ziyad from Imam Ja’far (a.s) from his father (a.s), peace be upon them both, who said:
Imam al-Baqir (a.s) said: “Seven (groups of people) do not shorten the prayer; the tax collector (al-jabi) who moves about in his collection (of taxes), the governor (al-amir) who moves about in his governorship, the merchant (al-tajir) who moves about in his trade from market to market, the shepherd (al-ra’i), the Bedouin (al-badawi) who seeks places of rainfall and plant growth, the man who seeks hunting for the amusement of the world, And the highwayman (al-muharib) who cuts off the road.” (Arabic idiom for ambush or attack on travellers on the road,)
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ اَلْمُغِيرَةِ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ أَبِي زِيَادٍ عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَلَيْهِمَا اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« سَبْعَةٌ لاَ يُقَصِّرُونَ اَلصَّلاَةَ اَلْجَابِي يَدُورُ فِي جِبَايَتِهِ وَ اَلْأَمِيرُ اَلَّذِي يَدُورُ فِي إِمَارَتِهِ وَ اَلتَّاجِرُ اَلَّذِي يَدُورُ فِي تِجَارَتِهِ مِنْ سُوقٍ إِلَى سُوقٍ وَ اَلرَّاعِي وَ اَلْبَدَوِيُّ اَلَّذِي يَطْلُبُ مَوَاضِعَ اَلْقَطْرِ وَ مَنْبِتَ اَلشَّجَرِ وَ اَلرَّجُلُ يَطْلُبُ اَلصَّيْدَ يُرِيدُ بِهِ لَهْوَ اَلدُّنْيَا وَ اَلْمُحَارِبُ اَلَّذِي يَقْطَعُ اَلسَّبِيلَ»
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Isa from Abdillah ibn al-Mughira from Isma'il ibn Abi Ziyad from Imam Ja’far (a.s) from his father (a.s), peace be upon them both, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Baqir (a.s) said: “Seven (groups of people) do not shorten the prayer; the tax collector (al-jabi) who moves about in his collection (of taxes), the governor (al-amir) who moves about in his governorship, the merchant (al-tajir) who moves about in his trade from market to market, the shepherd (al-ra’i), the Bedouin (al-badawi) who seeks places of rainfall and plant growth, the man who seeks hunting for the amusement of the world, And the highwayman (al-muharib) who cuts off the road.” (Arabic idiom for ambush or attack on travellers on the road,)

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 235

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Muhammad ibn Isa from Abu al-Mi'za from Muhammad ibn Muslim from one of the two Imams (a.s), peace be upon them, who said:
Imam (a.s) said: “There is no shortening (of the prayer) upon the sailors in their ships, nor upon the mule drivers, nor upon the camel drivers.”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ أَبِي اَلْمِعْزَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ أَحَدِهِمَا عَلَيْهِمَا اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« لَيْسَ عَلَى اَلْمَلاَّحِينَ فِي سَفِينَتِهِمْ تَقْصِيرٌ وَ لاَ عَلَى اَلْمُكَارِينَ وَ لاَ عَلَى اَلْجَمَّالِينَ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Muhammad ibn Isa from Abu al-Mi'za from Muhammad ibn Muslim from one of the two Imams (a.s), peace be upon them, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: “There is no shortening (of the prayer) upon the sailors in their ships, nor upon the mule drivers, nor upon the camel drivers.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 236

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Hammad ibn Isa from Hariz from Zurarah, who said:
Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, said: “There are four for whom it may be obligatory to perform the prayer in full, whether they are traveling or residing; the muleteer (al-mukari), the hired rider (al-kariyy), the shepherd (al-ra‘i), and the courier (al-ashtaqan), because it is their work.”
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ:« أَرْبَعَةٌ قَدْ يَجِبُ عَلَيْهِمُ اَلتَّمَامُ فِي سَفَرٍ كَانُوا أَوْ فِي حَضَرٍ اَلْمُكَارِي وَ اَلْكَرِيُّ وَ اَلرَّاعِي وَ اَلْأَشْتَقَانُ لِأَنَّهُ عَمَلُهُمْ»
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Hammad ibn Isa from Hariz from Zurarah, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, said: “There are four for whom it may be obligatory to perform the prayer in full, whether they are traveling or residing; the muleteer (al-mukari), the hired rider (al-kariyy), the shepherd (al-ra‘i), and the courier (al-ashtaqan), because it is their work.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 236

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ali ibn Ibrahim from Muhammad ibn Isa from Yunus ibn Abd al-Rahman from Ishaq ibn Ammar, who said:
I asked Imam (a.s) about the sailors (al-mallahin) and the Bedouins (al-a‘rab), is the shortening of the prayer (taqsir) obligatory upon them? Imam (a.s) said: “No, their ‘homes’ are with them.”
arabicText: عَلِيُّ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَلرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلْمَلاَّحِينَ وَ اَلْأَعْرَابِ هَلْ عَلَيْهِمْ تَقْصِيرٌ قَالَ« لاَ بُيُوتُهُمْ مَعَهُمْ»
thaqalaynSanad: Ali ibn Ibrahim from Muhammad ibn Isa from Yunus ibn Abd al-Rahman from Ishaq ibn Ammar, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Imam (a.s) about the sailors (al-mallahin) and the Bedouins (al-a‘rab), is the shortening of the prayer (taqsir) obligatory upon them? Imam (a.s) said: “No, their ‘homes’ are with them.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 236

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
As for what was narrated by Sa’ad from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Faddalah from al-Ala ibn Razin from Muhammad ibn Muslim from one of the two Imams (a.s), peace be upon them, who said:
Imam (a.s) said: “The muleteer (al-mukari) and the camel driver (al-jammal), if the travel becomes serious for them, then let them shorten (the prayer).”
arabicText: فَأَمَّا مَا رَوَاهُ سَعْدٌ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنِ اَلْعَلاَءِ بْنِ رَزِينٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ أَحَدِهِمَا عَلَيْهِمَا اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« اَلْمُكَارِي وَ اَلْجَمَّالُ إِذَا جَدَّ بِهِمَا اَلسَّيْرُ فَلْيَقْصُرَا»
thaqalaynSanad: As for what was narrated by Sa’ad from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Faddalah from al-Ala ibn Razin from Muhammad ibn Muslim from one of the two Imams (a.s), peace be upon them, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: “The muleteer (al-mukari) and the camel driver (al-jammal), if the travel becomes serious for them, then let them shorten (the prayer).”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 236

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Ahmad from al-Husayn from Faddalah from Aban ibn Uthman from al-Fadl ibn Abd al-Malik, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about the mule drivers (al-makarin) who travel frequently. Imam (a.s) said: “If they intensify the travel, then let them shorten (the prayer).”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ أَبَانِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنِ اَلْفَضْلِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَلْمَلِكِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلْمُكَارِينَ اَلَّذِينَ يَخْتَلِفُونَ فَقَالَ« إِذَا جَدُّوا اَلسَّيْرَ فَلْيَقْصُرُوا»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Ahmad from al-Husayn from Faddalah from Aban ibn Uthman from al-Fadl ibn Abd al-Malik, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about the mule drivers (al-makarin) who travel frequently. Imam (a.s) said: “If they intensify the travel, then let them shorten (the prayer).”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 236

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Sa’ad from Ahmad from Imran ibn Muhammad ibn Imran al-Ash'ari from some of our companions who raised it (in isnad) to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “The camel driver (al-jammal) and the mule driver (al-makari) if the travel becomes intense for them, then let them shorten (the prayer) between the two residences, and perform it in full at the residence.”
arabicText: سَعْدٌ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ عَنْ عِمْرَانَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِمْرَانَ اَلْأَشْعَرِيِّ عَنْ بَعْضِ أَصْحَابِنَا يَرْفَعُهُ إِلَى أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« اَلْجَمَّالُ وَ اَلْمُكَارِي إِذَا جَدَّ بِهِمَا اَلسَّيْرُ فَلْيَقْصُرَا فِيمَا بَيْنَ اَلْمَنْزِلَيْنِ وَ يُتِمَّا فِي اَلْمَنْزِلِ»
thaqalaynSanad: Sa’ad from Ahmad from Imran ibn Muhammad ibn Imran al-Ash'ari from some of our companions who raised it (in isnad) to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “The camel driver (al-jammal) and the mule driver (al-makari) if the travel becomes intense for them, then let them shorten (the prayer) between the two residences, and perform it in full at the residence.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 237

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Sa’ad from Ibrahim ibn Hashim from Isma'il ibn Marrar from Yunus ibn Abd al-Rahman from Abdillah ibn Sinan from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “The mule driver (al-makari), if he does not stay in his home for more than five days or less, then he shortens (the prayer) during his travel in the daytime and completes it at night, and he is obligated to fast the Month of Ramadan. But if he has a residence in the town, to which he travels, where he stays for ten days or more, then he shortens (the prayer) during his journey and breaks his fast.”
arabicText: سَعْدٌ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ هَاشِمٍ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ مَرَّارٍ عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَلرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: قَالَ:« اَلْمُكَارِي إِنْ لَمْ يَسْتَقِرَّ فِي مَنْزِلِهِ إِلاَّ خَمْسَةَ أَيَّامٍ أَوْ أَقَلَّ قَصَّرَ فِي سَفَرِهِ بِالنَّهَارِ وَ أَتَمَّ بِاللَّيْلِ وَ عَلَيْهِ صَوْمُ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ فَإِنْ كَانَ لَهُ مُقَامٌ فِي اَلْبَلَدِ اَلَّذِي يَذْهَبُ إِلَيْهِ عَشَرَةَ أَيَّامٍ وَ أَكْثَرَ قَصَّرَ فِي سَفَرِهِ وَ أَفْطَرَ»
thaqalaynSanad: Sa’ad from Ibrahim ibn Hashim from Isma'il ibn Marrar from Yunus ibn Abd al-Rahman from Abdillah ibn Sinan from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “The mule driver (al-makari), if he does not stay in his home for more than five days or less, then he shortens (the prayer) during his travel in the daytime and completes it at night, and he is obligated to fast the Month of Ramadan. But if he has a residence in the town, to which he travels, where he stays for ten days or more, then he shortens (the prayer) during his journey and breaks his fast.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 237

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Muhammad ibn Khalid al-Tayalisi from Sayf ibn Umayrah from Ishaq ibn Ammar, who said:
I asked Abu Ibrahim (Imam al-Kadhim (a.s)), peace be upon him, about those who hire out animals and travel constantly, every day. Are they required to shorten (the prayer), when they are on a journey? Imam (a.s) said: “Yes.”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ اَلطَّيَالِسِيِّ عَنْ سَيْفِ بْنِ عَمِيرَةَ عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلَّذِينَ يُكْرُونَ اَلدَّوَابَّ يَخْتَلِفُونَ كُلَّ اَلْأَيَّامِ أَ عَلَيْهِمُ اَلتَّقْصِيرُ إِذَا كَانُوا فِي سَفَرٍ قَالَ« نَعَمْ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Muhammad ibn Khalid al-Tayalisi from Sayf ibn Umayrah from Ishaq ibn Ammar, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Ibrahim (Imam al-Kadhim (a.s)), peace be upon him, about those who hire out animals and travel constantly, every day. Are they required to shorten (the prayer), when they are on a journey? Imam (a.s) said: “Yes.”

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Sa’ad from Abu Ja’far from his father, and Muhammad ibn Khalid al-Barqi from Abdillah ibn al-Mughira from Ishaq ibn Ammar from Abu Ibrahim (Imam al-Kadhim (a.s)), peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Imam al-Kadhim (a.s) about the mule drivers who hire out animals, and said: “They are constantly traveling, whenever some opportunity comes to them, they set out.” Imam (a.s) said: “They are required to shorten (the prayer) when they travel.”
arabicText: سَعْدٌ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ وَ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ اَلْبَرْقِيِّ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ اَلْمُغِيرَةِ عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ عَنْ أَبِي إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلْمُكَارِينَ اَلَّذِينَ يُكْرُونَ اَلدَّوَابَّ وَقُلْتُ يَخْتَلِفُونَ كُلَّ أَيَّامٍ كُلَّمَا جَاءَ هُمْ شَيْءٌ اِخْتَلَفُوا فَقَالَ« عَلَيْهِمُ اَلتَّقْصِيرُ إِذَا سَافَرُوا»
thaqalaynSanad: Sa’ad from Abu Ja’far from his father, and Muhammad ibn Khalid al-Barqi from Abdillah ibn al-Mughira from Ishaq ibn Ammar from Abu Ibrahim (Imam al-Kadhim (a.s)), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Imam al-Kadhim (a.s) about the mule drivers who hire out animals, and said: “They are constantly traveling, whenever some opportunity comes to them, they set out.” Imam (a.s) said: “They are required to shorten (the prayer) when they travel.”

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Abdillah ibn Ja’far from Muhammad ibn Jazzaq, who said:
I wrote to Abu al-Hasan al-Thalith (a.s) (the Third), peace be upon him, saying: “I have camels and caretakers over them, and I do not go out with them except on the road to Mecca, due to my desire for Hajj, or rarely to some (other) places. What is incumbent upon me when I go out with them what should I do? Is it obligatory upon me to shorten the prayer and break the fast while traveling, or to complete them?” So Imam al-Hadi (a.s), peace be upon him, wrote in response: “If you do not accompany them regularly and do not go out with them on every journey, except on the road to Mecca, then shortening (the prayer) and breaking the fast are incumbent upon you.”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ جَزَّكٍ قَالَ: كَتَبْتُ إِلَى أَبِي اَلْحَسَنِ اَلثَّالِثِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ أَنَّ لِي جِمَالاً وَ لِي قُوَّاماً عَلَيْهَا وَ لَسْتُ أَخْرُجُ فِيهَا إِلاَّ فِي طَرِيقِ مَكَّةَ لِرَغْبَتِي فِي اَلْحَجِّ أَوْ فِي اَلنَّدْرَةِ إِلَى بَعْضِ اَلْمَوَاضِعِ فَمَا يَجِبُ عَلَيَّ إِذَا أَنَا خَرَجْتُ مَعَهُمْ أَنْ أَعْمَلَ أَ يَجِبُ عَلَيَّ اَلتَّقْصِيرُ فِي اَلصَّلاَةِ وَ اَلصِّيَامِ فِي اَلسَّفَرِ أَوِ اَلتَّمَامُ فَوَقَّعَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ« إِذَا كُنْتَ لاَ تَلْزَمُهَا وَ لاَ تَخْرُجُ مَعَهَا فِي كُلِّ سَفَرٍ إِلاَّ إِلَى طَرِيقِ مَكَّةَ فَعَلَيْكَ تَقْصِيرٌ وَ إِفْطَارٌ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Abdillah ibn Ja’far from Muhammad ibn Jazzaq, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I wrote to Abu al-Hasan al-Thalith (a.s) (the Third), peace be upon him, saying: “I have camels and caretakers over them, and I do not go out with them except on the road to Mecca, due to my desire for Hajj, or rarely to some (other) places. What is incumbent upon me when I go out with them what should I do? Is it obligatory upon me to shorten the prayer and break the fast while traveling, or to complete them?” So Imam al-Hadi (a.s), peace be upon him, wrote in response: “If you do not accompany them regularly and do not go out with them on every journey, except on the road to Mecca, then shortening (the prayer) and breaking the fast are incumbent upon you.”

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Faddalah ibn Ayyub from Aban ibn Uthman from al-Fadl ibn Abd al-Malik, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about a traveller who stays with some of his family for a day and a night. Imam (a.s) said: “He should shorten the prayer.”
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ بْنِ أَيُّوبَ عَنْ أَبَانِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنِ اَلْفَضْلِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَلْمَلِكِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلْمُسَافِرِ يَنْزِلُ عَلَى بَعْضِ أَهْلِهِ يَوْماً وَ لَيْلَةً قَالَ« يُقَصِّرُ اَلصَّلاَةَ»
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Faddalah ibn Ayyub from Aban ibn Uthman from al-Fadl ibn Abd al-Malik, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about a traveller who stays with some of his family for a day and a night. Imam (a.s) said: “He should shorten the prayer.”

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Sahl ibn Ziyad from Ali ibn Asbat from Ibn Bukayr, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about a man who goes hunting for a day, or two days, or three days. Should he shorten the prayer? Imam (a.s) said: “No, unless the man is accompanying his brother in faith. Indeed, hunting is a vain journey (‘masir batil’) in which the prayer is not to be shortened.” And Imam (a.s) said: “He shortens (the prayer) if he is accompanying his brother.”
arabicText: سَهْلُ بْنُ زِيَادٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَسْبَاطٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ بُكَيْرٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يَتَصَيَّدُ اَلْيَوْمَ وَ اَلْيَوْمَيْنِ وَ اَلثَّلاَثَ أَ يُقَصِّرُ اَلصَّلاَةَ قَالَ« لاَ إِلاَّ أَنْ يُشَيِّعَ اَلرَّجُلُ أَخَاهُ مِنَ اَلدِّينِ وَ إِنَّ اَلتَّصَيُّدَ مَسِيرٌ بَاطِلٌ لاَ يُقَصَّرُ اَلصَّلاَةُ فِيهِ» وَ قَالَ« يُقَصِّرُ إِذَا شَيَّعَ أَخَاهُ»
thaqalaynSanad: Sahl ibn Ziyad from Ali ibn Asbat from Ibn Bukayr, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about a man who goes hunting for a day, or two days, or three days. Should he shorten the prayer? Imam (a.s) said: “No, unless the man is accompanying his brother in faith. Indeed, hunting is a vain journey (‘masir batil’) in which the prayer is not to be shortened.” And Imam (a.s) said: “He shortens (the prayer) if he is accompanying his brother.”

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ibn Faddal from Ibn Bukayr from Ubayd ibn Zurarah, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about a man who goes out for hunting, should he shorten or complete (the prayer)? Imam (a.s) said: “He should complete (the prayer), because it is not a journey of truth (masir haqq).” (meaning it is not a journey of necessity)
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ بُكَيْرٍ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ زُرَارَةَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يَخْرُجُ إِلَى اَلصَّيْدِ أَ يُقَصِّرُ أَوْ يُتِمُّ قَالَ« يُتِمُّ لِأَنَّهُ لَيْسَ بِمَسِيرِ حَقٍّ»
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ibn Faddal from Ibn Bukayr from Ubayd ibn Zurarah, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about a man who goes out for hunting, should he shorten or complete (the prayer)? Imam (a.s) said: “He should complete (the prayer), because it is not a journey of truth (masir haqq).” (meaning it is not a journey of necessity)

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Imran ibn Muhammad ibn Imran al-Qummi from some of our companions from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
I said to Imam al-Sadiq (a.s): “A man goes out for hunting for a distance of a day or two, should he shorten or complete (the prayer)?” Imam (a.s) said: “If he goes out for his sustenance and the sustenance of his family (meaning necessity), then let him break his fast and shorten (the prayer); But if he goes out seeking excess (luxury or amusement, without necessity), then no (breaking fast or shortening prayer) and no honor (in that) for him.”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ عِمْرَانَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِمْرَانَ اَلْقُمِّيِّ عَنْ بَعْضِ أَصْحَابِنَا عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لَهُ اَلرَّجُلُ يَخْرُجُ إِلَى اَلصَّيْدِ مَسِيرَةَ يَوْمٍ أَوْ يَوْمَيْنِ يُقَصِّرُ أَوْ يُتِمُّ فَقَالَ« إِنْ خَرَجَ لِقُوتِهِ وَ قُوتِ عِيَالِهِ فَلْيُفْطِرْ وَ يُقَصِّرُ وَ إِنْ خَرَجَ لِطَلَبِ اَلْفُضُولِ فَلاَ وَ لاَ كَرَامَةَ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Imran ibn Muhammad ibn Imran al-Qummi from some of our companions from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I said to Imam al-Sadiq (a.s): “A man goes out for hunting for a distance of a day or two, should he shorten or complete (the prayer)?” Imam (a.s) said: “If he goes out for his sustenance and the sustenance of his family (meaning necessity), then let him break his fast and shorten (the prayer); But if he goes out seeking excess (luxury or amusement, without necessity), then no (breaking fast or shortening prayer) and no honor (in that) for him.”

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad from al-Mu'alla ibn Muhammad from al-Washa from Hammad ibn Uthman from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) was asked regarding the saying of Allah (swt), the Majestic: “But whoever is forced by necessity, neither desiring it nor transgressing” (Surah Al Baqarah 2:173). Imam (a.s) said: “The one who ‘desires’ (it) is the seeker of game (hunting, ‘al-baghi’), and the ‘transgressor’ is the thief (al-adi); Neither of them is permitted to eat the dead meat (al-maytah) if they are compelled to it (starvation), it is forbidden for them (even under extreme necessity). It is not (allowed) upon them as it is upon the Muslims, and also they are not allowed to shorten the prayer.”
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اَلْمُعَلَّى بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اَلْوَشَّاءِ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: فِي قَوْلِ اَللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ« فَمَنِ اُضْطُرَّ غَيْرَ بٰاغٍ وَ لاٰ عٰادٍ» قَالَ« اَلْبَاغِي بَاغِي اَلصَّيْدِ وَ اَلْعَادِي هُوَ اَلسَّارِقُ لَيْسَ لَهُمَا أَنْ يَأْكُلاَ اَلْمَيْتَةَ إِذَا اُضْطُرَّا إِلَيْهَا هِيَ حَرَامٌ عَلَيْهِمَا لَيْسَ هِيَ عَلَيْهِمَا كَمَا هِيَ عَلَى اَلْمُسْلِمِينَ وَ لَيْسَ لَهُمَا أَنْ يُقَصِّرَا فِي اَلصَّلاَةِ»
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad from al-Mu'alla ibn Muhammad from al-Washa from Hammad ibn Uthman from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) was asked regarding the saying of Allah (swt), the Majestic: “But whoever is forced by necessity, neither desiring it nor transgressing” (Surah Al Baqarah 2:173). Imam (a.s) said: “The one who ‘desires’ (it) is the seeker of game (hunting, ‘al-baghi’), and the ‘transgressor’ is the thief (al-adi); Neither of them is permitted to eat the dead meat (al-maytah) if they are compelled to it (starvation), it is forbidden for them (even under extreme necessity). It is not (allowed) upon them as it is upon the Muslims, and also they are not allowed to shorten the prayer.”

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Abbas ibn Amir from Aban ibn Uthman from Zurarah from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Imam al-Baqir (a.s) about a man who goes out, from his family with falcons, hawks, and dogs, spending a night or two or three nights for recreation. Should he shorten his prayer or not? Imam (a.s) said: “Indeed, he has gone out for amusement; he does not shorten (the prayer).” I asked: “A man accompanies his brother for a day or two, during the Month of Ramadan.” Imam (a.s) said: “He breaks his fast and shortens the prayer, for that is a right upon him (to accompany his brother or brother in faith).”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ عَبَّاسِ بْنِ عَامِرٍ عَنْ أَبَانِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَمَّنْ يَخْرُجُ مِنْ أَهْلِهِ بِالصُّقُورِ وَ اَلْبُزَاةِ وَ اَلْكِلاَبِ يَتَنَزَّهُ اَللَّيْلَةَ وَ اَللَّيْلَتَيْنِ وَ اَلثَّلاَثَةَ هَلْ يُقَصِّرُ مِنْ صَلاَتِهِ أَمْ لاَ يُقَصِّرُ قَالَ« إِنَّمَا خَرَجَ فِي لَهْوٍلاَ يُقَصِّرُ» قُلْتُ اَلرَّجُلُ يُشَيِّعُ أَخَاهُ اَلْيَوْمَ وَاَلْيَوْمَيْنِ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ قَالَ« يُفْطِرُ وَ يُقَصِّرُ فَإِنَّ ذَلِكَ حَقٌّ عَلَيْهِ»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Abbas ibn Amir from Aban ibn Uthman from Zurarah from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Imam al-Baqir (a.s) about a man who goes out, from his family with falcons, hawks, and dogs, spending a night or two or three nights for recreation. Should he shorten his prayer or not? Imam (a.s) said: “Indeed, he has gone out for amusement; he does not shorten (the prayer).” I asked: “A man accompanies his brother for a day or two, during the Month of Ramadan.” Imam (a.s) said: “He breaks his fast and shortens the prayer, for that is a right upon him (to accompany his brother or brother in faith).”

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
As for what was narrated by Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from Safwan from Abdillah, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about a man who goes hunting. Imam (a.s) said: “If he moves about within his vicinity, then he should not shorten (the prayer); but if he goes beyond the distance (that defines the time limit), then let him shorten (the prayer).”
arabicText: فَأَمَّا مَا رَوَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يَتَصَيَّدُ فَقَالَ« إِنْ كَانَ يَدُورُ حَوْلَهُ فَلاَ يُقَصِّرُ وَ إِنْ كَانَ يُجَاوِزُ اَلْوَقْتَ فَلْيُقَصِّرْ»
thaqalaynSanad: As for what was narrated by Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from Safwan from Abdillah, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about a man who goes hunting. Imam (a.s) said: “If he moves about within his vicinity, then he should not shorten (the prayer); but if he goes beyond the distance (that defines the time limit), then let him shorten (the prayer).”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 239

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from al-Abbas ibn Ma'ruf from al-Hasan ibn Mahbub from some of our companions from Abu Basir from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “There is no shortening (of the prayer) upon the one who goes hunting for three days, but if he exceeds three days, then it becomes obligatory upon him (to shorten prayer).”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنِ اَلْعَبَّاسِ بْنِ مَعْرُوفٍ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ بَعْضِ أَصْحَابِنَا عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« لَيْسَ عَلَى صَاحِبِ اَلصَّيْدِ تَقْصِيرٌ ثَلاَثَةَ أَيَّامٍ وَ إِذَا جَاوَزَ اَلثَّلاَثَةَ لَزِمَهُ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from al-Abbas ibn Ma'ruf from al-Hasan ibn Mahbub from some of our companions from Abu Basir from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “There is no shortening (of the prayer) upon the one who goes hunting for three days, but if he exceeds three days, then it becomes obligatory upon him (to shorten prayer).”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 239

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad al-Sayyari, from one of the people of al-Askari, said:
There came a statement from Abu al-Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him: “Indeed, the hunter (sahib al-sayd) shortens (the prayer) as long as he is on the main road (al-jaddah). But when he deviates from the main road, he performs the full prayer. Then, if he returns to it, he shortens again.”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ اَلسَّيَّارِيِّ عَنْ بَعْضِ أَهْلِ اَلْعَسْكَرِ قَالَ: خَرَجَ عَنْ أَبِي اَلْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ« أَنَّ صَاحِبَ اَلصَّيْدِ يُقَصِّرُ مَادَامَ عَلَى اَلْجَادَّةِ فَإِذَا عَدَلَ عَنِ اَلْجَادَّةِ أَتَمَّ فَإِذَا رَجَعَ إِلَيْهَا قَصَّرَ»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad al-Sayyari, from one of the people of al-Askari, said:
thaqalaynMatn: There came a statement from Abu al-Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him: “Indeed, the hunter (sahib al-sayd) shortens (the prayer) as long as he is on the main road (al-jaddah). But when he deviates from the main road, he performs the full prayer. Then, if he returns to it, he shortens again.”

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from al-Husayn ibn Uthman, from Isma'il ibn Jabir, said:
I sought permission from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, while we were fasting in the Month of Ramadan, to go and meet Walid in al-A‘was. So Imam (a.s) said: “Meet him and break your fast (aftir).”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ جَابِرٍ قَالَ: اِسْتَأْذَنْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ وَ نَحْنُ نَصُومُ رَمَضَانَ لِنَلْقَى وَلِيداً بِالْأَعْوَصِ فَقَالَ« تَلَقَّهُ وَ أَفْطِرْ»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from al-Husayn ibn Uthman, from Isma'il ibn Jabir, said:
thaqalaynMatn: I sought permission from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, while we were fasting in the Month of Ramadan, to go and meet Walid in al-A‘was. So Imam (a.s) said: “Meet him and break your fast (aftir).”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 240

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Safwan, from al-Ala’, from Muhammad, from one of the two Imams (a.s), peace be upon them, who said:
Imam (a.s) said: “When a man escorts (yushayyi‘u) his brother (on a journey), then let him shorten (his prayer).” I asked: “Which of the two is better; that he fasts or that he escorts him and breaks his fast?” Imam (a.s) said: “(It is better that) He escorts him, for Allah (swt) has lifted it from him when he escorts him.”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنِ اَلْعَلاَءِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَحَدِهِمَا عَلَيْهِمَا اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« إِذَا شَيَّعَ اَلرَّجُلُ أَخَاهُ فَلْيُقَصِّرْ» قُلْتُ أَيُّهُمَا أَفْضَلُ يَصُومُ أَوْ يُشَيِّعُهُ وَ يُفْطِرُ قَالَ« يُشَيِّعُهُ لِأَنَّ اَللَّهَ قَدْ وَضَعَهُ عَنْهُ إِذَا شَيَّعَهُ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Safwan, from al-Ala’, from Muhammad, from one of the two Imams (a.s), peace be upon them, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: “When a man escorts (yushayyi‘u) his brother (on a journey), then let him shorten (his prayer).” I asked: “Which of the two is better; that he fasts or that he escorts him and breaks his fast?” Imam (a.s) said: “(It is better that) He escorts him, for Allah (swt) has lifted it from him when he escorts him.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 240

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Hammad ibn Uthman, from Hariz, from Zurarah, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
I said to Imam al-Baqir (a.s): “What do you say about someone who arrives in a town, until when should he remain shortening (his prayer), and when should he complete it (his prayer in full)?” Imam (a.s) said: “If you enter a land and you are certain (‘ayqanta’) that you will stay there for ten days, then complete the prayer (‘atimm al-salat’). But if you do not know how long your stay will be there, saying, ‘Tomorrow I will leave,’ or ‘the day after tomorrow,’ then shorten (your prayer) until a month passes. When a full month has passed for you, then complete the prayer even if you intend to leave at that very moment.”
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لَهُ أَ رَأَيْتَ مَنْ قَدِمَ بَلْدَةً إِلَى مَتَى يَنْبَغِي لَهُ أَنْ يَكُونَ مُقَصِّراً وَ مَتَى يَنْبَغِي لَهُ أَنْ يُتِمَّ فَقَالَ« إِذَا دَخَلْتَ أَرْضاً فَأَيْقَنْتَ أَنَّ لَكَ بِهَا مُقَامَ عَشَرَةِ أَيَّامٍ فَأَتِمَّ اَلصَّلاَةَ وَ إِنْ لَمْ تَدْرِ مَا مُقَامُكَ بِهَا تَقُولُ غَداً أَخْرُجُ أَوْ بَعْدَ غَدٍ فَقَصِّرْ مَا بَيْنَكَ وَ بَيْنَ أَنْ يَمْضِيَ شَهْرٌ فَإِذَا تَمَّ لَكَ شَهْرٌ فَأَتِمَّ اَلصَّلاَةَ وَ إِنْ أَرَدْتَ أَنْ تَخْرُجَ مِنْ سَاعَتِكَ»
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Hammad ibn Uthman, from Hariz, from Zurarah, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I said to Imam al-Baqir (a.s): “What do you say about someone who arrives in a town, until when should he remain shortening (his prayer), and when should he complete it (his prayer in full)?” Imam (a.s) said: “If you enter a land and you are certain (‘ayqanta’) that you will stay there for ten days, then complete the prayer (‘atimm al-salat’). But if you do not know how long your stay will be there, saying, ‘Tomorrow I will leave,’ or ‘the day after tomorrow,’ then shorten (your prayer) until a month passes. When a full month has passed for you, then complete the prayer even if you intend to leave at that very moment.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 240

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
As for what was narrated by Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub, from Abd al-Samad ibn Muhammad, from Hanan, from his father, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Baqir (a.s) said: “If you enter a town and say, ‘Today I will leave’ or ‘Tomorrow I will leave,’ but you complete ten (days), then complete (the prayer, ‘atimm’).”
arabicText: فَأَمَّا مَا رَوَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَلصَّمَدِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ حَنَانٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« إِذَا دَخَلْتَ اَلْبَلْدَةَ فَقُلْتَ اَلْيَوْمَ أَخْرُجُ أَوْ غَداً أَخْرُجُ فَاسْتَتْمَمْتَ عَشْراً فَأَتِمَّ»
thaqalaynSanad: As for what was narrated by Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub, from Abd al-Samad ibn Muhammad, from Hanan, from his father, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Baqir (a.s) said: “If you enter a town and say, ‘Today I will leave’ or ‘Tomorrow I will leave,’ but you complete ten (days), then complete (the prayer, ‘atimm’).”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 241

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
What was narrated by Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Ibn Abi Umayr from Abu Ayyub, who said:
Muhammad ibn Muslim asked Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, and I was listening, about the traveller; ‘if he considers staying for ten days.’ Imam (a.s) said: “Then let him complete the prayer. But if he does not know how long he will stay, a day or more, then let him count thirty days, then complete (the prayer), even if he has already stayed one day or performed one prayer.” Then Muhammad ibn Muslim said to Imam (a.s): “It has reached me that you said five (days).” Imam (a.s) said: “Yes, I did say that.” Abu Ayyub said: “So I asked: ‘May I be your ransom, could it be less than five days?’” Imam (a.s) said: “No.”
arabicText: ما رواه عَلِيُّ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ قَالَ: سَأَلَ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ وَ أَنَا أَسْمَعُ عَنِ اَلْمُسَافِرِ إِنْ حَدَّثَ نَفْسَهُ بِإِقَامَةِ عَشَرَةِ أَيَّامٍ قَالَ« فَلْيُتِمَّ اَلصَّلاَةَ فَإِنْ لَمْ يَدْرِ مَا يُقِيمُ يَوْماً أَوْ أَكْثَرَ فَلْيَعُدَّ ثَلاَثِينَ يَوْماً ثُمَّ لْيُتِمَّ وَ إِنْ كَانَ أَقَامَ يَوْماً أَوْ صَلاَةً وَاحِدَةً» فَقَالَ لَهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ بَلَغَنِي أَنَّكَ قُلْتَ خَمْساً فَقَالَ« قَدْ قُلْتُ ذَاكَ» قَالَ أَبُو أَيُّوبَ فَقُلْتُ أَنَا جُعِلْتُ فِدَاكَ يَكُونُ أَقَلَّ مِنْ خَمْسَةِ أَيَّامٍ فَقَالَ« لاَ»
thaqalaynSanad: What was narrated by Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Ibn Abi Umayr from Abu Ayyub, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Muhammad ibn Muslim asked Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, and I was listening, about the traveller; ‘if he considers staying for ten days.’ Imam (a.s) said: “Then let him complete the prayer. But if he does not know how long he will stay, a day or more, then let him count thirty days, then complete (the prayer), even if he has already stayed one day or performed one prayer.” Then Muhammad ibn Muslim said to Imam (a.s): “It has reached me that you said five (days).” Imam (a.s) said: “Yes, I did say that.” Abu Ayyub said: “So I asked: ‘May I be your ransom, could it be less than five days?’” Imam (a.s) said: “No.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 241

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub, from Ali ibn al-Sindi, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Hariz, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:
I asked Imam (a.s) about the traveller who arrives in a land. Imam (a.s) said: “If he considers within himself to stay for ten days, then let him complete (the prayer); but if he says, 'Today I will leave,' or 'Tomorrow I will leave,' and he does not know, then let him shorten (his prayer) until a month passes. If a month passes, then let him complete (the prayer). And he should not complete (the prayer) in less than ten (days), except in Mecca and Medina. And if he stays in Mecca and Medina for five (days), then let him complete (the prayer in full).”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ اَلسِّنْدِيِّ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلْمُسَافِرِ يَقْدَمُ اَلْأَرْضَ فَقَالَ« إِنْ حَدَّثَتْهُ نَفْسُهُ أَنْ يُقِيمَ عَشْراً فَلْيُتِمَّ وَ إِنْ قَالَ اَلْيَوْمَ أَخْرُجُ أَوْ غَداً أَخْرُجُ وَ لاَ يَدْرِي فَلْيُقَصِّرْ مَا بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ شَهْرٍ فَإِنْ مَضَى شَهْرٌ فَلْيُتِمَّ وَلاَ يُتِمَّ فِي أَقَلَّ مِنْ عَشَرَةٍ إِلاَّ بِمَكَّةَ وَاَلْمَدِينَةِ وَإِنْ أَقَامَ بِمَكَّةَ وَ اَلْمَدِينَةِ خَمْساً فَلْيُتِمَّ»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub, from Ali ibn al-Sindi, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Hariz, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Imam (a.s) about the traveller who arrives in a land. Imam (a.s) said: “If he considers within himself to stay for ten days, then let him complete (the prayer); but if he says, 'Today I will leave,' or 'Tomorrow I will leave,' and he does not know, then let him shorten (his prayer) until a month passes. If a month passes, then let him complete (the prayer). And he should not complete (the prayer) in less than ten (days), except in Mecca and Medina. And if he stays in Mecca and Medina for five (days), then let him complete (the prayer in full).”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 241

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ibn Faddal, from Abdillah ibn Bukayr, said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about a man who is in Basra while he is originally from Kufa, and he has a house and residence there. He passes through Kufah, and he is only passing by, not intending to stay except for the duration needed to prepare himself, for a day or two. Imam (a.s) said: “He stays on the outskirts of the city and shortens (the prayer).” I asked: “And if he enters his family’s home?” Imam (a.s) said: “Then it is upon him to perform the full prayer.”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنِ اِبْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ بُكَيْرٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يَكُونُ بِالْبَصْرَةِ وَ هُوَ مِنْ أَهْلِ اَلْكُوفَةِ لَهُ بِهَا دَارٌ وَ مَنْزِلٌ فَيَمُرُّ بِالْكُوفَةِ وَ إِنَّمَا هُوَ مُجْتَازٌ لاَ يُرِيدُ اَلْمُقَامَ إِلاَّ بِقَدْرِ مَا يَتَجَهَّزُ يَوْماً أَوْ يَوْمَيْنِ قَالَ« يُقِيمُ فِي جَانِبِ اَلْمِصْرِ وَ يُقَصِّرُ قُلْتُ فَإِنْ دَخَلَ أَهْلَهُ قَالَ «عَلَيْهِ اَلتَّمَامُ»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ibn Faddal, from Abdillah ibn Bukayr, said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about a man who is in Basra while he is originally from Kufa, and he has a house and residence there. He passes through Kufah, and he is only passing by, not intending to stay except for the duration needed to prepare himself, for a day or two. Imam (a.s) said: “He stays on the outskirts of the city and shortens (the prayer).” I asked: “And if he enters his family’s home?” Imam (a.s) said: “Then it is upon him to perform the full prayer.”

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa’id, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Mu‘awiyah ibn Wahb, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “If you enter a town and you intend to stay for ten days, then complete the prayer (atimm al-salat) as soon as you arrive. But if you intend to stay less than ten days, then shorten (the prayer, ‘fa-qassir’) until a month has passed. When the month is complete, then complete the prayer.” He (ibn Wahb) said: “I asked, ‘I entered a town on the first day of the Month of Ramadan, and I did not intend to stay for ten days.’” Imam (a.s) said: “Shorten (the prayer, ‘qassir’) and break your fast (aftir).” I asked: “I continued in that state, saying, ‘Tomorrow (I will leave)’ or ‘the day after tomorrow,’ and so I broke my fast for the whole month and shortened (the prayer).” Imam (a.s) said: “Yes, the two are the same; if you shorten (the prayer), you also break your fast, and if you break your fast, you also shorten (the prayer).”
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ وَهْبٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« إِذَا دَخَلْتَ بَلَداً وَ أَنْتَ تُرِيدُ اَلْمُقَامَ عَشَرَةَ أَيَّامٍ فَأَتِمَّ اَلصَّلاَةَ حِينَ تَقْدَمُ وَ إِنْ أَرَدْتَ دُونَ اَلْعَشَرَةِ فَقَصِّرْ مَا بَيْنَكَ وَ بَيْنَ شَهْرٍ فَإِذَا تَمَّ اَلشَّهْرُ فَأَتِمَّ اَلصَّلاَةَ» قَالَ قُلْتُ دَخَلْتُ بَلَداً أَوَّلَ يَوْمٍ مِنْ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ وَ لَسْتُ أُرِيدُ أَنْ أُقِيمَ عَشْراً فَقَالَ« قَصِّرْ وَ أَفْطِرْ» قُلْتُ فَإِنِّي مَكَثْتُ كَذَلِكَ أَقُولُ غَداً أَوْ بَعْدَ غَدٍ فَأُفْطِرُ اَلشَّهْرَ كُلَّهُ وَ أُقَصِّرُ قَالَ« نَعَمْ هُمَا وَاحِدٌ إِذَا قَصَّرْتَ أَفْطَرْتَ وَ إِذَا أَفْطَرْتَ قَصَّرْتَ»
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Sa’id, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Mu‘awiyah ibn Wahb, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “If you enter a town and you intend to stay for ten days, then complete the prayer (atimm al-salat) as soon as you arrive. But if you intend to stay less than ten days, then shorten (the prayer, ‘fa-qassir’) until a month has passed. When the month is complete, then complete the prayer.” He (ibn Wahb) said: “I asked, ‘I entered a town on the first day of the Month of Ramadan, and I did not intend to stay for ten days.’” Imam (a.s) said: “Shorten (the prayer, ‘qassir’) and break your fast (aftir).” I asked: “I continued in that state, saying, ‘Tomorrow (I will leave)’ or ‘the day after tomorrow,’ and so I broke my fast for the whole month and shortened (the prayer).” Imam (a.s) said: “Yes, the two are the same; if you shorten (the prayer), you also break your fast, and if you break your fast, you also shorten (the prayer).”

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Sa’ad, from Musa ibn Umar, from Ali ibn al-Nu‘man, from Mansur ibn Hazim, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
I heard Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) say: “If you come to a town and firmly decide (azma‘ta) to stay for ten days, then complete the prayer (atimm al-salat). But if a man leaves it (completing the prayer) out of ignorance, then there is no need for him to repeat it.”
arabicText: سَعْدٌ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ عُمَرَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ اَلنُّعْمَانِ عَنْ مَنْصُورِ بْنِ حَازِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ سَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ:« إِذَا أَتَيْتَ بَلْدَةً فَأَزْمَعْتَ اَلْمُقَامَ عَشَرَةَ أَيَّامٍ فَأَتِمَّ اَلصَّلاَةَ فَإِنْ تَرَكَهُ رَجُلٌ جَاهِلٌ فَلَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ إِعَادَةٌ»
thaqalaynSanad: Sa’ad, from Musa ibn Umar, from Ali ibn al-Nu‘man, from Mansur ibn Hazim, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I heard Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) say: “If you come to a town and firmly decide (azma‘ta) to stay for ten days, then complete the prayer (atimm al-salat). But if a man leaves it (completing the prayer) out of ignorance, then there is no need for him to repeat it.”

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Sa’ad, from Abu Ja’far, from al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Abu Walad al-Hannat, who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “Indeed, I had intended when I entered Medina to stay there for ten days, so I completed the prayer (in full). Then afterward it appeared to me that I would not remain there. So what do you see for me, should I complete (the prayer) or shorten it?” Imam (a.s) said: “If, when you entered Medina, you prayed one obligatory prayer (salat faridah wahidah) in full, then you may not shorten (prayer) until you leave it (Medina). But if, when you entered it (Medina), your intention was to complete (the prayer), yet you did not pray in it one obligatory prayer in full, until it appeared to you that you would not stay. Then you are, in that state, at liberty (bil-khiyar); if you wish, then intend to stay for ten days and complete (the prayer), and if you do not intend to stay, then shorten (the prayer) until a month passes for you; and when a month has passed, then complete the prayer.”
arabicText: سَعْدٌ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ أَبِي وَلاَّدٍ اَلْحَنَّاطِ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ إِنِّي كُنْتُ نَوَيْتُ حِينَ دَخَلْتُ اَلْمَدِينَةَ أَنْ أُقِيمَ بِهَا عَشَرَةَ أَيَّامٍ فَأُتِمَّ اَلصَّلاَةَ ثُمَّ بَدَالِي بَعْدُ أَنْ لاَ أُقِيمَ بِهَا فَمَا تَرَى لِي أُتِمُّ أَمْ أُقَصِّرُ فَقَالَ« إِنْ كُنْتَ حِينَ دَخَلْتَ اَلْمَدِينَةَ صَلَّيْتَ بِهَا صَلاَةً فَرِيضَةً وَاحِدَةً بِتَمَامٍ فَلَيْسَ لَكَ أَنْ تَقْصُرَ حَتَّى تَخْرُجَ مِنْهَا وَإِنْ كُنْتَ حِينَ دَخَلْتَهَا عَلَى نِيَّتِكَ اَلتَّمَامَ فَلَمْ تُصَلِّ فِيهَا صَلاَةً فَرِيضَةً وَاحِدَةً بِتَمَامٍ حَتَّى بَدَا لَكَ أَنْ لاَ تُقِيمَ فَأَنْتَ فِي تِلْكَ اَلْحَالِ بِالْخِيَارِ إِنْ شِئْتَ فَانْوِ اَلْمُقَامَ عَشْراً وَأَتِمَّ وَإِنْ لَمْ تَنْوِ اَلْمُقَامَ فَقَصِّرْ مَا بَيْنَكَ وَبَيْنَ شَهْرٍ فَإِذَا مَضَى لَكَ شَهْرٌ فَأَتِمَّ اَلصَّلاَةَ»
thaqalaynSanad: Sa’ad, from Abu Ja’far, from al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Abu Walad al-Hannat, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “Indeed, I had intended when I entered Medina to stay there for ten days, so I completed the prayer (in full). Then afterward it appeared to me that I would not remain there. So what do you see for me, should I complete (the prayer) or shorten it?” Imam (a.s) said: “If, when you entered Medina, you prayed one obligatory prayer (salat faridah wahidah) in full, then you may not shorten (prayer) until you leave it (Medina). But if, when you entered it (Medina), your intention was to complete (the prayer), yet you did not pray in it one obligatory prayer in full, until it appeared to you that you would not stay. Then you are, in that state, at liberty (bil-khiyar); if you wish, then intend to stay for ten days and complete (the prayer), and if you do not intend to stay, then shorten (the prayer) until a month passes for you; and when a month has passed, then complete the prayer.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 242

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
As for what was narrated by Sa’ad ibn Abdillah, from Abu Ja’far, from Muhammad ibn Khalid al-Barqi, from Hamzah ibn Abdillah al-Ja’fari, who said:
When I (Hamzah ibn Abdillah) departed from Mina, I intended to stay in Mecca, so I completed the prayer until news came to me from home, and I found no choice but to go to the house. And I did not know whether I should complete or shorten (the prayer). And Abu al-Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him, was in Mecca on that day, so I then went to Imam (a.s) and relayed the story to him. Imam (a.s) said: “Return to shortening (the prayer).”
arabicText: وَ أَمَّا مَا رَوَاهُ سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ اَلْبَرْقِيِّ عَنْ حَمْزَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ اَلْجَعْفَرِيِّ قَالَ: لَمَّا أَنْ نَفَرْتُ مِنْ مِنًى نَوَيْتُ اَلْمُقَامَ بِمَكَّةَ فَأَتْمَمْتُ اَلصَّلاَةَ حَتَّى جَاءَنِي خَبَرٌ مِنَ اَلْمَنْزِلِ فَلَمْ أَجِدْ بُدّاً مِنَ اَلْمَصِيرِ إِلَى اَلْمَنْزِلِ وَ لَمْ أَدْرِ أُتِمُّ أَمْ أُقَصِّرُ وَ أَبُو اَلْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ يَوْمَئِذٍ بِمَكَّةَ فَأَتَيْتُهُ فَقَصَصْتُ عَلَيْهِ اَلْقِصَّةَ فَقَالَ «اِرْجِعْ إِلَى اَلتَّقْصِيرِ»
thaqalaynSanad: As for what was narrated by Sa’ad ibn Abdillah, from Abu Ja’far, from Muhammad ibn Khalid al-Barqi, from Hamzah ibn Abdillah al-Ja’fari, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: When I (Hamzah ibn Abdillah) departed from Mina, I intended to stay in Mecca, so I completed the prayer until news came to me from home, and I found no choice but to go to the house. And I did not know whether I should complete or shorten (the prayer). And Abu al-Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him, was in Mecca on that day, so I then went to Imam (a.s) and relayed the story to him. Imam (a.s) said: “Return to shortening (the prayer).”

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa’id, from Safwan, from Ishaq ibn Ammar, from Abu Ibrahim, peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Imam al-Kadhim (a.s) about a man who is a traveller, then arrives and enters the houses of Kufah. Should he complete the prayer or remain shortening it until he enters his family (house)? Imam (a.s) said: “Rather, he remains shortening it until he enters his family (house).”
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ عَنْ أَبِي إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يَكُونُ مُسَافِراً ثُمَّ يَقْدَمُ فَيَدْخُلُ بُيُوتَ اَلْكُوفَةِ أَ يُتِمُّ اَلصَّلاَةَ أَمْ يَكُونُ مُقَصِّراً حَتَّى يَدْخُلَ أَهْلَهُ قَالَ« بَلْ يَكُونُ مُقَصِّراً حَتَّى يَدْخُلَ أَهْلَهُ»
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Sa’id, from Safwan, from Ishaq ibn Ammar, from Abu Ibrahim, peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Imam al-Kadhim (a.s) about a man who is a traveller, then arrives and enters the houses of Kufah. Should he complete the prayer or remain shortening it until he enters his family (house)? Imam (a.s) said: “Rather, he remains shortening it until he enters his family (house).”

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from al-‘Ayyas ibn al-Qasim, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “The traveller continues to shorten (the prayer, ‘muqassiran’) until he enters his house.”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنِ اَلْعِيصِ بْنِ اَلْقَاسِمِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ:« لاَ يَزَالُ اَلْمُسَافِرُ مُقَصِّراً حَتَّى يَدْخُلَ بَيْتَهُ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from al-‘Ayyas ibn al-Qasim, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “The traveller continues to shorten (the prayer, ‘muqassiran’) until he enters his house.”

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Sa’ad ibn Abdillah, from Abu Ja’far, from Ali ibn Hadid; and al-Husayn ibn Sa’id, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Hariz ibn Abdillah, from Abu Ja’far, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about a man who returns from his journey and the time of prayer has entered while he is still on the road. Imam (a.s) said: “He should pray two rak‘ahs. And if he sets out on his journey and the time of prayer has entered, then he should pray four (rak‘ahs).”
arabicText: سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ حَدِيدٍ وَ اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ حَرِيزِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ يَدْخُلُ مِنْ سَفَرِهِ وَقَدْ دَخَلَ وَقْتُ اَلصَّلاَةِ وَ هُوَ فِي اَلطَّرِيقِ فَقَالَ« يُصَلِّي رَكْعَتَيْنِ وَ إِنْ خَرَجَ إِلَى سَفَرِهِ وَ قَدْ دَخَلَ وَقْتُ اَلصَّلاَةِ فَلْيُصَلِّ أَرْبَعاً»
thaqalaynSanad: Sa’ad ibn Abdillah, from Abu Ja’far, from Ali ibn Hadid; and al-Husayn ibn Sa’id, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Hariz ibn Abdillah, from Abu Ja’far, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about a man who returns from his journey and the time of prayer has entered while he is still on the road. Imam (a.s) said: “He should pray two rak‘ahs. And if he sets out on his journey and the time of prayer has entered, then he should pray four (rak‘ahs).”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 243

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa’id, from Safwan, from Isma’il ibn Jabir, who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “The time of prayer enters upon me while I am traveling, but I do not pray until I enter my family (house).” Imam (a.s) said: “Pray and complete the prayer.” I asked: “And what if the time of prayer enters upon me while I am with my family and I intend to travel, so I do not pray until I depart?” Imam (a.s) said: “Then pray and shorten (the prayer), and if you do not do so, by Allah (swt), you have opposed the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family.”
arabicText: الحسين بن سعيد عن صفوان عن اسماعيل بن جابر قال قلت لابي عبد الله عليه السلام يدخل علي وقت الصلاة وانا في السفر فلا اصلي حتى أدخل اهلي فقال صل وأتم الصلاة قلت فدخل علي وقت الصلاة وانا في أهلي اريد السفر فلا اصلي حتى اخرج؟ فقال فصل وقصر فان لم تفعل فقد خالفت والله رسول الله صلى الله عليه وآله
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Sa’id, from Safwan, from Isma’il ibn Jabir, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “The time of prayer enters upon me while I am traveling, but I do not pray until I enter my family (house).” Imam (a.s) said: “Pray and complete the prayer.” I asked: “And what if the time of prayer enters upon me while I am with my family and I intend to travel, so I do not pray until I depart?” Imam (a.s) said: “Then pray and shorten (the prayer), and if you do not do so, by Allah (swt), you have opposed the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 244

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Sa’ad, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Ja’far ibn Bashir, from Hammad ibn Uthman, from Ishaq ibn Ammar, who said:
I heard Abu al-Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him, say regarding a man who returns from his journey during the time of prayer. Imam (a.s) said: “If he does not fear the passing of the time (of prayer), then let him complete (the prayer in full), but if he fears that the time (of prayer) will pass, then let him shorten (the prayer).”
arabicText: سَعْدٌ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ بَشِيرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا اَلْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ يَقُولُ: فِي اَلرَّجُلِ يَقْدَمُ مِنْ سَفَرِهِ فِي وَقْتِ اَلصَّلاَةِ فَقَالَ« إِنْ كَانَ لاَ يَخَافُ اَلْوَقْتَ فَلْيُتِمَّ وَ إِنْ كَانَ يَخَافُ خُرُوجَ اَلْوَقْتِ فَلْيُقَصِّرْ»
thaqalaynSanad: Sa’ad, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Ja’far ibn Bashir, from Hammad ibn Uthman, from Ishaq ibn Ammar, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I heard Abu al-Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him, say regarding a man who returns from his journey during the time of prayer. Imam (a.s) said: “If he does not fear the passing of the time (of prayer), then let him complete (the prayer in full), but if he fears that the time (of prayer) will pass, then let him shorten (the prayer).”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 244

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from al-Hakam ibn Miskin, from a man, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said regarding a man who returns from travel during the time of prayer. Imam (a.s) said: “If he does not fear the passing of the time (of prayer), then let him complete (the prayer in full); But if he fears the passing of the time (of prayer), then let him shorten (the prayer).”
arabicText: عنه عن محمد بن الحسين عن الحكم بن مسكين عن رجل عن ابي عبد الله عليه السلام في الرجل يقدم من سفر في وقت الصلاة فقال ان كان لا يخاف خروج الوقت فليتم وان كان يخاف خروج الوقت فليقصر
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from al-Hakam ibn Miskin, from a man, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said regarding a man who returns from travel during the time of prayer. Imam (a.s) said: “If he does not fear the passing of the time (of prayer), then let him complete (the prayer in full); But if he fears the passing of the time (of prayer), then let him shorten (the prayer).”
