chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Hamid, from Sayf ibn Umayrah, from Mansur ibn Hazim, who said:
I heard Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, say: “If he is on a journey and the time of prayer enters upon him, before he enters his family (house), and then he continues traveling until he enters his family (house), then if he wishes; he may shorten (the prayer), and if he wishes, he may complete (the prayer). And completing (the prayer) is more beloved to me.”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَلْحَمِيدِ عَنْ سَيْفِ بْنِ عَمِيرَةَ عَنْ مَنْصُورِ بْنِ حَازِمٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ يَقُولُ:« إِذَا كَانَ فِي سَفَرٍ فَدَخَلَ عَلَيْهِ وَقْتُ اَلصَّلاَةِ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَدْخُلَ أَهْلَهُ فَسَارَ حَتَّى يَدْخُلَ أَهْلَهُ فَإِنْ شَاءَ قَصَّرَ وَ إِنْ شَاءَ أَتَمَّ وَ اَلْإِ تْمَامُ أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Hamid, from Sayf ibn Umayrah, from Mansur ibn Hazim, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I heard Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, say: “If he is on a journey and the time of prayer enters upon him, before he enters his family (house), and then he continues traveling until he enters his family (house), then if he wishes; he may shorten (the prayer), and if he wishes, he may complete (the prayer). And completing (the prayer) is more beloved to me.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 245

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad, from Mu‘alla ibn Muhammad, from al-Hasan ibn Ali al-Washsha, who said:
I heard Imam al-Ridha (a.s), peace be upon him, say: “If the sun passes the zenith (zawat al-shams) while you are in the city (al-misr) and you intend to travel, then complete (the prayer); but if you depart after the zenith, then shorten the ‘Asr (prayer).”
arabicText: الحسين بن محمد عن معلى بن محمد عن الحسن بن علي الوشا قال سمعت الرضا عليه السلام يقول إذا زالت الشمس وانت في المصر وأنت تريد السفر فأتم فإذا خرجت بعد الزوال قصر العصر
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad, from Mu‘alla ibn Muhammad, from al-Hasan ibn Ali al-Washsha, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I heard Imam al-Ridha (a.s), peace be upon him, say: “If the sun passes the zenith (zawat al-shams) while you are in the city (al-misr) and you intend to travel, then complete (the prayer); but if you depart after the zenith, then shorten the ‘Asr (prayer).”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 245

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Faddal, from Dawud ibn Farqad, from Bashir al-Nabbal, who said:
I went out with Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, until we reached al-Shajarah. Then Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said to me: “O Nabbal!” I said: “At your service.” Imam (a.s) said: “It is not obligatory upon anyone from the people of this encampment to pray four (rak‘ahs) except me and you, and that is because the time of prayer entered before we departed.”
arabicText: احمد بن محمد عن ابن فضال عن داود بن فرقد عن بشير النبال قال خرجت مع ابي عبد الله عليه السلام حتى أتينا الشجرة فقال لي أبو عبد الله عليه السلام يا نبال فقلت لبيك قال انه لم يجب على أحد من أهل هذا العسكر ان يصلي اربعا اربعا غيري وغيرك وذاك انه دخل وقت الصلاة قبل أن نخرج
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Faddal, from Dawud ibn Farqad, from Bashir al-Nabbal, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I went out with Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, until we reached al-Shajarah. Then Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said to me: “O Nabbal!” I said: “At your service.” Imam (a.s) said: “It is not obligatory upon anyone from the people of this encampment to pray four (rak‘ahs) except me and you, and that is because the time of prayer entered before we departed.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 245

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ali, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Ali ibn Yaqtin, from Abu al-Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him, said:
I asked Imam al-Kadhim (a.s) about a man who set out on a journey, then the intention to stay (al-iqamah) occurs to him, while he is in the middle of his prayer. Imam (a.s) said: “He should complete (the prayer), if the intention to stay arises during it (middle of his prayer).”
arabicText: عَلِيٌّ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ يَقْطِينٍ عَنْ أَبِي اَلْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ خَرَجَ فِي سَفَرٍ ثُمَّ تَبْدُو لَهُ اَلْإِقَامَةُ وَ هُوَ فِي صَلاَتِهِ قَالَ« يُتِمُّ إِذَا بَدَتْ لَهُ اَلْإِقَامَةُ
thaqalaynSanad: Ali, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Ali ibn Yaqtin, from Abu al-Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him, said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Imam al-Kadhim (a.s) about a man who set out on a journey, then the intention to stay (al-iqamah) occurs to him, while he is in the middle of his prayer. Imam (a.s) said: “He should complete (the prayer), if the intention to stay arises during it (middle of his prayer).”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 245

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Sahl, from his father, who said:
I asked Abu al-Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him, about a man who sets out on a journey, then the intention to stay (al-iqamah) occurs to him while he is in the middle of his prayer. Should he complete (the prayer) or shorten it? Imam (a.s) said: “He should complete (the prayer), if the intention to stay arises during it (middle of his prayer).”
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سَهْلٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا اَلْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يَخْرُجُ فِي سَفَرٍ ثُمَّ تَبْدُو لَهُ اَلْإِقَامَةُ وَ هُوَ فِي صَلاَتِهِ أَ يُتِمُّ أَمْ يُقَصِّرُ قَالَ« يُتِمُّ إِذَا بَدَتْ لَهُ اَلْإِقَامَةُ»
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Sahl, from his father, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu al-Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him, about a man who sets out on a journey, then the intention to stay (al-iqamah) occurs to him while he is in the middle of his prayer. Should he complete (the prayer) or shorten it? Imam (a.s) said: “He should complete (the prayer), if the intention to stay arises during it (middle of his prayer).”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 245

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa’id, from Safwan, from al-Ala’, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “A man intends to travel and he departs, when should he begin shortening (his prayer)?” Imam (a.s) said: “When he disappears from the houses (‘tawara min al-buyut’).” I asked: “A man intends to travel and he departs when the sun has passed its zenith (zawal al-shams).” Imam (a.s) said: “When you set out, then pray two rak‘ahs.”
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنِ اَلْعَلاَءِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ رَجُلٌ يُرِيدُ اَلسَّفَرَ فَيَخْرُجُ مَتَى يُقَصِّرُ قَالَ« إِذَا تَوَارَى مِنَ اَلْبُيُوتِ» قُلْتُ اَلرَّجُلُ يُرِيدُ اَلسَّفَرَ فَيَخْرُجُ حِينَ تَزُولُ اَلشَّمْسُ فَقَالَ «إِذَا خَرَجْتَ فَصَلِّ رَكْعَتَيْنِ»
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Sa’id, from Safwan, from al-Ala’, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “A man intends to travel and he departs, when should he begin shortening (his prayer)?” Imam (a.s) said: “When he disappears from the houses (‘tawara min al-buyut’).” I asked: “A man intends to travel and he departs when the sun has passed its zenith (zawal al-shams).” Imam (a.s) said: “When you set out, then pray two rak‘ahs.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 246

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from al-Nadr ibn Suwayd, from Musa ibn Bakr, from Zurarah, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him:
Imam al-Baqir (a.s) was asked about a man upon whom the time of prayer entered while he was traveling, but he delayed the prayer until he arrived (at his destination). He intended to pray it (in full) when he reached his family (house), then he forgot to pray it upon arriving, until the prayer time had passed. Imam (a.s) said: “He should pray it as two rak‘ahs, the prayer of a traveller, because the time (of prayer) entered while he was traveling, and it was incumbent upon him to pray at that time.”
arabicText: عنه عن النضر بن سويد عن موسى بن بكر عن زرارة عن ابي جعفر عليه السلام انه سئل عن رجل دخل وقت الصلاة وهو في السفر فأخر الصلاة حتى قدم فهو يريد يصليها إذا قدم إلى أهله فنسي حين قدم إلى أهله ان يصليها حتى ذهب وقتها قال يصليها ركعتين صلاة المسافر لان الوقت دخل وهو مسافر فكان ينبغي له ان يصلي عند ذلك
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from al-Nadr ibn Suwayd, from Musa ibn Bakr, from Zurarah, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Baqir (a.s) was asked about a man upon whom the time of prayer entered while he was traveling, but he delayed the prayer until he arrived (at his destination). He intended to pray it (in full) when he reached his family (house), then he forgot to pray it upon arriving, until the prayer time had passed. Imam (a.s) said: “He should pray it as two rak‘ahs, the prayer of a traveller, because the time (of prayer) entered while he was traveling, and it was incumbent upon him to pray at that time.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 246

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Fadala ibn Ayyub, from Musa ibn Bakr, from Zurarah, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Baqir (a.s) said: “If a man forgets a prayer or performs it without purification (tahur), while he is residing or traveling, then remembers it. He must make up what was obligatory upon him, he should neither increase upon that nor decrease. Whoever forgets four (units) must make up four (units), whether he was traveling or residing. And if he forgets two (units), he should perform two (units) when he remembers, whether he was traveling or residing.”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ بْنِ أَيُّوبَ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ بَكْرٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« إِذَا نَسِيَ اَلرَّجُلُ صَلاَةً أَوْ صَلاَّهَا بِغَيْرِ طَهُورٍ وَ هُوَ مُقِيمٌ أَوْ مُسَافِرٌ فَذَكَرَهَا فَلْيَقْضِ اَلَّذِي وَجَبَ عَلَيْهِ لاَ يَزِيدُ عَلَى ذَلِكَ وَ لاَ يَنْقُصُ مَنْ نَسِيَ أَرْبَعاً فَلْيَقْضِ أَرْبَعاً مُسَافِراً كَانَ أَوْ مُقِيماً وَ إِنْ نَسِيَ رَكْعَتَيْنِ صَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ إِذَا ذَكَرَ مُسَافِراً كَانَ أَوْ مُقِيماً»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Fadala ibn Ayyub, from Musa ibn Bakr, from Zurarah, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Baqir (a.s) said: “If a man forgets a prayer or performs it without purification (tahur), while he is residing or traveling, then remembers it. He must make up what was obligatory upon him, he should neither increase upon that nor decrease. Whoever forgets four (units) must make up four (units), whether he was traveling or residing. And if he forgets two (units), he should perform two (units) when he remembers, whether he was traveling or residing.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 246

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Sa’ad ibn Abdillah, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from Iys ibn al-Qasim, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) about a man who prayed while he was traveling, but completed the prayer in full. Imam (a.s) said: “If it is still within the time, then he should repeat it (as shortened prayer), and if the time has passed, then no (meaning he does not repeat the prayer).”
arabicText: سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ عِيصِ بْنِ اَلْقَاسِمِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ صَلَّى وَ هُوَ مُسَافِرٌ فَأَتَمَّ اَلصَّلاَةَ قَالَ« إِنْ كَانَ فِي اَلْوَقْتِ فَلْيُعِدْ وَ إِنْ كَانَ اَلْوَقْتُ قَدْ مَضَى فَلاَ»
thaqalaynSanad: Sa’ad ibn Abdillah, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from Iys ibn al-Qasim, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) about a man who prayed while he was traveling, but completed the prayer in full. Imam (a.s) said: “If it is still within the time, then he should repeat it (as shortened prayer), and if the time has passed, then no (meaning he does not repeat the prayer).”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 246

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Sa’ad, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Ali ibn al-Nu'man, from Suwayd al-Qalla, from Abu Ayyub, from Abu Basir, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) about a man who forgets and prays four rak‘ahs while traveling. Imam (a.s) said: “If he remembers during that day, then he should repeat (and shorten the prayer), And if he does not remember until that day has passed, then there is no repetition upon him.”
arabicText: سعد عن محمد بن الحسين عن علي بن النعمان عن سويد القلا عن ابي ايوب عن ابي بصير عن ابي عبد الله عليه السلام قال سألته عن الرجل ينسى فيصلي في السفر اربع ركعات قال ان ذكر في ذلك اليوم فليعد وان لم يذكر حتى يمضي ذلك اليوم فلا إعادة عليه
thaqalaynSanad: Sa’ad, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Ali ibn al-Nu'man, from Suwayd al-Qalla, from Abu Ayyub, from Abu Basir, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) about a man who forgets and prays four rak‘ahs while traveling. Imam (a.s) said: “If he remembers during that day, then he should repeat (and shorten the prayer), And if he does not remember until that day has passed, then there is no repetition upon him.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 246

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Abi Najran, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Hariz, from Zurarah and Ibn Muslim, who said:
We said to Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him: “A man prayed four (rak‘ahs) while traveling (full prayer), Should he repeat it or not?” Imam (a.s) said: “If the verse of shortening (‘ayat al-taqsir’) was recited to him and it was explained to him, then he prayed four (rak‘ahs), he must repeat (the prayer). But if it had not been recited to him and he did not know it, then there is no repetition upon him.”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي نَجْرَانَ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ وَ اِبْنِ مُسْلِمٍ قَالاَ: قُلْنَا لِأَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ رَجُلٌ صَلَّى فِي اَلسَّفَرِ أَرْبَعاً أَ يُعِيدُ أَمْ لاَ قَالَ« إِنْ كَانَ قُرِئَتْ عَلَيْهِ آيَةُ اَلتَّقْصِيرِ وَ فُسِّرَتْ لَهُ فَصَلَّى أَرْبَعاً أَعَادَ وَ إِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ قُرِئَتْ عَلَيْهِ وَ لَمْ يَعْلَمْهَا فَلاَ إِعَادَةَ عَلَيْهِ»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Abi Najran, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Hariz, from Zurarah and Ibn Muslim, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: We said to Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him: “A man prayed four (rak‘ahs) while traveling (full prayer), Should he repeat it or not?” Imam (a.s) said: “If the verse of shortening (‘ayat al-taqsir’) was recited to him and it was explained to him, then he prayed four (rak‘ahs), he must repeat (the prayer). But if it had not been recited to him and he did not know it, then there is no repetition upon him.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 247

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Muhammad ibn Ishaq ibn 'Ammar:
I asked Abu al-Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him, about a woman who was with us on a journey, and she used to pray Maghrib as two rak‘ahs; going and returning. Imam (a.s) said: “There is no make-up (qada) upon her.”
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا اَلْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اِمْرَأَةٍ كَانَتْ مَعَنَا فِي اَلسَّفَرِ وَ كَانَتْ تُصَلِّي اَلْمَغْرِبَ رَكْعَتَيْنِ ذَاهِبَةً وَ جَائِيَةً قَالَ« لَيْسَ عَلَيْهَا قَضَاءٌ»
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Muhammad ibn Ishaq ibn 'Ammar:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu al-Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him, about a woman who was with us on a journey, and she used to pray Maghrib as two rak‘ahs; going and returning. Imam (a.s) said: “There is no make-up (qada) upon her.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 248

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Abbas ibn Ma'ruf, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from Abdillah ibn Maskan and Muhammad ibn al-Nu'man al-Ahwal, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “When a traveller joins a group of residents in their prayer, then if it is the noon prayer (‘al-ula’), he should make the obligatory (prayer) in the first two rak‘ahs. And if it is the afternoon prayer (‘al-Asr’), he should make the first two (rak‘ahs) supererogatory (nafila) and the last two (rak’ahs) as obligatory (fardh).”
arabicText: احمد بن محمد عن العباس بن معروف عن صفوان بن يحيى عن عبد الله بن مسكان ومحمد بن النعمان الاحول عن ابي عبد الله عليه السلام قال إذا دخل المسافر مع أقوام حاضرين في صلاتهم فان كانت الاولى فليجعل الفريضة في الركعتين الاولتين وان كانت العصر فليجعل الاولتين نافلة والاخيرتين فريضة
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Abbas ibn Ma'ruf, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from Abdillah ibn Maskan and Muhammad ibn al-Nu'man al-Ahwal, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “When a traveller joins a group of residents in their prayer, then if it is the noon prayer (‘al-ula’), he should make the obligatory (prayer) in the first two rak‘ahs. And if it is the afternoon prayer (‘al-Asr’), he should make the first two (rak‘ahs) supererogatory (nafila) and the last two (rak’ahs) as obligatory (fardh).”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 248

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, from Dawud ibn al-Husayn, from Abu al-Abbas al-Fadl ibn Abd al-Malik, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “The resident should not lead the traveller in prayer, nor should the traveller lead the resident. But if one is tested with such a situation and leads a group of residents in prayer, then when he completes two rak‘ahs, he should give the salutation (taslim), then take the hand of one of them (following him) and bring him forward, and he should lead them (to complete the prayer). And if the traveller prays behind a group of residents, he should complete his prayer as two rak‘ahs and give the salutation. And if he prays with them the noon prayer (Dhuhr), he should make the first two (rak‘ahs) as the noon prayer and the last two (rak’ahs) as the afternoon prayer (Asr).”
arabicText: عنه عن احمد بن محمد بن ابي نصر عن داود بن الحصين عن ابي العباس الفضل بن عبد الملك عن ابي عبد الله عليه السلام قال لا يؤم الحضري المسافر ولا المسافر الحضري فان ابتلى بشئ من ذلك فأم قوما حضريين فإذا أتم الركعتين سلم ثم اخذ بيد بعضهم فقدمه فأمهم وإذا صلى المسافر خلف قوم حضور فليتم صلاته ركعتين ويسلم وان صلى معهم الظهر فليجعل الاولتين الظهر والاخيرتين العصر
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, from Dawud ibn al-Husayn, from Abu al-Abbas al-Fadl ibn Abd al-Malik, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “The resident should not lead the traveller in prayer, nor should the traveller lead the resident. But if one is tested with such a situation and leads a group of residents in prayer, then when he completes two rak‘ahs, he should give the salutation (taslim), then take the hand of one of them (following him) and bring him forward, and he should lead them (to complete the prayer). And if the traveller prays behind a group of residents, he should complete his prayer as two rak‘ahs and give the salutation. And if he prays with them the noon prayer (Dhuhr), he should make the first two (rak‘ahs) as the noon prayer and the last two (rak’ahs) as the afternoon prayer (Asr).”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 249

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Sa’ad, from al-Hasan ibn al-Husayn al-Lu'lu'i, from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal, from Abu al-Ma‘za Humayd ibn al-Muthanna, from Imran, from Muhammad ibn Ali:
(Muhammad ibn Ali) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about a man who is traveling and enters into prayer with those who are residing. Imam (a.s) said: “Then he should pray his (shortened) prayer and give the salutation (taslim), and he should make the last two (rak‘ahs) as supererogatory (subha).”
arabicText: سعد عن الحسن بن الحسين اللؤلؤي عن الحسن بن علي ابن فضال عن ابي المعزا حميد بن المثنى عن عمران عن محمد بن علي انه سأل ابا عبد الله عليه السلام عن الرجل المسافر إذا دخل في الصلاة مع المقيمين قال فليصل صلاته ثم يسلم وليجعل الاخيرتين سبحة
thaqalaynSanad: Sa’ad, from al-Hasan ibn al-Husayn al-Lu'lu'i, from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal, from Abu al-Ma‘za Humayd ibn al-Muthanna, from Imran, from Muhammad ibn Ali:
thaqalaynMatn: (Muhammad ibn Ali) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about a man who is traveling and enters into prayer with those who are residing. Imam (a.s) said: “Then he should pray his (shortened) prayer and give the salutation (taslim), and he should make the last two (rak‘ahs) as supererogatory (subha).”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 249

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad ibn Uthman, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about a traveller who prays behind a resident. Imam (a.s) said: “He should pray two rak‘ahs and then go wherever he wishes.”
arabicText: الحسين بن سعيد عن محمد بن ابي عمير عن حماد بن عثمان قال سألت ابا عبد الله عليه السلام عن المسافر يصلي خلف المقيم قال يصلي ركعتين ويمضي حيث شاء
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad ibn Uthman, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about a traveller who prays behind a resident. Imam (a.s) said: “He should pray two rak‘ahs and then go wherever he wishes.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 249

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from al-Nadr ibn Suwayd, from Zur’ah ibn Muhammad, from Sama’ah, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about the time of the night prayer (salat al-layl) during travel. Imam (a.s) said: “From the time you pray the 'atamah (nightfall prayer) until the break of dawn (fajr).”
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ اَلنَّضْرِ بْنِ سُوَيْدٍ عَنْ زُرْعَةَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ وَقْتِ صَلاَةِ اَللَّيْلِ فِي اَلسَّفَرِ فَقَالَ« مِنْ حِينَ تُصَلِّي اَلْعَتَمَةَ إِلَى أَنْ يَنْفَجِرَ اَلصُّبْحُ»
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from al-Nadr ibn Suwayd, from Zur’ah ibn Muhammad, from Sama’ah, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about the time of the night prayer (salat al-layl) during travel. Imam (a.s) said: “From the time you pray the 'atamah (nightfall prayer) until the break of dawn (fajr).”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 249

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad ibn Uthman, from al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “If you fear that you will not wake up at the end of the night, and you are afflicted with an illness or struck by cold, then pray and perform the witr at the beginning of the night during travel.”
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنِ اَلْحَلَبِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« إِنْ خَشِيتَ أَنْ لاَ تَقُومَ فِي آخِرِ اَللَّيْلِ وَ كَانَتْ بِكَ عِلَّةٌ أَوْ أَصَابَكَ بَرْدٌ فَصَلِّ وَ أَوْتِرْ مِنْ أَوَّلِ اَللَّيْلِ فِي اَلسَّفَرِ»
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad ibn Uthman, from al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “If you fear that you will not wake up at the end of the night, and you are afflicted with an illness or struck by cold, then pray and perform the witr at the beginning of the night during travel.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 249

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Isma‘il, from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from Mansur ibn Hazim, from Aban ibn Taghlib, who said:
(Aban ibn Taghlib) said: “I went out with Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, between Mecca and Medina. Imam (a.s) would say: ‘As for you, you are young men who delay (the prayer), but as for me, I am an old man who hastens (the night prayer).’ So Imam (a.s) used to perform the night prayer (salat al-layl) at the beginning of the night.”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ عَنِ اَلْفَضْلِ بْنِ شَاذَانَ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ مَنْصُورِ بْنِ حَازِمٍ عَنْ أَبَانِ بْنِ تَغْلِبَ قَالَ: خَرَجْتُ مَعَ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ فِيمَا بَيْنَ مَكَّةَ وَ اَلْمَدِينَةِ فَكَانَ يَقُولُ« أَمَّا أَنْتُمْ فَشَبَابٌ تُؤَخِّرُونَ وَ أَمَّا أَنَا فَشَيْخٌ أُعَجِّلُ» فَكَانَ يُصَلِّي صَلاَةَ اَللَّيْلِ أَوَّلَ اَللَّيْلِ
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Isma‘il, from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from Mansur ibn Hazim, from Aban ibn Taghlib, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: (Aban ibn Taghlib) said: “I went out with Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, between Mecca and Medina. Imam (a.s) would say: ‘As for you, you are young men who delay (the prayer), but as for me, I am an old man who hastens (the night prayer).’ So Imam (a.s) used to perform the night prayer (salat al-layl) at the beginning of the night.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 249

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Ibn Maskan, from al-Halabi, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about performing the night prayer and the witr at the beginning of the night during travel, if I feared the cold or there was an illness. Imam (a.s) said: “There is no harm, for I do that myself.”
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنِ اَلْحَلَبِيِّ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ صَلاَةِ اَللَّيْلِ وَ اَلْوَتْرِ فِي أَوَّلِ اَللَّيْلِ فِي اَلسَّفَرِ إِذَا تَخَوَّفْتُ اَلْبَرْدَ أَوْ كَانَتْ عِلَّةٌ فَقَالَ« لاَ بَأْسَ أَنَا أَفْعَلُ ذَلِكَ
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Ibn Maskan, from al-Halabi, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about performing the night prayer and the witr at the beginning of the night during travel, if I feared the cold or there was an illness. Imam (a.s) said: “There is no harm, for I do that myself.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 250

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad by Ali ibn al-Nu'man by Muhammad ibn Sinan by Abdillah ibn Maskan by al-Halabi:
(al-Halabi) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about performing the supererogatory prayer (al-nafilah), on a camel or riding animal. Imam (a.s) said: “Yes, as long as he is facing the direction (of prayer). And likewise did the Messenger of Allah (swt), peace be upon him and his family.”
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ اَلنُّعْمَانِ وَ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنِ اَلْحَلَبِيِّ: أَنَّهُ سَأَلَ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ صَلاَةِ اَلنَّافِلَةِ عَلَى اَلْبَعِيرِ وَ اَلدَّابَّةِ فَقَالَ« نَعَمْ حَيْثُ كَانَ مُتَوَجِّهاً وَ كَذَلِكَ فَعَلَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ صَ»
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad by Ali ibn al-Nu'man by Muhammad ibn Sinan by Abdillah ibn Maskan by al-Halabi:
thaqalaynMatn: (al-Halabi) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about performing the supererogatory prayer (al-nafilah), on a camel or riding animal. Imam (a.s) said: “Yes, as long as he is facing the direction (of prayer). And likewise did the Messenger of Allah (swt), peace be upon him and his family.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 250

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Ibn Abi Nasr, from al-Ala’, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:
Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, said to me: “Pray the night prayer (salat al-layl), the witr, and the two rak‘ahs in the litter (al-mahmil).”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي نَصْرٍ عَنِ اَلْعَلاَءِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ قَالَ: قَالَ لِي أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ« صَلِّ صَلاَةَ اَللَّيْلِ وَ اَلْوَتْرَ وَ اَلرَّكْعَتَيْنِ فِي اَلْمَحْمِلِ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Ibn Abi Nasr, from al-Ala’, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, said to me: “Pray the night prayer (salat al-layl), the witr, and the two rak‘ahs in the litter (al-mahmil).”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 250

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from al-Abbas ibn Ma'ruf, from Ali ibn Mahziyar, who said:
I read in a letter from Abdillah ibn Muhammad to Abu al-Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him: “Our companions have differed in their narrations from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, regarding the two rak‘ahs of Fajr during travel. Some of them narrate: ‘That you should pray them in the litter (al-mahmil),’ And some narrate: ‘That you should not pray them except on the ground.’ So inform me how you act yourself, so that I may follow you in that.” Imam (a.s), peace be upon him, wrote in response: “It is permitted (muwassa‘un ‘alayk) for you, whichever of the two you act upon.”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنِ اَلْعَبَّاسِ بْنِ مَعْرُوفٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَهْزِيَارَ قَالَ: قَرَأْتُ فِي كِتَابٍ لِعَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ إِلَى أَبِي اَلْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: اِخْتَلَفَ أَصْحَابُنَا فِي رِوَايَاتِهِمْ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ فِي رَكْعَتَيِ اَلْفَجْرِ فِي اَلسَّفَرِ فَرَوَى بَعْضُهُمْ «أَنْ صَلِّهِمَا فِي اَلْمَحْمِلِ» وَ رَوَى بَعْضُهُمْ« أَنْ لاَ تُصَلِّهِمَا إِلاَّ عَلَى اَلْأَرْضِ» فَأَعْلِمْنِي كَيْفَ تَصْنَعُ أَنْتَ لِأَ قْتَدِيَ بِكَ فِي ذَلِكَ فَوَقَّعَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ« مُوَسَّعٌ عَلَيْكَ بِأَيَّةٍ عَمِلْتَ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from al-Abbas ibn Ma'ruf, from Ali ibn Mahziyar, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I read in a letter from Abdillah ibn Muhammad to Abu al-Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him: “Our companions have differed in their narrations from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, regarding the two rak‘ahs of Fajr during travel. Some of them narrate: ‘That you should pray them in the litter (al-mahmil),’ And some narrate: ‘That you should not pray them except on the ground.’ So inform me how you act yourself, so that I may follow you in that.” Imam (a.s), peace be upon him, wrote in response: “It is permitted (muwassa‘un ‘alayk) for you, whichever of the two you act upon.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 250

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from al-Abbas ibn Ma'ruf, from Ali ibn Mahziyar, from al-Hasan ibn Ali, from Abdillah ibn al-Mughira, and Safwan ibn Yahya, and Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from their companions:
Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said regarding prayer in the litter (al-mahmil). Imam (a.s) said: “Pray sitting cross-legged (mutarabbian), or with your legs extended (mamdud al-rijlayn), or in whatever way is possible for you (kayfa amkanaka).”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنِ اَلْعَبَّاسِ بْنِ مَعْرُوفٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَهْزِيَارَ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ اَلْمُغِيرَةِ وَ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ يَحْيَى وَ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ أَصْحَابِهِمْ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: فِي اَلصَّلاَةِ فِي اَلْمَحْمِلِ فَقَالَ« صَلِّ مُتَرَبِّعاً وَ مَمْدُودَ اَلرِّجْلَيْنِ وَ كَيْفَ أَمْكَنَكَ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from al-Abbas ibn Ma'ruf, from Ali ibn Mahziyar, from al-Hasan ibn Ali, from Abdillah ibn al-Mughira, and Safwan ibn Yahya, and Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from their companions:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said regarding prayer in the litter (al-mahmil). Imam (a.s) said: “Pray sitting cross-legged (mutarabbian), or with your legs extended (mamdud al-rijlayn), or in whatever way is possible for you (kayfa amkanaka).”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 251

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Muhammad ibn Khalid al-Barqi, from Ja’far ibn Bashir, from Mu‘awiyah ibn ‘Ammar, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “There is no harm if a man prays the night prayer (salat al-layl) during travel while he is walking, and there is no harm if he misses the night prayer and that he makes it up during the day while walking. He faces the qiblah, then walks and recites; and when he wants to bow (ruku‘), he turns his face toward the qiblah and performs ruku‘ and sujud, then walks again.”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ اَلْبَرْقِيِّ عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ بَشِيرٍ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَ قَالَ:« لاَ بَأْسَ بِأَنْ يُصَلِّيَ اَلرَّجُلُ صَلاَةَ اَللَّيْلِ فِي اَلسَّفَرِ وَ هُوَ يَمْشِي وَ لاَ بَأْسَ إِنْ فَاتَتْهُ صَلاَةُ اَللَّيْلِ أَنْ يَقْضِيَهَا بِالنَّهَارِ وَ هُوَ يَمْشِي يَتَوَجَّهُ إِلَى اَلْقِبْلَةِ ثُمَّ يَمْشِي وَ يَقْرَأُ فَإِذَا أَرَادَ أَنْ يَرْكَعَ حَوَّلَ وَجْهَهُ إِلَى اَلْقِبْلَةِ وَرَكَعَ وَ سَجَدَ ثُمَّ مَشَى»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Muhammad ibn Khalid al-Barqi, from Ja’far ibn Bashir, from Mu‘awiyah ibn ‘Ammar, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “There is no harm if a man prays the night prayer (salat al-layl) during travel while he is walking, and there is no harm if he misses the night prayer and that he makes it up during the day while walking. He faces the qiblah, then walks and recites; and when he wants to bow (ruku‘), he turns his face toward the qiblah and performs ruku‘ and sujud, then walks again.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 251

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Aban ibn Uthman, from Ibrahim al-Karkhi, from Abu Abdillah (a.s):
I said to Imam al-Sadiq (a.s): “I am able to face the qiblah in the litter (al-mahmil).” Imam (a.s) said: “What is this constriction? (meaning to rebuke this ‘over-strict’ interpretation) Do you not have in the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, an example?”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ اَلْحَكَمِ عَنْ أَبَانِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ اَلْكَرْخِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لَهُ إِنِّي أَقْدِرُ عَلَى أَنْ أَتَوَجَّهَ إِلَى اَلْقِبْلَةِ فِي اَلْمَحْمِلِ فَقَالَ« مَا هَذَا اَلضَّيْقُ أَ مَا لَكَ بِرَسُولِ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ أُسْوَةٌ
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Aban ibn Uthman, from Ibrahim al-Karkhi, from Abu Abdillah (a.s):
thaqalaynMatn: I said to Imam al-Sadiq (a.s): “I am able to face the qiblah in the litter (al-mahmil).” Imam (a.s) said: “What is this constriction? (meaning to rebuke this ‘over-strict’ interpretation) Do you not have in the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, an example?”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 251

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from al-Abbas ibn Ma‘ruf, from Ali ibn Mahziyar, from Ayyub ibn Nuh, from Abdillah ibn al-Mughira, from ‘Utaybah, from Ibrahim ibn Maymun, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “If you pray while you are walking, you pronounce the takbir, then walk and recite. When you want to bow, you indicate the bowing (ruku‘) with a gesture, then you indicate the prostration (sujud) with a gesture. And there is no supererogatory (voluntary) prayer in travel.”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنِ اَلْعَبَّاسِ بْنِ مَعْرُوفٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَهْزِيَارَ عَنْ أَيُّوبَ بْنِ نُوحٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ اَلْمُغِيرَةِ عَنْ عُتَيْبَةَ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ مَيْمُونٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« إِنْ صَلَّيْتَ وَ أَنْتَ تَمْشِي كَبَّرْتَ ثُمَّ مَشَيْتَ فَقَرَأْتَ فَإِذَا أَرَدْتَ أَنْ تَرْكَعَ أَوْمَأْتَ بِالرُّكُوعِ ثُمَّ أَوْمَأْتَ بِالسُّجُودِ وَ لَيْسَ فِي اَلسَّفَرِ تَطَوُّعٌ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from al-Abbas ibn Ma‘ruf, from Ali ibn Mahziyar, from Ayyub ibn Nuh, from Abdillah ibn al-Mughira, from ‘Utaybah, from Ibrahim ibn Maymun, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “If you pray while you are walking, you pronounce the takbir, then walk and recite. When you want to bow, you indicate the bowing (ruku‘) with a gesture, then you indicate the prostration (sujud) with a gesture. And there is no supererogatory (voluntary) prayer in travel.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 251

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Sa’ad, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Safwan, from Ya‘qub ibn Shu‘ayb, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about praying while traveling, and I am walking. Imam (a.s) said: “Gesture (perform the prayer) with motions (ima'), and make the (gesture of) prostration (sujud) lower than the bowing (ruku‘).”
arabicText: سَعْدٌ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ شُعَيْبٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلصَّلاَةِ فِي اَلسَّفَرِ وَ أَنَا أَمْشِي قَالَ« أَوْمِ إِيمَاءً وَ اِجْعَلِ اَلسُّجُودَ أَخْفَضَ مِنَ اَلرُّكُوعِ»
thaqalaynSanad: Sa’ad, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Safwan, from Ya‘qub ibn Shu‘ayb, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about praying while traveling, and I am walking. Imam (a.s) said: “Gesture (perform the prayer) with motions (ima'), and make the (gesture of) prostration (sujud) lower than the bowing (ruku‘).”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 252

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Sa’ad ibn Muhammad from al-Husayn ibn Sa’id from Ibn Abi Umayr and Ali ibn al-Hakam from Hammad ibn Uthman from Abu al-Hasan al-Awwal (a.s), peace be upon him:
Imam al-Kadhim (a.s) said regarding a man who performs the nafila (supererogatory) prayer, while on a riding animal in towns (al-amsar). Imam said: “There is no problem.”
arabicText: سَعْدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ وَ عَلِيِّ بْنِ اَلْحَكَمِ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ أَبِي اَلْحَسَنِ اَلْأَوَّلِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: فِي اَلرَّجُلِ يُصَلِّي اَلنَّافِلَةَ وَ هُوَ عَلَى دَابَّةٍ فِي اَلْأَمْصَارِ قَالَ« لاَ بَأْسَ»
thaqalaynSanad: Sa’ad ibn Muhammad from al-Husayn ibn Sa’id from Ibn Abi Umayr and Ali ibn al-Hakam from Hammad ibn Uthman from Abu al-Hasan al-Awwal (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Kadhim (a.s) said regarding a man who performs the nafila (supererogatory) prayer, while on a riding animal in towns (al-amsar). Imam said: “There is no problem.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 252

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Safwan, from Dharih, who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “I missed the night prayer (salat al-layl) during travel, Should I make it up during the day?” Imam (a.s) said: “Yes, if you are able to do that.”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنْ ذَرِيحٍ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ فَاتَتْنِي صَلاَةُ اَللَّيْلِ فِي اَلسَّفَرِ أَفَأَقْضِيهَا بِالنَّهَارِ فَقَالَ« نَعَمْ إِنْ أَطَقْتَ ذَلِكَ»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Safwan, from Dharih, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “I missed the night prayer (salat al-layl) during travel, Should I make it up during the day?” Imam (a.s) said: “Yes, if you are able to do that.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 252

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Hajjaj, from Abu al-Hasan al-Awwal (a.s), peace be upon him:
Imam al-Kadhim (a.s) said regarding a man who performs supererogatory prayers (al-nawafil) in cities, while on his riding animal, in whatever direction it turns him. Imam (a.s) said: “Yes, there is no harm in it.”
arabicText: عَلِيُّ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَلرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ اَلْحَجَّاجِ عَنْ أَبِي اَلْحَسَنِ اَلْأَوَّلِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: فِي اَلرَّجُلِ يُصَلِّي اَلنَّوَافِلَ فِي اَلْأَمْصَارِ وَ هُوَ عَلَى دَابَّتِهِ حَيْثُ تَوَجَّهَتْ بِهِ فَقَالَ« نَعَمْ لاَ بَأْسَ بِهِ»
thaqalaynSanad: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Hajjaj, from Abu al-Hasan al-Awwal (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Kadhim (a.s) said regarding a man who performs supererogatory prayers (al-nawafil) in cities, while on his riding animal, in whatever direction it turns him. Imam (a.s) said: “Yes, there is no harm in it.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 252

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from his father, from Hammad, from Hariz, from one who mentioned it, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him:
Imam al-Baqir (a.s) saw no problem with a person praying while walking, as he is walking. But he should not be driving the camels.
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَمَّنْ ذَكَرَهُ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ:« أَنَّهُ لَمْ يَكُنْ يَرَى بَأْساً أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ اَلْمَاشِي وَ هُوَ يَمْشِي وَ لَكِنْ لاَ يَسُوقُ اَلْإِبِلَ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from his father, from Hammad, from Hariz, from one who mentioned it, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Baqir (a.s) saw no problem with a person praying while walking, as he is walking. But he should not be driving the camels.

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 252

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Husayn ibn Musa, from Zurarah, who said:
I (Zurarah) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “About a man who sets out on a journey which he intends, and the prayer time enters while he has gone two farsakhs out of the village, so they prayed (the shortened prayer). And then some of them returned for a need of theirs, and then he was not able to proceed on his journey. What should he do regarding the prayer? “ Imam (a.s) said: “His prayer is complete and he does not repeat it.”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ مُوسَى عَنْ زُرَارَةَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يَخْرُجُ فِي سَفَرٍ يُرِيدُهُ فَدَخَلَ عَلَيْهِ اَلْوَقْتُ وَ قَدْ خَرَجَ مِنَ اَلْقَرْيَةِ عَلَى فَرْسَخَيْنِ فَصَلَّوْا وَ اِنْصَرَفَ بَعْضُهُمْ فِي حَاجَةٍ لَهُ ثُمَّ لَمْ يُقْضَ لَهُ اَلْخُرُوجُ مَا يَصْنَعُ فِي اَلصَّلاَةِ قَالَ« تَمَّتْ صَلاَتُهُ وَ لاَ يُعِيدُ»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Husayn ibn Musa, from Zurarah, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (Zurarah) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “About a man who sets out on a journey which he intends, and the prayer time enters while he has gone two farsakhs out of the village, so they prayed (the shortened prayer). And then some of them returned for a need of theirs, and then he was not able to proceed on his journey. What should he do regarding the prayer? “ Imam (a.s) said: “His prayer is complete and he does not repeat it.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 252

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Muhammad ibn Isa al-‘Ubaydi, from Sulayman ibn Hafs al-Marwazi, who said:
The jurist (faqih) of ‘Askar (Imam al-Hadi (a.s)), peace be upon him, said: “It is obligatory upon the traveller to say at the end of every prayer in which he shortens: ‘Subhana Allah, wal-hamdu lillah, wa la ilaha illa Allah, wallahu akbar’ , thirty times to complete the prayer.”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى اَلْعُبَيْدِيِّ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ حَفْصٍ اَلْمَرْوَزِيِّ قَالَ قَالَ اَلْفَقِيهُ اَلْعَسْكَرِيُّ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ:« يَجِبُ عَلَى اَلْمُسَافِرِ أَنْ يَقُولَ فِي دُبُرِ كُلِّ صَلاَةٍ يُقَصِّرُ فِيهَا سُبْحَانَ اَللَّهِ وَ اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ وَ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اَللَّهُ وَ اَللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ ثَلاَثِينَ مَرَّةً لِتَمَامِ اَلصَّلاَةِ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Muhammad ibn Isa al-‘Ubaydi, from Sulayman ibn Hafs al-Marwazi, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: The jurist (faqih) of ‘Askar (Imam al-Hadi (a.s)), peace be upon him, said: “It is obligatory upon the traveller to say at the end of every prayer in which he shortens: ‘Subhana Allah, wal-hamdu lillah, wa la ilaha illa Allah, wallahu akbar’ , thirty times to complete the prayer.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 253

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ali, from Amr ibn Sa’id, from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah, from ‘Ammar:
I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about a traveller who becomes ill and is unable to perform the obligatory prayer. Imam (a.s) said: “He should make it up when he recovers, in the same manner of the ‘traveller’s prayer’ shortened (with taqsir).”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُصَدِّقِ بْنِ صَدَقَةَ عَنْ عَمَّارٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلْمُسَافِرِ يَمْرَضُ وَلاَ يَقْدِرُ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ اَلْمَكْتُوبَةَ قَالَ« يَقْضِي إِذَا قَامَ مِثْلَ صَلاَةِ اَلْمُسَافِرِ بِالتَّقْصِيرِ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ali, from Amr ibn Sa’id, from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah, from ‘Ammar:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about a traveller who becomes ill and is unable to perform the obligatory prayer. Imam (a.s) said: “He should make it up when he recovers, in the same manner of the ‘traveller’s prayer’ shortened (with taqsir).”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 253

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad al-‘Alawi, from al-‘Amraki al-Bufaki, from Ali ibn Ja’far, from his brother Imam Musa (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Imam al-Kadhim (a.s) about a man who made a vow to Allah (swt) upon himself, to perform such-and-such number of prayers. Does it suffice him to perform that while on his riding animal and he is traveling? Imam (a.s) said: “Yes.”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَحْمَدَ اَلْعَلَوِيِّ عَنِ اَلْعَمْرَكِيِّ اَلْبُوفَكِيِّ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَخِيهِ مُوسَى عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ جَعَلَ لِلَّهِ عَلَيْهِ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ كَذَا وَ كَذَا صَلاَةً هَلْ يُجْزِيهِ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ ذَلِكَ عَلَى دَابَّتِهِ وَ هُوَ مُسَافِرٌ قَالَ« نَعَمْ»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad al-‘Alawi, from al-‘Amraki al-Bufaki, from Ali ibn Ja’far, from his brother Imam Musa (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Imam al-Kadhim (a.s) about a man who made a vow to Allah (swt) upon himself, to perform such-and-such number of prayers. Does it suffice him to perform that while on his riding animal and he is traveling? Imam (a.s) said: “Yes.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 253

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan, from Amr ibn Sa’id, from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah, from Ammar al-Sabati, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said regarding a man upon whom a prayer was obligatory, from a sitting position, but he forgot until he stood and began the prayer while standing, then remembered. Imam (a.s) said: “He should sit down and begin the prayer, and he should not count his beginning of the prayer while he was standing.”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ اَلْحَسَنِ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُصَدِّقِ بْنِ صَدَقَةَ عَنْ عَمَّارٍ اَلسَّابَاطِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: عَنْ رَجُلٍ وَجَبَتْ عَلَيْهِ صَلاَةٌ مِنْ قُعُودٍ فَنَسِيَ حَتَّى قَامَ وَ اِفْتَتَحَ اَلصَّلاَةَ وَ هُوَ قَائِمٌ ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ قَالَ« يَقْعُدُ وَ يَفْتَتِحُ اَلصَّلاَةَ وَ لاَ يَعْتَدُّ بِافْتِتَاحِهِ اَلصَّلاَةَ وَ هُوَ قَائِمٌ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan, from Amr ibn Sa’id, from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah, from Ammar al-Sabati, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said regarding a man upon whom a prayer was obligatory, from a sitting position, but he forgot until he stood and began the prayer while standing, then remembered. Imam (a.s) said: “He should sit down and begin the prayer, and he should not count his beginning of the prayer while he was standing.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 253

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan, from al-Nadr, from Ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “Do not perform any of the obligatory (mafrud) prayers while riding.” Al-Nadr said in his narration: “Except if you are ill.”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ اَلْحَسَنِ عَنِ اَلنَّضْرِ عَنِ اِبْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« لاَ تُصَلِّ شَيْئاً مِنَ اَلْمَفْرُوضِ رَاكِباً» قَالَ اَلنَّضْرُ فِي حَدِيثِهِ« إِلاَّ أَنْ تَكُونَ مَرِيضاً»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan, from al-Nadr, from Ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “Do not perform any of the obligatory (mafrud) prayers while riding.” Al-Nadr said in his narration: “Except if you are ill.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 253

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal, from Zharif ibn Nasih, from Musabbih, from Mandal ibn Ali, who said:
I heard Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, say: “The Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, performed the obligatory prayer (al-faridah) on his mount on a rainy day.”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ ظَرِيفِ بْنِ نَاصِحٍ عَنْ مُصَبِّحٍ عَنْ مَنْدَلِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ يَقُولُ:« صَلَّى رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ عَلَى رَاحِلَتِهِ اَلْفَرِيضَةَ فِي يَوْمٍ مَطِيرٍ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal, from Zharif ibn Nasih, from Musabbih, from Mandal ibn Ali, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I heard Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, say: “The Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, performed the obligatory prayer (al-faridah) on his mount on a rainy day.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 254

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from al-Himyari, who said:
I wrote to Abu al-Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him: “May I be your ransom, your followers narrate from your forefathers (a.s) that; ‘The Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, performed the obligatory prayer (al-faridah) on his mount on a rainy day.’ Rain falls upon us while we are in our litters (mahamil), and the ground is wet, and the rain causes harm, so is it permissible for us? O’ my master, (Is it) to perform the obligatory prayer in such a state, in our litters or on our riding animals, Allah (swt) willing?” Imam (a.s), peace be upon him, wrote in reply: “That is permissible, in the case of severe necessity.”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنِ اَلْحِمْيَرِيِّ قَالَ: كَتَبْتُ إِلَى أَبِي اَلْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ رَوَى جَعَلَنِيَ اَللَّهُ فِدَاكَ مَوَالِيكَ عَنْ آبَائِكَ« أَنَّ رَسُولَ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ صَلَّى اَلْفَرِيضَةَ عَلَى رَاحِلَتِهِ فِي يَوْمٍ مَطِيرٍ» وَ يُصِيبُنَا اَلْمَطَرُ وَ نَحْنُ فِي مَحَامِلِنَا وَ اَلْأَرْضُ مُبْتَلَّةٌ وَاَلْمَطَرُ يُؤْذِي فَهَلْ يَجُوزُ لَنَا يَا سَيِّدِي أَنْ نُصَلِّيَ فِي هَذِهِ اَلْحَالِ فِي مَحَامِلِنَا أَوْ عَلَى دَوَابِّنَا اَلْفَرِيضَةَ إِنْ شَاءَ اَللَّهُ فَوَقَّعَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ« يَجُوزُ ذَلِكَ مَعَ اَلضَّرُورَةِ اَلشَّدِيدَةِ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from al-Himyari, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I wrote to Abu al-Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him: “May I be your ransom, your followers narrate from your forefathers (a.s) that; ‘The Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, performed the obligatory prayer (al-faridah) on his mount on a rainy day.’ Rain falls upon us while we are in our litters (mahamil), and the ground is wet, and the rain causes harm, so is it permissible for us? O’ my master, (Is it) to perform the obligatory prayer in such a state, in our litters or on our riding animals, Allah (swt) willing?” Imam (a.s), peace be upon him, wrote in reply: “That is permissible, in the case of severe necessity.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 254

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Sahl, from his father, who said:
I asked Abu al-Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him, about a man who performs the supererogatory prayer (al-nafilah) sitting down, and he has no illness, whether in travel or at home. Imam (a.s) said: “There is no harm.”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سَهْلٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا اَلْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يُصَلِّي اَلنَّافِلَةَ قَاعِداً وَ لَيْسَتْ بِهِ عِلَّةٌ فِي سَفَرٍ أَوْ حَضَرٍ قَالَ« لاَ بَأْسَ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Sahl, from his father, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu al-Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him, about a man who performs the supererogatory prayer (al-nafilah) sitting down, and he has no illness, whether in travel or at home. Imam (a.s) said: “There is no harm.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 254

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Sa’ad ibn Abdillah, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Jamil ibn Darraj, who said:
I heard Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, say: “The Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, performed the obligatory prayer (al-faridah) in the litter (al-mahmil) on a day of mud and rain.”
arabicText: سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ جَمِيلِ بْنِ دَرَّاجٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ يَقُولُ:« صَلَّى رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ اَلْفَرِيضَةَ فِي اَلْمَحْمِلِ فِي يَوْمِ وَحَلٍ وَ مَطَرٍ»
thaqalaynSanad: Sa’ad ibn Abdillah, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Jamil ibn Darraj, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I heard Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, say: “The Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, performed the obligatory prayer (al-faridah) in the litter (al-mahmil) on a day of mud and rain.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 254

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Ahmad ibn Hilal, from Amr ibn Uthman, from Muhammad ibn ‘Udhafir, who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “A man brings sheep down from the mountain, and among them is a Magian (al-majusi) or Christian (al-nasrani) hired worker, and the sudden, unforeseen death of the animal (al-aridah) occurs, so it is brought to him salted.” (meaning the non-Muslim worker brings the meat back, salted, presumably to preserve it for later use) Imam (a.s) said: “He should not eat it.” I asked: “(What if) it is during the time of an obligatory prayer, and the ground does not allow him to stand on it or to prostrate upon it due to the abundance of snow, water, rain, and mud does it become permissible for him to perform the obligatory prayer in the litter (al-mahmil)?” Imam (a.s) said: “Yes, it is like the case of a boat if he is able to (pray) standing, then (he should do so), and if not, then sitting. And in all such cases, Allah (swt) is more deserving of granting the excuse. Allah (swt), Mighty and Majestic, says: ‘Rather, man is a witness against himself.’ (Surah Al Qiyamah 75:14)”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ هِلاَلٍ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عُذَافِرٍ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ رَجُلٌ يَجْلِبُ اَلْغَنَمَ مِنَ اَلْجَبَلِ يَكُونُ فِيهَا اَلْأَجِيرُ اَلْمَجُوسِيُّ وَاَلنَّصْرَانِيُّ فَتَقَعُ اَلْعَارِضَةُ فَيَأْتِيهِ بِهَا مُمَلَّحَةً قَالَ« لاَ يَأْكُلْهَا» قُلْتُ يَكُونُ فِي وَقْتِ فَرِيضَةٍ لاَ تُمَكِّنُهُ اَلْأَرْضُ مِنَ اَلْقِيَامِ عَلَيْهَا وَ لاَ اَلسُّجُودِ عَلَيْهَا مِنْ كَثْرَةِ اَلثَّلْجِ وَ اَلْمَاءِ وَ اَلْمَطَرِ وَ اَلْوَحَلِ أَ يَجُوزُ لَهُ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ اَلْفَرِيضَةَ فِي اَلْمَحْمِلِ قَالَ« نَعَمْ هُوَ بِمَنْزِلَةِ اَلسَّفِينَةِ إِنْ أَمْكَنَهُ قَائِماً وَ إِلاَّ قَاعِداً وَ كُلَّمَا كَانَ مِنْ ذَلِكَ فَاللَّهُ أَوْلَى بِالْعُذْرِ يَقُولُ اَللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ« بَلِ اَلْإِنْسٰانُ عَلىٰ نَفْسِهِ بَصِيرَةٌ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Ahmad ibn Hilal, from Amr ibn Uthman, from Muhammad ibn ‘Udhafir, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “A man brings sheep down from the mountain, and among them is a Magian (al-majusi) or Christian (al-nasrani) hired worker, and the sudden, unforeseen death of the animal (al-aridah) occurs, so it is brought to him salted.” (meaning the non-Muslim worker brings the meat back, salted, presumably to preserve it for later use) Imam (a.s) said: “He should not eat it.” I asked: “(What if) it is during the time of an obligatory prayer, and the ground does not allow him to stand on it or to prostrate upon it due to the abundance of snow, water, rain, and mud does it become permissible for him to perform the obligatory prayer in the litter (al-mahmil)?” Imam (a.s) said: “Yes, it is like the case of a boat if he is able to (pray) standing, then (he should do so), and if not, then sitting. And in all such cases, Allah (swt) is more deserving of granting the excuse. Allah (swt), Mighty and Majestic, says: ‘Rather, man is a witness against himself.’ (Surah Al Qiyamah 75:14)”
