chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa’id, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Mu‘awiyah ibn Wahb, who said:
I heard Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, say: “My father (Imam al-Baqir (a.s)), peace be upon him, used to call for water for purification (al-tahur) while on a journey, and he was in his litter (al-mahmil). A basin (al-tawr) containing water would be brought to him, and he would perform ablution, then he would pray the eight (rak‘ahs of night prayer) and the witr in his litter. Then, when He (Imam al-Baqir (a.s)) dismounted, He (a.s) would pray two rak‘ahs and the morning prayer (al-subh).”
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ وَهْبٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ يَقُولُ:« كَانَ أَبِي عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ يَدْعُو بِالطَّهُورِ فِي اَلسَّفَرِ وَ هُوَ فِي مَحْمِلِهِ فَيُؤْتَى بِالتَّوْرِ فِيهِ اَلْمَاءُ فَيَتَوَضَّأُ ثُمَّ يُصَلِّي اَلثَّمَانِيَ وَ اَلْوَتْرَ فِي مَحْمِلِهِ فَإِذَا نَزَلَ صَلَّى اَلرَّكْعَتَيْنِ وَ اَلصُّبْحَ»
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Sa’id, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Mu‘awiyah ibn Wahb, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I heard Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, say: “My father (Imam al-Baqir (a.s)), peace be upon him, used to call for water for purification (al-tahur) while on a journey, and he was in his litter (al-mahmil). A basin (al-tawr) containing water would be brought to him, and he would perform ablution, then he would pray the eight (rak‘ahs of night prayer) and the witr in his litter. Then, when He (Imam al-Baqir (a.s)) dismounted, He (a.s) would pray two rak‘ahs and the morning prayer (al-subh).”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 255

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Safwan, from Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Hajjaj, from Abu al-Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him, said:
I asked Imam al-Kadhim (a.s) about performing the supererogatory prayer (al-nafilah) while in residence (al-hadar) on the back of a riding animal, when I go out close to the houses of Kufah or if I am in a hurry in Kufah. Imam (a.s) said: “If you are in a hurry and unable to dismount, and you fear missing it (the prayer) if you leave it while you are riding, then yes. Otherwise, your prayer on the ground is more beloved to me.”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَلرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ اَلْحَجَّاجِ عَنْ أَبِي اَلْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ صَلاَةِ اَلنَّافِلَةِ فِي اَلْحَضَرِ عَلَى ظَهْرِ اَلدَّابَّةِ إِذَا خَرَجْتُ قَرِيباً مِنْ أَبْيَاتِ اَلْكُوفَةِ أَوْ كُنْتُ مُسْتَعْجِلاً بِالْكُوفَةِ فَقَالَ« إِنْ كُنْتَ مُسْتَعْجِلاً لاَ تَقْدِرُ عَلَى اَلنُّزُولِ تَخَوَّفْتَ فَوْتَ ذَلِكَ إِنْ تَرَكْتَهُ وَ أَنْتَ رَاكِبٌ فَنَعَمْ وَ إِلاَّ فَإِنَّ صَلاَتَكَ عَلَى اَلْأَرْضِ أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Safwan, from Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Hajjaj, from Abu al-Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him, said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Imam al-Kadhim (a.s) about performing the supererogatory prayer (al-nafilah) while in residence (al-hadar) on the back of a riding animal, when I go out close to the houses of Kufah or if I am in a hurry in Kufah. Imam (a.s) said: “If you are in a hurry and unable to dismount, and you fear missing it (the prayer) if you leave it while you are riding, then yes. Otherwise, your prayer on the ground is more beloved to me.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 255

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Najran, who said:
I asked Abu al-Hasan (a.s), about praying at night during travel in the litter (al-mahmil). Imam (a.s) said: “If you are not facing the qiblah, then face the qiblah, pronounce the takbir, and pray in whatever direction your camel takes you.” I asked: “May I be your ransom, (can I pray) at the beginning of the night?” Imam (a.s) said: “(Yes), If you fear missing it at the end of the night.”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَلرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي نَجْرَانَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا اَلْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلصَّلاَةِ بِاللَّيْلِ فِي اَلسَّفَرِ فِي اَلْمَحْمِلِ قَالَ« إِذَا كُنْتَ عَلَى غَيْرِ اَلْقِبْلَةِ فَاسْتَقْبِلِ اَلْقِبْلَةَ ثُمَّ كَبِّرْ وَ صَلِّ حَيْثُ ذَهَبَ بِكَ بَعِيرُكَ» قُلْتُ جُعِلْتُ فِدَاكَ فِي أَوَّلِ اَللَّيْلِ فَقَالَ« إِذَا خِفْتَ اَلْفَوْتَ فِي آخِرِهِ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Najran, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu al-Hasan (a.s), about praying at night during travel in the litter (al-mahmil). Imam (a.s) said: “If you are not facing the qiblah, then face the qiblah, pronounce the takbir, and pray in whatever direction your camel takes you.” I asked: “May I be your ransom, (can I pray) at the beginning of the night?” Imam (a.s) said: “(Yes), If you fear missing it at the end of the night.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 255

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Ja’far ibn Uthman, from Sama’ah, from Abu Abdillah (a.s):
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “There is no harm in performing the night prayer (salat al-layl) at any time, between its beginning and its end, except that the best of it is after the middle of the night.”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« لاَ بَأْسَ بِصَلاَةِ اَللَّيْلِ فِيمَا بَيْنَ أَوَّلِهِ إِلَى آخِرِهِ إِلاَّ أَنَّ أَفْضَلَ ذَلِكَ بَعْدَ اِنْتِصَافِ اَللَّيْلِ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Ja’far ibn Uthman, from Sama’ah, from Abu Abdillah (a.s):
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “There is no harm in performing the night prayer (salat al-layl) at any time, between its beginning and its end, except that the best of it is after the middle of the night.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 256

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Dawud ibn al-Husayn, from Fadl al-Baqbaq, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) about a traveller (shortening his prayer), who stays with some of his family for a day, or a night, or three (days). Imam (a.s) said: “I do not like that he should shorten the prayer.”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ دَاوُدَ بْنِ اَلْحُصَيْنِ عَنْ فَضْلٍ اَلْبَقْبَاقِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلْمُسَافِرِ يَنْزِلُ عَلَى بَعْضِ أَهْلِهِ يَوْماً أَوْ لَيْلَةً أَوْ ثَلاَثاً قَالَ« مَا أُحِبُّ أَنْ يُقَصِّرَ اَلصَّلاَةَ»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Dawud ibn al-Husayn, from Fadl al-Baqbaq, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) about a traveller (shortening his prayer), who stays with some of his family for a day, or a night, or three (days). Imam (a.s) said: “I do not like that he should shorten the prayer.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 256

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad, from al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah (a.s):
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “The Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, when He (saws) was on a journey or if a need hastened him, He (saws) would combine between the noon (Dhuhr) and afternoon (Asr) prayers. And (He (saws) would combine) between the sunset (Maghrib) and the final night (Isha al-akhira) prayers.” He (al-Halabi) said: “Then Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said; ‘There is no harm in performing the final night prayer early, during travel before the twilight (shafaq) disappears.’”
arabicText: عَلِيُّ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنِ اَلْحَلَبِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَ قَالَ: كَانَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ إِذَا كَانَ فِي سَفَرٍ أَوْ عَجَّلَتْ بِهِ حَاجَةٌ يَجْمَعُ بَيْنَ اَلظُّهْرِ وَ اَلْعَصْرِ وَ بَيْنَ اَلْمَغْرِبِ وَ اَلْعِشَاءِ اَلْآخِرَةِ قَالَ فَقَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ« لاَ بَأْسَ بِأَنْ تُعَجِّلَ عِشَاءَ اَلْآخِرَةِ فِي اَلسَّفَرِ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَغِيبَ اَلشَّفَقُ»
thaqalaynSanad: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad, from al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah (a.s):
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “The Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, when He (saws) was on a journey or if a need hastened him, He (saws) would combine between the noon (Dhuhr) and afternoon (Asr) prayers. And (He (saws) would combine) between the sunset (Maghrib) and the final night (Isha al-akhira) prayers.” He (al-Halabi) said: “Then Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said; ‘There is no harm in performing the final night prayer early, during travel before the twilight (shafaq) disappears.’”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 256

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad, by al-Husayn ibn Sa’id, by Fadalah, by Aban ibn Uthman, from Umar ibn Yazid, said:
Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: “The time of the Maghrib prayer during travel extends until one-fourth of the night.”
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ أَبَانِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ:« وَقْتُ اَلْمَغْرِبِ فِي اَلسَّفَرِ إِلَى رُبُعِ اَللَّيْلِ»
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, by al-Husayn ibn Sa’id, by Fadalah, by Aban ibn Uthman, from Umar ibn Yazid, said:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: “The time of the Maghrib prayer during travel extends until one-fourth of the night.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 256

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from al-Husayn ibn Sa’id, from Fadalah, from al-Husayn ibn Uthman, from Ishaq ibn Ammar, from Abu Basir, who said:
Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: “You are within the time of the Maghrib prayer, during travel, until five miles after the setting of the sun.”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ:« أَنْتَ فِي وَقْتٍ مِنَ اَلْمَغْرِبِ فِي اَلسَّفَرِ إِلَى خَمْسَةِ أَمْيَالٍ مِنْ بَعْدِ غُرُوبِ اَلشَّمْسِ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from al-Husayn ibn Sa’id, from Fadalah, from al-Husayn ibn Uthman, from Ishaq ibn Ammar, from Abu Basir, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: “You are within the time of the Maghrib prayer, during travel, until five miles after the setting of the sun.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 256

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn, from Fadalah, from Musa ibn Bakr, from Zurarah, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Baqir (a.s) said: “The prayer of the traveller is when the sun passes the zenith (zawal), because there is no prayer before it during travel. And if he wishes, he may delay it until the time of noon (Dhuhr) in a state of residence, except that the best of that, is to perform it at the beginning of its time, when the sun passes the zenith (zawal).”
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ بَكْرٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« صَلاَةُ اَلْمُسَافِرِ حِينَ تَزُولُ اَلشَّمْسُ لِأَنَّهُ لَيْسَ قَبْلَهَا فِي اَلسَّفَرِ صَلاَةٌ وَ إِنْ شَاءَ أَخَّرَهَا إِلَى وَقْتِ اَلظُّهْرِ فِي اَلْحَضَرِ غَيْرَ أَنَّ أَفْضَلَ ذَلِكَ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَهَا فِي أَوَّلِ وَقْتِهَا حِينَ تَزُولُ»
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn, from Fadalah, from Musa ibn Bakr, from Zurarah, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Baqir (a.s) said: “The prayer of the traveller is when the sun passes the zenith (zawal), because there is no prayer before it during travel. And if he wishes, he may delay it until the time of noon (Dhuhr) in a state of residence, except that the best of that, is to perform it at the beginning of its time, when the sun passes the zenith (zawal).”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 257

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And with this chain of narration, he said:
I heard Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, say: “If you are a traveller, it does not matter if you delay the noon (Dhuhr) prayer until the time of the afternoon (Asr) enters, so you pray the noon and then you pray the afternoon (Asr). And likewise the sunset (Maghrib) and the final night prayer (Isha al-akhira); you can delay the sunset prayer (Maghrib) until you perform it at the end of its time, along with two units (rak‘ahs) after it, then you perform the night prayer (Isha).”
arabicText: وَ بِهَذَا اَلْإِسْنَادِ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ يَقُولُ:« إِذَا كُنْتَ مُسَافِراً لَمْ تُبَالِ أَنْ تُؤَخِّرَ اَلظُّهْرَ حَتَّى يَدْخُلَ وَقْتُ اَلْعَصْرِ فَتُصَلِّيَ اَلظُّهْرَ ثُمَّ تُصَلِّيَ اَلْعَصْرَ وَ كَذَلِكَ اَلْمَغْرِبُ وَ اَلْعِشَاءُ اَلْآخِرَةُ تُؤَخِّرُ اَلْمَغْرِبَ حَتَّى تُصَلِّيَهَا فِي آخِرِ وَقْتِهَا وَ رَكْعَتَيْنِ بَعْدَهَا ثُمَّ تُصَلِّي اَلْعِشَاءَ»
thaqalaynSanad: And with this chain of narration, he said:
thaqalaynMatn: I heard Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, say: “If you are a traveller, it does not matter if you delay the noon (Dhuhr) prayer until the time of the afternoon (Asr) enters, so you pray the noon and then you pray the afternoon (Asr). And likewise the sunset (Maghrib) and the final night prayer (Isha al-akhira); you can delay the sunset prayer (Maghrib) until you perform it at the end of its time, along with two units (rak‘ahs) after it, then you perform the night prayer (Isha).”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 257

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn, from al-Qasim ibn Muhammad, from Rifaa‘ah ibn Musa, from Isma’il ibn Jabir, who said:
I was with Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, until when we reached between the two evening prayers (al-Isha’ayn). Imam (a.s) said: “O Isma‘il, go ahead with the luggage and the family, until I catch up with you.” And that was at the time of the sun’s setting, so I (Isma’il ibn Jabir) disliked dismounting to pray and leaving the family behind, since Imam (a.s) had instructed me to be with them. So I (Isma’il ibn Jabir) continued on, then Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, caught up with me and said: “O Isma‘il, have you prayed the Maghrib yet?” I said: “No”. So Imam (a.s) dismounted from his riding animal, gave the call to prayer (adhan), then the commencement (iqamah), and prayed the Maghrib, and I prayed with Him (a.s). And the distance from the place where I had parted from Imam (a.s) to the place where He (a.s) caught up with me was six miles.
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ عَنِ اَلْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ رِفَاعَةَ بْنِ مُوسَى عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ جَابِرٍ قَالَ: كُنْتُ مَعَ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ حَتَّى إِذَا بَلَغْنَا بَيْنَ اَلْعِشَاءَيْنِ قَالَ« يَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ اِمْضِ مَعَ اَلثَّقَلِ وَ اَلْعِيَالِ حَتَّى أَلْحَقَكَ» وَ كَانَ ذَلِكَ عِنْدَ سُقُوطِ اَلشَّمْسِ فَكَرِهْتُ أَنْ أَنْزِلَ فَأُصَلِّيَ وَأَدَعَ اَلْعِيَالَ وَقَدْ أَمَرَنِي أَنْ أَكُونَ مَعَهُمْ فَسِرْتُ ثُمَّ لَحِقَنِي أَبُو عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ فَقَالَ« يَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ هَلْ صَلَّيْتَ اَلْمَغْرِبَ بَعْدُ» فَقُلْتُ لاَ فَنَزَلَ عَنْ دَابَّتِهِ فَأَذَّنَ وَ أَقَامَ وَ صَلَّى اَلْمَغْرِبَ وَ صَلَّيْتُ مَعَهُ وَ كَانَ مِنَ اَلْمَوْضِعِ اَلَّذِي فَارَقْتُهُ فِيهِ إِلَى اَلْمَوْضِعِ اَلَّذِي لَحِقَنِي سِتَّةُ أَمْيَالٍ
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn, from al-Qasim ibn Muhammad, from Rifaa‘ah ibn Musa, from Isma’il ibn Jabir, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I was with Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, until when we reached between the two evening prayers (al-Isha’ayn). Imam (a.s) said: “O Isma‘il, go ahead with the luggage and the family, until I catch up with you.” And that was at the time of the sun’s setting, so I (Isma’il ibn Jabir) disliked dismounting to pray and leaving the family behind, since Imam (a.s) had instructed me to be with them. So I (Isma’il ibn Jabir) continued on, then Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, caught up with me and said: “O Isma‘il, have you prayed the Maghrib yet?” I said: “No”. So Imam (a.s) dismounted from his riding animal, gave the call to prayer (adhan), then the commencement (iqamah), and prayed the Maghrib, and I prayed with Him (a.s). And the distance from the place where I had parted from Imam (a.s) to the place where He (a.s) caught up with me was six miles.

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 257

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Safwan, from Mansur, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) about the Maghrib and Isha prayers at Jam‘ (al-Muzdalifah). Imam (a.s) said: “With one adhan and two iqamahs; do not pray anything between them. This is how Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, prayed.”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ صَلاَةِ اَلْمَغْرِبِ وَاَلْعِشَاءِ بِجَمْعٍ فَقَالَ« بِأَذَانٍ وَإِقَامَتَيْنِ لاَ تُصَلِّ بَيْنَهُمَا شَيْئاً هَكَذَا صَلَّى رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Safwan, from Mansur, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) about the Maghrib and Isha prayers at Jam‘ (al-Muzdalifah). Imam (a.s) said: “With one adhan and two iqamahs; do not pray anything between them. This is how Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, prayed.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 257

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad, from al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “If you pray anything of the prayer during travel, outside of its time, it does not harm you.”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنِ اَلْحَلَبِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« إِذَا صَلَّيْتَ فِي اَلسَّفَرِ شَيْئاً مِنَ اَلصَّلاَةِ فِي غَيْرِ وَقْتِهَا فَلاَ يَضُرُّكَ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad, from al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “If you pray anything of the prayer during travel, outside of its time, it does not harm you.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 257

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ghiyath ibn Ibrahim, from Imam Ja’far (a.s), from his father (a.s), peace be upon them, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “He (Imam al-Baqir (a.s)) would shorten the prayer when he departed from Kufah, at the first prayer that became due upon Him (a.s).”
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ غِيَاثِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَلَيْهِمَا اَلسَّلاَمُ:« أَنَّهُ كَانَ يُقَصِّرُ اَلصَّلاَةَ حِينَ يَخْرُجُ مِنَ اَلْكُوفَةِ فِي أَوَّلِ صَلاَةٍ تَحْضُرُهُ»
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ghiyath ibn Ibrahim, from Imam Ja’far (a.s), from his father (a.s), peace be upon them, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “He (Imam al-Baqir (a.s)) would shorten the prayer when he departed from Kufah, at the first prayer that became due upon Him (a.s).”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 258

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer During Travel
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
As for what was narrated by Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub, from Ahmad, from al-Husayn, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Muhammad ibn Ishaq ibn Ammar, who said:
I asked Abul Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him, about a woman who was with them on a journey, and she used to pray the Maghrib as two units (rak‘ahs), both when going and returning. Imam (a.s) said: “There is no make-up (qadah) upon her.”
arabicText: فَأَمَّا مَا رَوَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا اَلْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلْمَرْأَةِ كَانَتْ مَعَهُمْ فِي سَفَرٍ وَ كَانَتْ تُصَلِّي اَلْمَغْرِبَ رَكْعَتَيْنِ ذَاهِبَةً وَ جَائِيَةً قَالَ« لَيْسَ عَلَيْهَا قَضَاءٌ»
thaqalaynSanad: As for what was narrated by Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub, from Ahmad, from al-Husayn, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Muhammad ibn Ishaq ibn Ammar, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abul Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him, about a woman who was with them on a journey, and she used to pray the Maghrib as two units (rak‘ahs), both when going and returning. Imam (a.s) said: “There is no make-up (qadah) upon her.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 258

chapter: Chapter on the Deeds to Be Attained on Night of Friday and Its Day
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa’id, from al-Nadr, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “The hour in which supplication is answered on Friday, is from the time the imam (of prayer) finishes the sermon until the people stand in rows. And another hour is from the end of the day until the setting of the sun.”
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ اَلنَّضْرِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« اَلسَّاعَةُ اَلَّتِي يُسْتَجَابُ فِيهَا اَلدُّعَاءُ يَوْمَ اَلْجُمُعَةِ مَا بَيْنَ فَرَاغِ اَلْإِمَامِ مِنَ اَلْخُطْبَةِ إِلَى أَنْ يَسْتَوِيَ اَلنَّاسُ فِي اَلصُّفُوفِ وَ سَاعَةٌ أُخْرَى مِنْ آخِرِ اَلنَّهَارِ إِلَى غُرُوبِ اَلشَّمْسِ»
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Sa’id, from al-Nadr, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “The hour in which supplication is answered on Friday, is from the time the imam (of prayer) finishes the sermon until the people stand in rows. And another hour is from the end of the day until the setting of the sun.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 258

chapter: Chapter on the Deeds to Be Attained on Night of Friday and Its Day
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Mufaddal ibn Salih, from Jabir ibn Yazid, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Imam al-Baqir (a.s) regarding the saying of Allah (swt), Mighty and Majestic: “Then hasten to the remembrance of Allah” (Surah Al Jumu’ah 62:9) Imam (a.s) said: “Act and hasten, for it is a day made restricted upon the Muslims, and the reward of the deeds of the Muslims on it is according to the extent that it has been made restricted upon them. And the good deed and the bad deed are multiplied on it.” He (Jabir ibn Yazid) said: “And Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, said; ‘By Allah (swt), it has reached me that the companions of the Prophet (saws), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, used to prepare for Friday on Thursday, because it is a day made tight (restricted) upon the Muslims.”
arabicText: سَهْلُ بْنُ زِيَادٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اَلْمُفَضَّلِ بْنِ صَالِحٍ عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لَهُ قَوْلُ اَللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ« فَاسْعَوْا إِلىٰ ذِكْرِ اَللّٰهِ» قَالَ قَالَ« اِعْمَلُوا وَ عَجِّلُوا فَإِنَّهُ يَوْمٌ مُضَيَّقٌ عَلَى اَلْمُسْلِمِينَ فِيهِ وَ ثَوَابُ أَعْمَالِ اَلْمُسْلِمِينَ فِيهِ عَلَى قَدْرِ مَا ضُيِّقَ عَلَيْهِمْ وَ اَلْحَسَنَةُ وَ اَلسَّيِّئَةُ تُضَاعَفُ فِيهِ» قَالَ وَ قَالَ أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ عَ« وَ اَللَّهِ لَقَدْ بَلَغَنِي أَنَّ أَصْحَابَ اَلنَّبِيِّ صَ كَانُوا يَتَجَهَّزُونَ لِلْجُمُعَةِ يَوْمَ اَلْخَمِيسِ لِأَنَّهُ يَوْمٌ مُضَيَّقٌ عَلَى اَلْمُسْلِمِينَ»
thaqalaynSanad: Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Mufaddal ibn Salih, from Jabir ibn Yazid, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Imam al-Baqir (a.s) regarding the saying of Allah (swt), Mighty and Majestic: “Then hasten to the remembrance of Allah” (Surah Al Jumu’ah 62:9) Imam (a.s) said: “Act and hasten, for it is a day made restricted upon the Muslims, and the reward of the deeds of the Muslims on it is according to the extent that it has been made restricted upon them. And the good deed and the bad deed are multiplied on it.” He (Jabir ibn Yazid) said: “And Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, said; ‘By Allah (swt), it has reached me that the companions of the Prophet (saws), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, used to prepare for Friday on Thursday, because it is a day made tight (restricted) upon the Muslims.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 258

chapter: Chapter on the Deeds to Be Attained on Night of Friday and Its Day
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Hariz, from Zurarah and al-Fudayl, who said:
We said to Imam al-Baqir (a.s): “Is it sufficient if I perform the ghusl after Fajr for Friday?” Imam (a.s) said: “Yes.”
arabicText: عَلِيُّ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ وَ اَلْفُضَيْلِ قَالاَ: قُلْنَا لَهُ أَ يُجْزِي إِذَا اِغْتَسَلْتُ بَعْدَ اَلْفَجْرِ لِلْجُمُعَةِ قَالَ« نَعَمْ»
thaqalaynSanad: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Hariz, from Zurarah and al-Fudayl, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: We said to Imam al-Baqir (a.s): “Is it sufficient if I perform the ghusl after Fajr for Friday?” Imam (a.s) said: “Yes.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 259

chapter: Chapter on the Deeds to Be Attained on Night of Friday and Its Day
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Isma‘il, from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hafs ibn al-Bukhtari, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “Trimming the mustache and the nails, from one Friday to the next, is a protection from leprosy.”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ عَنِ اَلْفَضْلِ بْنِ شَاذَانَ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَفْصِ بْنِ اَلْبَخْتَرِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« أَخْذُ اَلشَّارِبِ وَ اَلْأَظْفَارِ مِنَ اَلْجُمُعَةِ إِلَى اَلْجُمُعَةِ أَمَانٌ مِنَ اَلْجُذَامِ»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Isma‘il, from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hafs ibn al-Bukhtari, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “Trimming the mustache and the nails, from one Friday to the next, is a protection from leprosy.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 259

chapter: Chapter on the Deeds to Be Attained on Night of Friday and Its Day
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Musa ibn Sa’adan, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “Whoever trims his mustache, clips his nails, and washes his head with ‘khitmi’ (a cleansing herb, named ‘marshmallow plant’) on Friday, it is as if he has freed a soul (in rewards).”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ سَعْدَانَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« مَنْ أَخَذَ مِنْ شَارِبِهِ وَ قَلَّمَ أَظْفَارَهُ وَ غَسَلَ رَأْسَهُ بِالْخِطْمِيِّ يَوْمَ اَلْجُمُعَةِ كَانَ كَمَنْ أَعْتَقَ نَسَمَةً»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Musa ibn Sa’adan, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “Whoever trims his mustache, clips his nails, and washes his head with ‘khitmi’ (a cleansing herb, named ‘marshmallow plant’) on Friday, it is as if he has freed a soul (in rewards).”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 259

chapter: Chapter on the Deeds to Be Attained on Night of Friday and Its Day
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Faddal, from Ibn Bukayr, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “Washing the head with ‘khitmi’ (marshmallow plant) every Friday, is a protection from leprosy and madness.”
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ بُكَيْرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« غَسْلُ اَلرَّأْسِ بِالْخِطْمِيِّ فِي كُلِّ جُمُعَةٍ أَمَانٌ مِنَ اَلْبَرَصِ وَ اَلْجُنُونِ»
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Faddal, from Ibn Bukayr, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “Washing the head with ‘khitmi’ (marshmallow plant) every Friday, is a protection from leprosy and madness.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 259

chapter: Chapter on the Deeds to Be Attained on Night of Friday and Its Day
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub, by Muhammad ibn Isa, by Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, by Muhammad ibn al-Fudayl, by Abd al-Rahman ibn Zayd, by Abu Abdillah (a.s), from his father (a.s), from his grandfather (a.s), said:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “A Bedouin came to the Prophet (saws), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, and he was called Qulayb. Qulayb said to Him (saws): ‘O Messenger of Allah (swt), I have prepared for Hajj such and such number of times, but it was never destined for me.’ So Prophet (saws) said to him: ‘O Qulayb, hold to Friday, for it is the Hajj of the poor.’” (striving on Fridays, is means to earn great rewards for those too poor to afford Hajj)
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْفُضَيْلِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَلرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ جَدِّهِ عَلَيْهِمُ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« جَاءَ أَعْرَابِيٌّ إِلَى اَلنَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ يُقَالُ لَهُ قُلَيْبٌ فَقَالَ لَهُ يَا رَسُولَ اَللَّهِ إِنِّي تَهَيَّأْتُ إِلَى اَلْحَجِّ كَذَا وَ كَذَا مَرَّةً فَمَا قُدِّرَ لِي فَقَالَ لَهُ« يَا قُلَيْبُ عَلَيْكَ بِالْجُمُعَةِ فَإِنَّهَا حَجُّ اَلْمَسَاكِينِ»»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub, by Muhammad ibn Isa, by Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, by Muhammad ibn al-Fudayl, by Abd al-Rahman ibn Zayd, by Abu Abdillah (a.s), from his father (a.s), from his grandfather (a.s), said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “A Bedouin came to the Prophet (saws), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, and he was called Qulayb. Qulayb said to Him (saws): ‘O Messenger of Allah (swt), I have prepared for Hajj such and such number of times, but it was never destined for me.’ So Prophet (saws) said to him: ‘O Qulayb, hold to Friday, for it is the Hajj of the poor.’” (striving on Fridays, is means to earn great rewards for those too poor to afford Hajj)

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 259

chapter: Chapter on the Deeds to Be Attained on Night of Friday and Its Day
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa’id, by al-Qasim ibn Muhammad, by Ja’far ibn Mu‘awiyah ibn Wahb, by Musa ibn Bakr, said:
I said to Abul Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him: “Indeed, our companions say that trimming the mustache and clipping the nails, is specific to (only) Friday.” Imam (a.s) said: “Glory be to Allah! Do it whenever you wish on Friday, and if you wish, then on any of the other days.”
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ اَلْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ وَهْبٍ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ بَكْرٍ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي اَلْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ إِنَّ أَصْحَابَنَا يَقُولُونَ إِنَّ أَخْذَ اَلشَّارِبِ وَقَلْمَ اَلْأَظْفَارِ يَوْمَ اَلْجُمُعَةِ فَقَالَ« سُبْحَانَ اَللَّهِ خُذْهَا مَتَى شِئْتَ فِي يَوْمِ اَلْجُمُعَةِ وَ إِنْ شِئْتَ فَفِي سَائِرِ اَلْأَيَّامِ»
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Sa’id, by al-Qasim ibn Muhammad, by Ja’far ibn Mu‘awiyah ibn Wahb, by Musa ibn Bakr, said:
thaqalaynMatn: I said to Abul Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him: “Indeed, our companions say that trimming the mustache and clipping the nails, is specific to (only) Friday.” Imam (a.s) said: “Glory be to Allah! Do it whenever you wish on Friday, and if you wish, then on any of the other days.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 260

chapter: Chapter on the Deeds to Be Attained on Night of Friday and Its Day
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal, from Abu Hafs al-Jurjani, from Abu al-Khadib al-Rabi‘ ibn Bakr, from Abd al-Rahim al-Qasir, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Baqir (a.s) said: “Whoever trims his nails and mustache every Friday, and says at the time of trimming: ‘In the name of Allah (swt), and by Allah (swt), and upon the Sunnah of the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family’, then not a single clipping (of nail) or cutting (of hair) will fall from him, except that Allah (swt) will write for him with it the freeing of a soul (in rewards), And he will not fall ill except with the illness by which he dies.”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ أَبِي حَفْصٍ اَلْجُرْجَانِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي اَلْخَضِيبِ اَلرَّبِيعِ بْنِ بَكْرٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَلرَّحِيمِ اَلْقَصِيرِ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« مَنْ أَخَذَ مِنْ أَظْفَارِهِ وَ شَارِبِهِ كُلَّ جُمُعَةٍ وَ قَالَ حِينَ يَأْخُذُهُ بِسْمِ اَللَّهِ وَ بِاللَّهِ وَ عَلَى سُنَّةِ رَسُولِ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ لَمْ تَسْقُطْ مِنْهُ قُلاَمَةٌ وَ لاَ جُزَازَةٌ إِلاَّ كَتَبَ اَللَّهُ لَهُ بِهَا عِتْقَ نَسَمَةٍ وَ لَمْ يَمْرَضْ إِلاَّ مَرَضَهُ اَلَّذِي يَمُوتُ فِيهِ»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal, from Abu Hafs al-Jurjani, from Abu al-Khadib al-Rabi‘ ibn Bakr, from Abd al-Rahim al-Qasir, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Baqir (a.s) said: “Whoever trims his nails and mustache every Friday, and says at the time of trimming: ‘In the name of Allah (swt), and by Allah (swt), and upon the Sunnah of the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family’, then not a single clipping (of nail) or cutting (of hair) will fall from him, except that Allah (swt) will write for him with it the freeing of a soul (in rewards), And he will not fall ill except with the illness by which he dies.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 260

chapter: Chapter on the Deeds to Be Attained on Night of Friday and Its Day
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from al-Hasan ibn Sulayman ibn Hilal, from his uncle Abdullah ibn Hilal, who said:
Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said to me: “Trim your mustache and your nails every Friday, And if there is nothing to trim, then purify them (symbolically clean or file them), so that leprosy, vitiligo, and madness do not afflict you.”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ هِلاَلٍ عَنْ عَمِّهِ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ هِلاَلٍ قَالَ قَالَ لِي أَبُو عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ:« خُذْ مِنْ شَارِبِكَ وَ أَظْفَارِكَ كُلَّ جُمُعَةٍ وَ إِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ فِيهَا شَيْءٌ فَزَكِّهَا فَلاَ يُصِيبَكَ جُذَامٌ وَ لاَ بَرَصٌ وَ لاَ جُنُونٌ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from al-Hasan ibn Sulayman ibn Hilal, from his uncle Abdullah ibn Hilal, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said to me: “Trim your mustache and your nails every Friday, And if there is nothing to trim, then purify them (symbolically clean or file them), so that leprosy, vitiligo, and madness do not afflict you.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 260

chapter: Chapter on the Deeds to Be Attained on Night of Friday and Its Day
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Safwan, from al-‘Ala’, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from one of the two (Imams (a.s)), peace be upon them, who said:
Imam (a.s) said: “Perform ghusl on the day of Friday, unless you are ill or fear for yourself.”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنِ اَلْعَلاَءِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ أَحَدِهِمَا عَلَيْهِمَا اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« اِغْتَسِلْ يَوْمَ اَلْجُمُعَةِ إِلاَّ أَنْ تَكُونَ مَرِيضاً أَوْ تَخَافَ عَلَى نَفْسِكَ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Safwan, from al-‘Ala’, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from one of the two (Imams (a.s)), peace be upon them, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: “Perform ghusl on the day of Friday, unless you are ill or fear for yourself.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 261

chapter: Chapter on the Deeds to Be Attained on Night of Friday and Its Day
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Ibn Faddal, from Isa al-Farra’, from Ibn Abi Ya‘fur, who said:
I said to Imam (a.s): “May I be your ransom, indeed sustenance has not been brought down by anything equal to ‘ta‘qib’ (post-prayer devotion acts) done between the rising of the dawn and the rising of the sun.” Imam (a.s) said to me: “Yes, but I will inform you of something better than that; trimming the mustache and clipping the nails on the day of Friday.”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنِ اِبْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ عِيسَى اَلْفَرَّاءِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي يَعْفُورٍ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لَهُ جُعِلْتُ فِدَاكَ إِنَّهُ مَا اُسْتُنْزِلَ اَلرِّزْقُ بِشَيْءٍ يَعْدِلُ اَلتَّعْقِيبَ بَيْنَ طُلُوعِ اَلْفَجْرِ إِلَى طُلُوعِ اَلشَّمْسِ قَالَ لِي« أَجَلْ وَ لَكِنِّي أُخْبِرُكَ بِخَيْرٍ مِنْ ذَلِكَ أَخْذِ اَلشَّارِبِ وَ تَقْلِيمِ اَلْأَظْفَارِ يَوْمَ اَلْجُمُعَةِ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Ibn Faddal, from Isa al-Farra’, from Ibn Abi Ya‘fur, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I said to Imam (a.s): “May I be your ransom, indeed sustenance has not been brought down by anything equal to ‘ta‘qib’ (post-prayer devotion acts) done between the rising of the dawn and the rising of the sun.” Imam (a.s) said to me: “Yes, but I will inform you of something better than that; trimming the mustache and clipping the nails on the day of Friday.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 261

chapter: Chapter on the Deeds to Be Attained on Night of Friday and Its Day
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa’id, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Umar ibn Udhaynah, from Zurarah, who said:
Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, said: “The Friday prayer is obligatory upon the one who, if he performs the morning prayer with his family, can reach the Friday prayer (meaning in terms of distance). And the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, used to pray the afternoon prayer, at the time of the noon prayer on other days, so that when they completed the prayer with Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, the people would return to their dwellings before nightfall. And this is a Sunnah until the Day of Resurrection.”
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ أُذَيْنَةَ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ:« اَلْجُمُعَةُ وَاجِبَةٌ عَلَى مَنْ إِنْ صَلَّى اَلْغَدَاةَ فِي أَهْلِهِ أَدْرَكَ اَلْجُمُعَةَ وَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ إِنَّمَا يُصَلِّي اَلْعَصْرَ فِي وَقْتِ اَلظُّهْرِ فِي سَائِرِ اَلْأَيَّامِ كَيْ إِذَا قَضَوُا اَلصَّلاَةَ مَعَ رَسُولِ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ رَجَعُوا إِلَى رِحَالِهِمْ قَبْلَ اَللَّيْلِ وَ ذَلِكَ سُنَّةٌ إِلَى يَوْمِ اَلْقِيَامَةِ»
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Sa’id, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Umar ibn Udhaynah, from Zurarah, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, said: “The Friday prayer is obligatory upon the one who, if he performs the morning prayer with his family, can reach the Friday prayer (meaning in terms of distance). And the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, used to pray the afternoon prayer, at the time of the noon prayer on other days, so that when they completed the prayer with Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, the people would return to their dwellings before nightfall. And this is a Sunnah until the Day of Resurrection.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 261

chapter: Chapter on the Deeds to Be Attained on Night of Friday and Its Day
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from al-Nadr, from Asim, from Abu Basir and Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Baqir (a.s) said: “Whoever abandons the Friday prayer for three consecutive Fridays, Allah (swt) places a seal upon his heart.”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنِ اَلنَّضْرِ عَنْ عَاصِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ وَ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« مَنْ تَرَكَ اَلْجُمُعَةَ ثَلاَثَ جُمَعٍ مُتَوَالِيَةً طَبَعَ اَللَّهُ عَلَى قَلْبِهِ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from al-Nadr, from Asim, from Abu Basir and Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Baqir (a.s) said: “Whoever abandons the Friday prayer for three consecutive Fridays, Allah (swt) places a seal upon his heart.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 261

chapter: Chapter on the Deeds to Be Attained on Night of Friday and Its Day
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn, from Safwan, from al-‘Ala’, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from one of the two (Imams (a.s)), peace be upon them, who said:
I asked Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) about a group of people in a village, do they perform the Friday prayer in congregation? Imam (a.s) said: “Yes, and they pray four units if there is no one to deliver the sermon.”
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنِ اَلْعَلاَءِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ أَحَدِهِمَا عَلَيْهِمَا اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ أُنَاسٍ فِي قَرْيَةٍ هَلْ يُصَلُّونَ اَلْجُمُعَةَ جَمَاعَةً قَالَ« نَعَمْ وَ يُصَلُّونَ أَرْبَعاً إِذَا لَمْ يَكُنْ مَنْ يَخْطُبُ»
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn, from Safwan, from al-‘Ala’, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from one of the two (Imams (a.s)), peace be upon them, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) about a group of people in a village, do they perform the Friday prayer in congregation? Imam (a.s) said: “Yes, and they pray four units if there is no one to deliver the sermon.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 261

chapter: Chapter on the Deeds to Be Attained on Night of Friday and Its Day
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Fadalah, from Aban ibn Uthman, from al-Fadl ibn Abd al-Malik, who said:
I heard Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, say: “If a group of people are in a village, they pray four units. But if they have someone to deliver the sermon for them, they may hold the Friday prayer if they are five individuals. And it (Salat Al Jumu’ah) was made two units because of the two sermons.”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ أَبَانِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنِ اَلْفَضْلِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَلْمَلِكِ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ يَقُولُ:« إِذَا كَانَ قَوْمٌ فِي قَرْيَةٍ صَلَّوْا أَرْبَعَ رَكَعَاتٍ فَإِنْ كَانَ لَهُمْ مَنْ يَخْطُبُ بِهِمْ جَمَّعُوا إِذَا كَانُوا خَمْسَةَ نَفَرٍ وَ إِنَّمَا جُعِلَتْ رَكْعَتَيْنِ لِمَكَانِ اَلْخُطْبَتَيْنِ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Fadalah, from Aban ibn Uthman, from al-Fadl ibn Abd al-Malik, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I heard Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, say: “If a group of people are in a village, they pray four units. But if they have someone to deliver the sermon for them, they may hold the Friday prayer if they are five individuals. And it (Salat Al Jumu’ah) was made two units because of the two sermons.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 262

chapter: Chapter on the Deeds to Be Attained on Night of Friday and Its Day
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hisham ibn Salim, from Zurarah, who said:
Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, urged us to attend the Friday prayer so strongly that I thought Imam (a.s) wanted us to come to him. So I said to Imam (a.s): “Shall we come to you in the morning?” Imam (a.s) said, “No, I only meant where you are.”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ سَالِمٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ قَالَ: حَثَّنَا أَبُو عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَى صَلاَةِ اَلْجُمُعَةِ حَتَّى ظَنَنْتُ أَنَّهُ يُرِيدُ أَنْ نَأْتِيَهُ فَقُلْتُ لَهُ نَغْدُو عَلَيْكَ فَقَالَ« لاَ إِنَّمَا عَنَيْتُ عِنْدَكُمْ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hisham ibn Salim, from Zurarah, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, urged us to attend the Friday prayer so strongly that I thought Imam (a.s) wanted us to come to him. So I said to Imam (a.s): “Shall we come to you in the morning?” Imam (a.s) said, “No, I only meant where you are.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 262

chapter: Chapter on the Deeds to Be Attained on Night of Friday and Its Day
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Safwan, from Mansur, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “A group may hold the Friday prayer if they are five or more. But if they are fewer than five, then there is no Friday prayer for them. And the Friday prayer is obligatory upon every individual. People are not excused from it except five (groups of people); the woman, the slave, the traveller, the sick person, and the child.”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« يُجَمِّعُ اَلْقَوْمُ يَوْمَ اَلْجُمُعَةِ إِذَا كَانُوا خَمْسَةً فَمَا زَادُوا فَإِنْ كَانُوا أَقَلَّ مِنْ خَمْسَةٍ فَلاَ جُمُعَةَ لَهُمْ وَاَلْجُمُعَةُ وَاجِبَةٌ عَلَى كُلِّ أَحَدٍ لاَ يُعْذَرُ اَلنَّاسُ فِيهَا إِلاَّ خَمْسَةٌ اَلْمَرْأَةُ وَ اَلْمَمْلُوكُ وَ اَلْمُسَافِرُ وَ اَلْمَرِيضُ وَ اَلصَّبِيُّ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Safwan, from Mansur, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “A group may hold the Friday prayer if they are five or more. But if they are fewer than five, then there is no Friday prayer for them. And the Friday prayer is obligatory upon every individual. People are not excused from it except five (groups of people); the woman, the slave, the traveller, the sick person, and the child.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 262

chapter: Chapter on the Deeds to Be Attained on Night of Friday and Its Day
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Uthman ibn Yahya, from Ibn Muskan, from Ibn Abi Ya‘fur, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), who said:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “There is no Friday prayer unless the people are five.”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنِ اِبْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي يَعْفُورٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« لاَ تَكُونُ جُمُعَةٌ مَا لَمْ يَكُنِ اَلْقَوْمُ خَمْسَةً»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Uthman ibn Yahya, from Ibn Muskan, from Ibn Abi Ya‘fur, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “There is no Friday prayer unless the people are five.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 262

chapter: Chapter on the Deeds to Be Attained on Night of Friday and Its Day
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub, from al-‘Abbas, from Abdullah ibn al-Mughirah, from Ibn Bukayr, who said: Zurarah narrated to me from Abd al-Malik, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Baqir (a.s) said: “Someone like you would perish and not pray a prescribed obligation that Allah (swt) has made obligatory?” Abd al-Malik asked: “So what should I do?” Imam (a.s) said: “Pray in congregation (meaning the Friday prayer).”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنِ اَلْعَبَّاسِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ اَلْمُغِيرَةِ عَنِ اِبْنِ بُكَيْرٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي زُرَارَةُ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَلْمَلِكِ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ قَالَ:« مِثْلُكَ يَهْلِكُ وَ لَمْ يُصَلِّ فَرِيضَةً فَرَضَهَا اَللَّهُ» قَالَ قُلْتُ فَكَيْفَ أَصْنَعُ قَالَ قَالَ« صَلُّوا جَمَاعَةً يَعْنِي صَلاَةَ اَلْجُمُعَةِ»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub, from al-‘Abbas, from Abdullah ibn al-Mughirah, from Ibn Bukayr, who said: Zurarah narrated to me from Abd al-Malik, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Baqir (a.s) said: “Someone like you would perish and not pray a prescribed obligation that Allah (swt) has made obligatory?” Abd al-Malik asked: “So what should I do?” Imam (a.s) said: “Pray in congregation (meaning the Friday prayer).”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 262

chapter: Chapter on the Deeds to Be Attained on Night of Friday and Its Day
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
As for what was narrated by Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Talhah ibn Zayd, from Imam Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, from his father (a.s), from Imam Ali (a.s), peace be upon him, said:
Imam Ali (a.s) said: “There is no Friday prayer except in a city where the legal punishments (hudud) are established.”
arabicText: فَأَمَّا مَا رَوَاهُ أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ طَلْحَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَلِيٍّ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« لاَ جُمُعَةَ إِلاَّ فِي مِصْرٍ تُقَامُ فِيهِ اَلْحُدُودُ»
thaqalaynSanad: As for what was narrated by Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Talhah ibn Zayd, from Imam Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, from his father (a.s), from Imam Ali (a.s), peace be upon him, said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam Ali (a.s) said: “There is no Friday prayer except in a city where the legal punishments (hudud) are established.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 263

chapter: Chapter on the Deeds to Be Attained on Night of Friday and Its Day
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Umar ibn Udhaynah, from Zurarah, who said:
Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, used to say: “The sermon, the Friday prayer, and the two-unit prayer do not take place with fewer than five persons; the (just) imam and four others.”
arabicText: عَلِيُّ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ أُذَيْنَةَ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ قَالَ كَانَ أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ يَقُولُ: «لاَ تَكُونُ اَلْخُطْبَةُ وَ اَلْجُمُعَةُ وَ صَلاَةُ رَكْعَتَيْنِ عَلَى أَقَلَّ مِنْ خَمْسَةِ رَهْطٍ اَلْإِمَامِ وَ أَرْبَعَةٍ»
thaqalaynSanad: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Umar ibn Udhaynah, from Zurarah, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, used to say: “The sermon, the Friday prayer, and the two-unit prayer do not take place with fewer than five persons; the (just) imam and four others.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 263

chapter: Chapter on the Deeds to Be Attained on Night of Friday and Its Day
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from his father, from Hammad, from Hariz, from Ibn Muslim, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about the Friday prayer. Imam (a.s) said: “It is obligatory upon one who is within two ‘farsakhs’ (approximately six miles) from it. If the distance is more than that, then nothing is obligatory upon him.”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ مُسْلِمٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلْجُمُعَةِ فَقَالَ« تَجِبُ عَلَى مَنْ كَانَ مِنْهَا عَلَى رَأْسِ فَرْسَخَيْنِ فَإِنْ زَادَ عَلَى ذَلِكَ فَلَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ شَيْءٌ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from his father, from Hammad, from Hariz, from Ibn Muslim, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about the Friday prayer. Imam (a.s) said: “It is obligatory upon one who is within two ‘farsakhs’ (approximately six miles) from it. If the distance is more than that, then nothing is obligatory upon him.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 263

chapter: Chapter on the Deeds to Be Attained on Night of Friday and Its Day
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
As for what was narrated by Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub, from Ya‘qub ibn Yazid, from Ibn Abi ‘Umayr, from Umar ibn Udhaynah, from Zurarah, who said:
Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, said: “The Friday prayer is obligatory upon the one who, if he performs the morning prayer with his family, can reach the Friday prayer. And the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, used to perform the afternoon prayer, at the time of the noon prayer, on the rest of the days so that when they completed the prayer with the Messenger of Allah (swt), May Allah (swt) bless him and his family, they would return to their dwellings before nightfall, and that is a sunnah until the Day of Resurrection.”
arabicText: فأما ما رواه محمد بن علي بن محبوب عن يعقوب بن يزيد عن ابن ابي عمير عن عمر بن اذينة عن زرارة قال قال أبو جعفر عليه السلام الجمعة واجبة على من إن صلى الغداة في أهله أدرك الجمعة وكان رسول الله صلى الله عليه وآله انما يصلي العصر في وقت الظهر في سائر الايام كي إذا قضوا الصلاة مع رسول الله صلى الله عليه وآله رجعوا إلى رحالهم قبل الليل وذلك سنة إلى يوم القيامة
thaqalaynSanad: As for what was narrated by Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub, from Ya‘qub ibn Yazid, from Ibn Abi ‘Umayr, from Umar ibn Udhaynah, from Zurarah, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, said: “The Friday prayer is obligatory upon the one who, if he performs the morning prayer with his family, can reach the Friday prayer. And the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, used to perform the afternoon prayer, at the time of the noon prayer, on the rest of the days so that when they completed the prayer with the Messenger of Allah (swt), May Allah (swt) bless him and his family, they would return to their dwellings before nightfall, and that is a sunnah until the Day of Resurrection.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 263

chapter: Chapter on the Deeds to Be Attained on Night of Friday and Its Day
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub narrated from Ali ibn al-Sindi, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Jamil ibn Darraj, from Zurarah and Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Baqir (a.s) said: “The Friday prayer is obligatory upon one who is at a distance of two farsakhs (farsakhayn) from it.”
arabicText: رَوَى مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ اَلسِّنْدِيِّ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ جَمِيلِ بْنِ دَرَّاجٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ وَ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« تَجِبُ اَلْجُمُعَةُ عَلَى مَنْ كَانَ مِنْهَا عَلَى فَرْسَخَيْنِ»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub narrated from Ali ibn al-Sindi, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Jamil ibn Darraj, from Zurarah and Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Baqir (a.s) said: “The Friday prayer is obligatory upon one who is at a distance of two farsakhs (farsakhayn) from it.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 264

chapter: Chapter on the Deeds to Be Attained on Night of Friday and Its Day
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub narrated from Yaqub ibn Yazid, from Abu Hammam, from Abu al-Hasan (a.s):
Imam al-Kadhim (a.s) said: “If a woman performs the Friday prayer in the mosque with the (just) imam of two rak‘ahs for Friday, then her prayer is deficient. And if she performs four rak‘ahs in the mosque, her prayer is deficient. Let her pray four rak‘ahs in her house; for that is better.”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ عَنْ أَبِي هَمَّامٍ عَنْ أَبِي اَلْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« إِذَا صَلَّتِ اَلْمَرْأَةُ فِي اَلْمَسْجِدِ مَعَ اَلْإِمَامِ يَوْمَ اَلْجُمُعَةِ اَلْجُمُعَةَ رَكْعَتَيْنِ فَقَدْ نَقَصَتْ صَلاَتَهَا وَ إِنْ صَلَّتْ فِي اَلْمَسْجِدِ أَرْبَعاً نَقَصَتْ صَلاَتَهَا لَتُصَلِّي فِي بَيْتِهَا أَرْبَعاً أَفْضَلُ»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub narrated from Yaqub ibn Yazid, from Abu Hammam, from Abu al-Hasan (a.s):
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Kadhim (a.s) said: “If a woman performs the Friday prayer in the mosque with the (just) imam of two rak‘ahs for Friday, then her prayer is deficient. And if she performs four rak‘ahs in the mosque, her prayer is deficient. Let her pray four rak‘ahs in her house; for that is better.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 264

chapter: Chapter on the Deeds to Be Attained on Night of Friday and Its Day
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Sa’ad narrated from Ahmad, from al-Husayn, from Fadalah, from Aban, from Abdur-Rahman ibn Abi Abdillah, who said:
Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: “There is no harm in abandoning the Friday prayer due to rain.”
arabicText: سَعْدٌ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ أَبَانٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَلرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ:« لاَ بَأْسَ بِأَنْ تَدَعَ اَلْجُمُعَةَ فِي اَلْمَطَرِ»
thaqalaynSanad: Sa’ad narrated from Ahmad, from al-Husayn, from Fadalah, from Aban, from Abdur-Rahman ibn Abi Abdillah, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: “There is no harm in abandoning the Friday prayer due to rain.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 264

chapter: Chapter on the Deeds to Be Attained on Night of Friday and Its Day
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Muawiyah ibn Hakeem, from Abdillah ibn al-Mughirah, from Dhareeh, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) was asked if a man, needs to make up the Friday ghusl (ritual bath)? (meaning to make it up as ‘qadha’) Imam (a.s) said: “No.”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ حُكَيْمٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ اَلْمُغِيرَةِ عَنْ ذَرِيحٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ :فِي اَلرَّجُلِ هَلْ يَقْضِي غُسْلَ اَلْجُمُعَةِ قَالَ« لاَ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Muawiyah ibn Hakeem, from Abdillah ibn al-Mughirah, from Dhareeh, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) was asked if a man, needs to make up the Friday ghusl (ritual bath)? (meaning to make it up as ‘qadha’) Imam (a.s) said: “No.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 264

chapter: Chapter on the Deeds to Be Attained on Night of Friday and Its Day
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Saeed narrated from Fadalah, from Ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said regarding the saying of Allah (swt), Mighty and Majestic: “Take your adornment at every place of worship” (Surah Al Araf 7:31) Imam (a.s) said: “(it is regarding) On the two Eids and on Fridays.”
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنِ اِبْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: فِي قَوْلِ اَللَّهِ عَزَّوَجَلَّ« خُذُوا زِينَتَكُمْ عِنْدَ كُلِّ مَسْجِدٍ» قَالَ« فِي اَلْعِيدَيْنِ وَ اَلْجُمُعَةِ»
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Saeed narrated from Fadalah, from Ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said regarding the saying of Allah (swt), Mighty and Majestic: “Take your adornment at every place of worship” (Surah Al Araf 7:31) Imam (a.s) said: “(it is regarding) On the two Eids and on Fridays.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 264

chapter: Chapter on the Deeds to Be Attained on Night of Friday and Its Day
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ali narrated from his father, from Hammad, from Hariz, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:
I asked Imam (a.s) about the Friday prayer. Imam (a.s) said: “There is an adhan and an iqamah. The (just) imam comes out after the adhan and ascends the pulpit and delivers the sermon, and the people do not pray as long as the (just) imam is on the pulpit. Then the (just) imam sits on the pulpit for the duration it takes to recite ‘Qul huwa Allahu Ahad’ (Surah Ikhlas), then he stands and begins his sermon, then he descends and leads the people in prayer. Then he recites for them in the first rak‘ah Surah ‘al-Jumu‘ah’ and in the second (rak’ah) Surah ‘al-Munafiqun’.”
arabicText: عَلِيٌّ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلْجُمُعَةِ فَقَالَ« أَذَانٌ وَ إِقَامَةٌ يَخْرُجُ اَلْإِمَامُ بَعْدَ اَلْأَذَانِ فَيَصْعَدُ اَلْمِنْبَرَ فَيَخْطُبُ وَ لاَ يُصَلِّي اَلنَّاسُ مَادَامَ اَلْإِمَامُ عَلَى اَلْمِنْبَرِ ثُمَّ يَقْعُدُ اَلْإِمَامُ عَلَى اَلْمِنْبَرِ قَدْرَ مَا يَقْرَأُ« قُلْ هُوَ اَللّٰهُ أَحَدٌ» ثُمَّ يَقُومُ فَيَفْتَتِحُ خُطْبَتَهُ ثُمَّ يَنْزِلُ فَيُصَلِّي بِالنَّاسِ ثُمَّ يَقْرَأُ بِهِمْ فِي اَلرَّكْعَةِ اَلْأُولَى بِالْجُمُعَةِ وَ فِي اَلثَّانِيَةِ بِالْمُنَافِقِينَ»
thaqalaynSanad: Ali narrated from his father, from Hammad, from Hariz, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Imam (a.s) about the Friday prayer. Imam (a.s) said: “There is an adhan and an iqamah. The (just) imam comes out after the adhan and ascends the pulpit and delivers the sermon, and the people do not pray as long as the (just) imam is on the pulpit. Then the (just) imam sits on the pulpit for the duration it takes to recite ‘Qul huwa Allahu Ahad’ (Surah Ikhlas), then he stands and begins his sermon, then he descends and leads the people in prayer. Then he recites for them in the first rak‘ah Surah ‘al-Jumu‘ah’ and in the second (rak’ah) Surah ‘al-Munafiqun’.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 264

chapter: Chapter on the Deeds to Be Attained on Night of Friday and Its Day
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad narrated from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from al-Ala, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from one of the two Imams (a.s), peace be upon them:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said regarding a man who wants to recite Surah ‘al-Jumu‘ah’ on Friday, but recites ‘Qul huwa Allahu Ahad’ (Surah Ikhlas). Imam (a.s) said: “He should return to Surah al-Jumu‘ah.” (meaning it is preferred)
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ اَلْحَكَمِ عَنِ اَلْعَلاَءِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ أَحَدِهِمَا عَلَيْهِمَا اَلسَّلاَمُ: فِي اَلرَّجُلِ يُرِيدُ أَنْ يَقْرَأَ سُورَةَ اَلْجُمُعَةِ فِي اَلْجُمُعَةِ فَيَقْرَأُ قُلْ هُوَ اَللَّهُ أَحَدٌ قَالَ« يَرْجِعُ إِلَى سُورَةِ اَلْجُمُعَةِ»
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad narrated from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from al-Ala, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from one of the two Imams (a.s), peace be upon them:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said regarding a man who wants to recite Surah ‘al-Jumu‘ah’ on Friday, but recites ‘Qul huwa Allahu Ahad’ (Surah Ikhlas). Imam (a.s) said: “He should return to Surah al-Jumu‘ah.” (meaning it is preferred)

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 265

chapter: Chapter on the Deeds to Be Attained on Night of Friday and Its Day
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Saeed narrated from Fadalah, from Husayn, from Ibn Muskan, and Muhammad ibn Sinan from Ibn Muskan, from al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “If you begin your prayer with ‘Qul huwa Allahu Ahad’ (Surah Ikhlas) while you intended to recite something else, then proceed with it and do not go back except if it is on the day of Friday, then you return to Surah ‘al-Jumu‘ah’ and Surah ‘al-Munafiqun’ from it.”
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ حُسَيْنٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ مُسْكَانَ وَ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنِ اَلْحَلَبِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «إِذَا اِفْتَتَحْتَ صَلاَتَكَ بِ«قُلْ هُوَ اَللّٰهُ أَحَدٌ» وَ أَنْتَ تُرِيدُ أَنْ تَقْرَأَ بِغَيْرِهَا فَامْضِ فِيهَا وَ لاَ تَرْجِعْ إِلاَّ أَنْ تَكُونَ فِي يَوْمِ جُمُعَةٍ فَإِنَّكَ تَرْجِعُ إِلَى اَلْجُمُعَةِ وَ اَلْمُنَافِقِينَ مِنْهَا»
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Saeed narrated from Fadalah, from Husayn, from Ibn Muskan, and Muhammad ibn Sinan from Ibn Muskan, from al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “If you begin your prayer with ‘Qul huwa Allahu Ahad’ (Surah Ikhlas) while you intended to recite something else, then proceed with it and do not go back except if it is on the day of Friday, then you return to Surah ‘al-Jumu‘ah’ and Surah ‘al-Munafiqun’ from it.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 265

chapter: Chapter on the Deeds to Be Attained on Night of Friday and Its Day
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Safwan, from Abdillah ibn Bukayr, from Ubayd ibn Zurarah, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about a man who intended to recite a surah but began reciting another. Imam (a.s) said: “Then let him return to the first surah, except if he recites ‘Qul huwa Allahu Ahad’ (Surah Ikhlas)’” I asked: “A man performed the Friday prayer and intended to recite Surah ‘al-Jumu‘ah’ but recited ‘Qul huwa Allahu Ahad’ (Surah Ikhlas) instead. Imam (a.s) said: “He should return to Surah al-Jumu‘ah.”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ بُكَيْرٍ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ زُرَارَةَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ أَرَادَ أَنْ يَقْرَأَ فِي سُورَةٍ فَأَخَذَ فِي أُخْرَى قَالَ «فَلْيَرْجِعْ إِلَى اَلسُّورَةِ اَلْأُولَى إِلاَّ أَنْ يَقْرَأَ بِ«قُلْ هُوَ اَللّٰهُ أَحَدٌ»» قُلْتُ رَجُلٌ صَلَّى اَلْجُمُعَةَ فَأَرَادَ أَنْ يَقْرَأَ سُورَةَ اَلْجُمُعَةِ فَقَرَأَ« قُلْ هُوَ اَللّٰهُ أَحَدٌ» قَالَ« يَعُودُ إِلَى سُورَةِ اَلْجُمُعَةِ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Safwan, from Abdillah ibn Bukayr, from Ubayd ibn Zurarah, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about a man who intended to recite a surah but began reciting another. Imam (a.s) said: “Then let him return to the first surah, except if he recites ‘Qul huwa Allahu Ahad’ (Surah Ikhlas)’” I asked: “A man performed the Friday prayer and intended to recite Surah ‘al-Jumu‘ah’ but recited ‘Qul huwa Allahu Ahad’ (Surah Ikhlas) instead. Imam (a.s) said: “He should return to Surah al-Jumu‘ah.”

chapter: Chapter on the Deeds to Be Attained on Night of Friday and Its Day
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Safwan, from al-Ala, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from one of the two (Imams (a.s)):
Imam (a.s) said regarding a man who wants to recite Surah al-Jumu‘ah in the Friday prayer but recites ‘Qul huwa Allahu Ahad’ (Surah Ikhlas). Imam (a.s) said: “He should return to Surah al-Jumu‘ah.”
arabicText: وعنه عن صفوان عن العلا عن محمد بن مسلم عن أحدهما عليه السلام في الرجل يريد أن يقرأ في الجمعة بالجمعة فيقرأ بقل هو الله احد قال يرجع إلى سورة الجمعة
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Safwan, from al-Ala, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from one of the two (Imams (a.s)):
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said regarding a man who wants to recite Surah al-Jumu‘ah in the Friday prayer but recites ‘Qul huwa Allahu Ahad’ (Surah Ikhlas). Imam (a.s) said: “He should return to Surah al-Jumu‘ah.”

chapter: Chapter on the Deeds to Be Attained on Night of Friday and Its Day
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Sa’ad narrated from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Safwan, from Abdillah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
I (Abdillah ibn Sinan) heard Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) say: “In the Friday prayer, there is no harm in reciting other than Surah ‘al-Jumu‘ah’ and Surah ‘al-Munafiqun’, if you are in a hurry.”
arabicText: سَعْدٌ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ سَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ: «فِي صَلاَةِ اَلْجُمُعَةِ لاَ بَأْسَ أَنْ تَقْرَأَ فِيهَا بِغَيْرِ اَلْجُمُعَةِ وَ اَلْمُنَافِقِينَ إِذَا كُنْتَ مُسْتَعْجِلاً
thaqalaynSanad: Sa’ad narrated from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Safwan, from Abdillah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: I (Abdillah ibn Sinan) heard Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) say: “In the Friday prayer, there is no harm in reciting other than Surah ‘al-Jumu‘ah’ and Surah ‘al-Munafiqun’, if you are in a hurry.”

chapter: Chapter on the Deeds to Be Attained on Night of Friday and Its Day
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad narrated from Muawiyah ibn Hakeem, from Aban, from Yahya al-Azraq, the seller of al-Sabiri, who said:
I asked Abu al-Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him, and said: “A man performed the Friday prayer and recited ‘Sabbih isma rabbika’ (Surah Al A'la) and ‘Qul huwa Allahu Ahad’ (Surah Ikhlas). Imam (a.s) said: “It sufficed him.”
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ حُكَيْمٍ عَنْ أَبَانٍ عَنْ يَحْيَى اَلْأَزْرَقِ بَيَّاعِ اَلسَّابِرِيِّ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا اَلْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قُلْتُ رَجُلٌ صَلَّى اَلْجُمُعَةَ فَقَرَأَ« سَبِّحِ اِسْمَ رَبِّكَ» وَ« قُلْ هُوَ اَللّٰهُ أَحَدٌ» قَالَ« أَجْزَأَهُ»
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad narrated from Muawiyah ibn Hakeem, from Aban, from Yahya al-Azraq, the seller of al-Sabiri, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu al-Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him, and said: “A man performed the Friday prayer and recited ‘Sabbih isma rabbika’ (Surah Al A'la) and ‘Qul huwa Allahu Ahad’ (Surah Ikhlas). Imam (a.s) said: “It sufficed him.”

chapter: Chapter on the Deeds to Be Attained on Night of Friday and Its Day
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Saeed narrated from al-Hasan, from Zur’ah, from Sama’ah, who said:
Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: “It is befitting for the Imam who delivers the sermon to the people, on the day of Friday, to wear a turban in both winter and summer, and to drape himself with a Yemeni or Adani cloak. And he should deliver the sermon while standing, praising Allah (swt) and extolling Him (azj), then advising with the fear of Allah (swt), then reciting a surah from the Quran, then he sits. Then he stands and praises Allah (swt) and extols Him (azj), and sends blessings upon Muhammad (saws), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, and upon the Imams (a.s) of the Muslims, and seeks forgiveness for the believing men and believing women. When he finishes this, the mu’adhdhin stands and gives the iqamah, then he leads the people in two rak‘ahs, reciting in the first with Surah ‘al-Jumu‘ah’ and in the second (rak’ah) with Surah ‘al-Munafiqun’.
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ عَنْ زُرْعَةَ عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ:« يَنْبَغِي لِلْإِمَامِ اَلَّذِي يَخْطُبُ بِالنَّاسِ يَوْمَ اَلْجُمُعَةِ أَنْ يَلْبَسَ عِمَامَةً فِي اَلشِّتَاءِ وَ اَلصَّيْفِ وَ يَتَرَدَّى بِبُرْدٍ يَمَنِيَّةٍ أَوْ عَدَنِيٍّ وَ يَخْطُبُ وَ هُوَ قَائِمٌ يَحْمَدُ اَللَّهَ وَ يُثْنِي عَلَيْهِ ثُمَّ يُوصِي بِتَقْوَى اَللَّهِ ثُمَّ يَقْرَأُ سُورَةً مِنَ اَلْقُرْآنِ قَصِيرَةً ثُمَّ يَجْلِسُ ثُمَّ يَقُومُ فَيَحْمَدُ اَللَّهَ وَ يُثْنِي عَلَيْهِ وَ يُصَلِّي عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ وَ عَلَى أَئِمَّةِ اَلْمُسْلِمِينَ وَ يَسْتَغْفِرُ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَ اَلْمُؤْمِنَاتِ فَإِذَا فَرَغَ مِنْ هَذَا قَامَ اَلْمُؤَذِّنُ فَأَقَامَ فَصَلَّى بِالنَّاسِ رَكْعَتَيْنِ يَقْرَأُ فِي اَلْأُولَى بِسُورَةِ اَلْجُمُعَةِ وَفِي اَلثَّانِيَةِ بِسُورَةِ اَلْمُنَافِقِينَ»
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Saeed narrated from al-Hasan, from Zur’ah, from Sama’ah, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: “It is befitting for the Imam who delivers the sermon to the people, on the day of Friday, to wear a turban in both winter and summer, and to drape himself with a Yemeni or Adani cloak. And he should deliver the sermon while standing, praising Allah (swt) and extolling Him (azj), then advising with the fear of Allah (swt), then reciting a surah from the Quran, then he sits. Then he stands and praises Allah (swt) and extols Him (azj), and sends blessings upon Muhammad (saws), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, and upon the Imams (a.s) of the Muslims, and seeks forgiveness for the believing men and believing women. When he finishes this, the mu’adhdhin stands and gives the iqamah, then he leads the people in two rak‘ahs, reciting in the first with Surah ‘al-Jumu‘ah’ and in the second (rak’ah) with Surah ‘al-Munafiqun’.
