Imam al-Baqir (a.s) said: “Commander of the Faithful (a.s), peace be upon him, narrated from the Messenger of Allah (swt), blessings on him and his family, that He (saws) said: ‘Do not be in ‘al-'Aykal’.’” I asked: “And what is ‘al-'Aykal’?” Imam (a.s) said: “That you pray alone behind the rows. If it is not possible to join the row, and he stands parallel to the imam (of prayer), it suffices him. But if he opposes the row intentionally, his prayer is invalidated.”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ هَاشِمٍ عَنِ اَلنَّوْفَلِيِّ عَنِ اَلسَّكُونِيِّ عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَلَيْهِمَا اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ قَالَ أَمِيرُ اَلْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ:« لاَ تَكُونَنَّ فِي اَلْعَيْكَلِ» قُلْتُ وَ مَا اَلْعَيْكَلُ قَالَ« أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ خَلْفَ اَلصُّفُوفِ وَحْدَكَ فَإِنْ لَمْ يُمْكِنِ اَلدُّخُولُ فِي اَلصَّفِّ قَامَ حِذَاءَ اَلْإِمَامِ أَجْزَأَهُ فَإِنْ هُوَ عَانَدَ اَلصَّفَّ فَسَدَ عَلَيْهِ صَلاَتُهُ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Ibrahim ibn Hashim, from al-Nawfali, from al-Sakuni, from Imam Ja’far (a.s), from his father (a.s), peace be upon them both, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Baqir (a.s) said: “Commander of the Faithful (a.s), peace be upon him, narrated from the Messenger of Allah (swt), blessings on him and his family, that He (saws) said: ‘Do not be in ‘al-'Aykal’.’” I asked: “And what is ‘al-'Aykal’?” Imam (a.s) said: “That you pray alone behind the rows. If it is not possible to join the row, and he stands parallel to the imam (of prayer), it suffices him. But if he opposes the row intentionally, his prayer is invalidated.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 312

chapter: Chapter on the Virtue of Mosques and Prayer Within Them, and the Virtue of Congregational Prayer and Its Rulings
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him (a.s), from his father (a.s), from his forefathers (a.s), peace be upon them, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said that the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, said: “Align your rows evenly and level your shoulders with one another, so that Satan does not gain control over you.” (meaning spiritual control)
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ آبَائِهِ عَلَيْهِمُ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ:« سَوُّوا بَيْنَ صُفُوفِكُمْ وَ حَاذُوا بَيْنَ مَنَاكِبِكُمْ لاَ يَسْتَحْوِذُ عَلَيْكُمُ اَلشَّيْطَانُ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him (a.s), from his father (a.s), from his forefathers (a.s), peace be upon them, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said that the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, said: “Align your rows evenly and level your shoulders with one another, so that Satan does not gain control over you.” (meaning spiritual control)

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 312

chapter: Chapter on the Virtue of Mosques and Prayer Within Them, and the Virtue of Congregational Prayer and Its Rulings
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And it has been narrated from Ali ibn Muhammad and Muhammad ibn Ali al-Ridha (a.s), peace be upon him, that they both said:
Imam (a.s) said: “Whoever says that Allah (swt) has a body (‘bi al-jism’), do not give him from the zakat, and do not pray behind him.”
arabicText: وَرُوِيَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَمُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ اَلرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ أَنَّهُمَا قَالاَ:« مَنْ قَالَ بِالْجِسْمِ فَلاَ تُعْطُوهُ مِنَ اَلزَّكَاةِ وَ لاَ تُصَلُّوا وَرَاءَهُ»
thaqalaynSanad: And it has been narrated from Ali ibn Muhammad and Muhammad ibn Ali al-Ridha (a.s), peace be upon him, that they both said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: “Whoever says that Allah (swt) has a body (‘bi al-jism’), do not give him from the zakat, and do not pray behind him.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 313

chapter: Chapter on the Virtue of Mosques and Prayer Within Them, and the Virtue of Congregational Prayer and Its Rulings
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText: And Umar ibn Yazid asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about the narration which they transmit that ‘it is not proper to perform recommended prayers (al-tatawwu') at the time of an obligatory prayer’, What is the limit of this time? Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: "When the muqim (the one who gives the iqamah) begins the iqamah." So he (Umar ibn Yazid) asked Imam (a.s): “Indeed, people differ in the iqamah”. Imam (a.s) said: "The iqamah is that with which you pray along with them."
arabicText: وَ سَأَلَ عُمَرُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: عَنِ اَلرِّوَايَةِ اَلَّتِي يَرْوُونَ أَنَّهُ لاَ يَنْبَغِي أَنْ يُتَطَوَّعَ فِي وَقْتِ فَرِيضَةٍ مَا حَدُّ هَذَا اَلْوَقْتِ قَالَ« إِذَا أَخَذَ اَلْمُقِيمُ فِي اَلْإِقَامَةِ» فَقَالَ لَهُ إِنَّ اَلنَّاسَ يَخْتَلِفُونَ فِي اَلْإِقَامَةِ قَالَ« اَلْإِقَامَةُ اَلَّذِي تُصَلِّي مَعَهُمْ»
thaqalaynMatn: And Umar ibn Yazid asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about the narration which they transmit that ‘it is not proper to perform recommended prayers (al-tatawwu') at the time of an obligatory prayer’, What is the limit of this time? Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: "When the muqim (the one who gives the iqamah) begins the iqamah." So he (Umar ibn Yazid) asked Imam (a.s): “Indeed, people differ in the iqamah”. Imam (a.s) said: "The iqamah is that with which you pray along with them."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 313

chapter: Chapter on the Virtue of Mosques and Prayer Within Them, and the Virtue of Congregational Prayer and Its Rulings
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText: And Ali ibn Ja’far asked his brother Imam Musa ibn Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon them both, about a man who is behind an imam (of prayer) and the imam (of prayer) prolongs the tashahhud. However, the man is overcome by the need to urinate, or fears something might be missed, or some pain arises, what should he do? Imam (a.s) said: “He should say the taslim and leave, and leave the imam (of prayer).”
arabicText: وَ سَأَلَ عَلِيُّ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ أَخَاهُ مُوسَى بْنَ جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِمَا اَلسَّلاَمُ: عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يَكُونُ خَلْفَ إِمَامٍ فَيُطَوِّلُ فِي اَلتَّشَهُّدِ فَيَأْخُذُهُ اَلْبَوْلُ أَوْ يَخَافُ عَلَى شَيْءٍ أَنْ يَفُوتَ أَوْ يَعْرِضُ لَهُ وَجَعٌ كَيْفَ يَصْنَعُ قَالَ« يُسَلِّمُ وَ يَنْصَرِفُ وَيَدَعُ اَلْإِمَامَ»
thaqalaynMatn: And Ali ibn Ja’far asked his brother Imam Musa ibn Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon them both, about a man who is behind an imam (of prayer) and the imam (of prayer) prolongs the tashahhud. However, the man is overcome by the need to urinate, or fears something might be missed, or some pain arises, what should he do? Imam (a.s) said: “He should say the taslim and leave, and leave the imam (of prayer).”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 313

chapter: Chapter on the Virtue of Mosques and Prayer Within Them, and the Virtue of Congregational Prayer and Its Rulings
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText: And he (Ali ibn Ja’far) also asked Imam Musa ibn Ja’far (a.s), about an imam (of prayer) who invalidated his ablution and withdrew without appointing anyone. What is the condition of the people? Imam (a.s) said: “There is no prayer for them without an imam (of prayer). So let one of them step forward and complete for them what remains of the prayer, and their prayer will be complete.”
arabicText: وَسَأَلَهُ أَيْضاً عَنْ إِمَامٍ أَحْدَثَ فَانْصَرَفَ وَلَمْ يُقَدِّمْ أَحَداً مَا حَالُ اَلْقَوْمِ قَالَ« لاَ صَلاَةَ لَهُمْ إِلاَّ بِإِمَامٍ فَلْيَتَقَدَّمْ بَعْضُهُمْ فَلْيُتِمَّ بِهِمْ مَا بَقِيَ مِنْهَا وَ قَدْ تَمَّتْ صَلاَتُهُمْ»
thaqalaynMatn: And he (Ali ibn Ja’far) also asked Imam Musa ibn Ja’far (a.s), about an imam (of prayer) who invalidated his ablution and withdrew without appointing anyone. What is the condition of the people? Imam (a.s) said: “There is no prayer for them without an imam (of prayer). So let one of them step forward and complete for them what remains of the prayer, and their prayer will be complete.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 313

chapter: Chapter on the Virtue of Mosques and Prayer Within Them, and the Virtue of Congregational Prayer and Its Rulings
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Mas'ud from Muhammad ibn Nusayr from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from Ja’far ibn Bashir from Hisham ibn Salim from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
I heard Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) say: “When the imam (of prayer) finishes and turns away, no one should pray in his place until he has turned away from his position.”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مَسْعُودٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ نُصَيْرٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ بَشِيرٍ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ سَالِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ سَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ:« إِذَا اِنْصَرَفَ اَلْإِمَامُ فَلاَ يُصَلِّي فِي مَقَامِهِ حَتَّى يَنْحَرِفَ عَنْ مَقَامِهِ ذَلِكَ»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Mas'ud from Muhammad ibn Nusayr from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from Ja’far ibn Bashir from Hisham ibn Salim from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I heard Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) say: “When the imam (of prayer) finishes and turns away, no one should pray in his place until he has turned away from his position.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 313

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer of the Two Eids
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from al-Abbas ibn Ma'ruf from Hammad ibn Isa from Hariz from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:
Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: “It is necessary to wear the turban and the cloak on the Day of al-Adha and al-Fitr. As for Friday, it is sufficient without a turban and a cloak.”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنِ اَلْعَبَّاسِ بْنِ مَعْرُوفٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ:« لاَ بُدَّ مِنَ اَلْعِمَامَةِ وَ اَلْبُرْدِ يَوْمَ اَلْأَضْحَى وَ اَلْفِطْرِ فَأَمَّا اَلْجُمُعَةُ فَإِنَّهَا تُجْزِي بِغَيْرِ عِمَامَةٍ وَ بُرْدٍ»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from al-Abbas ibn Ma'ruf from Hammad ibn Isa from Hariz from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: “It is necessary to wear the turban and the cloak on the Day of al-Adha and al-Fitr. As for Friday, it is sufficient without a turban and a cloak.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 314

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer of the Two Eids
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from al-Abbas, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Rib'i, from al-Fudayl, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “A prayer mat (khumrah) was brought to my father (a.s), peace be upon him, on the Day of al-Fitr, and He (a.s) ordered it to be returned. Then He (Imam al-Baqir (a.s)) said: “This is a day on which the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, loved to look toward the horizons of the sky and place his forehead on the earth.”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنِ اَلْعَبَّاسِ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ رِبْعِيٍّ عَنِ اَلْفُضَيْلِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« أُتِيَ أَبِي عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ بِخُمْرَةٍ يَوْمَ اَلْفِطْرِ فَأَمَرَ بِرَدِّهَا فَقَالَ« هَذَا يَوْمٌ كَانَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ يُحِبُّ أَنْ يَنْظُرَ فِيهِ إِلَى آفَاقِ اَلسَّمَاءِ وَ يَضَعَ جَبْهَتَهُ عَلَى اَلْأَرْضِ»»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from al-Abbas, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Rib'i, from al-Fudayl, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “A prayer mat (khumrah) was brought to my father (a.s), peace be upon him, on the Day of al-Fitr, and He (a.s) ordered it to be returned. Then He (Imam al-Baqir (a.s)) said: “This is a day on which the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, loved to look toward the horizons of the sky and place his forehead on the earth.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 314

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer of the Two Eids
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Yaqub ibn Yazid, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hisham ibn al-Hakam, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said regarding the prayer of the two Eids. Imam (a.s) said: “You connect the recitation with the recitation,” And Imam (a.s) said: “You begin with the takbir in the first (rak‘ah), then you recite, then you bow with the seventh (takbir).”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ اَلْحَكَمِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: فِي صَلاَةِ اَلْعِيدَيْنِ قَالَ« تَصِلُ اَلْقِرَاءَةَ بِالْقِرَاءَةِ» وَ قَالَ« تَبْدَأُ بِالتَّكْبِيرِ فِي اَلْأُولَى ثُمَّ تَقْرَأُ ثُمَّ تَرْكَعُ بِالسَّابِعَةِ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Yaqub ibn Yazid, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hisham ibn al-Hakam, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said regarding the prayer of the two Eids. Imam (a.s) said: “You connect the recitation with the recitation,” And Imam (a.s) said: “You begin with the takbir in the first (rak‘ah), then you recite, then you bow with the seventh (takbir).”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 314

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer of the Two Eids
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Ibn Abi Umayr from Hisham ibn al-Hakam from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, and Hammad ibn Uthman from Ubaydullah al-Halabi from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: The same.
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ اَلْحَكَمِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ وَ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اَللَّهِ اَلْحَلَبِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: مِثْلَهُ.
thaqalaynMatn: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Ibn Abi Umayr from Hisham ibn al-Hakam from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, and Hammad ibn Uthman from Ubaydullah al-Halabi from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: The same.

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 314

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer of the Two Eids
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from al-Abbas from Abdullah ibn al-Mughirah from Mu'awiyah ibn Ammar from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “The Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, used to go out until He (saws) looked at the horizons of the sky,” And Imam (a.s) said: “On that day, no one should pray upon a mat or a reed mat (bariyyah).”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنِ اَلْعَبَّاسِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ اَلْمُغِيرَةِ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ :«أَنَّ رَسُولَ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ كَانَ يَخْرُجُ حَتَّى يَنْظُرَ إِلَى آفَاقِ اَلسَّمَاءِ» وَ قَالَ« لاَ يُصَلَّيَنَّ يَوْمَئِذٍ عَلَى بِسَاطٍ وَ لاَ بَارِيَةٍ»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from al-Abbas from Abdullah ibn al-Mughirah from Mu'awiyah ibn Ammar from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “The Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, used to go out until He (saws) looked at the horizons of the sky,” And Imam (a.s) said: “On that day, no one should pray upon a mat or a reed mat (bariyyah).”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 314

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer of the Two Eids
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ali, from Amr ibn Sa'id, from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah, from Ammar al-Sabati, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about a man who forgets to perform the ghusl on the Day of Eid, until after he has prayed. Imam (a.s) said: “If it is still within the time, then he must perform the ghusl and repeat the prayer; but if the time has passed, then his prayer is valid.”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُصَدِّقِ بْنِ صَدَقَةَ عَنْ عَمَّارٍ اَلسَّابَاطِيِّ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يَنْسَى أَنْ يَغْتَسِلَ يَوْمَ اَلْعِيدِ حَتَّى صَلَّى قَالَ« إِنْ كَانَ فِي وَقْتٍ فَعَلَيْهِ أَنْ يَغْتَسِلَ وَ يُعِيدَ اَلصَّلاَةَ وَ إِنْ مَضَى اَلْوَقْتُ فَقَدْ جَازَتْ صَلاَتُهُ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ali, from Amr ibn Sa'id, from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah, from Ammar al-Sabati, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about a man who forgets to perform the ghusl on the Day of Eid, until after he has prayed. Imam (a.s) said: “If it is still within the time, then he must perform the ghusl and repeat the prayer; but if the time has passed, then his prayer is valid.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 315

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer of the Two Eids
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Muhammad ibn Khalid al-Tamimi, from Sayf ibn Umayrah, from Ishaq ibn Ammar, who said: Ibn Qays narrated to me from Ja’far ibn Muhammad, peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “Indeed, the prayer on the two Eid days is only upon the one who goes out to the open prayer ground (al-jabbana), and whoever does not go out, there is no prayer upon him.”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ اَلتَّمِيمِيِّ عَنْ سَيْفِ بْنِ عَمِيرَةَ عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي اِبْنُ قَيْسٍ عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« إِنَّمَا اَلصَّلاَةُ يَوْمَ اَلْعِيدَيْنِ عَلَى مَنْ خَرَجَ إِلَى اَلْجَبَّانَةِ وَمَنْ لَمْ يَخْرُجْ فَلَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ صَلاَةٌ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Muhammad ibn Khalid al-Tamimi, from Sayf ibn Umayrah, from Ishaq ibn Ammar, who said: Ibn Qays narrated to me from Ja’far ibn Muhammad, peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “Indeed, the prayer on the two Eid days is only upon the one who goes out to the open prayer ground (al-jabbana), and whoever does not go out, there is no prayer upon him.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 315

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer of the Two Eids
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Mahbub, from Abdurrahman ibn Sayabah, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “Indeed, it is upon the (just) imam to bring out those imprisoned for debt on Fridays to the Friday prayer, and on the Day of Eid, to the Eid prayer, and to send someone with them. Then, when they have completed the prayer and the Eid, he should return them to the prison.”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَلرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ سَيَابَةَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« إِنَّ عَلَى اَلْإِمَامِ أَنْ يُخْرِجَ اَلْمُحْبَسِينَ فِي اَلدَّيْنِ يَوْمَ اَلْجُمُعَةِ إِلَى اَلْجُمُعَةِ وَ يَوْمَ اَلْعِيدِ إِلَى اَلْعِيدِ وَ يُرْسِلَ مَعَهُمْ فَإِذَا قَضَوُا اَلصَّلاَةَ وَ اَلْعِيدَ رَدَّهُمْ إِلَى اَلسِّجْنِ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Mahbub, from Abdurrahman ibn Sayabah, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “Indeed, it is upon the (just) imam to bring out those imprisoned for debt on Fridays to the Friday prayer, and on the Day of Eid, to the Eid prayer, and to send someone with them. Then, when they have completed the prayer and the Eid, he should return them to the prison.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 315

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer of the Two Eids
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Abi Najran, from Asim ibn Humayd, from Abu Basir, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “If you intend to depart on the day of Eid, and dawn breaks while you are still in the town, then do not leave until you attend that Eid.”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي نَجْرَانَ عَنْ عَاصِمِ بْنِ حُمَيْدٍ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« إِذَا أَرَدْتَ اَلشُّخُوصَ فِي يَوْمِ عِيدٍ فَانْفَجَرَ اَلصُّبْحُ وَ أَنْتَ بِالْبَلَدِ فَلاَ تَخْرُجْ حَتَّى تَشْهَدَ ذَلِكَ اَلْعِيدَ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Abi Najran, from Asim ibn Humayd, from Abu Basir, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “If you intend to depart on the day of Eid, and dawn breaks while you are still in the town, then do not leave until you attend that Eid.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 315

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer of the Two Eids
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Yazid ibn Ishaq Sha'ir, from Harun ibn Hamzah al-Ghanawi, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) about the takbir in al-Fitr and al-Adha. Imam (a.s) said: “Five and four, so it does not harm you if you finish with an odd number.”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ شَعِرٍ عَنْ هَارُونَ بْنِ حَمْزَةَ اَلْغَنَوِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلتَّكْبِيرِ فِي اَلْفِطْرِ وَ اَلْأَضْحَى فَقَالَ« خَمْسٌ وَ أَرْبَعٌ فَلاَ يَضُرُّكَ إِذَا اِنْصَرَفْتَ عَلَى وَتْرٍ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Yazid ibn Ishaq Sha'ir, from Harun ibn Hamzah al-Ghanawi, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) about the takbir in al-Fitr and al-Adha. Imam (a.s) said: “Five and four, so it does not harm you if you finish with an odd number.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 315

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer of the Two Eids
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Muhammad ibn Abdullah, from Zurarah, from Isa ibn Abdullah, from his father, from his grandfather, from Imam Ali (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam Ali (a.s) said: “The Prophet (saws), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, would not say more than one takbir in the two Eids until the tongue of Imam al-Husayn (a.s), peace be upon him, was delayed in speech. Then, on one Eid day, his mother (Sayyidah Fatima (s.a)), peace be upon her, dressed him (Imam al-Husayn (a.s)) and sent him with his grandfather (saws). So the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, pronounced the takbir, and Imam al-Husayn (a.s), peace be upon him, also pronounced the takbir when the Prophet (saws), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, (had said it) seven times. Then He (saws) stood for the second unit, and the Prophet (saws), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, pronounced the takbir, and Imam al-Husayn (a.s), peace be upon him, also pronounced the takbir when He (saws) (had said it) five times. So thus Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, made it a sunnah, and the sunnah has remained established until today.”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ عِيسَى بْنِ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ جَدِّهِ عَنْ عَلِيٍّ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« مَا كَانَ يُكَبِّرُ اَلنَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ فِي اَلْعِيدَيْنِ إِلاَّ تَكْبِيرَةً وَاحِدَةً حَتَّى أَبْطَأَ عَلَيْهِ لِسَانُ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ فَلَمَّا كَانَ ذَاتُ يَوْمِ عِيدٍ أَلْبَسَتْهُ أُمُّهُ عَلَيْهَا اَلسَّلاَمُ وَ أَرْسَلَتْهُ مَعَ جَدِّهِ فَكَبَّرَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ فَكَبَّرَ اَلْحُسَيْنُ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ حِينَ كَبَّرَ اَلنَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ سَبْعاً ثُمَّ قَامَ فِي اَلثَّانِيَةِ فَكَبَّرَ اَلنَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ وَ كَبَّرَ اَلْحُسَيْنُ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ حِينَ كَبَّرَ خَمْساً فَجَعَلَهَا رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ سُنَّةً وَ ثَبَتَتِ اَلسُّنَّةُ إِلَى اَلْيَوْمِ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Muhammad ibn Abdullah, from Zurarah, from Isa ibn Abdullah, from his father, from his grandfather, from Imam Ali (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam Ali (a.s) said: “The Prophet (saws), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, would not say more than one takbir in the two Eids until the tongue of Imam al-Husayn (a.s), peace be upon him, was delayed in speech. Then, on one Eid day, his mother (Sayyidah Fatima (s.a)), peace be upon her, dressed him (Imam al-Husayn (a.s)) and sent him with his grandfather (saws). So the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, pronounced the takbir, and Imam al-Husayn (a.s), peace be upon him, also pronounced the takbir when the Prophet (saws), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, (had said it) seven times. Then He (saws) stood for the second unit, and the Prophet (saws), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, pronounced the takbir, and Imam al-Husayn (a.s), peace be upon him, also pronounced the takbir when He (saws) (had said it) five times. So thus Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, made it a sunnah, and the sunnah has remained established until today.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 316

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer of the Two Eids
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from al-Abbas, from Abdurrahman ibn Hammad, from Bashir ibn Sa'id, from Abu Abdillah (a.s):
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “You say in the supplication of the two Eids between every two takbirs: ‘Allah (swt) is my Lord (azj) forever, and Islam is my religion forever, and (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) is my Prophet forever, and the Quran is my Book forever, and the Ka'bah is my Qiblah forever, and Imam Ali (a.s) is my Guardian (waliyy) forever, and the Successors (awsiya) are my Imams (a.s) forever and you name them (the Imams (a.s)) until the last of them and none is to be worshipped except Allah (swt)’.”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنِ اَلْعَبَّاسِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَلرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ بَشِيرِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« تَقُولُ فِي دُعَاءِ اَلْعِيدَيْنِ بَيْنَ كُلِّ تَكْبِيرَتَيْنِ اَللَّهُ رَبِّي أَبَداً وَ اَلْإِسْلاَمُ دِينِي أَبَداً وَ مُحَمَّدٌ نَبِيِّي أَبَداً وَ اَلْقُرْآنُ كِتَابِي أَبَداً وَ اَلْكَعْبَةُ قِبْلَتِي أَبَداً وَ عَلِيٌّ وَلِيِّي أَبَداً وَ اَلْأَ وْصِيَاءُ أَئِمَّتِي أَبَداً وَ تُسَمِّيهِمْ إِلَى آخِرِهِمْ وَلاَ أَحَدَ إِلاَّ اَللَّهُ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from al-Abbas, from Abdurrahman ibn Hammad, from Bashir ibn Sa'id, from Abu Abdillah (a.s):
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “You say in the supplication of the two Eids between every two takbirs: ‘Allah (swt) is my Lord (azj) forever, and Islam is my religion forever, and (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) is my Prophet forever, and the Quran is my Book forever, and the Ka'bah is my Qiblah forever, and Imam Ali (a.s) is my Guardian (waliyy) forever, and the Successors (awsiya) are my Imams (a.s) forever and you name them (the Imams (a.s)) until the last of them and none is to be worshipped except Allah (swt)’.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 316

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer of the Two Eids
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Muhammad ibn Isa from Yunus from al-Ala ibn Razin from Muhammad:
I asked Imam (a.s) about a man who missed a rak‘ah with the imam (of prayer) from the prayer during the ‘Days of Tashriq’. (meaning 11th, 12th, and 13th of Dhul Hijjah) Imam (a.s) said: “He completes the prayer and pronounces the takbir.”
arabicText: عَلِيُّ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ يُونُسَ عَنِ اَلْعَلاَءِ بْنِ رَزِينٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ فَاتَتْهُ رَكْعَةٌ مَعَ اَلْإِمَامِ مِنَ اَلصَّلاَةِ أَيَّامَ اَلتَّشْرِيقِ قَالَ« يُتِمُّ اَلصَّلاَةَ وَ يُكَبِّرُ
thaqalaynSanad: Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Muhammad ibn Isa from Yunus from al-Ala ibn Razin from Muhammad:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Imam (a.s) about a man who missed a rak‘ah with the imam (of prayer) from the prayer during the ‘Days of Tashriq’. (meaning 11th, 12th, and 13th of Dhul Hijjah) Imam (a.s) said: “He completes the prayer and pronounces the takbir.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 317

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer of the Two Eids
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Fadalah from Abdullah ibn Sinan, who said:
The Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, only granted permission to the young unmarried women (al-‘awatiq), to go out on the two Eids for the purpose of seeking provision (al-tarudd lil-rizq).
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ قَالَ: إِنَّمَا رَخَّصَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ لِلنِّسَاءِ اَلْعَوَاتِقِ فِي اَلْخُرُوجِ فِي اَلْعِيدَيْنِ لِلتَّعَرُّضِ لِلرِّزْقِ
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Fadalah from Abdullah ibn Sinan, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: The Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, only granted permission to the young unmarried women (al-‘awatiq), to go out on the two Eids for the purpose of seeking provision (al-tarudd lil-rizq).

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 317

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer of the Two Eids
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from al-Hasan, from Zur’ah, from Sama’ah, who said:
I asked him about going early to the prayer ground on the Day of Fitr and Day of Adha. He said: “After sunrise.”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ عَنْ زُرْعَةَ عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلْغُدُوِّ إِلَى اَلْمُصَلَّى فِي اَلْفِطْرِ وَ اَلْأَضْحَى فَقَالَ« بَعْدَ طُلُوعِ اَلشَّمْسِ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from al-Hasan, from Zur’ah, from Sama’ah, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked him about going early to the prayer ground on the Day of Fitr and Day of Adha. He said: “After sunrise.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 317

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer of the Two Eids
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Safwan, from Al-Alaa, from Muhammad, from one of the two Imams (a.s), peace be upon them:
Imam (a.s) was asked regarding the prayer of the two Eids. Imam (a.s) said: “The prayer is before the two sermons, and the takbir is after the recitation; seven (takbir) in the first and five (takbir) in the last. The first to innovate placing the sermon before (the prayer) was Uthman (third oppressor), when he introduced his innovations. When Uthman finished the prayer, the people would stand up to leave. When Uthman saw that, he brought the two sermons forward and ‘detained’ the people for the prayer.”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنِ اَلْعَلاَءِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَحَدِهِمَا عَلَيْهِمَا اَلسَّلاَمُ: فِي صَلاَةِ اَلْعِيدَيْنِ قَالَ« اَلصَّلاَةُ قَبْلَ اَلْخُطْبَتَيْنِ وَاَلتَّكْبِيرُ بَعْدَ اَلْقِرَاءَةِ سَبْعٌ فِي اَلْأُولَى وَخَمْسٌ فِي اَلْأَخِيرَةِ وَكَانَ أَوَّلَ مَنْ أَحْدَثَهَا بَعْدَ اَلْخُطْبَةِ عُثْمَانُ لَمَّا أَحْدَثَ أَحْدَاثَهُ كَانَ إِذَا فَرَغَ مِنَ اَلصَّلاَةِ قَامَ اَلنَّاسُ لِيَرْجِعُوا فَلَمَّا رَأَى ذَلِكَ قَدَّمَ اَلْخُطْبَتَيْنِ وَ اِحْتَبَسَ اَلنَّاسُ لِلصَّلاَةِ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Safwan, from Al-Alaa, from Muhammad, from one of the two Imams (a.s), peace be upon them:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) was asked regarding the prayer of the two Eids. Imam (a.s) said: “The prayer is before the two sermons, and the takbir is after the recitation; seven (takbir) in the first and five (takbir) in the last. The first to innovate placing the sermon before (the prayer) was Uthman (third oppressor), when he introduced his innovations. When Uthman finished the prayer, the people would stand up to leave. When Uthman saw that, he brought the two sermons forward and ‘detained’ the people for the prayer.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 317

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer of the Two Eids
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Uthman ibn Isa, from Sama'ah, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
I said to Imam al-Sadiq (a.s): “When is the sacrifice to be slaughtered?” Imam (a.s) said: “When the (just) imam has finished (the Eid prayer and turned away).” I asked: “What if I am in a land where there is no (just) imam, and I lead them in prayer in congregation?” Imam (a.s) said: “(Do sacrifice) When the sun has risen fully (when it has ascended).” And Imam (a.s) said: “There is no harm in you praying alone, but there is no (valid) prayer except with an (just) imam.”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لَهُ مَتَى يُذْبَحُ قَالَ« إِذَا اِنْصَرَفَ اَلْإِمَامُ» قُلْتُ فَإِذَا كُنْتُ فِي أَرْضٍ لَيْسَ فِيهَا إِمَامٌ فَأُصَلِّي بِهِمْ جَمَاعَةً فَقَالَ« إِذَا اِسْتَقَلَّتِ اَلشَّمْسُ» وَقَالَ« لاَ بَأْسَ بِأَنْ تُصَلِّيَ وَحْدَكَ وَ لاَ صَلاَةَ إِلاَّ مَعَ إِمَامٍ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Uthman ibn Isa, from Sama'ah, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I said to Imam al-Sadiq (a.s): “When is the sacrifice to be slaughtered?” Imam (a.s) said: “When the (just) imam has finished (the Eid prayer and turned away).” I asked: “What if I am in a land where there is no (just) imam, and I lead them in prayer in congregation?” Imam (a.s) said: “(Do sacrifice) When the sun has risen fully (when it has ascended).” And Imam (a.s) said: “There is no harm in you praying alone, but there is no (valid) prayer except with an (just) imam.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 317

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer of the Two Eids
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Sa’ad, from Ahmad, from Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Fadalah, from Aban, from Zurarah, from one of the two Imams (a.s), peace be upon them, who said:
Imam (a.s) said: “Indeed, the prayer of the two Eids is only upon the resident (not the traveller), and there is no (valid) prayer except with an (just) imam.”
arabicText: سَعْدٌ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ أَبَانٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَحَدِهِمَا عَلَيْهِمَا اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« إِنَّمَا صَلاَةُ اَلْعِيدَيْنِ عَلَى اَلْمُقِيمِ وَ لاَ صَلاَةَ إِلاَّ بِإِمَامٍ»
thaqalaynSanad: Sa’ad, from Ahmad, from Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Fadalah, from Aban, from Zurarah, from one of the two Imams (a.s), peace be upon them, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: “Indeed, the prayer of the two Eids is only upon the resident (not the traveller), and there is no (valid) prayer except with an (just) imam.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 318

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer of the Two Eids
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn, from Ja’far ibn Bashir, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from one of the two Imams (a.s), peace be upon them, who said:
I asked Imam (a.s) about the speech that is said between the two takbirs, in the two Eids. Imam (a.s) said: “Whatever good speech you wish (to say).”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ بَشِيرٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ أَحَدِهِمَا عَلَيْهِمَا اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلْكَلاَمِ اَلَّذِي يُتَكَلَّمُ بِهِ فِيمَا بَيْنَ اَلتَّكْبِيرَتَيْنِ فِي اَلْعِيدَيْنِ فَقَالَ« مَا شِئْتَ مِنَ اَلْكَلاَمِ اَلْحَسَنِ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn, from Ja’far ibn Bashir, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from one of the two Imams (a.s), peace be upon them, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Imam (a.s) about the speech that is said between the two takbirs, in the two Eids. Imam (a.s) said: “Whatever good speech you wish (to say).”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 318

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer of the Two Eids
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn, from Yazid ibn Ishaq Sha’ir, from Harun ibn Hamzah al-Ghanawi, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “Going out on the day of Fitr and Adha to the open space (al-jabbana) is good for whoever is able to go out to it.” So I asked: “What do you say if he is sick and not able to go out, should he pray in his house?” Imam (a.s) said, “No.”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ شَعِرٍ عَنْ هَارُونَ بْنِ حَمْزَةَ اَلْغَنَوِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« اَلْخُرُوجُ يَوْمَ اَلْفِطْرِ وَاَلْأَضْحَى إِلَى اَلْجَبَّانَةِ حَسَنٌ لِمَنِ اِسْتَطَاعَ اَلْخُرُوجَ إِلَيْهَا» فَقُلْتُ أَرَأَيْتَ إِنْ كَانَ مَرِيضاً لاَ يَسْتَطِيعُ أَنْ يَخْرُجَ أَ يُصَلِّي فِي بَيْتِهِ قَالَ« لاَ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn, from Yazid ibn Ishaq Sha’ir, from Harun ibn Hamzah al-Ghanawi, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “Going out on the day of Fitr and Adha to the open space (al-jabbana) is good for whoever is able to go out to it.” So I asked: “What do you say if he is sick and not able to go out, should he pray in his house?” Imam (a.s) said, “No.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 318

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer of the Two Eids
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Mansur ibn Hazim, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “My father (Imam al-Baqir (a.s)), peace be upon him, became ill on the day of Adha, so He (a.s) prayed two rak‘ahs in his house, then offered the sacrifice.”
arabicText: منصور بن حازم عن ابي عبد الله عليه السلام قال مرض ابي عليه السلام يوم الاضحى فصلى في بيته ركعتين ثم ضحى
thaqalaynSanad: Mansur ibn Hazim, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “My father (Imam al-Baqir (a.s)), peace be upon him, became ill on the day of Adha, so He (a.s) prayed two rak‘ahs in his house, then offered the sacrifice.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 318

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer of the Two Eids
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn Ahmad ibn Ashyam, from Yunus, who said:
I asked him about the takbir in the two Eids, should he raise his hands with each takbir, or is it sufficient that he raises (them) with the first takbir? He said: “He should raise (his hands) with each takbir.”
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ أَشْيَمَ عَنْ يُونُسَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ تَكْبِيرِ اَلْعِيدَيْنِ أَ يَرْفَعُ يَدَهُ مَعَ كُلِّ تَكْبِيرَةٍ أَمْ يُجْزِيهِ أَنْ يَرْفَعَ فِي أَوَّلِ اَلتَّكْبِيرَةِ فَقَالَ« يَرْفَعُ مَعَ كُلِّ تَكْبِيرَةٍ»
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn Ahmad ibn Ashyam, from Yunus, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked him about the takbir in the two Eids, should he raise his hands with each takbir, or is it sufficient that he raises (them) with the first takbir? He said: “He should raise (his hands) with each takbir.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 318

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer of the Two Eids
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Sa’ad ibn Sa’ad al-Ash'ari, from Abu al-Hasan al-Ridha (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Imam al-Ridha (a.s) about the traveller to Mecca or elsewhere, does he have to perform the prayer of the two Eids; al-Fitr and al-Adha? Imam (a.s) said: “Yes, except in Mina on the ‘Day of Sacrifice’ (Yawm al-Nahr).”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ اَلْأَشْعَرِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي اَلْحَسَنِ اَلرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلْمُسَافِرِ إِلَى مَكَّةَ وَ غَيْرِهَا هَلْ عَلَيْهِ صَلاَةُ اَلْعِيدَيْنِ اَلْفِطْرِ وَ اَلْأَضْحَى فَقَالَ« نَعَمْ إِلاَّ بِمِنًى يَوْمَ اَلنَّحْرِ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Sa’ad ibn Sa’ad al-Ash'ari, from Abu al-Hasan al-Ridha (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Imam al-Ridha (a.s) about the traveller to Mecca or elsewhere, does he have to perform the prayer of the two Eids; al-Fitr and al-Adha? Imam (a.s) said: “Yes, except in Mina on the ‘Day of Sacrifice’ (Yawm al-Nahr).”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 319

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer of the Two Eids
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Hammad ibn Uthman and Khalaf ibn Hammad, from Rub'i ibn Abdillah and Al-Fudayl ibn Yasar, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “There is no (prayer of) Jumu'ah, nor Fitr, nor Adha in travel.”
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ وَ خَلَفِ بْنِ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ رِبْعِيِّ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ وَ اَلْفُضَيْلِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« لَيْسَ فِي اَلسَّفَرِ جُمُعَةٌ وَ لاَ فِطْرٌ وَ لاَ أَضْحًى»
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Hammad ibn Uthman and Khalaf ibn Hammad, from Rub'i ibn Abdillah and Al-Fudayl ibn Yasar, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “There is no (prayer of) Jumu'ah, nor Fitr, nor Adha in travel.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 319

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer of the Two Eids
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Abu Ja’far, from his father, from Hafs ibn Ghiyath, from his father, from Imam Ali (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam Ali (a.s) said: “It is upon men and women to perform the takbir during the ‘Days of Tashriq’ after the prayers, and (this applies) to the one who prays alone and the one who performs voluntary (nawafil) prayers.”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ حَفْصِ بْنِ غِيَاثٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَلِيٍّ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ قَالَ: «عَلَى اَلرِّجَالِ وَ اَلنِّسَاءِ أَنْ يُكَبِّرُوا أَيَّامَ اَلتَّشْرِيقِ فِي دُبُرِ اَلصَّلَوَاتِ وَ عَلَى مَنْ صَلَّى وَحْدَهُ وَ مَنْ صَلَّى تَطَوُّعاً»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Abu Ja’far, from his father, from Hafs ibn Ghiyath, from his father, from Imam Ali (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam Ali (a.s) said: “It is upon men and women to perform the takbir during the ‘Days of Tashriq’ after the prayers, and (this applies) to the one who prays alone and the one who performs voluntary (nawafil) prayers.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 319

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer of the Two Eids
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Al-Abbas ibn Ma'ruf, from Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Hanan ibn Sadir, from Abdillah ibn Dhubyan, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Baqir (a.s) said: “O Abdillah, there is no day of Eid for the Muslims; neither ‘Adha’ nor ‘Fitr’, except that Allah (swt) renews for the family of (Prophet) Muhammad (saws), peace be upon them, sorrow on that day.” He (Abdillah ibn Dhubyan) said: “I asked, ‘And why is that?’” Imam (a.s) said: “Because they see their right in the hands of others.”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنِ اَلْعَبَّاسِ بْنِ مَعْرُوفٍ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ حَنَانِ بْنِ سَدِيرٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ ذُبْيَانَ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: قَالَ:« يَا عَبْدَ اَللَّهِ مَا مِنْ يَوْمِ عِيدٍ لِلْمُسْلِمِينَ أَضْحًى وَ لاَ فِطْرٍ إِلاَّ وَهُوَ يُجَدِّدُ اَللَّهُ لآِلِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَلَيْهِمُ اَلسَّلاَمُ فِيهِ حُزْناً» قَالَ قُلْتُ وَ لِمَ ذَلِكَ قَالَ «إِنَّهُمْ يَرَوْنَ حَقَّهُمْ فِي أَيْدِي غَيْرِهِمْ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Al-Abbas ibn Ma'ruf, from Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Hanan ibn Sadir, from Abdillah ibn Dhubyan, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Baqir (a.s) said: “O Abdillah, there is no day of Eid for the Muslims; neither ‘Adha’ nor ‘Fitr’, except that Allah (swt) renews for the family of (Prophet) Muhammad (saws), peace be upon them, sorrow on that day.” He (Abdillah ibn Dhubyan) said: “I asked, ‘And why is that?’” Imam (a.s) said: “Because they see their right in the hands of others.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 319

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer of the Two Eids
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Yusuf ibn Aqil, from Muhammad ibn Qays, from Abu Ja’far (a.s):
Indeed, when he led the people in the prayer of ‘Fitr’ or ‘Adha’, he would lower his voice so that those near him could hear, and he would not recite the Quran aloud. And the sermons (al-mawa'iz) and the reminders (al-tadhkirah) on the Day of Adha and Fitr are after the prayer.”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ يُوسُفَ بْنِ عَقِيلٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ:« أَنَّهُ كَانَ إِذَا صَلَّى بِالنَّاسِ صَلاَةَ فِطْرٍ أَوْ أَضْحًى خَفَضَ مِنْ صَوْتِهِ يُسْمِعُ مَنْ يَلِيهِ لاَ يَجْهَرُ بِالْقُرْآنِ وَ اَلْمَوَاعِظُ وَ اَلتَّذْكِرَةُ يَوْمَ اَلْأَضْحَى وَ اَلْفِطْرِ بَعْدَ اَلصَّلاَةِ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Yusuf ibn Aqil, from Muhammad ibn Qays, from Abu Ja’far (a.s):
thaqalaynMatn: Indeed, when he led the people in the prayer of ‘Fitr’ or ‘Adha’, he would lower his voice so that those near him could hear, and he would not recite the Quran aloud. And the sermons (al-mawa'iz) and the reminders (al-tadhkirah) on the Day of Adha and Fitr are after the prayer.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 320

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer of the Two Eids
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan, from Amr ibn Sa'id, from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah, from Ammar ibn Musa al-Sabati, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
I said to Imam al-Sadiq (a.s): “May a man lead his family in the prayer of the two Eids on the rooftop or in a house?” Imam (a.s) said: “He should not lead them, and they should not go out, and it is not obligatory upon women to go out.” And Imam (a.s) said: “Minimize for them the appearance (of preparation), so that they do not ask to go out.”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ اَلْحَسَنِ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُصَدِّقِ بْنِ صَدَقَةَ عَنْ عَمَّارِ بْنِ مُوسَى اَلسَّابَاطِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لَهُ هَلْ يَؤُمُّ اَلرَّجُلُ بِأَهْلِهِ فِي صَلاَةِ اَلْعِيدَيْنِ فِي اَلسَّطْحِ أَوْ بَيْتٍ قَالَ« لاَ يَؤُمُّ بِهِنَّ وَ لاَ يَخْرُجْنَ وَ لَيْسَ عَلَى اَلنِّسَاءِ خُرُوجٌ» وَ قَالَ« أَقِلُّوا لَهُنَّ مِنَ اَلْهَيْئَةِ حَتَّى لاَ يَسْأَلْنَ اَلْخُرُوجَ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan, from Amr ibn Sa'id, from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah, from Ammar ibn Musa al-Sabati, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I said to Imam al-Sadiq (a.s): “May a man lead his family in the prayer of the two Eids on the rooftop or in a house?” Imam (a.s) said: “He should not lead them, and they should not go out, and it is not obligatory upon women to go out.” And Imam (a.s) said: “Minimize for them the appearance (of preparation), so that they do not ask to go out.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 320

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer of the Two Eids
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And Isma'il ibn Jabir narrated from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
I said to Imam al-Sadiq (a.s): “What do you say about the prayer of the two Eids, do they have adhan and iqamah?” Imam (a.s) said: “There is no adhan and no iqamah in them, but it is called out; 'The prayer, the prayer' three times. And there is no pulpit (minbar) in them, the pulpit is not to be moved from its place. Rather, something like a pulpit made of clay, is constructed for the (just) imam, and he stands upon it and delivers the sermon to the people, then descends.”
arabicText: وَ رَوَى إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ جَابِرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لَهُ أَ رَأَيْتَ صَلاَةَ اَلْعِيدَيْنِ هَلْ فِيهِمَا أَذَانٌ وَ إِقَامَةٌ قَالَ« لَيْسَ فِيهِمَا أَذَانٌ وَ لاَ إِقَامَةٌ وَ لَكِنْ يُنَادَى اَلصَّلاَةَ اَلصَّلاَةَ ثَلاَثَ مَرَّاتٍ وَ لَيْسَ فِيهِمَا مِنْبَرٌ اَلْمِنْبَرُ لاَ يُحَوَّلُ مِنْ مَوْضِعِهِ وَ لَكِنْ يُصْنَعُ لِلْإِمَامِ شَيْءٌ شِبْهُ اَلْمِنْبَرِ مِنْ طِينٍ فَيَقُومُ عَلَيْهِ فَيَخْطُبُ اَلنَّاسَ ثُمَّ يَنْزِلُ»
thaqalaynSanad: And Isma'il ibn Jabir narrated from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I said to Imam al-Sadiq (a.s): “What do you say about the prayer of the two Eids, do they have adhan and iqamah?” Imam (a.s) said: “There is no adhan and no iqamah in them, but it is called out; 'The prayer, the prayer' three times. And there is no pulpit (minbar) in them, the pulpit is not to be moved from its place. Rather, something like a pulpit made of clay, is constructed for the (just) imam, and he stands upon it and delivers the sermon to the people, then descends.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 320

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer of the Eclipse
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub, from Al-Abbas ibn Ma’ruf, from Ali ibn Mahziyar, from Al-Husayn ibn Sa’id, from Abdillah ibn Amr, from Hammad ibn Uthman, from Jamil, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), who said:
I asked Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) about the earthquake (al-zalzalah). Imam (a.s) said: “My father (a.s) informed me from his father (a.s), from his forefathers (a.s), peace be upon them, who said that the Messenger of Allah (swt), said: ‘Indeed, when Dhul-Qarnayn reached the barrier, he passed beyond it and entered into the darkness. There he came upon an angel standing, whose height was five hundred cubits. The angel said to him: “O Dhul-Qarnayn, was there no path behind you?” Dhul-Qarnayn said to him: “And who are you?” He (the angel) replied: “I am an angel from the angels of the All-Merciful, appointed over this mountain. There is no mountain that Allah (swt), Mighty and Majestic, has created except that it has a root connected to this mountain. So when Allah (swt), Mighty and Majestic, wills to shake a city, He (azj) reveals to me, and I shake it.”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنِ اَلْعَبَّاسِ بْنِ مَعْرُوفٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَهْزِيَارَ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ جَمِيلٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلزَّلْزَلَةِ فَقَالَ« أَخْبَرَنِي أَبِي عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ آبَائِهِ عَلَيْهِمُ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ« إِنَّ ذَا اَلْقَرْنَيْنِ لَمَّا اِنْتَهَى إِلَى اَلسَّدِّ جَاوَزَهُ فَدَخَلَ فِي اَلظُّلْمَةِ فَإِذَا هُوَ بِمَلَكٍ قَائِمٍ طُولُهُ خَمْسُمِائَةِ ذِرَاعٍ فَقَالَ لَهُ اَلْمَلَكُ يَا ذَا اَلْقَرْنَيْنِ أَ مَا كَانَ خَلْفَكَ مَسْلَكٌ فَقَالَ لَهُ ذُو اَلْقَرْنَيْنِ وَ مَنْ أَنْتَ قَالَ أَنَا مَلَكٌ مِنْ مَلاَئِكَةِ اَلرَّحْمَنِ مُوَكَّلٌ بِهَذَا اَلْجَبَلِ وَ لَيْسَ مِنْ جَبَلٍ خَلَقَهُ اَللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ إِلاَّ وَ لَهُ عِرْقٌ إِلَى هَذَا اَلْجَبَلِ فَإِذَا أَرَادَ اَللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ أَنْ يُزَلْزِلَ مَدِينَةً أَوْحَى إِلَيَّ فَزَلْزَلْتُهَا»»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub, from Al-Abbas ibn Ma’ruf, from Ali ibn Mahziyar, from Al-Husayn ibn Sa’id, from Abdillah ibn Amr, from Hammad ibn Uthman, from Jamil, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) about the earthquake (al-zalzalah). Imam (a.s) said: “My father (a.s) informed me from his father (a.s), from his forefathers (a.s), peace be upon them, who said that the Messenger of Allah (swt), said: ‘Indeed, when Dhul-Qarnayn reached the barrier, he passed beyond it and entered into the darkness. There he came upon an angel standing, whose height was five hundred cubits. The angel said to him: “O Dhul-Qarnayn, was there no path behind you?” Dhul-Qarnayn said to him: “And who are you?” He (the angel) replied: “I am an angel from the angels of the All-Merciful, appointed over this mountain. There is no mountain that Allah (swt), Mighty and Majestic, has created except that it has a root connected to this mountain. So when Allah (swt), Mighty and Majestic, wills to shake a city, He (azj) reveals to me, and I shake it.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 321

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer of the Eclipse
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Ali ibn al-Sindi, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Jamil, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), who said:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “The prayer of ‘al-Kusuf’ (prayer of eclipse) is an obligation (fardh).”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ اَلسِّنْدِيِّ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ جَمِيلٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَ قَالَ:« صَلاَةُ اَلْكُسُوفِ فَرِيضَةٌ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Ali ibn al-Sindi, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Jamil, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “The prayer of ‘al-Kusuf’ (prayer of eclipse) is an obligation (fardh).”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 321

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer of the Eclipse
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Ali ibn Khalid, from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal, from Amr ibn Sa'id, from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah, from Ammar, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “If you pray the eclipse prayer (al-kusuf) until the eclipse of the sun or the moon passes, and you prolong your prayer, then that is better. But if you wish to pray and finish your prayer before the eclipse ends, that is permissible. And if you did not know until the eclipse ended, then you came to know after that, there is no eclipse prayer (due upon you). And if someone informed you while you were asleep, and you became aware, then sleep overcame you and you did not pray, then you must make it up.”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ خَالِدٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُصَدِّقِ بْنِ صَدَقَةَ عَنْ عَمَّارٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ قَالَ:« إِنْ صَلَّيْتَ اَلْكُسُوفَ إِلَى أَنْ يَذْهَبَ اَلْكُسُوفُ عَنِ اَلشَّمْسِ وَاَلْقَمَرِ وَتُطَوِّلُ فِي صَلاَتِكَ فَإِنَّ ذَلِكَ أَفْضَلُ وَ إِنْ أَحْبَبْتَ أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ فَتَفْرُغَ مِنْ صَلاَتِكَ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَذْهَبَ اَلْكُسُوفُ فَهُوَ جَائِزٌ وَ إِنْ لَمْ تَعْلَمْ حَتَّى يَذْهَبَ اَلْكُسُوفُ ثُمَّ عَلِمْتَ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ فَلَيْسَ عَلَيْكَ صَلاَةُ اَلْكُسُوفِ وَ إِنْ أَعْلَمَكَ أَحَدٌ وَ أَنْتَ نَائِمٌ فَعَلِمْتَ ثُمَّ غَلَبَتْكَ عَيْنُكَ فَلَمْ تُصَلِّ فَعَلَيْكَ قَضَاؤُهَا»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Ali ibn Khalid, from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal, from Amr ibn Sa'id, from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah, from Ammar, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “If you pray the eclipse prayer (al-kusuf) until the eclipse of the sun or the moon passes, and you prolong your prayer, then that is better. But if you wish to pray and finish your prayer before the eclipse ends, that is permissible. And if you did not know until the eclipse ended, then you came to know after that, there is no eclipse prayer (due upon you). And if someone informed you while you were asleep, and you became aware, then sleep overcame you and you did not pray, then you must make it up.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 321

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer of the Eclipse
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Al-Hajjaj, from Hammad ibn Uthman, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
We mentioned the eclipse of the moon and what the people suffer from its intensity. So Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: “If any part of it becomes uncovered, then it has become uncovered.” (meaning the eclipse is considered ‘finished’ when a part of it gets ‘uncovered’)
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنِ اَلْحَجَّالِ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: ذَكَرْنَا اِنْكِسَافَ اَلْقَمَرِ وَ مَا يَلْقَى اَلنَّاسَ مِنْ شِدَّتِهِ قَالَ فَقَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ« إِذَا اِنْجَلَى مِنْهُ شَيْءٌ فَقَدِ اِنْجَلَى»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Al-Hajjaj, from Hammad ibn Uthman, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: We mentioned the eclipse of the moon and what the people suffer from its intensity. So Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: “If any part of it becomes uncovered, then it has become uncovered.” (meaning the eclipse is considered ‘finished’ when a part of it gets ‘uncovered’)

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer of the Eclipse
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from a group of our companions, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Hamid, from Ali ibn al-Fadl al-Wasiti, who said:
I wrote to Imam al-Ridha (a.s), peace be upon him, (asking) “If the sun or the moon is eclipsed while I am riding, and I am unable to dismount?” So Imam (a.s) wrote back to me: “Pray on your mount which you are on.”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ عِدَّةٍ مِنْ أَصْحَابِنَا عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَلْحَمِيدِ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ اَلْفَضْلِ اَلْوَاسِطِيِّ قَالَ: كَتَبْتُ إِلَى اَلرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ إِذَا اِنْكَسَفَتِ اَلشَّمْسُ وَ اَلْقَمَرُ وَ أَنَا رَاكِبٌ لاَ أَقْدِرُ عَلَى اَلنُّزُولِ قَالَ فَكَتَبَ إِلَيَّ« صَلِّ عَلَى مَرْكَبِكَ اَلَّذِي أَنْتَ عَلَيْهِ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from a group of our companions, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Hamid, from Ali ibn al-Fadl al-Wasiti, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I wrote to Imam al-Ridha (a.s), peace be upon him, (asking) “If the sun or the moon is eclipsed while I am riding, and I am unable to dismount?” So Imam (a.s) wrote back to me: “Pray on your mount which you are on.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 322

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer of the Eclipse
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Khalid al-Barqi, from Abu al-Bakhtari, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “Indeed, Imam Ali (a.s), peace be upon him, prayed during the solar eclipse; two rak‘ahs with four prostrations and four bowings. He (a.s) stood and recited, then bowed, then raised his head and recited again, then bowed, then stood and supplicated (like in his first rak‘ah), then prostrated twice. Then He (a.s) stood and did the same as he did in the first rak‘ah in his recitation, standing, bowing, and prostration all of it equally.”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ اَلْبَرْقِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي اَلْبَخْتَرِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ:« أَنَّ عَلِيّاً عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ صَلَّى فِي كُسُوفِ اَلشَّمْسِ رَكْعَتَيْنِ فِي أَرْبَعِ سَجَدَاتٍ وَ أَرْبَعِ رَكَعَاتٍ قَامَ فَقَرَأَ ثُمَّ رَكَعَ ثُمَّ رَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ فَقَرَأَ ثُمَّ رَكَعَ ثُمَّ قَامَ فَدَعَا مِثْلَ رَكْعَتِهِ ثُمَّ سَجَدَ سَجْدَتَيْنِ ثُمَّ قَامَ فَفَعَلَ مِثْلَ مَا فَعَلَ فِي اَلْأُولَى فِي قِرَاءَتِهِ وَ قِيَامِهِ وَ رُكُوعِهِ وَ سُجُودِهِ سَوَاءً»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Khalid al-Barqi, from Abu al-Bakhtari, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “Indeed, Imam Ali (a.s), peace be upon him, prayed during the solar eclipse; two rak‘ahs with four prostrations and four bowings. He (a.s) stood and recited, then bowed, then raised his head and recited again, then bowed, then stood and supplicated (like in his first rak‘ah), then prostrated twice. Then He (a.s) stood and did the same as he did in the first rak‘ah in his recitation, standing, bowing, and prostration all of it equally.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 322

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer of the Eclipse
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Bunan ibn Muhammad, from Al-Muhassin ibn Ahmad, from Yunus ibn Ya'qub, who said:
Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: “The moon was eclipsed, so my father (Imam al-Baqir (a.s)) went out, and I went out with him to the ‘Sacred Mosque’, And He (a.s) prayed eight rak‘ahs, like how one prays with a rak‘ah and two prostrations.”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ بُنَانِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اَلْمُحَسِّنِ بْنِ أَحْمَدَ عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ يَعْقُوبَ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ:« اِنْكَسَفَ اَلْقَمَرُ فَخَرَجَ أَبِي وَ خَرَجْتُ مَعَهُ إِلَى اَلْمَسْجِدِ اَلْحَرَامِ فَصَلَّى ثَمَانَ رَكَعَاتٍ كَمَا يُصَلِّي رَكْعَةً وَ سَجْدَتَيْنِ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Bunan ibn Muhammad, from Al-Muhassin ibn Ahmad, from Yunus ibn Ya'qub, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: “The moon was eclipsed, so my father (Imam al-Baqir (a.s)) went out, and I went out with him to the ‘Sacred Mosque’, And He (a.s) prayed eight rak‘ahs, like how one prays with a rak‘ah and two prostrations.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 323

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer of the Eclipse
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub, from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ali, from Ali ibn Ya'qub al-Hashimi, from Marwan ibn Muslim, from Ibn Abi Ya'fur, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “If the sun or the moon is eclipsed, and the entire body is eclipsed, then it is proper for the people to hasten to an imam (of prayer) so that he may pray with them. And if either of them is partially eclipsed, then it suffices for a man to pray alone. And the prayer of ‘al-Kusuf’ (prayer of eclipse) is ten rak‘ahs and four prostrations. The eclipse of the sun is more severe upon the people and the animals.”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ يَعْقُوبَ اَلْهَاشِمِيِّ عَنْ مَرْوَانَ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي يَعْفُورٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« إِذَا اِنْكَسَفَتِ اَلشَّمْسُ وَاَلْقَمَرُ فَانْكَسَفَ كُلُّهَا فَإِنَّهُ يَنْبَغِي لِلنَّاسِ أَنْ يَفْزَعُوا إِلَى إِمَامٍ لِيُصَلِّيَ بِهِمْ وَ أَيُّهُمَا كَسَفَ بَعْضُهُ فَإِنَّهُ يُجْزِي اَلرَّجُلَ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ وَحْدَهُ وَ صَلاَةُ اَلْكُسُوفِ عَشْرُ رَكَعَاتٍ وَ أَرْبَعُ سَجَدَاتٍ كُسُوفُ اَلشَّمْسِ أَشَدُّ عَلَى اَلنَّاسِ وَ اَلْبَهَائِمِ»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub, from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ali, from Ali ibn Ya'qub al-Hashimi, from Marwan ibn Muslim, from Ibn Abi Ya'fur, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “If the sun or the moon is eclipsed, and the entire body is eclipsed, then it is proper for the people to hasten to an imam (of prayer) so that he may pray with them. And if either of them is partially eclipsed, then it suffices for a man to pray alone. And the prayer of ‘al-Kusuf’ (prayer of eclipse) is ten rak‘ahs and four prostrations. The eclipse of the sun is more severe upon the people and the animals.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 323

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer of the Eclipse
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali al-Kufi, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal, from Ghalib ibn Uthman, from Rawh ibn Abd al-Rahim, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about the eclipse prayer, whether it is prayed in congregation. Imam (a.s) said: “In congregation and not in congregation.” (meaning whichever that you wish)
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ اَلْكُوفِيِّ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ غَالِبِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ رَوْحِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَلرَّحِيمِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ صَلاَةِ اَلْكُسُوفِ تُصَلَّى جَمَاعَةً قَالَ« جَمَاعَةً وَ غَيْرَ جَمَاعَةٍ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali al-Kufi, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal, from Ghalib ibn Uthman, from Rawh ibn Abd al-Rahim, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about the eclipse prayer, whether it is prayed in congregation. Imam (a.s) said: “In congregation and not in congregation.” (meaning whichever that you wish)

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 323

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer of the Eclipse
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Ahmad ibn al-Husayn, from Ubayd ibn Zurarah, from his father, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “The sun was eclipsed while I was in the bath, and I came to know about it after I came out, so I did not make it up.”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« اِنْكَسَفَتِ اَلشَّمْسُ وَ أَنَا فِي اَلْحَمَّامِ فَعَلِمْتُ بَعْدَ مَا خَرَجْتُ فَلَمْ أَقْضِ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Ahmad ibn al-Husayn, from Ubayd ibn Zurarah, from his father, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “The sun was eclipsed while I was in the bath, and I came to know about it after I came out, so I did not make it up.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 323

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer of the Eclipse
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Ahmad, from Musa ibn al-Qasim and Abu Qatadah, from Ali ibn Ja’far, from his brother Imam Musa ibn Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon them both, who said:
I asked Imam al-Kadhim (a.s) about the eclipse prayer, and whether one who misses it must make it up. Imam (a.s) said: “If you missed it, then there is no make-up (qadah) upon you.”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ اَلْقَاسِمِ وَ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَخِيهِ مُوسَى بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِمَا اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ صَلاَةِ اَلْكُسُوفِ وَ هَلْ عَلَى مَنْ تَرَكَهَا قَضَاءٌ قَالَ« إِذَا فَاتَتْكَ فَلَيْسَ عَلَيْكَ قَضَاءٌ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Ahmad, from Musa ibn al-Qasim and Abu Qatadah, from Ali ibn Ja’far, from his brother Imam Musa ibn Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon them both, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Imam al-Kadhim (a.s) about the eclipse prayer, and whether one who misses it must make it up. Imam (a.s) said: “If you missed it, then there is no make-up (qadah) upon you.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 323

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer of the Eclipse
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali, from Ja’far ibn Muhammad, from Abdillah ibn Maymun al-Qaddah, from Imam Ja’far (a.s), from his father (a.s), from his forefathers, peace be upon them, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “The sun was eclipsed during the time of the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, so He (saws) led the people in two rak‘ahs, and He (saws) prolonged (the prayer) until some of the people behind him lost consciousness, due to the length of the standing.”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ مَيْمُونٍ اَلْقَدَّاحِ عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ آبَائِهِ عَلَيْهِمُ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« اِنْكَسَفَتِ اَلشَّمْسُ فِي زَمَنِ رَسُولِ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ فَصَلَّى بِالنَّاسِ رَكْعَتَيْنِ فَطَوَّلَ حَتَّى غُشِيَ عَلَى بَعْضِ اَلْقَوْمِ مِمَّنْ كَانَ وَرَاءَهُ مِنْ طُولِ اَلْقِيَامِ»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali, from Ja’far ibn Muhammad, from Abdillah ibn Maymun al-Qaddah, from Imam Ja’far (a.s), from his father (a.s), from his forefathers, peace be upon them, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “The sun was eclipsed during the time of the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, so He (saws) led the people in two rak‘ahs, and He (saws) prolonged (the prayer) until some of the people behind him lost consciousness, due to the length of the standing.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 324

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer of the Eclipse
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad from Ibn Abi ‘Umayr from Jamil ibn Darraj from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “The time for the eclipse prayer is at the hour when the eclipse occurs, at sunrise and at sunset. He (narrator) said: “And Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: ‘It is an obligation (faridah)’.”
arabicText: احمد بن عن ابن ابي عمير عن جميل بن دراج عن ابي عبد الله عليه السلام قال وقت صلاة الكسوف في الساعة التي تنكسف عند طلوع الشمس وعند غروبها قال وقال أبو عبد الله عليه السلام هي فريضة
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad from Ibn Abi ‘Umayr from Jamil ibn Darraj from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “The time for the eclipse prayer is at the hour when the eclipse occurs, at sunrise and at sunset. He (narrator) said: “And Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: ‘It is an obligation (faridah)’.”

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer of the Eclipse
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Saeed from al-Nadr from Asim from Abu Basir who said:
The moon was eclipsed while I (Abu Basir) was with Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, in the Month of Ramadan. So Imam (a.s) leapt up and said: “It used to be said: ‘When the moon and the sun are eclipsed, then hasten to your mosques’.”
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ اَلنَّضْرِ عَنْ عَاصِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ قَالَ: اِنْكَسَفَ اَلْقَمَرُ وَ أَنَا عِنْدَ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ فَوَثَبَ وَ قَالَ« إِنَّهُ كَانَ يُقَالُ إِذَا اِنْكَسَفَ اَلْقَمَرُ وَ اَلشَّمْسُ فَافْزَعُوا إِلَى مَسَاجِدِكُمْ»
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Saeed from al-Nadr from Asim from Abu Basir who said:
thaqalaynMatn: The moon was eclipsed while I (Abu Basir) was with Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, in the Month of Ramadan. So Imam (a.s) leapt up and said: “It used to be said: ‘When the moon and the sun are eclipsed, then hasten to your mosques’.”

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer of the Eclipse
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Saeed from Ibn Abi ‘Umayr from Abu Ayyub Ibrahim ibn Uthman from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) about the eclipse prayer before the sun sets, and we fear missing the obligatory prayer. So Imam (a.s) said: “Cut it off, perform the obligatory prayer, and then return to your eclipse prayer.”
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ صَلاَةِ اَلْكُسُوفِ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَغِيبَ اَلشَّمْسُ وَ نَخْشَى فَوْتَ اَلْفَرِيضَةِ فَقَالَ« اِقْطَعُوهَا وَ صَلُّوا اَلْفَرِيضَةَ وَ عُودُوا إِلَى صَلاَتِكُمْ»
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Saeed from Ibn Abi ‘Umayr from Abu Ayyub Ibrahim ibn Uthman from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) about the eclipse prayer before the sun sets, and we fear missing the obligatory prayer. So Imam (a.s) said: “Cut it off, perform the obligatory prayer, and then return to your eclipse prayer.”

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer of the Eclipse
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Safwan, from Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Sabati, from Imam al-Ridha (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Imam al-Ridha (a.s) about the eclipse prayer, whether it is to be performed in congregation or individually. Imam (a.s) said: “Whichever of the two you wish.”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى اَلسَّابَاطِيِّ عَنِ اَلرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ صَلاَةِ اَلْكُسُوفِ تُصَلَّى جَمَاعَةً أَوْ فُرَادَى فَقَالَ« أَيَّ ذَلِكَ شِئْتَ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Safwan, from Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Sabati, from Imam al-Ridha (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Imam al-Ridha (a.s) about the eclipse prayer, whether it is to be performed in congregation or individually. Imam (a.s) said: “Whichever of the two you wish.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 325

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer of the Eclipse
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad from Ali ibn al-Hakam from Ali ibn Abi Hamzah from Abu Basir who said:
I asked Imam (a.s) about the eclipse prayer. Imam (a.s) said: “Ten rak‘ahs and four prostrations. In each rak‘ah you recite like Surah ‘Yasin’ and Surah ‘al-Nur’, and your bowing (rukuh) should be like your recitation, and your prostration (sujud) like your bowing.” I asked: “What about someone, who does not know Surah ‘Yasin’ and similar (surahs)?” Imam (a.s) said: “Then let him recite sixty verses in each rak‘ah. When he raises his head from bowing, he should not recite Surah ‘al-Fatiha’.” Imam (a.s) said: “If he forgets it or was asleep, then let him make it up (qadah).”
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ اَلْحَكَمِ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ صَلاَةِ اَلْكُسُوفِ فَقَالَ« عَشْرُ رَكَعَاتٍ وَ أَرْبَعُ سَجَدَاتٍ تَقْرَأُ فِي كُلِّ رَكْعَةٍ مِثْلَ يَاسِينَ وَ اَلنُّورِ وَ يَكُونُ رُكُوعُكَ مِثْلَ قِرَاءَتِكَ وَ سُجُودُكَ مِثْلَ رُكُوعِكَ» قُلْتُ فَمَنْ لَمْ يُحْسِنْ يَاسِينَ وَ أَشْبَاهَهَا قَالَ« فَلْيَقْرَأْ سِتِّينَ آيَةً فِي كُلِّ رَكْعَةٍ فَإِذَا رَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ مِنَ اَلرُّكُوعِ فَلاَ يَقْرَأْ بِفَاتِحَةِ اَلْكِتَابِ» قَالَ« فَإِنْ أَغْفَلَهَا أَوْ كَانَ نَائِماً فَلْيَقْضِهَا»
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad from Ali ibn al-Hakam from Ali ibn Abi Hamzah from Abu Basir who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Imam (a.s) about the eclipse prayer. Imam (a.s) said: “Ten rak‘ahs and four prostrations. In each rak‘ah you recite like Surah ‘Yasin’ and Surah ‘al-Nur’, and your bowing (rukuh) should be like your recitation, and your prostration (sujud) like your bowing.” I asked: “What about someone, who does not know Surah ‘Yasin’ and similar (surahs)?” Imam (a.s) said: “Then let him recite sixty verses in each rak‘ah. When he raises his head from bowing, he should not recite Surah ‘al-Fatiha’.” Imam (a.s) said: “If he forgets it or was asleep, then let him make it up (qadah).”

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer of the Eclipse
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ali ibn Mahziyar narrated:
I wrote to Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, and complained to Imam (a.s) about the frequent earthquakes in Ahwaz, and I asked: ‘Do you see that I should relocate from it (Ahwaz)?’ So Imam (a.s), peace be upon him, wrote: “Do not relocate from it. Fast on Wednesday, Thursday, and Friday, and perform ghusl, purify your clothes, go out on Friday, and supplicate to Allah (swt), for indeed He (azj) will repel it from you.” He (Ali ibn Mahziyar) said: “So we did (as Imam (a.s) said), and the earthquakes subsided.”
arabicText: وَ رَوَى عَلِيُّ بْنُ مَهْزِيَارَ قَالَ: كَتَبْتُ إِلَى أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ وَ شَكَوْتُ إِلَيْهِ كَثْرَةَ اَلزَّلاَزِلِ فِي اَلْأَهْوَازِ وَ قُلْتُ تَرَى لِيَ اَلتَّحَوُّلَ عَنْهَا فَكَتَبَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ« لاَ تَتَحَوَّلُوا عَنْهَا وَ صُومُوا اَلْأَرْبِعَاءَ وَ اَلْخَمِيسَ وَ اَلْجُمُعَةَ وَ اِغْتَسِلُوا وَ طَهِّرُوا ثِيَابَكُمْ وَ اُبْرُزُوا يَوْمَ اَلْجُمُعَةِ وَ اُدْعُوا اَللَّهَ فَإِنَّهُ يَدْفَعُ عَنْكُمْ» قَالَ فَفَعَلْنَا فَسَكَنَتِ اَلزَّلاَزِلُ
thaqalaynSanad: Ali ibn Mahziyar narrated:
thaqalaynMatn: I wrote to Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, and complained to Imam (a.s) about the frequent earthquakes in Ahwaz, and I asked: ‘Do you see that I should relocate from it (Ahwaz)?’ So Imam (a.s), peace be upon him, wrote: “Do not relocate from it. Fast on Wednesday, Thursday, and Friday, and perform ghusl, purify your clothes, go out on Friday, and supplicate to Allah (swt), for indeed He (azj) will repel it from you.” He (Ali ibn Mahziyar) said: “So we did (as Imam (a.s) said), and the earthquakes subsided.”
