chapter: Chapter on the Recommended Prayers
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn al-Hakam from a man from Muhammad ibn Muslim from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Baqir (a.s) said: “Whoever desires that conception (pregnancy) be granted to him, let him pray two units of prayer after Jumu‘ah (Friday prayer), prolonging the bowing (ruku‘) and the prostration (sujud) in them. Then let him say: ‘O’ Allah (swt), I ask You (azj) by what Zakariyya (a.s) asked You (azj) when he said: ‘My Lord, do not leave me alone, and You are the best of inheritors’. (Surah Al Anbiya 21:89) O’ Allah (swt), grant me ‘good offspring; indeed, You are the Hearer of supplication’. (Surah Aal Imran 3:38) O’ Allah (swt), by Your name I have made her lawful, and by Your trust I have taken her (as a wife), so if You decree in her womb a child, then make him a boy, and do not make for Satan any share or partnership in him’.”
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ اَلْحَكَمِ عَنْ رَجُلٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« مَنْ أَرَادَ أَنْ يُحْبَلَ لَهُ فَلْيُصَلِّ رَكْعَتَيْنِ بَعْدَ اَلْجُمُعَةِ يُطِيلُ فِيهِمَا اَلرُّكُوعَ وَ اَلسُّجُودَ ثُمَّ يَقُولُ اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِمَا سَأَلَكَ بِهِ زَكَرِيَّا إِذْ قَالَ« رَبِّ لاٰ تَذَرْنِي فَرْداً وَ أَنْتَ خَيْرُ اَلْوٰارِثِينَ» اَللَّهُمَّ هَبْ لِي« ذُرِّيَّةً طَيِّبَةً إِنَّكَ سَمِيعُ اَلدُّعٰاءِ» اَللَّهُمَّ بِاسْمِكَ اِسْتَحْلَلْتُهَا وَ بِأَمَانَتِكَ أَخَذْتُهَا فَإِنْ قَضَيْتَ فِي رَحِمِهَا وَلَداً فَاجْعَلْهُ غُلاَماً وَ لاَ تَجْعَلْ لِلشَّيْطَانِ فِيهِ نَصِيباً وَ لاَ شِرْكاً»
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn al-Hakam from a man from Muhammad ibn Muslim from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Baqir (a.s) said: “Whoever desires that conception (pregnancy) be granted to him, let him pray two units of prayer after Jumu‘ah (Friday prayer), prolonging the bowing (ruku‘) and the prostration (sujud) in them. Then let him say: ‘O’ Allah (swt), I ask You (azj) by what Zakariyya (a.s) asked You (azj) when he said: ‘My Lord, do not leave me alone, and You are the best of inheritors’. (Surah Al Anbiya 21:89) O’ Allah (swt), grant me ‘good offspring; indeed, You are the Hearer of supplication’. (Surah Aal Imran 3:38) O’ Allah (swt), by Your name I have made her lawful, and by Your trust I have taken her (as a wife), so if You decree in her womb a child, then make him a boy, and do not make for Satan any share or partnership in him’.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 348

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer over the Dead
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa’id from Fadalah from Kulayb al-Asadi said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about the takbir (declaration of ‘Allahu Akbar’) over the deceased. Imam (a.s) gestured with his hand five times. I asked: “Then what should I say when I pray over him?” Imam (a.s) said: “You say; ‘O’ Allah (swt), Your servant has become in need of Your mercy, and You are free of any need to punish him. O’ Allah (swt), if he was a doer of good, then increase his good deeds, and if he was a wrongdoer, then forgive him’.”
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ كُلَيْبٍ اَلْأَسَدِيِّ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلتَّكْبِيرِ عَلَى اَلْمَيِّتِ فَقَالَ بِيَدِهِ خَمْساً قُلْتُ فَكَيْفَ أَقُولُ إِذَا صَلَّيْتُ عَلَيْهِ قَالَ تَقُولُ« اَللَّهُمَّ عَبْدُكَ اِحْتَاجَ إِلَى رَحْمَتِكَ وَ أَنْتَ غَنِيٌّ عَنْ عَذَابِهِ اَللَّهُمَّ إِنْ كَانَ مُحْسِناً فَزِدْ فِي إِحْسَانِهِ وَ إِنْ كَانَ مُسِيئاً فَاغْفِرْ لَهُ»
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Sa’id from Fadalah from Kulayb al-Asadi said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about the takbir (declaration of ‘Allahu Akbar’) over the deceased. Imam (a.s) gestured with his hand five times. I asked: “Then what should I say when I pray over him?” Imam (a.s) said: “You say; ‘O’ Allah (swt), Your servant has become in need of Your mercy, and You are free of any need to punish him. O’ Allah (swt), if he was a doer of good, then increase his good deeds, and if he was a wrongdoer, then forgive him’.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 348

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer over the Dead
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Fadalah, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “The takbir over the deceased is five takbirs.”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« اَلتَّكْبِيرُ عَلَى اَلْمَيِّتِ خَمْسُ تَكْبِيرَاتٍ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Fadalah, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “The takbir over the deceased is five takbirs.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 348

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer over the Dead
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from al-Qasim ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn Abi Hamzah, from Abu Basir, from Abu Ja’far (a.s):
Imam al-Baqir (a.s) said: “The Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, pronounced five takbirs (over the deceased).”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنِ اَلْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ« كَبَّرَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ خَمْساً»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from al-Qasim ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn Abi Hamzah, from Abu Basir, from Abu Ja’far (a.s):
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Baqir (a.s) said: “The Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, pronounced five takbirs (over the deceased).”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 348

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer over the Dead
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Sa’ad ibn Abdullah from Ibrahim ibn Mahziyar from his brother Ali from Hammad ibn Muhammad from Shu‘ayb from Abu Basir from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “The takbir over the deceased is five takbirs.”
arabicText: سعد بن عبد الله عن ابراهيم بن مهزيار عن اخيه علي عن حماد بن محمد عن شعيب عن ابي بصير عن ابي عبد الله عليه السلام قال التكبير على الميت خمس تكبيرات
thaqalaynSanad: Sa’ad ibn Abdullah from Ibrahim ibn Mahziyar from his brother Ali from Hammad ibn Muhammad from Shu‘ayb from Abu Basir from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “The takbir over the deceased is five takbirs.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 348

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer over the Dead
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ali ibn al-Husayn from Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Ali ibn al-Salt from Abdullah ibn al-Salt from al-Hasan ibn Ali from Ibn Bukayr from Qudamah ibn Zaydah who said:
I heard Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, say: “Indeed, the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, prayed (Salat Al Mayyit) over his son Ibrahim (a.s), peace be upon him, and He (saws) pronounced five takbirs over him.”
arabicText: عَلِيُّ بْنُ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ اَلصَّلْتِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ اَلصَّلْتِ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ عَنِ اِبْنِ بُكَيْرٍ عَنْ قُدَامَةَ بْنِ زَائِدَةَ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ يَقُولُ:« إِنَّ رَسُولَ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ صَلَّى عَلَى اِبْنِهِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ فَكَبَّرَ عَلَيْهِ خَمْساً»
thaqalaynSanad: Ali ibn al-Husayn from Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Ali ibn al-Salt from Abdullah ibn al-Salt from al-Hasan ibn Ali from Ibn Bukayr from Qudamah ibn Zaydah who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I heard Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, say: “Indeed, the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, prayed (Salat Al Mayyit) over his son Ibrahim (a.s), peace be upon him, and He (saws) pronounced five takbirs over him.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 348

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer over the Dead
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Abdullah ibn al-Salt from al-Hasan ibn Mahbub from Abu Walad who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about the takbirs over the deceased. Imam (a.s) said: “Five (takbirs).”
arabicText: عَبْدُ اَللَّهِ بْنُ اَلصَّلْتِ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ أَبِي وَلاَّدٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلتَّكْبِيرِ عَلَى اَلْمَيِّتِ فَقَالَ« خَمْساً»
thaqalaynSanad: Abdullah ibn al-Salt from al-Hasan ibn Mahbub from Abu Walad who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about the takbirs over the deceased. Imam (a.s) said: “Five (takbirs).”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 349

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer over the Dead
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
As for what was narrated by Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa from Muhammad ibn Khalid al-Barqi from Ahmad ibn al-Nadr al-Khazzaz from ‘Amr ibn Shimr from Jabir, who said:
I asked Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, about the takbir over the funeral, is there something fixed (in number) in it or not? Imam (a.s) said: “No. The Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, pronounced eleven, nine, seven, five, six, and four takbirs (over the deceased).”
arabicText: فَأَمَّا مَا رَوَاهُ أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ اَلْبَرْقِيِّ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ اَلنَّضْرِ اَلْخَزَّازِ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ شِمْرٍ عَنْ جَابِرٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلتَّكْبِيرِ عَلَى اَلْجِنَازَةِ هَلْ فِيهِ شَيْءٌ مُوَقَّتٌ أَمْ لاَ فَقَالَ« لاَ كَبَّرَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ أَحَدَ عَشَرَ وَ تِسْعاً وَ سَبْعاً وَ خَمْساً وَ سِتّاً وَ أَرْبَعاً»
thaqalaynSanad: As for what was narrated by Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa from Muhammad ibn Khalid al-Barqi from Ahmad ibn al-Nadr al-Khazzaz from ‘Amr ibn Shimr from Jabir, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, about the takbir over the funeral, is there something fixed (in number) in it or not? Imam (a.s) said: “No. The Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, pronounced eleven, nine, seven, five, six, and four takbirs (over the deceased).”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 349

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer over the Dead
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa’id from Muhammad ibn Abi ‘Umayr from Hammad ibn Uthman and Hisham ibn Salim from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “The Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, used to pronounce five takbirs (of Salat Al Mayyit) over some people and four over others. So if He (saws) pronounced four takbirs over a man, he would be regarded with suspicion.” (meaning it was commanded to Prophet (saws) to recite four takbir over the deceased hypocrites)
arabicText: الحسين بن سعيد عن محمد بن ابي عمير عن حماد بن عثمان وهشام بن سالم عن ابي عبد الله عليه السلام قال كان رسول الله صلى الله عليه وآله يكبر على قوم خمسا وعلى آخرين أربعا فإذا كبر على رجل أربعا اتهم
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Sa’id from Muhammad ibn Abi ‘Umayr from Hammad ibn Uthman and Hisham ibn Salim from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “The Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, used to pronounce five takbirs (of Salat Al Mayyit) over some people and four over others. So if He (saws) pronounced four takbirs over a man, he would be regarded with suspicion.” (meaning it was commanded to Prophet (saws) to recite four takbir over the deceased hypocrites)

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 349

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer over the Dead
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ali ibn al-Husayn from Abdullah ibn Ja’far from Ibrahim ibn Mahziyar from his brother Ali from Isma’il ibn Hammam from Abu al-Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him, who said that Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “The Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, prayed over a funeral and pronounced five takbirs over it, and He (saws) prayed over another and pronounced four takbirs over it. As for the one over whom Prophet (saws) pronounced five takbirs; He (saws) praised Allah (swt) and glorified Him (azj) in the first takbir, And in the second, He (saws) supplicated for the Prophet (saws) (himself), And in the third, He (saws) supplicated for the believing men and believing women, And in the fourth, He (saws) supplicated for the deceased, And He (saws) concluded in the fifth. As for the one over whom Prophet (saws) pronounced four takbirs; He (saws) praised Allah (swt) and glorified Him (azj) in the first takbir, And in the second, He (saws) supplicated for the himself, may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, and for his household, peace be upon them, And in the third, He (saws) supplicated for the believing men and believing women, And He (saws) concluded in the fourth and He (saws) did not supplicate for him, because he was a hypocrite.”
arabicText: عَلِيُّ بْنُ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ مَهْزِيَارَ عَنْ أَخِيهِ عَلِيٍّ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ هَمَّامٍ عَنْ أَبِي اَلْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ:« صَلَّى رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ عَلَى جِنَازَةٍ فَكَبَّرَ عَلَيْهِ خَمْساً وَ صَلَّى عَلَى آخَرَ فَكَبَّرَ عَلَيْهِ أَرْبَعاً فَأَمَّا اَلَّذِي كَبَّرَ عَلَيْهِ خَمْساً فَحَمِدَ اَللَّهَ وَ مَجَّدَهُ فِي اَلتَّكْبِيرَةِ اَلْأُولَى وَ دَعَا فِي اَلثَّانِيَةِ لِلنَّبِيِّ وَ دَعَا فِي اَلثَّالِثَةِ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَ اَلْمُؤْمِنَاتِ وَ دَعَا فِي اَلرَّابِعَةِ لِلْمَيِّتِ وَ اِنْصَرَفَ فِي اَلْخَامِسَةِ وَ أَمَّا اَلَّذِي كَبَّرَ عَلَيْهِ أَرْبَعاً فَحَمِدَ اَللَّهَ وَ مَجَّدَهُ فِي اَلتَّكْبِيرَةِ اَلْأُولَى وَ دَعَا لِنَفْسِهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ وَ أَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ عَلَيهِمُ اَلسَّلاَمُ فِي اَلثَّانِيَةِ وَ دَعَا لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَ اَلْمُؤْمِنَاتِ فِي اَلثَّالِثَةِ وَ اِنْصَرَفَ فِي اَلرَّابِعَةِ فَلَمْ يَدْعُ لَهُ لِأَنَّهُ كَانَ مُنَافِقاً»
thaqalaynSanad: Ali ibn al-Husayn from Abdullah ibn Ja’far from Ibrahim ibn Mahziyar from his brother Ali from Isma’il ibn Hammam from Abu al-Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him, who said that Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “The Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, prayed over a funeral and pronounced five takbirs over it, and He (saws) prayed over another and pronounced four takbirs over it. As for the one over whom Prophet (saws) pronounced five takbirs; He (saws) praised Allah (swt) and glorified Him (azj) in the first takbir, And in the second, He (saws) supplicated for the Prophet (saws) (himself), And in the third, He (saws) supplicated for the believing men and believing women, And in the fourth, He (saws) supplicated for the deceased, And He (saws) concluded in the fifth. As for the one over whom Prophet (saws) pronounced four takbirs; He (saws) praised Allah (swt) and glorified Him (azj) in the first takbir, And in the second, He (saws) supplicated for the himself, may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, and for his household, peace be upon them, And in the third, He (saws) supplicated for the believing men and believing women, And He (saws) concluded in the fourth and He (saws) did not supplicate for him, because he was a hypocrite.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 349

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer over the Dead
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ali ibn al-Husayn from Ahmad ibn Idris from Muhammad ibn Salim from Ahmad ibn al-Nadr from ‘Amr ibn Shimr who said:
I said to Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad (a.s), peace be upon him: “May I be your ransom, we speak in Iraq that Imam Ali (a.s), peace be upon him, prayed over Sahl ibn Hunayf and pronounced six takbirs over him, then turned to those who were behind him and said: ‘Indeed, he was a Badri (a participant in the Battle of Badr)’.” He (‘Amr ibn Shimr) said: “So Imam Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, said: ‘It was not so, but Imam Ali (a.s) prayed over him with five takbirs, then lifted him and walked with him for a while, then placed him down and pronounced five takbirs over him (again), And Imam (a.s) did that five times, until He (a.s) had pronounced over him twenty-five takbirs.”
arabicText: عَلِيُّ بْنُ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ إِدْرِيسَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سَالِمٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ اَلنَّضْرِ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ شِمْرٍ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِجَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ جُعِلْتُ فِدَاكَ إِنَّا نَتَحَدَّثُ بِالْعِرَاقِ أَنَّ عَلِيّاً عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ صَلَّى عَلَى سَهْلِ بْنِ حُنَيْفٍ فَكَبَّرَ عَلَيْهِ سِتّاً ثُمَّ اِلْتَفَتَ إِلَى مَنْ كَانَ خَلْفَهُ فَقَالَ« إِنَّهُ كَانَ بَدْرِيّاً» قَالَ فَقَالَ جَعْفَرٌ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ« إِنَّهُ لَمْ يَكُنْ كَذَا وَ لَكِنَّهُ صَلَّى عَلَيْهِ خَمْساً ثُمَّ رَفَعَهُ وَ مَشَى بِهِ سَاعَةً ثُمَّ وَضَعَهُ فَكَبَّرَ عَلَيْهِ خَمْساً فَفَعَلَ ذَلِكَ خَمْسَ مَرَّاتٍ حَتَّى كَبَّرَ عَلَيْهِ خَمْساً وَ عِشْرِينَ تَكْبِيرَةً»
thaqalaynSanad: Ali ibn al-Husayn from Ahmad ibn Idris from Muhammad ibn Salim from Ahmad ibn al-Nadr from ‘Amr ibn Shimr who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I said to Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad (a.s), peace be upon him: “May I be your ransom, we speak in Iraq that Imam Ali (a.s), peace be upon him, prayed over Sahl ibn Hunayf and pronounced six takbirs over him, then turned to those who were behind him and said: ‘Indeed, he was a Badri (a participant in the Battle of Badr)’.” He (‘Amr ibn Shimr) said: “So Imam Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, said: ‘It was not so, but Imam Ali (a.s) prayed over him with five takbirs, then lifted him and walked with him for a while, then placed him down and pronounced five takbirs over him (again), And Imam (a.s) did that five times, until He (a.s) had pronounced over him twenty-five takbirs.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 350

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer over the Dead
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa from Muhammad ibn Isma’il ibn Bazi‘ from Muhammad ibn ‘Udhafir from ‘Uqbah from Imam Ja’far (a.s), who said:
Imam Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, was asked about the takbir over the funerals. Imam (a.s) said: “That is up to the family of the deceased whatever they wish, they may pronounce in takbirs.” It was said to Imam (a.s): “They (chose to) pronounce four takbirs.” Imam (a.s) said: “That is up to them.” Then Imam (a.s) said: “Has it (a report)not reached you that a man was prayed over by Imam Ali (a.s), peace be upon him, and Imam (a.s) pronounced five takbirs over him until he prayed over him five prayers, pronouncing five takbirs in each (Salat Al Mayyit) prayer?” He (Uqbah) said: “Then Imam (a.s) said: ‘Indeed, he was a Badri, ‘Uqabi, Uhudi, and he was among the naqib (leaders) whom the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, chose from among the twelve, so he had five virtues’. Therefore, Imam Ali (a.s) prayed over him; one (Salat Al Mayyit) prayer for each virtue.”
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ بَزِيعٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عُذَافِرٍ عَنْ عُقْبَةَ عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ قَالَ: سُئِلَ جَعْفَرٌ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلتَّكْبِيرِ عَلَى اَلْجَنَائِزِ فَقَالَ« ذَاكَ إِلَى أَهْلِ اَلْمَيِّتِ مَا شَاءُوا كَبَّرُوا» فَقِيلَ إِنَّهُمْ يُكَبِّرُونَ أَرْبَعاً فَقَالَ« ذَاكَ إِلَيْهِمْ» ثُمَّ قَالَ« أَ مَا بَلَغَكُمْ أَنَّ رَجُلاً صَلَّى عَلَيْهِ عَلِيٌّ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ فَكَبَّرَ عَلَيْهِ خَمْساً حَتَّى صَلَّى عَلَيْهِ خَمْسَ صَلَوَاتٍُ يُكَبِّرُ فِي كُلِّ صَلاَةٍ خَمْسَ تَكْبِيرَاتٍ» قَالَ« ثُمَّ قَالَ« إِنَّهُ بَدْرِيٌّ عَقَبِيٌّ أُحُدِيٌّ وَكَانَ مِنَ اَلنُّقَبَاءِ اَلَّذِينَ اِخْتَارَهُمْ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ مِنَ اَلاِثْنَيْ عَشَرَ فَكَانَتْ لَهُ خَمْسُ مَنَاقِبَ» فَصَلَّى عَلَيْهِ لِكُلِّ مَنْقَبَةٍ صَلاَةً»
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa from Muhammad ibn Isma’il ibn Bazi‘ from Muhammad ibn ‘Udhafir from ‘Uqbah from Imam Ja’far (a.s), who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, was asked about the takbir over the funerals. Imam (a.s) said: “That is up to the family of the deceased whatever they wish, they may pronounce in takbirs.” It was said to Imam (a.s): “They (chose to) pronounce four takbirs.” Imam (a.s) said: “That is up to them.” Then Imam (a.s) said: “Has it (a report)not reached you that a man was prayed over by Imam Ali (a.s), peace be upon him, and Imam (a.s) pronounced five takbirs over him until he prayed over him five prayers, pronouncing five takbirs in each (Salat Al Mayyit) prayer?” He (Uqbah) said: “Then Imam (a.s) said: ‘Indeed, he was a Badri, ‘Uqabi, Uhudi, and he was among the naqib (leaders) whom the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, chose from among the twelve, so he had five virtues’. Therefore, Imam Ali (a.s) prayed over him; one (Salat Al Mayyit) prayer for each virtue.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 350

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer over the Dead
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ali ibn al-Husayn from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Muhammad ibn Ahmad al-Kufi, whose nickname was Hamdan, from Muhammad ibn Abdullah from Muhammad ibn Abi Hamzah from Muhammad ibn Yazid from Abu Basir who said:
I was sitting with Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, when a man entered and asked Imam (a.s) about the (amount of) takbir over the funerals. Imam (a.s) said: “Five takbirs.” Then another man entered and asked Imam (a.s) about the prayer over the funerals. Imam (a.s) said to him: “Four prayers.” So the first man said: “May I be your ransom, I asked you and you said five (takbirs), and this one asked you and you said four (takbirs).” Imam (a.s) said: “You asked me about the takbirs, and this one asked me about the prayers.” Then Imam (a.s) said: “They are five takbirs, between them are four prayers.” Then Imam (a.s) opened his palm and said: “Indeed, they are five takbirs, between them are four prayers.”
arabicText: عَلِيُّ بْنُ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَحْمَدَ اَلْكُوفِيِّ وَ لَقَبُهُ حَمْدَانُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ قَالَ: كُنْتُ عِنْدَ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ جَالِساً فَدَخَلَ رَجُلٌ فَسَأَلَهُ عَنِ اَلتَّكْبِيرِ عَلَى اَلْجَنَائِزِ فَقَالَ« خَمْسُ تَكْبِيرَاتٍ» ثُمَّ دَخَلَ آخَرُ فَسَأَلَهُ عَنِ اَلصَّلاَةِ عَلَى اَلْجَنَائِزِ فَقَالَ لَهُ« أَرْبَعُ صَلَوَاتٍُ» فَقَالَ اَلْأَوَّلُ جُعِلْتُ فِدَاكَ سَأَلْتُكَ فَقُلْتَ خَمْساً وَ سَأَلَكَ هَذَا فَقُلْتَ أَرْبَعاً فَقَالَ« إِنَّكَ سَأَلْتَنِي عَنِ اَلتَّكْبِيرِ وَ سَأَلَنِي هَذَا عَنِ اَلصَّلاَةِ» ثُمَّ قَالَ« إِنَّهَا خَمْسُ تَكْبِيرَاتٍ بَيْنَهُنَّ أَرْبَعُ صَلَوَاتٍُ» ثُمَّ بَسَطَ كَفَّهُ فَقَالَ« إِنَّهُنَّ خَمْسُ تَكْبِيرَاتٍ بَيْنَهُنَّ أَرْبَعُ صَلَوَاتٍُ»
thaqalaynSanad: Ali ibn al-Husayn from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Muhammad ibn Ahmad al-Kufi, whose nickname was Hamdan, from Muhammad ibn Abdullah from Muhammad ibn Abi Hamzah from Muhammad ibn Yazid from Abu Basir who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I was sitting with Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, when a man entered and asked Imam (a.s) about the (amount of) takbir over the funerals. Imam (a.s) said: “Five takbirs.” Then another man entered and asked Imam (a.s) about the prayer over the funerals. Imam (a.s) said to him: “Four prayers.” So the first man said: “May I be your ransom, I asked you and you said five (takbirs), and this one asked you and you said four (takbirs).” Imam (a.s) said: “You asked me about the takbirs, and this one asked me about the prayers.” Then Imam (a.s) said: “They are five takbirs, between them are four prayers.” Then Imam (a.s) opened his palm and said: “Indeed, they are five takbirs, between them are four prayers.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 351

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer over the Dead
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ali ibn al-Husayn from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from ‘Ubayys ibn Hisham from al-Hasan ibn Ahmad al-Minqari from Yunus from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “The prayer over the funerals; the first takbir is the opening of the prayer, the second is to bear witness that there is ‘No God but Allah (swt)’ and that ‘(Prophet) Muhammad (saws) is the Messenger of Allah (swt)’, may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, the third is the prayer upon the Prophet (saws), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, and upon his household, and praise of Allah (swt), the fourth is for (prayer for) him (the deceased), and the fifth is the salutation, And he (imam of prayer) stands for the amount of time between two takbirs and does not leave until the bier is lifted from in front of him (imam of prayer).”
arabicText: عَلِيُّ بْنُ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ عُبَيْسِ بْنِ هِشَامٍ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ أَحْمَدَ اَلْمِنْقَرِيِّ عَنْ يُونُسَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ قَالَ:« اَلصَّلاَةُ عَلَى اَلْجَنَائِزِ اَلتَّكْبِيرَةُ اَلْأُولَى اِسْتِفْتَاحُ اَلصَّلاَةِ وَ اَلثَّانِيَةُ يَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اَللَّهُ وَ أَنَّ مُحَمَّداً رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ وَ اَلثَّالِثَةُ اَلصَّلاَةُ عَلَى اَلنَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ وَ عَلَى أَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ وَ اَلثَّنَاءُ عَلَى اَللَّهِ وَ اَلرَّابِعَةُ لَهُ وَ اَلْخَامِسَةُ يُسَلِّمُ وَ يَقِفُ مِقْدَارَ مَا بَيْنَ اَلتَّكْبِيرَتَيْنِ وَ لاَ يَبْرَحُ حَتَّى يُحْمَلَ اَلسَّرِيرُ مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ»
thaqalaynSanad: Ali ibn al-Husayn from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from ‘Ubayys ibn Hisham from al-Hasan ibn Ahmad al-Minqari from Yunus from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “The prayer over the funerals; the first takbir is the opening of the prayer, the second is to bear witness that there is ‘No God but Allah (swt)’ and that ‘(Prophet) Muhammad (saws) is the Messenger of Allah (swt)’, may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, the third is the prayer upon the Prophet (saws), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, and upon his household, and praise of Allah (swt), the fourth is for (prayer for) him (the deceased), and the fifth is the salutation, And he (imam of prayer) stands for the amount of time between two takbirs and does not leave until the bier is lifted from in front of him (imam of prayer).”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 351

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer over the Dead
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
As for what was narrated by Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya from Ja’far ibn Muhammad from ‘Ubaydullah al-Qummi from Abdullah ibn Maymun al-Qaddah from Imam Ja’far (a.s), from his father (a.s):
Imam al-Baqir (a.s) said: “Indeed, Imam Ali (a.s), peace be upon him, when He (a.s) prayed over a deceased person, He (a.s) would recite the ‘Fatihati al-Kitab’ (Surah al-Fatiha) and send blessings upon the Prophet (saws), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family.”
arabicText: فَأَمَّا مَا رَوَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اَللَّهِ اَلْقُمِّيِّ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ مَيْمُونٍ اَلْقَدَّاحِ عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ:« أَنَّ عَلِيّاً عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ كَانَ إِذَا صَلَّى عَلَى مَيِّتٍ يَقْرَأُ بِفَاتِحَةِ اَلْكِتَابِ وَ يُصَلِّي عَلَى اَلنَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ»
thaqalaynSanad: As for what was narrated by Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya from Ja’far ibn Muhammad from ‘Ubaydullah al-Qummi from Abdullah ibn Maymun al-Qaddah from Imam Ja’far (a.s), from his father (a.s):
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Baqir (a.s) said: “Indeed, Imam Ali (a.s), peace be upon him, when He (a.s) prayed over a deceased person, He (a.s) would recite the ‘Fatihati al-Kitab’ (Surah al-Fatiha) and send blessings upon the Prophet (saws), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 352

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer over the Dead
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Sahl ibn Ziyad from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr from Musa ibn Bakr from Abu al-Hasan (a.s):
Imam (a.s) said: “When you pray (Salat Al Mayyit) over a woman, stand at her head; and when you pray (Salat Al Mayyit) over a man, stand at his chest.”
arabicText: سهل بن زياد عن احمد بن محمد بن ابي نصر عن موسى بن بكر عن ابي الحسن عليه السلام قال إذا صليت على المرأة فقم عند رأسها وأذا صليت على الرجل فقم عند صدره
thaqalaynSanad: Sahl ibn Ziyad from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr from Musa ibn Bakr from Abu al-Hasan (a.s):
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: “When you pray (Salat Al Mayyit) over a woman, stand at her head; and when you pray (Salat Al Mayyit) over a man, stand at his chest.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 352

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer over the Dead
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Yahya ibn Zakariyya, from his father Zakariyya ibn Musa, from al-Qasim ibn Ubaydullah al-Qummi, said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s) about a man who prays over a funeral alone. Imam (a.s) said: “Yes (it is allowed).” I asked: “And what if two pray over it?” Imam (a.s) said: “Yes (it is allowed), but the other should stand behind the one leading, and not stand beside him.”
arabicText: عَلِيُّ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ زَكَرِيَّا عَنْ أَبِيهِ زَكَرِيَّا بْنِ مُوسَى عَنِ اَلْقَاسِمِ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اَللَّهِ اَلْقُمِّيِّ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يُصَلِّي عَلَى جِنَازَةٍ وَحْدَهُ قَالَ« نَعَمْ» قُلْتُ فَاثْنَانِ يُصَلِّيَانِ عَلَيْهَا قَالَ «نَعَمْ وَ لَكِنْ يَقُومُ اَلْآخَرُ خَلْفَ اَلْآخَرِ وَ لاَ يَقُومُ بِجَنْبِهِ»
thaqalaynSanad: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Yahya ibn Zakariyya, from his father Zakariyya ibn Musa, from al-Qasim ibn Ubaydullah al-Qummi, said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s) about a man who prays over a funeral alone. Imam (a.s) said: “Yes (it is allowed).” I asked: “And what if two pray over it?” Imam (a.s) said: “Yes (it is allowed), but the other should stand behind the one leading, and not stand beside him.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 352

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer over the Dead
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ali, from his father, from al-Nawfali, from al-Sakuni, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “The Prophet, may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, said: ‘The best of the rows in prayer is the front one, and the best of the rows in funerals is the last one.’ It was asked: “O Messenger of Allah (swt), and why is that?” Prophet (saws) said: “Because it becomes a screen (barrier), for the women.”
arabicText: عَلِيٌّ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اَلنَّوْفَلِيِّ عَنِ اَلسَّكُونِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« قَالَ اَلنَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ: «خَيْرُ اَلصُّفُوفِ فِي اَلصَّلاَةِ اَلْمُقَدَّمُ وَ خَيْرُ اَلصُّفُوفِ فِي اَلْجَنَائِزِ اَلْمُؤَخَّرُ» قِيلَ يَا رَسُولَ اَللَّهِ وَلِمَ قَالَ« صَارَ سُتْرَةً لِلنِّسَاءِ»»
thaqalaynSanad: Ali, from his father, from al-Nawfali, from al-Sakuni, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “The Prophet, may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, said: ‘The best of the rows in prayer is the front one, and the best of the rows in funerals is the last one.’ It was asked: “O Messenger of Allah (swt), and why is that?” Prophet (saws) said: “Because it becomes a screen (barrier), for the women.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 352

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer over the Dead
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Fadalah, from Aban ibn Uthman, from al-Fadl ibn Abd al-Malik, said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “Is it permitted to pray over the deceased in the mosque?” Imam (a.s) said: “Yes.”
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ أَبَانِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنِ اَلْفَضْلِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَلْمَلِكِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ هَلْ يُصَلَّى عَلَى اَلْمَيِّتِ فِي اَلْمَسْجِدِ قَالَ« نَعَمْ»
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Fadalah, from Aban ibn Uthman, from al-Fadl ibn Abd al-Malik, said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “Is it permitted to pray over the deceased in the mosque?” Imam (a.s) said: “Yes.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 352

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer over the Dead
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText: Sa’ad ibn Abdillah, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from al-Ala ibn Razin, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from one of the two Imams (a.s), peace be upon them: The same as that.
arabicText: سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنِ اَلْعَلاَءِ بْنِ رَزِينٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ أَحَدِهِمَا عَلَيْهِمَا اَلسَّلاَمُ: مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ.
thaqalaynMatn: Sa’ad ibn Abdillah, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from al-Ala ibn Razin, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from one of the two Imams (a.s), peace be upon them: The same as that.

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 353

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer over the Dead
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Sa’ad ibn Abdillah, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Yazid ibn Ishaq Sha'ir, from Harun ibn Hamzah, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “When the time of an obligatory prayer enters, begin with it before the prayer over the deceased, unless the deceased had abdominal illness (mabtun) or was a woman in postpartum bleeding (nufasa) or something like that.” (meaning to hurry and pray Salat Al Mayyit and bury such deceased with such cases)
arabicText: سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ شَعِرٍ عَنْ هَارُونَ بْنِ حَمْزَةَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« إِذَا دَخَلَ وَقْتُ صَلاَةٍ مَكْتُوبَةٍ فَابْدَأْ بِهَا قَبْلَ اَلصَّلاَةِ عَلَى اَلْمَيِّتِ إِلاَّ أَنْ يَكُونَ مَبْطُوناً أَوْ نُفَسَاءَ أَوْ نَحْوَ ذَلِكَ»
thaqalaynSanad: Sa’ad ibn Abdillah, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Yazid ibn Ishaq Sha'ir, from Harun ibn Hamzah, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “When the time of an obligatory prayer enters, begin with it before the prayer over the deceased, unless the deceased had abdominal illness (mabtun) or was a woman in postpartum bleeding (nufasa) or something like that.” (meaning to hurry and pray Salat Al Mayyit and bury such deceased with such cases)

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 353

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer over the Dead
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ali ibn al-Husayn, from Ahmad ibn Idris, from Muhammad ibn Salim, from Ahmad ibn al-Nadr, from Amr ibn Shimr, from Jabir, said:
I said to Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him: “If I am present for the funeral prayer at the time of an obligatory prayer, which one should I begin with?” Imam (a.s) said: “Hasten the deceased to his grave, unless you fear that the time for the obligatory prayer will pass. And do not delay the prayer over the deceased until the rising of the sun or its setting.” (meaning to hasten to bury the deceased, as possible)
arabicText: عَلِيُّ بْنُ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ إِدْرِيسَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سَالِمٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ اَلنَّضْرِ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ شِمْرٍ عَنْ جَابِرٍ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ إِذَا حَضَرْتُ اَلصَّلاَةَ عَلَى اَلْجِنَازَةِ فِي وَقْتِ مَكْتُوبَةٍ فَبِأَيِّهَا أَبْدَأُ فَقَالَ« عَجِّلِ اَلْمَيِّتَ إِلَى قَبْرِهِ إِلاَّ أَنْ تَخَافَ أَنْ يَفُوتَ وَقْتُ اَلْفَرِيضَةِ وَ لاَ تَنْتَظِرْ بِالصَّلاَةِ عَلَى اَلْجَنَائِزِ طُلُوعَ اَلشَّمْسِ وَ لاَ غُرُوبَهَا»
thaqalaynSanad: Ali ibn al-Husayn, from Ahmad ibn Idris, from Muhammad ibn Salim, from Ahmad ibn al-Nadr, from Amr ibn Shimr, from Jabir, said:
thaqalaynMatn: I said to Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him: “If I am present for the funeral prayer at the time of an obligatory prayer, which one should I begin with?” Imam (a.s) said: “Hasten the deceased to his grave, unless you fear that the time for the obligatory prayer will pass. And do not delay the prayer over the deceased until the rising of the sun or its setting.” (meaning to hasten to bury the deceased, as possible)

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 353

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer over the Dead
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Musa ibn al-Qasim al-Bajali and Abu Qatadah al-Qummi, from Ali ibn Ja’far, from his brother Musa ibn Ja’far, peace be upon them, said:
I asked Imam al-Kadhim (a.s) about the funeral prayer if the sun has turned red, does it become valid or not? Imam (a.s) said: “There is no prayer during the time of (another) prayer.” And Imam (a.s) said: “When the sun sets, then perform the Maghrib prayer, then perform the prayer over the funeral.”
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ اَلْقَاسِمِ اَلْبَجَلِيِّ وَ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ اَلْقُمِّيِّ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَخِيهِ مُوسَى بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِمَا اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ صَلاَةِ اَلْجَنَائِزِ إِذَا اِحْمَرَّتِ اَلشَّمْسُ أَ يَصْلُحُ أَوْلاَ قَالَ« لاَ صَلاَةَ فِي وَقْتِ صَلاَةٍ» وَ قَالَ« إِذَا وَجَبَتِ اَلشَّمْسُ فَصَلِّ اَلْمَغْرِبَ ثُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى اَلْجَنَائِزِ
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Musa ibn al-Qasim al-Bajali and Abu Qatadah al-Qummi, from Ali ibn Ja’far, from his brother Musa ibn Ja’far, peace be upon them, said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Imam al-Kadhim (a.s) about the funeral prayer if the sun has turned red, does it become valid or not? Imam (a.s) said: “There is no prayer during the time of (another) prayer.” And Imam (a.s) said: “When the sun sets, then perform the Maghrib prayer, then perform the prayer over the funeral.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 353

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer over the Dead
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Humayd ibn Ziyad, from al-Hasan ibn Muhammad ibn Sama'ah, from more than one person, from Aban, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “Do any of these hours prevent you from praying over the funerals?” Imam (a.s) said, “No.”
arabicText: حُمَيْدُ بْنُ زِيَادٍ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سَمَاعَةَ عَنْ غَيْرِ وَاحِدٍ عَنْ أَبَانٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ هَلْ يَمْنَعُكَ شَيْءٌ مِنْ هَذِهِ اَلسَّاعَاتِ عَنِ اَلصَّلاَةِ عَلَى اَلْجَنَائِزِ فَقَالَ« لاَ»
thaqalaynSanad: Humayd ibn Ziyad, from al-Hasan ibn Muhammad ibn Sama'ah, from more than one person, from Aban, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “Do any of these hours prevent you from praying over the funerals?” Imam (a.s) said, “No.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 353

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer over the Dead
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Abu Ali al-Ash'ari, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Jabbar, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from al-Ala ibn Razin, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, said:
Imam al-Baqir (a.s) said: “The funeral prayer is performed at any hour, for it is not a prayer of bowing (ruku') or prostration (sujud). Rather, what is disliked is the prayer at sunrise and at sunset the one that contains humility (khushu), bowing (rukuh), and prostration (sujud) because sun sets between the horns of a devil and it rises between the horns of a devil.” (meaning metaphorical warning not to imitate non-Islamic or pagan rituals as they used to do)
arabicText: أبو علي الاشعري عن محمد بن عبد الجبار عن صفوان بن يحيى عن العلا بن رزين عن محمد بن مسلم عن ابي جعفر عليه السلام قال يصلى على الجنازة في كل ساعة انها ليست بصلاة ركوع ولا سجود وإنما تكره الصلاة عند طلوع الشمس وعند غروبها التي فيها الخشوع والركوع والسجود لانها تغرب بين قرني شيطان وتطلع بين قرني شيطان
thaqalaynSanad: Abu Ali al-Ash'ari, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Jabbar, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from al-Ala ibn Razin, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Baqir (a.s) said: “The funeral prayer is performed at any hour, for it is not a prayer of bowing (ruku') or prostration (sujud). Rather, what is disliked is the prayer at sunrise and at sunset the one that contains humility (khushu), bowing (rukuh), and prostration (sujud) because sun sets between the horns of a devil and it rises between the horns of a devil.” (meaning metaphorical warning not to imitate non-Islamic or pagan rituals as they used to do)

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 353

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer over the Dead
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad ibn Uthman, from Ubaydullah al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “There is no harm in performing the funeral prayer when the sun sets and when it rises; it is merely a seeking of forgiveness.”
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اَللَّهِ اَلْحَلَبِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «لاَ بَأْسَ بِالصَّلاَةِ عَلَى اَلْجَنَائِزِ حِينَ تَغِيبُ اَلشَّمْسُ وَ حِينَ تَطْلُعُ إِنَّمَا هُوَ اِسْتِغْفَارٌ»
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad ibn Uthman, from Ubaydullah al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “There is no harm in performing the funeral prayer when the sun sets and when it rises; it is merely a seeking of forgiveness.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 354

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer over the Dead
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
As for what was narrated by al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from al-Qasim ibn Muhammad from Aban from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Abdillah from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “It is disliked to perform the funeral prayer when the sun turns yellow and when it rises.”
arabicText: فَأَمَّا مَا رَوَاهُ اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ اَلْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَبَانٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَلرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« تُكْرَهُ اَلصَّلاَةُ عَلَى اَلْجَنَائِزِ حِينَ تَصْفَرُّ اَلشَّمْسُ وَ حِينَ تَطْلُعُ»
thaqalaynSanad: As for what was narrated by al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from al-Qasim ibn Muhammad from Aban from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Abdillah from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “It is disliked to perform the funeral prayer when the sun turns yellow and when it rises.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 354

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer over the Dead
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, from al-Ala ibn Razin, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, said:
I asked Imam al-Baqir (a.s): “How is the funeral prayer performed over men and women?” (meaning the congregation) Imam (a.s) said: “The men are placed in the front where the men stand, and the women are placed behind the men.”

thaqalaynSanad: Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, from al-Ala ibn Razin, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, said:

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer over the Dead
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad, from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ali, from Amr ibn Sa’id, from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah, from Ammar ibn Musa, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) was asked regarding a man who performs the funeral prayer over two or three deceased persons (together), how should he pray over them? Imam (a.s) said: “If they are three, or two, or ten, or more than that, let him perform one prayer over them. He (leader of prayer) should pronounce five takbirs over them, just as he does for a single deceased person. He has thus prayed over all of them. He should place one deceased person, then place the next one at the buttocks (Aliyah) of the first, then place the head of the third at the buttocks (aliyah) of the second, in a stepped arrangement (shibh al-madrar) until he finishes arranging all of them, however many they may be. Once he has arranged them like this, he should stand in the middle and pronounce five takbirs, doing just as he would when praying over a single deceased person.” Imam (a.s) was asked, “And if they are deceased men and women?” Imam (a.s) said: “He begins with the men, placing the head of the second at the buttocks (Aliyah) of the first, until he finishes with all the men. Then he places the head of the woman at the buttocks (Aliyah) of the last man. Then he places the head of the next woman at the head of the first woman, until he finishes arranging all of them. Once he has arranged them in this way, he stands in the middle, in the center of the men, and pronounces the takbirs and performs the prayer over them just as he does when praying over a single deceased person.” Imam (a.s) was asked about a deceased person over whom the funeral prayer was performed, and after the imam (of prayer) had given the taslim, it was discovered that the deceased was turned around, with his feet where his head should have been. Imam (a.s) said: “He should be straightened, and the prayer should be repeated over him. And if he had been carried away but not yet buried, then it is to be repeated. But if he has already been buried, then the prayer has passed and is not to be repeated while he is buried.”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُصَدِّقِ بْنِ صَدَقَةَ عَنْ عَمَّارِ بْنِ مُوسَى عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: فِي اَلرَّجُلِ يُصَلِّي عَلَى مَيِّتَيْنِ أَوْ ثَلاَثَةِ مَوْتَى كَيْفَ يُصَلِّي عَلَيْهِمْ قَالَ« إِنْ كَانَ ثَلاَثَةً أَوِ اِثْنَيْنِ أَوْ عَشَرَةً أَوْ أَكْثَرَ مِنْ ذَلِكَ فَلْيُصَلِّ عَلَيْهِمْ صَلاَةً وَاحِدَةً يُكَبِّرُ عَلَيْهِمْ خَمْسَ تَكْبِيرَاتٍ كَمَا يُصَلِّي عَلَى مَيِّتٍ وَاحِدٍ وَ قَدْ صَلَّى عَلَيْهِمْ جَمِيعاً يَضَعُ مَيِّتاً وَاحِداً ثُمَّ يَجْعَلُ اَلْآخَرَ إِلَى أَلْيَةِ اَلْأَوَّلِ ثُمَّ يَجْعَلُ رَأْسَ اَلثَّالِثِ إِلَى أَلْيَةِ اَلثَّانِي شِبْهَ اَلْمَدْرَجِ حَتَّى يَفْرُغَ مِنْهُمْ كُلِّهِمْ مَا كَانُوا فَإِذَا سَوَّاهُمْ هَكَذَا قَامَ فِي اَلْوَسَطِ فَكَبَّرَ خَمْسَ تَكْبِيرَاتٍ يَفْعَلُ كَمَا يَفْعَلُ إِذَا صَلَّى عَلَى مَيِّتٍ وَاحِدٍ سُئِلَ فَإِنْ كَانُوا مَوْتَى رِجَالاً وَنِسَاءً» قَالَ« يَبْدَأُ بِالرِّجَالِ فَيَجْعَلُ رَأْسَ اَلثَّانِي إِلَى أَلْيَةِ اَلْأَوَّلِ حَتَّى يَفْرُغَ مِنَ اَلرِّجَالِ كُلِّهِمْ ثُمَّ يَجْعَلُ رَأْسَ اَلْمَرْأَةِ إِلَى أَلْيَةِ اَلرَّجُلِ اَلْأَخِيرِ ثُمَّ يَجْعَلُ رَأْسَ اَلْمَرْأَةِ اَلْأُخْرَى إِلَى رَأْسِ اَلْمَرْأَةِ اَلْأُولَى حَتَّى يَفْرُغَ مِنْهُمْ كُلِّهِمْ فَإِذَا سَوَّى هَكَذَا قَامَ فِي اَلْوَسَطِ وَسَطِ اَلرِّجَالِ فَكَبَّرَ وَ صَلَّى عَلَيْهِمْ كَمَا يُصَلِّي عَلَى مَيِّتٍ وَاحِدٍ» سُئِلَ عَنْ مَيِّتٍ صُلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ فَلَمَّا سَلَّمَ اَلْإِمَامُ فَإِذَا اَلْمَيِّتُ مَقْلُوبٌ رِجْلَيْهِ إِلَى مَوْضِعِ رَأْسِهِ قَالَ« يُسَوَّى وَ تُعَادُ اَلصَّلاَةُ عَلَيْهِ وَ إِنْ كَانَ قَدْ حُمِلَ مَا لَمْ يُدْفَنْ فَإِنْ كَانَ قَدْ دُفِنَ فَقَدْ مَضَتِ اَلصَّلاَةُ وَ لاَ يُصَلَّى عَلَيْهِ وَ هُوَ مَدْفُونٌ»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ahmad, from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ali, from Amr ibn Sa’id, from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah, from Ammar ibn Musa, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) was asked regarding a man who performs the funeral prayer over two or three deceased persons (together), how should he pray over them? Imam (a.s) said: “If they are three, or two, or ten, or more than that, let him perform one prayer over them. He (leader of prayer) should pronounce five takbirs over them, just as he does for a single deceased person. He has thus prayed over all of them. He should place one deceased person, then place the next one at the buttocks (Aliyah) of the first, then place the head of the third at the buttocks (aliyah) of the second, in a stepped arrangement (shibh al-madrar) until he finishes arranging all of them, however many they may be. Once he has arranged them like this, he should stand in the middle and pronounce five takbirs, doing just as he would when praying over a single deceased person.” Imam (a.s) was asked, “And if they are deceased men and women?” Imam (a.s) said: “He begins with the men, placing the head of the second at the buttocks (Aliyah) of the first, until he finishes with all the men. Then he places the head of the woman at the buttocks (Aliyah) of the last man. Then he places the head of the next woman at the head of the first woman, until he finishes arranging all of them. Once he has arranged them in this way, he stands in the middle, in the center of the men, and pronounces the takbirs and performs the prayer over them just as he does when praying over a single deceased person.” Imam (a.s) was asked about a deceased person over whom the funeral prayer was performed, and after the imam (of prayer) had given the taslim, it was discovered that the deceased was turned around, with his feet where his head should have been. Imam (a.s) said: “He should be straightened, and the prayer should be repeated over him. And if he had been carried away but not yet buried, then it is to be repeated. But if he has already been buried, then the prayer has passed and is not to be repeated while he is buried.”

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer over the Dead
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Abu Ali al-Ash'ari, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Jabbar, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from al-Ala, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from one of the two Imams (a.s), peace be upon them, said:
I asked Imam (a.s) about (Salat Al Mayyit) men and women (together), how is the funeral prayer performed over them? Imam (a.s) said: “The man is placed in front of the women, in the position closest to the imam (of prayer), and they are lined up, one following another.”
arabicText: أَبُو عَلِيٍّ اَلْأَشْعَرِيُّ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَلْجَبَّارِ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنِ اَلْعَلاَءِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ أَحَدِهِمَا عَلَيْهِمَا اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلرِّجَالِ وَاَلنِّسَاءِ كَيْفَ يُصَلَّى عَلَيْهِمْ قَالَ« اَلرَّجُلُ أَمَامَ اَلنِّسَاءِ مِمَّا يَلِي اَلْإِمَامَ يَصُفُّ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَى أَثَرِ بَعْضٍ»
thaqalaynSanad: Abu Ali al-Ash'ari, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Jabbar, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from al-Ala, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from one of the two Imams (a.s), peace be upon them, said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Imam (a.s) about (Salat Al Mayyit) men and women (together), how is the funeral prayer performed over them? Imam (a.s) said: “The man is placed in front of the women, in the position closest to the imam (of prayer), and they are lined up, one following another.”

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer over the Dead
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī

Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad, from Zurarah and al-Halabi:

thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad, from Zurarah and al-Halabi:

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer over the Dead
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ali ibn al-Husayn, from Abdillah ibn Ja’far, from Ibrahim ibn Mahziyar, from his brother Ali ibn Mahziyar, from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal, from Ibn Bukayr, from some of his companions, from Abu Abdillah (a.s):
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) was asked regarding the funerals of men, children, and women. Imam (a.s) said: “The women are placed closest to the qiblah (furthest from the imam of prayer), the children below them, and the men below that, and the imam (of prayer) stands closest to the men.”
arabicText: عَلِيُّ بْنُ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ مَهْزِيَارَ عَنْ أَخِيهِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَهْزِيَارَ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ بُكَيْرٍ عَنْ بَعْضِ أَصْحَابِهِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: فِي جَنَائِزِ اَلرِّجَالِ وَاَلصِّبْيَانِ وَاَلنِّسَاءِ قَالَ «تُوضَعُ اَلنِّسَاءُ مِمَّا يَلِي اَلْقِبْلَةَ وَ اَلصِّبْيَانُ دُونَهُنَّ وَ اَلرِّجَالُ دُونَ ذَلِكَ وَ يَقُومُ اَلْإِمَامُ مِمَّا يَلِي اَلرِّجَالَ»
thaqalaynSanad: Ali ibn al-Husayn, from Abdillah ibn Ja’far, from Ibrahim ibn Mahziyar, from his brother Ali ibn Mahziyar, from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal, from Ibn Bukayr, from some of his companions, from Abu Abdillah (a.s):
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) was asked regarding the funerals of men, children, and women. Imam (a.s) said: “The women are placed closest to the qiblah (furthest from the imam of prayer), the children below them, and the men below that, and the imam (of prayer) stands closest to the men.”

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer over the Dead
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Ali ibn al-Salt, from Abdillah ibn al-Salt, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad ibn Uthman, from Ubaydullah al-Halabi, who said:
I asked Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) about a man and a woman, over whom the funeral prayer is performed (together). Imam (a.s) said: “The man is placed in front of the woman, closest to the qiblah, so that the woman's head is at the level of the man's thighs, on his left side. And her head is also on the left side of the imam (of prayer), while the man's head is on the right side of the imam (of prayer).”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ اَلصَّلْتِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ اَلصَّلْتِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اَللَّهِ اَلْحَلَبِيِّ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ وَاَلْمَرْأَةِ يُصَلَّى عَلَيْهِمَا قَالَ« يَكُونُ اَلرَّجُلُ بَيْنَ يَدَيِ اَلْمَرْأَةِ مِمَّا يَلِي اَلْقِبْلَةَ فَيَكُونُ رَأْسُ اَلْمَرْأَةِ عِنْدَ وَرِكَيِ اَلرَّجُلِ مِمَّا يَلِي يَسَارَهُ وَ يَكُونُ رَأْسُهَا أَيْضاً مِمَّا يَلِي يَسَارَ اَلْإِمَامِ وَ رَأْسُ اَلرَّجُلِ بِمَا يَلِي يَمِينَ اَلْإِمَامِ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Ali ibn al-Salt, from Abdillah ibn al-Salt, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad ibn Uthman, from Ubaydullah al-Halabi, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) about a man and a woman, over whom the funeral prayer is performed (together). Imam (a.s) said: “The man is placed in front of the woman, closest to the qiblah, so that the woman's head is at the level of the man's thighs, on his left side. And her head is also on the left side of the imam (of prayer), while the man's head is on the right side of the imam (of prayer).”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 356

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer over the Dead
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ali ibn al-Husayn, from Sa’ad ibn Abdillah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn al-Hakam and Muhammad ibn Isma'il ibn Bazi', from Hisham ibn Salim, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “There is no harm if the man is placed in front, and the woman behind, Or the woman is placed in front, and the man behind” (meaning in the funeral prayer over the deceased).
arabicText: عَلِيُّ بْنُ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ اَلْحَكَمِ وَ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ بَزِيعٍ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ سَالِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« لاَ بَأْسَ بِأَنْ يُقَدَّمَ اَلرَّجُلُ وَ تُؤَخَّرَ اَلْمَرْأَةُ وَ تُقَدَّمَ اَلْمَرْأَةُ وَ يُؤَخَّرَ اَلرَّجُلُ يَعْنِي فِي اَلصَّلاَةِ عَلَى اَلْمَيِّتِ»
thaqalaynSanad: Ali ibn al-Husayn, from Sa’ad ibn Abdillah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn al-Hakam and Muhammad ibn Isma'il ibn Bazi', from Hisham ibn Salim, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “There is no harm if the man is placed in front, and the woman behind, Or the woman is placed in front, and the man behind” (meaning in the funeral prayer over the deceased).

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 356

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer over the Dead
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ali ibn al-Husayn, from Sa’ad ibn Abdillah, from al-Hasan ibn Musa al-Khashshab, from Ghiyath ibn Kallub ibn Fayhas al-Bajali, from Ishaq ibn Ammar, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “Indeed, the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, performed the funeral prayer over a deceased person. When Prophet (saws) finished, a group of people came and said; ‘O Messenger of Allah (swt), we missed the prayer over him.’ So the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, said: ‘A funeral is not prayed over twice. Supplicate for him and say good things’.”
arabicText: عَلِيُّ بْنُ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ مُوسَى اَلْخَشَّابِ عَنْ غِيَاثِ بْنِ كَلُّوبِ بْنِ فَيْهَسٍ اَلْبَجَلِيِّ عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« إِنَّ رَسُولَ اَللَّهِ صَ صَلَّى عَلَى جِنَازَةٍ فَلَمَّا فَرَغَ جَاءَ قَوْمٌ فَقَالُوا يَا رَسُولُ فَاتَتْنَا اَلصَّلاَةُ عَلَيْهَا فَقَالَ صَ« إِنَّ اَلْجِنَازَةَ لاَ يُصَلَّى عَلَيْهَا مَرَّتَيْنِ اُدْعُوا لَهُ وَ قُولُوا خَيْراً»»
thaqalaynSanad: Ali ibn al-Husayn, from Sa’ad ibn Abdillah, from al-Hasan ibn Musa al-Khashshab, from Ghiyath ibn Kallub ibn Fayhas al-Bajali, from Ishaq ibn Ammar, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “Indeed, the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, performed the funeral prayer over a deceased person. When Prophet (saws) finished, a group of people came and said; ‘O Messenger of Allah (swt), we missed the prayer over him.’ So the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, said: ‘A funeral is not prayed over twice. Supplicate for him and say good things’.”

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer over the Dead
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad, from al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah (a.s):
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “The Commander of the Faithful, peace be upon him, performed five takbirs over Sahl ibn Hunayf, who had participated in Badr. Then Imam Ali (a.s) walked for a while (with his bier), then placed him down and performed another five takbirs over him. He (a.s) continued doing this until he had pronounced twenty-five takbirs over him.”
arabicText: عَلِيُّ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنِ اَلْحَلَبِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« كَبَّرَ أَمِيرُ اَلْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَى سَهْلِ بْنِ حُنَيْفٍ وَ كَانَ بَدْرِيّاً خَمْسَ تَكْبِيرَاتٍ ثُمَّ مَشَى سَاعَةً ثُمَّ وَضَعَهُ وَ كَبَّرَ عَلَيْهِ خَمْساً أُخْرَى يَصْنَعُ ذَلِكَ حَتَّى كَبَّرَ عَلَيْهِ خَمْساً وَ عِشْرِينَ تَكْبِيرَةً»
thaqalaynSanad: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad, from al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah (a.s):
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “The Commander of the Faithful, peace be upon him, performed five takbirs over Sahl ibn Hunayf, who had participated in Badr. Then Imam Ali (a.s) walked for a while (with his bier), then placed him down and performed another five takbirs over him. He (a.s) continued doing this until he had pronounced twenty-five takbirs over him.”

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer over the Dead
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ali ibn al-Husayn, from Ahmad ibn Idris, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Ahmad ibn al-Nadr, from Amr ibn Shimr, from Jabir, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, said:
I said to Imam al-Baqir (a.s): “What do you say if I miss a takbir or more (of Salat Al Mayyit)?” Imam (a.s) said: “Make up what you missed.” Iasked: “Should I face the qiblah?” Imam (a.s) said: “Yes, while you are following the funeral. Indeed, the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, went out for the funeral of a woman from Banu Najjar and prayed over her. Then Prophet (saws) found the grave had not yet been prepared, so they placed the bier down. And whenever a group came, He (saws), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, would say to them; ‘Pray over her’.”
arabicText: عَلِيُّ بْنُ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ إِدْرِيسَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ اَلنَّضْرِ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ شِمْرٍ عَنْ جَابِرٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لَهُ أَرَأَيْتَ إِنْ فَاتَتْنِي تَكْبِيرَةٌ أَوْ أَكْثَرُ قَالَ« تَقْضِي مَا فَاتَكَ» قُلْتُ أَسْتَقْبِلُ اَلْقِبْلَةَ قَالَ« بَلَى وَ أَنْتَ تَتْبَعُ اَلْجَنَازَةَ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ خَرَجَ عَلَى جِنَازَةِ اِمْرَأَةٍ مِنْ بَنِي اَلنَّجَّارِ فَصَلَّى عَلَيْهَا فَوَجَدَ اَلْحَفَرَةَ لَمْ يُمَكَّنُوا فَوَضَعُوا اَلْجَنَازَةَ فَلَمْ يَجِئْ قَوْمٌ إِلاَّ قَالَ لَهُمْ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ« صَلُّوا عَلَيْهَا»»
thaqalaynSanad: Ali ibn al-Husayn, from Ahmad ibn Idris, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Ahmad ibn al-Nadr, from Amr ibn Shimr, from Jabir, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, said:
thaqalaynMatn: I said to Imam al-Baqir (a.s): “What do you say if I miss a takbir or more (of Salat Al Mayyit)?” Imam (a.s) said: “Make up what you missed.” Iasked: “Should I face the qiblah?” Imam (a.s) said: “Yes, while you are following the funeral. Indeed, the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, went out for the funeral of a woman from Banu Najjar and prayed over her. Then Prophet (saws) found the grave had not yet been prepared, so they placed the bier down. And whenever a group came, He (saws), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, would say to them; ‘Pray over her’.”

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer over the Dead
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ali ibn al-Husayn, from Sa’ad ibn Abdillah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Fadalah, from Aban, from al-Fadl ibn Abd al-Malik, said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “Is it permitted to perform the funeral prayer over the deceased in the mosque?” Imam (a.s) said: “Yes.”
arabicText: علي بن الحسين عن سعد بن عبد الله عن احمد بن محمد ابن عيسى عن الحسين بن سعيد عن فضالة عن ابان عن الفضل بن عبد الملك قال سألت ابا عبد الله عليه السلام هل يصلى على الميت في المسجد؟ قال نعم
thaqalaynSanad: Ali ibn al-Husayn, from Sa’ad ibn Abdillah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Fadalah, from Aban, from al-Fadl ibn Abd al-Malik, said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “Is it permitted to perform the funeral prayer over the deceased in the mosque?” Imam (a.s) said: “Yes.”

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer over the Dead
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText: From him, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from al-Ala ibn Razin, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from one of the two Imams (a.s), peace be upon them: The same as that.
arabicText: عنه عن محمد بن يحيى عن محمد بن الحسين عن محمد بن سنان عن العلا بن رزين عن محمد بن مسلم عن أحدهما عليه السلام مثل ذلك

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer over the Dead
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, from Dawud ibn al-Husayn, from Fadl al-Baqbaq, who said:
I asked Imam (a.s) about the deceased, whether the funeral prayer (Salat Al Mayyit) may be performed over him in the mosque. Imam (a.s) said: “Yes.”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي نَصْرٍ عَنْ دَاوُدَ بْنِ اَلْحُصَيْنِ عَنْ فَضْلٍ اَلْبَقْبَاقِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلْمَيِّتِ هَلْ يُصَلَّى عَلَيْهِ فِي اَلْمَسْجِدِ قَالَ« نَعَمْ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, from Dawud ibn al-Husayn, from Fadl al-Baqbaq, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Imam (a.s) about the deceased, whether the funeral prayer (Salat Al Mayyit) may be performed over him in the mosque. Imam (a.s) said: “Yes.”

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer over the Dead
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ya'qub, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Musa ibn Talhah, from Abu Bakr ibn Isa ibn Ahmad al-Alawi, said:
I was in the mosque and a funeral (bier) was brought in, and I intended to pray over it. Then Abu al-Hasan al-Awwal (a.s) (the First), peace be upon him, came and placed his elbow against my chest and began to push me until he drove me out of the mosque. Then Imam (a.s) said: “O’ Abu Bakr (ibn Isa), funeral prayers are not to be performed in mosques.”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ طَلْحَةَ عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ عِيسَى بْنِ أَحْمَدَ اَلْعَلَوِيِّ قَالَ: كُنْتُ فِي اَلْمَسْجِدِ وَ قَدْ جِيءَ بِجَنَازَةٍ فَأَرَدْتُ أَنْ أُصَلِّيَ عَلَيْهَا فَجَاءَ أَبُو اَلْحَسَنِ اَلْأَوَّلُ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ فَوَضَعَ مِرْفَقَهُ فِي صَدْرِي فَجَعَلَ يَدْفَعُنِي حَتَّى أَخْرَجَنِي مِنَ اَلْمَسْجِدِ ثُمَّ قَالَ« يَا أَبَا بَكْرٍ إِنَّ اَلْجَنَائِزَ لاَ يُصَلَّى عَلَيْهَا فِي اَلْمَسَاجِدِ»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Musa ibn Talhah, from Abu Bakr ibn Isa ibn Ahmad al-Alawi, said:
thaqalaynMatn: I was in the mosque and a funeral (bier) was brought in, and I intended to pray over it. Then Abu al-Hasan al-Awwal (a.s) (the First), peace be upon him, came and placed his elbow against my chest and began to push me until he drove me out of the mosque. Then Imam (a.s) said: “O’ Abu Bakr (ibn Isa), funeral prayers are not to be performed in mosques.”

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer over the Dead
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Sahl ibn Ziyad, from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal, from Ali ibn Uqbah, from the wife of al-Hasan al-Sayqal, from al-Hasan al-Sayqal, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) was asked: “How do women perform the funeral prayer if there is no man with them?” Imam (a.s) said: “They all stand in a row, and no woman advances in front of the others.” (meaning the women leading the prayer stands in the middle of the front row)
arabicText: سَهْلُ بْنُ زِيَادٍ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ عُقْبَةَ عَنِ اِمْرَأَةِ اَلْحَسَنِ اَلصَّيْقَلِ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ اَلصَّيْقَلِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سُئِلَ كَيْفَ تُصَلِّي اَلنِّسَاءُ عَلَى اَلْجِنَازَةِ إِذَا لَمْ يَكُنْ مَعَهُنَّ رَجُلٌ قَالَ« يَصْفُفْنَ جَمِيعاً فَلاَ تَتَقَدَّمُهُنَّ اِمْرَأَةٌ»
thaqalaynSanad: Sahl ibn Ziyad, from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal, from Ali ibn Uqbah, from the wife of al-Hasan al-Sayqal, from al-Hasan al-Sayqal, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) was asked: “How do women perform the funeral prayer if there is no man with them?” Imam (a.s) said: “They all stand in a row, and no woman advances in front of the others.” (meaning the women leading the prayer stands in the middle of the front row)

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 358

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer over the Dead
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Abu Ali al-Ash'ari, from Muhammad ibn Salim, from Ahmad ibn al-Nadr, from Amr ibn Shimr, from Jabir, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, said:
Imam al-Baqir (a.s) said: “If no man is present, a woman steps forward to the center of them (in the same row), and the women stand to her right and to her left, and she is in their midst. She pronounces the takbirs until she completes the prayer.”
arabicText: أَبُو عَلِيٍّ اَلْأَشْعَرِيُّ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سَالِمٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ اَلنَّضْرِ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ شِمْرٍ عَنْ جَابِرٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« إِذَا لَمْ يَحْضُرِ اَلرَّجُلُ تَقَدَّمَتِ اِمْرَأَةٌ وَسَطَهُنَّ وَ قَامَ اَلنِّسَاءُ عَنْ يَمِينِهَا وَ شِمَالِهَا وَ هِيَ وَسَطُهُنَّ تُكَبِّرُ حَتَّى تَفْرُغَ مِنَ اَلصَّلاَةِ»
thaqalaynSanad: Abu Ali al-Ash'ari, from Muhammad ibn Salim, from Ahmad ibn al-Nadr, from Amr ibn Shimr, from Jabir, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Baqir (a.s) said: “If no man is present, a woman steps forward to the center of them (in the same row), and the women stand to her right and to her left, and she is in their midst. She pronounces the takbirs until she completes the prayer.”

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer over the Dead
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Faddal, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Najran, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Hurayz, from Zurarah, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, said:
I said to Imam al-Baqir (a.s): “May a woman lead other women in prayer?” Imam (a.s) said, “No, except over a deceased person (Salat Al Mayyit), if there is no one more entitled than her. She stands in the middle of them in the (same) row with them, pronounces the takbirs, and they pronounce the takbirs.”
arabicText: علي بن الحسن بن فضال عن عبد الرحمن بن ابى نجران عن حماد بن عيسى عن حريز عن زرارة عن ابي جعفر عليه السلام قال قلت له المرأة تؤم النساء؟ قال لا إلا على الميت إذا لم يكن له أحد أولى منها تقوم وسطهن في الصف معهن فتكبر ويكبرن
thaqalaynSanad: Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Faddal, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Najran, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Hurayz, from Zurarah, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, said:
thaqalaynMatn: I said to Imam al-Baqir (a.s): “May a woman lead other women in prayer?” Imam (a.s) said, “No, except over a deceased person (Salat Al Mayyit), if there is no one more entitled than her. chapter: Chapter on the Prayer over the Dead
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Yahya, from al-‘Amraki ibn Ali, from Ali ibn Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, from his brother Imam Musa ibn Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon them, said:
I asked Imam al-Kadhim (a.s) about a group who had pronounced one or two takbirs over a funeral, and then another body was brought and placed with it, what should they do? Imam (a.s) said: “If they wish, they may leave the first one (at its place) until they finish the takbirs over the second. And if they wish, they may remove the first (bier) and complete the remaining takbirs over the second (bier). All of that is permissible and there is no harm in it.”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى عَنِ اَلْعَمْرَكِيِّ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ أَخِيهِ مُوسَى بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِمَا اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ قَوْمٍ كَبَّرُوا عَلَى جِنَازَةٍ تَكْبِيرَةً أَوِ اِثْنَتَيْنِ وَ وُضِعَتْ مَعَهَا أُخْرَى كَيْفَ يَصْنَعُونَ قَالَ« إِنْ شَاءُوا تَرَكُوا اَلْأُولَى حَتَّى يَفْرُغُوا مِنَ اَلتَّكْبِيرِ عَلَى اَلْأَخِيرَةِ وَ إِنْ شَاءُوا رَفَعُوا اَلْأُولَى فَأَتَمُّوا مَا بَقِيَ عَلَى اَلْأَخِيرَةِ كُلُّ ذَلِكَ لاَ بَأْسَ بِهِ»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from al-‘Amraki ibn Ali, from Ali ibn Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, from his brother Imam Musa ibn Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon them, said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Imam al-Kadhim (a.s) about a group who had pronounced one or two takbirs over a funeral, and then another body was brought and placed with it, what should they do? Imam (a.s) said: “If they wish, they may leave the first one (at its place) until they finish the takbirs over the second. And if they wish, they may remove the first (bier) and complete the remaining takbirs over the second (bier). All of that is permissible and there is no harm in it.”

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer over the Dead
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ali ibn Ibrahim, from Abu Hashim al-Ja’fari, said:
I asked Imam al-Ridha (a.s), peace be upon him, about the crucified (person). Imam (a.s) said: “Do you not know that my grandfather (a.s), peace be upon him, prayed over his uncle?” I asked: “I know that, but I do not understand it clearly.” Imam (a.s) said: “I will clarify it for you. If the face of the crucified is toward the qiblah, then stand at his right shoulder. And if his back is toward the qiblah, then stand at his left shoulder. Indeed, between the east and the west is a qiblah. So if his left shoulder is toward the qiblah, then stand at his right shoulder. And if his right shoulder is toward the qiblah, then stand at his left shoulder. And however he is turned, do not separate yourself from his shoulders, and let your face be toward what lies between the east and the west (Qiblah). Do not face him directly, and do not turn your back to him at all.” Abu Hashim said: “And I have understood, if Allah (swt) wills. I have understood, by Allah (swt)”.
arabicText: عَلِيُّ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِي هَاشِمٍ اَلْجَعْفَرِيِّ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ اَلرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلْمَصْلُوبِ فَقَالَ« أَ مَا عَلِمْتَ أَنَّ جَدِّي عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ صَلَّى عَلَى عَمِّهِ» قُلْتُ أَعْلَمُ ذَلِكَ وَ لَكِنِّي لاَ أَفْهَمُهُ مُبَيَّناً قَالَ« أُبَيِّنُهُ لَكَ إِنْ كَانَ وَجْهُ اَلْمَصْلُوبِ إِلَى اَلْقِبْلَةِ فَقُمْ عَلَى مَنْكِبِهِ اَلْأَيْمَنِ وَ إِنْ كَانَ قَفَاهُ إِلَى اَلْقِبْلَةِ فَقُمْ عَلَى مَنْكِبِهِ اَلْأَيْسَرِ فَإِنَّ بَيْنَ اَلْمَشْرِقِ وَ اَلْمَغْرِبِ قِبْلَةً فَإِنْ كَانَ مَنْكِبُهُ اَلْأَيْسَرُ إِلَى اَلْقِبْلَةِ فَقُمْ عَلَى مَنْكِبِهِ اَلْأَيْمَنِ وَ إِنْ كَانَ مَنْكِبُهُ اَلْأَيْمَنُ عَلَى اَلْقِبْلَةِ فَقُمْ عَلَى مَنْكِبِهِ اَلْأَ يْسَرِ وَ كَيْفَ كَانَ مُنْحَرِفاً فَلاَ تُزَايِلَنَّ مَنَاكِبَهُ وَ لْيَكُنْ وَجْهُكَ إِلَى مَا بَيْنَ اَلْمَشْرِقِ وَ اَلْمَغْرِبِ وَ لاَ تَسْتَقْبِلْهُ وَ لاَ تَسْتَدْبِرْهُ اَلْبَتَّةَ» قَالَ أَبُو هَاشِمٍ وَ قَدْ فَهِمْتُ إِنْ شَاءَ اَللَّهُ فَهِمْتُ وَ اَللَّهِ
thaqalaynSanad: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from Abu Hashim al-Ja’fari, said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Imam al-Ridha (a.s), peace be upon him, about the crucified (person). Imam (a.s) said: “Do you not know that my grandfather (a.s), peace be upon him, prayed over his uncle?” I asked: “I know that, but I do not understand it clearly.” Imam (a.s) said: “I will clarify it for you. If the face of the crucified is toward the qiblah, then stand at his right shoulder. And if his back is toward the qiblah, then stand at his left shoulder. Indeed, between the east and the west is a qiblah. So if his left shoulder is toward the qiblah, then stand at his right shoulder. And if his right shoulder is toward the qiblah, then stand at his left shoulder. And however he is turned, do not separate yourself from his shoulders, and let your face be toward what lies between the east and the west (Qiblah). Do not face him directly, and do not turn your back to him at all.” Abu Hashim said: “And I have understood, if Allah (swt) wills. I have understood, by Allah (swt)”.

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer over the Dead
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr from Marwan from Ammar ibn Musa, who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “What do you say about a group of people who were on a journey, walking along the seashore, and suddenly they came upon a dead naked man whom the sea had cast out. However, they themselves were naked, wearing nothing but loincloths. How should they pray over him (Salat Al Mayyit) while he is naked and they do not have an extra cloth to shroud him in? Imam (a.s) said: “A grave should be dug for him and he should be placed in his lahd (side niche of the grave), and bricks (libn) should be placed over his private parts to cover his private parts, with the bricks and with stones. Then the prayer (Salat Al Mayyit) should be performed over him, then he should be buried.” I asked: “Should the prayer not be performed over him after he is buried?” Imam (a.s) said: “The prayer (Salat Al Mayyit) is not performed over the dead after he is buried, and it is not performed over him while he is naked, until his private parts are concealed.”
arabicText: احمد بن محمد بن عيسى عن احمد بن محمد بن ابي نصر عن مروان عن عمار بن موسى قال قلت لابي عبد الله عليه السلام ما تقول في قوم كانوا في سفر لهم يمشون على ساحل البحر فإذا هم برجل ميت عريان قد لفظه البحر وهم عراة وليس عليهم إلا ازار كيف يصلون عليه وهو عريان وليس معهم فضل ثوب يكفنونه؟ قال يحفر له ويوضع في لحده ويوضع اللبن على عورته فيستر عورته باللبن وبالحجر ثم يصلى عليه ثم يدفن قلت فلا يصلى عليه إذا دفن؟ فقال لا يصلى على الميت بعد ما يدفن ولا يصلى عليه وهو عريان حتى توارى عورته
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr from Marwan from Ammar ibn Musa, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “What do you say about a group of people who were on a journey, walking along the seashore, and suddenly they came upon a dead naked man whom the sea had cast out. However, they themselves were naked, wearing nothing but loincloths. How should they pray over him (Salat Al Mayyit) while he is naked and they do not have an extra cloth to shroud him in? Imam (a.s) said: “A grave should be dug for him and he should be placed in his lahd (side niche of the grave), and bricks (libn) should be placed over his private parts to cover his private parts, with the bricks and with stones. Then the prayer (Salat Al Mayyit) should be performed over him, then he should be buried.” I asked: “Should the prayer not be performed over him after he is buried?” Imam (a.s) said: “The prayer (Salat Al Mayyit) is not performed over the dead after he is buried, and it is not performed over him while he is naked, until his private parts are concealed.”
