chapter: Chapter on the Prayer over the Dead
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Sa’ad ibn Abdillah from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from Muhammad ibn Aslam from a man from the people of al-Jazirah who said:
I said to Abu al-Hasan Imam al-Ridha (a.s): “A group was shipwrecked in the sea, and they came out walking along the shore, and suddenly they came upon a dead man; naked. However, the group had nothing on them except towels which they had wrapped around their waists, and they did not have any extra cloth to cover (shroud) the man. So how should they pray over him while he is naked?” Imam (a.s) said: “If they are not able to find a cloth with which to cover his private parts, then they should dig his grave and place him in its lahd (grave niche), and cover his private parts with bricks (libn), or stones, or with soil. Then they should perform the prayer (Salat Al Mayyit) over him, then they should bury him in his grave.” I asked: “Should they not pray over him while he is buried, after he has been buried?” Imam (a.s) said: “No. If that had been permissible for anyone, it would have been permissible for the Messenger of Allah (swt). So the prayer is not performed over someone already buried, nor over someone who is naked.”
arabicText: سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ عَنْ رَجُلٍ مِنْ أَهْلِ اَلْجَزِيرَةِ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي اَلْحَسَنِ اَلرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَوْمٌ كُسِرَ بِهِمْ فِي بَحْرٍ فَخَرَجُوا يَمْشُونَ عَلَى اَلشَّطِّ فَإِذَا هُمْ بِرَجُلٍ مَيِّتٍ عُرْيَانٍ وَاَلْقَوْمُ لَيْسَ عَلَيْهِمْ إِلاَّ مَنَادِيلُ مُتَّزِرِينَ بِهَا وَ لَيْسَ عَلَيْهِمْ فَضْلُ ثَوْبٍ يُوَارُونَ اَلرَّجُلَ فَكَيْفَ يُصَلُّونَ عَلَيْهِ وَ هُوَ عُرْيَانٌ فَقَالَ «إِذَا لَمْ يَقْدِرُوا عَلَى ثَوْبٍ يُوَارُونَ بِهِ عَوْرَتَهُ فَلْيَحْفِرُوا قَبْرَهُ وَ يَضَعُوهُ فِي لَحْدِهِ يُوَارُونَ عَوْرَتَهُ بِلَبِنٍ أَوْ أَحْجَارٍ أَوْ بِتُرَابٍ ثُمَّ يُصَلُّونَ عَلَيْهِ ثُمَّ يُوَارُونَهُ فِي قَبْرِهِ» قُلْتُ وَ لاَ يُصَلُّونَ عَلَيْهِ وَ هُوَ مَدْفُونٌ بَعْدَ مَا يُدْفَنُ قَالَ« لاَ لَوْ جَازَ ذَلِكَ لِأَ حَدٍ لَجَازَ لِرَسُولِ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ فَلاَ يُصَلَّى عَلَى اَلْمَدْفُونِ وَ لاَ عَلَى اَلْعُرْيَانِ»
thaqalaynSanad: Sa’ad ibn Abdillah from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from Muhammad ibn Aslam from a man from the people of al-Jazirah who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I said to Abu al-Hasan Imam al-Ridha (a.s): “A group was shipwrecked in the sea, and they came out walking along the shore, and suddenly they came upon a dead man; naked. However, the group had nothing on them except towels which they had wrapped around their waists, and they did not have any extra cloth to cover (shroud) the man. So how should they pray over him while he is naked?” Imam (a.s) said: “If they are not able to find a cloth with which to cover his private parts, then they should dig his grave and place him in its lahd (grave niche), and cover his private parts with bricks (libn), or stones, or with soil. Then they should perform the prayer (Salat Al Mayyit) over him, then they should bury him in his grave.” I asked: “Should they not pray over him while he is buried, after he has been buried?” Imam (a.s) said: “No. If that had been permissible for anyone, it would have been permissible for the Messenger of Allah (swt). So the prayer is not performed over someone already buried, nor over someone who is naked.”

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer over the Dead
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from al-Nadr ibn Suwayd from Hisham ibn Salim:
I said to Imam al-Sadiq (a.s): “The one who drinks wine, the adulterer, and the thief, should the funeral prayer (Salat Al Mayyit) be performed over them when they die?” Imam (a.s) said: “Yes.”
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ اَلنَّضْرِ بْنِ سُوَيْدٍ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ سَالِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لَهُ شَارِبُ اَلْخَمْرِ وَ اَلزَّانِي وَ اَلسَّارِقُ يُصَلَّى عَلَيْهِمْ إِذَا مَاتُوا فَقَالَ« نَعَمْ»
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from al-Nadr ibn Suwayd from Hisham ibn Salim:
thaqalaynMatn: I said to Imam al-Sadiq (a.s): “The one who drinks wine, the adulterer, and the thief, should the funeral prayer (Salat Al Mayyit) be performed over them when they die?” Imam (a.s) said: “Yes.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 362

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer over the Dead
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Sa’ad from Ayyub ibn Nuh from al-Hasan ibn Mahbub from Ibrahim ibn Mihzam from Talhah ibn Zayd from Abu Abdillah (a.s) from his father (a.s), peace be upon them both, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “Pray over whoever dies from the people of the Qiblah, and his reckoning is upon Allah (swt).”
arabicText: سَعْدٌ عَنْ أَيُّوبَ بْنِ نُوحٍ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ مِهْزَمٍ عَنْ طَلْحَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَلَيْهِمَا اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« صَلِّ عَلَى مَنْ مَاتَ مِنْ أَهْلِ اَلْقِبْلَةِ وَ حِسَابُهُ عَلَى اَللَّهِ»
thaqalaynSanad: Sa’ad from Ayyub ibn Nuh from al-Hasan ibn Mahbub from Ibrahim ibn Mihzam from Talhah ibn Zayd from Abu Abdillah (a.s) from his father (a.s), peace be upon them both, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “Pray over whoever dies from the people of the Qiblah, and his reckoning is upon Allah (swt).”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 362

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer over the Dead
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal from Abu Hammam Isma'il ibn Hammam from Muhammad ibn Sa'id from Ghazwan from al-Sakuni from Imam Ja’far (a.s), from his father (a.s), from his forefathers, peace be upon them, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “The Messenger of Allah (swt), peace be upon him and his family, said: ‘Pray over the one who was stoned to death (rajm) from my nation, and over the one who killed himself (suicide) from my nation. Do not leave anyone from my nation without the funeral prayer.’”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ أَبِي هَمَّامٍ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ هَمَّامٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ غَزْوَانَ عَنِ اَلسَّكُونِيِّ عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ آبَائِهِ عَلَيْهِمُ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ:« صَلُّوا عَلَى اَلْمَرْجُومِ مِنْ أُمَّتِي وَ عَلَى اَلْقَتَّالِ نَفْسَهُ مِنْ أُمَّتِي لاَ تَدَعُوا أَحَداً مِنْ أُمَّتِي بِلاَ صَلاَةٍ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal from Abu Hammam Isma'il ibn Hammam from Muhammad ibn Sa'id from Ghazwan from al-Sakuni from Imam Ja’far (a.s), from his father (a.s), from his forefathers, peace be upon them, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “The Messenger of Allah (swt), peace be upon him and his family, said: ‘Pray over the one who was stoned to death (rajm) from my nation, and over the one who killed himself (suicide) from my nation. Do not leave anyone from my nation without the funeral prayer.’”

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer over the Dead
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Sa’ad ibn Abdillah from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from al-Nadr ibn Suwayd from Khalid ibn Madd al-Qalanisi from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Imam al-Baqir (a.s) about a man who is eaten by a wild beast or a bird, and only his bones remain, without flesh. What should be done with him? Imam (a.s) said: “He should be washed, shrouded, prayed over, and buried. And if the deceased is in two halves, the prayer (Salat Al Mayyit) should be performed over the half that contains his heart.”
arabicText: سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنِ اَلنَّضْرِ بْنِ سُوَيْدٍ عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ مَادٍّ اَلْقَلاَنِسِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يَأْكُلُهُ اَلسَّبُعُ أَوِ اَلطَّيْرُ فَتَبْقَى عِظَامُهُ بِغَيْرِ لَحْمٍ كَيْفَ يُصْنَعُ بِهِ قَالَ« يُغَسَّلُ وَ يُكَفَّنُ وَ يُصَلَّى عَلَيْهِ وَ يُدْفَنُ فَإِذَا كَانَ اَلْمَيِّتُ نِصْفَيْنِ صُلِّيَ عَلَى اَلنِّصْفِ اَلَّذِي فِيهِ قَلْبُهُ»
thaqalaynSanad: Sa’ad ibn Abdillah from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from al-Nadr ibn Suwayd from Khalid ibn Madd al-Qalanisi from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Imam al-Baqir (a.s) about a man who is eaten by a wild beast or a bird, and only his bones remain, without flesh. What should be done with him? Imam (a.s) said: “He should be washed, shrouded, prayed over, and buried. And if the deceased is in two halves, the prayer (Salat Al Mayyit) should be performed over the half that contains his heart.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 363

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer over the Dead
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText: Muhammad ibn Yahya from al-Amraki al-Bufaki from Ali ibn Ja’far from his brother Imam Musa ibn Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon them both: the same as that.
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى عَنِ اَلْعَمْرَكِيِّ اَلْبُوفَكِيِّ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَخِيهِ مُوسَى بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِمَا اَلسَّلاَمُ: مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ.
thaqalaynMatn: Muhammad ibn Yahya from al-Amraki al-Bufaki from Ali ibn Ja’far from his brother Imam Musa ibn Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon them both: the same as that.

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 363

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer over the Dead
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa from al-Abbas ibn Ma'ruf from Talhah ibn Zayd:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “The funeral prayer is not performed over a limb of a man, whether a leg, or a hand, or a head, when it is separate (from the body). But if the body is present, then pray over it, even if it is missing the head, the hand, and the leg.” (meaning the body containing the heart)
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنِ اَلْعَبَّاسِ بْنِ مَعْرُوفٍ عَنْ طَلْحَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ:« لاَ يُصَلَّى عَلَى عُضْوِ رَجُلٍ مِنْ رِجْلٍ أَوْ يَدٍ أَوْ رَأْسٍ مُنْفَرِداً فَإِذَا كَانَ اَلْبَدَنُ فَصَلِّ عَلَيْهِ وَ إِنْ كَانَ نَاقِصاً مِنَ اَلرَّأْسِ وَ اَلْيَدِ وَ اَلرِّجْلِ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa from al-Abbas ibn Ma'ruf from Talhah ibn Zayd:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “The funeral prayer is not performed over a limb of a man, whether a leg, or a hand, or a head, when it is separate (from the body). But if the body is present, then pray over it, even if it is missing the head, the hand, and the leg.” (meaning the body containing the heart)

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 363

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer over the Dead
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Abbas ibn Ma'ruf from Muhammad ibn Sinan from Abu al-Jarrah Talhah ibn Zayd from al-Fadl ibn Uthman al-A‘war from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) was asked regarding a man who is killed and his head is found in one tribe (away from the body). Imam (a.s) said: “His blood money (diyah) is upon the tribe in which his chest and his hands are found, and the funeral prayer is performed over him.” (meaning the place where the chest is found)
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اَلْعَبَّاسِ بْنِ مَعْرُوفٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي اَلْجَرَّاحِ طَلْحَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ عَنِ اَلْفَضْلِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ اَلْأَعْوَرِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: فِي اَلرَّجُلِ يُقْتَلُ فَيُوجَدُ رَأْسُهُ فِي قَبِيلَةٍ قَالَ« دِيَتُهُ عَلَى مَنْ وُجِدَ فِي قَبِيلَتِهِ صَدْرُهُ وَ يَدَاهُ وَ اَلصَّلاَةُ عَلَيْهِ»
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Abbas ibn Ma'ruf from Muhammad ibn Sinan from Abu al-Jarrah Talhah ibn Zayd from al-Fadl ibn Uthman al-A‘war from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) was asked regarding a man who is killed and his head is found in one tribe (away from the body). Imam (a.s) said: “His blood money (diyah) is upon the tribe in which his chest and his hands are found, and the funeral prayer is performed over him.” (meaning the place where the chest is found)

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 363

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer over the Dead
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Sa’ad ibn Abdillah from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from al-Sindi ibn al-Rabi' from Ali ibn Ahmad ibn Abi Nasr from his father from Jamil ibn Darraj from Muhammad ibn Muslim from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him:
Imam al-Baqir (a.s) said: “If a person is killed and only flesh, without bone, is found. Then the funeral prayer is not performed over him. But if bone is found without flesh, the funeral prayer is performed over him.”
arabicText: سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنِ اَلسِّنْدِيِّ بْنِ اَلرَّبِيعِ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ أَبِي نَصْرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ جَمِيلِ بْنِ دَرَّاجٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« إِذَا قُتِلَ قَتِيلٌ فَلَمْ يُوجَدْ إِلاَّ لَحْمٌ بِلاَ عَظْمٍ لَمْ يُصَلَّ عَلَيْهِ فَإِنْ وُجِدَ عَظْمٌ بِلاَ لَحْمٍ صُلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ»
thaqalaynSanad: Sa’ad ibn Abdillah from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from al-Sindi ibn al-Rabi' from Ali ibn Ahmad ibn Abi Nasr from his father from Jamil ibn Darraj from Muhammad ibn Muslim from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Baqir (a.s) said: “If a person is killed and only flesh, without bone, is found. Then the funeral prayer is not performed over him. But if bone is found without flesh, the funeral prayer is performed over him.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 364

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer over the Dead
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from al-Hasan ibn Musa al-Khasshab from Ghiyath ibn Kallub al-Bajali from Ishaq ibn Ammar from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “Indeed, Imam Ali (a.s), peace be upon him, found parts of a dead body, so they were gathered, then He (a.s) performed the funeral prayer over them, then they were buried.”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ مُوسَى اَلْخَشَّابِ عَنْ غِيَاثِ بْنِ كَلُّوبٍ اَلْبَجَلِيِّ عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ:« أَنَّ عَلِيّاً عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ وَجَدَ قِطَعاً مِنْ مَيِّتٍ فَجُمِعَتْ ثُمَّ صَلَّى عَلَيْهَا ثُمَّ دُفِنَتْ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from al-Hasan ibn Musa al-Khasshab from Ghiyath ibn Kallub al-Bajali from Ishaq ibn Ammar from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “Indeed, Imam Ali (a.s), peace be upon him, found parts of a dead body, so they were gathered, then He (a.s) performed the funeral prayer over them, then they were buried.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 364

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer over the Dead
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa from Muhammad ibn Khalid from Khalaf ibn Hammad from Abdillah ibn Sinan from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “When Adam (a.s), peace be upon him, died and the time came to pray over him, Hibatullah (his son) said to Jibra'il (a.s), peace be upon him: 'Step forward, O’ Messenger (angel) of Allah (swt), and perform the prayer over the Prophet of Allah (swt).' So Jibra'il (a.s), peace be upon him, said: “Indeed, Allah (swt) commanded us to prostrate to your father (Adam (a.s)), so we do not go ahead of the righteous among his children, and you are among the most righteous of them.” So Hibatullah stepped forward and said takbir over him (Adam (a.s)) five times, equal to the number of the prayers which Allah (swt) has made obligatory upon the nation of (Prophet) Muhammad (saws), and this became the ongoing sunnah among his children (Children of Adam (a.s)) until the Day of Resurrection.”
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ عَنْ خَلَفِ بْنِ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« لَمَّا مَاتَ آدَمُ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ فَبَلَغَ إِلَى اَلصَّلاَةِ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالَ هِبَةُ اَللَّهِ لِجَبْرَئِيلَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ تَقَدَّمْ يَا رَسُولَ اَللَّهِ فَصَلِّ عَلَى نَبِيِّ اَللَّهِ فَقَالَ جَبْرَئِيلُ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ إِنَّ اَللَّهَ أَمَرَنَا بِالسُّجُودِ لِأَ بِيكَ فَلَسْنَا نَتَقَدَّمُ عَلَى أَبْرَارِ وُلْدِهِ وَ أَنْتَ مِنْ أَبَرِّهِمْ فَتَقَدَّمَ فَكَبَّرَ عَلَيْهِ خَمْساً عِدَّةَ اَلصَّلاَةِ اَلَّتِي فَرَضَهَا اَللَّهُ عَلَى أُمَّةِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ هِيَ اَلسُّنَّةُ اَلْجَارِيَةُ فِي وُلْدِهِ إِلَى يَوْمِ اَلْقِيَامَةِ»
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa from Muhammad ibn Khalid from Khalaf ibn Hammad from Abdillah ibn Sinan from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “When Adam (a.s), peace be upon him, died and the time came to pray over him, Hibatullah (his son) said to Jibra'il (a.s), peace be upon him: 'Step forward, O’ Messenger (angel) of Allah (swt), and perform the prayer over the Prophet of Allah (swt).' So Jibra'il (a.s), peace be upon him, said: “Indeed, Allah (swt) commanded us to prostrate to your father (Adam (a.s)), so we do not go ahead of the righteous among his children, and you are among the most righteous of them.” So Hibatullah stepped forward and said takbir over him (Adam (a.s)) five times, equal to the number of the prayers which Allah (swt) has made obligatory upon the nation of (Prophet) Muhammad (saws), and this became the ongoing sunnah among his children (Children of Adam (a.s)) until the Day of Resurrection.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 364

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer over the Dead
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal from Amr ibn Sa’id al-Mada'ini from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah from Ammar ibn Musa al-Sabati from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
I asked Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) about the prayer over the deceased. Imam (a.s) said: “You say takbir, then you say: ‘Indeed, we belong to Allah (swt), and indeed to Him (azj) we return. Indeed, Allah (swt) and His (azj) angels send blessings upon the Prophet (saws). O’ you who have believed, send blessings upon him and greet him with peace. O’ Allah (swt), send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), And bless Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), just as You (azj) sent blessings and bestowed blessings upon Ibrahim (a.s) and the family of Ibrahim (a.s). Indeed, You (azj) are Praiseworthy, Glorious. O’ Allah (swt), send blessings upon Muhammad (saws) and upon the leaders of the Muslims (meaning Imams (a.s)). O’ Allah (swt), send blessings upon Muhammad (saws) and upon the Imam (a.s) of the Muslims. O’ Allah (swt), Your servant ‘so-and-so’ (the deceased) and You (azj) know him best. O’ Allah (swt), join him with his Prophet Muhammad (saws), may Allah (swt) send blessings upon him and his family, And make spacious for him his grave, And illuminate it for him, And raise his soul, And prompt him with his proof, And make what is with You (azj) better for him. And return him to better than what he was in. O’ Allah (swt), with You (azj) we count him, so do not deprive us of his reward and do not test us after him. O’ Allah (swt), Your pardon, Your pardon.’ (Imam (a.s) then continued) “You say all of this in the first takbir, then you say the second takbir and you say: ‘O’ Allah (swt), Your servant ‘so-and-so’ (the deceased), O’ Allah (swt), join him with his Prophet Muhammad (saws), may Allah (swt) send blessings upon him and his family, And make spacious for him his grave, And illuminate it for him, And raise his soul, And prompt him with his proof, And make what is with You (azj) better for him, And return him to better than what he was in. O’ Allah (swt), with You (azj) we count him, so do not deprive us of his reward. And do not test us after him. O’ Allah (swt), Your pardon, O’ Allah (swt), Your pardon.’ (Imam (a.s) then continued) “You say this in the second, third, and fourth takbir. Then when you say the fifth takbir, say: ‘O’ Allah (swt), send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws). O’ Allah (swt), forgive the believing men and believing women. O’ Allah (swt), unite their hearts and cause me to die upon the religion of Your Messenger (saws). O’ Allah (swt), forgive us and our brothers who preceded us in faith, and do not place in our hearts any resentment toward those who have believed. Our Lord (azj), indeed You (azj) are Kind and Merciful. O’ Allah (swt), Your pardon, O’ Allah (swt), Your pardon.’ And you give the final salutation.”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدٍ اَلْمَدَائِنِيِّ عَنْ مُصَدِّقِ بْنِ صَدَقَةَ عَنْ عَمَّارِ بْنِ مُوسَى اَلسَّابَاطِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلصَّلاَةِ عَلَى اَلْمَيِّتِ فَقَالَ« تُكَبِّرُ ثُمَّ تَقُولُ «إِنّٰا لِلّٰهِ وَإِنّٰا إِلَيْهِ رٰاجِعُونَ»« إِنَّ اَللّٰهَ وَمَلاٰئِكَتَهُ يُصَلُّونَ عَلَى اَلنَّبِيِّ يٰا أَيُّهَا اَلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا صَلُّوا عَلَيْهِ وَسَلِّمُوا تَسْلِيماً» اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ وَبَارَكْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَآلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ عَلَى أَئِمَّةِ اَلْمُسْلِمِينَ اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ عَلَى إِمَامِ اَلْمُسْلِمِينَ اَللَّهُمَّ عَبْدُكَ فُلاَنٌ وَ أَنْتَ أَعْلَمُ بِهِ اَللَّهُمَّ أَلْحِقْهُ بِنَبِيِّهِ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ وَ اِفْسَحْ لَهُ فِي قَبْرِهِ وَ نَوِّرْ لَهُ فِيهِ وَ صَعِّدْ رُوحَهُ وَ لَقِّنْهُ حُجَّتَهُ وَ اِجْعَلْ مَا عِنْدَكَ خَيْراً لَهُ وَ اِرْجِعْهُ إِلَى خَيْرٍ مِمَّا كَانَ فِيهِ اَللَّهُمَّ عِنْدَكَ نَحْتَسِبُهُ فَلاَ تَحْرِمْنَا أَجْرَهُ وَ لاَ تَفْتِنَّا بَعْدَهُ اَللَّهُمَّ عَفْوَكَ عَفْوَكَ تَقُولُ هَذَا كُلَّهُ فِي اَلتَّكْبِيرَةِ اَلْأُولَى ثُمَّ تُكَبِّرُ اَلثَّانِيَةَ وَ تَقُولُ اَللَّهُمَّ عَبْدُكَ فُلاَنٌ اَللَّهُمَّ أَلْحِقْهُ بِنَبِيِّهِ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ وَاِفْسَحْ لَهُ فِي قَبْرِهِ وَنَوِّرْ لَهُ فِيهِ وَ صَعِّدْ رُوحَهُ وَلَقِّنْهُ حُجَّتَهُ وَ اِجْعَلْ مَا عِنْدَكَ خَيْراً لَهُ وَ اِرْجِعْهُ إِلَى خَيْرٍ مِمَّا كَانَ فِيهِ اَللَّهُمَّ عِنْدَكَ نَحْتَسِبُهُ فَلاَ تَحْرِمْنَا أَجْرَهُ وَ لاَ تَفْتِنَّا بَعْدَهُ اَللَّهُمَّ عَفْوَكَ اَللَّهُمَّ عَفْوَكَ تَقُولُ هَذَا فِي اَلثَّانِيَةِ وَ اَلثَّالِثَةِ وَ اَلرَّابِعَةِ فَإِذَا كَبَّرْتَ اَلْخَامِسَةَ فَقُلِ اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ اَللَّهُمَّ اِغْفِرْ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَاَلْمُؤْمِنَاتِ اَللَّهُمَّ أَلِّفْ بَيْنَ قُلُوبِهِمْ وَ تَوَفَّنِي عَلَى مِلَّةِ رَسُولِكَ اَللَّهُمَّ« اِغْفِرْ لَنٰا وَ لِإِخْوٰانِنَا اَلَّذِينَ سَبَقُونٰا بِالْإِيمٰانِ وَ لاٰ تَجْعَلْ فِي قُلُوبِنٰا غِلاًّ لِلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا رَبَّنٰا إِنَّكَ رَؤُفٌ رَحِيمٌ» اَللَّهُمَّ عَفْوَكَ اَللَّهُمَّ عَفْوَكَ وَ تُسَلِّمُ»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ahmad from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal from Amr ibn Sa’id al-Mada'ini from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah from Ammar ibn Musa al-Sabati from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) about the prayer over the deceased. Imam (a.s) said: “You say takbir, then you say: ‘Indeed, we belong to Allah (swt), and indeed to Him (azj) we return. Indeed, Allah (swt) and His (azj) angels send blessings upon the Prophet (saws). O’ you who have believed, send blessings upon him and greet him with peace. O’ Allah (swt), send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), And bless Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), just as You (azj) sent blessings and bestowed blessings upon Ibrahim (a.s) and the family of Ibrahim (a.s). Indeed, You (azj) are Praiseworthy, Glorious. O’ Allah (swt), send blessings upon Muhammad (saws) and upon the leaders of the Muslims (meaning Imams (a.s)). O’ Allah (swt), send blessings upon Muhammad (saws) and upon the Imam (a.s) of the Muslims. O’ Allah (swt), Your servant ‘so-and-so’ (the deceased) and You (azj) know him best. O’ Allah (swt), join him with his Prophet Muhammad (saws), may Allah (swt) send blessings upon him and his family, And make spacious for him his grave, And illuminate it for him, And raise his soul, And prompt him with his proof, And make what is with You (azj) better for him. And return him to better than what he was in. O’ Allah (swt), with You (azj) we count him, so do not deprive us of his reward and do not test us after him. O’ Allah (swt), Your pardon, Your pardon.’ (Imam (a.s) then continued) “You say all of this in the first takbir, then you say the second takbir and you say: ‘O’ Allah (swt), Your servant ‘so-and-so’ (the deceased), O’ Allah (swt), join him with his Prophet Muhammad (saws), may Allah (swt) send blessings upon him and his family, And make spacious for him his grave, And illuminate it for him, And raise his soul, And prompt him with his proof, And make what is with You (azj) better for him, And return him to better than what he was in. O’ Allah (swt), with You (azj) we count him, so do not deprive us of his reward. And do not test us after him. O’ Allah (swt), Your pardon, O’ Allah (swt), Your pardon.’ (Imam (a.s) then continued) “You say this in the second, third, and fourth takbir. Then when you say the fifth takbir, say: ‘O’ Allah (swt), send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws). O’ Allah (swt), forgive the believing men and believing women. O’ Allah (swt), unite their hearts and cause me to die upon the religion of Your Messenger (saws). O’ Allah (swt), forgive us and our brothers who preceded us in faith, and do not place in our hearts any resentment toward those who have believed. Our Lord (azj), indeed You (azj) are Kind and Merciful. O’ Allah (swt), Your pardon, O’ Allah (swt), Your pardon.’ And you give the final salutation.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 364

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer over the Dead
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Ibrahim ibn Hashim from al-Nawfali from al-Sakuni from Imam Ja’far (a.s) from his forefathers (a.s), peace be upon them, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “A child inherits and the funeral prayer is performed over him if he falls from his mother's womb (birth) and cries aloud. But if he does not cry aloud (stillborn), he is neither inherited from nor is the funeral prayer performed over him.”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ هَاشِمٍ عَنِ اَلنَّوْفَلِيِّ عَنِ اَلسَّكُونِيِّ عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ آبَائِهِ عَلَيْهِمُ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« يُورَثُ اَلصَّبِيُّ وَ يُصَلَّى عَلَيْهِ إِذَا سَقَطَ مِنْ بَطْنِ أُمِّهِ فَاسْتَهَلَّ صَارِخاً وَ إِذَا لَمْ يَسْتَهِلَّ صَارِخاً لَمْ يُوَرَّثْ وَ لَمْ يُصَلَّ عَلَيْهِ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Ibrahim ibn Hashim from al-Nawfali from al-Sakuni from Imam Ja’far (a.s) from his forefathers (a.s), peace be upon them, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “A child inherits and the funeral prayer is performed over him if he falls from his mother's womb (birth) and cries aloud. But if he does not cry aloud (stillborn), he is neither inherited from nor is the funeral prayer performed over him.”

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer over the Dead
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from a man from Abu al-Hasan al-Madi (a.s) said:
I said to Imam (a.s): “For how old is a child prayed over (for Salat Al Mayyit), if he has reached a certain number of years or months?” Imam (a.s) said: “The funeral prayer is performed over him in every case, unless he is miscarried before completion (birth).”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ رَجُلٍ عَنْ أَبِي اَلْحَسَنِ اَلْمَاضِي عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لَهُ لِكَمْ يُصَلَّى عَلَى اَلصَّبِيِّ إِذَا بَلَغَ مِنَ اَلسِّنِينَ وَ اَلشُّهُورِ قَالَ« يُصَلَّى عَلَيْهِ عَلَى كُلِّ حَالٍ إِلاَّ أَنْ يَسْقُطَ لِغَيْرِ تَمَامٍ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from a man from Abu al-Hasan al-Madi (a.s) said:
thaqalaynMatn: I said to Imam (a.s): “For how old is a child prayed over (for Salat Al Mayyit), if he has reached a certain number of years or months?” Imam (a.s) said: “The funeral prayer is performed over him in every case, unless he is miscarried before completion (birth).”

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer over the Dead
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Yaqtin from his brother al-Husayn ibn Ali ibn Yaqtin:
I asked Abu al-Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him: “For how old is a child prayed over (for Salat Al Mayyit), if he has reached a certain number of years and months?” Imam (a.s) said: “The funeral prayer is performed over him in every case, unless he is miscarried before completion (birth).”
arabicText: احمد بن محمد عن الحسن بن علي بن يقطين عن اخيه الحسين بن علي بن يقطين قال سألت ابا الحسن ع ل كم يصلى على الصبي إذا بلغ من السنين والشهور؟ قال يصلى عليه على كل حال إلا أن يسقط لغير تمام
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Yaqtin from his brother al-Husayn ibn Ali ibn Yaqtin:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu al-Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him: “For how old is a child prayed over (for Salat Al Mayyit), if he has reached a certain number of years and months?” Imam (a.s) said: “The funeral prayer is performed over him in every case, unless he is miscarried before completion (birth).”

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer over the Dead
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn Hadid and Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Najran from Hurayz from Zurarah:
I said to Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him: “May a woman lead women in prayer?” Imam (a.s) said: “No, except over the deceased, if there is no one more appropriate than her (to lead the prayer). She stands in the middle of them in the (same) row with them, and says the takbir, and they say the takbir.”
arabicText: احمد بن محمد عن علي بن حديد وعبد الرحمن بن ابي نجران عن حريز عن زرارة قال قلت لابي جعفر عليه السلام المرأة تؤم النساء؟ قال لا إلا على الميت إذا لم يكن أحد أولى منها تقوم وسطهن في الصف معهن فتكبر ويكبرن
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn Hadid and Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Najran from Hurayz from Zurarah:
thaqalaynMatn: I said to Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him: “May a woman lead women in prayer?” Imam (a.s) said: “No, except over the deceased, if there is no one more appropriate than her (to lead the prayer). She stands in the middle of them in the (same) row with them, and says the takbir, and they say the takbir.”

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer over the Dead
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ya‘qub from Ali ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn Shirah from Muhammad ibn Sulayman from Husayn al-Marjusi from Hisham, who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “The people speak to us and refute our statement that the funeral prayer is not performed over the child because he did not pray, and they ask (us): ‘The funeral prayer is only for one who has prayed?.’ So we say: ‘Yes.’ Then they ask (us): ‘What do you say if a Christian or Jew embraces Islam and then dies immediately, what is the ruling in his case?’” Imam (a.s) said: “Say to them: ‘What do you say if someone embraces Islam just now and then slanders a person, would the prescribed punishment (hadd) be obligatory upon him for his slander?’ They will say (to you): ‘The hadd is obligatory upon him.’ Then say to them: ‘What if this child, who did not pray, were to slander a person. Would the hadd be obligatory upon him?’ They will say: ‘No.’ Then say to them: ‘You have (now) spoken the truth. The funeral prayer is only obligatory for the one upon whom the prayer and the hadd are obligatory, and it is not performed for the one upon whom neither the prayer nor the hadd are obligatory.’”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ شِيرَةَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سُلَيْمَانَ عَنْ حُسَيْنٍ اَلْمَرْجُوسِ عَنْ هِشَامٍ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ إِنَّ اَلنَّاسَ يُكَلِّمُونَّا وَ يَرُدُّونَ عَلَيْنَا قَوْلَنَا إِنَّهُ لاَ يُصَلَّى عَلَى اَلطِّفْلِ لِأَنَّهُ لَمْ يُصَلِّ فَيَقُولُونَ لاَ يُصَلَّى إِلاَّ عَلَى مَنْ صَلَّى فَنَقُولُ نَعَمْ فَيَقُولُونَ أَ رَأَيْتُمْ لَوْ أَنَّ رَجُلاً نَصْرَانِيّاً أَوْ يَهُودِيّاً أَسْلَمَ ثُمَّ مَاتَ مِنْ سَاعَتِهِ فَمَا اَلْجَوَابُ فِيهِ فَقَالَ« قُولُوا لَهُمْ أَ رَأَيْتَ لَوْ أَنَّ هَذَا اَلَّذِي أَسْلَمَ اَلسَّاعَةَ ثُمَّ اِفْتَرَى عَلَى إِنْسَانٍ هَلْ كَانَ يَجِبُ عَلَيْهِ فِي فِرْيَتِهِ فَإِنَّهُمْ سَيَقُولُونَ يَجِبُ عَلَيْهِ اَلْحَدُّ فَإِذَا قَالُوا هَذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ فَلَوْ أَنَّ هَذَا اَلصَّبِيَّ اَلَّذِي لَمْ يُصَلِّ اِفْتَرَى عَلَى إِنْسَانٍ هَلْ كَانَ يَجِبُ عَلَيْهِ اَلْحَدُّ فَإِنَّهُمْ سَيَقُولُونَ لاَ فَيُقَالُ لَهُمْ صَدَقْتُمْ إِنَّمَا يَجِبُ أَنْ يُصَلَّى عَلَى مَنْ وَجَبَتْ عَلَيْهِ اَلصَّلاَةُ وَ اَلْحَدُّ وَ لاَ يُصَلَّى عَلَى مَنْ لَمْ تَجِبْ عَلَيْهِ اَلصَّلاَةُ وَ لاَ اَلْحُدُودُ»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ya‘qub from Ali ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn Shirah from Muhammad ibn Sulayman from Husayn al-Marjusi from Hisham, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “The people speak to us and refute our statement that the funeral prayer is not performed over the child because he did not pray, and they ask (us): ‘The funeral prayer is only for one who has prayed?.’ So we say: ‘Yes.’ Then they ask (us): ‘What do you say if a Christian or Jew embraces Islam and then dies immediately, what is the ruling in his case?’” Imam (a.s) said: “Say to them: ‘What do you say if someone embraces Islam just now and then slanders a person, would the prescribed punishment (hadd) be obligatory upon him for his slander?’ They will say (to you): ‘The hadd is obligatory upon him.’ Then say to them: ‘What if this child, who did not pray, were to slander a person. Would the hadd be obligatory upon him?’ They will say: ‘No.’ Then say to them: ‘You have (now) spoken the truth. The funeral prayer is only obligatory for the one upon whom the prayer and the hadd are obligatory, and it is not performed for the one upon whom neither the prayer nor the hadd are obligatory.’”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 366

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer over the Dead
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya from Abu Ja’far from his father from Wahb ibn Wahb from Imam Ja’far (a.s) from his father (a.s), peace be upon them both:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “Indeed, the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, prayed over a funeral. When Prophet (saws) finished, a group of people came to Him (saws) and said: ‘O’ Messenger of Allah (swt), we did not catch the prayer (Salat Al Mayyit) over it.’ Prophet (saws) said: ‘The funeral is not prayed over twice, but you may supplicate for it (the deceased)’.”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ وَهْبِ بْنِ وَهْبٍ عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَلَيْهِمَا اَلسَّلاَمُ:« أَنَّ رَسُولَ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ صَلَّى عَلَى جِنَازَةٍ فَلَمَّا فَرَغَ جَاءَهُ أُنَاسٌ فَقَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اَللَّهِ لَمْ نُدْرِكِ اَلصَّلاَةَ عَلَيْهَا فَقَالَ« لاَ يُصَلَّى عَلَى جِنَازَةٍ مَرَّتَيْنِ وَ لَكِنِ اُدْعُوا لَهَا»»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya from Abu Ja’far from his father from Wahb ibn Wahb from Imam Ja’far (a.s) from his father (a.s), peace be upon them both:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “Indeed, the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, prayed over a funeral. When Prophet (saws) finished, a group of people came to Him (saws) and said: ‘O’ Messenger of Allah (swt), we did not catch the prayer (Salat Al Mayyit) over it.’ Prophet (saws) said: ‘The funeral is not prayed over twice, but you may supplicate for it (the deceased)’.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 367

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer over the Dead
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Harun ibn Muslim from Mas'adah ibn Sadaqah from Imam Ja’far (a.s) from his forefathers (a.s), peace be upon them:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “Indeed, Imam Ali (a.s), peace be upon him, did not wash Ammar ibn Yasir nor Hashim ibn Utbah, who was al-Mirqal. He (a.s) buried them in their clothes with their blood,” And did not perform the funeral prayer over them.”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ هَارُونَ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ مَسْعَدَةَ بْنِ صَدَقَةَ عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ آبَائِهِ عَلَيْهِمُ اَلسَّلاَمُ:« أَنَّ عَلِيّاً عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ لَمْ يُغَسِّلْ عَمَّارَ بْنَ يَاسِرٍ وَ لاَ هَاشِمَ بْنَ عُتْبَةَ وَ هُوَ اَلْمِرْقَالُ دَفَنَهُمَا فِي ثِيَابِهِمَا بِدِمَائِهِمَا وَ لَمْ يُصَلِّ عَلَيْهِمَا»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Harun ibn Muslim from Mas'adah ibn Sadaqah from Imam Ja’far (a.s) from his forefathers (a.s), peace be upon them:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “Indeed, Imam Ali (a.s), peace be upon him, did not wash Ammar ibn Yasir nor Hashim ibn Utbah, who was al-Mirqal. He (a.s) buried them in their clothes with their blood,” And did not perform the funeral prayer over them.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 367

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer over the Dead
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Faddal from Muhammad ibn Ali from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Ghiyath ibn Ibrahim from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, from his father (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam (a.s) said: “There is no funeral prayer over a bier, that has a woman with it.”
arabicText: عَلِيُّ بْنُ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ غِيَاثِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: قَالَ:« لاَ صَلاَةَ عَلَى جِنَازَةٍ مَعَهَا اِمْرَأَةٌ
thaqalaynSanad: Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Faddal from Muhammad ibn Ali from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Ghiyath ibn Ibrahim from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, from his father (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: “There is no funeral prayer over a bier, that has a woman with it.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 367

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer over the Dead
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ali ibn al-Hasan from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Najran and Sindi ibn Muhammad and Muhammad ibn al-Walid, all from Asim ibn Humayd from Yazid ibn Khalifah, who said:
I was with Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, when a man from the people of Qumm asked Imam (a.s) and said: “O’ Abu Abdillah, do women pray over the deceased?” So Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: “Indeed, the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, had declared the blood of al-Mughirah ibn Abi al-As to be lawfully shed,” and Imam (a.s) narrated a long hadith, “and indeed, Zaynab the daughter of the Prophet (saws), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, passed away, and (Sayyidah) Fatimah (s.a), peace be upon her, went out with her women and prayed over her sister.”
arabicText: عَلِيُّ بْنُ اَلْحَسَنِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَلرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي نَجْرَانَ وَ سِنْدِيِّ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَمُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْوَلِيدِ جَمِيعاً عَنْ عَاصِمِ بْنِ حُمَيْدٍ عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ خَلِيفَةَ قَالَ: كُنْتُ عِنْدَ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ فَسَأَلَهُ رَجُلٌ مِنَ اَلْقُمِّيِّينَ فَقَالَ يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ تُصَلِّي اَلنِّسَاءُ عَلَى اَلْجَنَائِزِ قَالَ فَقَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ« إِنَّ رَسُولَ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ كَانَ هَدَرَ دَمَ اَلْمُغِيرَةِ بْنِ أَبِي اَلْعَاصِ» وَ حَدَّثَ حَدِيثاً طَوِيلاً« وَ إِنَّ زَيْنَبَ بِنْتَ اَلنَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ تُوُفِّيَتْ وَ إِنَّ فَاطِمَةَ عَلَيْهَا اَلسَّلاَمُ خَرَجَتْ فِي نِسَائِهَا فَصَلَّتْ عَلَى أُخْتِهَا»
thaqalaynSanad: Ali ibn al-Hasan from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Najran and Sindi ibn Muhammad and Muhammad ibn al-Walid, all from Asim ibn Humayd from Yazid ibn Khalifah, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I was with Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, when a man from the people of Qumm asked Imam (a.s) and said: “O’ Abu Abdillah, do women pray over the deceased?” So Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: “Indeed, the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, had declared the blood of al-Mughirah ibn Abi al-As to be lawfully shed,” and Imam (a.s) narrated a long hadith, “and indeed, Zaynab the daughter of the Prophet (saws), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, passed away, and (Sayyidah) Fatimah (s.a), peace be upon her, went out with her women and prayed over her sister.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 367

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer over the Dead
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from al-Abbas ibn Amir from Abu al-Mi'za from Sama'ah from Abu Basir from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “It is not appropriate for a young woman to go out to a funeral to pray over it, unless she is a woman who has reached a older age.”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنِ اَلْعَبَّاسِ بْنِ عَامِرٍ عَنْ أَبِي اَلْمِعْزَى عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ:« لَيْسَ يَنْبَغِي لِلْمَرْأَةِ اَلشَّابَّةِ أَنْ تَخْرُجَ إِلَى اَلْجِنَازَةِ تُصَلِّي عَلَيْهَا إِلاَّ أَنْ تَكُونَ اِمْرَأَةً قَدْ دَخَلَتْ فِي اَلسِّنِّ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from al-Abbas ibn Amir from Abu al-Mi'za from Sama'ah from Abu Basir from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “It is not appropriate for a young woman to go out to a funeral to pray over it, unless she is a woman who has reached a older age.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 368

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer over the Dead
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ali ibn al-Hasan from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan from Amr ibn Sa’id from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah from Ammar al-Sabati from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “The deceased may be prayed over, as long as he has not been covered with soil (in his grave), even if the prayer has already been performed over him.”
arabicText: عَلِيُّ بْنُ اَلْحَسَنِ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ اَلْحَسَنِ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُصَدِّقِ بْنِ صَدَقَةَ عَنْ عَمَّارٍ اَلسَّابَاطِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« اَلْمَيِّتُ يُصَلَّى عَلَيْهِ مَا لَمْ يُوَارَ بِالتُّرَابِ وَ إِنْ كَانَ قَدْ صُلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ»
thaqalaynSanad: Ali ibn al-Hasan from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan from Amr ibn Sa’id from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah from Ammar al-Sabati from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “The deceased may be prayed over, as long as he has not been covered with soil (in his grave), even if the prayer has already been performed over him.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 368

chapter: Chapter on the Prayer over the Dead
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Muhammad ibn al-Walid from Yunus ibn Ya'qub from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) about a funeral that I did not catch, until it reached the grave. Should I pray over it? Imam (a.s) said: “If you reach it before it is buried, then if you wish, you may pray over it.”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْوَلِيدِ عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلْجَنَازَةِ لَمْ أُدْرِكْهَا حَتَّى بَلَغَتِ اَلْقَبْرَ أُصَلِّي عَلَيْهَا قَالَ« إِنْ أَدْرَكْتَهَا قَبْلَ أَنْ تُدْفَنَ فَإِنْ شِئْتَ فَصَلِّ عَلَيْهَا»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Muhammad ibn al-Walid from Yunus ibn Ya'qub from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) about a funeral that I did not catch, until it reached the grave. Should I pray over it? Imam (a.s) said: “If you reach it before it is buried, then if you wish, you may pray over it.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 3, p. 369
